items.title: Abid na kabhi
items.body:
abid na kabhi tauq-o-zanjeer pe roye

dil thaam ke tanhaai e shabbir pe roye
haan bekasi e hazrate…

items.title: Ay qatile shabbir
items.body:
ay shimr e layeen tu kya kaat raha hai

ay qaatil e shabbir tu kya kaat raha hai

sheh rag nahi tu zikre khuda kaat raha hai
ay qaatil e shabbir...

kya jurm hai kyun sakht saza kaat raha hai
ay qaatil e shabbir...

har zarra hi kaante ki tarha kaat raha hai

items.title: Bhai ki nazar
items.body:
bhai ki nazar kehti hai bhai ki nazar se
gar izn ho darya idhar aajaye udhar se

har daure bala qaid may ye sheh ke azadaar
zinda hai to zehra ki duaon ke asar se
bhai ki nazar kehti...

hai ashke ghame sheh ki tarha khaabile tazeem
wo khoon jo matam may bahay seena-o-sar se
bhai ki nazar kehti...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ke baazu hi qalam hogaye warna
cheeni nahi jaati kabhi chadar kisi sar se
bhai ki nazar kehti...
<<DIVIDER>>
gehware se be-dast gira kaise zameen par
us karb ko pooche koi sarwar ke jigar se
bhai ki nazar kehti...

kano may bahot dard raha phir bhi sakina
jee bhar ke kabhi ro na saki shimr ke darr se
bhai ki nazar kehti...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad ka har naqshe khadam khoon se ubhra
zanjeer uthaye hue guzre hai jidhar se
bhai ki nazar kehti...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye tarbiyat e majlis e sarwar hai ke shahid
waaqif hue aadaab e sama'at ke hunar se
bhai ki nazar kehti...

items.title: Daastan gham ki
items.body:

items.title: Dunya usay kehti hai
items.body:
dunya usay kehti hai alamdar alamdar
pyason ka alamdar hai pyason ka alamdar
shabbir ke lashkar ka alamdar alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
emaan ke liye marne ko tayyar alamdar
nusrat ke liye bar sar e paikaar alamdar
mashkeeze may pani ka talabgaar alamdar
aur haathon ke kat jaane se nachaar alamdar
dunya usay kehti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
wehdat ki tajalli se nazar jodne waala
dunya ke har ek aysh se moo modne waala
khyber ki tarha fauj ki hadh todne waala
hai maut ka maidan may khareedaar alamdar
dunya usay kehti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye khoon ke bauchaar may ummat ka safina
tadpati hai maidan may jab yaade sakina
naize pe ye ja padta hai taane huwe seena
sun leta hai talwaron ki jhankaar alamdar
dunya usay kehti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
talwaar si baatil ki girha kholne waala
haq baat haqeeqat ke liye bolne waala
nazron may hayate abadi tolne waala
har lehja shahadat ka talabgaar alamdar
dunya usay kehti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
milne ka na umeed hai jeena ka na yaara
kya jaaniye kis tarha se dhoonda hai sahara
sunte hai sakina ne kayi baar pukara
mumkin hua kismat se na deedar alamdar
dunya usay kehti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mashkeeze se har baar wo girta hua pani
raftaar se takrati hai nafson ki rawani
chehre se nikharti hui baba ki jawani
abbas hai ya hyder e karraar alamdar
dunya usay kehti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
talwaar sambhali kabhi mashkeeza uthaya
darya pe bhi pani ke liye khoon ko bahaya
saa'il wo kya cheez ye kaunain pe chaaya
chalta hi raha azm ki raftaar alamdar
dunya usay kehti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo sookhi zaban ubhre huwe pyas ke chaale
behta hai lahoo jism ke har zakhm hai aale
jab haath nahi hai to alam kaise sambhale
bhai ko sada deta hai har baar alamdar
dunya usay kehti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
maidan may jam jaana bahadur ka ye khoon hai
khoon chehre pe mal lena shaheedon ka wazoo hai
hai gurz gira sar pe to aankhon may lahoo hai
ho jata hai yun bhi kabhi nachaar alamdar
dunya usay kehti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
islam ke jaade hai to emaan ki raahe
hai rob o jalaal itna ke tham jati hai aahein
jhuk jaati hai ay fazl malayak ki nigahein
nazron se bahot ooncha hai darbar alamdar
dunya usay kehti hai...

items.title: Hussain Aur Sabr
items.body:
Har Ek Kadam Pa Sab'r Dikhaya Hussain Ne.
Ek Do Pahar Me Ghar Ko Lutaya Hussain Ne
1)
Qatil Ko Jaam E Shir Pilaya Ali Ne Tha.
Lashkar Jafa Ka Pyasa Jo Shabbir Ko Mila.
Ye Jante The Pyasa Rakhenge Ye Ashqiya.
Dushman Ko Fir Bhi Pani Pilaya Hussain Ne.
Har Ek Kadam Pa Sab'r Dikhaya Hussain Ne.
2)
Burrer Ho Mazahir O Hur Ho Ke Ausaja.
Aabis Ho Ya Zoher O Wahab Ho Ya Zurgama.
Galte The Khu'n Me Sare Hi Ansaar O Akraba.
Tanha Har Ek Lasha Uthaya Hussain Ne.
Har Ek Kadam Pa Sab'r Dikhaya Hussain Ne.
3)
Tera Baras Ka Ladla Jiteji Mar Gaya.
Ghode Se Jab Gira Tha To Zinda Tha Mahelaka.
Zinda Hi Usko Zulm Ne Pamaal Qar Diya.
Tukdo'n Se Ek Laasha Banaya Hussain Ne.
Har Ek Kadam Pa Sab'r Dikhaya Hussain Ne.
4)
Zainab Ke Dono Ladle Makhtal Me Ghir Gaye.
Talwar O Teer O Naizo'n Se Zakhmi The Ladle.
Godi Me Unke Lashe Liye Shah The Khade.
Jinko Tha Godio'n Me Khilaya Hussain Ne.
Har Ek Kadam Pa Sab'r Dikhaya Hussain Ne.
5)
Akbar Ki Lash Par Yu'n Gaye Shah E Bhero Bar.
Har Ekse Puchte The Mera Laal He Kidhar.
Beenayi Ja Chuki Thi Ke Sadma Tha Is Kadar.
Sadma Ye Dil Pa Apne Uthaya Hussain Ne.
Har Ek Kadam Pa Sab'r Dikhaya Hussain Ne.
6)
Zoor E Qamar Jari Tha Jo Darya Pa So Gaya.
Gazi Ke Sar Ko Goad Me Shabbir Ne Liya.
Dekha Jo Aasmaan Ki Jaanib Fir Ek Dafa.
Suraj Ko Apna Chand Dikhaya Hussain Ne.
Har Ek Kadam Pa Sab'r Dikhaya Hussain Ne.
7)
Akbar Ke Dil Ka Khun Diya Kaat Ke Jigaar.
Asgar Ka Khun Pesh Kiya Muhh Pa Mal Qar.
Bazu Jari Ke De Diya Islaam Ke Magar.
Sukhe Shajar Ko Fir Se Khilaya Hussain Ne.
Har Ek Kadam Pa Sab'r Dikhaya Hussain Ne.
8)
Abbas Or Haqir Ye Shah Ka He Moa'jiza.
Har Ek Mazhab Se Aate He Zawwar Is Jaga.
Har Ek Ka Dil Ye Kheta He Gairat Ka Ba Khuda.
Karbobala ko qibla banaya Hussain ne.
Har Ek Kadam Pa Sab'r Dikhaya Hussain Ne.

items.title: Jao baba jaldi
items.body:
rakh ke sar seena e sarwar pe sakina boli
chod kar ammu gaye aur gaye sab bhai
ab na mera sabr aazmana
jao baba jaldi laut aana

baad aap ke hamein ye ashkiyan satayenge
mai kise bulaungi gauhar jo cheene jayenge
ye layeen jalayenge hamare qaimagaah bhi
aap agar na aaye to ye mujhpe zulm dhayenge
seh nahi sakungi taaziyana
jao baba jaldi laut aana...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaanti hoo mai ke sakht aap ka hai imtehan
aap be-watan ghareeb tashna lab hai baba jaan
kar rahi hoo mai dua khuda ki bargaah mein
jaa rahe hai aap jo sitamgaro ke darmiyan
hogaya hai sang dil zamana
jao baba jaldi laut aana...

keh gaye thay ammu jaan ran se laut aayenge
pani mere waaste wo alqama se layenge
itne zakhm dil pe seh ke kis tarha jiyungi mai
tanha chod kar mujhe ab aap ran ko jayenge
kis khadar kathin hai gham chupana
jao baba jaldi laut aana...

aap ke baghair raat ko na so sakungi mai
aap jo na aaye aur ban mein raat hogayi
beqaraar aap aur be-sukoon rahungi mai
jaake ran mein na mujhe bhulana
jao baba jaldi laut aana...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ajeeb waqt kaise aap ko juda karun
kaise aap ko mai baba jaan alwida kahun
marzi e khuda ke saamne zuban band hai
dil magar ye keh raha hai aap ko mai rok loo
hai naseeb mein ye gham uthaana
jao baba jaldi laut aana...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaalimon ko is khadar hai dushmani kyun aap se
band kardiye hai karbala ke saare raaste
pehre itne sakht kar diye labe furaat par
fauj e ashqiyan khadi hai alqama ke saamne
pani mere waaste na laana
jao baba jaldi laut aana...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaanti hoo tashnagi se khushk hai mera gala
garm hai hawa sulag rahi hai rayg e karbala
mere jaanisaar saare ran mein jaa ke sogaye
mera dasht mein hai kaun sirf aap ke siwa
meri tashnagi ko bhool jaana
jao baba jaldi laut aana...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise aap ki madad karun mujhe bataiye
baba aap tanha fauje shaam mein na jaaiye
subho se gaya jo ran mein laut kar na aa saka
aap laut aayenge mujhe yaqeen dilaaiye
yan mujhe bhi ran mein tum bulaana
jao baba jaldi laut aana...
<<DIVIDER>>
de rahi hu aap ko khuda ki mai panaah mein
aanch aaye koi aap par na qatl gaah mein
haath jod kar ye arz kar rahi hoo baba jaan
ran mein aap ho jahan rahe meri nigaah mein
door na meri nazar se jaana
jao baba jaldi laut aana...
<<DIVIDER>>
safdar e hazeen ye bain sun ke shahe behrobar
bole waqt e imtehan hai shaahzadi sabr kar
ran ko jaa raha hai tashnalab ghareeb bekhata
ay sakina laut kar na aayega tera padar
ab na keh ke tu mujhe rulaana
jao baba jaldi laut aana...

items.title: Abbas Batao
items.body:
Jab zeen se zameen pe aaya Ali ka sher
Rukhsat is jahaan se lamho Ki thi jo der
Awaaz di Hussain ko Aaqa salaam ho
Abbas ja rahe hai yaha se ba-hisht ko
Pohonche Hussain roote hue tham kar kamar
Pochha lahu ko aankh se zanu pe rakha sir...
• Kya tum Pe Guzar ti hai kehte thay
Shahe wala Abbas batao
Abbas batao
• Kyu chhod ke jaate ho, pardes me yu
Tanha Abbas batao
Abbas batao
1) Shabbir pe gurbat me yeh waqt pada kaisa
Tum chhod ke jaaoge humne nahi socha tha
Ab kaun pukarega, aye bhai hume aaqa...
Abbas batao(2)
2) Zainab tere raste pe palko ko bichaye hai
Har tishna dahan tujhse ek aas lagaaye hai
Hum kaise batayenge be-bazu hua saqqa..
Abbas batao(2) ..
3) Saqqa-e-Haram tum ho, lashkar ka bharam tum ho
Shabbir ke baazu me, jitna bhi hai dum tum ho
Kya tum ko gawara hai Zahra ka lutey Kunba...
Abbas batao(2)....
4) Gazi" ne kaha Aaqa, mar gaya sab lashkar
Lashkar ki jo raunak tha, mar gaya wo Akbar
Ab kaisi alamdaari, salaar bane kiska...
Abbas batao(2)...
5) Sheh ne kaha khaime me kehti yeh Sakina hai
Aatey hai abhi Ammu, paani abhi aata hai
Poochengi tumhara jab, kya usko bataunga...
Abbas batao(2)....
6)Rote hue Gazi yeh, aye kehne lage Aaqa
Sharminda Sakina se
hai uska bohot saqqa
Saqqayi na kar paya, ab ji ke karega kya...
Abbas batao (2)...
7) Sheh kehne lage accha, ehsaan toh yeh karo
Ek baar zara bhai, tum bhai Hume kehdo
Mat bolo hume Aaqa, tum kehte nahi bhayya...
Abbas batao(2)..
8) Gazi ne kaha bhai, taqat nahi, mutlaq hai
Dil dubta jaata hai, yun aapke girye se
Poochengi sare jannat, rone ka sabab Zahra...
Abbas batao (2)....
9)"Salman" kalam se ho, manzar vo bayan kaise
Ek bhai ke zanu pe, dam toda jo bhai ne
Shabbir ke honton pe, tha der raha jumla...
Abbas batao

aur akbar chale hai marne ko
umme laila ka mustafa beta
zakhm seene pe khaane jaata hai
innalillaah pad ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaise dil jaa raha ho maqtal mein
jaise jaati ho jaan seene se
aise apne jawan ke peeche
ek mazloom baap chalta hai
innalillaah pad ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitna pyara hai shaah ko akbar
saare zaalim ye baat jaante hai
taygh akbar pe chal rahi ha yahan
ibne zahra wahan tadapta hai
innalillaah pad ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
quwwat e murtaza ye poochti hai
sabr e shabbir itna batla de
wo to khyber ke dar se wazni tha
kaise laasha jawan uthaya hai
innalillaah pad ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ran mein rahwaar se giray akbar
shaah qaime ke dar se uth na sake
aise dil thaam ke giray maula
arsh jaise zameen pe girta hai
innalillaah pad ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay raza us jawan ke seene se
khoon rukta nahi hai roke se
sheh ka daaman lahoo mein doob gaya
zakhm na jaane kitna gehra hai
innalillaah pad ke...
items.author: Raza Shah

items.title: Jari diler alamdar
items.body:
jari diler e alamdar bawafa abbas
hussainiat ka sahara payambari ka bharam
jo cha gaya dare sehra misaale abre karam
huwe hai haath qalam phir bhi jhuk saka na alam
jahan e sabr ko jeena sikha gaya abbas
jari diler-e-alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo zore baazu e shabbir karbala mein raha
wo pehradaare haram tajdaare ehle wafa
faraath jis ki shahadat par aab aab huwa
khamosh rehke jahan ko rula gaya abbas
jari diler-e-alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi to saahile darya pe hai wohi pehre
abhi to asghare baysheer bhi nahi sooye
abhi to jaag rahe hai qaya mein bache
na jaane ki liye maqtal mein sogaya abbas
jari diler-e-alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
rasan pehan ke ye kehti thi roke binte ali
tumhare baad koi dil mein aas bhi na rahi
jale qayaam bhi jaagere fathima bhi luti
ghazab ke chin gayi sar se meri rida abbas
jari diler-e-alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
karoon shuja'ate abbas kis tarha se bayan
na mere paas wo dil hai na mere paas zuban
yahi bahut hai ke maqtal mein hoke nauha bajan
har ek shaheed ne girte huwe kaha abbas
jari diler-e-alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
likha hai ye lufe tareeq par baqad se jali
wafa ki rasm to abbas e naujawan se chali
zamane bhar ka sahara hussain ibne ali
hussain ibne ali ka hai aasra abbas
jari diler-e-alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
karenge hashr mein nasir hussain ka matam
jari ke saath shahe mashraqayn ka matam
alam ke saath sakina ke bain ka matam
labe faraat pe pyasa jo sogaya abbas
jari diler-e-alamdar...

items.title: Karyal Jawaan Ki Laash Pay
items.body:
Karyal jawaan ki laash pay
Kitne sitam Hussain nay, tanha uthaay hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Kia vakhth agaya hay Muhammad ki Aal par
Sehdania yay kehthi thi sar apna peet kar
Shabbir kiska khoon yay, rukh par lagaay hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Taarikh Bhi Hussain ki ghurbat pay ro pari
Betay ki laash baap say run may na uth saki
Islam nay Hussain ko, Kya din dikhaye hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Mehmane Karbala pay qayamat guzargai
Akbar ki laash khoon may doobi hui mili
Nayzon kay zakhm Bhi Ali, Akbar nay khaaye hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Khayyam ahlebait may matam bapa hua
Zainab nay jab Hussain say roro kay yeh kaha
Maqtal may hum sagheer ko, dafna kay aaye hain

items.title: Kinare furat ke
items.body:
kat kar gire thay kal jo kanare furaat ke
wo haath aasra hai hamari nijaat ke
<<DIVIDER>>
hai thokron mein aaj bhi abbas ke furaat
aise dhani bhi hote hai dunya mein baat ke
kat kar gire thay...
<<DIVIDER>>
unse ba-zor e taygh ye bayyat ki koshishein
jo fatha dhaal dete hai saanche mein maat ke
kat kar gire thay...
<<DIVIDER>>
haste ho aansuon pe hamare khuda gawah
hum jamma kar rahe hai waseele nijaat ke
kat kar gire thay...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala mein teer e sitam kha ke ek sagheer
lehra gaya jahan pe parcham hayaat ke
kat kar gire thay...
<<DIVIDER>>
tera hi dil tha tu ne uthaali jawan ki laash
sadqe hussain is tere paaye sabaat ke
kat kar gire thay...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis jaa chupe ho ay ali asghar jawab do
maadar bhatak rahi hai andhere mein raat ke
kat kar gire thay...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum bhi ghulame hurr hai karam ay shah e umam
kab se hai muntazir nazr e iltefaat ke
kat kar gire thay...
<<DIVIDER>>
ho jaaye munharif ye zamana to fikr kya
hum fatema se lenge silay nauha jaat ke
kat kar gire thay...
items.author: Sachey Bhai

items.title: Labbaik ya maula
items.body:
labbaika ya maula
<<DIVIDER>>
hal min ki sada ran mein shabbir lagate hai
rukh kar suye darya bhai ko bulaate hai
abbas chale aao hum marne ko jaate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas pukare ya maula
hoon nehr kinare ya maula
sadqe mein tumhare ya maula
labbaika ya maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab koi nahi mera maidan mein tanha hoon
laakhon hai mere dushman ay bhai akela hoon
mai saare azeezon ke gham mein bhi dooba hoon
khwahish hai ke aaun ya maula
tera saath nibhaun ya maula
aaqa ko bachaun ya maula
labbaika ya maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum quwwate baazu thay lakhte dile zehra thay
tooti hai kamar meri bhaiya tere marne se
mai bekas o laaghar hoon tere nahi hone se
sab kehte hai ran se ya maula
har zakhmi badan se ya maula
abbas ke tan se ya maula
labbaika ya maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab dard bhara lehja mai aap ka sunta hoon
darya pe tadapta hoon kuch kar nahi sakta hoon
mai pyasi sakina se ab bhi sharminda hoon
pani na pilaya ya maula
darya se na lauta ya maula
phat'ta hai kaleja ya maula
labbaika ya maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
de dete agar mujhko aap izne wigha maula
is lashkare aada ko mitti mein mila deta
phir aap pe na hota ye waqt musibat ka
phir dil hai machalta ya maula
ho jaun zinda ya maula
dushman ko sikhata ya maula
labbaika ya maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
ho jaata agar zinda nusrat ke liye aata
is baar bhi aaqa par qurban mai ho jaata
sau baar fida hota hargis nahi ghabrata
phir aap na jaate ya maula
hum taygh chalate ya maula
aur khoon mein nahate ya maula
labbaika ya maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
maula ki sada sun kar sab laashe tadapte hai
sab apni kati gardan se cheekh ke kehte hai
ab chaah ke bhi maula hum uth nahi sakte hai
goya huwe jafar ya maula
tadpe ali akbar ya maula
gehware mein asghar ya maula
labbaika ya maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
agar maut mujhe aaqa majboor nahi karti
is fauje yazeedi mein itni kahan jurrat thi
jo aap ke ghazi se aankhein bhi mila paati
majboor hai khadim ya maula
tukdhe huwe qasim ya maula
soye bani hashim ya maula
labbaika ya maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad aap ki ay aaqa zainab ko satayegi
kulsoom o ruqayya ko bhi khoon rulayegi
aur nanhi sakina ko jab neend na aayegi
bolegi tadap kar ya maula
baba mere sarwar ya maula
bechain hai dukhtar ya maula
labbaika ya maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
shafqat ye sada aayi darya ki taraayi se
aamir jo madad maangi ek bhai ne bhai se
bechain hua ghazi aaqa ki judaai se
hoon tukde tukde ya maula
dauda diye ghode ya maula
sun paaun na dukhde ya maula
labbaika ya maula...
items.author: Shafqat Taqi

items.title: Mai aankhein band karta
items.body:
baqir mere beta meri faryad suno
<<DIVIDER>>
tadap kar hazrate baqir se ye zainulliba bole
mai aankhein band karta hoo to maqtal yaad aata hai
ay mere laal batla de ke mai so'un bhala kaise
<<DIVIDER>>
meri nazron mein aajata hai ek toota hua naiza
rulaata hai mujhe zakhmi kaleja mere bhaiya ka
hatane se bhi wo manzar nahi hat'ta hai aankhon se
mai aankhein band karta hoo...
tadap kar hazrate baqir se...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab aankhein band hoti hai to yaad aajate hai baba
mere baba ka zakhmi jism teeron par muallaq tha
mere rehte huwe tashna dahan maare gaye pyase
mai aankhein band karta hoo...
tadap kar hazrate baqir se...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo qaima jal raha tha jisme mai behosh tha beta
badi mushkil se qaime se phupi jaan ne nikaala tha
mujhe hosh aaya to dekha fiza mein thay faqat sholay
mai aankhein band karta hoo...
tadap kar hazrate baqir se...
<<DIVIDER>>
sakina karbala ke baad soyi hi nahi baqir
wo ek din mar gayi ghutkar kabhi royi nahi baqir
wo rona chaahti thi jab layeen thay maarte durre
mai aankhein band karta hoo...
tadap kar hazrate baqir se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali asghar ka mar jaana sare maqtal qayamat thi
mere laqte jigar wo tere baba ki shahadat thi
abhi tak yaad karta hoo wohi manzar mai ro ro ke
mai aankhein band karta hoo...
tadap kar hazrate baqir se...
<<DIVIDER>>
tan e qasim ka khoon mein doob jaana kaise bhoolunga
eba mein is liye tha wo ke paara paara laasha tha
badi mushkil se baba ran se uski laash laaye thay
mai aankhein band karta hoo...
tadap kar hazrate baqir se...
<<DIVIDER>>
pase ashoor wo mehshar raha mai kaise bhoolunga
meri nanhi sakina ka gala rassi mein jakda tha
nikalti thi kahan awaaz aakhir bolti kaise
mai aankhein band karta hoo...
tadap kar hazrate baqir se...
<<DIVIDER>>
mubarak bain kaisa tha ke baba ro pade haye
pidar rote thay apne laal ko seene se liptaye
bayan irfan kaise ho qayamat ke manazir thay
mai aankhein band karta hoo...
tadap kar hazrate baqir se...
items.author: Mubarak Jalalpuri

items.title: Aalam e arwah
items.body:
aalam e arwah mein
apne rab se mohamed ne kaha
mera waada hai
mere allah tujhse waada hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mera beta teen din ka bhooka pyasa
qalb zakhmi pusht zakhmi aur tanha
ghar apna tujh par lutayega
mera waada hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ambiya bhi dekhte hi royenge sab
sar katane is ke bete jayenge jab
har ek laasha uthayega
mera waada hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
laash e qasim ki tarha dil hoga tukde
layega jab dasht se wo tukde dil ke
lahoo falak bhi bahayega
mera waada hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
laasha e abbas e ghazi alqama par
jab chinegi bibiyon ke sar se chadar
wo sabr ko aazmeinega
mera waada hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mauj e darya mein bhi hoga ek talaatum
tashnagi se sabr ka hoga tasaddum
wo sabr hi fatha payega
mera waada hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala ki sar zameen ko khoon de kar
soyega jalti zameen par ye gule tar
lahoo mein apne nahayega
mera waada hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye zamana aisa saabir to dikhaye
wo jo darya se bhi pyasa laut aaye
ye sabr bhi wo dikhayega
mera waada hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
qabr asghar ki banayega akela
seena e akbar se barchi khaynchlega
janaze sab ke uthayega
mera waada hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala ki dhoop hogi aur laashe
aur qaimon mein haram honge tadapte
tasalli unko dilayega
mera waada hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaisa zaahid aur abid mera beta
aisa qari aur ghazi kaun hoga
sina pe quran sunayega
mera waada hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
apni shehzadi se mazhar ka hai waada
jab talak ek saans baaqi tan mein hoga
qalam ye rukne na payega
mera waada hai...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Abbas beta marhaba
items.body:
kehti hai ran mein fatema
abbas beta marhaba
<<DIVIDER>>
tu ishq ki meraj hai
sar par wafa ka taaj hai
saabit ye tu ne kar diya
darya pe tera raaj hai
chullu mein le li alqama
abbas beta marhaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
aale nabi ki aas hai
imran ka akkaas hai
teri talab darya nahi
darya ko teri pyaas hai
saqqa e aale mustafa
abbas beta marhaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhse zabar bhi zer hai
tashnalabi se ser hai
haibat hai sheron par teri
tu sher e haq ka sher hai
shamsheer e shaah e karbala
abbas beta marhaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
ajdaad ki pehchan hai
binte ali ka maan hai
bachpan se lekar aaj tak
shabbir par qurban hai
qurban tujhpar hai wafa
abbas beta marhaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere shaano pe qurban jaun
aaja seene se apne lagaun
tujhko shabbir jaisa samajh kar
apne haathon se pani pilaun
darya se pyasa aagaya
abbas beta marhaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha ye mehzar mein abbas likha
tashnalab hi rahegi sakina
gham na kar mashk gar chid gayi hai
tujhse raazi hai shaah e madina
tune ada haq kar diya
abbas beta marhaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo mahafiz thay aale nabi ke
kat gaye haye baazu wo tere
aaj se hashr tak deen ka parcham
tu uthayega bin baazuon ke
ab ye alam tera hua
abbas beta marhaba..
<<DIVIDER>>
jo takallum hai emaan tera
shadman ka wohi hai aqeeda
rauza e ibne shere khuda par
dil ye kehta hai ahle aza ka
ek maa ki aati hai sada
abbas beta marhaba...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Abid udaas hai
items.body:
boli ye binte murtuza abid udaas hai
koday na maar be-khata abid udaas hai
<<DIVIDER>>
pahuncha jo shaam khaafla abid udaas hai
khush hai har ek be-haya abid udaas hai
boli ye binte murtaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
ehsaan hoga kuch to karam kar aleel pe
tujhko khuda ka waasta abid udaas hai
boli ye binte murtaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhega kaise maa'on ka behno ka sar khula
tu is tarha na zulm dha abid udaas hai
boli ye binte murtaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
quran suna raha hai juda tan se hoke bhi
naize pe sar hussain ka abid udaas hai
boli ye binte murtaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye haalat e ruku may kaise safar kare
rakhegi kaise hausala abid udaas hai
boli ye binte murtaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas garche hota salamat ay shaamiyon
kehna na padta ba-khuda abid udaas hai
boli ye binte murtaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
rassi se ghut na jaye sakina ka dam kahin
is fikr may har ek jaa abid udaas hai
boli ye binte murtaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar may najaf ye manadi ne di sada
aayi hai binte fatema abid udaas hai
boli ye binte murtaza...
items.author: Najaf Murshidabadi

items.title: Al ajal ya mehdi
items.body:
roke zehra ye pukari al ajal ya mehdi
mujhpe darwaza gira tod di pasli meri
al ajal ya mehdi
<<DIVIDER>>
inteqam aa ke tujhe lena hai mohsin ka mere
yaad karti hai abhi se tujhe teri dadi
al ajal ya mehdi
roke zehra ye pukari...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmi pehlu pe hi ek haath mera rehta tha
doosra haath utha kar mai dua karti thi
al ajal ya mehdi
roke zehra ye pukari...
<<DIVIDER>>
has rahe thay sabhi darbari meri ghurbat par
maine tehreer e nabi khaak se ye kehke chuni
al ajal ya mehdi
roke zehra ye pukari...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere pehlu ki tarha beta shikasta hai mazaar
dekho sau saal huwe qabr dubara na bani
al ajal ya mehdi
roke zehra ye pukari...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek kooche mein jo zaalim ne tamacha maara
haye mai rote huwe khaak pe ye kehke giri
al ajal ya mehdi
roke zehra ye pukari...
<<DIVIDER>>
baandh ke khaynchi jo zaalim ne galay mein rassi
dil mera kehta raha dekh ke tauheen e ali
al ajal ya mehdi
roke zehra ye pukari...
<<DIVIDER>>
mekh darwaze ki jis dam mere phasli pe lagi
mujhko mohsin ki sada rote huwe aati thi
al ajal ya mehdi
roke zehra ye pukari...
<<DIVIDER>>
mir sajjad jo jalta hua darwaza gira
al madad fizza se pehle meri bibi boli
al ajal ya mehdi
roke zehra ye pukari...
items.author: Mir Sajjad Mir

items.title: Alwida ahle haram
items.body:
asr ka waqt qareeb aagaya lo jaate hai ham
alwida ahle haram alwida ahle haram alwida alwida
jane phir laut ke aaye ke na aaye ye khadam
alwida ahle haram alwida alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
mere nana ki abaa aur amama lao
wo jo kurta meri amma ne siya tha lao
aur zainab ko bula lao ke ab waqt hai kam
alwida ahle...
<<DIVIDER>>
bibiyo dekhlo jee bhar ke chalo ruye hussain
gule zainab se juda hoti khushbuye hussain
jaane phir ho ke na ho lamha ye ziarat ka baham
alwida ahle...
<<DIVIDER>>
bole sheh ghar ki nigehban meri zainab tum ho
mai to jaata hoo magar meri jagah ab tum ho
janiyo isko ghanimat hai jo sajjad ka dam
alwida ahle...
<<DIVIDER>>
bibiya halqa kiye thi tane mazloom ke gird
baal khole huwe aansu liye masoom ke gird
noha e hazrate zainab pa tha sheh ka matam
alwida ahle...
<<DIVIDER>>
haat uthate hi nahi zulm se ye baaniye shar
le gaye kaat ke ye aun o mohamed ke bhi sar
ab mere sar ke talabgaar hai ye ahle sitam
alwida ahle...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghash se abid ko uthakar kaha beta hoshiyar
lo hui shaam hui shaam ki manzil tayyaar
tum ho ab aur hai be-pardagiye ahle haram
alwida ahle...
<<DIVIDER>>
hoke ruqsat hue shabbir jo ghode pa sawaar
ayd dete thay to badta na tha aage rahwaar
koi bachi thi jo rahwaar ke thaame thi khadam
alwida ahle...
<<DIVIDER>>
utre ghode se sakina ko uthaya ek baar
jhuk ke ruqsaar ko seene se lagaya ek baar
bole phir se ke pani ke liye jaate hai hum
alwida ahle...
<<DIVIDER>>
karke seene se sakina ko juda sheh ne naved
jao qaime may sakina se kaha sheh ne naved
phir bade suye faraz shah ba-larzida khadam
alwida ahle...
items.author: Ahmed Naved

items.title: Ashoor ka manzar
items.body:
ashoor ka manzar hai aur zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
kuffar ka lashkar hai aur zainab
ashoor ka manzar hai aur zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
asbab lut chuka hai qaime bhi jal chuke hai
aur zulm o sitam ki soorat aahon mein dhal chuke hai
ek laashaye besar hai aur zainab
kuffar ka lashkar hai…
ashoor ka manzar hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ki laash ran mein uriyan padi hui hai
aur hamsheer sar barehna be aasra khadi hai
ab sogh ki chadar hai aur zainab
kuffar ka lashkar hai…
ashoor ka manzar hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
nana ki qabr chooti haye watan bhi choota
tha wo ghar jo fatema ka kal tak basa hua tha
ujda hua wo ghar hai aur zainab
kuffar ka lashkar hai…
ashoor ka manzar hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim ki laash dekhi akbar ki laash dekhi
aur abbas e ba-wafa ki asghar ki laash dekhi
ab laashaye biradar hai aur zainab
kuffar ka lashkar hai…
ashoor ka manzar hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
sholay bhadak rahe hai gulzar e panjetan mein
ahle haram ke baazu baandhe hai ek rasan mein
islam ka lashkar hai aur zainab
kuffar ka lashkar hai…
ashoor ka manzar hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
phayle huye hai har soo veeraniyo ke saaye
zainab ki ek jaan hai kis kis ka gham uthaye
bemaar hai langar hai aur zainab
kuffar ka lashkar hai…
ashoor ka manzar hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
koofe ki shahzadi sar par rida nahi hai
ye haal hai ke koi pehchanta nahi hai
darbar e sitamgar hai aur zainab
kuffar ka lashkar hai…
ashoor ka manzar hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
na mehramo ki nazrein padti hai jab haram par
sharm o haya se zainab bechain har qadam par
har gaam ek nashtar hai aur zainab
kuffar ka lashkar hai…
ashoor ka manzar hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
mehshar quloose dil se kar zikr panjetan ka
likh apne aansu'on se noha shahe zaman ka
phir tera muqaddar hai aur zainab
kuffar ka lashkar hai…
ashoor ka manzar hai…
items.author: Mehshar Lakhnavi

items.title: Ay rakibe doshe
items.body:
ay raakibe doshe shaahe lau laak
ba izz o wiqar wa hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
seene pa tumhare ya shahe paak
qatil ho sawaar wa hussaina
ay raakibe doshe...
<<DIVIDER>>
farq aap ka aur sinaan e khooli
sar aap ka aur makaan e khooli
aalood e khaakh wo rukhe paak
zulfon may ghubaar wa hussaina
ay raakibe doshe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay khusrawe ko shaheer sad haif
ek tan tera laakhon teer sad haif
ghodon ke sumon wo jisme sad chaak
mai tere nisaar wa hussaina
ay raakibe doshe...
<<DIVIDER>>
majrooh o al-amaan wo seena
zaanu wo kahan kahan wo seena
wo bosagahe payambar e lau laak
aur taygh ki dhaar wa hussaina
ay raakibe doshe...
<<DIVIDER>>
khwahar teri anjuman may jaaye
beti teri aur tamache khaye

items.title: Baba Ab Hamse Tamache Nahi Khaye Jaate
items.body:
Baba ab hamse tamache nahi khaye jate
1 • Jaante the na sitam istarah tadpaega
Soch kar ab bhi tadap te hai tumara jana
Kash ae baba hame saat me tum le jate
Baba Ab Hamse tamache.....
2• bhool payenge na ham ap ka ran me jana
Pyar karna kabhi sine se hame liptana
Hai tamache waha lete the jaha tum bose
Baba Ab Hamse tamache.....
3• shimr ke kauf se ghut ghut ke hi jite hai ham
Kitne ayyan hue nind ko tarse hai ham
Milta gar sina hame apka to so jaate
Baba Ab Hamse tamache.....
4• koi in zaalimo se aake bacha le hamko
Kitni be dardi se mare hai tamache hamko
Hote ammu to tamacho ke nisha diklate
Baba Ab Hamse tamache.....
5• apki godme naazo se pale ham baba
Zindagi me kabhi paidal na chale ham baba
Ab ye kaate bhare raste nahi kaate jate
Baba Ab Hamse tamache.....
6• ye andhera na ye tanhahi na ye zindan hota
Na hamare liye ye qaid ka sama hota
Gar madad ke liye abbas chacha aajate
Baba Ab Hamse tamache.....
7• Nanhe se halq pe phir tire sitam na chalta
Saat phir asgar e beshir hamare aata
Leke ham godme masum ka dil behlate
Baba Ab Hamse tamache.....
8• ap ke baad bhala jina hamara kaisa
Phir se mil jata agar ap ka sina baba
Our kuch apki agosh me ham ji jate
Baba Ab Hamse tamache.....
9• kamsini me jo sitam hampe na itna hota
Milti gar puri ghiza pani jo pura milta
Ham andero me na zindan ke yu mar jate
Baba Ab Hamse tamache.....
10• uske ammu jo chale aate madad ko asghar
Phir azadar bhala khati tamache kyu kar
Phir sakina ke labo par na ye naale aate
Baba Ab Hamse tamache nahi khaye jaate..

items.title: Hussain dasht se laye jo laasha qasim ka
items.body:
Husain dasht se laae jo laasha qasim ka.
Kaha yeh ma'n ne jo dekha janaza qaasim ka
Pukarti hai tumhe ma'n mere pisar uth'tho.
Ay mere laal mere goshae jigar uth'tho.
Yeh kaisi neend me soye ho bekhabar uth'tho.
Yu'n ma'n ne ro ro ke sadqa utaara qasim ka.
Huva hai pyaas se chehra nidhaal dulhe ka.
Bhula na paaungi dil se mai haal dulhe ka.
Lahoo me doob ke sehra hai laal dulhe ka.
Ujaala kis ne yeh ghar se mitaaya qasim ka.
Bichhar ke ma'n se gae aur mar gae ran me.
Suna hai laash ke tukde bikhar gae ran me.
Badan pe jeeteji ghode guzar gae ran me.
Lahoo wigha me yeh kisne bahaya qasim ka.
Ghubaar chaand se chehre pe kaysa chhaaya hai.
Haraik tukda badan ka lahoo me dooba hai.
Yeh haal dekh ke chhalni mera kaleja hai.
Hai zakhmi ghodo'n ki taanpo'n se seena qaasim ka.
Jigar ko thaam ke bewa hasan ki roti thi.
Utha ke khaak ko chehre pe apne malti thi.
Tadap tadap ke yu'n laashe pe bayn karti thi.
Hai surkh khoon se shaadi ka joda qaasim ka.
Yeh likh ke daasta'n navshaad kar raha hai gham.
Azaae shaah me karta hai mustufa maatam.
Khayaame shaahe zaman me hai ranj ka aalam.
Harayk deta hai ma'n ko dilaasa qasim ka.

items.title: Jashn-e-Ali (a.s)
items.body:
Kaabe Main Kyun Dhoom Machi Hai Kis Ki Ammad Hai
Kis Ke Ane Ki Ye Khushi Hai Kis Ki Ammad Hai
Logo Ne Jab Ye Pucha Deewar Main Dar Hai Kesa
Bol Uthi Tera Rajab Ye Kaabe Ki Deewar
Aye Hain Haider E Karar
Ye Jashn E Ali Hai
Khool Li Agoosh E Nabi Main Jab Ali Ne Ankh Tou
Muskura Kar Mustafa Ne Dekha Ain Ul Allah Ko
Bhai Aur Apne Wasi Ko Hathon Main Leke Ali Ko
Kaabe Se Nikle Tou Sab Se Bole Sarkar
Agayi Tera Rajab Khushiyan Manao Doston
Jo Jaale Jitna Usay Utna Jaalo Doston
Apni Galiyon Ko Sajao Hum Molayi Hain Batao
Eid Ayi Hai Ghar Se Niklo Ho Kar Tayar
Jashn E Ali Hai Yar Manana Banta Hai
Mola Se Hai Pyar Jatana Banta Hai
Mun Metha Sarkar Karana Banta Hai
Ik Dooje Se Gaale Milo Phoolon Ke Pehnao Har
Jab Qadam Maidan Main Rakha Haider E Karar Ne
Aik Dooje Se Kaha Dar Kar Ye Har Farar Ne
Choro Talwarein Choro Dekho Peeche Tou Dekho
Bhago Bhago Ke Maidan Main Le Kar Talwar
Lashkar E Deen E Khuda Kuch Bhi Nhi Haider Ke Bin
Larne Marhab Se Na Aya Koi Untalees Din
Chaleeswan Din Jab Aya Ye Aaqa Ne Farmaya
Keh Do Marhab Se Ke Ab Hoga Tu Finaar
Dekhun Mola Ko Tou Jeene Ka Maza Aye Mujhe
Mesum E Tamaar Ki Tarhan Qaza Aye Mujhe
Turbat Main Meri Aake Nara Haider Ka Laga Ke
Mujhe Se Ye Bole Farishte Uth Jaa Mere Yar
Jab Zameen Se Barsar E Meraj Aye Mustafa
Mukura Kar Rab Se Bole Jis Ghari Lehja Suna
Aye Mere Paalne Wale Mujh Ko Bas Ye Batla De
Ye Tu Hai Parde Main Ya Parde Ke Us Paar
Jab Dar E Haider Pe Taara Arsh Se Bheja Gaya
Dekha Ye Manzar Tou Chehra Kitno Ka Murjha Gaya
Yasrab Main Dhoom Machi Hai Ye Zahra Ki Shadi Hai
Dulhan Lene Dulha Ban Kar Duldul Sawar
Manao Jashn Hai Mere Yar Dama Dum Haider Haider
Khul Gayi Kaabe Ki Deewar Dama Dum Haider Haider
Hai Jashn E Ammad E Sarkar Dama Dum Haider Haider
Kaho Sab Mil Ke Mere Dildaar Dama Dum Haider Haider
Karao Mun Metha Hai Yar Dama Dum Haider Haider
Zara Phir Jhoom Ke Nara Mar Dama Dum Haider Haider
Zeeshan O Farhan Wila Ka Karte Raho Parchar

items.title: Labo par hai sada
items.body:
Labo par hai sada haaye madeena qaydkhaane me.
Watan ko yaad karti hai sakeena qaydkhaane me.
Gale me hai rasan ke zakhm or hai pyaas ki shiddat.
Sakeena ka hai ab dushwar jeena qaydkhaane me.
Andhera is qadar hai ke nazar kuchh bhi nahi aata.
Ghutan hoti hai ab har ayk lamha qayd khaane me.
Sukoo'n se so nahi paati yateema khaak ke upar.
Bahut yaad aata hai baab ka seena qaydkhaane me.
Parindo se sakeena kehti thi jaakar madeene tum.
Zara pohchaa do muj tak haale sughra qaydkhaane me.
Laga kar apne seene se husain ibne ali ka sar.
Yateema ne hazaaro baar chooma qaydkhaane me.
Labe sarwar pe rakh ke apne lab karti rahi girya
Huva ek hashr sa kohraam barpa qaydkhaane me.
Yakayak rote rote ho gai khaamosh jab bacchi.
Huva zainab ko tab gham se ifaqa qaidkhaane me.
Hila kar shaana bacchi ka kaha sajjad ne ro kar.
Jaha'n se ho gai rukhsat sakeena qaydkhaane me.
Ba waqte ghusl zakhme pusht jab dekha sakeena ka.
Kiya ehle haram ne ro ke girya qaydkhaane me.
Gale me tauq hai aur paau'n me hai bediya'n fir bhi.
Uthaya ayk qaydi ne janaza qaydkhaane me.
Waqaar aakar pade nawha kare navshaad bhi maatam.
Dikhaa de tu hame raoza khudaaya qaydkhaane me.

items.title: Aalam o masaib mein

items.title: Abbas chale aao
items.body:

maare hai tamache bhi bachi pa taras khao

ye raat ye tareeki ye dasht ye sannata

items.title: Al madad al madad
items.body:
al madad al madad ya ali
berida ho ke zainab chali

boli zainab tadap kar ye haye
ghar hamare layeen ne jalaye
bekhata taaziyane lagaye
zulm aada ne is tarha dhaaye
sab ke mushkil kusha sun hamari dua
de ghareebon ko aa kar sahare
gham ke maaron ko aa kar bachale
al madad al madad...
<<DIVIDER>>
keh rahi hai musibat ki maari
kaisi bigdi hai kismat hamari
be-kajawa mili hai sawari
aur muqaddar mein hai aah o zaari
shaam tak ka safar berida nange sar
shaahe waala hai ab aur na akbar
zulm hi zulm hai har qadam par
al madad al madad...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ke dada thay shaahe madina
jis ka takiya tha sarwar ka seena
dar badar hai wo baali sakina
ab to dushwaar hai uska jeena
kis se shikwa karun kisko awaaz dun
koi sunta nahi aah o zaari
aaj bekas hai zainab tumhari
al madad al madad...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye qaidi banaye gaye hai
dar badar hum phiraye gaye hai
shaam emin aaj laaye gaye hai
koocha o dar sajaye gaye hai
zulmat e shaam mein balwa e aam mein
ghair hai koi apna nahi hai
haye koi sahara nahi hai
al madad al madad...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera maajaya pyasa sidhara
mar gaya bhai abbas jaisa
maine aulaad ka gham bhi paaya
phir bhi shikwa zaban par na aaya
rasme parda dari mere ghar se chali
berida besahara hoon baba
kaise darbar mai jaaun baba
al madad al madad...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro azadare sibte payambar
tere seene mein hai yaade sarwar
ungliyan hai teri khoon mein tar
shayar e karbala hai tu gohar
hai ye nuha tera teri dil ki sada
koi bhi gham na hoga tujhe ab
teri bakshish ki zaamin hai zainab
al madad al madad...

items.title: Alwida ay hussain
items.body:
alwida ay hussain

items.title: Ashoor ka suraj dekhega
items.body:
ashoor ka suraj dekhega
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas e dilawar maqtal mein
be-izne wigha jab aayega
toofan uthega sehra mein
aur darya se takrayega
maqtal ki fazaon ko phir se
ek baar ali yaad aayega
ashoor ka suraj dekhega...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor ka suraj dekhega
shaane pe sajaye mashkeeza
aayega jari haathon mein liye
bas ek alam aur ek naiza
jab ghaat ka pehra tootega
dil zaalim ka ghabrayega
ashoor ka suraj dekhega...
<<DIVIDER>>
saahil ki hawa ki thandak mein
ghode ka badan jab haampega

jab darya thar thar kaampega

ashoor ka suraj dekhega...

jab maujein behte darya ki
uth uth ke raqaabe choomengi

ghazi ka alam lehrayega
ashoor ka suraj dekhega...

pani mein girega mashkeeza

jab farte nidamat se darya

ashoor ka suraj dekhega...

gham dil mein sambhale bachon ke

jab pani lekar palthega

har samt se hamla aayega
ashoor ka suraj dekhega...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab gurz lagega chehre pe
jab shaane girenge kat kat kar

jab laash bahegi matti par
jab mashq chidegi teeron se
dil saqqa ka phat jayega
ashoor ka suraj dekhega...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab ghazi kahega maula se
ek baar hamiyat hai aaqa
qaimon mein mujhe na le jaana
bas itni wasiyat hai aaqa
gar laash gayi qaimon ki taraf
sar zainab ka khul jayega
ashoor ka suraj dekhega...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab maula tanha lautenge
aankhon mein lahoo ke ashk liye
ek khoon mein dooba surkh alam
teeron se chidi ek mashk liye
jab kooze girenge haathon se
kulsoom ko ghash aajayega
ashoor ka suraj dekhega...
<<DIVIDER>>
masoom sakina poochegi
hai mashk o alam pe kiska lahoo
kyon laut ke wapas aaye nahi
kyon laaye nahi pani ammu
ye sunke amma fizza ki
aankhon mein lahoo aajayega
ashoor ka suraj dekhega...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil apna dhadakta hai mazhar
naqvi jo ishqe karbal mein
ye bhi hai karam un haathon ka
jo haath kate thay maqtal mein
jab ahle aza ke ashkon mein
har lafz mera dhal jayega
ashoor ka suraj dekhega...

items.title: Baraste Patharo Main Zakhmi
items.body:
Baraste patharo me zakhmi jab hui Zainab
Toh roo k ghazi ka sar dekhti rahi Zainab
Kahi pe durro se darbaar me tha maara gaya
Kahi pe sung se bazaar me tha maara gaya
Wohi sitam hue jis jaa khadi rahi Zainab
Sitam ki koofiyo ne hai ayse had kardi
Phirai kufe me jaise thi laash muslim ki
Phirai waise hi rassi se thi bandhi Zainab
Sitam kuch itne laeeno ki fauj karti thi
Laraste kadmo se bazaar me wooh chalti thi
Yun taziyano se zakhmi thi ho chuki Zainab
Yeh shimr logo se has has ke hae kehta tha
Bahen hai baaghi ki yeh jisko humne maar dia
Najaane kis tarah yeh sab thi sun rahi Zainab
Ali ke badle joh shami yeh humse lete hai
Pukari fizza yeh pathar baraste kehte hai
Ali se kitni hai in sabko dushmani Zainab
Jab aai bhai ke maqtal me kaidi hoke bahen
Kata Hussain ka tukdo me iss tarah tha badan
Joh dekhi laash toh naake se gir padi Zainab
Churi gale pe bhi jiske naa dekh pai thi
Wooh dekhti rahi roo rook e gham satai thi
Labo pe bhai ke chalte hue churi Zainab
Waha asad o fazal aasoon ka tha nauha
Mila rehai pe azbaab jab luta saara
Toh der tak rahi chadar ko dekhti Zainab

items.title: Dam ba dam ali ali pukar
items.body:
Dam badam ali ali pukaar
har qadam ali ali pukaar
tere sune aangan me khilegi bahaar
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Dar badar bhathakne ka kyun ye rog paala hai
sab ke sab bhikaari hain kon dene waala hai
un se maang oo'nton ki dede jo qataar
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Paak hai lahu kis ka kis mein kya kharaabi hai
kon hai saqifaayi kon buturaabi hai
pal me sab ke chehro'n se hoga aashkaar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. aal ki taraf gar tu ek qadam badhayega
das qadam zamaane se khud ko aage paayega
kyun ke ye nahi rakhte kisi ka udhaar
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ranj o gham ki raaho'n me bad hawaas betha hai
chal ali ki chokhat par kyun udaas betha hai
bas palak jhapakte hi hoga bedaa paar
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Naam e faatahe khaibar gar tera vazifa hai
dur hogi har mushkil ye hamaara daava hai
khaali jaa nahi sakta tera koyi vaar
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Chaahta hai gar tujhse Sayyada bhi raazi ho
khush ho khaaliq e akbar Mustafa bhi raazi ho
munkiraan e haidar pe karde beshumaar
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Tujhko fatema zehra ki duaayein mil jaaye
khud teri ziyaarat ko ambiya chale aayein
karbala pahonch jaaye tu jo ek baar
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Adl aur adaalat ka intezaam lene ko
karbala ka ay nayaab inteqaam lene ko
aane waala hai koyi leke zulfiqaar

Kalam bhi likh ke ye roya hussain rote hain....

items.title: Kat Raha Tha Gala Dhirey Dhirey Se
items.body:
Chal Raha Tha Shahe Dee’n Pe Khanjar
Kat Raha Tha Gala Dheere Dheere
Sajdaye Shukkr Phir Bhi Khuda Ka
Ho Raha Tha Ada Dheere Dheere
1) Zakham Zalim Ne Aysa Dia Hai
Dard Baba Boht Ho Raha Hai
Mere Seene Se Zalim Ka Khanjar
Baba Jaa’n Khenchana Dheere Dheere
2) Ilteja Ek Maa Kar Rahi Hai
Maamta Samne Ro Rahi Hai
Gir Rahi Hai Sakina Zamee’n Par
SeShimrr Naqa Chala Dheere Dheere
3) Taziyane Tu Kiyu Marta Hai
Ye Hai Beemar Tu Janta Hai
Thak Ke betha Tha Mera Baradar
Hai Uthana Utha Dheere Dheere
4) Aik Rassi Mai Sab Ke Gale Hai
Kitne Paidal Na Jane Chale Hai
Rook Zalim Zara Deer Lashakar
Ya Badha Qafela Dheere Dheere
5) Dekh Kar Be Rida Bibiyo’n Ko
Aur Hanste Hue Zalimo Ko
Aik Ghayyur Beemar Laghar
Qatal Hota Raha Dheere Dheere
6) Bhai Na De Mujhe Ab Dilase
Kab Rihai Mile Gi Bata De
Le Chalo Qed Khane Se Bahar
Aarahi Hai Qaza Dheere Dheere
7) kaise Behlaunga Qalbe Madar
Kaise Dikhlaunga Lashe Asghar
Bas Isi Soch Mai Haye Rokar
Baap Badhta Raha Dheere Dheere
8) Baba Aysa Sitm Bhi Hua Tha
Baliya’n Ek Laee’n Mangta Tha
Noche Tezi Se Itne Hi Gohar
Mai Ne Jetna Kaha Dheere Dheere
9) Murtaza Aur Payambar Bhi Roye
Anbiya Aur Malaik Bhi Roye
Jis Ghadi Ibne Zehra Ka Mehwar
Kat Raha Tha Gala Dheere Dheere

phasliyan toot ke deti hi rahi tum ko sada
al-madad baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
apni haalat mai ali se bhi nahi keh sakti
itni zakhmi hoon ke zinda bhi nahi reh sakti
har ghadi khoon mein tar rahti hai ab meri rida
al-madad baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun nahi aate bhala aap kahan hai baba
dekho chehre pe tamachon ke nishan hai baba
maine zainab se chupaya hai ye zakhmi chehra
al-madad baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhse darbar ne ek din mein jawani cheeni
ghar talak bhi hoon mai beton ke sahare aayi
haal athara baras mein hai zaeefa jaisa
al-madad baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
keel paywast jo pehlu mein hui hai mere
is liye baba mere haath nahi uth sakte
kuch nahi maangna bas maut ki karni hai dua
al-madad baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
kam qayamat se nahi hai ye ajab din baba
mujh mein hi dafn hua hai mera mohsin baba
saare zakhmon se hai mere yehi ek zakhm bada
al-madad baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab bhi azlaan baqayya se sada aati hai
phasliyan tooti thi kal aj lehad tooti hai
jaane kis baat ki di ahle madina ne saza
al-madad baba...
items.author: Arsalan Azmi

items.title: Alwida ay hussain
items.body:
alwida alwida ay hussain alwida
kehti thi dukhiya behen mere hussain alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
banda e mabood ada sidq o safa ki kitaab
paikare sabr o riza roohe risalat ma'ab
faatahe karbobala lakhte dil e bu-turaab
ambiya ki zindagi fatema ke jaan o tan
kehti thi dukhiya behen...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis jagah taqdeer ka laaya safeena mujhe
dekh mila hai yahan gham ka dafeena mujhe
kaash ke kar le qubool jadh ka madina mujhe
jaati hoon saughaat mein leke nishane rasan
kehti thi dukhiya behen...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri qasam ay hussain qabr pe aati zaroor
aake lehed par teri shamma jalati zaroor
chadar e ashke aza roke chadhati zaroor
kya kare zindan mein qaid thi teri behen
kehti thi dukhiya behen...
<<DIVIDER>>
peshe nazar har ghadi ghurbate ahle haram
qasime muztar ki yaad aun o mohamed ka gham
baad tere ay hussan mujhpe thi har har qadam
dard o alam ki ghata baarishe ranj o mehen
kehti thi dukhiya behen...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham ki har ek daastan jaake sunaungi mai
neel jo shaano pe hai wo bhi dikhaungi mai
roke mazaar e nabi par ye bataungi mai
loota gaya kis tarha nana tumhara chaman
kehti thi dukhiya behen...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil ke nageenein sar e dashte bala kho gaye
ran mein dileron ko aayi qaza so gaye
bhai bhatije pisar mujhse juda ho gaye
sone na degi mujhe ab mere dil ki chubhan
kehti thi dukhiya behen...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham mein tere raat din roye na kyun dil malool
khusboo e deene khuda baaghe imamat ke phool
haye re ghurbat teri raakib e doshe rasool
na hui turbat naseeb laash rahi bekafan
kehti thi dukhiya behen...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham ki meri daastan haal safar ka suno
roohe payambar utho mere baradar utho
uth ke zara qabr se daade shuja'at to do
jeet ke kufa o shaam aayi hai dukhiya behen
kehti thi dukhiya behen...
<<DIVIDER>>
raas na aaya tujhe ye safar e karbala
maa ki lehed bhi chuti nana ka rauza chuta
zindagi bhar ke liye door madina hua
koi nahi deher mein tujhsa ghareebul watan
kehti thi dukhiya behen...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya teri fikre rasa kya tera nauha bilal
khatra e na-cheez tu aur wo darya bilal
dil mein faqat hai yehi ek tamanna bilal
kaash ye karle qubool shaahe huda ki behen
kehti thi dukhiya behen...
items.author: Bilal Kazmi

items.title: Ashoor ka suraj keh
items.body:
ashoor ka suraj keh dega
khamosh kinara keh dega
jo baat ke asghar keh na sake
behta hua darya keh dega
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha jawani khaak hui
laila ka kaleja keh dega
behte huwe aansu keh denge
utra hua chehra keh dega
<<DIVIDER>>
ahmed ki nawasi ka aalam
uth'ta hua parda keh dega
kis tarha chini sar se chaadar
jalta hua qaima keh dega
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha gaye asghar ran mein
aabad hui kyun kar turbat
bano ki udaasi keh degi
ujda hua jhoola keh dega
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ki ajal aayi pehle
ya barchi ka phal nikla pehle
shabbir ki kismat keh degi
akbar ka kaleja keh dega
<<DIVIDER>>
ummat ke liye asghar aaye
pani na mila pyase hi gaye
chup hogi agar nanhi si lehad
ujda hua jhoola keh dega
<<DIVIDER>>
nawak ki khatak dil ki himmat
ummat pe nazar baba ka khayal
kya raaze khuda samjhe asghar
hasta hua chehra keh dega
<<DIVIDER>>
har gaam pe thokar kha kha kar
jab baap pisar ko dhoondega
kis samt hai akbar ki mayyat
uljha hua rasta keh dega
<<DIVIDER>>
mashkeeza chida pani to baha
mayyat na hati turbat hi bani
darya ki tarayi kiski hai
abbas ka rauza keh dega
<<DIVIDER>>
shadi se gharaz shadi kab thi
ye dars e alam tha dunya ko
kuch dayr ka dulha keh dega
ujda hua sehra keh dega

items.title: Ay sakina ke chacha
items.body:
ay sakina ke chacha ay mere bhai abbas
maar daalegi hamein teri judaai abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
wo nahi hoti to mai aa bhi nahi sakta tha
tere laashe pe mujhe maa meri laayi abbas
ay sakina ke chacha...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum yahan zeen se giray aur wahan qaime mein
sar se zainab ke rida gir gayi bhai abbas
ay sakina ke chacha...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise tanha mai sambhalunga ali akbar ko
laash hum ne hai har ek mil ke uthayi abbas
ay sakina ke chacha...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis se sharminda ho tum uski qasam deta hoo
aankhein khole ke sakina nahi aayi abbas
ay sakina ke chacha...
<<DIVIDER>>
ho gaye hai tere qasim se zyada tukde
laash uthaun mai teri kis tarha bhai abbas
ay sakina ke chacha...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera armaan mere dil mein na reh jaye kahin
bhai shabbir ko ab bol do bhai abbas
ay sakina ke chacha...
<<DIVIDER>>
mir sajjad ye kehte rahe akbar se hussain
meri bat'tees baras ki hai kameini abbas
ay sakina ke chacha...

items.title: Baba ali
items.body:
subhe unees falak par jo namudaar hui
mere maula ki shahadat ki khabar le aayi
sar pe talwaar chali shor utha haye ali
apne baba ko musalle pe jo dekha zakhmi
hasnain shareefain ne di ro ke sada
baba ali baba ali
maahe ramzan ban gaya maahe aza
<<DIVIDER>>
zarb lagi hai sher e elaahi ko
chehra lahoo may dooba hai
abbas aur hasnain ke baba ko
sajde may kis ne maara hai
baba ke sar ko zaanu pe rakh ke
haye hassan ne ro kar kaha
baba ali baba ali
maahe ramzan ban gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar ki taraf jab le ke chale bete
bole ali girya na karo
saath hamare koi nahi aaye
jao hassan sab se keh do
aisa na ho ke aa jaye baahar
karti hui zainab ye buka
baba ali baba ali
maahe ramzan ban gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon ali ki aankhon se jab pocha
chaadar se apni zainab ne
aankhein khuli to saamne beti ko
dekh ke hyder rone lage
zainab tadap ke baba se boli
chod ke hum ko na jaana
baba ali baba ali
maahe ramzan ban gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
aagayi jab ekkeeswi ramzan
zehra ke ghar shaam e ghariban
band hui hyder ki aankhein
ruk gayi saansein hogaye be-jaan
shaana hila ke kehne lagi zainab
baba utho aankhein kholo
baatein karo khamosh ho kyun baba
bolo zara kuch to bolo
aap ke gham may ab rote rote
dam na nikal jaaye mera
baba ali baba ali
maahe ramzan ban gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
zeeshan aur irfan e aza bete
ghar se janaza le aaye
koi naqaab may jab mayyat lene
aaya hassan bole haye
kaun ho apna chehra dikhao
bole hassan jab parda hata
baba ali baba ali
maahe ramzan ban gaya...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Barbaad Hui Aale Nabi
items.body:
barbaad hui aal e nabi (saww) ahle madina tum chain se sona
baba ke liye raat me roygi na zahra (as)
tum chain se sona
jeete jee unhe chain se rehne na diya hai
tum logon ki ab ahle madina ye saza hai
khatoon e qayamat (as) ke janaze me na aana
tum chain se sona
aulad e ali (as) gham ye akele hi sahegi
zahra (as) ki judai me wo maghmoom rahegi
har raat unhe ab to hai ro kar hi bitana
tum sona chain se
dhal jayega din ayega jab shab ka andhera
tanhai me bad jayega gham aur ali (as) ka
zahra (as) ke liye royege tanhai me maula (as)
tum chain se sona
amma ka unhen hoga na ab pehlu mayassar
so payenge raaton me na ek pal ko bhi sarwar (as)
maan ban ke unhe fizza (as) hi de degi dilasa
tum chain se sona
zainab (as) jo bichayengi tahajjud ka musalla
tasbeeh jo dekhegi to yaad ayengi zahra (as)
de denge unhe aa ke malak arsh se pursa
tum chain se sona
turbat me bhi ab chain kahan payege mursal (saww)
zahra (as) ke liye royege din raat musalsal
lekin tumhe is baat se kya farq padega
tum chain se sona
haider (as)ke mohibbon pa qayamat ki ghadi hai
khatoon e qayamat ki shahadat jo hui hai
salmaan o abuzar (as) ko hai is gham me tadapna
tum chain se sona
ye raat musibat ki hai ham ahle aza par
ham fatema zahra (as) ke liye royege shab bhar
kya wasta is gham se musalmaanon tumhara
tum chain se sona
kis dil se wilayat ho bayan. dard ka manzar
bole ye ali (as) zahra (as)ko turbat me sulakar
wada hai mera dhyaan main bachchon ka rakhuga
tum chain se sona

items.title: Bhaiya kyun nahi
items.body:
pooch rahi hai karbobala ke raston se bemaar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon rulaate hai mujhko yasrab ke dar o deewar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon se ojhal nahi hota chehra akbar ka
dhoondti rehti hoon khwabon mein sehra akbar ka
toot ke roz bikhar jaate hai aansuon ke haar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se falak par chand nazar aaya hai moharam ka
lagta hai mujhko arsh bhi jaise farsh ho matam ka
chand ke peeche jaise chipi ho barchi aur talwaar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ye dua ay maalik mera baabul khair se ho
ghayr na le sehrayi darinde duldul khair se ho
ache nahi haalat bhi shayad kufe ke us paar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya hui aakhir mujhse khata maloom to ho mujhko
paayi hai kyun furqat ki saza maloom to ho mujhko
rooth gaya majboor behen se kyun beeran ka pyaar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...

khat bheja aur qasid se sandes bhi keh laaya
phir bhi mujh birhan ka kisi ko dhyaan nahi aaya
bhool gaya pardes mein jaa kar mujhko mera pariwar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
haar gayi mai kismat ki tehreerein jeet gayi
raasta takte takte do do eidein beet gayi
ho na saka hamshakle nabi ke chehre ka deedar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise bataun kitna kathin hai hijr ka gham bhaiya
choomti rehti hoon mai tere nakshe qadam bhaiya
darr hai mit jaaye na kahin in qadmon ke aasaar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere maalik mere pardesi kunbe ki khair
behno ke maaon ke phupiyon ke parde ki khair
khwaab mein maine dekhe hai kuch pathar aur bazaar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh rahi hoon naiza naiza chadar chadar khoon
basti basti sehra sehra pathar pathar khoon
sheeshe mein jo khaak thi wo bhi hogayi khoon ki dhaar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaise kisi barchi ki chuban mehsoos ho seene mein
rone lagti hai ek bibi ab bhi madine mein
sunte hi aamir ki zaban se nayyar ke ash'aar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...

items.title: Ghar chalo ay
items.body:
ghar chalo ghar chalo ay sakina
qabr e zindan pe zainab pukari
hogayi hai rehaai hamari
ghar chalo…
<<DIVIDER>>
poochti thi ye har baar mujhse
dekh kar aasman ke parinde
phupi amma ye mujhko batado
kab talak jayenge hum madine
utho utho sarwar ki pyari
ghar chalo…

kaan zakhmi hai ab tak tumhare
utho marham unhe mai lagadoo
gar tum na saath aao hamare
kaise ghazi ko chehra dikhaun
apne ammu ki tum ho dulaari
ghar chalo…
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ghazab ka andhera yahan par
aur kisi simt ujaala nahi hai
hai parayi ye basti yahan ki
koi ghamkhwar apna nahi hai
hogayi ye phupi tumpe waari
ghar chalo…
<<DIVIDER>>
ab to paidal bhi tum na chalogi
aur na zulm o sitam ko sahogi
na rasan koi baandhega tumko
aur na haaton se parda karogi
mil gayi hai jo chadar tumhari
ghar chalo…
<<DIVIDER>>
jab mai jaungi apne watan ko
ujde ghar ko mai seh na sakungi
meri masooma meri sakina
ye batao usay kya kahoongi
tumko pooche jo behna tumhari
ghar chalo…
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala ki zameen pe hai asghar
aur saath uske soye hai sarwar
kaun dilaasa usay dega dilbar
jo yahan sogayi ho zameen par
mar na jaye ye maadar tumhari
ghar chalo…
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid e zindan se haye ahmed
ab talak bhi reha ho na paayi
sheh ki is laadli ko ay mohsin
ye zameen kis tarha raas aayi
keh rahi thi phupi gham ki maari

items.body:

items.title: Lahoo Husain Ka Hai Raegaan Na Jayega
items.body:
Rang Layega Zaroor Rang Layega
Dhaaye Kis Qadar Jahaan Ye Zulm Dhaaye Ga
Hosila Humara Kitna Aazmayega
Aayega Zaroor Aik Waqt Ayega
Warisay Husain Jab Naqab Uthayega
Asalam Fatima Ke Laal Asalam
Shahkaar E Azmay Bay Misaal Asalam
Jisko Teri Na Khudayi Mustarad Karay
Woh Safeena E Hayat Doob Jayega
Sunnatay Rasool Hai Vila Husain Ki
Hai Bahisht Ki Sanad Wafa Husain Ki
Karbala Ko Aansuon Ka Tum Khiraaj Doh
Har Mahazay Zindagi Pe Kaam Ayega
Ye Lahoo Ghareeb O Bay Nawa Ka Ye Lahoo
Ye Lahoo Shaheeday Karbala Ka Ye Lahoo
Ye Lahoo Jo Beh Raha Hai Raigay Garm Par
Ye Lahoo Ajal Ko Zindagi Banayega
Ye Lahoo Husain Ka Nahi Nabi Ka Hai
Fatima Ka Hai Hasan Ka Hai Ali Ka Hai
Doob Jayega Khud Apnay Beheray Zulm May
Iss Lahoo Ki Zad Pe Jo Yazid Ayega
Manzilay Saba Toh Shukr Ka Khaleel Hai
Maa Azeemtar Hai Aur Pidar Jaleel Hai
Aye Yazeed E Bad Sipaat Ye Husain
Sar Jhukayega Nahi Ye Sar Katayega
Karbala May Dukhtaray Rasool Lut Gayi
Qatl Hogaya Pisar Batool Lut Gayi
Raigay Garm Par Parhi Hain Mayatein Tamam
Kya Khabar Thi Aal Par Ye Waqt Aayega

items.title: Abbas chale aao
items.body:
Abbas abbas chale aao
Zainab ne sada di hai abbas chale aao.
Mahol fasadi hai abbas chale aao.
Rone ki manadi hai abbas chale aao.
Tum jab se gaye bhai zainab ko na nind aai.
Main tumko mere bhai rone bhi nahin paai.
Naamuse mohammad ko ghere hain tamashai.
Asghar bhi gaye mare sarwar bhi nahin baqi.
Qasim bhi nahin baqi akbar bhi nahin baqi.
Kya tumko ye sunna haikhwahar bhi nahi baqi.
Pamal hue lashey naizon pa kate sir hain.
Afsos k maqtal mein uriyan tane athar hain.
Kabe k muhafiz bhi pardes mein be ghar hain.
Furqat mein shahe deen ki rah rah k tadapte hain.
Salare haram aabid hargaam larazte hain.
Nanhi si sakina ko be peer ghudakte hain.
Asghar ki bhi laash aai akbar ki bhi laash aai
Shabbir ki maiyyat pe khud pahonchi hai maajai.
Aur tumneto khwahar ko surat bhi na dikhlai.
Masoom sakina ko durron se aziyat hai.
Sajjad pe harlamha ek taza musibat hai.
Majruh imamat hai majruh shriyat hai.
Toofane masayeb hai maghmum tabiyat mein.
Ham qaid hue bhai zindane musibat mein.
Ham qaid hue bhai is aalame ghurbat mein.
Aye ammu taras khao kahtithi ye roro kar.
Mazluma yatima ki nazrein thi lagi darpar.
Maut aai usey phir bhi kahti hi rahi muztar.
Abbase dilawar se kahti hain ye masooma.
Tum mere muhafiz ho mahfuz karo rauza.
Rauza jo mera tuta phir hoga mujhe sadma.
Abbas k waris na ajayein shajar jab tak.
Gham aale mohammad ka tum karte raho tabtak.
Ye nauha bhi taaza hai bibi ka azim abtak.

ab dedo hussain ka kuch sadqa
hamein raas na aayi...

items.title: Haye mere bemaar
items.body:
haye mera bemaar imam

ghash mein pada hai tashnakaam
hojaye gham se na tamaam
haye mera bemaar…
<<DIVIDER>>
durre hai tazeerein hai
paon mein zanjeerein hai
haath mein taqdeerein hai
chalna hai mushkil do gaam
haye mera bemaar…
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhm lahoo barsaata hai
dil hai ke chalka aata hai
durre khaata jaata hai
lamha lamha gaam ba gaam
haye mera bemaar…
<<DIVIDER>>
bughz o hasad se keeno se
lau dete huwe seeno se
kalma go be-deeno se
chalta hua bazaare shaam
haye mera bemaar…
<<DIVIDER>>
maa'on behno ke chehre
baalon ke peeche hai chupe
haath bandhe hai sar hai khule
saamne hai ek majmeine aam
haye mera bemaar…
<<DIVIDER>>
majma saara hasta hai
dil ka zehr ugalta hai
khoon ke aansu rota hai
sar ko jhukaye tashnakaam
haye mera bemaar…
<<DIVIDER>>
kalmagoyo ka majma
aur payambar ka kunba
haif hai sar nange hai khada
aaj sar e darbare shaam
haye mera bemaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
teer sa dil pe lagta hai
ek rasan mein basta hai
shimr e sitamgar hasta hai
le le kar ek ek ka naam
haye mera bemaar…

umme rabab ye laila hai

items.title: Hussain girta hai
items.body:
hussain girta hai ghode se aaiye amma
lage na zakhm khudara bachaiye amma
<<DIVIDER>>
sadyein deta hai ro ro ke aap ko sarwar
mujhe galay se laga lijiye khareeb aa kar
khudara naaz mere phir uthaiye amma
hussain girta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye imtehan bhi shabbir dene jaate hai
zameen e garm pe zakhmon ke saath aate hai
sulagti rayt hai daaman bichaiye amma
hussain girta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dua kare ke na mujh sa koi ghareeb howe
kahin se khatra agar aab ka naseeb howe
hamari tashna labi ko bujhaiye amma
hussain girta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye zauf kehta hai utha na jayega sarwar
karoo mai aap ki tazeem maadar e muztar
sahara de ke mujhe bas uthaiye amma
hussain girta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sukoon mujhko milega yaqeen hai mujhko
jo zakhm hai wo silega yaqeen hai mujhko
jo ho sake to galay se lagaiye amma
hussain girta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai aap maa meri mai aap ka ghareeb hussain
qaza se hogaya is waqt to khareeb hussain
qaza ka waqt hai himmat bandhaiye amma
hussain girta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mangaya tha kabhi kapda bahisht se mera
phir ek baar ye zehmat gawara ho lilaah
jina se mera kafan ab mangaiye amma
hussain girta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
yehi thi dayam o yazdan ghareeb ki hasrat
na dekh paye behan mere zakhm ki kasrat
rida se zakhm hamara chupaiye amma

items.author: Dayam Najafi

items.title: Jawan ali akbar
items.body:
raahat e jaan wird e zaban
saa'at e azan jaan ali akbaram
<<DIVIDER>>
jawan ali akbar naujawan ali akbar
ay gul e laila ali jaan ali akbaram
jawan ali akbar naujawan ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
ay dil o jaan e pidar shakle payambar akbar
ay qaraar e dil e zainab gul e maadar akbar
misle abbas e jari shere dilawar akbar
yusuf e fatema zahra dil e hyder akbar
husn e zaman akbar ay naaz e chaman akbar
ay gul e laila...
jawan ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
maula shabir ne maanga hai duaon mein tumhe
ghazi abbas ne rakha hai panaaho mein tumhe
mil ke do maaon ne paala hai ridaon mein tumhe
rabb e akbar ne rakha noori hijabon mein tumhe
naaz e dil e sarwar ay shabih e paighambar
<<DIVIDER>>
boli laila ke galay mujhko lagate jao
boli zainab mujhe surat to dikhate jao
bole shabbir meri aas bandhate jao
mujhko nana ki ziyarat to karate jao
haye lahoo mein tar humsurat e paighambar
ay gul e laila...
jawan ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise maqtal tumhe jaane ki ijazat de doo
kaise qaime se nikalne ki ijazat de doo
kaise is pyaas mein ladne ki ijazat de doo
maa hoo kaise tumhe marne ki ijazat de doo
ay jaan e dil e maadar ye maa ho fida tum par
ay gul e laila...
jawan ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaake seene pe sina zeen se akbar jo gira
ho gaya qaimon mein kohraam bapa wawaila
ye sada dasht mein deta tha ghareeb e zahra
haye akbar mera akbar mera akbar na raha
noor e nazar akbar ay naaz e pidar akbar
ay gul e laila...
jawan ali akbar...

saani e zahra kisko bulaye

saani e zahra kisko bulaye

ay mere asghar hasliyon waale
kaise phupi ab dil ko sambhale
dhal gayi shaam aur tum bhi na aaye
saani e zahra kisko bulaye
kaun hai jo imdad...

zainabe muztar shaam e ghariban
khaak pe baithi baal pareshan
gham ki hai dhoop aur dard ke saaye
saani e zahra kisko bulaye
kaun hai jo imdad...

ek rasan mein baara galay hai
chote bade sab qaidi bane hai
kaun inhe aafat se chudaye
saani e zahra kisko bulaye
kaun hai jo imdad...
<<DIVIDER>>
aake watan se door safar mein
sab kuch luta hai ek dopahar mein
dushman pe bhi ye waqt na aaye
saani e zahra kisko bulaye
kaun hai jo imdad...

kaise ho ab parde ki hifazat
jiske bharose li thi zamanat

aun o mohamed qasim e muztar

qaisar ka nauha kehna aur shadman ka padna

items.title: Abbas e Alamdaar
items.body:
Chadar e Zainab ka nighedar Abbas e Alamdar
Lashkar e Shabbir ka Salar Abbas e Alamdar
Dete Ladne Ki Raza Jo Shahe Jinn o Bashar
Door Tak Aate Nahi Ran Mein Kuffar Nazar
Aapse Phir Bhi Koi, Ladne Aajata Agar
Jism Se Hota Juda, Uska Kuch Lamhon Mei Sar
Hoti Jafa Ki Khatm Wahaan Zindagi
Fauj e yazeedi mei nahi Bachta koi
Milti agar aapko talwaar Abbas e Alamdaar
Nehr Pe Pohach Gaye, Mashk Paani Se Bhari
Apne Rahwaar Se Phir Bole Yeh Ibne Ali
Tu bhI Pyaasa Hai Bohat Thoda Pii Lee Paani
Sar Jhuka Kar Yeh Faras Ne Kaha Ay Ghazi
Bachche Hai Pyaase Paani Piun Kis Tarha
Naam E Sakina Pe Nahi Paani Piya
Pyaasa Raha Aapka Rahwaar Abbas e Alamdaar
Haye Ashoor Ke Din Tha Qayamat Ka Samaañ
Kham Kamar Thaame Huwe Aur Liye Khushk Zabaañ
Aaye Ghazi ke qareeN, Malik e Kaun o Makaañ
Sar Ko Zanu Pe Rakha, Bole Yeh Shahe Zamaañ
Aap Ne Tifli Se Humme Aaqa Kaha
Kardo Ay Ghazi Pura Yeh Armaañ Mera
Bhai Bhi Kehdo Humme Ek baar Abbas e Alamdaar
Jab Rasan Basta Huwe, Roke Zainab Ne Kaha
Tasnalab Sher E Jari,ay Sakina Ke Chacha
Uth Ke Dekho Toh Zara,ay Alamdaar E Wafa
Jaa Rahi Hai Yeh Behan,chord Kar Karbobala
Baad Tumhare, Aise Hai Badla Jahaan
Na Koi Mehmil Na Hai Koi Saebaan
Chalne Ko Hai Kafela Tayyar Abbas e Alamdar
Hai Yeh Atif Ki Dua Ay Shahenshaahe Wafa
Aake Rauze Pe Tumhare Woh Pade Yeh Nauha
Ho Surani Pe Karam Ay Wafaon Ke Khuda
Yunhi Likhta Woh Rahe Aapke Nauhe Sadaa
Bab E Hawaij Dil Ki Hai Yeh Ilteja
Baali Sakina Ka Hai Tumhe Vaasta
Hum Bhi Bane Aapke Zawwaar, Abbas E Alamdaar

barchi ali akbar...

zainab ne kaha haaye mere naazon ke paale

items.title: Bhaiya tum laut ke
items.body:
bhaiya tum laut ke ke kab khair se ghar aaoge

chand hi roz ko zinda hai tumhari behna

maine ro ro ke guzaare hai khushi ke mausam

log diljoyi kiya karte hai bemaaron ki
haath rakhta nahi sar par mere bhaiya koi

nagaah ek khabar doshe hawa par aayi

kaise tehreer ho rehaan o raza haye wo baat

items.title: Dar dhoond ke
items.body:
dar dhoond ke zindan ka ye kehti hai sakina

is aalam e tanhaai mein mar jaaun na baba
marne se sakina ko bachane chale aao
<<DIVIDER>>
har waqt teri yaad mein roti hai sakina
maghmoom teri aas mein hoti hai sakina
naraaz teri lakhte jigar tujhse hai baba
roothi hui beti ko manane chale aao
dar dhoond ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai chain ka ek saans bhi baba nahi leti
ye pyaas ki shiddat mujhe sone nahi deti
ab neend teri beti ko na aayegi baba
ek chain ki lori hi sunane chale aao
dar dhoond ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar mera bhaiya wo meri jaan kahan hai
cheh maah jo dunya mein tha mehman kahan hai
baba mujhe bhaiya ki judaai nahi bhooli
asghar ko sakina se milane chale aao
dar dhoond ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek daagh hai bhai ka kamar tod'di jis ne
ek daagh hai bete ka nazar cheenli jis ne
jo dil pe lage zakhm tumhe karbobala mein
baba wo sakina ko dikhane chale aao
dar dhoond ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
bistar nahi sone ke liye farshe zameen hai
mai sheh ki yateema hoon mera qalb hazeen hai
zindan ka andhera hai muqaddar mera baba
tareeki e zindan ko mitane chale aao
dar dhoond ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai aale mohamed ke gharane ka nagina
is waaste baba mujhe kehte thay sakina
zaalim ke tamachon ne sukoon cheena hai mera
kab aaoge baba ye batane chale aao
dar dhoond ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo zulm kiye shimr ne chehre se ayaan hai
rukhsaar pe zaalim ke tamachon ke nishan hai
baba mere rone pe yahan pehre lage hai
in pehron ko ay baba hatane chale aao
dar dhoond ke...
items.author: Zulqarnain

items.title: Ghar fatema zehra
items.body:
ghar fatema zehra ka ajab shan ka ghar hai
ye wahi ki manzil hai ye quran ka ghar hai
islam ke maahol mein emaan ka ghar hai
momin ki munafiq ki ye pehchan ka ghar hai
kuch log mare jaate hai is ranjo mehan mein
is ghar ka jo darwaza hai masjid ke sehan mein
<<DIVIDER>>
allah ne is ghar ko nabuwat se nawaza
dunya mein isay deen o shariyat se nawaza
qismat se imamat se wilayat se nawaza
har fard ko quran ki aayat se nawaza
saanche mein mashiyat ke ye afraad dhale hai
sab chadare tatheer ke saaye mein pale hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye azm ke faulaad isi ghar mein milenge
ye noor ke ajsaad isi ghar ay milenge
jibreel ke ustaad isi ghar mein milenge
is satha ke afraad isi ghar mein milenge
maqlooq ki baat aakhri sarhad nazar aaya
jis fard ko dekha wo mohamed nazar aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
ashaab mukarram hai magar apni jagah par
ghair apni jagah laqte jigar apni jagah par
khaar apni jagah ghunchaye tar apni jagah par
sang apni jagah laal-o-gohar apni jagah par
pehlu mein jo baitha ho usay dil nahi kehte
rehro kabhi rehbare manzil nahi kehte
<<DIVIDER>>
allah re izzo sharafe binte risalat
qandeele haram shamme shabistane imamat
rehmat jo mohamed hai to ye paraye rehmat
wo kulle nabuwat hai to ye juzze nabuwat
aasaan kaho maarifate khatme rasul ko
jo juz ko na samjha ho wo kya samjhega kul ko
items.author: Hasan Imdad

items.title: Hamsheer Khuda Hafiz
items.body:
Sarwar Ne Kaha Rokar Hamsheer Khuda Haafiz
Hum Jaate Hain Marne Ko Dilgeer Khuda Haafiz
Sarwar Me Kaha Rokar Hamsheer Khuda Haafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Bachpan Ka Kiya Wada Ab Mujhko Nibhana Hai,
Sar De Ke Mujhe Apna Islam Bachana Hai,
Nana Ki Bachani Hai Jageer Khuda Haafiz
Sarwar Ne Kaha Rokar..........
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Amma Ke Mere Kurta Pehnao Behan Zainab,
Gardan Ka Meri Bosa Lo Aao Behan Zainab,
Chal Jayegi Gardan Par Shamsheer Khuda Haafiz
Sarwar Ne Kaha Rokar........
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ghurbat Mein Mujhe Maa Ne Armano'n Se Paala Hai,
Pardes Mein Ab Mujh Par Kya Waqt Ye Aaya Hai,
Lutti Hai Teri Maa Ki Jageer Khuda Haafiz
Sarwar Ne Kaha Rokar........
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ab Khushk Gale Par Hi Khanjar Wo Chalayenge,
Phir Sar Ko Mere Zaalim Naize Pe Chadha Yenge,
Mil Jayegi Mitti Mein Tasveer Khuda Haafiz
Sarwar Ne Kaha Rokar........
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Wo Zulm O Masaib Hain Seh Roz Ke Pyaase Parz
Kya Kya Na Sitam Tote Ahmed Ke Nawase Par,
Ummat Ne Na Ki Meri Touqeer Khuda Haafiz
Sarwar Ne Kaha Rokar........
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Qaime Bhi Jalayenge Chadar Bhi Utarenge,
Haato'n Ko Tere Behna Rassi Se Bhi Bandhenge,
Is Tarah Teri Hogi Tash-heer Khuda Haafiz
Sarwar Ne Kaha Rokar........
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Masoom Sakina Ko Zaalim Se Bachana Hai,
Sajjad Ko Bhi Himmat Har Haal Mein Dena Hai,
Pehnayenge Jab Zalim Zanjeer Khuda Haafiz
Sarwar Ne Kaha Rokar........
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Us Waqt Falak Roya Us Aan Zamee'n Kanpi,
Wasiq O Muqarrib Jab Sarwar Ki Bhi Royi,
Shabbir Jo Kehte The Hamsheer Khuda Haafiz
Sarwar Ne Kaha Rokar Hamsheer Khuda Haafiz

lilaah karam kuch farmeine

items.title: Dar E Binte Payambar
items.body:
Juk Kar Salaam Karte The Jis Dar Pe Mustafa
Uske Makeen Par Hi Gazab Dha Diya Gya...
Ahmad Ke Madeene Me Bapa Ho Gya Mehshar
Ummat Ne Jalaya Hai Dare Binte Payambar
1 . Masoom Tha Duniya Me Wo Aaya Bhi Nahi Tha
Zahra(S.A)Ne Abhi Jula Julaya Bhi Nahi Tha
Mohsin Ko Kabhi Bhul Nahi Payegi Maadar
2 . Pasli Pe Rakhe Hath Imamat Ki Muhafiz
Shehzadi Chali Ban Ke Wilayat Ki Muhafiz
Darbaar Rasan Basta Jo Laaye Gaye Haider
3 . Sadma Ye Rakam Koi Qalam Kar Nahi Sakta
Darbaar Ka Manzar Me Rakam Kar Nahi Sakta
Zahra S.A Hain Khadi Kursi Pe Baithe Hain Sitamgar
4 . Qur,Aan Ne Di Jiski Sadakat Ki Gawaahi
Khud Us Se Fidak Ke Liye Hai Maangi Gawaahi
Tareekh Kabhi Bhul N Payegi Ye Manzar
5 . Zakhmi Hain Sabhi Ungliya Or Baazu Bhi Zakhmi
Ye Tooti Hui Pasliya Chalne Nahi Deti
Ik Hath Hai Pehlu Pe To Ik Hath Kamar Par
6 . Jab Guslo Qafan Dene Lage Binte Nabi Ko
Kaap Uththa Badan Or Na Rahi Taab Ali Ko
Zakhmo Pe Nazar Padte Hi Gash Kha Gye Haider
7 . Sadiya Hui Ummat Ke Sitam Jaari Hai Ab Bhi
Gaibat Se Madad Ke Liye Aa Jao Ya Mehdi
Saya Bhi Nahi Aapki Daadi Ki Lahad Par
8 . Rizwan Kabhi Subbat Alyya N Bhulana
Rudaade Game Fatema(S A)Farhaan Sunana
Hota Nahi Har Ak Ko Ye Sog Mayyasaar

items.title: Ghar ghar me bicha hai farshe azaa
items.body:
Ya hussain (4)
Phir maahe muharram aya hai
Ghar ghar me bicha hai farshe azaa
Ya hussain (4)
1) Aati hai sadaye matam ki har simt fiza me nauha hai,
Paiker hai mukammal yeh gham ka,
Jo chand falak pe ubhra hai,
Sab ghar me aza khaane hai saje'n (2)
Ek sog ka alam chaya hai...
2) Har dil me ghamo ki lehre hai,
Ashqo ka samadar palkho par,
Maqtal ke manazir aankhon me,
Tehrir ki yeh kisne akar,
Gham apne bhula kar har insaa'n (2)
Shabbir ke gham me rota hai...
3) Pyase jo rahen thay maqtal mein,
Toh yaad me un sab baccho ki,
Paani ki sabile jaari hai,
Jo pyaas bujhati hai sabki,
Apna ho, ya ho gair koi (2)
Sehraab isi se hota hai...
4) Jab farshe aza bichta hai kahin,
Aur nauhay sunaaye jaate hai,
Shabbir ke purse ki khatir,
Sab ehle haram ajaate hai,
Mehmaan waha par hai zehra (2)
Jis ghar me majlis barpa hai...
5) sarwar ke juloos o ke aagey,
Abbas ke parcham hote hai,
Aur matami halqo ki surat,
Sab ehle matam hote hai,
Shabbir ka gham har aankh hai nam (2)
Har lab pe buqao girya hai...
6) Ha zehra ka bhara ghar ujda tha,
Haider ko bohot tadpaya tha,
Vo maahe aza eksat hijri,
Jo karbobala me aya tha,
Us maahe muharram ki yaaden (2)
Yeh maahe muharram laata hai..
7) Is chand ko dekho aye logo,
Jo chand falaq par hai yeh aya,
Is chand ke paikar me shaamil,
Sughra ke ghamo ka sara baya,
Akbar,Asghar,Qasim,Gazi (2)
Har aks nazar aajata hai...
8) Salmaan o Taqi farshe gham par,
Sab matami aur sab nauha khuwa'n,
Karte hai namaz e ishq ada,
Dete hai sada nauho ki azaa'n
Ta hashr nibhaayenge aise (2)
Zehra se hamara wada hai...
