khoon ugalti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hyder ko is tareeqe se hasnain uthaye thay
jis tarha koi kaandhe pe mayyat ko laadle
mushkil kusha ke beton pa mushkil ki inteha
qatl sajde mein...
khoon ugalti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaye ali jo ghar mein to roti thi bibiyan
kulsoom sar ko peet ke leti thi hichkiyan
zainab giri hai khaak pe karti hui buka
qatl sajde mein...
khoon ugalti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
nasir ye nauha sunke bahot roye soghwaar
haathon ko apne jod ke ye bole soghwaar
arif ne pursa aap ka dil se ada kiya
qatl sajde mein...
khoon ugalti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar peete fatema
khoon roye mustafa
shabbar ka tadapna
shabbir ka girya
ghazi ka machalna
kulsoom ghamzada
zainab ne ye kaha
sar dekh ke tera
haye haye mere baba
items.author: Nasir Hussain

items.title: Hussain haye hussain
items.body:
kahan se laaun bhara ghar hussain haye hussain
pukari zainab e muztar hussain haye hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare baad to ab jab bhi shaam aati hai
saron ko dar se patakne ki kaam aati hai
baraste rehte hai aankhon se ta-sehar sab ki
lahoo bhare hue manzar hussain haye hussain
pukari zainab e muztar...
<<DIVIDER>>
palat ke aun o mohamed bhi ghar nahi aate
ab umme laila ko akbar nazar nahi aate
tadapti rehti hai qasim ki yaad mein farwa
rubab kehti hai asghar hussain haye hussain
pukari zainab e muztar...
<<DIVIDER>>
guzur gaye hai kayi din na sabr hai na kharaar
tumhe bulaati hai raaton ko neend mein kayi baar
kabhi kabhi yahan hum sab se chup ke kone mein
sakina roti hai aksar hussain haye hussain
pukari zainab e muztar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kate jo pani ki khaatir kareeb nehr e furaat
wohi to thay mere baazu wohi to thay mere haath
mila huwa hai dil o jaan mein zakhm ki soorat
hai jiska naam alam par hussain haye hussain
pukari zainab e muztar...
<<DIVIDER>>
badan tha jism ali ka lahoo rasool ka tha
jigar hassan ka tha seene mein dil batool ka tha
wo jism chod ke aayi hoo tapte sehra mein
wo sar hai noke sina par hussain haye hussain
pukari zainab e muztar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo hum pe toot gaya aasman e ranj o mehan
qayaam qaid mein hota hai aur safar mein rasan
aseeri bebasi o bekasi ke aalam mein
mera salaam ho tum par hussain haye hussain
pukari zainab e muztar...
items.author: Husnain

items.title: Jawan hokar jahan se
items.body:
jawan hokar jahan se tum sidhare ay ali akbar
jiye ab maa bata kiske sahare ali akbar
jawan hokar jahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
badi umeedein wabasta thi tumse jab jawan hoge
phuphi ke maa'on behno ke sahare ay ali akbar
jawan hokar jahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
safeena doobta hai maa ka ab majdhaar may beta
lagaye kaun kashti ab kanare ay ali akbar
jawan hokar jahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
balaye chand se chehre ki loon ek baar to aaja
nazar ka maa teri sadqa utaare ay ali akbar
jawan hokar jahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
shama roti rahi kadiyal jawan ki dekh kar surat
wo jab maa ne tere gaysu saware ay ali akbar
jawan hokar jahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
lagaye aas baithi hai udhar sughra madine may
behan ko lene kab jaa'oge pyare ay ali akbar
jawan hokar jahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
sakina khogayi hai ban may kehdo uske ammu se
ye dukhiya maa kahan jaa kar pukare ay ali akbar
jawan hokar....
<<DIVIDER>>
pidar se yun bhi koi root'ta hai maan bhi jao
zaeefi kis tarha tujh bin guzare ay ali akbar
jawan hokar jahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
sada anjum wo kya deta jigar tukhde badan chalni
na bolay moo se wo aur maa pukare ay ali akbar
jawan hokar jahan...
items.author: Anjum Zaidi

items.title: Kaise ho musalman
items.body:
kaise ho musalman charaghon ko bujhado
shehzadi e kaunain khule sar hai rida do
<<DIVIDER>>
uth'ta hua qaimon se dhuan dekhne walon
islam ke ghar may hai lagi aag bujhado
kaise ho musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
is din ke liye paala tha kya binte nabi ne
shabbir ka sar kaat ke naize pe chadado
kaise ho musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghodon se tan e sibte nabi raundh rahe ho
dar par hai behan ran ki zara khaak uda do
kaise ho musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye shaam ka bazaar mohamed ki nawasi
uryan sar e islam hai chadar to udha do
kaise ho musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa dekh na le sar ko kahin bar sare naiza
jis par sar e asghar hai zara door hata do
kaise ho musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghabrake tamachon se ye kehti thi sakina
achi phupi amma mere ammu ko bula do
kaise ho musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ke matam ki sada goonj rahi hai
utho meri awaaz se awaaz mila do
kaise ho musalman...

items.title: Kaun kehta hai ke
items.body:
kaun kehta hai ke darya ki rawani de do
zaalimo asghar e baysheer ko pani de do
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ne ehtemaam ki hujjat ali asghar tum bhi
ab jo dena ho wo paigham zabani de do
kaun kehta hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ummate jad ki hai bakshish ka sakina ye sawaal
tashnagi lelo ghame tashna dahani de do
kaun kehta hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
hashr tak bhool na paye ye zamana jis ko
aaj tareekh ko ek aisi kahani de do
kaun kehta hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
maalik e kausar o tasneem ali ke ho pisar
alqama cheez hai kya hyder e saani de do
kaun kehta hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
khusk reti pe safeena hai kate haathon se
kashti e deen e elaahi ko rawani de do
kaun kehta hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
baksh do deen ko hamshakle payambar ye shabab
aaj islam ko akbar ye jawani de do
kaun kehta hai ke...

items.title: Kisi ki mayyat tadap
items.body:
ye sham e ashoor ka hai manzar
hai karb main itrat e payambar
jabeen pa saahil pa alqama ke
kisi ki mayyat tadap rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye koi mehve buka hai shayad
kisi ne ammu kaha hai shayad
bada hai shayad koi sitamgar
jabeen pa saahil pa alqama ke
kisi ki mayyat tadap rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
wo bholi bhali si ek bachi
najaf ki jaanib jo tak rahi thi
kisi ne cheene hai uske gohar
jabeen pa saahil pa alqama ke
kisi ki mayyat tadap rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
atash se bache machal rahe hai
ye phool sholon may jal rahe hai
chaman may kumla gaye gule tar
jabeen pa saahil pa alqama ke
kisi ki mayyat tadap rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hujoom e gham se jo neem jaan hai
wohi jo bemaar o natawan hai
kisi ne kheyncha hai uska bistar
jabeen pa saahil pa alqama ke
kisi ki mayyat tadap rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
rahi jo kufe ki shaahzadi
kisi ne shayad usay sada di
chini hai kausar ab uski chadar
jabeen pa saahil pa alqama ke
kisi ki mayyat tadap rahi hai
items.author: Kausar Naqvi

items.title: Mai jaa raha hoo
items.body:
hogayi poori dua marhaba salle alaa
uth gaye mere qadam jaanib e karbobala
is din ka barso se tha intezaar
mai bhi ziarat to tha be qaraar
hai arbaeen shabbir ka mai jaa raha hoo karbala
paidal safar karta hua mai jaa raha hoo karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
do jannato ke darmiyan sajda karoo ye khwab tha
jaa kar kafe abbas par nauha padhoo ye khwab tha
jo khwab tha sacha hua mai jaa raha hoo karbala
hai arbaeen shabbir ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
us maqtal e shabbir mein dena hai pursa khoon ka
karna hai us dehleez par seena zani ka haq ada
maangoo khuda se aur kya mai jaa raha hoo karbala
hai arbaeen shabbir ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
haji kahe zaair kahe mujhko sabhi ahle aza
maula mujhe de ye sharaf karta tha mai har dam dua
mujhko sharaf mil hi gaya mai jaa raha hoo karbala
hai arbaeen shabbir ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
haathon mein ek lekar alam abbas ka mehwe buka
jaa'un najaf se karbala muddat se ye armaan tha
armaan ye poora hua mai jaa raha hoo karbala
hai arbaeen shabbir ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab matami jeete rahe aao kare mil kar dua
maula ka ho hum pe karam bibi ki ho hum par ata
honton pe ho bas ye sada mai jaa raha hoo karbala
hai arbaeen shabbir ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek maqam e shahadat pe mai
matam karunga sare karbala
akbar ne khaayi jahan par sina
pamaal qasim jahan par hua
ghazi ke baazu jahan par kate
paalon ka asghar jahan so gaya
aur jis jagah sheh ke qaime jale
cheeni gayi bibiyon ki rida
mai us jagah karke aah o buka
majlis kara'unga behre aza
mai jaa raha hoo karbala
hai arbaeen shabbir ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo safdar o mazhar ho ya zaair koi shabbir ka
abbas de jis ko sada jaata wohi hai karbala
ghazi ne di mujhko sada mai jaa raha hoo karbala
hai arbaeen shabbir ka...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Abbas e jari
items.body:
ay faatah e khyber ke bete
ay sher e jawan abbas e jari
karti hai tumhari turbat par
zainab ye fughan abbas e jari
<<DIVIDER>>
hum gheerat hyder shaan e ali
poocho to behan par kya guzri
utho mai dikhane aayi hoo
baazu ke nishan abbas e jari
<<DIVIDER>>
di maine sada bhaiya tum ko
amma ne pukara tha tum ko
jab pyase galay par sarwar ke
khanjar tha rawan abbas e jari
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ne tum ko yaad kiya
hasrat se suye saahil dekha
peeri mein uthayi bekas ne
jab laashe jawan abbas e jari
<<DIVIDER>>
jab shaam e ghariban qaime jale
jab hum pe baraste thay kode
saahil pe suni hogi tum ne
bewon ki fughan abbas e jari
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ke dil par kya guzri
kuch tum ko khabar iski na hui
tooti mere akbar ke dil mein
jab nok e sina abbas e jari
<<DIVIDER>>
be-maqna o chadar aale nabi
bazaar mein darbaron mein gayi
har lamha tumhe deti thi sada
ashkon ki zuban abbas e jari
<<DIVIDER>>
tum naaz uthaate thay jis ke
hum qaid mein usko chod aaye
ta hashr tumhari pyari ka
zindan hai makan abbas e jari
<<DIVIDER>>
ay sher e dilawar kya bayan
phat'ta hai jigar rukti hai zuban
pamaal hua tanha ran mein
zehra ka nishan abbas e jari
<<DIVIDER>>
bano ne jo asghar ka laasha
shabbir ke haathon par dekha
manzar tha qayamt ka bhaiya
mehshar ka samaa abbas e jari
<<DIVIDER>>
jawed tha ek mehshar barpa
ghazi ka larazta tha rauza
awaaz jo deti thi zainab
ay sher e jawan abbas e jari
items.author: Ali Jaweed Maqsood

items.title: Al madad ya zahra
items.body:
fatema zahra
haye haye zainab haye haye shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam ko jaate huwe
kehti thi saani e zahra
al madad ya zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
sharm aati thi mujhe mai baap se na keh saki
aap maa hai jaanti hai kaifiyat dil ki meri
ho gayi binte ali na mehramon mein beparda
al madad ya zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
bekasi dikhla rahi hai kya qayamat ka samaa
mar na jaaye gham se maqtal mein kahin asghar ki maa
kaise dekhegi bhala naize pe jism asghar ka
al madad ya zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
door na hone diya tha apni nazron se jise
us jawan bete ko laila alwida kaise kahe
laashe akbar saamne rone pe hai laga pehra
al madad ya zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
hathkadi haathon mein hai aur bediyan hai paon mein
ab kaha mohlat milegi baithne ki chhaon mein
shaam tak sajjad ka kaanto se hai hai bhara rasta
al madad ya zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
ladkhadate hai qadam aur aankh mein aansu bhare
marhala dushwaar hoga ye ruqayya ke liye
laasha e abbas se guzregi kaise beparda
al madad ya zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
dasht mein taqseem kaise hogaya wo mahjabeen
sar kahin tukde kahin hai aur sehra hai kahin
apne qasim ko bhala pehchane kis tarha farwa
al madad ya zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
berida binte ali hai bekafan ibne ali
shaam jaaye ya sambhale laash ko shabbir ki
kaampte honton pe ye fizza ke isteghasa tha
al madad ya zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
dasht mein aun o mohamed ki takallum thi sada
bhar na aaye maa ka dil laashe chupade ay hawa
ruk na jaaye ye qadam hai sakht imtehan maa ka
al madad ya zehra...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Alwida ya hussain
items.body:
shaah e mashraqain fatema ke chain
ya maula hussain alvida
alvida ya hussain alvida ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
roke zainab ye karti thi bain alvida
alvida ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj akbar ki mayyat pe mai ro chuki
haath afsos abbas se dho chuki
kisko kisko kahun mai kisay kho chuki
bhai ab zulm ki inteha ho chuki
alvida ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai kya kehke bewon ko samjhaungi
sar khule kaise darbar may jaungi
kaise baali sakina ko behlaungi
mere maajaye tumko kahan paungi
alvida ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai tum thokare ran may khaate rahe
laash maidan se qaime may laate rahe
har tarha deen e haq ko bachate rahe
apni manzil ke nazdeek aate rahe
alvida ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab wo baysheer ki bezubani kahan
akbar e naujawan ki jawani kahan
ab wo abbas ki paasbani kahan
al-atash ki sadaein hai pani kahan
alvida ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
aao tumko galay se lagaye behan
aao bhaiya ke qurban jaye behan
kaun baaqi hai kisko bulaye behan
aao ghode pe khud hi bithaye behan
alvida ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ran se halmin ki nagaah aayi sada
choor zakhmo se hai ab badan shaah ka
ay muazzam hui zulm ki imtehan
kat gaya shaah e bekas ka sookha gala
alvida ya hussain...
items.author: Moazzin Pasha

items.title: Askari maula
items.body:
ye gham wo gham hai ke dono jahan rote hai
yateem aaj imam e zamaan hote hai
<<DIVIDER>>
haye hassan askari maula
ay bine zehra askari maula
shaahe saamara askari maula
ay bine zehra askari maula
<<DIVIDER>>
haye qayamat ki ghadi aa gayi kaisi
saaye se mehroom tere hogaye mehdi
hoke juda rota raha aap ka beta
ay mere baba askari maula
ay bine zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisa aseeri ka sitam tumpe hua hai
tere liye ghar tera zindan bana hai
maula tera ghar mein hua dafn janaza
haye ghurbata askari maula
ay bine zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
saamara har saal chale aate hai zawwar
aap ka taboot uthaate hai azadaar
farshe aza bichta raha bichta rahega
lijiye pursa askari maula
ay bine zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
saare azadaron ke lab par ye dua hai
waasta tujhko tere bete ka diya hai
dil mein basa rauza tera mehdi ke baba
hum ko bulana askari maula
ay bine zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaidi o mazloom mere gyaarwe sarkar
dene ko pursa tumhe aaye hai azadaar
pursa qubool ho ay mere syed o sardar
hum log teri nazre karam ke hai talabgaar
gham ye tera dil mein sada zinda rahega
roti hai dunya askari maula
ay bine zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab bhi tere naam ki hoti hai ye majlis
saath mein zahra ke chali aati hai narjis
dekh zara mehve buka hai teri zauja
karti hai nauha askari maula
ay bine zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
parda e ghaibat mein jo beta hai tumhara
bhejein usay jald pareshan hai dunya
sunlo zara behre khuda waaris e kaaba
hai ye ilteja askari maula
ay bine zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
mesum o azlan pe bas itna karam ho
naam tere chaahne waalon mein raqam ho
kardo ata hum ko sila nauhe ka maula
khwaab ho poora askari maula
ay bine zehra...
items.author: Arsalan Azmi

items.title: Ay seem tana
items.body:
chandi sa badan phool sa tan khaak hua hai
zainab ka jigar rashke qamar chaak hua hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aun o mohamed aun o mohamed
<<DIVIDER>>
ay seem tana gulbadana aun o mohamed
zainab hai kahan aur kahan aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyase rahe darya ki taraf ki na nigahein
de aaye thay zainab ko zuban aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek dard ki dunya hai basi dashte bala mein
kafoor huwe dono jahan aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime mein thay jab tak to faqat dono thay bacche
maidan mein huwe jaake jawan aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo maut ke sehra mein raha manzar e mehshar
angdaiyan lete thay wahan aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo maqsad e sarwar pe fida dono ka hona
tum jaise kahan deeda varan aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashon pe kiye hai zainab e dilgeer ne sajde
un sajdon ke raushan hai nishan aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor ko dulhan thi bani ashoor ko bewa
pamaal hua ran mein jawan aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
baysheer ki gardan par chala teer e sitamgar
honton pa jo pheri hai zuban aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
barchi ki ani jo dhans gayi khud mere jigar mein
ab hai meri aankhon mein dhuaan aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
darya ko bhi abbas ne darya nahi samjha
tha husne wafa se ye ayan aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas e jari sogaye darya ke kanare
bedast huwe sher e jawan aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar bhi nahi abbas nahi tum bhi nahi ho
bhai ke bina hum hai yahan aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek nusrat e haq ke siwa maa ne na socha
ay jaane dileraane jawan aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
iqbal ke nauhe ye sada haq ki sada hai
dhoondenge tumhe haq talaban aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
items.author: Iqbal

items.title: Barchi ki ani qabr
items.body:
asghar ka laasha dhoondte phirte thay jab udoo
naize chubho chubho ke sar e dasht char soo
ek baar goonji dashte bayaban mein ye sada
baba jaan baba jaan baba jaan baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
barchi ki ani qabr talak aayi hai baba
asghar ne bhi seene pe sina khaayi hai baba
<<DIVIDER>>
jab asr ko sab chaahne waale gaye maare
nusrat ko chala jhoole se haathon pe tumhare
hal min ki sada ran mein mujhe laayi hai baba
barchi ki ani qabr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
waqif thay sitamgar bhi meri tashnalabi se
hai pyaas bujhayi meri ek teer chala ke
sadaat pe ummat ne jafa dhaayi hai baba
barchi ki ani qabr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
tay kar ke chala dasht se jab teer ki manzil
paywast hua naize mein nanha sa mera dil
tadpaya badan rooh bhi tadpayi hai baba
barchi ki ani qabr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene ko lahoo kar diya zaalim ki sina ne
manzar ye magar dekh liya qaime se maa ne
taqdeer meri maa ko kahan laayi hai baba
barchi ki ani qabr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
is waqt qayamat hui maidan mein barpa
wo neem hua naize se jab mera kaleja
yaade ali akbar ye mujhe aayi hai baba
barchi ki ani qabr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe ko lehad se meri naize pe utha kar
aada ne chalaya mere halqoom pe khanjar
ghurbat ki ghata kaise yahan chaayi hai baba
barchi ki ani qabr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon naize pe rota tha ye sun kar sar e sarwar
altaf sada dete thay jab naize se asghar
asghar ne bhi seene pe sina khaayi hai baba
barchi ki ani qabr talak...
items.author: Altaf Hussain

items.title: Bharay Darbar Main Zahra Ko Bulaya
items.body:
Bharay Darbar May Zahra Ko Bulaya Ay Musalma Tunay
<<DIVIDER>>
Khatam e mursal ka kaleja
Kyu jhalaya
Ay musalmaan tunay
<<DIVIDER>>
Phaar kar penkdi, jo sanad dikaayee zahra
Day kay jherkain dil mohammed
Ka dukaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghair muslim tha koyi, sikh tha yahoodi yan masi
Kisne darbaar main zahra
Ko rulaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Aisa hosak ta nahi, jaayega tu jannat main
Haath khaali jesay zahra
Ko lowtaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Haq Adaa Khob Howaa AjareRisalat Naa Milaa
Daar Pay Ahmad Kay Hay Darvaza Giraya

items.title: Dar se deti thi
items.body:
dar se deti thi awaaz maadar
raat hone ko hai aao asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
shaq ab hai judaai ye dil par
raat hone ko hai aao asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
kitna pur haul hai ye biyaban
khauf o dehshat hai kitni rumeinan
darr na jaana kahin mere dilbar
raat hone ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaag kar raat tum ne guzaari
subho se thi ajab bekharari
ab to sojao pehlu mein aa kar
raat hone ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab na paaungi pehlu mein tum ko
neend beta na aayegi hum ko
so sakoge na tum bhi bichad kar
raat hone ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
teer gardan pa teri laga hai
kya ye sach hai jo maine suna hai
maa ko dikhlao to ran se aa kar
raat hone ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo kaha maine tum ne suna tha
aur jawab uska has kar diya tha
hogaye kyun khafa ghar se jaa kar
raat hone ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jang maidan mein ki sab ne pyare
par na dekhe thay aise nazaare
kya kiya tum ne roya jo lashkar
raat hone ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya koi kehna un ka na maana
ho ke nazraaz shaah e madina
chod aaye tumhe ran mein sarwar
raat hone ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum na kuch gham karo mere beta
kya hua gar jala tera jhoola
doongi lori mai godhi mein le kar
raat hone ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya malak ne khabar ye sunaayi
sab anees e shahe karbalayi
jaaye jannat mein nauha ye padh kar
raat hone ko hai...

items.title: Hangame asr hai
items.body:
hangame asr hai ye sheh khoon ugal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
kul ambiya sirhane haaton ko mal rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aisa koi sitara sur khaasima hai saara
wo aandhiyan hai seeno mein dil behal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
hangame asr hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
yani na hai wo zeen par yani na hai zameen par
teeron pe shaahe wala karwat badal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
hangame asr hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon to ragon mein kya hai khushk is khadar gala hai
khaatil bhi thak ke apne khanjar badal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
hangame asr hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
khud gardane katane shabbir ko bachane
jaane ko ran mein haye kamsin machal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
hangame asr hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmon se jo rawan hai haye lahoo kahan hai
ye noor e kibriya ke chashme ubhal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
hangame asr hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
har shaam roz jisko royegi yaad karke
wo shaam dhal rahi hai qayyam jal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
hangame asr hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo hogaya zamana shane se taaba shana
taboot chal raha hai kaandhe badal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
hangame asr hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ay naved hai ye kul karbala ka haasil
hal min ke lafz sheh ke moo se nikal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
hangame asr hai ye...

items.title: Haye moosae kazim
items.body:
haye moosa-e-kazim
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ghareebul watan qaid mein mar gaya
pul pe baghdad ke hai janaza rakha
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon aankhon se apni bahate hue
hatkadi bediyan tauq pehne hue
qaid sajjad ki yaad karta hua
ek ghareebul watan…
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ke athara bete jawan saal ke
uski mayyat ko mazdoor le kar chale
bain karti chali saath mein sayyeda
ek ghareebul watan…
<<DIVIDER>>
ajnabi shehr hai door ahle watan
tere baba ko de kaun ghusl o kafan
aao jaldi watan se imam e raza
ek ghareebul watan…
<<DIVIDER>>
sabr karna hai sughra ke jaisa tujhe
raasta dekhna baap ka chod de
jaa ke masoom-e-qum se kehde hawa
ek ghareebul watan…
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid mein chal basa shaahe kaun-o-makan
ab to mazloom ki khol do bediyan
tumne chaaha tha jo lo wohi hogaya
ek ghareebul watan…
<<DIVIDER>>
laash par bhi nahi rone wala koi
warise deen ki haye bewaarsi
dhoonti hai khaza dafn karne ki jaa
ek ghareebul watan…
<<DIVIDER>>
bayn karte takkalum sabhi aa gaye
karbala se madine se aur sham se
chauda barson ka qaidi reha hogaya
ek ghareebul watan…

items.title: Hussain haye hussain
items.body:
ye bain karti thi zehra hussain haye hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
sada e girya o zaari ki roz o shab aayi
hussain baad tere aisi wehshatein aayi
ujad gaya hai madina hussain haye hussain
ye bain karti thi zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere baghair madine may reh ke kya karti
mai tere saath hi is dasht may chali aayi
akeli reh gayi sughra hussain haye hussain
ye bain karti thi zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai teri maa hoo har ek ranj o gham uthaungi
ay mere laal tujhe chod kar na jaaungi
mai tere saath hoo beta hussain haye hussain
ye bain karti thi zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
na paas aun o mohamed hai aur na akbar hai
na ab alam na alamdar hai na asghar hai
ghareeb hogaya mera hussain haye hussain
ye bain karti thi zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
udaas tashna dahan khoon may nahaye huwe
akela khaak pe baitha hai sar jhukaye huwe
kya haal hogaya tera hussain haye hussain
ye bain karti thi zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi mai aayi hoo qaime se ho ke ay beta
hai tere gham may ajab haal teri behna ka
tadap rahi hai sakina hussain haye hussain
ye bain karti thi zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
tadap ke ghamzada mazloom maa ye kehti hai
zara sa pani pilaade hussain ko koi
hai teen roz ka pyasa hussain haye hussain
ye bain karti thi zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
tamaam raat mai ro ro ke aahein bharti rahi
mai us maqaam ko baalon se saaf karti rahi
karega tu jahan sajda hussain haye hussain
ye bain karti thi zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar e hussain se naawar tha ghamzada gohar
chala jo khaafla to saath hi chali maadar
labon pe tha yehi nauha hussain haye hussain
ye bain karti thi zehra...

items.title: Ishq e haider madad madad
items.body:
madad ya ali..(6)
tu hai shere khuda, ya ali
do hame hausla, ya ali
jaan tum pe fida, ya ali
lab pe hai ye dua, ya ali
mere mushkil kusha, ya ali
dil kahe karbala, ya ali
ali ali ali ali
ishq e haider madad madad
ishq e haider madad madad
ishq e haider madad madad
ishq e haider madad ya ali
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Haider haider bol rahe hai khauf nahi khookharo ka
naam ali ka sunkar rann me dam ukhde talwaro ka
ishq e ali hai sara asasa hum se matam daaro ka
bol utha hai fir duniya me sufiyani ghaddaro ka
zaigham e kibrya ya ali

ali ali ali ali ali ali

ishq e haider madad madad ya ali

ishq e haider madad madad ya ali

quwwat se eeman ki humne sare yazeedi maare hain
lab pa hai ye dua ya ali
phir sajay karbala ya ali
phir adu ho fana ya ali
ali ali ali ali ali ali

ishq e haider madad madad
ishq e haider madad madad ya ali

kis ko jihad e haq kehte hain ye to hum batlaenge

ali ali ali ali ali ali

ishq e haider madad madad ya ali

items.title: Jawani ali akbar ke
items.body:
salaam ali akbar salaam ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
hum jawano ki jawani hai ali akbar ke naam
kaash unke kaam aaye hum kare kuch aise kaam
ay ali akbar salaam ay ali akbar salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
khadimon ki tarha hum bhi pesh aaye baap se
jis tarha karte thay akbar baba jaan ka ehteraam
ay ali akbar salaam ay ali akbar salaam
hum jawano ki jawani...
<<DIVIDER>>
is khadar padhlo wakeel e fatema zehra bano
ho tumhare haath mein saara adalat ka nizaam
ay ali akbar salaam ay ali akbar salaam
hum jawano ki jawani...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis tahra abbas ko akbar samajhte thay sada
us tarha ustad ko dein baap ke jaisa maqam
ay ali akbar salaam ay ali akbar salaam
hum jawano ki jawani...
<<DIVIDER>>
is jawan ka naam lekar dil se tayyari karo
imtehan mein kamiyabi khud milegi gaam gaam
ay ali akbar salaam ay ali akbar salaam
hum jawano ki jawani...
<<DIVIDER>>
paon choone chaahta tha roka maatha choom kar
is kareemi par tumhari ro pada hurr ka ghulam
ay ali akbar salaam ay ali akbar salaam
hum jawano ki jawani...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab sawalon ke milenge sciencee tumko jawab
tum kalaam e paak se kar ke zara dekho kalaam
ay ali akbar salaam ay ali akbar salaam
hum jawano ki jawani...
<<DIVIDER>>
laut aaye qaime mein sajjad ki awaaz par
tum ne sikhlaya bade bhai ka kya hai ehteraam
ay ali akbar salaam ay ali akbar salaam
hum jawano ki jawani...

haath ka matam ho ya phir matam e zanjeer ho
dil se bas matam karo tum kya halal aur kya haram
ay ali akbar salaam ay ali akbar salaam
hum jawano ki jawani...

ye adab sajjad bat jaaye tabarruk mein kahin
sar jhuka kar jis tarha karte thay wo maa se kalaam
ay ali akbar salaam ay ali akbar salaam
hum jawano ki jawani...

items.title: Kaise mai dafnaun
items.body:
shaam ke zindan may ek choti si qaidi
haathon may paon may aur gardan may hai rassi
aur seene pe baba ka hai sar sar se hai lipti
moo pe moon ko rakh ke bahot dayr wo royi
haye rote rote us ne jo li aakhri hichki
zindan may dam tod gayi shaah ki pyari
sakina sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
karte thay sajjad ye nauha
kaise mai dafnaun sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
qaidi agar qaid may mar jaata hai koi
laash ko rassi se chuda dete hain us ki
zakhmon may paywast rasan hai tere aise
maine teri laash se rassi nahi kholi
laasha bikhar jaye kahin na
kaise mai dafnaun sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon rulaata hai ye manzar meri behna
jism tera khoon may hai tar meri behna
haathon pe laasha hai tera soch raha hoo
ghusl ko pani bhi mayassar nahi behna
tu hi bata de meri behna
kaise mai dafnaun sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisi musibat ye padi door watan se
baba bhi mehroom hai aur tu bhi kafan se
chaahun chudhana to chuda bhi nahi sakta
khoon bhara kurta jo chipka hai badan se
tera kafan hai yehi kurta
kaise mai dafnaun sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad mujhe aata hai ay ghamzada khwahar
mujhse yehi poochti rehti thi tu aksar
dafn mai ho jaun agar qaid e sitam may
shimr na aa jaye kahin meri lehad par
ab isi zindan may dukhiya
kaise mai dafnaun sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu hi nahi teri to saansein bhi thi qaidi
dekhi nahi pehle kahin aisi aseeri
sona jo chaaha to tujhe neend na aayi
rona jo chaaha to tamachon ki saza thi
hogi teri qabr bhi tanha
kaise mai dafnaun sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazhar o farhan yehi baat hai nauha
haathon pe ek qaidi ke ek qaidi ka laasha
kaise bandhe haathon se mai qabr banaun
sab ko rulaata tha ye sajjad ka jumla
haye wo sajjad ka kehna
kaise mai dafnaun sakina...

items.title: Kaun sambhale
items.body:
girte huwe naaqe se zameen par
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi baradar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
<<DIVIDER>>
athara bhai ki behen pe
kaisi musibat aayi hai
haath bandhe hai pusht ke bal
aur gard badan par chaayi hai
sar pe nahi hai maqna o chadar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
aun o mohamed qasim aur
abbas e dilawar koi nahi
kaun madad ko aayega aakhir
monis o yawar koi nahi
abid hai par wo bhi hai laaghar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi agar girta hai to wo
haathon ka sahara leta hai
lekin zainab ke girne ka
haal bahot ranjeeda hai
chehre ke bal girti hai muztar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab ko bachaya khud ko faqat
takleef mein dhaala zainab ne
karbobala se shaam talak
har ek ko sambhala zainab ne
lekin ab hai shaam ka manzar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab ye chali thi apne watan se
saani e hyder saath mein thay
inki amaari sab se haseen thi
saare baradar saath mein thay
ab hai magar tanha ye yahan par
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh rahi hain uski nigahein
bheed mein apna koi nahi
shaam ke logon ka majma hai
ahle madina koi nahi
chaaron taraf hai zulm ka lashkar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam ke zaalim maar rahe thay
zainab ko jab patthar se
dekh ke nok e naiza par
abbas e dilawar ke sar se
kehne lagi fizza ro ro kar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
na-mahram hai log sabhi
aur ghairon ki aabadi hai
shaam ke bazaron mein khule sar
kufe ki shehzadi hai
dukhiya par haste hai sitamgar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh ke zainab ko is gham mein
sab ko khayaal aaya hoga
dil mein kumail o aamir ye
logon ke sawaal aaya hoga
nok e sina par sar hai bahattar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...

items.title: Kisko bedeeno ne
items.body:
kisko be-deeno ne maara ay zameene karbala
hai payambar ka dulara ay zameene karbala
kisko be-deeno ne…
<<DIVIDER>>
pani pani jab ke ho jayegi ye kheti tamam
ek tu hogi kanara ay zameene karbala
kisko be-deeno ne…
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha khodi lehad kya guzri dil par shah ke
jab ke asghar ko utara ay zameene karbala
kisko be-deeno ne…
<<DIVIDER>>
laa rahe hai shaahe wala asghare baysheer ko
ya koi quran ka paara ay zameene karbala
kisko be-deeno ne…
<<DIVIDER>>
lo chali maqtal ko ye kehti hui umme rabab
mujhko asghar ne pukara ay zameene karbala
kisko be-deeno ne…
<<DIVIDER>>
baap peeri mein utha'ta hai jawan bete ki laash
de zara bad kar sahara ay zameene karbala
kisko be-deeno ne…
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhna turbat mein asghar ka zara rakhna khayal
saare ghar ka hai dulara ay zameene karbala
kisko be-deeno ne…
<<DIVIDER>>
ye batade kis tarha mayyat pe pahunche thay hussain
jab ke akbar ne pukara ay zameene karbala
kisko be-deeno ne…
<<DIVIDER>>
le liye tune meri godhi ke paale boli maa
ab karoon kyun kar guzara ay zameene karbala
kisko be-deeno ne…

items.title: Laila ka chand
items.body:
laila ka chand doob gaya qatlgaah mein

ek laash ghar mein laaye to ek laash le gaye

laila ka chand...
<<DIVIDER>>
milta nahi qaraar kisi jaa hussain ko

laila ka chand...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis dam gulu e asghar e baysheer chid gaya
na jaane kitne teer chube qalbe shaah mein
laila ka chand...

items.title: Mai jaa rahi hoo
items.body:
ye keh rahi thi fatema
hai aakhri meri sada
mai jaa rahi hoo ya ali

haafiz tumhara hai khuda
mai jaa rahi hoo ya ali

dard uthaati hi rahi

mai ab nahi jee paungi

mai jaa rahi hoo ya ali
ye keh rahi thi fatema...

is zulm ki aadi na thi
kya mai nabi zaadi na thi
qismat ki shehzadi na thi
mai sabr bhi karti rahi
phir bhi sitam badta raha
mai jaa rahi hoo ya ali
ye keh rahi thi fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
ummat se naata tod ke
dunya se moo ko mod ke
khaaliq se rishta jod ke
bachon ko tanha chod ke
karti hui aah o buka

ye keh rahi thi fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye zainab o kulsoom hai
kamsin hai aur masoom hai
meri tarha mazloom hai
parda hai in ki zindagi
hone na paye berida
mai jaa rahi hoo ya ali
ye keh rahi thi fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
leti hoo jab mai siskiyan
aati hai mujhko hichkiyan
tooti hui hai phasliyan
mayyat ko meri qabr may
aahista se rakhna zara
mai jaa rahi hoo ya ali
ye keh rahi thi fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai sochti hoo ya ali
paas unke jab mai jaaungi
guzregi kya baba pe bhi
rukh par tamachaon ke nishan
dekhega jab baba mera

items.title: Kaise Maloom Ho Laashe Pe Hai Dono Madar
items.body:
Kaise Maloom ho laashe pe hai dono madar,
Kun Akbar ko bahut chahti hai..
Dono ek sath me laashe pe giri ghash kha kar,
Kun Akbar ko bahut chahti hai.
Ek sine se hai liptaye jawa ka laasha,
Ek ne roote hu chehre par chehra rakkha,
Dono kehti hai zara boldo mere dilbar,
Kun Akabar ko bahut chahti hai.
Kaise Maloom ho laashe pe hai dono maadar. 2
Ek ki batan se duniya ko mila akbar,
Ek ki good me bachpan se pala hai akbar,
Haaye is laash pe thairi rahi dono ki nazar,
Kun Akabar ko bahut chahti hai.
Kaise Maloom ho laashe pe hai dono maadar.  2
Zanuye Hazrate zainab pe hai akbar ka sar,
Jab ki hai uljhi hui zulfoo par laila ki nazar,
Dono behosh hui kehke aye akbar akbar,
Kun Akabar ko bahut chahti hai.
Kaise Maloom ho laashe pe hai dono maadar.  2
Hosh jab zainab ko jab aata hai to ye rooti hain,
Aankh laila ki jo khulti hain jigar khoti hain,
Dono kehti hain barabar se aye mere lakht-e-jigar,
Kun Akabar ko bahut chahti hai.
Kaise Maloom ho laashe pe hai dono maadar. 2
Muntazir fatima sugra hai madine me teri,
Teri furqat me kahi hogi wo behosh padi,
Dekhne paai na sehra teri khawahar sar par,
Kun Akabar ko bahut chahti hai.
Kaise Maloom ho laashe pe hai dono maadar. 2
Kaise hum ja ke kahege ki aakhi mara gaya,
Kaise batlaeyege ki sine me chubha tha naiza,
Haye kis tarah sunegi teri marne ki khabar,
Kun Akabar ko bahut chahti hai.
Kaise Maloom ho laashe pe hai dono maadar. 2
Umr bhar na auno mohammad ko na roeei zainab,
Teri furqat me na tere baad soeei zainab,
Neend laila ko bhi aayi nhi aaye kyu kar,
Kun Akabar ko bahut chahti hai.
Kaise Maloom ho laashe pe hai dono maadar.  2
Aaj kis kis ko sambhale bhala amma fizza,
Kabhi zainab hai tadapti kabhi umme laila,
Ye sama dekhlo aye fatima zehra aakar,
Kun Akabar ko bahut chahti hai.
Kaise Maloom ho laashe pe hai dono maadar.  2
Khoon hatho ki hatheli pe tha is tarah laga,
Ek ek hath ko pakde hue maaoo ne kaha,
Haye armaano ki ab mendhi lage kise ja kar,
Kun Akabar ko bahut chahti hai.
Kaise Maloom ho laashe pe hai dono maadar. 2
Ya ali keh ke jo shabbir ne khaichi hai aani,
Naujawa marne laga arshebala kaap uthi,
Ek sawal utha jo sarwar chale laasha le kar,
Kun Akabar ko bahut chahti hai.
Kaise Maloom ho laashe pe hai dono maadar. 2
Khoon me apne hi sar taba qadam doob gaye,
Shah maieeyat ali akbar ki liye kaise chale,
Ja baja kehte hai ye laashe jawa rakh rakh kar,
Kun Akabar ko bahut chahti hai.
Kaise Maloom ho laashe pe hai dono maadar. 2
Kisne kar dala hai akbar ka kaleja chalani,
Ek naize se hue teen kaleje zakhmi,
Haaye dono pe hua is tarah sadme ka aasar,
Kun Akabar ko bahut chahti hai.
Kaise Maloom ho laashe pe hai dono maadar.  2
Ugaliya hilne lagi hath ko raasha aaya,
Kaise batlaye koi kaise mubarak ne likha,
Dono rooti hain nawaz ab bhi lahed ke andar,
Kun Akabar ko bahut chahti hai.
Kaise Maloom ho laashe pe hai dono maadar. 2

zainab ki be-ridayi pe chup hai kyun zamana
is waqt kalmago ki insaniyat kahan hai
ay shaam ke musafir...
<<DIVIDER>>
chalta rahega yun hi ye khaafila azaa ka
hargiz na chup sakegi ye ran ki dastan hai
ay shaam ke musafir...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ye dua muhib ki is par karam ho maalik
aulaad e mustafa ka ye mir nauhakhwan hai
ay shaam ke musafir...
items.author: Mohib Fazli

items.title: Baba idhar na
items.body:
hua ye shor ke ghode se gir gaye akbar
hussain aaye hai maqtal mein ghutniyo chal kar
sar apne laal ka zaanu pe shaah ne rakkha
zaeef baap ye kadiyal jawan se bola
rakha hai haath kaleje pe kyun mere beta
hata le haath ke ab phat raha hai dil mera
hata ke haathon ko kehne laga pisar baba
jo ho sakega to na dekhna idhar baba
<<DIVIDER>>
bole akbar apne baba se idhar na dekhna
ay mere baba mera zakhmi jigar na dekhna
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ki khaatir bada hi sakht hai bete ka gham
naujawan hoon jis ghadi baba mera niklega dam
mera chehra us ghadi mere pidar na dekhna
bole akbar apne baba se...
<<DIVIDER>>
door hat jaana mere seene se barchi khaynch kar
khoon niklega uchal kar mere seene se agar
dil to tadpega bahot baba magar na dekhna
bole akbar apne baba se...
<<DIVIDER>>
rok kar akbar ko sarwar ne kaha mere hilal
imtihan e sabr hai ye baap ka ay mere laal
ab mujhe kuch dayr ay mere pisar na dekhna
bole akbar apne baba se...
<<DIVIDER>>
aasteen apni chadha kar jab mai khaynchunga sina
waasta tujhko tere baba ka ay kadiyal jawan
meri jaanib ay mere noor e nazar na dekhna
bole akbar apne baba se...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir kiya qaime ka rukh akbar ne rokar ye kaha
doobta hai karbala mein chaand ay amma tera
chaand ki jaanib kabhi ab umr bhar na dekhna
bole akbar apne baba se...
<<DIVIDER>>
hichkiyan jab maut ki aayi to bola naujawan
aap par qurban ho akbar ay mere baba jaan
godh ke paale ka ye mushkil safar na dekhna
bole akbar apne baba se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay surani ro pada dil maine jis dam ye likha
aakhri saanson mein di sughra ko akbar ne sada
ab mera rasta behen shaam o sehar na dekhna
bole akbar apne baba se...
items.author: Ali Raza Surani

items.title: Bariyan Pehne Huey Qafila Salaar Chala, Hy Beemar Chala
items.body:
Bariyan Pehne Huey Qafla Salaar Chala Hy Beemar Chala.
<<DIVIDER>>
Arahi Hai Dar-o-Deewar Ronay Ki Sada, Hy Beemar Chala.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hy Jalte Hai Zameen Aag Ugalti Hai Zameen
Koyi Saaya Bhi Nehi (x2)
Chalay Par Gaye Paron Mein Aur Badan Tapnay Laga, Hy Beemar Chala.
<<DIVIDER>>
Chain Kia Hathon Pe Gardan Pe Paray Hain Chalay
Koyi Paani Dalay (x2)
Tapti Hai Tauq-o-salat Til Hai Garm Hawa, Hy Beemar Chala.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kantay Chub Jatay Hain Chalay Kabhi Chil Jatay Hain
Hy Dukh Patay Hain (x2)
Paon Behrana Aur Yeh Aziyat Ka Safar Aur Yeh Jafa, Hy Beemar Chala.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaha Kartay Hain To Duron Saza Patay
Yun Tarap Jatay Hain (x2)
Hy Kis Haal Mein Hain Ibn Shahay Karbobala, Hy Beemar Chala.
<<DIVIDER>>
Cheenkh Uthatay Hain Jab Lahu Se Behta Hai
Har Sitam Sehta Hai (x2)
Dukh Faryad Karay Bhai Na Baba Na Chacha, Hy Beemar Chala.
<<DIVIDER>>
Dekh Kar Bete Ki Halat To Tarap Uthti Hai Maa
Yeh Bhi Hota Hai Guman (x2)
Aa Na Jaye Kahin Beemar Ko Rastay Mein Qaza, Hy Beemar Chala.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar Khulay Hain Mayein Hain Behnay Hain Sitamgaron
Hy Bazaron Mein (x2)
Sir Jhukaye Rotay Huey Haye Khuddar Chala, Hy Beemar Chala.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hy Kis Haal Mein Sibt-e-payambar Safdar
Khaak Urao Gohar(x2)
Pheet Kar Seena-o -sir Bain Karo Ahl-e-Zza, Hy Beemar Chala.

items.title: Bhare darbar may
items.body:
bhare darbar mein zainab ne sada di ghazi
teri khwahar ko kisi ne na rida di ghazi
bhare darbar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala kya thi hai kya shaam ye mujhse poocho
sakhti har deesh e ayyam ye mujhse poocho
sola sau meel ne dunya hi mita di ghazi
bhare darbar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye baaghi ki behan kehke bulaya mujhko
kya bataun tujhe kis tarha sataya mujhko
yun mohamed ki nawasi ko saza di ghazi
bhare darbar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
aansuon ne likhi tehreer jale daaman par
dard hote gaye tasveer jale daaman par
aisi haalat hai sakina ki bana di ghazi
bhare darbar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha jab khoon mein tar fatema jaaya maine
bhai ki laash pe tha khud ko giraya maine
maine allah ko ya tujhko sada di ghazi
bhare darbar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
tez khanjar se kahin tez hai nazron ki chuban
ab nishan daal chuki meri kalayi mein rasan
aane jaane ki na thi behan ye aadi ghazi
bhare darbar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
saikdon kursi nasheen baithe hai darbar mein dekh
teri khwahar hai ghiri majmeine aghyaar mein dekh
karbala shaamiyon ne shaam mein laa di ghazi
bhare darbar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghair ki nazron se zainab ko chupane ke liye
apni maajayi ka parda sa banane ke liye
nauke naiza se kehef sar ne sunaadi ghazi
bhare darbar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
maaf karna hai unhe ahsan o abid hai kahan
kal haqeeqat mein dhale aaj hai dono ka gumaan
kaash ho hashr mein ek ye bhi manadi ghazi
bhare darbar mein...
items.author: Abid Zaidi

items.title: Darbar Jaa raha hai
items.body:
Haye Zainab(sa) Haye Darbar...3
Haaye Ali(as) Ki Beti, Darbar Jarahi Hai.... 2
Baalo'n Se Apna Chehra, Zainab(sa) Chupa Rahi Hai
Haaye Ali(as) Ki Beti, Darbar Jarahi Hai....2
1) Qaidi Bana Ke Haaye, Sadaat Ko Phiraya
Binte Ali(as) Pe Ya Rab,Kaisa Hai Waqt Aaya
Patthar Kahi'n Pe Durra, Mazluma Kha Rahi Hai
2) Masnad Nashi'n Hain Zaalim, Sar Samne Rakha Hai
Ek Hath Me Chadhi Hai, Jo Sar Pe Maarta Hai
Kya Kya Ali(as) Ki Beti, Sadme Utha Rahi Hai
3) Qaidi Bani Huwi Hai, Afsos Binte Zahra(sa)
Chadar Bhi Chinn Chuki Hai, Phirti Hai Koocha Koocha
Is Haal Me Bhi Zainab(sa), Khutbe Suna Rahi Hai
4) Na Mehramo Ka Majma, Darbar Me Khada Hai
Parde Ki Paasba'n Hai, Aayi Jo Berida Hai
Ghairat Ka Hai Taqaza, Nazre'n Jhuka Rahi Hai
5) Fizza(sa) Ko Yeh Pata Hai, Kya Shaan Thi Ali(as) Ki
Be Parda Shamiyo,n Me, Beti Hai Aaj Uski
Fizza(sa) Lahu Ke Aansu, Is Dam Baha Rahi Hai
6) Abbas(as) Tum The Zamin, Mazluma Ki Rida Ke
Kis Haal Me Bahen Hai, Dekho Zara Yeh Aake
Chadar Kahi'n Se Laa Do, Zainab(sa) Bula Rahi Hai
7) Bhai Teri Shahadat, Yu Raayega Na Hogi
Deene Khuda Ki Khatir, Har Zulm Me Sahungi
Bhai Se Jo Kiya Tha, Waada Nibha Rahi Hai
8) Shahbaz Kaise Danish, Manzar Baya'n Karega
Beti Ali(as) Ki Aayi, Darbar Saj Raha Tha
Zainab(sa) Ki Har Qadam Par, Ab Jaan Jarahi Hai.
Haaye Ali(as) Ki Beti, Darbar Jarahi Hai....2

items.title: Ek behan bhai ke
items.body:
haye hamsheer e raza
ya masooma
<<DIVIDER>>
qabr e masooma e qum se ab bhi aati hai sada
ek behan bhai ke laashe pe na jaane paayi
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ghadi shehr e khurasan mein bulwaye gaye
baani e zulm o jafa zulm se kab baaz aaye
tumko mamoon ne kyun zehr khila kar maara
qabr e masooma e qum se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay shehenshah e watan tumne bigada kya tha
mere pardesi aqi tera sahara kya tha
qum mein mai tanha rahi tum thay toos mein tanha
qabr e masooma e qum se...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehr ne apna asar jis ghadi choda hoga
kat gaya hoga mere bhai kaleja tera
kitni takleef hui hogi ghareebul ghurba
qabr e masooma e qum se...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap seene pe rakhe haath tadapte honge
bad naseebi ye meri mujhko bulaate honge
na wahan jaa saki mai tu na behan tak pahuncha
qabr e masooma e qum se...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai teri laash pe hoti to ye nauha karti
kam se kam tere janaze ki to zeenat hoti
mere bhai ye magar mere muqaddar mein na tha
qabr e masooma e qum se...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya musafir ko kabhi zehr e dagha milta hai
jab safar mein koi pardesi guzar jaata hai
yaad aa jaata hai hamshakle payambar bhaiya
qabr e masooma e qum se...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhse behtar kayi kismat thi mere jadda ki
laashe shabbir thi aur saani e zehra bhi thi
kam se kam bhai ki mayyat ko behan ne dekha
qabr e masooma e qum se...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye irfan na tha mera muqaddar aisa
kya mubarak tera kam hoga ye nauha mera
mai bhi tanha thi kahin bhai kahin tha tanha
qabr e masooma e qum se...
items.author: Mubarak Jalalpuri

items.title: Ghar hussain ka hai
items.body:
sharaf ke shehr mein har baam o dar hussain ka hai
zamane bhar ke gharano mein ghar hussain ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
furaate waqte rawan dekh suye maqtal dekh
jo sar baland hai ab bhi wo sar hussain ka hai
sharaf ke shehr mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
zameen kha gayi kya kya baland o baala darakht
hara bhara hai jo ab bhi shajar hussain ka hai
sharaf ke shehr mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
sawaale bayyate shamsheer par jawaz bahot
magar jawab wohi mohtabar hussain ka hai
sharaf ke shehr mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
mohabbaton ke hawalon mein zikr aane laga
ye fazl bhi to mere haal par hussain ka hai
sharaf ke shehr mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
huzoore shaafa e mehshar ali kahe ke ye shaks
gunaah gaar bahot hai magar hussain ka hai
sharaf ke shehr mein...

items.title: Haq kar gaye ada
items.body:
haq kar gaye maadar ke ada saare ke saare
mamu pe fida hogaye zainab ke dulare
haq kar gaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
samjhaati thi bachon ko bade pyar se zainab
bhoole se na jaana kabhi darya ke kanare
haq kar gaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
pyasi hai sakina rahe har aan yehi dhyan
pani ka tasavvur na ho zehno may tumhare
haq kar gaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
ghodon se giro bhi to sada ran se na dena
dekho mai khafa hongi jo mamu ko pukare
haq kar gaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
mai qaime se dekhungi jari kaun hai tum may
lalkaar ke pehle jo bine-saad ko maare
haq kar gaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
wada jo kiya maa se wafa kar gaye dono
pyase hi lade pyase hi dunya se sidhaare
haq kar gaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
sad hai to hai ay dashte bala teri zameen ne
sab cheen liye zainabe muztar ke sahare
haq kar gaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
paala tha jinhe godh may wo jaa base ban may
ab kaun hai zainab ko jo maa kehke pukaare
haq kar gaye…

items.title: Haye muslim ke dono
items.body:
tiflaan e muslim ibne aqeel
<<DIVIDER>>
haye muslim ke dono pisar
shehre kufa mein hai dar badar
<<DIVIDER>>
dono kufe ki galiyon se anjaan hai
inko koi thikaana bhi milta nahi
pyaase rehte hai pani bhi milta nahi
bhooke rehte hai khaana bhi milta nahi
rote rehte hai shaam o sahar
haye muslim ke dono pisar
shehre kufa mein hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
chup ke karte hai din raat dono basar
darr ke maare ye ek pal bhi sote nahi
dhoondte hai sitamgar inhe har jagah
zor se darr ke maare ye rote nahi
zaalimon ka hai har waqt darr
haye muslim ke dono pisar
shehre kufa mein hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
khairiyat koi baba ki milti nahi
dono bhai tadapte hai ye soch kar
roke kehte hai baba ko kya ho gaya
kyun na aaye wo lene hamari khabar
kaise baba ke bin jaaye ghar
haye muslim ke dono pisar
shehre kufa mein hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
haath rakhne koi sar pe aata nahi
koi aakar ke himmat badhata nahi
thokarein kha rahe hai kayi roz se
koi yasrab ka rasta bataata nahi
dekhte hai idhar aur udhar
haye muslim ke dono pisar
shehre kufa mein hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise honge mere laal is fikr mein
us taraf hai pareshan dono ki maa
maamta ko kahin chain aata nahi
roke bacchon ki furqat mein khoti hai jaan
aur ye ro rahe hai idhar
haye muslim ke dono pisar
shehre kufa mein hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kamsini hai musafir hai pardes hai
waqt kaisa ye zahra ke pyaron pe hai
koi kufe mein deta nahi aasra
ye sitam murtaza ke dularon pe hai
be-watan hai ye jaaye kidhar
haye muslim ke dono pisar
shehre kufa mein hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
leke haaris taraayi pe jis dam gaya
kaatne dono bacchon ka sookha gala
dono bhai bahot roye mil kar galay
aur dono ne mil kar ye nauha padha
amma ab hum na aayenge ghar
haye muslim ke dono pisar
shehre kufa mein hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye waiz wo manzar qayamat ka tha
roye abbas e ghazi bhi be-saakhta
ho gaya us ghadi ek mehshar bapa
jab ali shaahe waala ne ro kar kaha
ab nahi aayenge laut kar
haye muslim ke dono pisar
shehre kufa mein hai...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Hussain hote hai
items.body:
dilon ki ghair hai haalat kaho khuda hafiz
luta ke ashkon ki daulat kaho khuda hafiz
hai aaj roz e qayamat kaho khuda hafiz
bujhi hai shamme imamat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat kaho khuda hafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
musafiron ka moharram manalo ahle aza
jo aag dil mein lagi hai bujhalo ahle aza
tum apni aankhon mein aansu sajalo ahle aza
hai ek raat ki zehmat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo sayyeda se hai waada usay wafa kar do
aza e sipte payambar par dil fida kar do
gham e hussain manane ka haq ada kar do
nahi to hogi shikayat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
baha ke ashk dil e fatema ko shaad karo
dil e rasool ki poori har ek muraad karo
laga tha seena e akbar pa zakhm yaad karo
milegi qalb ko raahat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
alam utha ke alamdar ko karo ruqsat
zameen pa baith kar beemar ko karo ruqsat
saron ko peet kar sardar ko karo ruqsat
bana ke nanhi si turbat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajao nanha sa taboot sheh ke asghar ka
alam uthao padho marsiya bahattar ka
saron pe taaziya rakho nabi ke dilbar ka
yehi hai ajre risalat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
udao khaak saron par hussain jaate hai
lutao ashkon ke gauhar hussain jaate hai
hamare ghar se bahattar hussain jaate hai
baha ke ashk e nidamat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
aza e shaah ki raunaq jo ghar se jayegi
alam ki yaad hamein saal bhar satayegi
uthega taaziya ghar se to saat jayegi
imambadon ki zeenat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
bujha charaagh to tareek ye zamana hua
udaas udaas mere ghar ka aashiana hua
rasool zada suye karbala rawana hua
rasool e paak ki ummat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadayein aati hai reh reh ke saare aalam se
sukoon milta hai dil ko hussain ke gham se
magar hussain ki khidmat na ho saki hum se
dilon mein reh gayi hasrat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
raza na haath se choote hussain ka daaman
sada barasta rahe aansuon ka ye saawan
aza e sheh se mehekta raha mera gulshan
na kam ho sheh ki mohabbat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
items.author: Raza Ali Khan Lakhnavi

items.title: Islam ko fana se
items.body:
islam ko fana se bachaya hussain ne
qasre yazeediyat ko giraya hussain ne
<<DIVIDER>>
allah re hifazat e millat ka ehtemam
toofan mein charagh ko jalaya hussain ne
islam ko fana se...
<<DIVIDER>>
khushboo usi ki phaili hai saare jahan mein
jo phool karbala mein khilaya hussain ne
islam ko fana se...
<<DIVIDER>>
paigham jo nabi ne sunaya tamaam umr
sab kuch wo ek din mein sunaya hussain ne
islam ko fana se...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo kaam ambiya e salaf se na ho saka
kis shaan se wo kar ke dihkaya hussain ne
islam ko fana se...
<<DIVIDER>>
khyber ka dar uthana to kuch aur baat thi
laasha pisar jawan ka uthaya hussain ne
islam ko fana se...
<<DIVIDER>>
katwa diya sar apna bade shaukh se magar
baatil ke aage sar na jhukaya hussain ne
islam ko fana se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ek se poochte thay mera chand hai kidhar
jab ran mein naujawan ko na paaya hussain ne
islam ko fana se...
<<DIVIDER>>
chehre pe mal ke asghar e masoom ka lahoo
kya hai maqaam e sabr dikhaya hussain ne
islam ko fana se...
<<DIVIDER>>
haathon se apne qabr bana kar sagheer ki
pani ke badle ashk bahaya hussain ne
islam ko fana se...
<<DIVIDER>>
shayar bana ke aale rasool e anaam ka
rutba tera viqar badhaya hussain ne
islam ko fana se...
items.author: Viqar Nagri

items.title: Kaise na nikle aankh
items.body:
kaise na nikle aankh se aansu
aur honton se haye
mere nabi ka pyara nawasa
sajde may maara jaye
kaise na nikle aankh se...
<<DIVIDER>>
dharti kya aakash bhi larze
dard se nadiya karwat badle
pyasa baalak pani ke badle
teer gale par khaaye
kaise na nikle aankh se...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon may kohraam macha hai
akbar akbar ek sada hai
paala hua athara baras ka
seene pa barchi khaaye
kaise na nikle aankh se...
<<DIVIDER>>
jalti zameen par laash padi hai
aisi shaadi nahi suni hai
khoon ki boondon se qasim ka
sehra goondha jaaye
kaise na nikle aankh se...
<<DIVIDER>>
aake madine chain na paaya
ro ke guzaara saara zamana
bhai ki baatein karti zainab
qabr e nabi par jaaye
kaise na nikle aankh se...
<<DIVIDER>>
raat ka sannata hai darona
hoo ka jangal koi na apna
laash se lipti bali sakina
roye aur ghabraye
kaise na nikle aankh se...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon may dooba chappa chappa
maara gaya hai shayad saqqa
yasrib ka shehzada dekho
nehr pa dauda jaaye
kaise na nikle aankh se...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere aansu wo hai aansu
mahir ajr e payambar aansu
ho jo kisi ke aise aansu
saamne mere aaye
kaise na nikle aankh se...
items.author: Mahir Lakhnavi

items.title: Kazim ka hai janaza
items.body:
kazim ka hai janaza baghdad ke pul par
rone ko aayi zehra baghdad ke pul par
<<DIVIDER>>
pacheeswi rajab ko taboot hai ye kaisa
dooba hua lahoo may zanjeer may hai jakda
hai teen din se rakha baghdad ke pul par
kazim ka hai janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
haroon ne na-jaane kaisa zehar diya hai
tan paash paash haye kazim ka ho gaya hai
gathri may aaye maula baghdad ke pul par
kazim ka hai janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
beta imam ka hai baba imam ka hai
sheh ki tarha se is pe ghurbat ki inteha hai
be-gor o be-kafan tha baghdad ke pul par
kazim ka hai janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis be-watan ki mayyat mazdoor ne uthayi
mayyat pe jis padar ki beti bhi ro na paayi
roti hai us ko dunya baghdad ke pul par
kazim ka hai janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
utre badan ke tukde zanjeer may lipat kar
masooma dekhti to mar jaati wo wahin par
kis haal may hai baba baghdad ke pul par
kazim ka hai janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
sarwar ki laadli pe chauda baras jo roya
abid ko saath leke karne ko us pe girya
aati hai khud sakina baghdad ke pul par
kazim ka hai janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
uth'ta hai jab janaza haye saathwe ali ka
karne ko us pe girya aati hai bibi zehra
logon adab se aana baghdad ke pul par
kazim ka hai janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab kazmayn jao kazim ka gham manane
ay arsalan o mesum wajib hua hai tum pe
taboot tum uthana baghdad ke pul par
kazim ka hai janaza...
items.author: Arsalan Azmi

items.title: Kisko doo mai lori
items.body:
kis ko doo mai lori
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar mera reh gaya ran mein
maa ye ro kar boli
kis ko doo mai lori
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam e ghariban cha gayi ban mein
mera dil ghabraye
ghar nahi aaya asghar mera
phail gayi tareekhi

items.title: Alam abbas ka
items.body:
ALAM ABBAS KA - 4
ROZE AZAL SE AHELE AZA KA HAI PASBAN
ALAM ABBAS KA- 4
BARSEGI RAHEMATE YE LAGE GA JAHAN JAHAN
ALAM ABBAS K- 4
HAMZA KI AAN JAFARE TAIYAR KI WAFA
KHAIBAR ME BAN KE HAIDERE KARRAR KI WAFA
KARBOBALA KE DASHT ME AYA KUCH IS TARHA
CHAMKA YE BAN KE SHAYE KE ALAMDAR KI WAFA
KHURSHEED BAN KE CHUM RAHA HAI YE ASMAN
ALAM ABBAS KA- 4
TAQDEER KA DHANI HAI WO JISKO MILA HAI YE
HAR WAKHT KE YAZID KI KHATIR QAZA HAI YE
KOSHISH HAZAR KAR LE ZAMANE KI SAZISHE
FATWO SE MUFITIYO KE BHALA KAB JHUKA HAI YE
KARTA HAI UNKA AJ BHI CHEHRA DHUWAN DHUWAN
ALAM ABBAS KA – 4
AHELE NEFAQ HMKO NA KAR PAENGE FANAH
ZULMO SITAM NA TOD SAKE APNA HAOSLA
ZAHERA KI HAM DUWA HAI HAMARA NASEEB HAI
WIRDE ZABAN HO NADE ALI KA TO DAR HAI KYA
RAKKHEGA DUR HAMSE BALAON KI ANDHIYAN
ALAM ABBAS KA - 4
SINE ME DAGHE MATAME SARWAR LIYE HUWE
ASHKE AZA KE SATH GAOHAR LIYE HUWE
HAMPE KARAM RAHEGA RASULE ANAM KA
KUCH LOG HONGE APNA MUKADDAR LIYE HUWE
MAIHSHAR KI TEZ DHOOP ME DEGA HAME AMAN
ALAM ABBAS KA – 4
HAR BE QARAR DIL KA SAHARA ALAM RAHA
HAR DUBTE HUWE KA KINARA ALAMA RAHA
AORO NE DEEN BECH KE DUNIYA KHARIDLI
FAQO ME HAMKO JAN SE PYARA ALAM RAHA
HARGIZ NA KAR SAKEGA JUDA HAMSE YE JNHAN
ALAM ABBAS KA – 4
AYE KIBRIYA DUWA HO YE MANZAR KI MUSTUJAB
JAB HO DAHER ME JALWA NUMA IBNE BUTURAB
LABBAIK YA IMAM HO MERI ZUBAN PAR
KARLE WO JAN NISARO ME MERA BHI INTEKHAB
KABE SE JAB BALAND KARE SAHE BAZZMAN
ALAM ABBAS KA – 4
BAZU JO KAT KE RAN ME ALAMDAR KE GIRE
DANTO SE APNE MASHK KO THAMA DILER NE
NAGAH EK TEER LAGA AA KE MASHK PAR
PANI ZAMI PE BAHE GAYA NAZRO KE SAMNE
AYA ZAMI PE MASHK KE HAMRAH KHUFESHAN
ALAM ABBAS KA – 4
DUBA HUWA LAHU ME ALAM LAYE RAN SE SHAH
KHAIME ME DEKHTI HAI SAKINA CHACHA KI RAH
EK PAL SUWE FORAR SE HATTI NA THI NIGAH
DEKHA JO TASHNA KAM NE NIKLI JIGAR SE AHH
BABA LAHU BHARA JO ALAM SATH LAE HAIN
AMMU KO MERE RAN ME KNHAN CHOD AYE HAIN
ABBAS – 4
SHAIH NE UTHA KE GOD ME BACHHI KO KIYA PYAR
RONA NA MERI JAN YE BABA TERE NISAR
TUMKO HAI KITNI DER SE AMMU KA INTEZAR
MAKTAL ME SO RAHA HAI SAKINA WO DILFEGAR
JNGAH ME AJAL USE LORI SUNA GAI
BETA TERE CHACHA KO WAHAN NIND AA GAI
ABBAS - 4
JAB YE KHABAR SUNI KE ALAMADAR MAR GAYA
PANI PILAE KAON KE SAQQA GUZAR GAYA
KUZE ZAMI PE TASHNALABO KE BIKHAR GAE
TUTI HARAM KI AAS WO BE AAS KAR GAYA
BACHHO KE SATH HO GAYA GHAZI KA NAUHA KHAN
ALAM ABBAS KA – 4

items.title: Athara baras ke ali akbar
items.body:
Atthara Baras Ke Ali Akbar, Ali Akbar,
Farzande Hasan Ibne Ali Fatahe Khaibar,
1) Asghar Ka Tadapta Hua Seena Phuppi Amma,
Behaal Hai Pyasi Hai Sakina Phuppi Amma,
Dushwaar Hua Jaata Hai Jeena Phuppi Amma,
Baba Se Na Keh Paaunga, Lagta Hai Mujhe Dar....
2) Aajaye Agar Zidd Pe To Phir Saans Bhi Le Paaye,
Mumkin Nahi Talwaar Se Meri Koi Bach jaaye,
Ladne Ki Ijazat Jo Mujhe Baba Se Mil Jaaye,
Dekhega Zamana Meri Talwaar Ke Johar...
3) Ladne Ki Ijazat Jo Mili Shah Se Ek Baar,
Talwaar Ke Partol The Akbar Hue Tayyar,
Ek Shor Utha Rann Mein Hai Shagirde Alamdar...
Talwar Thi Akbar Ki To Abbas Ke Tewar...
4) Talwar Pe Rakha Jo Kahi Sar Nazar Aaya,
Khaak Usko Chatai Jo Sitamgar Nazar Aaya,
Behaal Bohat Shaam Ka Lashkar Nazar Aaya,
Ek Sher Ke Manind The Bikhre Hue Akbar...
5) Ek Waar Kiya Maut Ke Panje Ne Sambhala,
Ek Naami Sipahi Ka Sar Is Tarha Uchala,
Ladne Ka Jo Armaan Tha Akbar Ne Nikala,
Kaanp Uthi Zameen Rann Ki Dehalne Lage Patthar...
6) Is Fauj Ki Aankho'n Me Kahi Bhi Nahi Pani,
Aaye Kaash Mayassar Ho Zara Sa Kahi Pani,
Dushman Ko Pilado Mere Baba Yahi Pani,
Yalgaar Hai Pyaso Pe Hazaro Hai Sitamgar...
7) Akbar Ne Zaba'n Rakhi Jo Sarwar Ki Zaba'n Par,
Ek Aag Ka Darya Tha Barabar Ki Zaba'n Par,
Shola Sa Lapakne Laga Akbar Ki Zaba'n Par,
Kaato Ki Tarha Toot Gayi Pyaas Ke Sheh Par...
8) Wo Pyaas Ka Aalam Tha Ke Jalta Tha Kalega,
Kab yu Hi Sambhale Se Sambhalta Tha Kalega,
Bas Toot Ke Pehlu Ko Nikalta Tha Kaleja,
Roote Rahe Shabbir Kaleje Se Lipat Kar...
9) Dekha Na Suna Aisa Kisine Koi Paikar,
Jurmut Me Sitaaro'n Ke Hai Ye Mahe Munawwar,
Is Pyaas Pe Qurbaan Hai Zehra Ka Bhara Ghar,
Laila Ki Tamanna Hai Ye Zainab Ka Muqaddar...
10) Uth Paayega sarwar se kaha bete ka lasha,
Atthara baras wale jawa bete ka lasha,
Marr jaayegi dekhegi jo maa bete ka lasha,
Ye Umr Sharar Aane Ki Hai Phool Pehen Kar...

items.body:
jangal pahaad karte hai nad-e-ali ali

<<DIVIDER>>
ruksat ko ahlebait-e-nabi mein gaye imam
qadmon pe lotne lagi saydaniya tamam
wo shor al-firaaq ka wo yaas ke kalaam
bache bhi sar patak'te thay le le ke sheh ka naam
rote thay yun to lipte hue sab hussain se
lekin kaleje phat'te thay zainab ke bain se
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
us waqt tha ajab sheh-e-deen par hoojume yaas
dhalna wo do pahar ka wo aandhi wo loo o pyaas
laashe pade hue thay azeezo ke aas paas
rokar falak ko dekhte thay shaah-e-haq janas
ut'ta tha darde dil to qadam ladkhadate thay
farmake ya-ali-e-wali baith jaate thay
hussain hussain hussain

bhai ke sar ko chaati se lipta ke ye kaha
batlao kya irada hai ay mere mehlekha
daste adab ko jod ke bola wo bawafa
pyasi sakina marti hai ya shaah-e-karbala
guzre hai teen din yuhin is pusht pa par
gar izn ho to pani ko ja'un faraat par
hussain hussain hussain

yan chad chuke thay ghode pe abbas-e-haq shanas

boli ye mashq de ke sakina ba dard-o-yaas
qurban ammu jaan bujhado hamari pyaas
phat'ta hai dil atash se kaleja kabab hai
saqqayi kijiye ke ye kaare sawab hai
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ne kaha ke mera faqr hai ye kaam
bibi tumhare baap ka adna hai ye ghulam
di tumne aabru mujhe ay dukhtare imam
ab hogaya jahan mein bahishti hamara naam
kausar mai samjhu dosh pe gar mashke aab ho
tum bhi dua karo ke chacha kaamiyab ho
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
chaati tak usne pani ko dekha jo ek baar
ghode ka dil hua sifat-e-mauje beqarar
hasrat se moo phira ke nazar ki suye sawaar
bole ye baag jod ke abbas e naamdar
tu pile ay faraz ke bahot tishna-kaam hai
hum par to be-hussain ye pani haram hai
hussain hussain hussain

bouchaar yak-bayak hui teero ki hai ghazab
tayghe chali aqab se shareeron ki hai ghazab
ye shakl do jahan ke ameeron ki hai ghazab
bujhne na paayi pyaas sagheero ki hai ghazab
naize thay aur chand se pehlu diler ke
teero ne chaan dala safeene ko sher ke
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
shaane se yun ubhal ke baha khoon ke al-amaan
thirra ke jhoomne lage abbas-e-naujawan
machli ki tarha haath to reti pe tha tapan
lekin juda na hoti thi qabze se ungliyan
de-dast hogayi thi jo is tafdari ke saath
talwar bhi tadapti thi daste jari ke saath
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
raste mein ladkhadate thay jab zouf se qadam
akbar sambhaal lete thay baba ko dam-ba-dam
farmate thay tadap ke pisar se shahe-umam
jo haal ho baja hai ke bhai ka hai alam
baazu padak ke dilbare zehra ko le chalo
beta chacha ki laash pe baba ko le chalo
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ghul pad gaya ke sheh ke alamdar haye haye
ay noore chasme hydare karaar haye haye
ay ibne fathima ke madadgaar haye haye
ay fauje sheh ke jaafare tayyaar haye haye
chote se haat rakh ke dile dard naak par
de maara sar ko bali sakina ne khaak par

items.body:

items.title: Kitna haseen hai mera Hussain
items.body:
kehti thi Zahra (s.a) dekhke chehra kitna haseen hai mera Hussain
tum meri jaan hon sadqe yeh maa ho tum pay husn bhi fida Hussain
ban ke aaya hai mera noore nazar tu
isliye aankhon mein hain khushi ke ansoo
jis se mehka hai mera ghar mera Gulshan
teen shabaan mili mujhkoo woh khushbu
farsh pay aake mein ne kiya hai intezaar bas tera Hussain
aaja taron se teri nazar utaroon
chaand ko aaj tairay Husn pay vaaru
paas jab aaye to seenay se lagaakar
pyar se thujko hussaina mein poukaron
mein ne khuda se kuch nahi manga jab se mujhko tu mila Hussain
tu mere baba Muhammad (s.a.w.s) ki jhalak hai
ayaton ki tere chehray pay damak hai
hain Hussain abr ke jaisay tairay abroo
teri aankhon mein Ali (a.s) jaisi chamak hai
noore mujassam fakhre do aalam tu khuda ka moujza Hussain
aur bhar jaayegaa raunak se mera ghar
jab chalay ga tu meri ungli pakad kar
bhai ke sath mere paas tum aana
jab pukarungi mein shabbir aur shabbar
mujhko miley hain chaand se betay pehla Hasan dosra Hussain
mass huwa jab woh tairay jhulay se aakar
tairay sadqy mein hi fitrus ko miley par
mujhse darwazay pay aa aake farishtay
mangte hain tera sadqa ae mere dilbar
sabko mein tera baant dun sadqa aik baar muskura Hussain
dekh jibrael tera jhoola jhulaye
aur rizwan tairay naaz uthaaye
Anbiya hon ya malak hon ae mere dil
sab taire sath zamee par hi chalay aaye
arsh pay unkaa dil nahi lagta ishhq tujse hogaya Hussain
dekhke husn tera aur ye adaye
dil yeh karta hai liye jaaun balayen
tujse wada hai kabhi radd nah karongi
tairay sadqy mein jo mangay ga duayen
uski Shafaat hai mera zimma dil se jo kahega ya Hussain
aaj zeeshan o Raza jiski khushi hai
dilbar Zahra (s.a) hussain ibn-e Ali hai
teen shabaan badi eid hai phir bhi
sab azadaron ki aankhon mein nami he
kyun nah hon ansoo anay pay tairay roye thay khud Mustafa Hussain

tanhaai mein kulsoom pada karti thi nauha

items.title: Abbas hai maula mera
items.body:
Abbas ka aashiq bhi hoon
aur hoon bhi salamat
mat samjho ke paimana-e-wafa tod diya hai
Abbas ki bahon ki qasam, karta juda mai
Ye haath to matam ke liye chod diya hai
Kya shaan hai kya martaba
Abbas hai Maula mera
Ab gham hai kya sab gham bhula
Abbas hai Maula mera
1.
Yeh Surate Sher-e-Khuda
yeh hai dua-e-Syeda
jagirdar-e-Karbala yehi to hai shehr-e-wafa
Babul Hawaij bawafa
Abbas hai Maula mera
2.
Kehtay hain sab ahl-e-aza
yeh hai Khuda bandah-e-wafa
iska alam sab se juda
kehti hai darya ki hawa
Ghazi jari aur bawafa
Abbas hai Maula mera
3.
Naukar hai jo Abbas ka
mansab usay Allah mila
koi Qalandar ban gaya
koi bana hai Aulia
Sehwan se aati hai sada
Abbas hai Maula mera
4.
Har majlis-e-Shabbir mein
tere alam ko tham ke
naray laga kar matami
Mushkil Kusha ke naam ke
naray lagatay hain sada
Abbas hai Maula mera
5.
Pani pe lehraya alam
dang ho gaye ahl-e-sitam
uskay huwe jab haath num
kar wa di gayi baazi qalam
darya ki maujon ne kaha
Abbas hai Maula mera
6.
Babul Hawaij aap hain
hajat rawai kijiyé
Arbaz aur Salman par
apna karam kar dijiye
aur Irtiza ne yeh kaha

items.title: Aey Mere Laal Akbar(as)
items.body:
Moula Qadam Qadam Par Ye Keh Rahe Hain Ro Kar,
Aawaz Do Kaha Ho Ay Mere Laal Akbar..
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Gulshan Me Shaahe Di Ke Tareeki Cha Chuki Hai,
Tooti Hui Kamar Hai Binaai Ja Chuki Hai,
Haalat Pe Meri Haste Jaate Hain Sab Sitamgar..
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ab Kon Hai Jo Ran Me Mujko Dikhaye Rasta,
Chaaro Taraf Adu Hai Tanha Hai Tera Baba,
Beta Teri Sada Par Aaunga Ghutno Chal Kar..
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Khud Bhukha Reh Ke Maine Tujko Diya Niwala,
Aththara Saal Tujko Nazo Se Maine Pala,
Ye Bain Kar Rahi Hai Khaimo Me Teri Maadar..
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Barchi Ko Khechne Ki Himmat Kaha Se Laau,
Lasha Uthane Ki Me Taaqat Kaha Se Laau,
Kije Najaf Se Aakar Imdaad Baba Haider..
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ibne Hasan Ka Lasha Gathdi Me La Chuka Hu,
Abbase Bawfa Ke Bazu Utha Chuka Hu,
Mara Gya Hai Lashkar Koi Nahi Hai Sar..
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Tu Hi Mera Sahara Tu Hi Mera Asa Hai,
Baba Ki Jaan Hai Tu Ham Shaqle Mustafa Hai,
Tere Bagair Meri Duniya Hai Khaak Akbar..
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Puchegi Jab Muje Wo Akbar Kaha Hai Baba,
Sugra(S.A) Ko Khat Me Bolo Me Kya Jawab Dunga,
Takti Hai Tera Rasta Yasrab Me Teri Khwahar..
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Bazu Kata Ke Ran Me Soya Hai Mera Bhai,
Gurbat Pe Aaj Meri Roti Hai Ye Khudaai,
Chalta Hai Halqe Sheh Pe Zalim Ka Kund Khanjar..
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Rizwan Ran Me Akbar Aidi Ragad Raha Hai,
Kazim Jawaan Bete Ko Baap Dhundhta Hai,
Karbobala Me Chaaro Janib Bapa Hai Mehshar..

items.body:

Jaise Zahra s.a ka Dar jalaya tha

items.title: Islam pe ehsaan hai zehra ke bhare ghar ka
items.body:
Ehsaa’n hai kate sar ka, ehsaa’n hai khule sar ka
Islam pe ehsaa’n hai, Zehra ke bhare ghar ka
Kya zauq e bandagi hai, sajde mein jaake kehna
Maalik qabool kar le, hadiya jawaa’n pisar ka
Majboor hai ye behna, be-dard Zamana hai
Karne bhi nahi’n deta, maatam ye biradar ka
Be-tegh aaya Gaazi, roka nahi’n kisi ne
Kya faaeda hai zaalim, do laakh ke lashkar ka
Roya kiye hain Aabid, Aashoor se ajal tak
Do chaar ka nahi’n hai, sadma hai bhare ghar ka
Kyon dekhke Asgar ko, tujhko hayaa na aayi
Aye Hurmula bataa kya, dil tera hai patthar ka
Na-mehramo’n ki nazrein, Zainab se bachaane ko
Karne lagaa tilaawat, sar naize pe Sarwar ka
Paaya hai zaanoo Sheh ka, rumaal e Sayyada bhi
Hoga na Hur ke jaisa, sultan muqaddar ka
Be-haal kar diya hai, Aal e Nabi ko tu ne
Kya koi darr nahi’n hai, zaalim tujhe Mehshar ka
Asgar ki maut tak thi, dariya pe pehredaari
Kitna zaleel o badtar, manshaa tha sitamgar ka
Rooh e ‘Salim’ nikle farsh e azaa pe yaa Rab
Ye zindagi to yu’n bhi, sadqa hai bahattar ka

baba pe kate khair se ya rab ye mahina

khamosh dabeer ab ke qayamat ka hai aalam

rangeen sukhani sab ko teri yaad rahegi

items.title: Kazime muztar
items.body:
qaid mein chauda baras zulm o sitam dhaaya gaya
kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya

phir nishane ismate sadaat mitwaya gaya
kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid kar ke le ke aaye kazim e naushad ko
phir azadar e janabe syed e sajjad ko
paon mein bedi galay mein tauq pehnaya gaya
kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya
qaid mein chauda baras...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad abid ki aseeri aagayi rote rahe
pesh e haakim pa barehna haye peshi ke liye
jis ghadi sarkar ko darbar mein laaya gaya
kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya
qaid mein chauda baras...

char jaanib ghup andhera tha ke jaise qabr ho

kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya
qaid mein chauda baras...

qaid khane ki aziyat kam thi kya ay zaalimon

kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya
qaid mein chauda baras...

chand mazdooron ne laashe ko uthaya aap ke

ghul hua kaunain mein maara gaya ek be-khata

kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya

items.title: Kitna mushkil waqt
items.body:
kitna mushkil waqt qaidi saarban par aagaya

sar utha kar usne poocha ye jagah hai kaunsi
haye lafze shaam ye kiski zuban par aagaya

noke naize pe sare sheh ne sunaya haale gham
hashr ka pal karbala ki daastan par aagaya

dukh to saara natawan kadiyal jawan par aagaya

gul macha har ek jagah barpa qayamat hogayi

rodiya bemaar ek dam karke baba ko salaam

rab pe kya guzri qayamat rab ko hi maloom hai

kitna mushkil waqt...

paak zehra ke chaman mein kab raha waqte bahaar

dard ki tehreer abid likh ke ye karde tamaam

items.title: Lailatul qadr hoo
items.body:
jab se hai giraya zaalim ne
mujhpe jalta darwaza
pal pal mai dard se marti hoo
aaram nahi ek lahza
jo zakhm diye hai ummat ne
ta hashr rahenge taaza
hasrat hai raat ke parde may
mera uthe paak janaza
<<DIVIDER>>
lailatul qadr hoo mera taboot
ya ali raat ko uthana tum
mujhko jis jis ne bhi sataya usay
meri mayyat pe na bulana tum
<<DIVIDER>>
hai jigar daar hai shaheedon ke
ye kaleje chabane waale hai
mai hoo mazdoor inki nazron se
meri turbat ko bhi chupana tum
lailatul qadr hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere pehlu ka zakhm gehra hai
mera shabbir seh na payega
dafn ke waqt bhi mera maula
haath pehlu se na hatana tum
lailatul qadr hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere baazu ke neel dekh chuki
meri chadar se khoon ponch chuki
in masayib se wo bhi guzregi
kuch na zainab se ab chupana tum
lailatul qadr hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jabse zakhmi hui hoo mai maula
wo meri godh may nahi soye
raat ke waqt mere bachon ko
meri turbat may leke aana tum
lailatul qadr hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
naam leke mujhe pukara gaya
mere ghar aake mujhko maara gaya
teri amma batool qatl hui
mere abbas ko batana tum
lailatul qadr hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
phasliyan tod di hai ummat ne
thak chuki hoo mai zulm sehte huwe
jaa rahi hoo mai paas baba ke
ab wahin mujhse milne aana tum
lailatul qadr hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch to imran haq ada hoga
saahib ul asr se karo waada
jaan de dena sar katana magar
haq e zahra ko mat chupana tum
lailatul qadr hoo...
items.author: Imran Jatki

items.title: Mai laash uthaun
items.body:
hai jalti zameen tu hi bata ay mere asghar
mai laash uthaun ya teri qabr banaun
<<DIVIDER>>
rakh bhi to nahi sakta teri laash zameen par
mai laash uthaun ya teri qabr banaun
<<DIVIDER>>
rakhunga zameen par jo tujhe mere jiyale
hai garm zameen jism pe pad jayenge chaale
shabbir ko ab tu hi bata hasliyon waale
khud sambhla nahi jaata tujhe kaise sambhale
asghar ko kaha shaah ne seene se laga kar
mai laash uthaun ya...
hai jalti zameen...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye baat alag hai ke taraste ho kafan ko
dafnana zaroori hai bahot nanhe badan ko
warna ye layeen kar denge pamaal badan ko
maa teri na seh payegi is ranj o mahan ko
phir rote rahe dayr talak shaah ye keh kar
mai laash uthaun ya...
hai jalti zameen...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ye bhi khabar qabr mein na chain milega
hai garm zameen garm hawa jism jalega
pani ke bina dhoop ki shiddat na sahega
gar dafn na ho paaya to godhon se rundhega
laaya hoo tujhe is liye daaman mein chupa kar
mai laash uthaun ya...
hai jalti zameen...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon mein andhera hai nazar kuch nahi aata
tooti hai kamar baith ke utha nahi jaata
zaanu pe sula kar mai tujhe lori sunaata
ek haath se phir beta teri qabr banaata
majboor hoo ab uth bhi nahi sakta mai gir kar
mai laash uthaun ya...
hai jalti zameen...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek boond hi pani tu faqat maang raha tha
sookha hua seh roz se nanha sa gala tha
jo teer teri nanhi si gardan pe laga tha
wo teer mere laal tere qadh se bada tha
pani na diya qatl tujhe kar diya asghar
mai laash uthaun ya...
hai jalti zameen...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai phool sa nazuk ye tera chand sa chehra
kis dil se dabaunga isay khaak mein beta
mar jaunga sadme se yahin baap hoo tera
aa jayega us waqt mere moo ko kaleja
daalunga tere rukh pe jo mai rayt utha kar
mai laash uthaun ya...
hai jalti zameen...
<<DIVIDER>>
al kissa qamar qabr banane lage sarwar
asghar ko utha lete thay rakh rakh ke zameen par
ay shadman kehte thay ajab waqt hai hum par
bekafn hi dafnaana padega tujhe asghar
ab taab nahi baaqi mere jism ke andar
mai laash uthaun ya...
hai jalti zameen...

items.title: Aao alamdar
items.body:
binte ali ke liye hashr ka hai saamna
nargha e aada mein hai aale nabi berida
aagaya bazaar aao alamdaar

kaun dilaye rida koi baradar nahi
shaane kataye huwe shere jari so gaya

items.title: Aey Meri Behno Suno
items.body:
Aey meri behno suno,
Qoum ki behno suno
Mera paighaam suno,
Aey meri behno suno
Tum … Yaad parday ko rakho
Aurton key liye hai hukm e shariat parda
Ghour say dekho to hai aiK sa’aadat parda
Poocho quraan say hai tatheer ki ayat parda
Ba Khuda Zainab e Muztar ki hai sunnat parda
Bibi batlaingee un key liye kya tha parda
Sarbarehna theen tou baalon say kiya tha parda
Aao manzar main dikhati hun tumhain Yasrab ka
Aik din Baba say Zainab nay adab say ye kaha
Hum ko lay chaliye zara Qabr e Nabi par Baba
Baad e Maghrib tumhain lay jaoonga bolay Mola
Din dhala shaam ki kirnain jo ayan honay lageen
Betiyaan Mola ki parday main
nihan honay lageen
Sar pay maqna bhi rakha orh li Zainab nay aba
Us aba nay tab unhain dhaanp lia sar ta pa
Gird dukhtar kay lagay ghoomnay us dam Mola
Poocha Zainab nay k kia dekh rahay hain Baba
Bolay Haider key na parday main kami ho Beti
Dekhta hoon kahin chadar na
hati ho Beti
Kaha Abbas say Haider nay key tum aagay barho
Sab dukaanon kay charaghon ko zara bujhwa do
Bolay Hasnain say tum behnon ko ghairay main rakho
Parda behnon ka banaatay huay sab Bhaai chalo
Betiyyon ko meray mola jo yun lay jatay thay
Aisay parday ka chalan dahr ko sikhlatay thay
Gird jin aurton kay rahta hai parday ka hisar
Barhta hai aisi khawateen ka
dunya main waqar
Un ka hi hota hai zahra ki kaneezon main shumar
Bay rida ho kay karo apnay amal mat bekar
Bint e Zahra nay utari na thee khud hi chadar
Sar e Zainab say basad jabr chinee thee chadar
Mominaat aaj yahan tum pay koi jabr nahin
Koi cheenay nahin lay jata hai chadar bhi kahin
Sar pay hai Baap salamat to hai Bhaai bhi yahin
Ghar hain mahfooz jalata to nahin koi laeen
Tum nay kya samjha hai, Kya Fatima khush hotin hain
Be rida dekh kay tum ko
wo khafa hoti hain
Kab talak roaingay Sajjad say jab poocha gaya
Aap key ghar ka shahadat hai
qadeemi virsa
Bolay Sajjad k kia ye bhi hai virsa mera
Cheena jaey meri Maan behnon kay sar ka parda
Chadar e Zainab o Kulsoom ka yoon charcha kia
Mola Sajjad ney chalees baras girya kia
Voh jo parday ka chalan dehr ko sikhlaati thee
Karbala mein usi Bibi ki rida
cheeni gaee
Poocho Zainab say kay us waqt bhala kia guzri
Sarbarehna jo voh Darbar e Shaqi mein aaee
Boli Zainab meray Ghazi say koi farma do
Hosakay to meray sar key liey
chaadar laa do
ADEEYA, SAANIA, MAHUM suno MAJID ki sada
Tum khavateen ko batlaao key
kya hai parda
Be ridaaee E haram par jo ho karti girya
Laazmi hai key giray sar say tumharay na rida
Deen kay wastay Zainab nay lutaya parda
Sab khavateen ka ta hashr bachaya parda

items.title: Haq Mangne Ko Zehra
items.body:
Haq mangneko Zehra darbaar me khadi hai
Arshe ula pe rooh e Ahmed bhi ro rahi hai
Laayi hai sath main wo baba ki ek sanad ko
Koi tou Fathima ki haqaniyat ko samjho
Allah janta hai sacchai joh chupi hai
Zehra ko gham nahi hai baagh e fidak ka baba
Gham ye hai jis ka kehna qaliq ne sach kiya tha
Badkar ki zuban se jhutlayi jaa rahi hai
Moula hassan yahan se guzrenge na kabhi bhi
Ruq modhlenge apna yadh ayega joh maazi
Wo jis gaali me Zehra chalte huwe girin hain
Darbaar se nikal kar cha jayegi zaefi
Dar bhi girega usper tutigin phasliyan bhi
Zehra pe ab musibat har lamha badh rahi hai
Zainab tadap ke boli ye sab bhi main sahongi
Ek roz maa ke jaisi halaat meri bhi hogi
Amma ko dekhti hai aur roti jaa rahi hain
Dekhen joh zaqmi pehlu jab Fathima ka haider
Pehlu pakad ke apna royenge itna Sarwar
Phir sabr ye kahega mushkil me ab Ali hai
Qatil se wo hi lega har ek Sitam ka badla
Qaim ke sath aakar ek din rajjul hamara
Ghazi ki muntazir wo turbat me rorahi hai

Mujh Se Baatein Karo

Sun Ke Roti Rahi Zaalimoon Ki Hansi

Band Kar Ke Kafan Di Ali Ne Sadaa
