items.title: Kitne Hisso Me Mulaqat Karoge Baba
items.body:
Kitne Hisson Mein Mulaqat Karoge Baba
Qaid Mein Dekh Kar Sar, Bibi Sakina Ne Kaha
Kitne Hisson Mein Mulaqat Karoge Baba
Haye Kal Maine Bayaban Mein Tan Dekha Hai
Aur Ab Qaid Mein Zalim Ne Ye Sar Bheja Hai
Kya Mukammal Na Kabhi Mujhse Miloge Baba
Kitne Hisson Mein Mulaqat Karoge Baba
Kya Kabhi Mujhko Gale Se Na Lagaoge Pedar
Jeete Ji Dekhna Paungi Main Ye Seena-O-Sar
Maar Dalega Sakina Ko Yahi Ek Sadma
Kitne Hisson Mein Mulaqat Karoge Baba
In Labon Ke Liya Karte The Mohammad Bose
Khoon Mein Tar Hain Ye Lab, Mara Hai Patthar Kisne
Aapko Dekh Ke Phatta Hai Kaleja Mera
Kitne Hisson Mein Mulaqat Karoge Baba
Aapka Tan Sar-E-Maqtal Hai, Khabar Hai Mujhko
Kya Kiya Hoga Sitamgar Ne, Ye Dar Hai Mujhko
Kya Koi Hissa Badan Ka Hai Salamat Baba
Kitne Hisson Mein Mulaqat Karoge Baba
Aapke Baad Bahut Zulm Hua Hai Mujh Par
Dekhiye Shimr Ki Ungli Ke Nishan Hain Rukh Par
Itni Zakhmi Hun, Kafan Hoga Ye Kurta Mera
Kitne Hisson Mein Mulaqat Karoge Baba
Shimr Kehta Tha Karo In Pe Sitam Ab Aise
Aao Mil Jul Ke Karo Ek Badan Ke Tukde
Maine Zalim Ki Zuban Se Ye Suna Hai Jumla
Kitne Hisson Mein Mulaqat Karoge Baba
Karbala Ja Ke Main Mahfooz Karungi Baba
Mujhko Batlaiye Tukde Main Chunungi Baba
Kya Khabar Thi Use Mar Jayegi Wo Khud Dukhiya
Kitne Hisson Mein Mulaqat Karoge Baba
Ek Angoothi Ke Liye Kaati Gayi Thi Ungli
Aur Patke Ke Liye Kaatta Tha Haath Koi
Bhai Sajjad Se Ye Maine Suna Hai Noha
Kitne Hisson Mein Mulaqat Karoge Baba
Seena Bhi Bhej Do Zindan Mein, Ye Kahiye Baba
Ek Muddat Hui So Payi Nahin Ye Dukhiya
Main Sakina Hun Ke Wo Seena Hai Bistar Mera
Kitne Hisson Mein Mulaqat Karoge Baba
Aye Sharar Naqvi, Sada Aayi Sar-E-Sarwar Se
Lene Aaye Hain Chalo Qaid Ke Ab Is Ghar Se
Ab Mukammal Tumhein Jannat Mein Milenge Baba
Kitne Hisson Mein Mulaqat Karoge Baba

items.title: Lakhte dile hasan
items.body:
lakhte dil e hassan ke tukde utha utha ke
daaman mein rakh rahe hai sarwar saja saja ke
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala mein beta maadar ki laaj rakhna
bachpan se maa ne paala lori suna suna ke
lakhte dil e hassan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
de kar raza e maqtal bhai ke laadle ko
karte hai pyaar sarwar dil se laga laga ke
lakhte dil e hassan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye keh ke ran mein qasim fauje jafa pe toote
ladte nahi hai ran mein jaan ko bacha bacha ke
lakhte dil e hassan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
josh e wafa e qasim ghazi se mil raha hai
darya se uth rahi hai maujein wafa wafa ke
lakhte dil e hassan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek tashna lab ko ran mein laakhon ne mil ke maara
taapon se rond daala ghode bhaga bhaga ke
lakhte dil e hassan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
tukde badan hai saara shabbir ro rahe hai
chunte hai laash e qasim aansu baha baha ke
lakhte dil e hassan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
pamaal ho ke pyasa sairaab ho raha hai
tashna labi ko apne khoon mein bujha bujha ke
lakhte dil e hassan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa dekhne na paaye tukde badan hai saara
laate hai laash maula maa se chupa chupa ke
lakhte dil e hassan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
deti rahi sadayein farwa kahan ho qasim
haste rahe sitamgar qaime jala jala ke
lakhte dil e hassan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
farwa ka chand khoon mein dooba kuch is tarha se
rota raha falak bhi taare bujha bujha ke
lakhte dil e hassan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
tukde nahi ye qasim ran mein tere badan ke
naqshe baqa rakhe hai tu ne bana bana ke
lakhte dil e hassan ke...
items.author: Ali Rizvi Sachey

items.title: Mai maa hoo pyase
items.body:
jab tadape ne ki bhi taaqat na rahi sarwar ko
ghul hua ke ghash aaya khalaf e hyder ko
aur phir shimr badha khaynche huwe khanjar ko
sab se kehta tha ke kaatunga sar e sarwar ko
moo na mai daulate dunya se kabhi pherunga
aaj zahra ke kaleje pa churi pherunga
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi sada e fatema tars itna to khaa le zaalim
mai maa hoon pyase hussain ki
<<DIVIDER>>
na khanjar chala ay zaalim isko pani pilade zaalim
mai maa hoon pyase hussain ki
<<DIVIDER>>
choomte thay payambar jise wo gala
kaise dekhun usay zer e khanjar bhala
jis ka kalma padhe ye zamana
wo mohamed hai iske nana
mai maa hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
isko mehman bula kar sataate ho kyun
mere bacche pe khanjar chalate ho kyun
tars itna to khaa ay zaalim
mera dil na dukha ya zaalim
mai maa hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise paala hai isko tujhe kya khabar
mera haathon ke chaale huwe nauhagar
kaise dekhun bata de sitamgar
apne bacche ki gardan pe khanjar
mai maa hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
chakkiyan pees kar maine paal jise
kya bana hai ye khanjar isi ke liye
qatl karna hi hai gar che tujhko
dasht se door jaane de mujhko
mai maa hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne pehlu mein isko sulaati rahi
iski raahon se kaante hataati rahi
aaj iske galay pe khanjar
kaise dekhun bata de sitamgar
mai maa hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
loriyan isko deti thi mai raat bhar
kitni raatein guzari hai yun jaag kar
kab se soya nahi dilbar
bojh bas hai yehi mere dil par
mai maa hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
faaqe kar kar ke khaana khilaya jise
pyasi reh reh ke pani pilaya jise
aath pehron se hai aaj pyasa
kaise de dun tujhe ye asaasa
mai maa hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ki faryad farhan kya ho bayan
chashme mazhar se hai khoon ka gajra rawan
chal gaya ibne hyder pe khanjar
nauha karti rahi ban mein maadar
mai maa hoon...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Aao Amma Ko Rukhsat Karo
items.body:
Zahra Ko De Chuke Jo Ali Gusl Aur Kafan
Mayyat Ko Rakh Ke Bole Ye Ghar Mein Shahe Zaman
Aao Amma Ko Rukhsat Karo Aye..
Aao Amma Ko Rukhsat Karo Aye Husain a.s...2
Ab Na Amma Milegi Tumhe Mahlaqa...
Aao Amma Ko Rukhsat Karo Aye Husain a.s..
1)Aao Deedar Aakhir Ye Maañ Ka Karo
Jo Bhi Kahna Hai Aakar Wo Maañ Se Kaho
Maañ Tardap Jayegi Is Tarha Tu Na Ro
Peyar Tujhse Bahut Karti Thi Fatima s.a...
Aao Amma Ko Rukhsat Karo Aye Husain a.s...2
2)Tumse Zahra Ko Ulfat Bahut Thi Husain
Tere Bin Ek Pal Bhi Naa Paati Thi Chain
Aa Ja UthKe Wahañ Se Mere Nooreain
Dekho Beta Na Rona Kabhi Is Tarha...
Aao Amma Ko Rukhsat Karo Aye Hussain...2
3)Shab Ko Uth Kar Ke Pani Pilati Thi Maañ
Apne Sine Pe Beta Sulati Thi Maañ
Tere Rone Se Haye Tardapti Thi Maañ
Taaki Thora Sukuñ Pa Sake Fatima s.a...
Aao Amma Ko Rukhsat Karo Aye Hussain...2
4)Waqt Shab Ka Guzarta Hai Dekho Aye Laal
Maañ Ko Bhi Ye Lahed Mein Rahe Ga Malaal
Mujhse Milne Na Aaya Wo Yusuf Jamaal
Shab Na Dhal Jaye Hona Kahiñ Ab...
Aao Amma Ko Rukhsat Karo Aye Hussain...2
5)Sunke Baba Ki Bateñ Ye Kahne Lage
Amma KehKar Ke Sheh Aur Rone Lage
Baith Kar Ke Zamiñ Par tardapne Lage
Maañ Bulayegi Jab Tak Mai Aaunga Na...
Aao Amma Ko Rukhsat Karo Aye Hussain...2
6)Sunke Bete Ki Bateñ Ye Aai Sada
Maañ Ne Bande Kafan Todkar Ke Kaha
Aaja Sine Se Lagja Mere Mahlaqa
Maañ Se Mil Kar Bahut Roya Phir Ladlaa...
Aao Amma Ko Rukhsat Karo Aye Hussain...2
7)Deer Tak Fatima Se Kya Bateñ Huwi
Kuch Kisi Ko Khabar Hi Nahi Mil Saki
Hatife Ghaibi Ki Ye Sada Aa Gaiii
Kardo Maañ Se Ali Ja Ke Jaldi Juda...
Aao Amma Ko Rukhsat Karo Aye Hussain...2
8)Bateñ Jo Thi Huwi Fatima Se "Wafa"
Asre Aashur "Dayem" Pata ye chala
Girte Ghode Se Zahra Ko Dii Jab Sada
Amma Aao Jao Wo Waqt Aa Hi Gaya...
Aao Amma Ko Rukhsat Karo Aye Husain...2

items.title: Abbas Ho Kahaan
items.body:
Abbas Ho Kahaan
(Mere Abbas ho kahaa(n)) x2
Abbas ho kahaa(n), mere Abbas ho kahaa(n)
Bemakhna aur be chadar
Kehti hai bibi Zainab rokar
Ay sheyr-e-karwaa(n)
(Aal-e-nabi aur sham ka rasta, Koi nahi zainab ka sahara, Abbas ho kahaa(n)) x2
Sharm ye ati hai mujhko ke, sar pe nahi koi bhi parda
Sharm ki had hai ye ghazi ke, dekh rahe ho tum ay bhayya
Kaise karu(n) baalo(n) ki chadar
Khaak-e-shifa ko sar pe rakh kar
Ab hu(n) mei yak-zabaa(n)
Mere abbas ho kahaa(n)
(Aal-e-nabi aur sham ka rasta, Koi nahi zainab ka sahara, Abbas ho kahaa(n)) x2
Gham se bhara hai qalb ye mera, Sham ke is darbaar ke andar
Tasht tille pe bhayi ka sar hai, nok-e-sina par tu ay dilawar
Zakhm hazaro(n) hai ye dil mei(n)
Mei hu(n) anbaar-e-qatil mei(n)
Hu aayina-e-maa(n)
Mere abbas ho kahaa(n)
(Aal-e-nabi aur sham ka rasta, Koi nahi zainab ka sahara, Abbas ho kahaa(n)) x2
Ponch gaye shiree(n) ke gar pe, pooch rahi hai wo hasrat se
Saath mei aye hai kya maula, ayi hai Zainab kya ghurbat se
Boli ke haaye mei hu(n) Zainab,
Aal-e-muhammad ke bete sab,
Neze pe hai(n) yahaa(n)
(Aal-e-nabi aur sham ka rasta, Koi nahi zainab ka sahara, Abbas ho kahaa(n)) x2
Choti si qabrei(n) kitni banawu(n), sham ke raste mei bacho(n) ke
Sukhi zabaa(n) hai garm hawa hai, hosh nikalti hai pyaaso(n) ke
Eik rasan aur bara gale hai
Taziyaa(n) aur durre lagte hai
Hai pusht par nishaa(n)
Mere abbas ho kahaan
(Aal-e-nabi aur sham ka rasta, Koi nahi zainab ka sahara, Abbas ho kahaa(n)) x2
Jiske gale par khud ahmad ne, bose lagaaye the roro kar
Khaymo(n) ke dar se dekh rahi thi, hone laga jab tan se juda sar
Tha bachpan mei sawaar-e-payambar
Aya hai jo ye Nok-e-sina par
Hai natiq-e-quraa(n)
Mere abbas ho kahaan
(Aal-e-nabi aur sham ka rasta, Koi nahi zainab ka sahara, Abbas ho kahaa(n)) x2
tum bhi nahi mere ghazi aur, na akbar hai na asghar hai
had hai ke ab mere sar par bhi, bhayi nahi koi chadar hai
khake pathar zalim se ye
Sham ke zinda(n) ko behne ye
Jaati hai al-amaa(n)
Mere abbas ho kahaan
(Aal-e-nabi aur sham ka rasta, Koi nahi zainab ka sahara, Abbas ho kahaa(n)) x2
Bali sakina ko zinadan me, chhoti lahad me dafn karke
Yaad ayi apne bhayi ki, us pal binte ali ko had se
Phatta hai dil likh kar ay Tejani
Zinda(n) mei zainab ye pukari
Lekar jo siskiyaan
Mere Abbas ho kahaa(n)

items.title: Alam kiska hai
items.body:
dabdaba kiska hashm kiska alam kiska hai
mere ghazi ke muqabil ho ye dam kiska hai
<<DIVIDER>>
zameen waale usay toote dilon ki aas kehte hai
shariyat mein usay sadaat ka ehsaan kehte hai
karam sabr o raza ki saltanat ka naam hai shabbir
wafa ki aakhri sarhad ko hum abbas kehte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhna to kahin ay dil ye payambar to nahi
sardar e fatema zehra pe ye kham kiska hai
dabdaba kiska...
<<DIVIDER>>
hur ne ek pal mein shifa'at ki sanad paayi hai
shab e ashoor ye andaz e karam kiska hai
dabdaba kiska...
<<DIVIDER>>
sawaal e ajr e risalat maaf hona hai
munafiqat ko abhi be-naqaab hona hai
ali ka beta zamane mein aane waala hai
abhi to baagh e fidak ka hisaab hona hai
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ye kehte ho fidak haq hai nabi zaadi ka
hum ye kehte hai arab aur ajam kiska hai
dabdaba kiska...
<<DIVIDER>>
haq ko zinda kiya aulad e abu talib ne
warna tareekh e shuja'at mein bharam kiska hai
dabdaba kiska...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunnat e ahmed e mukhtaar hai shabbir ka gham
is hawaale se zara soch ye gham kiska hai
dabdaba kiska...
<<DIVIDER>>
aag ye kisne lagayi hai dar e zehra par
tu hi tareekh batade ye sitam kiska hai
dabdaba kiska...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye jahan waale jise mohr e nabuwat samjhe
dosh e ahmed pe muhib naqshe qadam kiska hai
dabdaba kiska...
items.author: Mohib Fazli

items.title: Amma fizza
items.body:
amma fizza mai thak gayi chal ke
zaalim baithne na deta hai
ye beti ali ki kis se kahe
ke zaalim baithne na deta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra jo gayi thi zaalim ke
darbar mein maine poocha tha
amma tu mujhko itna bata
darbar ye kaise hota hai
amma fizza mai thak gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene se laga kar zahra ne
ro ro ke mujhse itna kaha
mai sab ko bata sakti hoo magar
dekhun jo tujhe dil rota hai
amma fizza mai thak gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
amma fizza tu itna bata
mai beti ali ki hoo lekin
zaalim ke ghulamon ne tumko
shehzadi keh ke pukara hai
amma fizza mai thak gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne muqatib ho ke kaha
ay zaalim tu itna sun le
hum aaye nahi majboori mein
teri haar ne hum ko bulaya hai
amma fizza mai thak gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar ke baahar mai thi khadi
aur bacchi mujhse poochti thi
bas itna batadije mujhko
darbar ye kaahe sajaya hai
amma fizza mai thak gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab naam pukara zaalim ne
zainab ka to abid ne kaha
abbas chacha dekho to zara
kya waqt ne hum ko dikhaya hai
amma fizza mai thak gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi beti ne ye dunya mein nahi dekha ho
kund khanjar se baba jiska zibha ho
<<DIVIDER>>
sar tasht e tila mein rakha tha
aur zaalim sab se kehta tha
ye kis ki bacchi hai jis ne
darbar mein sab ko rulaya hai
amma fizza mai thak gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
awaaz suni zanjeeron ki
tab zainab ne fizza se kaha
amma ye kaisa qaidi hai
nazron ko jis ne jhukaya hai
amma fizza mai thak gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai shukr tera ay shehzadi
auqaat kahan thi mohsin ki
wo sar ko jhuka ke kehta hai
ye nauha tum ne likhaya hai
amma fizza mai thak gayi...
items.author: Toosi Zangipuri

items.title: Aun o mohamed mere
items.body:
zainab ke dulaare aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed mere aun o mohamed
<<DIVIDER>>
boli zainab ye mere maan badhana bachon
surkh roo jang ke maidan se aana bachon
maut ko zeest ka unwaan banana bachon
pyase seh roz ke ho khoon may nahana bachon
aun o mohamed mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj ke din ke liye maine tumhe paala tha
ibne makhdooma e kaunain hai mushkil may ghira
aarzu aun o mohamed hai tumhari maa ki
dono ho jao mere bhai ke akbar pe fida
aun o mohamed mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhm maidan may tum khao to khush ho maadar
shaan ajdaad ki dikhlao to khush ho maadar
suye darya na utha kar kabhi nazrein dekho
pyase dunya se guzar jao to khush ho maadar
aun o mohamed mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
jang is tarha karo ahl e wafa yaad kare
aise hamle ho jinhe shaami sada yaad kare
neemche khol ke lamhon may ulat do lashkar
daad abbas de aur sher e khuda yaad kare
aun o mohamed mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
dum karun naad e ali sar ko jhuka lo bachon
saare armaan ladayi ke nikaalo bachon
haye sehra na saja sar pe tumhare lekin
maut ko aaj dulhan apni banalo bachon
aun o mohamed mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
hukm zainab ka baja laaye dulaare bache
maut to haar gayi ran may na haare bache
dekh kar laashe pukari ye ali ki beti
surkh roo mai hui dunya se sidhare bache
aun o mohamed mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
boli maa laashon se kyun neend hai aayi utho
maa ko batlao ladi kaisi ladayi utho
ba adab tum ho bahot phir ye ghazab hai kaisa
kab se baali pe khade hai mere bhai utho
aun o mohamed mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaffri royi kahan bachon ko binte zehra
haa magar laut ke jab ghar may wo aayi dukhiya
khaali hujre jo nazar aaye to phir zabt hua
haat phailaye huwe ro ke ye zainab ne kaha
aun o mohamed mere...
items.author: Jaffri

items.title: Ay shame ghariban
items.body:
ay shame ghariban ay shame ghariban
tareekh ka hai gham se tere chaak gareban
<<DIVIDER>>
ek zakhme sina se ali akbar gaye maare
kausar ko sidhare
kya kya na thay laila ko abhi byaah ke armaan
ay shame ghariban…
<<DIVIDER>>
cheh maah ke baysheer bhi maare gaye pyase
ek teer e khaza se
is zulm pa khud ahle jafa hogaye girya
ay shame ghariban…
<<DIVIDER>>
bete thay wo zainab ke ajab faqre abujad
wo aun o mohamed
hamsheer ne dono ko kiya bhai pa qurban
ay shame ghariban…
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar hai na qasim hai na asghar hai na abbas
ab koi nahi paas
ek pehr may shabbir ka ghar hogaya veeran
ay shame ghariban…
<<DIVIDER>>
shehzadi sakina bhi aaghaze safar hai
lagte hai tamache
aur shaam ka zindan to hai pir shaam ka zindan
ay shame ghariban…

items.title: Bas itna batado
items.body:
jab khafila pahuncha tha madine ke zara paas
maqtal mein hua kya ye suna usne basad e yaas
kat'ta tha jigar dil mein nidamat ka tha ehsaas
har ek se yehi poochti thi maadar e abbas
jab gardan e shabbir pe khanjar wo rawan tha
bas itna batado mera abbas kahan tha
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ke pisar jaane nabi sayyade waali
akbar ke kaleje se sina kaise nikali
jab khaak pe dum tod'ta laila ka jawan tha
bas itna batado...
<<DIVIDER>>
maidan mein baysheer ko jab laaye thay shabbir
nanhe ali asghar ki jo gardan pe laga teer
jab baap ke haaton pe pisar tashna dahan tha
bas itna batado...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaqa mera maidan mein kyun rehgaya tanha
haa doodh na bakhshungi mai ye kya kiya beta
zehra ka pisar khaak pe jab girya kuna tha
bas itna batado...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab bibiyan jalte hue qaimon ke thi andar
jab zainab e dilgeer ki cheeni gayi chadar
jab gardane beemar mein wo tauqe garan tha
bas itna batado...
<<DIVIDER>>
abid ko liye phirti thi jab zainab e muztar
jab aag lagayi gayi cheena gaya bistar
phaila huwa jab shaam e ghariban ka dhuan tha
bas itna batado...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab shaam e ghariban mein bhi pyase rahe bache
jab dukhtare shabbir ke lagte thay tamache
jab uska jigar karbe yateeme se tapan tha
bas itna batado...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne kaha usko wafa ka tha bahot paas
jab zibha huwe bhai tho zindan na thay abbas
bin haaton ke tha ghairate ilyaas ka laasha
saahil pe tadapta raha abbas ka laasha
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sun ke kiya shukr magar phir bhi hai ehsas
ab tak ye qamar poochti hai madare abbas
jab gardane shabbir pe khanjar wo rawan tha
bas itna batado...
items.author: Qamar Hasnain

items.title: Bhoola hai na
items.body:
bhoola hai na bhoolega ta hashr zamana
darbar e yazeedi mein tera khutba sunana
<<DIVIDER>>
tere parde pe qurban tere bhai ke sadqe
aata hai jise deen pe ghar baar lutana
bhoola hai na...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ne ye dars zamane ko diya hai
aage kisi zaalim ke kabhi sar na jhukana
bhoola hai na...
<<DIVIDER>>
hurmul ye tera jurm kabhi chup nahi sakta
pani ke ewaz teer se asghar ko sulaana
bhoola hai na...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ki azmat hai ye shbbir ke jurrat
maqtal mein wo akbar ke laashe ko uthana
bhoola hai na...
<<DIVIDER>>
mushtaq kiye jaa tu isi dar ki ghulami
bakshish ka nahi aisa koi aur thikana
bhoola hai na...
items.author: Mushtaq Hussain

items.title: Darbari baithe hai
items.body:
jisne sada se pehle hamesha ata kiya
beti usi ki ban ke sawali khadi rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
jo samjhe musalaman musibat yehi hai
ke darbari baithe hai zahra khadi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sitam hai muhammad ki thereer padh kar
sabhi has rahe hai wohi ro rahi hai
ke darbari baithe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hijab e khuda hai jo binte nabi hai
wo darbar may jaane kabse khadi hai
ke darbari baithe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
diya aise ummat ne baba ka pursa
batool apne pehlu ke bal gir padi hai
ke darbari baithe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
bata mujhko amma mera jurm kya tha
ye mohsin ki ab bhi sada aa rahi hai
ke darbari baithe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
karegi na zahra ab apna koi gham
ali ke galay may rasan dekhti hai
ke darbari baithe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
khayaal aa gaya berida betiyon ka
wo ghazi ka kurta jabhi see rahi hai
ke darbari baithe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai mushkil bada qabre zahra banana
ali ke labon pe bhi nade ali hai
ke darbari baithe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
batool ab bhi qabre shikasta se ahsan
imam e zaman ko sada de rahi hai
ke darbari baithe hai...

items.title: Haye qasim
items.body:
sehriyan waala qasim
maa ka dulaara qasim
pehchaane maa kaise
laasha tumhara qasim

maa ko itna hi mil saka qasim
haye qasim haye haye qasim

gir gaye shaah e deen ye kehte huwe
dekho abbas gir gaya qasim
haye qasim...
ek gathri mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ek tukda de raha tha sada
ye raha ammu aap ka qasim
haye qasim...
ek gathri mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye maqtal mein chaar jaanib se
sheh ki tazeem ko utha qasim
haye qasim...
ek gathri mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere tukdon ko chun'ne ki khaatir
khud chali aayi fatema qasim
haye qasim...
ek gathri mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai sumon ke nishan chehre par
tera kya haal ho gaya qasim
haye qasim...
ek gathri mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
itna kamsin tha ran mein girte huwe
tu ne amma ko di sada qasim
haye qasim...
ek gathri mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ne dhoonda usay bahot ran mein
par mukammal nahi mila qasim
haye qasim...
ek gathri mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
mir sajjad apne ammu se
pehle pamaal ho gaya qasim
haye qasim...
ek gathri mein...
items.author: Mir Sajjad Mir

items.title: Izzat khuda ke deen
items.body:
izzat khuda ke deen ki bachali hussain ne
nana tumhari baat nibahyi hussain ne
<<DIVIDER>>
ab kaun hai jo qaimon may jaa kar khabar kare
asghar ki qabr ran may banaali hussain ne

items.title: Kehdo ye zainab nahi
items.body:
Haye bazaar, haye zainab..(2)
Ya rab tu meri chashm e tasawwur ko yaqee de
be parda aseero mein ye zainab to nahi hai
shaam ke bazaar mein, ye kaun aaya berida
kehdo ye zainab nahi..

1. Zakhm jiske padh rahe hai, aayatein
jis ke chehre se ayaa'n hai, zehmatein
aayi hai kis des se, maqdooma e sharm o haya
kehdo ye zainab nahi..

iske lab par kyu sadaa hai, ya ali ya ayliya
kehdo ye zainab nahi..
<<DIVIDER>>

apne sar ko peet-ti hai, nauhagar
aake jo bazaar mein karti hai marne ki dua
kehdo ye zainab nahi..
<<DIVIDER>>

haye ghazi keh rahi hai , baar baar
wo jo karti hai fugha, karta hai mera dil buka
kehdo ye zainab nahi..
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Bediyo'n mein qafela salaar hai
ye na kehna abid e beemar hai
wo jise kehkar phuphi, har gaam deta hai sadaa
kehdo ye zainab nahi..
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Is ka nauha sunke roye dil mera
kisko kehti hai shabeeh e mustafa
haye akbar kehke jo padhti hai rokar marsiya
kehdo ye zainab nahi..
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Ye samajhne se hu mai qasir yaha'n
kyu chupati hai ise sab bibiya'n
jis ke parde ke liye salaar hai mehwe buka
kehdo ye zainab nahi..
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Kaifiyat aisi hai mazhar abidi
isko padhkar ro diya irfan bhi
jab kiya nauha raqam, khud mere dil ne ye kaha
kehdo ye zainab nahi..

items.title: Baba Ka Janaza
items.body:
Zainab Ne Kaha Tham Ke Abbas Ka Shana
Bhaiyya Na Uthao abhe Baba Ka Janaza
Baba Ka Janaza
Dhud-la Gaye Manzar nazar ata nahe kuch bhe
thamty he nahi anso mery kya karun bhai
baba hein kafan mai na aaba hai na ama-ma
mai routi hun wo uth ke manaty nahi mujhko
yun baba kabhe chorr ke jaty nahe mujhko
na sar pe rakha hath na chuma mera mathaa
routy hein jo hasnain sambhalo inhen jakar
abbas na rou mery bhai yun tarap kar
ghassh agaya kulsoom ko do isko sahara
mai ladli baba ki hoon marjaungi bhaiiya
ab ayengy bas karbobala mai mery baba
jab sham e alam hogi rida bar sar e naiza
hai rooh e nabi girya kuna pass hamary
amma ke kabhe rouny ki sada aany lagi hai
jibril bukka karte hein ruk jao khudara
baba ki ziarat jo na kar paegi zainab
jeety jee issi dard sy marjaegi zainab
bin baba ujar jaegi bhaiiya meri duniya
jab ghar sy samar uthta tha moula ka janaza
shabbir ney zainab ko jo maiyyat sy uthaya
tha zainab e dilgir ke lab par yehi noha

items.body:

items.title: Aur phir shaam aagaya
items.body:
karbobala se laut ke aaya jo khaafla
qabr e nabi pe matam e shabbir jab hua
zainab ne baal khole nabi ke mazaar par
boli luta ke aayi hoo jangal mein saara ghar
aray nana
mai roti rahi mera ghar ujda tera deen bacha nana
lekin mere hussain ne waada nibha diya
hussain ya hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
nana tere shehr se chala zehra ka laadla
deen ke kaam aa gaya
salaar e khaafla ban gaya bemaar natawan
aur phir shaam aa gaya

raahon ke sangrezon ne pursa diya usay

nana tere shehr se...

sun ke aaram aa gaya
aur phir shaam aa gaya
nana tere shehr se...

nana bataun kaise mai kya ho gaye sitam
kufe ke dar pe jaise hi pahunche aseere gham

lab pe ash shaam aa gaya
aur phir shaam aa gaya
nana tere shehr se...

waan ek yahoodi rehta tha bahya tha jis ka naam

sabr phir kaam aa gaya
aur phir shaam aa gaya
nana tere shehr se...
<<DIVIDER>>

lene in'aam aa gaya

nana tere shehr se...

nana tere shehr se...

sab haste rahe hum rote rahe

items.title: Dard Ke Mare Kaha Jaye
items.body:
Koi apna nahi Kufe mein Muslim ke dularon ka,
Paraya desh hai ye, dard ke maare kahaan jaayein.
<<DIVIDER>>
Andhera hai nigahon mein, nazar aata nahi raasta,
Paraya desh hai ye, dard ke maare kahaan jaayein.
<<DIVIDER>>
Musafir hain ye, kamsin hain, abhi nadaan hain dono,
Zara bhi shehar se waaqif nahi, anjaan hain dono,
Koi aakar Madine ka inhe raasta dikha deta.
<<DIVIDER>>
Giraftaar-e-bala Kufe mein Haider ke nawase hain,
Na jaane kab se bhookhe hain, na jaane kab se pyaase hain,
Qayamat hai, saron se uth chuka hai baap ka saaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Judai baap ki dono ko har lamha rulaati hai,
Tadapte hain bahut, baba ki har dam yaad aati hai,
Kaleje par rawa rehta hai har dam dard ka aara.
<<DIVIDER>>
Watan jaane ka raasta dhoondte hain raat bhar dono,
Kya karte hain chupkar jhaadiyon mein din basar dono,
Kya karti hai inki maut, inka har ghadi peecha.
<<DIVIDER>>
Safar pe baap ke hamraah jab ye ghar se aaye the,
Badi ulfat se madar ne naye kapde pehnaaye the,
Nahi pardes mein koi ab inka poochne wala.
<<DIVIDER>>
Saron par khaak hai, kapde hain maile, baal bikhre hain,
Ajab aalam hai dono ka, gale mil-mil ke rote hain,
Kabhi kehte hain ae amma, kabhi kehte hain ae baba.
<<DIVIDER>>
Abhi bhi aas hai dil mein ke baba jald aayenge,
Wo apne saath apne laadlon ko leke jaayenge,
Inhe ye bhi nahi maloom inki lut gayi duniya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Qayamat ho gayi us dam, zameeno aasman roye,
Hua ek hashr barpa, fazl sab peero jawaan roye,
Likha waiz ne jab ye dard mein dooba hua noha.

items.title: Ek diya qabr e sakina
items.body:

kya karu hukm e mashiyat se hu majboor magar
ek diya qabr e sakina pe jalana aakar
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Sar khule saare aseero ke barabar hi rahi..(2)
baap ke sar ko kabhi dekhti thi mujhko kabhi..(2)
haath rakh leti thi apne kabhi rukhsaro par

9. Shaam walo tumhe nana ki risalat ki qasam..(2)

items.title: Ja raha hu mai karbala
items.body:
Ja raha hoon mai karbala nana (2)
Makhtasar leke khafela nana...
1.aap jab se hue juda nana,
jina dushwar hogaya nana,
chain ek pal nahin mila nana,
hum sahe zulm bekhata nana....
Ja raha hoon mai karbala nana (2)
2.nana ummat ne wo sitam dhaya,
Khoon me baba ka tar musalla hua,
Zeher se bhai ko shaheed kiya,
Maa ke pehlu pa dar gira nana....
Ja raha hoon mai karbala nana (2)
3.nana kistarha wo jigar laoun,
kaise beemaar ko mai samjhaoun,
saath sughra ko kaise lejaoun,
hu bahu hai ye fatema nana....
Ja raha hoon mai karbala nana (2)
4.gham bada hai meri judaai ka,
marna jaye kahen meri sughra,
qabr par gar jalana aaye diya,
aap usko sambhalna nana....
Ja raha hoon mai karbala nana (2)
5.deen-e-islaam ko bachana hai,
haq ke paighaam ko sunana hai,
wada tifli ka ab nibhaana hai,
do mujhe aake housla nana....
Ja raha hoon mai karbala nana (2)
6.nana jungle basane jaounga,
sar kataounga ghar lutaounga,
laut kar phir kabhi na aaounga,
Lo salaam aakhri mera nana....
Ja raha hoon mai karbala nana (2)
7.hai shabeeh aap ki ali akbar,
mera ghazi hai saniye haider,
aur qasim hai hu bahu shabbar,
karne deen pa inhen fida nana....
Ja raha hoon mai karbala nana (2)
8.naujawa'n laal ka jigar dounga,
aur dedounga bezaba'n ka gala,
khud laho deke apni shehrag ka,
deen ka gulshan sajaounga nana....
Ja raha hoon mai karbala nana (2)
9.ab mayassar na hoga mujhko qarar,
nana chutta hai mujhse maa ka mazar,
phir na dekhounga aap ka ye dayaar,
gham ye har pal rulayega nana....
Ja raha hoon mai karbala nana (2)
10.sunke "Zahid" ye noha e sarwar,
kaampi "Shahkar" qabr e paighambar,
aayi aawaaz aye mere dilbar,
saath hoga tere tera nana....
Ja raha hoon mai karbala nana (2)

items.body:

Aamday mehmaa hui orr mezbaan marra gya
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ahly gham seenoun pe akbar hath apny maar kr
Keh rhy hein zulm ka nezza yhan marra gya

items.title: Agar Aaj Maa Hoti
items.body:
Ho Gayi Dafn Zahra Ki Mayyat
Ghar Mein Har Simt Chhaya Andhera

Ek Konay Mein Chup Hai Akela

Agar Aaj Maa Hoti

1

Agar Aaj Maa Hoti
<<DIVIDER>>
3
<<DIVIDER>>

Lamhon Mein Hi Pyaas Bujhti Meri
Agar Aaj Maa Hoti
<<DIVIDER>>
4

Unhein Saari Ummat Satati Rahi

Woh Zakhmon Ko Hum Se Chhupati Rahi
Main Zakhmon Pe Marham Lagata Abhi
Agar Aaj Maa Hoti
<<DIVIDER>>
5
<<DIVIDER>>
Kabhi Chain Se Ab Na Sounga Main
Ke Ab Jaane Kis Kis Ko Khounga Main
Hai Nazdeek Woh Din Ke Maidan Mein
Bhare Ghar Ko Tanha Hi Rounga Main
Kabhi Mujh Pe Aati Na Mushkil Ghari
Agar Aaj Maa Hoti
<<DIVIDER>>
6
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaha To Ke Zainab Ne Aao Hussain
Gale Se Behen Ko Lagao Hussain
Chhupao Na Zainab Se Ranj-o-Alam
Jo Ahwaal-e-Dil Hai Sunao Hussain
Mujhe Hai Yaqeen Maa Bhi Karti Yahi
Agar Aaj Maa Hoti
<<DIVIDER>>
7

Pukari Jary Shah Se Woh Dil Hazeen
Tumhein Rota Main Dekh Sakti Nahi
Rahungi Sada Saath Maa Ki Tarah
Madina Ho Ya Karbala Ki Zameen
Qasam Tum Ko Meri Na Kehna Akhi
Agar Aaj Maa Hoti

items.title: Amma ke bina
items.body:
ek roz shahzadi ne asma se ye kaha
mai jaa rahi hoon hujre mein karne ko ab dua
awaaz gar na aaye mere shor o shain ki
bas ye samajhna mar gayi maadar hussain ki
bacche jo aaye laut ke tu pyar kijiyo
marne ka mere kuch bhi na izhaar kijiyo
alqissa band hogayi awaaz e shor o shain
asma pachadhe khaati thi aur kar rahi thi bain
itne mein aaye khelte ghar mein hasaan hussain

items.title: Bas Thodi Der Aur
items.body:
Jab ho chuke shaheed Shanshah e Karbala
Nanhi si ek yateema ka kurta bhi jal gaya
bacchi ko yaad baba ki jis dam rula gayi
Baaba.. Baba pukaarte hue maqtal mein aa gayi
Awaz di sakina s.a ko Maula Hussain ne
Ilayya Ilayya Sakina Sakina
Ye baba se ro kar pukari hazeena
Seene pe sona chahti hu mai baba
(Bas thodi der aur —2)
Kuch aaj zyada... thak si gayi hu mai baba
Seene pe sona chahti hu mai baba
(Bas thodi der aur —2)
1) Ye shaam e ghareeba hai baba
Ek zulm ka toofaan hai baaba
(Wehshat ka saamaa hai baba —2)
Jungle ke andhere, mein sehmi hu mai baaba
2) Kyu zaalim mujhko sataate hai
Kyu maarke mujhko rulaate hai
Daaman mein aag lagate hai 2—
Ab aapke paas, aake chupi hu mai baaba
3) Aagosh mein sab ke rehti thi
Ammu ke saaye mein palti thi
(Paidal bhi kaha mai chalti thi —2)
Haye daud ke kitna,Â aaj chali hu mai baba
4) Mujhko nahi apni pyaas ka gham
Tadpaata hai khaali ek alam
(Asghar ko lagaya teer e sitam —2)
Bhaiyya ko apne,dhundh rahi hu mai baba
5) Baaba chaadar bhi cheeni gai
Roti hai amma aur phuphi
Ab apna nahi monis koi 2—
Dekho kitni aafat mei padi hu mai baaba
6) Bhai hai kabse gash mein pade
Ab kaun hai sabke hai laashe
(Phir shimr kahi naa ajaaye —2)
Ye soch ke har dam, darti hu mai baba
7) Aye baba zara aankhe kholo
mein kab se bulaati hu bolo
(Sath apni sakina ke solo —2)
Phir kaise miloge, soch rahi hu mai baba
8) Ye Hashmi benno ki hai sada
Jaari rahe yunhi rasme aza
Usko hai Nigar apna pursa
Jo kehti rahi, naazo ki pali hu main Baba
Seene pe sona chaahti hu mai baba
(Bas thodi der aur —2)

items.title: Agar Hussain Ki Maa Agai Tuh Kiya Hoga
items.body:
Ya Hussain, Hussain Ya Hussain X4
Sawar Pusht Pay Qatil Gala Tahay Khanjar
Ghareeb e Zehra Pay Shimr Asah Zulm Na Kar
1. Bawaqt e Asr Musalsal Sada e Gaibi Thi
Zameen e Karbobala Had Hai Ye Shakawat Ki
Ye Jaan e Binte Pyamabar Hai Kiya Nahi Hai Kahbar
2. Sahar Se Asr Talak Har Sitam Rawa Dekha
Har Aik Sitam Pay Kiya Shay Nay Shukar Ka Sajda
Niga Ha Koi Na Hargis Uthai Ajj Bashar
3. Nabi K Deen Ko Khoon Dey K Paalnay Walay

items.title: Hussain Jaan
items.body:
Husaain jan husain jaan
Ye dilo jaa'n tujhpe feda husain husain jaan
Hoga yunhi zikr tera Husain Husain jaan
Bhulegi duniya na kbhi tera gham husain,
Teri musibat pe yuhi royenge ye nain
Tujhpe sitam jo hain hue Fatima k chain,
Yaad rakhega ye jaha'n shaahe mashraqain,
Jari rhegi ye wafa husain husain jaan
Ruk na sakegi ye aza husain husain jaan
Dil me basa sabke hai armane karbala
Sino me her ik k hai aiwane karbala
Itna karam humpe ho ae jaane karbala
Dekh le hum log bhi ab shane karbala
Humpe bhi ho itni ata Husain Husain jaan
Ishq ka kuch paye Sela Husain Husain jaan
Is dile gamkhwar ki hai arzu maula
Arbaee me ab k baras naam ho mera
Tay ho safar pa peyada karbobala ka,
Or mere lab pe ho faqat Haye husaina
Puri meri ho ye dua husain husain jaan
Ae shahe eesaro wafa husain husain jaan
Apke sadqe me Sela hum bhi ye payen
Deen ki raaaho me lahu apna bahayen
Shere jari ki tarah bazu ko katayen
Akbare Mahroo ki tarah bachiya khayen
Hausla qasim sa liye husain husain jaan
Walwala Asghar sa mile husain husain jaan
Zehnn se hatti nii karbal ki kahani
Haye tere bache ki wo tashnadahani
Kaise bhulaye ali akbar ki jawani
Lashe jari pe teri wo ashkfeshani
rahem jaha'n ne na kiya husain husain jaan
Krte rhe zulmo jafa husain husain jaan
Kaise raqam ho bhala soohail wo manzar
Jabke rage shaah pe tha shimr ka khanjar
deti thi Minhal sada roke ye Khwahar
Kaise bachau mai tumhe mere  baradar
Kaisi ye badli hai feza Husain Husain jaan
Koi nii sunta sada husain husain jaan

items.title: Jaa rahe hai karbala sarwar madina chod kar
items.body:
Bose gale ke jiske liye hai rasool ne.
Pala hai jis ko pees ke chakki batool ne.
Rehne diya na usko sitamgar ne chayn se.
Hota hai khaali aaj madeena husain se.
Ja rahe hai'n karbala sarwar madeena chhor kar.
Hai magar dushvar jeena maa'n ka roza chhor kar.
Sayyade abraar jate hai madeena chhor kar.
Jaanibe karbobala saaya watan ka chhor kar.
Ghutniyo ke bal husain aae hai ma ki qabr tak
Kis tarah uth paaenge ab qabre zehra chhor kar.
Qabre maadar se lipat kar ro ke kehte the husain.
Karbala jaata hu tera aasataana chhor kar.
Saaf kar dena zamee'n maqtal ki aakar karbala.
Jab mai apna sar kataane jaau khayma chhor kar
Teen din ki pyaas se sookha gala hoga mera.
Paani tu amma na peena mujko pyaasa chhor kar.
Sar mera kat jaae to le lena apni god me.
Dasht se jaana nahi mujko akela choor kar.
Karna saaya apne baalo'n se tu meri laash par
Dhoop me aada mera jaaenge laasha chhor kar.
Berida le jaaenge zainab ko aada shaam tak.
Dena tab pursa use mera janaaza chhor kar.
Qabr se aai sada zehra ki ay pyaare husain.
Kis tarah rah paaungi mai tuj ko tanha chhor kar.
Tu jaha'n hoga vaha'n yeh teri ma aajaayegi.
Saath tere mai bhi aaungi madeena chhor kar.
Tera sar kat'te hi mai le lunhi apni hod me.
Dhoop se kaise uthu mai tujko tanha chhor kar.
Baal bikhraye huve jaaungi mai zainab ke saath.
Dhoop me chalti rahungi mai bhi saaya chhor kar.
Ay mere pyare safar islaam ki khaatir karo.
Tum basaalo karbala shehre madeena chhor kar.
Alweda navshad maadar se kaha sheh ne waqaar.
Rote rote aagae ghar qabre zehra chhor kar.

items.title: Jhoola veeran hua
items.body:

jhoola veeran hua…

ab bhi khaabon mein mere hasta hua aata hai

meri aankhon ki ziya
mera asghar na raha
jhoola veeran hua…

aaja aghosh mein mai tujhko chupa loo beta
apne bahon mein tujhe jhoola jhulaun beta
ye sitam mujhpe hua
mera asghar na raha
jhoola veeran hua....

jab mai jaungi madine to kahoo kya dilbar
pooche gar sughra kahan hai mera bhaiya asghar
kya kahoo us se bhala
mera asghar na raha
jhoola veeran hua…

kaise manzar wo bhula payegi maadar beta
tere seene pe jo maara tha layeen ne naiza
zibha to laal hua
mera asghar na raha
jhoola veeran hua…

waada hai tujhse mera saaye mein na baithungi
gham mein ay laal tere har ghadi mai roungi
meri jaan tujhpe fida
mera asghar na raha
jhoola veeran hua…

darde dil uska bhala kaise ho ahmed se rakhm
na bhula payega mohsin ye jahan uska gham
thi ye ek maa ki sada
mera asghar na raha
jhoola veeran hua…

items.title: Kamar ko thaame
items.body:
kamar ko thaame chale hai maula
jawan bete ki laash uthaane
jahan pe zeen se gira tha beta
wahin pe khoon e jigar bahane
<<DIVIDER>>
badan mein raasha bala ki garmi
aur us pe ghalba hai tashnagi ka
zameen pe bikhre pade hai laashe
ajeeb aalam hai bekasi ka
kise pukaare kise bulaye
juda kiya sab ko hi qaza ne
kamar ko thaame...
<<DIVIDER>>
sujhaayi deta nahi hai kuch bhi
ke noor aankhon ka jaa chuka hai
har ek laashe se khaye thokar
koi dilaasa hai na asa hai
larazte qadmon se ja rahe hai
bas ek ahde wafa nibhaane
kamar ko thaame...
<<DIVIDER>>
kiya tha yaum e alast waada
mai ishq ka imtehan doonga
utha ke sadme luta ke kunba
mai apni sajde mein jaan doonga
tamaam ahle falak ne dekha
kaleje thaame hai ambiya ne
kamar ko thaame...
<<DIVIDER>>
na lab pe shikwa na bad'dua hai
magar hai aankhon mein ek samandar
zaeefi chalne se rokti hai
sambhalte jaate hai khaa ke thokar
koi to aaye madad ki khaatir
kiye hai ye bain karbala ne
kamar ko thaame...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghareeb e zehra ka hai ye nauha
kahan ho noor e nazar batao
mai kab se maqtal mein dhoondta hoo
padar ko awaaz to sunao
sada ye sun kar kiya hai nauha
har ek shaheed e rahe khuda ne
kamar ko thaame...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye din kisi ko na rab dikhaye
jawan ki mayyat padar uthaye
utha raha hai jo laashe akbar
hussain ka ye jigar hai haye
khaleel sabr e hussain dekhe
ke apne dil ka lahoo bahane
kamar ko thaame...
<<DIVIDER>>
badi qayamat ka hai ye manzar
bayan kaise karun mai safdar
lahoo qalam se tapak raha hai
ye baat kaise likhun mai mazhar
hai kaisa saabir ghareeb e zehra
ye sirf mera khuda hi jaane
kamar ko thaame...

items.title: Kehte hai nabi
items.body:
kehte hai nabi fatema zehra se tadap kar
ghar par malakul maut jo tayyar hai beti
ye tum se ijazat ta talabgaar hai beti
<<DIVIDER>>
maloom hai beti ke satayegi ye dunya
jab mai na rahunga to rulayegi ye dunya
afsos tere ghar ko jalayegi ye dunya
paaunga na ek lamha sukoon qabr ke andar
kehte hai nabi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek roz lehed mein hai har ek shaks ko sona
sab ke liye ye khaak ka hota hai bichona
deha nahi jaata hai ye beti tera rona
jaana hai bulaata hai mujhe khaaliq e akbar
kehte hai nabi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jitne ye munafiq hai bazaahir hai jo qadim
dukh denge bahot aur zara honge na naadim
darbar mein bulwayenge ek din tujhe zaalim
allah salamat rakhe beti teri chaadar
kehte hai nabi...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum honge na tum hogi na hyder hi rahenge
us waqt ajab chaal munafiq ye chalenge
beti tere shabbir ka ye qatl karenge
be-gor o kafan dhoop mein hoga tera dilbar
kehte hai nabi...
<<DIVIDER>>
zinda na bichad kar zara reh paogi beti
pehlu e shikasta liye tum aaogi beti
tum mujhse bahot jald hi mil jaogi beti
shabbir pe hum qabr mein royenge barabar
kehte hai nabi...
<<DIVIDER>>
beti ye hai khaaliq ki nazar mein teri azmat
dekhi nahi aisi malakul maut ki haalat
ye tera sharaf hai jo ye maangi hai ijazat
de do isay aane ki ijazat meri dukhtar
kehte hai nabi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte hai qamar deen ko allah bachaye
bas bakshish e ummat ki dua hont pe aaye
farzand mera amn o amaan deher mein laaye
ek roz zaroor aayega ghaibat se nikal kar
kehte hai nabi...

items.title: Aaj maqtal may
items.body:
aaj maqtal may ajab be saro samaan hai haram
dil hai majrooh khule sar hai pareshan hai haram
qatle shabbir se betaab hai girya hai haram
waarison may nahi ab koi to hairaan hai haram
zikre mazloomi shaahe madani karte hai
kabhi aahein to kabhi seena zani karte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime sab jal chuke hai loot chuke hai aada
farq par hai kisi bibi ke na maqna na rida
shaam hone ko hai sunsaan hai jangal saara
paas bacchon ko liye baithi hai binte zahra
pyar karti hai isay gah usay samjhati hai
koi masoom jo rota hai to behlati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ke farmati hai ye khwahare sultane anam
utho sajjad ki ab din hua jaata hai tamaam
jhat pata waqt hai kuch der may hone ko hai shaam
ab na qasim hai na abbas na akbar na imam
dil e paj murda pa ek gham ki ghata chaayi hai
raat hone ko hai aur aalame tanhaai hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kaan may pahunchi jo sajjad ke zainab ki sada
khol kar aankh ye ki arz basad aah o buka
kya kahun aap se qaabu may nahi dil mera
tap zyada hai to ghaflat bhi hai kuch aaj siwa
kaun maara gaya aur kaun juda hota hai
mujhko kuch hosh nahi hai ke ye kya hota hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bole fizza se ye phir abid e bemaar o hazeen
jitne bacche hai bula lo to unhe mere qareen
jamah fizza ne kiya bacchon ko la la ke wahin
par na do ladke thay aur ek sakina ghamgeen
dhoondne chaar taraf misle nazar jaati thi
un ke rone ki sada bhi na magar aati thi
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha abid ne ki ay khwahare sultane huda
laaiye sheh ne banayi hai jo farde shohda
dekh loo wo to mere dil ko tasalli ho zara
naam twhreer hai us fard may kiska kiska
jo gaye khuld me ab khwaab hai surat unki
jo mere saath hai laazim hai hifazat unki
<<DIVIDER>>
sun ke ye kehne lagi zainabe tafteeda jigar
le gaye loot ke asbaab to sab baani e shar
usi asbaab may wo fard bhi thi ay dilbar
sun ke kehne lage sajjad ye badeeda e tar
fikr kuch aur mai pabande alam kar loonga
qatl jo hogaye naam unke raqam kar loonga
<<DIVIDER>>
keh ke ye likhne lage khaak pe naam e shohda
yaad aaye jo wo sab karne lage aah o buka
dil pe ek teer laga naam jo asghar ka likha
ghame jaankah se tharra gaye saare aaza
yaad karte thay unhe jab to jigar jalta tha
teen bachon ka kahin par na pata chalta tha
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ke karne lagi sajjad se zainab ye kalaam
jaye tashveesh hai din koi ghadi may hai tamam
dhoondne bacchon ko jaati hoo ki ho jaye na shaam
do ijazat mujhe beta ke tumhi ab ho imam
raasta bhool gaye hai na idhar aayenge
dasht may jaa ke pukarungi to mil jayenge
<<DIVIDER>>
keh ke abid se chali khwahare sultane huda
aa zara saath mere mud ke ye fizza se kaha
wo bhi hamraah hui karti hui aah o buka
paon rakhti thi kahin aur kahin padta tha
jaa baja dasht may laashe jo nazar aate thay
dil dhadakta tha qadam khauf se tharrate thay
<<DIVIDER>>
aah thi lab pe rawan ishq thay aur dil tha fugaar
ek taraf ko ye chali jaati thi ba haalat e zaar
nagahan door se dikhlayi diya ek sawaar
boli fizza se ye zainab ke zara badh ke pukar
minnate uski karenge to taras khayega
us se bachon ka pata dasht may mil jayega
<<DIVIDER>>
hukm paana tha ki fizza ne ye di bad ke sada
ay sawaar is taraf aa is taraf aa behre khuda
koi takleef na denge tujhe hum iske siwa
hum gareebon ki hai ek arz usay sunta jaa
dil hai majrooh bahot roye jo hai bhai ko
tujhse kuch poochna hai fatema ki jaayi ko
<<DIVIDER>>
mutawaje hua wo sunte hi fizza ki sada
paas aakar kahan kya poochti hai ay dukhiya
boli ye khwahare shabbir ke ay mard e khuda
kisi bacche ko to dekha nahi tu ne ye bata
tashna lab hai watan awaara hai dikh paye hai
choot kar saath se jangal may chale aaye hai
<<DIVIDER>>
arz ki us ne jigar thaam ke ba-deeda e tar
abhi sehra may jo ek simt padi meri nazar
dekha ek laashe par khoon hai zameen par be-sar
ladki ek choti si baithi hui roti hai magar
wo bhi rota hai udhar jiska guzar hota hai
us ke naalon se ajab dil pe asar hota hai
<<DIVIDER>>
roke farmane lagi zainab e majrooh e jigar
meharbani ka sila de tujhe rabb e akbar
bas pata mil gaya ehsaan hua tera mujh par
kehke us simt chali girya kuna khaak e basar
ashk e khoon behte thay qaabu may dile zaar na tha
ek fizza ke siwa doosra ghamkhwar na tha
<<DIVIDER>>
pahunchi maqtal ki taraf dhoondti binte zehra
dekha us jaa pa hai ek noor se mamoor gadha
laash ek usme padi hai ke nahi sar jiska
aur sakina wahin baithi hui karti hai buka
ghash jo hoti hai maza maut ka mil jaata hai
chaunk padti hai to dil seene may hil jaata hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi nazdeek gharaz zainab e tafteeda jigar
baith kar le liya aaghosh may ba-deeda e tar
boli lipta ke kaleje se mai qurban tujh par
tu ne pehchan liya baap ka laasha kyun kar
hijr se maadar e nashaad hui jaati hai
bibi ab ghar may chalo raat hui jaati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
arz ki usne phuphi se ye basad aah o buka
furqate sheh may tadapne jo laga dil mera
aake is dasht may chillayi mai baba baba
ay phuphi mujhko isi laash se aayi ye sada
aayi hoo seena e shabbir pe sone ke liye
kaha zainab ne ke ab ghar chalo rone ke liye
<<DIVIDER>>
ye to behlati thi ro ro ke wo deti thi jawab
aatish e gham se wo nanha sa kaleja tha kabaab
godh may machli hua dil jo zyada betaab
pyaar karke use zainab ne ba chashme pur aab
li balaaein kabhi gah aankhon se aansu poche
khoon e sarwar se bhare jo thay wo gaysu poche
<<DIVIDER>>
dono bacchon ko chali dhoondne phir wo muztar
dekhti kya hai ke wo baaghe nabi ke gultar
nagahan jaa padi ek simt biyaban may nazar
baahein gerdan may hai aur so rahe hai rakhe sar
gard is tarah hai un chand se rukhsaron par
abr bareek ho jis tarah se sayyaron par
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi nazdeek jo roti to ye naksha dekha
mitti sarka ke wahan lete hai wo maahleqa
hont sookhe huwe thay pyaas jo thi had se siwa
jis jagah paa ke tari kuch ho kaleja thanda
baap ka seena nahi maa ki bhi aaghosh nahi
aise ghaafil hai ki tan ka bhi unhe hosh nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhte hi inhe bas baith gayi zainabe zaar
le ke dono ki balayein kiya phir khoob sa pyar
sar rakhe khaak se zaanu pe utha kar ek baar
boli ab ghar may chalo neend se ho kar hoshiyar
sard jangal ki hawa baaees aaram hui
dashte ghurbat may khabar bhi hai tumhe shaam hui
<<DIVIDER>>
neend se jab huwe hoshyaar na wo rashke qamar
dam na paaya to ye farmane lagi peet ke sar
jhuk ke phir ghaur se chehro pe ki zainab ne nazar
shayad in dono ka ab ho gaya dunya se safar
dashte ghurbat may kiya sab se kinara bachon
haye be maut tumhe pyaas ne maara bachon
<<DIVIDER>>
arz karne lagi zainab se ye fizza ghamgeen
bibi hae hae mere dil ko yehi hota hai yaqeen
loot kar qaimon ko jaane lagi jab fauje layeen
aagaye ghodo ke paon may ye khursheed e mubeen
haal inke jigar o qalb ko tadpaate hai
phool se jismon pe sab neel nazar aate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bas haseen rok qalam ab nahi taabe tehreer
dil may nashtar ki tarha chubte hai ab ranj ke teer
saaf har zakhm sada dete hai hae hae shabbir
kaisi bargasta hui ahle haram ki taqdeer
aasman gir na pada phat ke sitamgaron par
zulm kya kya na kiye fatema ke pyaron par

items.title: Abbas ka alam hai
items.body:
ooncha rahe ooncha rahe ghazi alam tera
har daur mein ooncha raha ghazi alam tera
<<DIVIDER>>
chauda sau baras se jhuk na saka

patke par raqam hai
abbas ka alam hai...

aa dekh zamane dekh zara

ghabrana nahi kahin jaana nahi

nisbat ka sharaf ya shaahe najaf

zainab ki azadari hai alam

deti hai sada ye sheh ki aza
rehbar jo alam hai

jab baarwa hyder aayega

ye manzar haan dekhega jahan
ooncha jo alam hai
abbas ka alam hai...

jab hashr ki dhoop mein pahunchenge
ghazi ka alam jab dekhenge
farhan aur mazhar keh denge
ab roz e qayamat ka hum ko
na darr hai na gham hai
abbas ka alam hai...

items.title: Alamdar
items.body:
alamdar alamdar abbas e alamdar

koi shabbir ke lashkar mein nahi tha aisa
ye kis ki nazar kha gayi jarraar na aamad
alamdar na aamad alamdar na aamad
saqqa e haram...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ki umeed pe pardon ki zamanat li thi
jab ye zainab ne kaha maara gaya wo ghazi
khud ba khud sar se sarakne lagi chadar sab ki
ay bibiyon chadar ka nigehdaar na aamad
alamdar na aamad alamdar na aamad

<<DIVIDER>>
goonji qaimon mein ye awaaz dil e zahra ki
ae behan mar gaya battees baras ka bhai
yaad baba ki jab aayegi kise dekhogi
darya se rukhe hyder e karrar na aamad
alamdar na aamad alamdar na aamad
saqqa e haram...
<<DIVIDER>>
raah mein gir ke kuchal jayega naaqe se koi
taaziyane koi khayega tamache koi
ab nahi aayega durron se bachane koi
jo karta tha bachon se bohat pyar na aamad
alamdar na aamad alamdar na aamad
saqqa e haram...
<<DIVIDER>>
saamne pani tha lekin na piya us ko khayal aata raha
ke abhi qaimon mein sab bacche hai pyase
pani jab le ke chala teer chale mashk chidi gir gaya parcham

wo pyasa wo pyason ka wafadaar na aamad

jab bhi bulwaya hai ghazi ne karam farma kar

roz e ashoor talak roz haram mein jaa kar

items.title: Amma kise bulaye
items.body:

amma kise bulaye hussain

mehmab bula ke ummat ne dil ka sukoon loota hai
naiza sitam ka ay amma seene mein mere toota hai
toofan aasuon ka hai saahil bhi mujhse rootha hai
akbar asghar qasim ghazi saare chale gaye
amma kise bulaye hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
maanga duaon mein jisko usko bhi kho chuka hoo mai

akbar asghar qasim ghazi saare chale gaye
amma kise bulaye hussain...

qaime mein jhoola rota hai rota hai qalb maadar ka
tadpa hai mere haathon par nanha sa laasha asghar ka
ye aakhri sipaahi tha ay amma mere lashkar ka
akbar asghar qasim ghazi saare chale gaye
amma kise bulaye hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyason ki pyaas par amma qurban hogaya ghazi
ek mashk par fida ho kar bejaan hogaya ghazi
amma wafa ki dunya ka quran hogaya ghazi
akbar asghar qasim ghazi saare chale gaye
amma kise bulaye hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ansaar o aqroba mere sar ko kata ke sote hai
pardesiyon pe ay amma kya aise zulm hote hai
dekho hussain ki ghurbat sab zakhm dil ke rote hai
akbar asghar qasim ghazi saare chale gaye
amma kise bulaye hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
bete ki guftagu sun kar royi rasool ki beti
jalti zameen pe baith kar boli rasool ki beti
mai tere saath hoo beta yani rasool ki beti
aaja meri godh mein aaja qurban ho ye maa
aaja mere hussain aaja...
<<DIVIDER>>
har imtehan mein beta mai tujhko hausla doongi
zakhmon pe tere ashkon ka marham bhi mai laga doongi
in zaalimon ki nazaron se aaja tujhe bachaungi
aaja meri godh mein aaja qurban ho ye maa
aaja mere hussain aaja...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghode ke zeen se maula jis dam zameen par aaye
gham se kaleja thaam kar zehra pukaar uthi haye
phaila ke apne haathon ko jhoola bana liya haye
aaja meri godh mein aaja qurban ho ye maa
aaja mere hussain aaja...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai shadman ke lab par nauha janabe zehra ka
maqtal ne is riwayat ko kuch is tarha se likha tha
khud mazhar abidi jisko nauhe mein dhaal kar roya
aaja meri godh mein aaja qurban ho ye maa
aaja mere hussain aaja...

items.title: Awaaz do ali akbar
items.body:
aina aina ali akbar
haye akbar haye akbar
ay naujawan ay naujawan
<<DIVIDER>>
awaaz do ay ali akbar awaaz do
<<DIVIDER>>
jaati hai meri jaan
maqtal mein hai dhuaan
beta ho tum kahan
<<DIVIDER>>
maara hai kis tarha se tumhe sochta hoon mai
patthar hata hata ke tumhe dhoondta hoon mai
chaaron taraf hai khoon milta nahi sukoon
laashon ke darmiyan
awaaz do ay ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch bhi dikhayi deta nahi mai ghareeb hoon
khushboo se lag raha hai tumhare khareeb hoon
ay mere dil ke chain baba ke noore ain
ab lo na imtehan
awaaz do ay ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
maine suna hai ghode se tum khud nahi gire
ay mere laal baalon se khayncha gaya tumhe
tum ho yahin kahin kyun bolte nahi
khamosh hai zuban
awaaz do ay ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise gire ho mujhko batao to zeen se
lagta hai tumne khaayi hai barchi layeen se
chehra bhi zard hai seene mein dard hai
kuch to karo bayan
awaaz do ay ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein aate aate bhi maara gaya mujhe
dooba hua hoon khoon mein patthar ke zakhm se
zakhmi hai ye jigar dekho mere pisar
chehre pe hai nishan
awaaz do ay ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
himmat karo zara si kaleje ko thaam kar
hai waqte asr jaago mere naujawan pisar
laila ki aas hai zainab udaas hai
do aakhri azaan
awaaz do ay ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum khud ali ho beta zara hausla karo
badhne laga hai dard to nade ali padho
aankhein hai meri nam sughra ki hai qasam
ragdo na aediyan
awaaz do ay ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
do maa'on ne jawan kiya tum ko paal kar
qaimon mein jaa ke kaise milaunga mai nazar
mai unse kya kahun behta hai tera khoon
kaise sahegi maa
awaaz do ay ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
azlaan ro ke kehta raha ye mera imam
beta hamare haal pe hasti hai fauje shaam
dhundhla hai sab jahan hai surkh aasman
chalti hai aandhiyan
awaaz do ay ali akbar...

items.body:
ay sheh ke alamdar, ay sheh ke alamdar alamdar

ay sheh ke alamdar...

hoti hoo dilafgaar, ay sheh ke alamdar alamdar
ay sheh ke alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
amma ka chaman ujda pardes mein ay bhaiya
mai dasht mein tanha hai char taraf aada
mar jaye na bemaar, ay sheh ke alamdar alamdar
ay sheh ke alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
masoom sakina hai garmi ka mahina hai
do boondh nahi pani hone ko hai zindani
mehshar ke hai aasaar, ay sheh ke alamdar alamdar
ay sheh ke alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jhoole mein nahi asghar lori de kise maadar
darwaza e qaima par kehti hai wo ro ro kar
mai kisko karoo pyar, ay sheh ke alamdar alamdar
ay sheh ke alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bachon ko hoo mai royi keh sakta nahi koi
wo bhai ka sadqa thay bas is liye zinda thay
kya unse saropaar, ay sheh ke alamdar alamdar
ay sheh ke alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaati hoo sare zindaan ay bhaai sare uriyan
bazu hai rasan basta purkhaar bahot rasta
nazron mein hai darbaar, ay sheh ke alamdar alamdar
ay sheh ke alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ne sina khaayi mujko na ajal aayi
seena hua do-paara naizo se usay maara
mai uski hoo ghamkhaar, ay sheh ke alamdar alamdar
ay sheh ke alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai laut ke aaungi marqad bhi banaungi
mai doongi kafan tujko mohlat de ajal mujko
ay mere wafadaar, ay sheh ke alamdar alamdar
ay sheh ke alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan kalam roya jab lik chuka ye nowha
majlis mein hua matam jab aaya tera parcham
rote thay azadaar, ay sheh ke alamdar alamdar
ay sheh ke alamdar...

khaake naiza zameen par gira hoo

tha ye izhaar nauha jawan ka

qadam ko aage badhaya kabhi gaye peeche

<<DIVIDER>>
kaleja phat'ta hai rehan aur khadim ka

basar ho maahe aza...

items.title: Ghar se nikal raha
items.body:
ghar se nikal raha hai janaza batool ka
girya kuna hai saara gharana batool ka

baad e rasool itne masayib huwe nuzool

darwaza e ali ko adoo ne jala diya

<<DIVIDER>>
ek jiska koi marta hai to rota hai wo shaks
lutgaya sab mera gha rbaar mujhe rone do
kehte thay abide bemaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jinko taqdeer hasaati hai wo haste bhi hai
mujhko rona hai sada baar mujhe rone do
kehte thay abide bemaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi baaqi nahi shabbir ka rone waala
hoo mai bekas ka azadar mujhe rone do
kehte thay abide bemaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaah e deen chod gaye hai mujhe rone ke liye
koi baaqi nahi ghamkhaar mujhe rone do
kehte thay abide bemaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zabt karta hoo to shaukat mera dil ketha hai
hoo bahattar ka azadar mujhe rone do
kehte thay abide bemaar...
items.author: Shaukath

items.title: Lashay Uthanay Walay Ka Laasha
items.body:
Laashe Uthane Wale Ka Laasha Na Uth Saka
Aise Gira Zameen Pe Pyaasa Na Uth Saka
<<DIVIDER>>
Maa Rokti Hi Reh Gai Khanjar Ruka Nahi
Sar Kaat Kay Hussain (as) Ka Jab Le Gaya Laeen
Gardan Se Maa Ne Hath Uthaya Na Uth Saka
<<DIVIDER>>
Beti Ghareeb Baap Ke Laashe Se Jab Milli
Shaana Hilla Hilla Ke Utha Ti Hi Reh Gayi
Haye Magar Sakina (sa) Se Baba Na Uth Saka
<<DIVIDER>>
Bete Ko Maa Ki Gowd Mei Aisa Sukoon Milla
Usko Khabar Hi Na Huwi Khanjar Kab Chala
Thak Kar Hussain (as) Ghum Se Jo Soya Na Uth Sakka
<<DIVIDER>>
Tooti Sinna Jawaan Ke Sinne Se Khench Kar
Bete Ki Laash Baap Se Uth Tho Gayi Magar
Ulja Huwa Sinna Mei Kaleja Na Uth Saka
<<DIVIDER>>
Asghar (as) Ko Jab Lehad Mei Utaara Hussain Ne
Phir Se Galle Lagana Jo Chaaha Hussain (as) Ne
Che Maa Ka Hussain (as) Se Bacha Na Uth Saka
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas (as) Aur Hussain (as) Ki Ghurbat Ka Woh Safar
Bhai Tarapta Reh Gaya Bhai Ki Laash Par
Tooti Huwi Kamar Thi Janaza Na Uth Saka
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindaan e Shaam Touq Wo Zanjeer Beriyan
Mushkil Mei Saath Dene Challi Aayi Bibiya
Abid (as) Se Jab Sakina (sa) Ka Laasha Na Uth sakka
<<DIVIDER>>
Zeeshan O Fatemah Wo Chali Jab Suey Watan
Khoon e Hussain (as) Dekh Kay Roti Rahi Behan
Zainab (sa) Se Apne Bhai Ka Kurta Na Uth Saka

items.title: Mai safeere hussain
items.body:
muslim e aqeel hoon safeer e hussain hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
baatil ka khauf e haq se kaleja laraz utha
bas ek sada se haakim e kufa laraz utha
ehsaas e qalb e haq hoon zameer e hussain hoon
mai aashiq e ali hoon asseer e hussain hoon
zainab ka intekhab musheer e hussain hoon
pehchaan lo mujhko mai safeer e hussain hoon
mai safeer e hussain hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
muslim e aqeel hoon mai jaan le jahan
ashjaul arab kahe zameen o aasman
hashmi wirasaton se azm hai jawan
hyderi shuja'atein lahoon mein hai rawan
mai waqt ka hisaar hoon
mai noor ki bahaar hoon
zameen ka ikhtetaar hoon
falak ka iftekhar hoon
mai ishq ka sheaar hoon
wafa ka aetbaar hoon
dua ka ikhteyar hoon
mai sheh ka jaan nisar hoon
mai safeer e hussain hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
aetmaad rakta hai ali ka noor e ain
ki mujhe imam ne siparaton ki zain
sar pe hai mere dua e shaah e mashraqain
mai akela zaat mai hoon lashkar e hussain
mai hausle ki jast hoon
wafa e haq parast hoon
maye wila se mast hoon
mai deen ka bandobast hoon
mai aetebaar e hast hoon
mai har hisaar e dast hoon
mai kufa e zameer mein
yazeed ki shikast hoon
mai safeer e hussain hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ghulame shaahe deen haq batayega
sheh ka saath dega jo falaah payega
jang jo karega mujhse maat khayega
taygh se meri na koi bach ke jayega
mai daur e inqelaab hoon
mai taygh ka shabab hoon
mai nusraton ka khwab hoon
mai khoon ka hisaab hoon
mai ilm ki kitaab hoon
mai jehl par azaab hoon
hussain ki haseen sifaraton ka intekhab hoon
mai safeer e hussain hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa raha hoon choom kar qadam imam ka
haat mein baland hai alam imam ka
leke aa raha hoon mai bharam imam ka
kufiyon pata hai tum ko gham imam ka
zindagi hai tashna kaam
din ka kab hai ehteram
qatl o khoon hai aaj aam
mushkilon mein hai imam
chod kar wafa awaam
khwahishon ki hai ghulam
jo bhi hai mera kalaam
hai hussain ka payam
mai safeer e hussain hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghaibate imam mein ho aisa intezar
ilm par yaqeen ho amal pe aetebaar
nasiran e haq ka phir se hona hai shumaar
muntakhib safeer hoga kaun ab ki baar
agar ho saum aur salaat
hajj o khums aur zakat
amr aur nahi ki deen e haq mein saari mumkinaat
ho hussain hi hussain
bhool jaaye apni zaat
deen pe yun amal kare
to keh sake ye hum ye baat
mai safeer e hussain hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
muslim e ghareeb ne kiya hai jab kalaam
marte dam naseeb ho ziyarat e imam
karbala uthi kiya hawaon par qayam
dekh kar hussain ko kaha hai as-salam
as salamo alaika ya aba abdillah
as salamo alaika yabna rasoolillah
<<DIVIDER>>
choor choor jism hai jigar hai paash paash
hai kahan pisar mere kahan karun talaash
qatl kar ke le chale hai mujhko bad-khamash
maut ke bhi baad hai safar mein meri laash
mai safeer e hussain hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
nazim aur razi ki tarz sab se hai juda
jaffar aur baksh bhai aur ali zia
javedan hai lehja ab bhi sachey bhai ka
hum hai tifle maktab aur ye asaateza
ye hai aza ka kaarwan
ye hai lehen ki kehkeshan
ye lehja o khayal mein ghame hussain ki azan
ye karbala ki dastaan
yeh zikr sheh ka sayeban
azeem hai jo nauhakhwan unhi ka hoon mai tarjuma
mai safeer e hussain hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
rizwan farhan sab hai nauha gar
nasir o shujah aur ali safdar
shadman shahid o nadeem sarwar
sab ke sab ki ek hi sada hai ye qamar
mai hoon aza ke paksh par
mai hoon dilon ke arsh par
mai majlison mein nauha gar
majlis aur juloos mein hoon jalwa gar
gali gali nagar nagar
mai aansuon ka hamsafar
mai poori kayenat mein hussain ka payaam bar
mai safeer e hussain hoon...
items.author: Qamar Hasnain

items.title: Aaj shabbir pe kya
items.body:
aaj shabbir pe kya aalam e tanhaai hai
zulm ki chaand pe zehra ke ghata chaayi hai
us taraf lashkar e aada mein saf aarayi hai
yan na beta na bhatija na koi bhai hai
barchiyan khaate chale jaate hai talwaron mein
maar lo pyase ko hai shor sitamgaaron mein
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmi baazu hai kamar kham hai badan mein nahi taab
dagmagate hai nikal jaati hai qadmon se rakaab
pyaas ka ghalba hai lab khushk hai aankhein pur aab
taygh se dete hai har waar ka aada ko jawab
shiddat e zaof mein jis jaa pe teher jaate hai
saikdon teer e sitam tan se guzar jaate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
gaysu aalooda khoon lipte hai rukhsaaron se
shaane kat kat ke latak aaye hai talwaron se
teer payvast hai khoon behta hai sofaaron se
laakh aafat mein hai ek jaan dil aazaaron se
fikr hai sajda e mabood mein sar dene ki
waar se tayghon ke fursat nahi dam lene ki
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon se tar pech amaame ke hai sar zakhmi hai
hai jabeen chaand si pur noor magar zakhmi hai
seena sab barchiyon se taaba kamar zakhmi hai
teer e beedaad se dil zakhmi jigar zakhmi hai
zarb e shamsheer se bekaar hai baazu dono
zulm ke teeron se majrooh hai pehlu dono
<<DIVIDER>>
barchi aa kar koi pehlu mein laga jaata hai
maarta hai koi naiza to ghash aa jaata hai
badte hai zakhm e badan zor ghata jaata hai
band aankhein hai sar e paak jhuka jaata hai
gird zahra o ali girya kuna phirte hai
ghul hai ghode se imame do jahan girte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
girte hai khatra e khoon zakhm e jabeen se paiham
daste majrooh se khaynch sakte nahi teer e sitam
fikr hai bakshish e ummat ki kuch apna nahi gham
karte hai shukre khuda khushk zuban se har dam
hai abaa teeron se ghurban qaba gulgoon hai
honth ya waqt se zakhmi hai dahan par khoon hai
<<DIVIDER>>
zeen se hota hai juda doshe mohamed ka makeen
chaman e fatema ka sard hai maa'il ba zameen
barchiyan gird hai beech mein hai sarwar e deen
hai ye nazdeek gire mehre nabuwat ka nageen
paon har baar raqabon se nikal jaate hai
ya ali kehti hai zainab to sambhal jaate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
laakh talwaarein hai aur ek tan e athar hai
ek mazloom hai aur zaalimon ka lashkar hai
saykdon khanjar e faulaad hai aur ek sar hai
na koi yaar na humdam na koi yawar hai
baag ghode ki latakti hai utha sakte nahi
saamne ahle haram rote hai jaa sakte nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
koi syed ka nahi aah bachane waala
harbe laakhon hai aur ek zakhm uthane waala
pyaas mein koi nahi pani pilaane waala
sambhle kis tarha bhala barchiyan khaane waala
charkh se aag barasti hai zameen jalti hai
maare garmi ke zuban khushk hai loo chalti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kahin dam lene ko saaya nahi hai waqt e zawaal
aenthi jaati hai zuban pyaas ki shiddat hai kamaal
kabhi zainab ka hai ghamgaah sakina ka khayaal
din jo dhalta hai to hazrat huwe jaate hai nidhaal
misle khursheed badan zauf se thar tharata hai
nayyar e burj e imamat pe zawaal aata hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte hai zaalimon se khushk zuban dikhla kar
behre haq pani ka ek jaam pila do laa kar
ahle keen kehte hai tayghe sitam chamka kar
aab e shamsheer piyo barchiyon ke phal kha kar
ye sukhan sun ke bhi ghussa nahi farmate hai
yaas se suye falak dekh ke reh jaate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
arz karte hai ye khaaliq se ke ay lab e ghafoor
tu hai aalam ke nahi kuch tere bande ka kasoor
karte hai ye mujhe be-jurm o khata tayghon se choor
haath ummat pe uthaana ko nahi mujhko manzoor
jaante hai ke mohammed ka nawasa hoo mai
pani dete nahi do roz ka pyaasa hoo mai
<<DIVIDER>>
tu ne bachpan se mere naaz uthaye ya rab
wo inayat kya jo tujhse kiya maine talab
tera mehboob bana eid ko mera murakkab
roza rakha to chupa mehr numaya hui shab
bhook mein khuld ka khana mujhe imdaad kiya
bhej kar hirni ka baccha mera dil shaad kiya
<<DIVIDER>>
ab agar hai ye teri maslehat ay rab e qadeer
ho rawan halq pe is pyaase ke aab e shamsheer
mere maula ba-sar o chashm hai haazir shabbir
hukme haakim mein ye taaqat hai karun mai taakheer
jald gardan pe rawan khanjar e baraa howe
ay khushaa wo jo teri raah mein qurban howe
<<DIVIDER>>
gham nahi kuch mujhe go bekas o beyaar hoo mai
zer e shamsheer gala rakhne ko tayyar hoo mai
tu madadgaar hai mukhtar hai lachaar hoo mai
waqte mushkil hai inayat ka talabgaar hoo mai
tere sajde mein ye sar tan se juda ho jawe
ehd e tifli ka jo waada hai wafa ho jawe
<<DIVIDER>>
sakhtiyan marg ki kar apne karam se aasan
lab pe takbeer ho jab khalq pe khanjar ho rawan
dil mein ho yaad teri band ho jis waqt zuban
dam bharun tera hi tan se jo nikalne lage jaan
baad e chehlum jo mujhe qabr mayassar howe
zakhmi tan par na fishaar ay mere daawar howe
<<DIVIDER>>
rehm kar rehm kar sharminda hoo ay yaar e khuda
bandagi ka tere jo haq tha ada ho na saka
khauf e mahshar se badan kaampta hai sar tapa
hogi aamaal ki pursish to kahunga mai kya
koi tohfa tere laayiq nahi paata hai hussain
haath khaali tere darbar mein aata hai hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
taqwiat dil ko karam se hai tere ya rahman
nahi mayoos ke rehmat hai teri be-paayan
mushkilein bando ki kar deta hai dam mein aasaan
shukr altaaf o inayaat mein qaasir hai zuban
aasiyon se bhi mohabbat nahi kam karta hai
jurm wo karte hai tu lutf o karam karta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mai teri raah mein mazloomi se hota hoo fida
tu hai aagaah ke do din ka hoo bhooka pyasa
chahta hoo mai yehi apni shahadat ka sila
maghfirat ummat e aasi ki ho ay baar e khuda
hai gawara mujhe jo kuch ke aziyyat howe
unko dunya mein bhi aakhirat mein bhi raahat howe
items.author: Mir Anees

items.title: Aao ro lein
items.body:
aao ro lein shahe karbala ko
zindagi ka bharosa nahi hai
jo bhi girta hai is gham mein aansu
koi bekaar jaata nahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
chand maahe aza ka jo nikla
dekh kar ro padi binte zahra
baad is chand ke zindagi mein
koi lamha khushi ka nahi hai
aao ro lein...
<<DIVIDER>>
chand badli mein chup jaa tu jaake
na khabar de moharram ki aake
jab se dekha hai tujhko falak par
mera sajjad sota nahi hai
aao ro lein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab jale honge qaime haram ke
jab chini hongi sar se ridayein
guzri hogi kya saydaniyon par
wo samaa dil se jaata nahi hai
aao ro lein...
<<DIVIDER>>
teer itne lage hai badan mein
bhai mera tadapta hai ran mein
dekh kar mere bhaiya ki haalat
mera dam kyun nikalta nahi hai
aao ro lein...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala mein jo jayegi zainab
kya batayegi bhai ko zainab
chutt ke zindan se jo aa rahe hai
un mein pyari sakina nahi hai
aao ro lein...
<<DIVIDER>>
behre ta'zeem utho ay akbar
parda daari karo mere dilbar
aa rahi hai sawari phupi ki
jis ka koi sahara nahi hai
aao ro lein...
<<DIVIDER>>
mar gaye mere saare dulaare
kaun mehmil se mujhko utaare
amma fizza do aake sahara
paas abbas mera nahi hai
aao ro lein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab madine mein jayegi zainab
kya batayegi sughra ko zainab
wo nishan e rasan baazuon par
neel ab tak bhi choota nahi hai
aao ro lein...

items.title: Abbas ka gham
items.body:
abbas ka gham hum karte hai
hum apna lahoo zam karte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
darya pe gaya laane pani
nazron mein sakina thi pyasi
abbas e dilawar sher e jari
oonchayi pe parcham karte hai
abbas ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai sher tarayi par biphra
ghazi ko koi kya rokega
darya pe wo qabza kar ke kaha
jo chahenge wo hum karte hai
abbas ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
mashkeeza chida tooti hai aas
pani nahi pahuncha hai ehsaas
sharminda bhatiji se abbas
ehsaas ye paiham karte hai
abbas ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghode se gira abbas e jari
aaqa lo khabar aakar uski
sheh bole kamar tooti meri
sheh rote hai matam karte hai
abbas ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime mein alam laaye sarwar
sab bibiyan kehti hai ro kar
ab zulm o sitam honge hum par
saqqe ka sabhi gham karte hai
abbas ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaya hai alam ammu hai kahan
maangungi na pani aao yahan
lab par ye sakina ki hai fughan
shikwa na yahan hum karte hai
abbas ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
chauda sau baras ke baad abhi
lagta ha ke gham kul hai yehi
rote hai malayek aur nabi
har aankh wo pur nam karte hai
abbas ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho to zara matam ka asar
har saal se hota hai bad kar
yaad aata hai karbal ka manzar
matam na kabhi kam karte hai
abbas ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai aap ke baad ye haal chacha
durre wo tamachon ka lagna
ro ro ke sakina ne ye kaha
is tarha basar hum karte hai
abbas ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ke ay matamdaron
kismat pe sabhi tum naaz karo
sab mil ke raza awaaz ye do
maula tera matam karte hai
abbas ka gham...
items.author: Raza

items.title: Agaya mahe moharam
items.body:
ay azadaron sheh ke pursadaron
<<DIVIDER>>
aagaya maahe moharram aao tayyari karein
karbala waale shaheedon se wafadari karein
<<DIVIDER>>
royein zainab ki rida ko gham kare shabbir ka
mil ke sab aale mohamed ki azadari karein
aagaya maahe moharram...
<<DIVIDER>>
farsh hum dil mein bicha ke matami mil kar sabhi
majlis e shabbir barpa zindagi saari karein
aagaya maahe moharram...
<<DIVIDER>>
matame shaahe saheedan kar ke sab ahle aza
sog mein ibne ali ke girya o zaari karein
aagaya maahe moharram...
<<DIVIDER>>
kar ke izhaar e aqeedat fatema ke laal se
ehtemam e zuljanah o taziyadari karein
aagaya maahe moharram...
<<DIVIDER>>
kar ke matam sheh ka de ke ya hussaina ki sada
gham ali ke laal ka kayenat par taari karein
aagaya maahe moharram...
<<DIVIDER>>
maalik e kausar labe darya huwe pyase shaheed
naam par unke sabeelein hum sada jaari karein
aagaya maahe moharram...
<<DIVIDER>>
matam e shabbir hai jawad saaman e shifa
jo bhi dushman hai azaa ke unse bezaari karein
aagaya maahe moharram...
items.author: Jawad Jaffri

items.title: Alamdar kahan ho
items.body:
alamdar kahan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ki buka thi mere ghamkhwar kahan ho
alamdar kahan ho alamdar alamdar alamdar kahan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor gaya aayi hai ab gyara moharram
naaqe pe rasan basta suye shaam chale hum
hai aale nabi gham mein giraftaar kahan ho
alamdar kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab ghar se chali tum ne amari mein bithaya
bazaar karo band ye aelaan karaya
mai jaati hoo ab shaam ke bazaar kahan ho
alamdar kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
maloom hai tujhko ye bada sakht safar hai
unnees maqamaat se zainab ka guzar hai
har gaam wahan honge sitamgaar kahan ho
alamdar kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo dekho barasne lage sadaat pe pathar
jab rote hai sadaat to haste hai sitamgar
hai aale nabi bekas o lachaar kahan ho
alamdar kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
lamhon ki musafat hui sadiyon ke barabar
darwaza e sa'ad pe khade hum hai khule sar
awaaz tumhe deta hai bemaar kahan ho
alamdar kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
khamosh hai sab haakim e badkaar ke darr se
gustakhi layeen karta hai sahbbir ke sar se
ay baazu e shabbir wafadaar kahan ho
alamdar kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
faryad thi zainab ki yehi safdar o mazhar
kis tarha bayan hoga wo darbar ka manzar
aao mere parde ke nigehdaar kahan ho
alamdar kahan ho...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Amma lahoo luhan
items.body:
amma haye amma
<<DIVIDER>>
jaane laga watan se jo kunba hussain ka
nana ki qabr se huwe rukhsat shaahe huda
bhai ki qabr pe padha bhai ne marsiya
wan se hua jo turbate zahra ka saamna
maa ki lehad pe chal ke gaye ghutniyo hussain
lipte hai maa ki qabr se karte huwe ye bain
<<DIVIDER>>
amma haye amma amma haye amma
amma lahoo luhaan chaman dekhne chalo
zainab ke baazuon mein rasan dekhne chalo
<<DIVIDER>>
jis mein mai apne godh ke paalon ko ro'unga
aur khud bhi sar kata ke mai jis ban mein so’unga
amma hamare saath wo ban dekhne chalo
zainab ke baazuon mein...
amma lahoo luhaan chaman...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim ko mere aise karenge wo payemal
tukdon mein leke aayega chaadar mein tera laal
amma wo laashe ibne hassan dekhne chalo
zainab ke baazuon mein...
amma lahoo luhaan chaman...
<<DIVIDER>>
naiza jahan lagega mere naujawan ko
teer e sitam lagega jahan bezaban ko
rakh kar ke haath dil pe wo ran dekhne chalo
zainab ke baazuon mein...
amma lahoo luhaan chaman...
<<DIVIDER>>
khud aap jis ke naaz uthaati thi raat din
pani ka jaam laa ke pilaati thi raat din
karbal mein usko tashna dahan dekhne chalo
zainab ke baazuon mein...
amma lahoo luhaan chaman...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghode pe jab sambhal na sakega tera hussain
zakhmon se choor ho ke girega tera hussain
teeron pe apne laal ka tan dekhne chalo
zainab ke baazuon mein...
amma lahoo luhaan chaman...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaalim tere hussain pe dhayenge sakhtiyan
amma ye tod daalenge meri bhi phasliyan
tukdon mein mera saara badan dekhne chalo
zainab ke baazuon mein...
amma lahoo luhaan chaman...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro kar ali ye shaah ne ki maa se iltejaa
ud ud ke mere sogh mein wo khaake karbala
kaise banegi mera kafan dekhne chalo
zainab ke baazuon mein...
amma lahoo luhaan chaman...
<<DIVIDER>>
amma haye amma
amma meri amma
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon mein aa ke aag lagayenge ashqiya
qaidi meri behan ko banayenge ashqiya
zainab ko mere baad satayenge ashqiya
chadar bhi cheen lenge rulayenge ashqiya
zaalim nabi ki aal ko dar dar phirayenge
paidal chala ke shaam talak le ke jayenge
<<DIVIDER>>
amma lahoo luhaan chaman dekhne chalo
zainab ke baazuon mein rasan dekhne chalo
items.author: Ali Mohd. Sultanpuri

items.title: Ay shehre madina
items.body:
kya tujhse kahe haal e safar zainabe muztar
ay shehr-e-madina
laut aayi hoo mai apne bhare ghar ko luta kar
ay shehr-e-madina
<<DIVIDER>>
athara baras naazon se maine jise paala
wo gaysuon wala
dunya se gaya seene pa phal barchi ka khakar
ay shehr-e-madina
kya tujhse kahe…
<<DIVIDER>>
darwaze pe qaime ke mai majboor khadi thi
aur dekh rahi thi
jab sibte payambar ke galay par chala khanjar
ay shehr-e-madina
kya tujhse kahe…
<<DIVIDER>>
thay shah jise pyar se seene pa sulaate
aur naaz uthaate
zindan ke andhere mein usay aayi hoo khokar
ay shehr-e-madina
kya tujhse kahe…

bache hi nahi saath mai kis tarha se jaaun

ghar dekhungi jab khaali to sabr aayega kyunkar
ay shehr-e-madina
kya tujhse kahe…

dil tham ke rote thay saeed ahle madina

ay shehr-e-madina
kya tujhse kahe…

items.title: Baba ko la rahe
items.body:
uneesvi ki subha wo mehshar bapa hua
aati thi aasman se jibreel ki sada
masjid mein mustafa ka wasi qatl hogaya
<<DIVIDER>>
daude saron ko peet'te sibtain e mustafa
dekha ki khoon mein lot'te hai shaahe mashraqain
lipta ke apne seene se roye ba-shor o shain
pehle namaziyon ko padayi namaz phir
masjid se leke baba ko nikle hassan hussain
koi zainab ko thaam le jaa kar
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar mein baba ko laa rahe hai hussain
hoga barpa abhi yahan mehshar
<<DIVIDER>>
gham mein baba ke ro rahi hogi
hosh apne wo kho rahi hogi
haye aa jaaye na wo deodi par
ghar mein baba ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
arsh waale pachade khaate hai
chand taare bhi thar'tharate hai
subha aayi hai aaj nauha gar
ghar mein baba ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil pe sadme sabhi uthalunga
kaise zainab ko mai sambhalunga
sochte jaa rahe hai ye shabbar
ghar mein baba ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyar karne ko nana jaan nahi
haye amma ka sayeban nahi
kaun dhaaras bandhayega bad kar
ghar mein baba ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
taygh zaalim ne aisi maari hai
zakhm sar ka bahot hi kaari hai
koi jaa kar bicha de ek chadar
ghar mein baba ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhm sar ka na dekh payegi
wo pachaade zaroor khayegi
kaise samjhayenge usay jaa kar
ghar mein baba ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
raah mein khoon tapakta jaata hai
aur amaama latakta jaata hai
kaise thaame do paara sar sarwar
ghar mein baba ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
betiyon ki ajeeb hai fitrat
hoti hai baap se badi ulfat
koi ehwaal keh na de jaa kar
ghar mein baba ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
dar pe aaye junhi shahe waala
ainee kohraam hogaya barpa
koi aamir ye kehta tha ro kar
ghar mein baba ko...
items.author: Ainee Rizvi

items.title: Bikherti hui raahon
items.body:
milta nahi tha koi sahara yazeed ko
zainab ne is tarha se ujaada yazeed ko
khatoon jang kar nahi sakti thi is liye
khutbon ki zulfiqar se maara yazeed ko
<<DIVIDER>>
as salaam ya zainab e kubra as salaam
bikherti hui raahon mein roshni zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
mizaaj e hazrate shabbir le chali zainab
bikherti hui raahon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jahan mein maqsade shabbir aam karti rahi
jo kaam bhai ne saumpa tha kaam karti rahi
kabhi hussain ki surat kabhi ali ki tarha
yazeed e waqt ki neendein haram karti rahi
teri zuban hai ya tayghe hyderi zainab
bikherti hui raahon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
yazeediyat ke liye kaam khoob ho jaata
jo aaftab e shariyat ghuroob ho jaata
zamana jehle murakkab ki neend so jaata
khuda ke deen mein shaamil uyub ho jaata
pase hussain na karti jo rehbari zainab
bikherti hui raahon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
tera wujood sadaqat ka pasban raha
tera wujood imamat ka pasban raha
quran e paak ki tatheer ki shahadat hai
tera wujood taharat ka pasban raha
hai tu hi makhzane ismat ki chaaoni zainab
bikherti hui raahon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ki laadli hamsheer e shabbar o shabbir
janabe fatema zehra ki hoo bahoo tasveer
masahebeen e sitamgar ki larzaban hamdaam
dayare shaam mein karke kuch is tarha taqreer
misaale hydare karraar chaa gayi zainab
bikherti hui raahon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
sitamgaron ne to chaaha magar na hone diya
khuda ke deen mein biddat ka ghar na hone diya
gawara kar liya khud daagh beridayi ka
barehna deene payambar ka sar na hone diya
hai tere khoon mein shaamil tawangari zainab
bikherti hui raahon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
siraate haq o sadaaqat se hat gayi hoti
isaare kufr mein dunya simat gayi hoti
tamam nabiyon ki mehnat bhi zere takhte yazeed
qurane paak ke hamraah pat gayi hoti
agar mizaaj e zamana na modti zainab
bikherti hui raahon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda tera hai imaam o rasool tere hai
jo panjetan ke hai zainab usool tere hai
mehek raha hai gulistane kibriya jis se
sabhi kali hai tere saare phool tere hai
hai tujhse deene mohamed ki dilkashi zainab
bikherti hui raahon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan bayan ka mohtaaj zikr hai tera
har ek zikr ka sartaaj zikr hai tera
tere amal tere kirdaar ki badaulat hai
zuban zuban pe agar aaj zikr hai tera
hai tere zikr ki mohtaaj har sadi zainab
bikherti hui raahon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
misaale hazrate meesam dahan ataa kar do
hamay janabe farazdaq sa fan ataa kar do
dua ye monis o kausar ki shadman ki hai
ay bibi hum ko bhi auje sukhan ataa kardo
tumhari bazm mein karte hai naukri zainab
bikherti hui raahon mein...

items.title: Dare zindan par
items.body:
dar e zindan par koi masooma
padha karti hai ye ro kar nauha
baba baba baba baba

bahot darr mujhko yahan lagta hai
bahot tanha hoo chale aao na
baba baba baba baba
dar e zindan par...

khud aake dekh lo meri haalat
nahi pehchaan paoge meri surat
sahe bachpan mein masayib itne
zaeefa dikhne lagi ye dukhiya
baba baba baba baba
dar e zindan par...

bada dushwaar hai is qaid mein jeena
bahot yaad aa raha hai aap ka seena
gaye ho jab se nahi soyi mai
sukoon se ab tak kabhi ek lamha
baba baba baba baba
dar e zindan par...

mujhe phir qabr mein lagne laga hai darr
nikaala tha jinhone laasha e asghar
wo zaalim phir se palat aaye hai
phupi aur mai hoo yahan phir tanha
baba baba baba baba
dar e zindan par...

mai royun leke kab tak siskiyan baba
bahot dukhti hai meri phasliyan baba
sakina is dam hai kis haalat mein
faqat samjhengi ye daadi zahra
baba baba baba baba
dar e zindan par...

nazar aata nahi aankhon ko malti hoo
sahara leke deewaron ka chalti hoo
pakad kar zulfein mujhe zaalim ne
na jaane kaisa tamacha maara
baba baba baba baba
dar e zindan par...

lage hai zakhm jitne sab dikhaungi
jab aaoge to mai sab kuch bataungi
bahot maara hai bahot tadpaya
mujhe logon ne samajh kar tanha
baba baba baba baba
dar e zindan par...

nadeem us waqt khud zindan rota tha
sakina jis ghadi padti thi ye nauha
mujhe lagta hai ke ab ghut ghut kar
nikal jayega yahin dam mera
baba baba baba baba
dar e zindan par...

items.title: Ghareeb baba
items.body:
ghareeb baba ghareeb beti
<<DIVIDER>>
wo be-kafan tha ye be-rida thi
ghareeb baba ghareeb beti
<<DIVIDER>>
tamache dono ne ban may khaaye
hai dono pehlu shikasta haye
wo ibne zehra ye zehra jaisi
ghareeb baba ghareeb beti...
<<DIVIDER>>
musalla baba ka ye bichaati
hussain dete thay isko lori
ye uski aadi wo iska aadi
ghareeb baba ghareeb beti...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha usko maara rula rula ke
bahaya pani isay dikha ke
tha wo bhi pyasa hai ye bhi pyasi
ghareeb baba ghareeb beti...
<<DIVIDER>>
huwe jo khanjar ke waar sheh par
khadi thi pehlu may unki dukhtar
wo jitna tadpe ye utna royi
ghareeb baba ghareeb beti...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye durre zaalim se kha rahi hai
padar ke seene ko dhoondti hai
wo jab se soya ye so na paayi
ghareeb baba ghareeb beti...
<<DIVIDER>>
thay zakhm shabbir ke badan par
sakina khaati rahi hai pathar
tha wo bhi zakhmi hai ye bhi zakhmi
ghareeb baba ghareeb beti...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar uska sandooq may rakha hai
rasan may iska gala bandha hai
safar may rehte thay dono qaidi
ghareeb baba ghareeb beti...
<<DIVIDER>>
nibhaya har ek waada jis ne
uthaaya dono ka laasha jis ne
behan thi uski phupi thi iski
ghareeb baba ghareeb beti...

tha mir sajjad kaisa lamha

items.title: Haye sakina meri
items.body:
waqt e nizha kehta raha sheh ka alamdar
haye sakina meri haye sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
tashna dahan mar na kahin jaye dilafgaar
haye sakina meri haye sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
haathon mein kooza liye qaime ke dar par khadi
pani ki ummeed mein hogi sakina meri
payegi jis dam khabar mashk meri chid gayi
roke kahegi chacha pyaas meri bujh gayi
dil mein rahega ye qalaq sayyed e abraar
haye sakina meri haye sakina
waqt e nizha kehta raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
naaz uthaata raha jiska mai shaam o sahar
aaj bhatiji meri hai wohi tashna jigar
kya kahun kis darja ab gham ka hai dil par asar
tashna dahani faqat uski hai peshe nazar
chashm hui kehke yehi ghazi ki khoon baar
haye sakina meri haye sakina
waqt e nizha kehta raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye nahi bujh saki bacchon ki tashna labi
waada na poora hua aur qaza aagayi
kaise kahun kis qadar mujhko hai sharmindagi
laash na jayegi ab qaime mein aaqa meri
roke yehi kehta raha sheh ka alamdar
haye sakina meri haye sakina
waqt e nizha kehta raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
karta hoon mai to safar hogi qayamat magar
chaayegi gham ki ghata bekas o mazloom par
zulm sahegi bhala kis tarha jaan e pidar
phat'ta hai ye soch kar bakhuda mera jigar
baad mere uspe sitam dhayenge aghiyaar
haye sakina meri haye sakina
waqt e nizha kehta raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
teeron ki baarish hui naiza o khanjar chale
zulm ki hadh hogayi baazu qalam ho gaye
mashk nahi laa sake gurz laga gir pade
nehr pe maare gaye bekhata ammu mere
sun ke khabar royegi wo bekas o lachaar
haye sakina meri haye sakina
waqt e nizha kehta raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
shakl bhatiji ko mai kaise dikhaun bhala
maut se majboor hoon kaise mai jaaun bhala
pyaas sakina ki ab kaise bujhaun bhala
mashk mein pani nahi kaise bataun bhala
nauha yehi padta raha sheh ka madadgaar
haye sakina meri haye sakina
waqt e nizha kehta raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ka bilakna kabhi mujhko gawara na tha
pyaas se tadpegi wo maine ye socha na tha
pani mai laata nahi ba khuda aisa na tha
jang mai karta yahan sheh ka iraada na tha
keh ke yehi rone laga paikar e eesaar
haye sakina meri haye sakina
waqt e nizha kehta raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ye tasavvur faqat nauha alamdar ka
kaun likhega bhala ranj wafadaar ka
maqsad e khursheed hai ashk azadaar ka
tazkera karta hai wo shaah ke ghamkhwar ka
samjho zaban ahle aza kehte hai ash'aar
haye sakina meri haye sakina
waqt e nizha kehta raha...
