items.title: Hussain jaate hai
items.body:
aza tamaam hai riqqat karo azadaron
hussain jaate hai ruqsat karo azadaron
<<DIVIDER>>
safar ka waqt hai mehman ko alwida kaho
juloos e shaah e shaheedan ko alwida kaho
ujad ne waale hai kuch dayr mein azakhane
kisi behan ko kisi maa ko alwida kaho
hussain jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zareeh tashna musafir ki badne waali hai
imambadon ki raunaq ujadne waali hai
bujhe huwe hai diye ro rahi hai deewarein
jo mehman thi wo bibi bichadne waali hai
hussain jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
saron pe gard hai aansu hai aasteeno par
udaas baithe hai sab matami zameeno par
rula rahe hai ye murjhaye phool sehron ke
na taaziye hai na patke hai sheh nasheeno par
hussain jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan se aaj ye manzar aza ke layegi
ye khamoshi ye udaasi hamein rulayegi
jiyenge kaise zari o alam se hoke juda
na din ko chain na raaton ko neend aayegi
hussain jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
nabi ke chain ko kaise kahe khudahafiz
shahe hunain ko kaise kahe khudahafiz
ye soch soch ke aankhon mein ashk aaye hai
ke hum hussain ko kaise kahe khudahafiz
hussain jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
suqood bazme aza ka bahot rulayega
khud apne ghar ka ye sannata humko khayega
kisay khabar ke ye din phir naseeb ho ke na ho
jo agle saal jiyega wo gham manayega
hussain jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
udaasiyan sabhi maaon ke rukh pe chaayi hai
labon pe bayn ko aankhon mein ashq laayi hai
phupi ko dena hai pursa tumhare baba ka
sakina bibi tumhari kaneezein aayi hai
hussain jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhari yaad mein bechain hote jaate hai
tumhari hijr mein jaan apni khote jaate hai
inhe bhi dekhlo jhoole se ay ali asghar
ye bache godhi mein maaon ki rote jaate hai
hussain jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab aayega kisi barchi ka dhyan royenge
faza mein goonjegi jab jab azan royenge
tumhare hijr mein hum ay shabihe paighambar
dil apna peet ke saare jawan royenge
hussain jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai itna aamir o nayyar ko bhi yaqeen maula
pasand tum ko hai dono hi sar zameen maula
watan hamara hai bharat bhi karbala bhi magar
jahan chale ho hamein le chalo wahin maula
hussain jaate hai...

items.author: Qambar

items.title: Kanto pe chal ke abid
items.body:
Kaanto'n pe chalke aabide muztar idhar udhar.
Raaho'n me khaake girte hai thokar idhar udhar.
Haatho'n me hathkadi hai to paaun me bediya'n.
Gardan me tauq aur hai langar idhar udhar.
Zakhmo se choor choor hai sajjade naatva'n.
Kha kha ke taaziyaane badan par idhar udhar.
Beemaar qaydi dhoop ki shiddat me pyaas se.
Ghash khake gir raha tha zamee'n par idhar udhar.
Barsa ke shole aag ke logo ne shaam me.
Maare the naatwaan ko patthar idhar udhar.
Sajjaad ho gae the sara pa lahoo loha'n
Zaalim chubhoe jaate the nashtar idhar udhar.
Aale nabi ko dekhke balve me nange sar.
Ghayyor dhoondhta raha chaadar idhar udhar.
Baccho ko pyaasa dekh ke rota tha zaar zaar.
Raaho'n me ibne saakie kavsar idhar udhar.
Tadpa rahe the pyaase yateemo ko haaye haaye.
Zaalim zamee'n pe paani baha kar idhar udhar.
Karke baland chaadre zaynab ko shaam me.
Aabid pe has rahe the sitamgar idhar udhar.
Navshad or waqaar na kar paayenge baya'n.
Harsu hai gham ke shaam me manzar idhar udhar.

items.title: Lashe Farzand Pe Kehte Thay Shahe Dein Roker
items.body:
Lashe Farzand pe kehte thay shahe Dein Roker,
Uttho akber uttho
Deyklo utke hai kya haal hamara Akber
Uttho akber uttho akber.
1) Saamne Maa ke tujhe leke mai jaun kaise,
Iss Zaeefi me teri Lash uthana kaise,
Mujko Ata nahi ab khaime ka Rasta me Nazar.
Utho....
2) Haat me Rasha Hai ab paon bhi Tharraye hain,
Thokare khate howe laash pe Ham aayein hain,
Tere Gham me nahi rakkha hai amama Sar par
Uttho...
3) Waqt Gurbat ka hai wo Saat Hamara deta,
Mera abbas jo hota tu Sahara deta,
Haat oske bhi Magar Kaat chuke hain Akfar
Utho....
4) Hur ke bete ki Tarha tujhko utha tha beta,
Par tere Baap se Sambla nahi Jata Beta,
Gham me abbas ke seedhi nahi hoti hai Kamar.
Utho...
5) Ab tu bhai ko bhi Darya se bula sakta nahi,
Ek beta hai wo bimaar hai aa sakta nahi,
Kya kare baap tera ab ye Bata rashke Qamar.
Utho...
6) koi Ata nahi ab Lash Uthane ke liye,
Sirf zainab hai mera Haat batane ke liye,
Mai tere paon sambhalunga sambhalegi wo Sar.
Utho...
7) umr bhar koi bhi kehna nahi Tala toone,
Haye Ghurbath Me Na Par Mujko sambhala toone,
Ab nahi utte bulata hai tumhe kabse padar.
Utho...
8) Aakhri waqth Sahara Ye lagaja Beta,
Khud Hi uttkar meri Agosh me Aja Beta,
Bodhay Khandon pa nahi uthay Gi lashe akber.
Uttho...
9) Aisi dekhi na koi Charkhe Mehen ne Mayyath,
Apne Khandon pa Rakkhi Bhai Behen ne Mayyath,
Rohe Zehra bhi Chali saath kiye nange Sar.
Uttho...
10) Sheh ye Kehte thay koi saath Sahara dedo,
Bacho aao tume Lashe ko sahara dedo,
Chand Bacho diya shehko Sahara aakar..
Uttho...
11) Shaah dete the ye ro ro ke duhayi sahil,
Unke bete ki kuchh avaz na aayi sahil,
Wo muqarrib yahi chillate rahe Peet ke sar.
Uttho Akber uttho...4

mehshar tha bapa gohar is dashte musibat mein
tadpa to zaroor hoga baysheer bhi turbat mein
jab maa ne kaha hoga aajao ali asghar
ek maa ka ye nauha tha...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Ghareeb baba
items.body:
haye o mera ghareeb baba
ay shaam de logon mai sayyed haan
<<DIVIDER>>
na kafan mila na dafan hua
mera baba pyasa maar diya
haye o mera ghareeb baba
<<DIVIDER>>
bazaar e shaam ka majma tha
sajjad ghareeb ka nauha tha
kyun baaghi baaghi kehte ho
kya jurm tha mere baba ka
sajde mein namazi qatl kiya
mera baba pyasa maar diya
haye o mera ghareeb...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera baba shaan e rasoolallah
mera baba jaan e madina tha
chauda baara aur paanch mein bhi
beshak anmol nagina tha
sadaat ke dil ko chaak kiya
mera baba pyasa maar diya
haye o mera ghareeb...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera baba paak namazi tha
allah bhi jis se raazi tha
mera baba aisa qaari tha
quran bhi jis ka haami tha
sajde mein us par zulm kiya
mera baba pyasa maar diya
haye o mera ghareeb...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehle to pyar se khat likh ke
dhoke se bulaya baba ko
phir karbobala ke sehra mein
kitna hai sataya baba ko
mehman bana kar loot liya
mera baba pyasa maar diya
haye o mera ghareeb...
<<DIVIDER>>
batlao kya mera baba
ek kafan ka bhi haqdaar na tha
batlao kya mera baba
nana ka virsadaar na tha
laakho ne us ko ghayr liya
mera baba pyasa maar diya
haye o mera ghareeb...

items.title: Har dil ki sada
items.body:
kehte hai ahle aza har dil ki hai ye sada
ya hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
kehta hai khud ye khuda zehra ki jaan marhaba
ya hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
tu ne bichaya musalla wahan
dam tod de khud ibadat jahan
is hausle par tere qurban salle alaa
ya hussain ya hussain
kehte hai ahle aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
aadam ke dam ke muhafiz ho tum
musa ki haibat mein naafiz ho tum
isaa ka tum maujiza tum khizr ke rehnuma
ya hussain ya hussain
kehte hai ahle aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
raushan tere noor se noore hai
ghairat zada jalwa e toor hai
khoon se tere hogayi matti bhi khaake shifa
ya hussain ya hussain
kehte hai ahle aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye hausla to kisi mein nahi
quwaat kisi ye nabi mein nahi
tu ne uthaaye magar baazu e shaah e wafa
ya hussain ya hussain
kehte hai ahle aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ne sitam kis tarha se saha
tum ne ye gham kis tarha se saha
laasha jawan laal ka kaandhon pe kaise rakha
ya hussain ya hussain
kehte hai ahle aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
is gham mein kaampe zameen aasman
is gham mein tadpe ye kaun o makaan
asghar ka tu ne lahoo chehre pe kaise mala
ya hussain ya hussain
kehte hai ahle aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
ran mein musibat ye tum par padi
tum par qayamat ki thi ye ghadi
khanjar talay haath jab maa ne teri rakh diya
ya hussain ya hussain
kehte hai ahle aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
aisi kisi ki bhi mayyat nahi
yasir kisi ki ye ghurbat nahi
tareekh mein ek hai teeron pe laasha tera
ya hussain ya hussain
kehte hai ahle aza...
items.author: Yasir Abbas

items.title: Haye shaame ghariban
items.body:
jis shaam jalaye gaye sadaat ke qayyaam
guzri nahi wo shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
paywast hai khanjar ki tarha dil pe wo hangaam
guzri nahi wo shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
sar ban ke rida ban ke sare noke sina hai
shola hai dhuan hai
hai jo tahe zanjeer tahe tauq tahe naam
guzri nahi wo shaam
jis shaam jalaye gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal ka tawaf ab bhi usi tarha hai jaari
ek zauf hai taari
khola hi nahi waqt ne us shaam ka ehraam
guzri nahi wo shaam
jis shaam jalaye gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis shaam ki ghurbat ne dukhaya dil e sajjad
rulaya dil e sajjad
zainab ne jise shaam e ghariban ka diya naam
guzri nahi wo shaam
jis shaam jalaye gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye saare azal saare abad jis mein sameine
ab kya kahoo haye
jis mein simat aaya hai har aghaaz har anjaam
guzri nahi wo shaam
jis shaam jalaye gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
uth'ti hai wohi aandhiya kat jaata hai seena
phat jaata hai seena
har shaam mujhe yaad dilaati hai wohi shaam
guzri nahi wo shaam
jis shaam jalaye gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis raakh mein dil mera naved aah daba hai
aur raakh hua hai
us raakh mein reh reh ke bhadakti hai wohi shaam
guzri nahi wo shaam
jis shaam jalaye gaye...
items.author: Ahmed Naved

items.title: Hussain janam
items.body:
hussain jaanam hussain jaanam
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein khule sar yehi kehti rahi maadar
hussain jaanam hussain jaanam
pyase gale pe chala haye zulm ka khanjar
hussain jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
sehra e karbala mein hua zehra ka nazool
beti ke saath rote huwe aa gaye rasool
zehra ka baazu thaame huwe rote hai haider
hussain jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho na alamdar raha aur na lashkar
na aun o mohamed rahe na qasim o akbar
ladte huwe laakhon se nazar aaye jo sarwar
hussain jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
ladte hue shabbir ne jis dam suni sada
ay nafse mutmain aa palat kehta tha khuda
sajde mein rakha shaah ne sar khaak ke upar
hussain jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
khanjar ko liye haaton mein wo shimr chala hai
pyase gale pe shaah ke khanjar ko rakha hai
ye dekh ke roti rahi shabbir ki maadar
hussain jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte thay ke ay shimr ye ahmed ka pisar hai
aur pyaas ki shiddat se jala uska jigar hai
pani usay pilado dua denge payambar
hussain jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar khole huwe fatema karti rahi faryad
sar kaat ke hathon mein utha legaya jallaad
zainab ne dare qaima se dekha tha wo manzar
hussain jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon aasman se barsa udhar karbobala mein
aur fathe ki naubat baji wan ahle jafa mein
sajjad se kehti thi utho abid e muztar
hussain jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad ne tab chaunk ke sar apna uthaya
sar hazrate shabbir ka wan naize pe paaya
kehte thay salaam aap pe ay zehra ke dilbar
hussain jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
farmati thi zehra ke mere yusuf e saani
pyase hi gaye dunya se paaya nahi pani
ab khuld mein nana tere denge tujhe kausar
hussain jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra se ye farmane lage ahmad e mukhtar
de sabr tujhe fatema ab khaaliq e ghaffar
zibhe azeem bangaya hai ab mera sarwar
hussain jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
farmate thay ye zehra se ro ro ke murtaza
zaalim ne mere bache ko maara hai be-khata
shabbir ke laashe pe yehi kehte thay hyder
hussain jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sab ghulam aap ke hai hazrate shabbir
aijaz o aaqif ki badhi is liye taukeer
rote huwe kehte hai jo aakar sare mimbar
hussain jaanam...
items.author: Aijaz Rizvi

items.title: Jaan ali akbar
items.body:
shabihe payambar haye haye ali akbar
kaise jiyegi tere bin haye ye maadar
ay jaan ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
beta ali akbar maadar ko pukaro
ghamzada maadar ko chehra to dikhado
khaak se utho mujhko bula lo
maa hai pareshan kahan ho mere dilbar
ay jaan ali akbar
shabihe payambar...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid hui beta zindan chali maa
saare shaheedon ka allah nigehban
ghar hua veeran aao meri jaan
ho gya sajjad akela mera dilbar
ay jaan ali akbar
shabihe payambar...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ka ye armaan tha tujhe dulha banaati
maa teri dulhan ko naazon se sajaati
ho nahi paayi aas ye poori
aise gaye aaye na maidan se palat kar
ay jaan ali akbar
shabihe payambar...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa hai rasan basta sar tera sina par
balwa e aada mein laaya hai muqaddar
ay mere pyare nok e sina se
dekh le maa teri hai balwe mein khule sir
ay jaan ali akbar
shabihe payambar...
<<DIVIDER>>
beta ali akbar maadar ka hai waada
sogh manaungi ta umr tumhara
ab na piyungi thanda mai pani
ab na mai baithungi kabhi saaye mein jaa kar
ay jaan ali akbar
shabihe payambar...
<<DIVIDER>>
pooch liya mujhse sughra ne jo tera
kaise bataungi akbar nahi aaya
royegi sughra tadpegi sughra
tere bina kaise jiyegi teri khwahar
ay jaan ali akbar
shabihe payambar...

items.title: Kar diya islam
items.body:
ya hussain as salaam
as salaam ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
kar diya islam ko hai surkh roo shabbir ne
is ki khaatir ki hai aisi justuju shabbir ne
<<DIVIDER>>
aankh mein aansu thay har ek ki shabe ashoor ko
ki hai is andaaz se guftugu shabbir ne
kar diya islam ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
leke aaye thay layeen jo karbala ke dasht mein
khaak mein wo sab mila di aarzoo shabbir ne
kar diya islam ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
na kiya na kar sakega koi ghazi is tarha
khoon mein jaise kiya hai wazoo shabbir ne
kar diya islam ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kufr ke haathon ye deen ke chid gaye thay jo libaas
wo zibha sab kar diye hai wo rufoo shabbir ne
kar diya islam ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay ameer is deen ki khaatir bala ke dasht mein
kar diye qurban bete khoon baroo shabbir ne
kar diya islam ko hai...
items.author: Ameer Hussain Mashadi

items.title: Kehte thay shaah
items.body:
kehte thay shaah ay ali akbar kahan ho tum
ay mere laal ay mere dilbar kahan ho tum
<<DIVIDER>>
apne zaeef baap ki aa kar madad karo
ghere huwe hai shaam ka lashkar kahan ho tum
kehte thay shaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
awaaz de rahe hai pisar ko shah e huda
ay naujawan shabihe payambar kahan ho tum
kehte thay shaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime ke dar pa aas lagaye khadi hai maa
veeran ho gaya hai bhara ghar kahan ho tum
kehte thay shaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ro ke keh rahi hai ye zainab jawab do
qaime jala rahe hai sitamgar kahan ho tum
kehte thay shaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
laila ke dil ko kaun sambhale mere pisar
dar dar phira rahe hai sitamgar kahan ho tum
kehte thay shaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se gaye ho tum dil e maadar udaas hai
aankhon ka noor ay ali akbar kahan ho tum
kehte thay shaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
baithi hui hoo moo ko chipaye zameen par
aade ne cheen li meri chadar kahan ho tum
kehte thay shaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab shaam ho rahi hai sakina ki lo khabar
ay naujawan hussain ke dilbar kahan ho tum
kehte thay shaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ghir chuke hai nargha e aada mein ay pisar
durre laga rahe hai sitamgar kahan ho tum
kehte thay shaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
tooti hui kamar ko sambhalo hussain ki
kehti hai ro ke zainab e muztar kahan ho tum
kehte thay shaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
laila ki aarzoo hai ek baar dekh loo
hamshakle mustafa ali akbar kahan ho tum
kehte thay shaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ke galay pa shimr ka khanjar ghazab hua
aayi sada ke ay ali akbar kahan ho tum
kehte thay shaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
ahle haram mein hashr bapa hogaya aseem
sarwar ne jab kaha ali akbar kahan ho tum
kehte thay shaah...
items.author: Aseem Lakhnavi

items.title: Kiye hai shimr ne do qatl
items.body:
Kiye Hai Shimr Ne Do Qatl Ek Khanjar Se
Lahu Hussain Ka Pocha Behen Ki Chadar Se
1) Ghareeb-E-Zahra Wahi'n Rote Rote Marr Jaata
Behen Utha Ke Na Laati Jo Laash-E-Akbar Se
2) Kisi Ne Baalo'n Se Pakda Koi Utha Ke Chala,
Sar-E-Hussain Ko Maara Kisi Ne Patthar Se
3) Use Uthaya Hai Baba Ki Laash Se Aise,
Ke Phir Sakina Nahi Soyi Shimr Ke Darr Se
4) Lab-E-Hussain(as) Pe Hass Hass Ke Marta Hai Chhadi,
Yazeed Khel Raha Tha Hussain(as) Ke Sarr Se
5) Bulaya Shaam Ke Zindan Mein Jab Sakina Ne,
Hussain Pyaase Palat Aaye Hauze Kausar Se
6) Faqat gala hi nahi shah ka kata ran me
Kate hai haath bhi zahra(sa) ke kund khanjar se
6) Behen Ka Parda Taqallum Use Bana Na Tha,
Suna Raha Tha Woh Quran Sina Ke Mimbar Se.

items.title: Lashkare aada mein
items.body:
lashkare aada mein jitne thay sabhi kehne lage
dekh kar abbas ke tewar ali kehne lage
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar andaaz e jang e hazrate abbas ke
aagaye maidan mein hyder khyberi kehne lage
lashkare aada mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
haath mein abbas ke chamki jo wo tayghe hyderi
lashkari be-saakhta bijli giri kehne lage
lashkare aada mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar o akbar pe ki nazrein to dil mein ashkiyan
unko tasveer e ali unko nabi kehne lage
lashkare aada mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ho nazar to aao dekho kya hai tasveer e hussain
raushni apne ko kaise rasuhni kehne lage
lashkare aada mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala waalon ne zinda kar diya islam ko
marne waale maut ko hi zindagi kehne lage
lashkare aada mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
laash akbar ki uthaayi jo zameen e garm se
har qadam pe shaahe waala ya ali kehne lage
lashkare aada mein...

items.title: Mai seene pe baba
items.body:
ye nauha sakina ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mai seene pe baba ke so'un kahan
teer hi teer hai
haye teer hi teer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kund khanjar se sookha gala kat gaya
mera baba magar phir bhi pyasa raha
aagayi raat maine na pani piya
itne seene pe hai zakhme noke sina
teer hi teer hai
mai seene pe baba ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhiye dada baba ka kya haal hai
dadi zahra yehi aap ka laal hai
laash ghodon ki taapon se pamaal hai
jism tukde hua tooti hai phasliyan
teer hi teer hai
mai seene pe baba ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar teer hi teer roti hoo mai
bolte kyun nahi jaan khoti hoo mai
aap ke sirf sine pe soti hoo mai
neend aati hai lekin mai so'un kahan
teer hi teer hai
mai seene pe baba ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
jal chuke qaime aur chadarein chin chuki
berida meri phupiyan hai baithi wahin
is jagah bhi na aajaye shimr e layeen
mera kurta jala chin chuki baaliyan
teer hi teer hai
mai seene pe baba ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhaiya sajjad par ab hai mushkil badi
aap ke baad kya kya musibat padi
dekhiye aap ke paas mai hoo khadi
ye tamachon ke rukhsar par hai nishan
teer hi teer hai
mai seene pe baba ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai to samjhi thi yan hoga asghar mera
teer se chid gaya jiska nanha gala
aake seene pe wo aap ke sogaya
baba batlayein hai mera asghar kahan
teer hi teer hai
mai seene pe baba ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe qasim ki surat hai laash aap ki
hai kamar bhai ke gham se tooti hui
zakhme akbar jigar se hai rista abhi
ab bhi nikli nahi hai wo noke sina
teer hi teer hai
mai seene pe baba ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
akhm baazu pe pyase baradar ka hai
zakhm seene pe baba ye akbar hai
hai jo gardan kati zakhm asghar ka hai
kaise so'un ye hai ap ka imtehan
teer hi teer hai
mai seene pe baba ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro rahi hai zameen rota hai asmaan
ay qamar ye batayein imam e zaman
seena sone ko mil jaaye ho shadman
teer kaise nikalegi ye natawan
teer hi teer hai
mai seene pe baba ke...
items.author: Qamar Hasnain

items.title: Abbas ka laasha
items.body:
abbas ka laasha mai nahi laaya sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
laaya hoon tarayi se alam khoon mein dooba
abbas ka laasha mai nahi laaya sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
baba se meri laadli naaraz na hona
abbas ka laasha mai nahi laaya sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
jab khaali alam leke mai darya se chala tha
har ek qadam par mai yehi soch raha tha
phat jaaye na masoom sakina ka kaleja
jab apni dulaari se mai ye jaa ke kahunga
abbas ka laasha mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
chalta hai kaleje pe mere dard ka khanjar
maara gaya pyasa mera mazloom baradar
malta hua haathon ko mai aaya hoon palat kar
ye dard mere dil se juda ho nahi sakta
abbas ka laasha mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhse tere ammu ne kaha tha meri pyari
abbas ki ye aakhri khwahish thi dulaari
le jaana na qaime ki taraf laash hamari
poori hui abbas e dilawar ki tamanna
abbas ka laasha mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
chota na karo dil meri naadan sakina
qismat ka likha hai ye meri jaan sakina
tujh par ye tera baap ho qurban sakina
ye baat meri laadli dil mein nahi rakhna
abbas ka laasha mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ke laashe ko tasavvur mein bana lo
jee bhar ke chacha jaan pe ashkon ko baha lo
ammu ka alam laaya hoon seene se laga lo
reh jaaye na ye dil mein khalaq ay meri dukhiya
abbas ka laasha mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil par jo mere zakhm laga kaise bataun
is waqt mera haal hai kya kaise bataun
sadma jo mujhe aaj hua kaise bataun
ab dil mera har waqt isi gham se phatega
abbas ka laasha mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
masoom sakina ko kaleje se laga kar
roye hai bahot dayr talak sibte payambar
kehte thay ki ab sabr karo ay meri dukhtar
maine wo kiya jo mere bhai ne kaha tha
abbas ka laasha mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
waiz wo musibat ki badi sakht ghadi thi
masoom sakina dar e qaima pe khadi thi
aur laash alamdar ki darya pe padi thi
shabbir ke is bain se kohraam tha barpa
abbas ka laasha mai...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Alamdare hussain
items.body:
jaan e hussain alamdar e hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ay abalfazl alamdar e hussain
bawafa monis o ghamkhwar e hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ye azadaar na bhoolenge kabhi aap ka gham
hum na bhoolenge kabhi khoon mein dooba wo alam
hashr tak aap ki ghurbat ka karenge matam
ay jari aap ke baazu e bureeda ki qasam
ay abalfazl alamdar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ke dar se liya dars e sharafat hum ne
aap se seekhi hai bhai ki mohabbat hum ne
chadar e saani e zahra ki qasam ay ghazi
aap se seekhi hai behno ki hifazat hum ne
ay abalfazl alamdar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek masooma ke ehsaas pe rona aaya
uski mazloomi pe aur pyaas pe rona aaya
jab bhi parcham pe lagi mashke sakina dekhi
aap ki tooti hui aas pe rona aaya
ay abalfazl alamdar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye maula wo qayamat ki ghadi
sheh ko jis waqt sada aap ne di
aasman dard ka sarwar pe gira
daude ye kehte huwe shaahe huda
mere ghayyur mere shere jari
tere bhai ki kamar toot gayi
aur jeena nahi ab mujhko gawara ghazi
maar daalega mujhe daagh tumhara ghazi
ay abalfazl alamdar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye maqtal ka wo manzar wo musibat maula
ta abad yaad rahegi wo qayamat maula
seena e sayyede waala pe layeen ka zaanu
aur tadpti hui wo aap ki mayyat maula
ay abalfazl alamdar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil bahot rota hai ye soch ke mera ghazi
aap ko jaan se pyari thi sakina ghazi
shimr ne usko tamachon pe tamache maare
aap ne kaise saha hoga ye sadma ghazi
ay abalfazl alamdar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil laraz jaata hai ye sun ke azadaron ka
bhare bazaar mein thay ahle haram beparda
haye kya aap pe guzri hai qayamat us dam
jab ye zainab ne kaha cheeni gayi meri rida
ay abalfazl alamdar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye kis dil se nadeem aap ki ghurbat likhe
is tasavvur se jigar hota hai tukde tukde
mai bayan kaise karun aap ke zakhmi sar ko
shimr ne gardan e rahwaar se baandha kaise
ay abalfazl alamdar e hussain...
items.author: Nadeem Sultanpuri

items.title: Amma laut aayi hoo
items.body:
amma laut aayi hoo mai
daagh dil pe bahattar ke laayi hoo mai
<<DIVIDER>>
jab gaye thay yahan se to ghar tha bhara
gulsitan tera phoolon se abaad tha
haye dashte sitam haye karbobala
loot kar legayi sab bhara ghar mera
sab luta aayi teri kameini hoo mai
amma laut aayi hoo....
<<DIVIDER>>
qasimo akbaro asghare dilruba
sab ke sab hogaye karbala mein juda
sher jaisa wo abbas bhai mera
katgaye haath saahil pe maara gaya
nehr pe bekafan chod aayi hoo mai
amma laut aayi hoo....
<<DIVIDER>>
choomti thi bade pyar se jo gala
dasthe ghurbat mein tan se hua wo juda
ek khatra dame zibha mil na saka
laadla tera pyasa jahan se gaya
khoon bhara payrahan saath laayi hoo mai
amma laut aayi hoo....
<<DIVIDER>>
baade shabbir itna bada hausla
cheen kar legaye chadare ashkiyan
qaima e ahl par thay rasoole khuda
aag lagti gayi khaak hota gaya
jalte qaimon se abid ko laayi hoo mai
amma laut aayi hoo....
<<DIVIDER>>
jaa baja pa barehna yuhin sar khule
shaam o koofa ki galiyon mein khaynche gaye
kya kahoon waaliye shaam ke saamne
haath thay rassiyon mein hamare bandhe
neel baazu ke dikhlane aayi hoo mai
amma laut aayi hoo....
<<DIVIDER>>
wo dulaari sakina bhatiji meri
kha rahi thi tamache mai chup thi khadi
haye re bebasi haye bechaargi
wo sitam jhelte jhelte mar gayi
shaam ki qaid mein chod aayi hoo mai
amma laut aayi hoo....

items.title: Baba ko sadayein
items.body:
baba ko sadayein deti hai
jangal may sakina raat gaye
jab kaan may uske aati hai
awaaz e ilayya raat gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas nahi qasim bhi nahi
akbar bhi nahi asghar bhi nahi
be-gor o kafan hai jangal may
shabbir ka laasha raat gaye
baba ko sadayein...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ki dulaari sar kholay
be-makhna o chadar baithi hai
roodad e alam dohrata hai
jalta hua qaima raat gaye
baba ko sadayein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab sham e ghariban ko lekar
ashoor ka suraj doob gaya
sajjad ko bhi be-deeno ne
zanjeer may jakda raat gaye
baba ko sadayein...

items.title: Batees baras waar
items.body:
sar choom ke abbas ka kehte rahe sarwar
battees baras waar diye char baras par
<<DIVIDER>>
ek mashke sakina ke liye baazu kata kar
battees baras waar diye chaar baras par
<<DIVIDER>>
laasha liye godhi mein sada deti hai zahra
is sher ka khoon beh gaya pani se zyada
abbas ka ehsaan hai ye aale nabi par
battees baras waar diye...
sar choom ke abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
baazu ko qalam dekh ke kehne lage maula
ye haath mere haath mein baba ne diya tha
phir suye najaf dekh ke goya huwe sarwar
battees baras waar diye...
sar choom ke abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir pe sadqe hua shabbir ka banda
ya fatema zehra mera maqbool ho hadiya
kehti hai baqaiya mein ye abbas ki maadar
battees baras waar diye...
sar choom ke abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
saadat ki ab kaun bujhayega bhala pyaas
ek gurz laga zeen se gire khaak pe abbas
ye sunte hi qaimon mein bapa hogaya mehshar
battees baras waar diye...
sar choom ke abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun ho na dile abide bemaar ke tukde
qasim se zyada thay alamdar ke tukde
turbat bhi bani qabr e sakina ke barabar
battees baras waar diye...
sar choom ke abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
majlis mein kabhi naam jo abbas ka aata
ye kehte huwe uth'ta tha shabbir ka beta
qurban chacha aap pe ye abid e muztar
battees baras waar diye...
sar choom ke abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ro ke sada deti thi ye paalne waali
abbas hui aaj se jholi meri khaali
tha shor bapa qaima e kulsoom ke andar
battees baras waar diye...
sar choom ke abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya nehr pe guzri hai ye kehti thi sakina
kyun khoon mein dooba hai alam mere chacha ka
sheh beti ko kehte rahe seene se laga kar
battees baras waar diye...
sar choom ke abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ko ghareebi ki khabar kaise sunate
maare gaye abbas ye kis dil se batate
sheh kehte rahe choom ke hamsheer ki chadar
battees baras waar diye...
sar choom ke abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe ki tarha haathon pe parcham ko utha kar
shabbir sada dete thay rote huwe akbar
jaan waar doon tujh par ay mere sher e dilawar
battees baras waar diye...
sar choom ke abbas ka...

items.title: Bin bhai ke ab
items.body:
ay bhaiya mere bhaiya
haye hussain pyase hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
bin bhai ke ab kaise watan jayegi zainab
mar jayegi mar jayegi mar jayegi mar jayegi zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
poochegi jo sughra ke kahan hai mere baba
mujhko mera baysheer nazar kyun nahi aata
sab qatl huwe kaise bata payegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab chaahne waale hai mere karbobala mein
sab godh ke paale hai isi dasht e jafa mein
yeh kehte huwe jahan se guzar jayegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan e masayib se to laut aayi hoon bhaiya
par saath sakina ko kahan laayi hoon bhaiya
ye daagh kaleje pe na seh payegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas ek hi aaram hai is qalb e hazeen ko
bazaar ke sab zakhm abhi yaad hai mujhko
baaghi ki behan ab nahi kehlayegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
yasrab ke makeen poochenge sajjad se aa kar
pardes mein barbaad hua kaise bhara ghar
khoon royega sajjad to ghabrayegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
aayenge nazar aun o mohamed ke jo hujre
ho jayenge sab zakhm hare mere jigar ke
jab aun o mohamed ko nahi payegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kohe sitam qalb pe nani ke girega
amma ki lehad kaamp uthegi mere bhaiya
jab neel rasan ke unhe dikhlayegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun aayi nahi saath mein farzand tumhare
gar pooch liya mujhse ye abdulla ne aa ke
sau baar wohi waqeya dohrayegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazhar wo ghadi kaisi thi mai likh nahi sakta
mehmil se nazar aaya jo zainab ko madina
fizza ne kaha dard se mar jayegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...

items.title: Ek maa ki aa rahi
items.body:
ek maa ki aa rahi hai sada ay mere hussain
aaja tu meri godh mein aa ay mere hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
bachpan mein ladkhada ke tu girta tha jab kabhi
tujhko sambhalne mein kayi baar mai giri
aati thi mere rab se sada ay mere hussain
ek maa ki aa rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
beta wo tere naala ho ya maa ho wo teri
tujhko na dekh sakte thay rote huwe kabhi
ab ro ke de rahe hai sada ay mere hussain
ek maa ki aa rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
rukhsat hua tu shehre madina se jis ghadi
nana ki qabr se ye sada maine bhi suni
beta bacha le deen mera ay mere hussain
ek maa ki aa rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi sada falak se jo tu pahuncha karbala
shabbir ye maqam hai ta hashr ab tera
is khaak par katega gala ay mere hussain
ek maa ki aa rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
bachpan mein tere naaz uthaati rahi hoon mai
pehlu mein apne tujhko sulaati rahi hoon mai
ye tujhpe kaisa waqt pada ay mere hussain
ek maa ki aa rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu ne uthaya akbar o asghar ki laash ko
ibne hassan ke laasha e sad paash paash ko
ghazi ka laasha uth na saka ay mere hussain
ek maa ki aa rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
mukhtar ran mein bain ye karti thi fatema
majid kaleja phat gaya zehra ne jab kaha
pamaal tera laasha hua ay mere hussain
ek maa ki aa rahi...

items.title: Ghareeb imam alvida
items.body:
haye hussain alwida haye hussain alwida
maula hussain alwida aaqa hussain alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
ghareeb imam alwida shaheed imam alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ranj o gham ki barishein ye khoon mein doobi aasteen
ye beshumar zakhm aur tumhara jism e nazneen
hai kaun jo samajh sake tumhare gham ki inteha
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
na waqte zibha zaalimon ne aab boondh bhar diya
rula rula ke tujhko dushmano ne qatl kar diya
tadap rahe hai mustafa bilak rahi hai fatema
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan aza ki wus'atein kahan ye ashke mukhtasir
isi ka shaahe behrobar qalaq rahega saal bhar
tumhare gham mein rone ka hua na hum se haq ada
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
hamara ghut raha hai dum hamay rula rahe hai kyun
abhi to aap aaye thay abhi ye ja rahe hai kyun
hamay batate jaaiye hui hai hum se kya khata
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
na aap aise jaaiye na is tarha rulaiye
jo ja rahe hai aap to ghulamon ko bataiye
ye saal bhar ka faasla ghatega kis tarha bhala
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
tadap rahi hai aurtein bilag rahi hai bacchiyan
sawaal kar rahi hai hum se hind ki udasiyan
thi jis ke dum se raunaqein wo ab kahan chala gaya
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan ye gham ki barishein kahan aza ki raunaqein
kahan naseeb hongi saal bhar wafa ki raunaqein
alam jo hum badhayenge lagega ghar luta luta
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
khata jo hogayi ho kuch tu usko bakhsh dijiye
gunah gaar hai bohat humay muaaf kijiye
qasam hai aap ko janabe hurr ki shaahe karbala
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo hoga beqarar dil to farshe gham bichayenge
mere imam aap ko hum apne ghar bulayenge
zaroor aaiyega aap ko azaa ka waasta
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
kareem ho karam karo qasam hai tumko shaahe deen
bilal e kazmi tumhara ho ke aamir e hazeen
ye dono beqarar hai bula lo jald karbala
ghareeb imam alwida...

items.title: Haye shame ghariban
items.body:
haye sham e ghariban
<<DIVIDER>>
kunbe ki nigehban ye kehti hai laraz kar
ruk ja sawaar mera lut agya hai ghar
ruk ja ke abhi soye hai bacche mere ro kar
daala jo haath ghaiz se aspe lagaam par
parda utha diya phir ghode ke sawaar ne
zainab ye ro ke kehne lagi baba ke saamne
<<DIVIDER>>
ab aaye ho baba mere kunba hai ab kahan
haye sham e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas kho chuki hoo mai akbar pe ro chuki
bhaiya tumhare baad mai barbaad ho chuki
zinda mai kaise reh gayi meri maut hai kahan
haye sham e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim ki laash tukdon may taqseem ho chuki
bhaiya hassan ki ye bhi nishani bhi mit chuki
dulhan hai ek roz ki dulha hai ab kahan
haye sham e ghariban…
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ke hausle pe jawani bhi ro chuki
sookhi zuban pe fauje sitamgar bhi ro chuki
aaghosh may rabab ki asghar hai ab kahan
haye sham e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
laayi thi apne saath wo ansaar kho chuki
nana tumhare deen pe qurban kar chuki
mai bhi to berida hui chadar hai ab kahan
haye sham e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba mai kya bataun ke kya kya mai seh chuki
bhaiya ki laash teeron ke bistar pe so chuki
bhai ke mer jism pe ab sar bhi hai kahan
haye sham e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyasi sakina bain ye kar kar ke so chuki
ammu hamare kaano se baali bhi chin chuki
kehti hai har tamache pe baba ho ab kahan
haye sham e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
fauje yazeed shaam ki hadh se guzar chuki
qaime jalaye qaidi bhi hum ko bana chuki
zaalim ye mujhse kehte hai sajjad hai kahan
haye sham e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
mohsin dua e fatema zahra bhi mil chuki
hyder se har imamon ki kadiyan bhi mil chuki
rehbar ka hum pe haath hai auron ko ab kahan
haye sham e ghariban...

items.title: Jinko tu samjhi hai
items.body:
jinko tu samjhi hai ay hind yahan wo to nahi
hum to awara watan qaidi hai aur khaak nasheen
<<DIVIDER>>
wo to hai noore mohamed ki ziya arshe makeen
haal ye dekh ke bhi aata nahi tujhko yakeen
tune kya dekh ke kya soch ke ye baat kahi
kalmago qaid karenge bhala aulad e nabi
jinko tu samjhi hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
boli wo kaun ho tum log mujhe ye to batao
apna afsana e gham mujhko mufassar to sunao
roko in aansuon ko apne khudara na bahao
sar ko ooncha karo ay bibiyon surat to dikhao
boli ek bibi bada ranj hai maajayi ko
tere shauhar ne kiya qatl mere bhai ko
jinko tu samjhi hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
kitna pur dard tha ye zainab e muztar ka bayan
sunte hi hind ki ankhon se huwe ashk rawan
roke kehne lagi ba qaatire sultan e zaman
mai chudaungi tumhe qaid se ba izzat o shaan
naam leke na ab kijiyo yun shor o shain
mere aaqa mere maula ka bhi hai naam hussain
jinko tu samjhi hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
shab ko ek khaab wo dekha hai ke allah ki panaah
yani hai teen shab o roz se pyasa mera shaah
boli phir apne kaneezo se basad ashk o aah
naam ab leti hoo saydaniyo ke haq e dawa
paas behad hai mujhe aale mohamed ka janab
jao le aao wazoo karne ko mere liye aab
jinko tu samjhi hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
lab pe abbas kabhi akbar o asghar tha anees
qasim o aun o mohamed kabhi jafar tha anees
zikr e ansaar kabhi ya shahe safdar tha anees
teen din shaam azakhana e sarwar tha anees
majlise sibte payambar hui pehli barpa
zaakira jiski thi khud binte ali o zehra
jinko tu samjhi hai…

items.title: Kar rahi hai dastane
items.body:
haye shaam e ghariban
<<DIVIDER>>
kar rahi hai daastane gham bayan qaimon ki raakh
haye ye kismat kahan zainab kahan qaimon ki raakh
<<DIVIDER>>
sar chupane ke liye jaaye bhi to jaaye kidhar
khoon ke pyase nazar aate hai ta-hadhe nazar
door tak phaili hai zer aasman qaimon ki raakh
kar rahi hai daastane...
<<DIVIDER>>
aalam e islam ko ghairat dilaane ke liye
zulm kis hadh tak huwe hai ye bataane ke liye
le gayi hai shaam tak saydaniya qaimon ki raakh
kar rahi hai daastane...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala ki khaak par khoon mein naha kar so gaye
naaz zainab ko tha jin par qatl wo sab ho gaye
kaash udte dekhte peer o jawan qaimon ki raakh
kar rahi hai daastane...
<<DIVIDER>>
bediyan naize rasan pathar atash aur ghurkiyan
kya yehi kismat mein likha tha ke dekhe hum yahan
naiza o shamsheer o khanjar barchiyan qaimon ki raakh
kar rahi hai daastane...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum isay ghurbat sakina ki kahein ya bebesai
sar chupane ke liye jaane hussain ibne ali
daalti hai sar mein bhar ke mutthiyan qaimon ki raakh
kar rahi hai daastane...
<<DIVIDER>>
raakh ne behte lahoo ko jazb jis dam kar liya
chand lamhe hi sahi par dekhne mein yun laga
ban gayi kaano ki jaise baliyan qaimon ki raakh
kar rahi hai daastane...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehmaton ka raat din wallah hota hai nuzool
khil rahe hai aaj is jaa sabr e shabbiri ke phool
chaar soo phaili hui thi kal jahan qaimon ki raakh
kar rahi hai daastane...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah allah karbala se shaam tak ka imtehan
kar nahi sakta koi asif kisi surat bayan
shadman is gham mein khud hai nauhakhwan qaimon ki raakh
kar rahi hai daastane...

assalaam alaika ay zainab o umme kulsum
assalaam alaika ay ruqqaya o sakina
assalaam alaika ay umme laila o rabab
assalaam alaika ay fatema o fizza o lubaba
assalaam alaika ay ahlebaitun nubuwa
assalaam alaika ay haram e ansar o aizza
alaikum minni salaam
aale syedunnisa dukhtrane murtaza
kehte thay shahe huda al firaq alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
aale syedunnisa al firaq alwida
dukhtrane murtaza al firaq alwida
kehte thay shahe huda al firaq alwida

aao zainab e hazeen dikhaye tum ko haale zaar

kalega barchi se chida hussain dekhta raha
al firaq alwida al firaq alwida

items.title: Ahle Aza Maahe Aza Agaya
items.body:
Kyu ye atey hai ashkbaar bohat
Kyu mera dil gai beqarar bohat
Wo mahina qareeb aa pohcha
Jiska tha mujhko intezar bohat
Ahle Aza Mahe Aza Agaya
Dil ye Mera Kyu Bhala Rone Laga
Dilbare Shere Khuda,
Ghar hai Hamara Khula,
Ham Hai Tumhare Gadaa.
Ye Chand Mahe Muharram Ka Jabse Nikla Hai,
Gharo Me Ghazi Ka Parcham Koi Lagata Hai,
Kahi sabeel pe pani koi pilata hai,
Deta hai rokar sada,
Aey Shahe Karbobala, lijiye pursa mera.
Kahi'n pa matam o majlis ka ahtemam hai ab
Kahi'n pa marsiya khwani kahi'n salaam hai ab
Hamara kaam to itna hi subh o shaam hai ab
Gham hai faqat shaah ka
Kuch nahi iske sewa
Kaam mera doosra
Khuda kare yunhi hoti rahe Azadari
Har ik jawa'n me rahe jazbaye alamdaari
Na ruk sake ye kabhi ho agar che bambaari
Hai yahi waada mera
Ghaazi mere baawafa
Koi nahi aapsa
Hussain farshe aza par jise bulaate hain
Ghar apna chodh ke wo majliso me aate hain
Duaayen fatima zahra se phir wo paate hain
Kahte hain ahle aza
Jaane dil Mustafa
Hai ye karam aapka
Main de raha hoon sakina ka waasta ghaazi
Bulalo mujhko bhi is baar karbala ghaazi
Tumhe sunana hai jo haal hai mera ghaazi
Aaun main jab karbala
Rauza ho bas aapka
Aur ye khaadim tera
Karo rabaab ke us bezabaan ka maatam
Zayeef baap ke kadyal jawaan ka maatam
Jo ban me lut gaya us khaandaan ka maatam
Ham shabihe Mustafa
Bas hai ye armaa'n mera
Dekhlun main karbala
Jo nauhakhwan ye padhte hain shaah ka nauha
To sar ko peet ke karte hain matami girya
Ghame hussain me baccho ko karte hain sadqa
Rahti hai lab par sada
Baaniye farshe aza
Aapka sad shukriya
Hai ye tumhara karam ham pe Zainabe muztar
Aza ka farsh bicha hai ghareeb khaane par
Sar apna kham kiye kahta hai baraha Haider
Bakht mera khul gaya
Aagyin ghar fatima
Lene ko ashke aza
Dil Ki sada Ya Hussain(a.s),
Gham ki Dawa Ya Hussain(a.s),
Humko Bulana Hussain(a.s),
Karbobala Ya Hussain(a.s)
Maar Ke seene pe Hath
Sab ne Kaha Ya Hussain(a.s)

items.title: Darmiyaan e Dar O Deewar pisi Hain Cheekhein
items.body:
Ummat se pareshaan muhammed ki Dulaari
Karti thi jigar tham ke bus girya o zari
Hasnain ko dekha kabhi haider ko pukari
Yeh Gham dil e zehra ke liye kitna tha bhari
Ankhoon mai dehekte hue ashko ki ladi thi
Be sakata mohsin jo mara cheekh padhi thi
Darmiyaan E Dar O Deewaar Pisi Hain Cheekhein
Ashk Ban Kar Kabhi Aankho'n Se Bahi Hain Cheekhein
Reza Reza Kahi Ik Phool Ka Bikhra Hai Wujood
Dheere Dheere Kisi Goshe Se Uthi Hain Cheekhein
Dhoondh kar dekh zara raakh mei mil jaayegi
Jalte darwaaze k hamraah jali hai cheekhein
Pasliya Chatkhi Thi Jis Lamhe Me Seydaani Ki
Usi Ik Lamhe Ki Sadyo'n Ne Suni Hain Cheekhein
Ho gaya larza bar-andaam moarrikh ka Qalam
Itni tareekh k kaanoN mei basi hain cheekhein
Jaise gir ke kahi taaza lahoo jamm jata hai
Daaman e waqt pa is tarha jamee hain cheekhein
Abr E Gham Toot Ke Barsa Hai Shikasta Dil Par
Tab Kahi Jaake Bahaaro Ki Thami Hain Cheekhein
Zakhm E Taaza Pa Naye Zakhm Ka Marham Rakh De
Abhi Zinda Hu Main Kuch Baaqi Abhi Hain Cheekhein

Mere Har Lafz Ke Pehloo Se Uthi Hain Cheekhein

items.title: Ghareebe karbala
items.body:
ya ghareebe karbala
ya ghareebe nainawa
haa qateele be-khata
ya zabeehe nainawa
<<DIVIDER>>
dashte bala mein aa ke ghera
mehman bula kar rukh apna phera
be-aab kar ke tumko sataya
alqama ro kar karti thi girya
ya ghareebe karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
aada ne tujhpe hai zulm dhaaya
darya kinare pehra lagaya
ro ro ke kehti thi ye sakina
mai bhi hoo pyasi tum bhi ho pyasa
ya ghareebe karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim o akbar bhi gaye maara
tanha khade hai ab shaahe waala
maara gaya sab godh ka paala
kaisi musibat ka hai ye lamha
ya ghareebe karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani ke badle maara hai payka
nehr hua hai masoom bacha
phat gaya sheh ka us dam kaleja
darya ki maujon ne ye pukara
ya ghareebe karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
teer o tabar aur khanjar o naiza
mein chup gaya haye wo pyasa
pushte farash pe mushkil hai rehna
asr ka mehshar aur sheh ka sajda
ya ghareebe karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
hae hae wo asghar cheh maah waala
ghutno ke bal bhi jo chal na paaya
uska badan jo naize pa dekha
baba ke sar se boli sakina
ya ghareebe karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
sattar qadam pe zainab e kubra
roti thi haye karti thi girya
koi bacha lo aake khudara
jalti zameen pe hota hai zibha
ya ghareebe karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
aqif o aazam manzar ajab tha
kaata gala jab hilta tha sehra
naize pe sar jo baap ka dekha
sajjad ro kar us dam pukara
ya ghareebe karbala...

items.title: Har durood aur har
items.body:
har durood aur har salaam
madare hussain tere naam

zaujaye ali e sar baland
fatema azeem arjumand
jiske aastane paak ke
qudsiyane arsh hai ghulam
har durood aur…

hai wo fatema wo fatema
aarzoo-e-qalb e mustufa

har durood aur…

kat raha tha farte shaahe deen
chal raha tha khanjare layeen
bibi aap dekhti rahi
lut gaye haram jalay khayaam
har durood aur…

har durood aur salam
khwahare hussain tere naam
<<DIVIDER>>
sani e janabe sayyeda
allah allah tera hausla
khoob ki hifazate haram
baad-e-qatle sayyede anaam
har durood aur…

bibi gham uthaye hai bahot
dil pe daagh khaaye hai bahot
tujpe ay hussain ki behan
hogayi musibatein tamaam
har durood aur…
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala mein apne dilruba
kardiye hussain par fida
aun aur mohamed e jari
hogaye shaheed e tashnakaam
har durood aur…
<<DIVIDER>>
daulate batool lut gayi
dukhtare rasool lut gayi
chin gayi saro se chadarein
jal gaye hussain ke qayam
har durood aur…
<<DIVIDER>>
mayyatein padi hai bekafan
kya kare hussain ki behan
bekasi aur aisi bekasi
shaam aur karbala ki shaam
har durood aur…
<<DIVIDER>>
inqilaabe waqt dekhiye
imtihane saqt dekhiye
sar khule rasool zadiyan
aur ahle shar ka ijtema
har durood aur…
<<DIVIDER>>
har durood aur salam
dukhtare hussain tere naam

shimr kibriya ka waasta

binte shaah be-gohar na thi
mubtela e gham hai tashnakaam
har durood aur…

shimr ke tamache khaye hai
bibi kitne gham uthaye hai
baap ki judaai kam na thi
tujpe qaid ke sitam khatam
har durood aur…
<<DIVIDER>>
bibi aap par sitam hue
mar gayi pidar ka gham liye
haaye jeete ji na chut saka
qaid qaanaye ameere shaam
har durood aur…

items.title: Haye shame ghariban
items.body:
din dhal gaya hai logon
ghar jal gaya hai logon
zainab ujad gayi hai
haye shaam e ghariban
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ke sar se dekho chadar bhi cheen li hai
bemaar ek jaan ko kaisi saza ye di hai
abid bhi ro raha hai daaman bhigo raha hai
zainab ujad gayi hai
haye shaam e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
loota hai zalimon ne zahra ke gulistan ko
dekho lage tamache nanhi si ek jaan ko
be-aasra sakina bhai padar bhi cheena
zainab ujad gayi hai
haye shaam e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe pe jaake baap ke kehti hai ye sakina
phir kab milega baba mujhko tera ye seena
dushman jahan hai mera cheena hai pyar tera
zainab ujad gayi hai
haye shaam e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaya sawaar koi qaimon mein ek hijab mein
poocha batool zaadi ne tu kaun hai naqaab mein
bole ali na ghabra ye kya hua hai batla
zainab ujad gayi hai
haye shaam e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
roke kaha ye zainab ne hum lut gaye hai baba
maidan e karbala mein hum mit gaye hai baba
haye zulm kya hua hai haye kya sitam hua hai
zainab ujad gayi hai
haye shaam e ghariban
<<DIVIDER>>
daaman kisi ka dekho aatish se jal raha hai
logon yehi sakina asghar se jo juda hai
bhai kisi ka bichda gulshan ali ka ujda
zainab ujad gayi hai
haye shaam e ghariban
<<DIVIDER>>
nasir ye shaam kaisi aayi hai karbala mein
kya kya musibaton ko laayi hai karbala mein
bhai bichad gaya hai ghar bhi ujad gaya hai
zainab ujad gayi hai
haye shaam e ghariban

items.title: Hussain ka dame
items.body:
haye hussain haye ghareeb

hussain ka dam e ruqsat ye tha sukhan zainab
chala mai ran ko khuda hafiz ay behan zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ab tumhare hawale tamaam ahle haram
ye honge baad mere qaidi e mehan zainab
hussain ka dame ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
chalega ab meri gardan pa shimr ka khanjar
rahegi laash meri ran mein bekafan zainab
hussain ka dame ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
bahot rulayenge zaalim meri sakina ko
galay mein uske bandhi jayegi rasan zainab
hussain ka dame ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
tadap tadap ke guzar jayegi wo zindan mein
kafan banega sakina ka pairahan zainab
hussain ka dame ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
lehad mein bhi na sukoon payega mera asghar
rahega naize pe sar khaak par badan zainab
hussain ka dame ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
aqeel qaimon mein ek hashr tha bapa us dam
kaha jo sheh ne khuda hafiz ay behan zainab
hussain ka dame ruqsat...

items.title: Jaane kaise thay
items.body:
pehchano musalmano mai fatema zehra hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
jaane kaise thay musalman ghar jalaane aagaye
baap ke jaate hi beti ko sataane aagaye
<<DIVIDER>>
qabr pe baba ke di ye ro ke beti ne sada
kis tarha badle musalman dekhiye ukda kusha
aap ke jaate hi mujhpe zulm dhaane aagaye
jaane kaise thay musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis khadar jaldi thi unko aap ki ruqsat ke saath
ahle baatil ek jaa ho kar yahan shiddat ke saath
jalta darwaza mere uar giraane aagaye
jaane kaise thay musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha in aankhon ne kya kya al amaan o al hafeez
is qadar badla zamana al amaan o al hafeez
hyder e karraar ko qaidi banane aagaye
jaane kaise thay musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ki beti kahan aur zulm ki shiddat kahan
ehteram e fatema zehra ke badle baba jaan
aap ki beti ka haye dil dukhaane aagaye
jaane kaise thay musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ko deti rahi awaaz ye khasta jigar
ya nabi allah lije aake dukhiya ki khabar
fatema ko kalmago durra lagaane aagaye
jaane kaise thay musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis khadar dushwaar hota hai bichadne baap ka
haq to ye tha ghamzada ko dete pursa baap ka
pursa dene ke bajaye khoon rulaane aagaye
jaane kaise thay musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
aalam e islam ka dastoor ehsan hai yehi
uske ghar chula na roshan ho jahan guzre koi
hum thay ghar mein aur stiamgar ghar jalane aagaye
jaane kaise thay musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
dayam o yazdan tha ek ghamkhwar ka ye marsiya
baba jaan kya aap roothe lut gaya mera jahan
baani e mushkil meri mushkil badhane aagaye
jaane kaise thay musalman...

items.body:
jis dam dulhan ne laash ke tukdon pe ki nigaah

qadmon pe sar jhuka ke pukari wo rashk e maa

jis dam dulhan ne...

boli na thi hijab se taqseer waar hoo

items.body:
zulm jab bhi tha ab bhi hai mujh par yahan
baba jaan baba jaan

kar rahi hai lehad se sakina fughan
baba jaan baba jaan

jald bhijwaiye ab alamdaar ko
badla lena hai karbal ke ghamkhwar ko

ye wohi nasl hai jisne baysheer ki

ab mazaaron ko todenge zaalim yahan

tod daali lehad tere ghamkaar ki
hujr ki bhi lehad aur ammar ki

zulm jo dha rahe hai ye salfi hai sab

khoon nikalta tha kaano se jab bhi mere

kar rahi hai lehad se...

shimr ne tab bhi maare tamache mujhe
taaziyane lagaye thay durre mujhe
baaliyan khenchi kaano se khoon tha rawan

kar rahi hai lehad se...

hashmi ne ye ro ro ke nauha kaha
padke irfan bhi nauha rone laga
rone walon ko dengi dua dadi jaan

items.title: Kehti hai khud

nana hamari peet pe durro ke ye nishan

nana utha janaza meri maa ka raat mein

<<DIVIDER>>
abid tha is tarha thi musalsal ye bediyan
ab paon thar-tharate hai zanjeer ke baghair
kehti hai khud amariyan...

items.title: Laut kar aajao
items.body:
qaime ke darwaze se ye di sakina ne sada
laut kar aajao wapas ho kahan ammu
ho gaya pardes mein ab jurm pani maangna
laut kar aajao waapas ho kahan ammu

hoo khadi qaime ke dar par khaali kooza thaam kar
pyaas ki shiddat nahi seh paungi mai lamha bhar
phat'ta hai gham se jigar aur khushk hai mera gala

yaad ab aate hai mujhko guzre jo yasrab mein din
saamne rakhte thay pani kuch zuban se bole bin
lamha bhar bhi pyaas ka ehsaas na hone diya

ho gaya maloom ab to pyaas kehte hai kise
kya khabar thi din ye mujhko bhi padenge dekhne
char saala umr mein ye dard hai sehna pada
laut kar aajao wapas...

paas aate thay hamesha meri ek aawaz par
dekh kar hairaan hoo ab badle se andaaz par
kyun nahi aate palat kar kya hui mujhse khata
laut kar aajao wapas...
<<DIVIDER>>
kho na jaaye pyaas ki in wadiyon mein hum kahin
lag raha hai ab banegi shaam tak turbat yahin
daalne turbat pe pani aaoge kya ab chacha
laut kar aajao wapas...
<<DIVIDER>>
sabr rakhe kis tarha se bhai bhi cheh maah ka
pani maange kis tahra se bhai bhi cheh maah ka
chand lamhon mein hai lagta aayegi usko qaza
laut kar aajao wapas...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai bujha'ungi chacha jaan apne hi ashkon se pyaas
hai dua ke jald aao khairiyat se mere paas
ab kabhi na pyaas ka shikwa karungi ba-khuda
laut kar aajao wapas...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap hote to munaver hoti meri kayenaat
aap ke bin ho gayi hai ab andheri kayenaat
likh ke ye nauha najaf bhi karta hai aah o buka
laut kar aajao wapas...

items.title: Mai uthata raha wo bikharta raha
items.body:
Aaye jis waqt aseeron me wo tadfeen ke baad
Roke karte the yai aabide muztar faryaad
Aisi haalat me tha laasha Abbas ka,
Mai uthata raha wo bikharta raha - 2
Dadi Zahra ki paamal thi yu dua
Mai uthata raha wo bikharta raha
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Maine chaha ke mayyat ko yakjaa rahe
Apne haathon se baazu chacha ke chune
Pattharon se laaeno ne maara unhe
tukde tukde muje baazu unke mile
Ek baazu bhi unka salamat na tha
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Chaar su laash unki yu mujko mili
Jaise mayyat thi qasim ki bikhri hui
babajaan ne aba me use chunliya
ye bhi mumkin na tha haaye gurbat meri
Ek qaidi tha mai kaise laata aba
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Apni haalat karu kis tarha se bayaan
Ek manzar pe meri bandhi hichkiya
pehluon per yu naizo ke kuch waar the
Yaad dadi ki aane lagi pasliya
yu shikasta tha laasha sambhalta na tha
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Daayen jaanib se mayyat uthayi agar
Baayi jaanib kiya haddiyon ne safar
laash paamal lashkar ne is tarha ki
Sher ke tukde tukde hui thi qamar
Mere kaandhon pe laasha sambhal na saka
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Run me ladte hue zeen se jab gira
Sar juda tan juda dono baazu juda
Mera battees barso ka kadyal jawaan
6 mahine ke asgar ke jitna bacha
Usko ghodo ne paamal aise kiya
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Teer se jis ghadi run me paani baha
Aisa lagta tha ghazi ko aayi qaza
Misle ghazi tha mashkiza Abbas ka
na wo khayme gaya na ye khayme gaya
bawafa ka tha mashkiza bhi bawafa
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Qaafela laut kar jab madine gaya
Haye akbar ye ummul baneen ne kaha
Mera Abbas maqtal me kaise lada
Beta Sajjad kya haal laashe ka tha
Roke sajjad bas ye hi kehta raha

dekhti thi bano e dilgeer hasrat se mujhe

ho sada rehaan o safdar ki sar e karbobala

aap agar aa jaate baba ghudkiyan khaati na dukhtar
aap agar aa jaate baba...

items.title: Abbas ka matam
items.body:
Abbas ka matam
Abbas Ka Matam Hai Alamdar Ka Matam...
Farzande Ali Haidare Karrar ka matam...Abbas(a.s) Hai shabbir (a.s) khaimo ke nigehba,
saalar hai lashkar ke to bachho ke nigehba,
parde ke muhafiz hai ye behno ke nigehba,
(Daryaa ka kinara hai)..(2)
Wafadar ka matam
lashkar ke alamdar pe lashkar ki nazar hai
abbas ke jazbat pe sarwar ki nazar hai
is sher ke ehsas pe ghar bhar ki nazar hai
(Daryaa ka kinara hai)..(2)
Wafadar ka matam
Abbas ko ladne ki ijazat na milegi
is sher ko jeene mein bhi rahat na milegi
mar jaae to phir daade shuja'at na milegi
(Daryaa ka kinara hai)..(2)
Wafadar ka matam
pani se bhari mashk ko kandhe pe sambhala,
rehwar ko dariya ki rawani se nikala,
dushman ki safe cheer ke nikla hai jiyala
(Daryaa ka kinara hai)..(2)
Wafadar ka matam
Abbas ne shabbir ko ek baar pukara
khaime mein meri laash na pohche mere aaqa
sharminda sakina se hua jaata hu maula
(Daryaa ka kinara hai)..(2)
Wafadar ka matam
Asgar Kabhi pyasi nazar aati hai sakina
ammu ko nazar bhar ke bulati hai sakina
abbas se pyas apni chhupati hai sakina
(Daryaa ka kinara hai)..(2)
Wafadar ka matam
dariya hai jaha zero zabar sher ka matam
haider ki tamanna ka sharar sher ka matam
abbas ka matam hai magar sher ka matam
(Daryaa ka kinara hai)..(2)
Wafadar ka matam

saanson mein rawan parcham e ghazi ki hawa hai

mai hoo ghairat ka khuda
mai hoo zehra ki dua
mai alamdare wafa
mai hoo zainab ki rida
saani e shere khuda hoo mai
alamdar hoo mai
alamdare lashkare...

mai ali ki hoo dua
mai alamdare wafa
mai sakina ka chacha
apni taqleeq mein allah ka shaah-kaar hoo mai
alamdare lashkare...

hashr kardoonga bapa

alamdare lashkare...

items.title: Jis ka Nahi Ghadeer Pe Emaan Ya Ali
items.body:
Jis Ka Nahi Ghadeer Pe Emaan Ya Ali
Jis ka nahi Ghadeer pe emaan ya Ali
Kaise my usko maano musalman ya Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Wo jo huwa tha barsare maidaan ya ali
Behroon ne bhi suna tha wo ailaan ya ali
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Utaah wo kehke laash e Salman ya ali
Niklegi kaise aise meri jaan ya ali
<<DIVIDER>>
3. ALLAH Sarfaraz rakhe unko ta-abad
Hum aaj jinke ghar me hai mehman ya ali
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Dushman hai tera jo bhi wo ibne qaseer hai
Tere liye Nabi ka hai farmaan ya Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Kadmo me hai pade huwe jiske tamaam taaj
Hain aap us Hussain ke Sultan ya Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Khushbu Najaf ki aati us sar Zameen se
Jaata hu jab main Shehr e Khurasan ya Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Maidaan se bhaag jane ka jinka plan tha
Qambar ne unse le liye paaran ya Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Salman bole mimber e paalan dekh kar
Aisa kaha tha Taqt e Sulaiman ya Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Thanda kiya hai aapka dil jisne mai use
Karne Salam jaunga kashaan ya Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Kausar ki aayate teri zauja ki rukshati
Zahra hai tera Surah e Rahman ya Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
11. Khanjar uthaye hath me qatil hai bad hawas
Mesum nahi zara bhi pareshan ya Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
12. Adam se taba Isa hai sab hi qataar me
Rakh le hame kahi pe bhi darmaan ya Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
13. Dosh e Rasul e Paak pe phir jalwa gar ho aap
Phir todne hai konse Bhagwaan ya Ali

items.title: Kar rahi thi sakina
items.body:
kar rahi thi sakina fughan
kyun nahi aaye ay baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
kaan se chin gayi baaliyan
kyun nahi aaye ay baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
seh ke shaam e ghariban ki uftaad ko
lab hilaye phupi ne jo fariyad ko
unke baba chale aaye imadad ko
koi sunta nahi meri rudaad ko
kar rahi hoon mai kab se fughan
kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye ghurbat mein saare sahare gaye
pusht par taziyane bhi maare gaye
chadrein chin gayi goshware gaye
al-madad al-madad hum pukare gaye
goonjti reh gayi siskiyan
kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
seh liya ammu jaise fidayi ka gham
asghare bezaban jaise bhai ka gham
jaan lelega daaghe judaai ka gham
aur sitam dar sitam beridayi ka gham
haye baandhi gayi reesma
kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
jin se dhaaras thi mujhko wo saare gaye
aur phupi jaan ke dono dulaare gaye
saare hamdard maqtal mein maare gaye
is aziyat se gohar utaare gaye
khoon hai kaano se ab tak rawan
kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kahe hum ye kya kya jafa hogayi
jo jafa hogayi bekhata hogayi
hadh ye hai zulm ki inteha hogayi
hai aale nabi berida hogayi
durre khaata raha natawan
kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
phande rassi ke gardan mein kaste rahe
phusht par taziyane baraste rahe
dekh kar hum ko kuffaar haste rahe
aah karne ko bhi hum taraste rahe
har qadam thi nayi sakhtiyan
kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaunsa hai sitam jo na dhaaya gaya
hum ko kaanto pe paidal chala gaya
berida karke dar dar phiraya gaya
aur bazaar mein hum ko laaya gaya
dil se uth'ta hai gham ka dhuaan
kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
humko kitna sataya gaya be-sabab
haye darbar mein hum ko ghere thay sab
dha rahe thay sitamgaar ye bhi ghazab
kar rahe thay kaneezi mein mujhko talab
haye gham se nikalti thi jaan
kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ko bazaar se bhi guzara gaya
saath bemaar e gham besahara gaya
haye be-maut yun humko maara gaya
naam lekar phupi ka pukara gaya
kya qayamat ka tha wo samaan
kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
apni aagosh mein leke baba ka sar
waqte rehlat sakina hui nauhagar
aamir o fakhri bole shahe behrobar
tha mai hamraah naize pe laqte jigar
ab na ro kar karo ye bayan
kyun nahi aaye...

items.title: kehti hai sakina
items.body:
(Kehti hai sakina ×4)
(Alatash ki sada e deti hai)
(Kehti hai sakina×2)
(1) Tab tum gaye dariya par,
Wapas nahi aye
pyasa hai mera asghar(a.s)
pyase hai wo pyaree
intezar jo karti ho aao na chacha jaan
(Kehti hai sakina ×4)
(2) kehti thi phuphi meri,
ayenge chacha jaan
deti thi dilasa mujhe,
meri phuphi amma
sabr karo aye jaan ayenge chacha jaan
(Kehti hai sakina ×4)
(3) baba nazar ane lage,
aap ka alam bhi
tab bhi meri ek aas,
ammu nahi tooti
afsous hai ammu tum bhi tho na aye na
(Kehti hai sakina ×4)
(4) ammu tumhare baad,
Kya kya na wo guzre
Shamiyou ne akaar,

items.title: Karam Maangta hai
items.body:
karam mangta hai Ata mangta hai
Bina MURTAZA k tu kya mangta hai
ATa kese ho tjhe pe shan e karimi
kary tujh pe kese wo apni rahimi
jo hai SYEDA khud dua MUSTAFA KI
usy chor kar tu Dua mangta hai
jahan per khuda hai wahi MUSTAFA hay
jahan MUSTAFA hai wahi MURTAZA hai
ALI k bina to NABI na mily ga
Ali K bina tu KHUDA mangta hai
Wo dar jisse rahib ko daulat mili hai
Wahi per se fitrus ko izzat mili hai
Ata apni rakhdi jaha per khuda ne
Wo dar chhodkar tu ata maangta hai
wafa ko sikhay salika wafa ka
sabaq jis ne baksha jahan ko haya ka
mily kese tjh ko haya bhi wafa bhi
ALAM chor kar tu wafa mangta hai
Ye jannat ke maalik ye kauthar ke maalik
Ye deene nabi k ye mimbar k maalik
Bina panjtan ke dua tujo maange
Dua wo kaha baddua maangta hai
Tu kehta hai jinko nabi ke barabar
Wo sab hai bhikhari hai bagi sitamgar
Jo haq chin khaaye nabi k haram ka
Tu aise fakiro se kya maangta hai
Elahi ye kaisa kada waqt aaya
Wo jisne zamane ko parda sikhaya
Wo gairat ka rab hai jo begayrato me
Har ek mod per bas rida maangta hai
Wo ghar se chala tha to kadyal jawan tha
Wo baazaar pohcha jawan fir kaha tha
Wo hai saath jiske wo maaye wo behne
Wo marne ki harpal dua maangta hai

items.title: Abbas ka parcham
items.body:
abbas ka parcham hai alamdar ka parcham
uncha hai mere sayyed o sardar ka parcham
<<DIVIDER>>
parcham mere murshid ka jo ghar ghar pe laga hai
ye saare azadaron pe zehra ki ataa hai
is parchame abbas ko zainab ki dua hai
kaun isko jhukayega bhala kis mein hai ye dum
uncha hai mere...
abbas ka parcham hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghazi ka sakina se wafa ka hai ye aalam
parcham se juda mashk hai na mashk se parcham
jaise kisi baazu pe ho taweez muqaddam
ye bali sakina ki dua saath hai har dum
uncha hai mere...
abbas ka parcham hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
matam na ruka tha na ruka hai na rukega
parcham na jhuka tha na jhuka hai na jhukega
har lehza julooson ki qayadat ye karega
ho koi faza koi waba koi bhi mausam
uncha hai mere...
abbas ka parcham hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
parcham ye mareezon ko shifa baant raha hai
dunya ko mohabbat ki fiza baant raha hai
aulaad makan rizq o wafa baant raha hai
kya fikr ho dunya ki hamay kya ho bhala gham
uncha hai mere...
abbas ka parcham hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye baat hai bachpan ki mujhe yaad abhi bhi
har aat moharram ko jo baba se kahi thi
ye parcham e abbas uthana hai mujhe bhi
kuch saath mera di jiye hai umr meri kam
uncha hai mere...
abbas ka parcham hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
manzar ye julooson mein nazar aata hai hum ko
tasleem kiya sab ne isi jood o karam ko
sar jhukta nahi uska uthaye jo alam ko
ye naara lagate hai kabhi aap kabhi hum
uncha hai mere...
abbas ka parcham hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
haan mazhar o farhan nazar aayega ek din
maula ka alam kaabe pe lehrayega ek din

abbas ka parcham hai...

amma mai thak chuka hoon laashe utha utha ke

yun maarte hai zaalim mujhko rula rula ke
amma mai thak chuka...

maidan se mujhko jis dam abbas ne pukara

darya pe jaa raha tha mai sar jhuka jhuka ke
amma mai thak chuka...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar meri nazar ki beenayi le gaye thay
gir gir ke poochta tha beta mera kidhar hai
wo mujhko dhoondta tha gardan utha utha ke
amma mai thak chuka...

do bhanjon ke mere jab ran se aaye laashe
zainab ne laadlon ke jis waqt paaye laashe
sajde wo kar rahi thi aansu baha baha ke
amma mai thak chuka...

amma meri nazar mein manzar wo chaa rahe hai
bacchi pe meri aada yun zulm dhaa rahe hai
pani baha rahe hai us ko dikha dikha ke
amma mai thak chuka...
<<DIVIDER>>
guzrenge aur masayib meri behan ke upar
aankhon mein phir raha hai ye dardnaak manzar
wo sham ja rahi hai nauhe suna suna ke
amma mai thak chuka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay shadman o majid kaise padhe ye manzar
jab halq rakh rahi thi zehra gulu e sheh par
gardan jhuka jhuka ke khanjar hata hata ke
amma mai thak chuka...

items.title: Ay akbar ye sehra
items.body:

akbar mera sehriyan waala akbar

tujhe naaz se aise paala phupi ne

shahe deen ye laashe pe kehte hai ro kar

ay akbar ye sehra...

har ek subha maadar ne jab tujhko dekha

ay akbar ye sehra...

tadapte huwe keh rahi hai ye maadar

ay akbar ye sehra...

tha izhaar aur shadman gham ka manzar

items.title: Ay warise adam
items.body:
ay waaris e adam teri qurbaniyan
farzande fatema teri qurbaniyan
<<DIVIDER>>
ya hussain teri qurbani ki sunnat koi bhi kar na saka
teer par teer bhi kha kar tu dua deta raha
aisi anmol ibadat koi bhi kar na saka
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak ko khaake shifa tu ne kiya ek taraf
ek taraf aayi ye awaaz e shehenshahe najaf
tu ne maidan e jafa ko laaeq e sajda kiya
ek maidan ko jannat koi bhi kar na saka
ya hussain teri qurbani...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhse bayyat ka taqaza jo layeeno ne kiya
tu ne baatil ke taqazon ka jawab aisa diya
ban gaya qaari e quran bar sare noke sina
aur phir aisi tilawat koi bhi kar na saka
ya hussain teri qurbani...
<<DIVIDER>>
subhe se shaam talak laashein uthaye thay magar
yun lada jang ke maidan mein hyder ka pisar
dasht laashon se sajaya keh uthe jinn o bashar
pyasa reh kar bhi ye himmat koi bhi kar na saka
ya hussain teri qurbani...
<<DIVIDER>>
khud raha pyasa magar pyason ko sairaab kiya
zarf maula tere jaisa kahin dekha na suna
hurr ko seene se lagaya to yehi hurr ne kaha
aisi insan se mohabbat koi bhi kar na saka
ya hussain teri qurbani...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere hone se azaan hai tere hone se namaz
tere sajde se mila deen e mohamed ko faraaz
har dhadakte huwe dil ki hai yehi ek awaaz
yun dilon par to hukumat koi bhi kar na saka
ya hussain teri qurbani...
<<DIVIDER>>
faqr e adam bhi tu hi hai faqr e hyder bhi tu hi
naazish e ahle haram naazish e daawar bhi tu hi
tu hi sardar e jina hai aur kausar bhi tu hi
khud ko aaeena e aayat koi bhi kar na saka
ya hussain teri qurbani...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyasa darya ke kanare se alamdar chala
kat gaye baazu magar nazron mein asghar hi raha
mashk se pani gaya aur deen se ghazi gaya
ye wafayein ye ata'at koi bhi kar na saka
ya hussain teri qurbani...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek mastoor ne mushkil mein bada kaam kiya
teri mazloomi ka parchaar sar e aam kiya
khud to be-ghar hui ghar ghar tera paigham diya
is tarha teri himayat koi bhi kar na saka
ya hussain teri qurbani...
<<DIVIDER>>
shadman hogayi zehra jo qalam chalta raha
apne alfazon mein pursa tu unhe deta raha
raat din nauhe jo mazhar ro ke tu likhta raha
zikre sheh mein ye riyazat koi bhi kar na saka
ya hussain teri qurbani...

items.title: Ek natiqe quran
items.body:
ay natiq e quran ya maula
ay waaris e quran ya maula
<<DIVIDER>>
ek natiq e quran naize par quran sunata jaata hai
aur waaris e quran marqad mein khaak udaata jaata hai
<<DIVIDER>>
quran e masayeb ke sar se juzdaan utaare jaate hai
ek ek aayat ke seene mein khanjar jo utaare jaate hai
quran ke haafiz ke haathon quran jalaya jaata hai
ek natiq e quran...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek chota sa quran abhi naize pe jo maine dekha hai
seh pehlu teer se us ka gala takbeer suna kar cheda hai

ek natiq e quran...

quran sifat wo do bacche jo doshe nabi ke raakib thay

quran ka parda rakhna hai ay umme abiha teri tarha

items.title: Haye wo asr ka
items.body:
haye wo asr ka hangaam wo maidan e bala

items.title: Jis waqt teer khakar
items.body:
QANJAR SE LIPAT JAATI THI YE KEHKE SAYYEDA
AY SHIMR KARDE REHAM MERA LAAL BEQATA
BABA KA DEKE WAASTA SAMJHAATI THI ZEHRA
JISKE GALE KO CHUMTE REHTE THE PAYAMBAR
QANJAR CHALAA RAHA HAI USI PAR YE SITAMGAR
TEERON SE AUR NAIZON SE CHALNI HUA SEENA
FARZANDE ALI SABR KA PAIKAR HAI QAAK PAR
LO AAJ HAAI SIBTE PAYAMBAR HAI QAAK PAR
BAALON SE JHAADTI THI ZAMEE FATHIMA ZEHRA
UMMAT NE AJR AISE DI BANDAE KAMAAL KO
PAANI NA MILAA SAAKHIYE KAUSAR KE LAAL KO
SAR PEETKE KARTE THE ALI DASHT ME FUGAA
BETON KA BHATEEJON KA KABHI BHAI KA LASHA
HAATHON PE APNE LAAYE THE ASGAR KA JANAAZA
DENE DILAASA KAUN BACHA DASHT ME BHALA
HONE KO AB HAI BHAI BEHEN ME BHI JUDAAI
BEPARDA BEHEN HOYEGI QANJAR TALE BHAI
QOO RONE LAGI DAR PE QADI ZAINABE KUBRA
QANJAR HAI NAIZE TEGH TABAR TEER SHORO SHAIN
TANHA QADAA HAI ZULM KE AAGOSH ME HUSSAIN
KAUNO MAKAA ME ASR KO KOHRAAM THA BARPA
NAAZON SE JISKO PAALI THI CHAKKI KO PEESKAR
WO LAAL AAJ ZAKHMI HAI JALTI ZAMEE PAR
GHAM SE HI PHATAA HOGA MAADAR KA KALAIJA
DARIYA PE JAAKE KEHTI THI AAJA AY DILAAWAR
PAAMAL HORAHA HAI MOQTAL ME BIRAADAR
SAAHIL PE TADAPTA THA ALAMDAAR KA LASHA
NAZRON ME MAA KE APNE LAADLE KI HAI MAYYAT
ALTHAF-O-ALI HAI YE QAYAAMAT KI MUSIBAT
MAJBOOR MAA KO KAISE SAMBHAALEGI KARBALA…

items.title: Kehti rahi sakina
items.body:
kehti rahi sakina beemar saarban se
hogi rehaai mar ke bhaiya meri zindan se
<<DIVIDER>>
is kaal kothari mein hai zulm ka andhera
mujhe chod ke na jao dam ghut raha hai mera
asghar ki tarha mai bhi bichdi hoo aaj maa se
kehti rahi sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai daagh tamachon ke mehshar talak rahenge
bhaiya yateem ho ke kab tak sitam sahenge
masoom poochti thi beemar natawan se
kehti rahi sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
durr cheen kar kamina raahon mein keh raha tha
thay kaan mere zakhmi aur khoon beh raha tha
roti ho kyun lipat kar abbas ke nishan se
kehti rahi sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
aulaad waale mil ke insaaf khud kare wo
jin betiyon ke baba pardes jaa maray wo
roti nahi bichad kar kya apne baba jaan se
kehti rahi sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ko yaad kar ke zindan mein ro rahi hai
seene pe sone waali matti pe so rahi hai
kya jurm ho gaya tha masoom nanhi jaan se
kehti rahi sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad ne janaza zindan se jab uthaya
afsos saath koi hai kalmago na aaya
aisa sulook koi karta nahi mehman se
kehti rahi sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
tareekh ke muarrikh insaaf se batayein
masoom ko mili hai kis jurm ki sazayein
sardar poochta hai har ek musalman se
kehti rahi sakina...
items.author: Sardar

items.title: Koi aisa mujahid
items.body:
koi aisa mujahid to dikhade
galay par teer kha kar muskurade
<<DIVIDER>>
badi mushkil hai koi baap kaise
jawan bete ko marne ki riza de
koi aisa mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
charaghe zindagi bujhta hai laila
ali akbar ko daaman ki hawa de
koi aisa mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha shabbir ne ay khuwwate dil
jawan laashe ali akbar utha de
koi aisa mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
riza e jang de kar shaah bole
ajal qasim ko ab dulha bana de
koi aisa mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
ali akbar ko hichki lag rahi hai
koi ab to isay pani pilaade
koi aisa mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
bade jallaad hai ye shaam wale
badal sakte nahi inke iraade
koi aisa mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
sare zainab ki chadar chin chuki hai
ghubare khaak uth chehra chupa de
koi aisa mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
lagi hai aag bistar jal raha hai
koi bemaar ka shana hilaade
koi aisa mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
guzar bazaar se hai bekaso ka
koi in shaam walon ko hatade
koi aisa mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
bhare darbar mein jaati hai zainab
zara ay khuwwate dil hausla de
koi aisa mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
sakina se yateemi keh rahi hai
charaghe ashk zindan mein jala de
koi aisa mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
koi kaaton pe paidal chal raha hai
zaheer ab raah mein aankhein bicha de
koi aisa mujahid…
items.author: Zaheer Jaffery

items.title: Maidan mein hussain
items.body:
maidan mein hussain ka ghamkhar gir pada
alamdar gir pada
shane kata ke ghode se jarrar gir pada
alamdar gir pada
<<DIVIDER>>
dikhla gaya bahare wafa jaane murtaza
dooba hua lahoo mein hai armane murtaza
hai paara paara nehr pe qurane murtaza
fauje khuda ka haye alamdar gir pada
alamdar gir pada…
<<DIVIDER>>
tanha hussain hogaye yawar nahi raha
tashna labon mein saaqiye kausar nahi raha
bibi sakina amme ghazanfar nahi raha
fauje khuda ka haye alamdar gir pada
alamdar gir pada…
<<DIVIDER>>
thar-ra uthega gham se biyaban e karbala
royegi khoon shame ghariban e karbala
rassi mein baandhe jayenge mehman e karbala
fauje khuda ka haye alamdar gir pada
alamdar gir pada…
<<DIVIDER>>
darya-e-zindagi ka kinara nahi raha
be-aas bibyan hai sahara nahi raha
tha dil ko jis se chain wo pyara nahi raha
fauje khuda ka haye alamdar gir pada
alamdar gir pada…
<<DIVIDER>>
zarraate karbala ba alam bolne lage
abbas ke firaq mein aansu ubhal pade
shabbir kis tarha ali fitrat ye gham sahe
fauje khuda ka haye alamdar gir pada
alamdar gir pada…
items.author: Ali Fitrat

items.title: Aap Ki Beti Nay Baba Madinay
items.body:
Aap ki beti nay baba Madinay walo ka her ek sitam uthaya hai .
<<DIVIDER>>
Sani)
Kabhi mara geya tamacho say kabhi darwaza gira ker zakhm gehra mujhay lagaya hai..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Aap nay ruk kay jahan Aaya e Tatheer perhi Aur tazeem bhi ki
Mujh ko lagta hai jaisay umat nay ghar ka darwaza jala kay Aap ki yad ko jalaya hai ..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Mujh pay jalta hua darwaza jis waqt gira Mu kay bal baba giri
Dar kay neechay thi aap ki beti jaltay darwazay say baba mujh ko Fiza nay aa bachaya hai..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Hai yaqeen zer e lehad Ahmad e mursal roye aur tarpay hon gay
Lamha ek baap nay saha kaisay jis ghari Bint e Nabi ka kalma goyon nay ghar jalaya hai .
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Tazeyana meray bazu pay jis waqt laga Karbala yaad aae
Mujh ko mehsoos aisay honay laga jaisay Abbas kay bazu kaat kay zeen say giraya hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Meray ronay say pareshaan madinay walay mujh ko ronay na diya
Shehar say door meray ronay ko hakim e waqt nay Baba aik Bait ul Huzan banaya hai .
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Isi ek baat pay rotay zamanay walay dukh Samar hai is ka
Jis ko Khair ul Nisa kaha Rab nay jo Mohammad ka thi tukra us ko darbar main jhutlaya hai .
<<DIVIDER>>
