items.title: Abbas ka sar
items.body:
haye abbas haye haye abbas
ghairat ka aasman zainab ka sayeban
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise zainab ki taraf dekhta abbas ka sar
sharm se khaak pe girta raha abbas ka sar
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam ke logon ne pathar se kiya isteqbal
jun hi bazar mein daakhil hua abbas ka sar
kaise zainab ki taraf...
<<DIVIDER>>
yun bhi is sar se liya badr o ohad ka badla
hoo ba hoo baba ali jaisa tha abbas ka sar
kaise zainab ki taraf...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo sina par bhi na aaqa ke barabar aaya
sheh ki ta'zeem mein jhukta raha abbas ka sar
kaise zainab ki taraf...
<<DIVIDER>>
paon ke aabile abid ko kahan yaad rahe
jab gira garm zameen par gira abbas ka sar
kaise zainab ki taraf...
<<DIVIDER>>
yun bhi baandha gaya rahwaar ki gardan se isay
zulm nazdeek se dekhe zara abbas ka sar
kaise zainab ki taraf...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehle chadar se lahoo saaf kiya zainab ne
saath asbaab ke jis dam mila abbas ka sar
kaise zainab ki taraf...
<<DIVIDER>>
nehr pe jis ghadi abbas ne dam toda tha
dilbar e zahra ki godhi mein tha abbas ka sar
kaise zainab ki taraf...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad zeeshan sar e shere khuda aane laga
gurz se aise shikasta hua abbas ka sar
kaise zainab ki taraf...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Ahsantum ya husain
items.body:
naize pe gaye jab shaah e umam
sar peet rahe thay ahle haram
sadaat mein ek bezaari thi
kohraam tha aur gham khwari thi
jab shaah ne yeh manzar dekha
sar peet rahe hai aal e aba
shabbir ne pad ke bismillah
bar nok e sina quran padha
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch dayr mein phir manzar badla
kam hone lagi matam ki sada
khush rang fizayein chaane lagi
ahsan ki sadayein aane lagi
pahunchi jo falak tak sheh ki sada
allah ne bhi khush ho ke kaha
ahsantum ya hussain
ahsantum ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
arwaah mein jo waada tha kiya
wo tum ne nibhaya hai
islam ki khaatir jangal mein
ghar apna lutaaya hai
raazi hoon mai tujhse mere wali
ay ibne batool ay ibne ali
karta hoon mai tera shukr ada
ahsantum ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunkar ye sukhan allah ke
kehte thay ye rasool allah
qurban mai tujh par sau jaan se
waah mere hussaina waah
bachpan mein ay mere lakhte jigar
waada jo kiya tha ay dilbar
wo tum ne kiya hai aaj wafa
ahsantum ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
naize ki ani par aa kar bhi
quran sunaya hai
hum jeet gaye sar de kar bhi
dunya ko bataya hai
dekhi jo shuja’at bete ki
aur sun ke tilawat bete ki
hyder ki najaf se aayi sada
ahsantum ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ne kaha ay laal tujhe
tanha na karungi mai
jayega agar tu shaam talak
to saath chalungi mai
hai naaz bahot tujh par beta
jo sheer pilaaya tha us ka
kya khoob kiya hai farz ada
ahsantum ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya khoob fareeza ay bhai
anjaam diya tum ne
jo kaam na koi kar paata
wo kaam kiya tum ne
shabbir se kehte thay ye hassan
bas ab na karo tum ranj o mehan
hai zaat tumhari fakhre khuda
ahsantum ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas dilawar aun o mohamed
qasim o akbar hai
naizon pe sar e shabbir ke sang
shohda ke kate sar hai
aankhon se rawan hai ashk magar
hai saare shaheedon ke lab par
hum aap pe ho har baar fida
ahsantum ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi zameen e karbobala
gumnaam zameen thi mai
lagta tha kumail o aamir
dunya pe nahi thi mai
pehchaan dilaayi sarwar ne
kya shaan badhaayi sarwar ne
ta hashr yehi hai meri sada
ahsantum ya hussain...
items.author: Kumail Jafri

items.title: Amma mera sar
items.body:
jab sar e hussain kat ke khaak pe gira
aa rahi thi shaah ke badan se ye sada
maa haye maa haye maa
<<DIVIDER>>
maa tumhari godh mein ab hussain kaise soyega
amma mera sar nahi raha
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ki tum nazar utaarti rahi ho maa
aankhein wo kahan wo mera chehra ab kahan
zulfein tum sawaarti thi kitne pyar se
maatha kaise choomogi hussain ka yahan
hasratein nikalogi aaj kaise khud batao na
amma mera sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr kaat'ta tha amma jab mera dahan
kuch qadam se dekhti rahi meri behen
baalon se utha ke sar wo saath le gaya
khaak par tadapta reh gaya mera badan
mere khushk halq par khanjar itni dayr tak chala
amma mera sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
amma koi kurta le gaya hussain ka
koi khoon bhara amaama le gaya mera
ungli meri kaat di angoothi ke liye
dekho ab mere badan pe kuch nahi bacha
loot'te rahe mujhe shamiyon ko jab pata chala
amma mera sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmi hoke jab zameen par gira hussain
pyasa mar gaya tumhara laadla hussain
dafn kar chuka hoon apne sheerkhwar ko
dekho ek din mein kitna thak chuka hussain
haath bhai ke kate seena chid gaya jawan ka
amma mera sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
chaar saal jisko maine pyar se rakha
kha chuki hai aaj wo tamacha shimr ka
kurta jal chuka hai chin gayi hai baaliyan
baba tum kahan ho de rahi hai wo sada
ab sakina dasht mein kaise dhoondegi badan mera
amma mera sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab aayegi jab amma meri laash par
wo yahin giregi bhai bhai bol kar
pattharon ko laash se wo jab hatayegi
chaahta tha dekh loon behen ko ek nazar
haye hasrata magar mai behen ko kaise dekhunga
amma mera sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zeeshan abidi ye goonji dasht mein sada
beta tere paas aagayi hai fatema
maa to maa hai godh mein utha legi tujhe
sar nahi to kya hua badan to hai tera
soja meri godh mein dekh maa se ab na bolna
amma mera sar...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Ay alamdar e wafa
items.body:
ay alamdar e wafa ghazi
chin gayi meri rida ghazi
mera barbaad hua ghar
<<DIVIDER>>
jab hua shaam e ghariban ka andhera ban mein
goonj utha khaak nasheeno ka ye nauha ban mein
aagayi binte ali dene ko pehra ban mein
thi yehi lab pe buka ghazi
dekhle aake zara ghazi
mera barbaad hua ghar
ay alamdar e wafa ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera ghar loot liya shaam ke khazzaqo ne
chaadare cheen ke aada ne jalaye qaime
maine amma ki suni thi ye sada rote huwe
chod ke tu jo gaya ghazi
bad gayi aur jafa ghazi
mera barbaad hua ghar
ay alamdar e wafa ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
har taraf aag dhuan shor e buka wawaila
ye sitam kaisa ghareebon pe hua wawaila
hogayi khaak basar aale aba wawaila
tu nahi kuch na raha ghazi
khaak hai sar ki rida ghazi
mera barbaad hua ghar
ay alamdar e wafa ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-sukoon mai hoo alamdar tere jaane se
zindagi ban gayi aazaar tere jaane se
pyase bache hai azadaar tere jaane se
teri furqat hai saza ghazi
kya kahoo aur bhala ghazi
mera barbaad hua ghar
ay alamdar e wafa ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
hogaya tanha mera bhai tere jaane se
bad gayi aur bhi tanhaai tere jaane se
mere bhai pe qaza aayi tere jaane se
jab chali taygh e jafa ghazi
thi mere lab pey buka ghazi
mera barbaad hua ghar
ay alamdar e wafa ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro padi aaya e tatheer sar e karbobala
jab chini chadar e hamsheer sar e karbobala
lut gayi zehra ki jaageer sar e karbobala
mere ashkon ne kaha ghazi
alqama chod ke aa ghazi
mera barbaad hua ghar
ay alamdar e wafa ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-qata bali sakina pe ghashi hai taari
aankh mein ashk hai aankhon se lahoo hai jaari
tujhse faryaad ye karti hai ghamon ki maari
ay wafadaar chacha ghazi
mere maqtool e jafa ghazi
mera barbaad hua ghar
ay alamdar e wafa ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh ay mere wafadaar sitam ka manzar
ek naize pe rida ek pe shabbir ka sar
haye pardes mein kya waqt pada hai mujh par
kya mere paas raha ghazi
hasrat o yaas ke siwa ghazi
mera barbaad hua ghar
ay alamdar e wafa ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
bai ye safdar o mazhar thay nabi zaadi ke
le gaye loot ke khazzaq ridayein sar se
dekh hum khaak nasheeno ki musibat aa ke
ghar jala dil bhi jala ghazi
mera kunba na raha ghazi
mera barbaad hua ghar
ay alamdar e wafa ghazi...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Ay zaafare jin
items.body:
ay zaafare jin aap bhi aaye thay wahan par
kya aap ne dekha
ashoor ke din lut gaya zehra ka bhara ghar
kya aap ne dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ke pisar neemche haaton pe uthaye
aur khoon mein nahaye
darya ki taraf pusht kiye mar gaye dilbar
kya aap ne dekha
ay zaafare jin…
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime mein kahin kya koi masnad bhi bichi thi
dulhan bhi khadi thi
jab kholi gayi laashaye nowshah ki chadar
kya aap ne dekha
ay zaafare jin…
<<DIVIDER>>
allah re wo saani e hyder ba alamdar
wo sheh ka wafadar
kis tarha gira ghode se be-dast zameen par
kya aap ne dekha
ay zaafare jin…
<<DIVIDER>>
sunte hai ke barchi mein kaleja nikal aaya
sakte mein hai dunya
khenchi hai sina shaah ne jo ya ali keh kar
kya aap ne dekha
ay zaafare jin…
<<DIVIDER>>
baysheer ka khoon lene se inkaar kiya hai
jab arz-o-samaa ne
tab sheh ne mala chehre pe khoone ali asghar
kya aap ne dekha
ay zaafare jin…
<<DIVIDER>>
mazloom ke seene pe tha sawaar sitamgar
tha hashr ka manzar
aur khushk galay par tha rawan shimr ka khanjar
kya aap ne dekha
ay zaafare jin…
<<DIVIDER>>
jab phail gayi charon taraf shaam e ghariban
mahol tha giryan
bachi koi baba ko sada deti thi rokar
kya aap ne dekha
ay zaafare jin…
<<DIVIDER>>
bemaar ka bistar ho ke baysheer ka jhoola
sab jal gaya wallah
shahid na tha is zulm ka koi bhi wahan par
kya aa pne dekha
ay zaafare jin…
items.author: Shahid Jafer

items.title: Bismillah wa billah
items.body:
zakhmon se choor hoke jo quran gir gaya
ro'o saron ko peeto qayamat hui bapa
naiza sambhale daaye se ibne anas bada
baayi taraf se maarne ibne ashas chala
dono ne waar shaah pe jo ek saath kar diya
phasli mein jaake naize mein naiza ulajh gaya
ibne anas ne chaaha ke naiza nikaale
shabbir chaahte thay ke khud ko sambhale
is kashma kash mein phasliyan baahar nikal padi
roti bilakti qabr se zehra nikal padi
girte huwe zameen pe ye shabbir ne kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
bismillah wabillah wala millate rasoolillah
<<DIVIDER>>
ghode se gir ke baithe hi thay sibte mustafa
ek teer san sanata hua teen bhaal ka
seene mein aake shaahe shaheedan ke gad gaya
haathon se usko kheench ke shabbir ne kaha
bismillah wabillah...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadme hazaar hone lage naazneen par
patthar kisi ne khaynch ke maara jabeen par
teora ke aah gir pade maula zameen par
girte hi teer jism mein chubne lage siwa
bismillah wabillah...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmon se choor choor hoon yawar nahi raha
akbar nahi raha mera asghar nahi raha
chautees saal waala baradar nahi raha
ab kya karunga jee ke bhara ghar nahi raha
bismillah wabillah...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha khoon mein joshe faatahe khyber ki al amaan
uth kar khade huwe kabhi baithe shahe zamaan
naiza jigar se khayncha to kheenchi kabhi sina
phir leke khoon haath mein bole shahe huda
bismillah wabillah...
<<DIVIDER>>
chullu ka khoon phaynka jo hi aasman par
sakta sa taari hogaya saare jahan par
laakhon layeen tooth pade ek jaan par
aandhi chali larazne lagi arze karbala
bismillah wabillah...
<<DIVIDER>>
khanjar liye wo haath mein shimr e layeen badha
sarwar ne sar ko sajda e khaaliq mein rakh diya
subhana rabbi aala wo mabood hai mera
khanjar chala to shaah ne besaakta kaha
bismillah wabillah...
<<DIVIDER>>
khanjar chalaya pyase pe ek baara martaba
pehli jo zarb khaayi kaha wa mohammada
aur doosri pe kehne lage haye murtuza
deen e nabi pe hota hai ab khaatma mera
bismillah wabillah...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir teesri pe tadpe kaha amma fatema
chauti lagi to kehne lage bhai mujtaba
phir uske baad sheh ne kisi se na kuch kaha
sookhi hui ragon se ye aati rahi sada
bismillah wabillah...
<<DIVIDER>>
aamir ali ka laal wo zehra ka dil ka chain
ainee lahoo mein lot'te thay shaahe mashraqain
chalti rahi churi aur ye kehte rahe hussain
kat'te huwe galay se ye aati rahi sada
abbas abbas abbas abbas
items.author: Ainee Rizvi

items.title: Ghazi alamdar teri
items.body:
ghazi alamdar teri qasam
jhukne nahi denge tera alam
<<DIVIDER>>
teri amanat samajh kar isay
tere alam ko uthaate hai hum
ghazi alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
le kar alam suye darya gaya
maujon ne choome thay tere qadam
ghazi alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sookhe huwe hont bachon ke thay
is gham mein aankhein rahi teri nam
ghazi alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri wafa tere paikar mein thi
paaya tha hyer ka jaah o hasham
ghazi alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
likhi kibate wafa is tarha
ran mein huwe tere baazu qalam
ghazi alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mashk e sakina se pani baha
aur aagaya tera honton pe dam
ghazi alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
marne se tere ghazab ye hua
sheh ki kamar hogayi gham se kham
ghazi alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ke dil se na kam ho saka
abbas teri judaai ka gham
ghazi alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum jo balaaon se bachte rahe
abbas ghazi ka hai ye karam
ghazi alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
farhan nauha ye abbas ka
karta hai rehaan ro ke raqam
ghazi alamdar...

items.title: Har ranj saha
items.body:
har ranj saha sadma bhi kya kya na uthaya
bazaar bhi halaat ne zainab ko dikhaya
<<DIVIDER>>
pathar to baraste thay magar aag bhi barsi
jab khaafila abid ka bazaar mein aaya
har ranj saha...
<<DIVIDER>>
har zulm pe sajjad ki aankhein to hai barsi
par shaam ke bazaar ne zyada hai rulaya
har ranj saha...
<<DIVIDER>>
islam ki khatir qadam qadam pe har dard alam apnaya
thi do ta'reefaat mohamed ki usay des ba des phiraya
virse mein paak moazzama ko darbar gaya dikhlaya
par waqt ki zaalim gardish ne bibi ko khoob sataya
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch ranj to maqdooma ko virsa mein milay thay
par waqt ki gardish ne usay bahot sataya
har ranj saha...

items.title: Jab aaya shaam ka bazaar
items.body:
JAB AAYA SHAAM KA BAAZAR TADAP KAR REHGAYE SAJJAD
AYAA HAI HASHR KE AASAAR TADAPKAR REHGAYE SAJAAD
MOHAMMED KE GHARAANE KI HUVI KAISI YE BARBAADI
PHIRAAYA KOOCHA-O-BAAZAR TADAPKAR REHGAYE SAJJAD
KABHI BABA KE AAGE BHI JO BEPARDA NA AAYI THI
BAREHNA SAR HAI AUR AGIYAAR TADAPKAR REHGAYE SAJAAD
KATA SAJDE ME SAR SHEH KA LUTA KARBAL ME GHAR SHEH KA
CHALI HAI QALB PE TALWAAR TADAPKAR REHGAYE SAJAAD
AY MERE BEKAFAN BABA SAKINA MARGAYI BABA
KARE TO KYA KARE LAACHAAR TADAPKAR REHGAYE SAJJAD
SAKINA KE CHINE GAUHAR TAMAACHON KE NASHAA RUKHPAR
YE SAB SEHTI RAHI GHAMQAAR TADAPKAR REHGAYE SAJJAD
NABI KI AAL AUR QAIDI YE KYA AJRE RISALAT THI
GAYE JAB SHAAM KA DARBAAR TADAPKAR REHGAYE SAJJAD
YE HAI BEEMAAR KA MAATAM KARO ZANJEER KA MAATAM
SUNO ZANJEER KI JHANKAAR TADAPKAR REHGAYE SAJJAD
YE NAUHA JAB PADHA ROKAR QAYAAMAT AAGAYI ASGAR
MASAAYAB KE TERE AMBAAR TADAPKAR REHGAYE SAJAAD

items.title: Abbas kahan ho
items.body:
sar kat gaya jab dasht may zehra ke pisar ka
hilti thi zameen kaampta tha arshe moalla
surkh aandhi chali khoon ugalne laga sehra
wehshat ka ye aalam tha ke hilta tha kaleja
thi ek qayamat sar e maqtal jo bapa thi
goonji hui sehra may faqad ek sada thi
abbas kahan ho aajao jahan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
seene pa sina kha chuke akbar gaye maare
khaali hua jhoola ali asghar gaye maare
tanha hui saydaniya sarwar gaye maare
zainab hai pareshan chale aao jahan ho
abbas kahan ho....
<<DIVIDER>>
namoose payambar ko badi aas thi tum se
kya aisi bhala bhai khata hogayi hum se
phat jaye kaleja kahin zainab ka na gham se
kyon roothay ho kis waaste nazro se niha ho
abbas kahan ho....
<<DIVIDER>>
is dashte musibat may kahan kho gaye bhai
naize ki ani aayaye tatheer tak aayi
aajao zara chorke darya ki taraai
chaadar sare zainab se utarti hai kahan ho
abbas kahan ho....
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ahle sitam aur qayamat na machade
sab loot ke asbab e haram aag lagade
darr hai kahin bemaar ka qaima na jalade
phir char taraf sirf dhuan sirf dhuan ho
abbas kahan ho....
<<DIVIDER>>
dhaane pa sitam aur sitamgar tulay hai
talware liye sab dare qaima pa khade hai
mardo may fakad abid e bemaar bache hai
khanjar kahin abid ke galay par na rawan ho
abbas kahan ho....
<<DIVIDER>>
bacha koi rota hai udhar taapo may aake
bachi koi roti hai idhar khaake tamache
laa'un to bhala laa'un zuban aisi kahan se
alfaaz nahi haal jo bachon ka bayan ho
abbas kahan ho....

items.title: Ai Shareekatul Hussain
items.body:
Sadqa Hussain Ka Suno, Ham Sab Ilteja Zainab

Shabbir Ri Ki Raza Mai Teri Razi Hai Shaamil
Tera Sabr To Mola Shabbir Sahiba Mil
Tu Fatima, Tu Haider
Tu Hassan-e-Mujtaba
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu Ghairat Panjetan Hai Tu Binte Abu Talib Kar Ham Pai Karam Aisa Muskil Pai Ham Ho Ghalib
Mushkil Kusha Ki Beti
Kar Mushkil-e-Kusha Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Ban Kai Hussain Ki Hai Abid Ki Rehnumai
Laila Nay Ali Nay Di Tareekh Ki Gawahi
Tu Fatima, Tu Ismat
Tu Ayat-e-Khuda Zainab

Tu Faath Shaam Bibi Tujh Sai Imam Bibi
Har Aik Tere Dar Pai Haajat Tamaam Bibi
Har Aik Pursadaar Ko
Ab Shaam Mai Bula Zainab

Khaime Mai Mole Ne Jab Akbar Ki Tilwat Ki
Qasim O Ali Asghar Wo In Sai Khitabat Ki
Shabbir Ka Bani To
Us Baat Hosila Zainab

Laiker Dua Aaye Tere Dhar Pai Azaadaryai
Tere Bhaiyyo Kai Behto Kai Aaye Haijo Ghamkhaar Yai
Ho Mustajaab Sab Nai
Maangi Hai Jo Dua Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu Woh Ali Ki Beti Jo Shaam Mai Ali Hai
Tere Hi Sadqe Bibi Mushkil Jo Hal Huwi Hai
Mamnoon Hai Jo Tera
Khud Rabbay Kibriya Zainab

items.title: Ali akbar ka janaza
items.body:
umme laila ali akbar ka janaza aaya
khoon may dooba hua laal ka sehra aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema sughra ka khat pad kar ye bole shabbir
naam tere ali akbar khat e sughra aaya
umme laila ali akbar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
baith kar sochti rehti thi ye sughra ghar may
mere bhai ka na shaadi ka bulawa aaya
umme laila ali akbar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
le to aaye shah e deen laash e jawan qaime tak
aisa lagta tha ke shabbir ka laasha aaya
umme laila ali akbar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ne athara baras paala tha us se poocho
kis tarha barchi may akbar ka kaleja aaya
umme laila ali akbar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
naujawan laal ke seene se nikaali barchi
waqt mazloom musafir pe ye kaisa aaya
umme laila ali akbar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ko armaan tha shadi ka wo maa kya karti
jis ki taqdeer may ta umr tadapna aaya
umme laila ali akbar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab na akbar hai na abbas na koi nasir
ay zafar ye lab e shabbir pe nauha aaya
umme laila ali akbar ka...

items.title: Amma mujhe chupa lo
items.body:
bazaar mein ye zainab fizza se keh rahi hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
<<DIVIDER>>
bazaar mein ye zainab fizza se keh rahi
abbas ki bahen ko har aankh dhoondti hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha na murtaza ne jisko baghair chadar
na-mehramo mein haye wo aagayi khule sar
qatle hussain se bhi dushwaar ye ghadi hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
bazaar mein ye…

himmat nahi hai meri kaise khadam badhaun
is shehre be-amaan mein khud ko kahan chupaun
haathon mein leke pathar ummat khadi hui hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
bazaar mein ye…
<<DIVIDER>>
bemaare karbala ke aankhon se khoon hai jari
ye soch kar badan mein larza hai uske taari
beparda shamiyon mein beti batool ki hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
bazaar mein ye…
<<DIVIDER>>
pooche to koi inse cheena hai kya tumhara
pardesi bewatan hai kya jurm hai hamara
kaisa hai ye tamasha ye bheed kyun lagi hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
bazaar mein ye…

is naam se hamesha aayi hai mujhko ghairat
paala hai tumne mujhko tum jaanti ho aadat
bazaar zindagi mein zainab kahan gayi hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
bazaar mein ye…
<<DIVIDER>>
saahil pe laashe ghazi us dam tadap gayi thi
sar se chini thi chadar jab binte murtaza ki
wo raat thi andheri ye din ki roshni hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
bazaar mein ye…
<<DIVIDER>>
aaya khayaal jab bhi aansu lagi bahane
bazaar ka takallum kaisa asar tha jaane
aksar watan mein zainab ye kehke chaunk uthi hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
bazaar mein ye…

items.title: Ay alamdara rasha
items.body:
ay alamdara ghazi abbasa
ay alamdara raasha zamarora
ghazi abbasa raasha zamarora
<<DIVIDER>>
kaun bewaon ki chadar ko bachaye aa kar
laashe sab waali o waaris ke pade hai be-sar
meri awaaz pe koi nahi aata ghazi
hogayi dasht e bayaban mein tanha khwahar
ghazi abbasa ghazi abbasa raasha zama rora
ay alamdara...
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm karte hai hamay tanha samajh kar aada
berida balwe mein rote hai haram wawaila
sar pe masoom sakina ke nahi dast e karam
chingaye uske gohar aag se daaman bhi jala
ghazi abbasa ghazi abbasa raasha zama rora
ay alamdara...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay alamdar fughan lab pe sakina laaye
har taraf aag dhuan hai wo kahan par jaaye
ghurkiyan ranj o alam tashnalabi daagh e padar
suye darya na chali jaaye sakina haye
ghazi abbasa ghazi abbasa raasha zama rora
ay alamdara...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum to aaye thay yahan tere sahare ghazi
tu magar sogaya darya ke kanare ghazi
bewatan tashna dahan maara gaya bhai mera
chin gayi chadarein ab sar se hamare ghazi
ghazi abbasa ghazi abbasa raasha zama rora
ay alamdara...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere parde ke zaamin ay alamdar aaja
mere ghazi ay mere monis o ghamkhwar aaja
aake pardes mein bigda hai muqaddar mera
teri zainab ka nahi koi madadgaar aaja
ghazi abbasa ghazi abbasa raasha zama rora
ay alamdara...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri hamsheer hai balwe mein khule sar ghazi
ab nahi koi mera monis o yawar ghazi
tere jaane se bharam toot gaya zainab ka
haye be-aas hui aale payambar ghazi
ghazi abbasa ghazi abbasa raasha zama rora
ay alamdara...
<<DIVIDER>>
safdar e khasta jigar mera qalam bhi bhi roye
karbala roti rahi ahle haram bhi roye
bain karti thi ye abbas ki khwahar ran mein
sun ke faryad meri mashk o alam bhi roye
ghazi abbasa ghazi abbasa raasha zama rora
ay alamdara...

zinda na rahungi mai agar aap na aaye

phat'ta tha jigar maa ka phupi jaan balab thi

items.title: Biya ali asgharam
items.body:
Ali asghar...
Dasht e purhaal mein matam ki sadaa goonj uthi..(2)
Karbala roti hai, hawa roti hai, alqama roti hai
Barsare, barsare karbobala girya kuna madaram
biya ali asgharam..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Tu gaya saath tere ghar ke ujale bhi gaye
sar se waali bhi gaya god ke paale bhi gaye..(2)
haath hai,
haath hai dil pe buka lab pe kahe chashme namm
biya ali asgharam..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Khali jhule ki taraf dekh ke karti hu buka
jhulne wala nahi kisko jhulau jhula..(2)
ek maa,
ek maa hi nahi jhula bhi kahe ye baham
biya ali asgharam..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Jaane wale tere jaane se teri maa ujdi
teri hamsheer tere baad meri jaa'n ujdi..(2)
roke wo,
roke wo karti hai fariyad labo par hai damm
biya ali asgharam..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Bayn karti hai sakina mai karu kya jeekar
tu mere paas hai ammu hai na bhayya akbar..(2)
pyaas se,
pyaas se din bhi mere jeene ke ab to hai kam
biya ali asgharam..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Dard ye jeene nahi dega teri madar ko
jo laga tujhko tere qad se bada teer tha wo..(2)
aur isi,
aur isi ghum mein dilafgaar hai ehle haram
biya ali asgharam..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Tu bata ghum ko tere dil se bhulaye kaise
dhoop mein tu hai to maa saaye mein jaaye kaise..(2)
saaye mein,
saaye mein jaane nahi deta mujhe tera ghum
biya ali asgharam..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Tu nahi aaya to mai jaa'n se guzar jaungi
saans bhi chalti rahe laash bhi kehlaungi..(2)
zindagi,
zindagi tu hai meri tere lahu ki qasam
biya ali asgharam..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Tere hi dum se to roshan thi hamari duniya
nauha  karte hai haram nanhe mujahid aaja..(2)
laut aa,
laut aa, aa nahi sakte hai tere paas hum
biya ali asgharam..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Ye wo alfaaz hai khud jis pe qaza rone lage
Bayn mazhar ne likhe ehle azaa rone lage..(2)
ek hi,
ek hi lafz bana jaata hai irfan e ghum
biya ali asgharam..(4)

items.title: Hussain kehte hue
items.body:
chala hun janibe kaaba Hussain kehte hue
khuda se aaj milon ga Hussain kehte huay
sipahi daudtay jatay hain janibe koofa
panah maang rahay thay ke kholo darwaaza
kiya hai ghazi ne hamla Hussain kehte hue
pul-e Siraat ka dar ho to ho bhala kaisay
zamana dekh le aashor karbalaa ja ke
guzarti jati hai duniya Hussain kehte hue
karenge khoon ka maatam baroze aashorah
khuda se hum ko isi wastay to manga gaya
hamein hai maaon ne paala Hussain kehte hue
adhoora chhod ke hajj karbalaa jo aaye thay
khaday hain gird woh bint-e Ali ke khaimay ke
tawaf karte hain poora Hussain kehte hue
kaha Hussain ne marna nahi habib abhi
ke karbalaa mein zaroorat padegi mujh ko teri
habib hogaya zindah Hussain kehte hue
agar ho ahle tawalla mitaao yeh tafriq
namaz ho ya Azaa mil ke honge saare shareek
uthao tum bhi qama ya Hussain kehte hue
yahi waseela hai saari duaon ka behtar
poukaro bhai ko bhai ka vaastaa day kar
Hasan se maang lo sadqa Hussain kehte hue
tamam ghar huwa khushiyon se aaj baagh o bahar
pidar ke samnay boli hai beti pehli baar
sakeena aayi hai baba Hussain kehte hue
hai mera sher wasiyat banam Ahle azaa
yeh iltija hai ke akbar ko aaye jab bhi qaza
uthana mera janaza Hussain kehte hue

ay mere jari bhai mere sher e dilawar
abbas kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo kooze liye baithe hai raste mein tumhare
seh roz ke pyase
in bacchon ka kya haal hai dekho zara aa kar
abbas kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
mar jayegi is dasht mein ro ro ke sakina
dushwaar hai jeena
do aake dilaasa usay seene se laga kar
abbas kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab dashte bala qaiz mein kohraam bapa hai
har lab pe buka hai
kuffaar ke narghe mein hai aulaad e payambar
abbas kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ro ke bulaati hai nabi zadiyan tum ko
kyun sunte nahi ho
qaimon ko jalaata hai sitamgaaron ka lashkar
abbas kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
haathon se rida thaam ke zainab ye pukari
ho jaaun mai waari
chin jaaye na sar se mere bhaiya meri chadar
abbas kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunte hi tadap jaata tha abbas ka laasha
gohar labe darya
jab kehti thi saydaniya hasrat se tadap kar
abbas kahan ho...
items.author: Gohar

items.title: Ali akbar sidharo
items.body:
ali akbar sidharo
<<DIVIDER>>
shahe waala ne di awaaz ay hamshakle paighambar
ali akbar sidharo
<<DIVIDER>>
baqa e haq ki khaatir baandh lo beta kafan sar par
ali akbar sidharo
<<DIVIDER>>
wo dekho wo bade aate hai aada jaanib e qaima
bado aur bad ke beta rok do badta hua lashkar
ali akbar sidharo...
<<DIVIDER>>
gala kat jaaye lekin haq pe aanch aane nahi paaye
hifazat deen ki hum pe hai hum hai aale paighambar
ali akbar sidharo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo raah e haq mein maut aaye to mar jaana shahadat hai
shahadat ka ye saagar shehed se shireen hai ay dilbar
ali akbar sidharo...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare baazuon mein quwwate baazu e haider hai
tumhare saamne kya hai bhala ye fauj ye lashkar
ali akbar sidharo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ani khud bad ke barchi ki lagalo apne seene se
jigar par khao ab zakhme sinaan o teer has has kar
ali akbar sidharo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ijazat maa se haan ab jaa ke qaime mein zara lelo
phuphi se hum ijazat khud dila denge tumhe chal kar
ali akbar sidharo...
<<DIVIDER>>
pisar ko barchiyon mein bhejna aasaan nahi beta
hai fitrat ka taqaza ghash bhi ho sakti hai maa sun kar
ali akbar sidharo...
<<DIVIDER>>
phuphi ke saath hi ay laal hai bemaar ka qaima
ye rakhna dhyaan chank uthe na ghash se abide muztar
ali akbar sidharo...
<<DIVIDER>>
shikayat pyaas ki ab jaa ke dada jaan se karna
tumhe sairaab beta ab karenge saaqi e kausar
ali akbar sidharo...
<<DIVIDER>>
sina khaa kar jo girna khaak par gir kar sada dena
tumhari laash pe sajda karunga shukr ka dilbar
ali akbar sidharo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jawan bete ka laasha kis tarha laate hai maqtal se
zamana dekh lega daur e ibne faatahe khyber
ali akbar sidharo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye lamha dard ka cha jayega yun deen e aalam par
na bhoolega zamana hashr tak ye dasht ye manzar
ali akbar sidharo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo sun lega mera bhai tumhe jaane nahi dega
wo bebas mujhko kar dega mere qadmon pe sar rakh kar
ali akbar sidharo...
items.author: Sachey Bhai

items.title: Amma na jao
items.body:
ghar se jo zehra ke mayyat uthi
ghar mein ali ke qayamat hui
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi zainab ye sar peet kar
amma na jao mujhe chod kar
veeran hojayega ab ye ghar
amma na jao mujhe chod kar
<<DIVIDER>>
uth uth ke karti thi shab ko fughan
dil kaat jaata tha gham ka bayan
khamosh ho kuch to bolo na maa
uth jao zainab ki faryaad par
amma na jao mujhe chod kar
kehti thi zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
de kar sadayein bulao hamein
seene se apne lagao hamein
furqat ke din na dikhao hamein
kyun aaj hum se hui be-khabar
amma na jao mujhe chod kar
kehti thi zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
bachon pe koh e alam gir pada
sar ko jhukaye hai sher e khuda
kulsoom o fizza hai mehwe buka
hasnain rote hai thaame jigar
amma na jao mujhe chod kar
kehti thi zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ka apne judaai ka gham
darbaar jaane ka dil par sitam
ummat se paaye hai is darja gham
sab se chupa ke wo zaqme jigar
amma na jao mujhe chod kar
kehti thi zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehlu pe jalta hua dar gira
mohsin ka maqtal ye ghar ban gaya
is gham ne tum ko na jeene diya
sab zakhm dekhe hai tum ne magar
amma na jao mujhe chod kar
kehti thi zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehlu shikasta jhuki hai kamar
ek haath pehlu pe ek qalb par
zeb e musalla thi tum raat bhar
ab kyun ho khamosh lagta hai darr
amma na jao mujhe chod kar
kehti thi zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
altaf o safdar ho kaise raqam
khairunnisa pe jo guzre sitam
khirtaas par likh ke roya qalam
hai ek jumle ka dil par asar
amma na jao mujhe chod kar
kehti thi zainab...
items.author: Altaf Hussain

items.title: Ay alamdare haram
items.body:
ay alamdar e haram
<<DIVIDER>>
saaqi e tishna labaan ay alamdar e haram
hyderi sher e jawan ay alamdar e haram
marhaba sher ejawan ay jawan ay jawan ay jawan
ay alamdar e haram
<<DIVIDER>>
ay shehanshah e wafa saani e hyder maula
ay sakina ke chacha fatema zehra ki dua
fauje shabbir ke salaar alamdar e wafa
bani hashim ke qamar naaz e shah e karbobala
maula qurban dil o jaan ay alamdar e haram
saaqi e tishna laban...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye wo shaam e ghariban wo qayamat ka samaa
haye sadaat ke jalte huwe qaimon ka dhuaan
bibiyan karti thi ro ro ke yehi aah o fughaan
aao abbas ridaon ke muhafiz ho kahan
ho kahan sher e jawan ay alamdar e haram
saaqi e tishna laban...
<<DIVIDER>>
kab na bibi ko alamdar chacha yaad aaya
aaya jab shaam ka bazaar chacha yaad aaya
na mila saaya e deewar chacha yaad aaya
jab tamanche lage har baar chacha yaad aaya
thi sakina ki fughan ay alamdar e haram
saaqi e tishna laban...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum azadaron ki taqdeer jaga do maula
karbala ka hamein zawwar bana do maula
apni jageer ka deedaar kara do maula
rauza e hazrat e shabbir dikha do maula
hai yehi wird e zaban ay alamdar e haram
saaqi e tishna laban...
items.author: N. Sarwar & J. Jaffri

items.title: Ay zaamine ghariban
items.body:
ay zaamin e ghariban
lajpal raza maula sarkar raza maula
rote hai tere gham mein
ghamkhwar raza maula
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun zehr de diya hai kazim ke gulbadan ko
ghurbat mein maar daala mazloom bewatan ko
phir lut gaya tumhara ghar baar raza maula
ay zaamin e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
yasrab mein teri behna karti hai yaad tujhko
bhai se ab mila de parwardigar mujhko
ho na saka behen ko deedar raza maula
ay zaamin e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere laal keh kar wo pyaar se bulana
maathe ko choomna aur seene se bhi lagana
yaad aayega taqi ko tera pyar raza maula
ay zaamin e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye sitamgari ne kya haal kar diya hai
haan zehr ke asar se tukde jigar hua hai
khoon ugle jaa rahe hai sardar raza maula
ay zaamin e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
taboot se lipat kar kehte hai rone waale
hum tere matami hai rauze pe ab bula le
ek baar hum bhi dekhe darbar raza maula
ay zaamin e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay fatema ke bete ye hai hamara waada
karte rahenge tere qatil pe hum tabbara
rokegi ab na koi dewaar raza maula
ay zaamin e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
zeeshan o shadmaan ye nauha suna rahe hai
yaad aagayi shahadat angoor bhi saje hai
taboot hogaya hai tayyar raza maula
ay zaamin e ghariban...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Bawafa bawafa
items.body:
bawafa bawafa ghazi alamdar e wafa
baazu e shabbir hai fatema ki hai dua
<<DIVIDER>>
kulle emaan hai ali kulle wafa abbas hai
karbala ke zaairon ka rehnuma abbas hai
hai yehi babul hawaij hai yehi haajat rawa
bawafa bawafa...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap quran e shuja'at ye hai quran e wafa
baap hai saaqi e kausar ye hai pyason ki dua
aaj tak qabze mein iske hai furaat o alqama
bawafa bawafa...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ragon mein khoon abu talib ka iske maujizan
bu-tarabi khoon hai kyun kar na ho baatil shikan
tod daala is jari ne khyber e karbobala
bawafa bawafa...
<<DIVIDER>>
aas dhaaras dastageeri khaadime shabbir bhi
karbala walon ka saqqa karbala jageer bhi
uske parcham ki hawa hai surat e khaake shifa
bawafa bawafa...
<<DIVIDER>>
hogaye baazu qalam aur khoon mein dooba alam
hat sake na alqama se phir bhi ghazi ke qadam
turbat e abbas par pehre pe hai darya khada
bawafa bawafa...
<<DIVIDER>>
noke naiza par ruke sar kis tarha abbas ka
berida zainab ko dekhe ye shehenshahe wafa
isliye noke sina par sar na ghazi ka ruka
bawafa bawafa...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye wo bali sakina aur tamachon ke nishan
kaan zakhmi tashnalab ahle sitam ke darmiyan
haath kano par rakhe kehti rahi mere chacha
bawafa bawafa...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhlo rehaan aur rizwan ghazi ka bharam
kha nahi sakta hai koi aaj bhi jhooti qasam
hai ata'on par ata nakshe qadam abbas ka
bawafa bawafa...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Bohat yaad aaye
items.body:
jab utri saron se bhaiya ridayein
tum yaad aaye bohat yaad aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha so rahe ho behan ko bhulaye
tum yaad aaye bohat yaad aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
khule sar sar e bazm mujhko bulaya
aziyat se durron ki mujhko rulaya
doon awaaz kis ko kise doon sadayein
tum yaad aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha dushwaar chalna magar mai chali thi
mere haal par bekasi ro rahi thi
qadam dar qadam toot'ti thi jafayein
tum yaad aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
sitamgar ne jab hum ko durron se maara
khuda ke liye seh liya dard saara
magar jab saron se utri ridayein
tum yaad aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
manadi sada de raha tha barabar
ye baaghi hai baaghi karo zulm in par
jahan tak ho mumkin inhe hum satayein
tum yaad aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kharashein kharashein yateema ke tan par
lahoo jam raha hai jale pairahan par
ye kehti thi dukhiya chacha ko bulayein
tum yaad aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kise kya kahun mai naseebon ki maari
sitam hum pe karte hai sab kaari kaari
jo aale payambar pe tooti jafayein
tum yaad aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kiye maine faaqe isi khastatan par
ye roodad e gham likh rahi hai rasan par
mukhalif bhi apni hui hai hawayein
tum yaad aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay aamir wo laashe jari par gayi thi
faqat shams ro ro ke ye keh rahi thi
jo guzri hai hum pe wo kya kya batayein
tum yaad aaye...
items.author: Shams Rizvi

items.title: Darya se koi ja kar
items.body:
darya se koi jaa kar ghazi ko bula laye
aisa na ho ghurbat may ghar zehra ka lut jaye
<<DIVIDER>>
ek baap zaeefi ke aalam may akela hai
aur sher se bete ke laashe ko uthaana hai
koi to sahara de lilaah koi aaye
darya se koi jaa kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
rukh kar ke suye darya haathon se kamar thaame
akbar ke janaze par sheh kehte thay ro ro ke
kya baat hui ab tak abbas nahi aaye
darya se koi jaa kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai laakhon adoo ran may aur sibte nabi tanha
zakhmi hai bahot zakhmi pyasa hai bahot pyasa
mazloom ki gardan par shamsheer na chal jaye
darya se koi jaa kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ka jari bhai maara gaya maqtal may
ghabrayi hui behna insaano ke jangal may
ek ek se ro ro kar ye kehti rahi haye
darya se koi jaa kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazloomo ke qaimo may ab gham ka basera hai
kal tak thi jahan raunak ab gehra andhera hai
shaam aagayi ghurbat ki tareek huwe saaye
darya se koi jaa kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadaat ke qaimon ko hai ghere huwe shole
kehti hai nabi zaadi ghabrayi hui ro ke
ghar lut gaya is ban may chadar bhi na chin jaye
darya se koi jaa kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
haalat hai ajab gohar masoom sakina ki
khoon behta hai kaano se lagte hai tamache bhi
naazon may pali bachi ro ro ke na mar jaye
darya se koi jaa kar...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Ek sar kya tha
items.body:
ek sar kya tha shaheede karbala ke saamne
rakh diye sheh ne bahattar sar khuda ke saamne
<<DIVIDER>>
jhil-milate hi rahenge hashr tak ashk e aza
jhil-milate hi rahenge ye diye
hum ne jalaye hai hawa ke saamne
ek sar kya tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay tabeeb e asr dauran kya maseehai teri
ay tabeeb e asr dauran khaak hai
teri dawa khaake shafa ke saamne
ek sar kya tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
hashr tak wo log ruswaye zamana hogaye
hashr tak wo log ruswa aagaye thay
jo shahe karbobala ke saamne
ek sar kya tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
cha gaya bankar jalaale hyderi darbar mein
cha gaya bankar jalaale khutbaye
zainab yazeede be-haya ke saamne
ek sar kya tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
apna sar saahil se takrane lagi mauje furaat
apna sar takra jab sakina
mashk laayi thi chacha ke saamne
ek sar kya tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhiye kya ho ba waqte izn maa ke dil ka haal
dekhiye kya ho ba waqte layenge
qasim ko jab dulha bana ke saamne
ek sar kya tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
teer jab asghar ne khaya ro rahe thay ashkiyan
teer jab asghar ne khaya aur asghar
has rahe thay ashkiyan ke saamne
ek sar kya tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
le gaya sar kaat kar shabbir ka shimr e layeen
le gaya sar kaat kar zainabe
khasta jigar ke ilteja ke saamne
ek sar kya tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
saniye zehra ke sar se us rida ko le gaye
saniye zehra ke sar se dono aalam
sard goo thay jis rida ke saamne
ek sar kya tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
maine paayi sar balandi maine paaya hai urooj
maine paayi sar balandi sar jhuka
rehta hai mera karbala ke saame
ek sar kya tha...
items.author: Urooj Bijnori

items.title: Ghazi e bawafa
items.body:
ghazi e bawafa chin rahi hai rida
nehr se laut aa chin rahi hai rida
<<DIVIDER>>
maal o asbaab sab loot'te hai layeen
jalte qayyam mein ghus rahe hai layeen
hashr hai ek bapa chin rahi hai rida
ghazi e bawafa…
<<DIVIDER>>
jaan se saydaniyan ab guzar jayengi
maut se pehle hi saari mar jayengi
hai ye waqte qaza chin rahi hai rida
ghazi e bawafa…
<<DIVIDER>>
is se pehle ke sar ran mein ho berida
saari saydaniyan kar rahi hai dua
maut de ay khuda chin rahi hai rida
ghazi e bawafa…
<<DIVIDER>>
tere baazu kate sabr maine kiya
sab sahare chine sabr maine kiya
ab nahi hausla chin rahi hai rida
ghazi e bawafa…
<<DIVIDER>>
har taraf ab yahan aag hi aag hai
jaaun aakhir kahan aag hi aag hai
zulm is par siwa chin rahi hai rida
ghazi e bawafa…
<<DIVIDER>>
be-ridayi ka gham bhai kaise sahoon
tu hi aa kar bata mai sada kis ko doon
sun behan ki buka chin rahi hai rida
ghazi e bawafa…
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhse kehte thay ye mere baba ali
hogi tu berida ay meri laadli
waqt wo aagaya chin rahi hai rida
ghazi e bawafa…
<<DIVIDER>>
main teri aas par aayi thi karbala
tere hote huwe kyun chinegi rida
qatl tu ho gaya chin rahi hai rida
ghazi e bawafa…
<<DIVIDER>>
noor har laash se khoon ubalne laga
laasha e bawafa bhi tadapne laga
jab ye goonji sada chin rahi hai rida
ghazi e bawafa…
items.author: Noor Ali

items.title: Har simt hai udasi
items.body:
har simt hai udaasi ujda hua samaa
kya kya na huwe zulm o sitam zer e aasman
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar abbas qasim o shabbir na rahe
namoos e mustafa ka abid hai paasban
har simt hai udaasi...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon se khoon hai jaari daadi rangeen hai
goya jhuka hua hai par azm hai jawan
har simt hai udaasi...
<<DIVIDER>>
majdhaar may hai kashti toofan ka zor hai
teeron se phat gaya hai safeene ka baadban
har simt hai udaasi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ujda hai do pahar may shabbir ka chaman
maqtal may reh gaya hai qaimon ka ab dhuan
har simt hai udaasi...
<<DIVIDER>>
oonton se gir rahe hai bacche zameen par
jaane kahan rukega ghareebon ka kaarwan
har simt hai udaasi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitne ameer aate thay wo mutma'in nazar
jinke raha saron par tayghon ka saayeban
har simt hai udaasi...

items.title: Jab alam se koi
items.body:
jab alam se koi mashkeeza bandha hota hai
kisi bedast ka izhare wafa hota hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise rehwar se girta hai koi be-baazu
gurz ka zakhm bhi jab sar pe laga hota hai
jab alam se koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
isko lilaah na kholo ke hai pamaal badan
aisa laasha kahin chadar may khula hota hai
jab alam se koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
shahe deen sirf alam qaimae may laaye honge
ye jo ek shor qayamat ka bapa hota hai
jab alam se koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon barasta hai fizaon se larazti hai zameen
kundh khanjar se jo sar sheh ka juda hota hai
jab alam se koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
haye sajjad ke pairon may wo zanjeer-e-garan
aabilon ke liye har kaanta laga hota hai
jab alam se koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
mashk dikhlake bahate hai zameen par pani
roz ek zulm sakina pe naya hota hai
jab alam se koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
qalbe akbar se sina gardan e baysheer se teer
khaynche waala shahe karbobala hota hai
jab alam se koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
ek awaaz haram sunte hai har shab shahid
pase zindan koi noha sada hota hai
jab alam se koi…
items.author: Shahid Jafer

items.title: Jisne sajda kiya
items.body:
jis ne sajda kiya chaand zehra ka tha khanjar talay
jis ka koi na raha chaand zehra ka tha khanjar talay
<<DIVIDER>>
veeran karbobala aabaad jis ne kiya
ummat ne kyun kar bhala kaata hai uska gala
nok e sina jisne quran pada chaand zehra ka tha
khanjar talay
jis ne sajda kiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
sakina ke dur le gaye ghazi ke baazu kate
shimr tamache maare kis jurm ki hai saza
hai ye saza jis ka koi na raha chaand zehra ka tha
khanjar talay
jis ne sajda kiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ne ki jaan fida qasim ke tukde huwe
aun o mohamed abbas akbar bhi maare gaye
maare gaye khoon dukhtar ka tha chaand zehra ka tha
khanjar talay
jis ne sajda kiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ki cheeni rida abid ke kode lagay
bibiyan qaidi hui qaime bhi jalne lagay
qaime jalay jis ne quran pada chaand zehra ka tha
khanjar talay
jis ne sajda kiya...

items.title: Kehti thi madar aye ali akbar
items.body:
Hoti hay subha azaan do (x2)
Kehti thi madaar ay Ali Akber, hoti hay subha azaan do(x2),
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Janti hu mein mujko khabar hai

items.title: Lehed choti banayi kyun gayi hai
items.body:
Lehad choti banayi kyun gayi
Reha hokar haram jab ran me pohche
kaha zainab ne abid se tadapke
shaheedo'n ki kaha'n qabrein bani hai
fugha'n karti ye aale nabi hai
kaha sajjad ne haaye phuphijaa'n
nahi tadfeen ka tha koi saamaa'n
wo dekho qabr hai baba ki mere
wo akbar ki ye qasim ki hamare
gaye sahil pe ek choti lehad par
tadap utthi ye keh kar binte haider
ye kiski qabr hai sajjad beta
hai isme dafn kis be ghar ka laasha
kiya phir aabid e muztar ne nauha
ke is me dafn hai laasha chacha ka
kaha zainab ne ay sajjad beta
Lehad choti banayi kyun gayi hai-2
Mera abbas to chota nahi tha

1. Pukari SANIYE ZEHRA ay dilbar
Mere ABBAS ka aisa muqaddar
Lehad choti si aur GHAZI ka laasha
Lehad choti banayi kyun gayi hai-2
1) mere AABID phuphi jaa'n ko bata de
Chacha ki lash dafnayi hai kaise
Mera bhaiya jawano me siwa tha
Lehad choti banayi kyun gayi hai-2
2) Kisi choti si turbat me ay dilbar
Mera ABBAS soya hai to kyun kar
Badi mushkil me hoga mera bhaiya
Lehad choti banayi kyun gayi hai-2
3) mujhe lagta hai ay beemar mere
tha laasha ba wafa ka tukde tukde
zara apni phuphi amma ko batla
Lehad choti banayi kyun gayi hai-2
4) phuphi amma btaun mai ye kaise
Chacha KI lash k tukde the bikhre
Kia chun-chun ke jinko maine yak jaa'n
Lehad choti banayi kyun gayi hai-2
5) Tarai me chacha ki laash rakhi
bhatije ne banakar qabr chhoti
lehed me phir rakha unka janaza
Lehad choti banayi kyun gayi hai-2
6) Yehi kehti thi dadi mujhse rokar
ke ek tukda yaha par ek waha par
mera ghazi hai haaye paara paara
Lehad choti banayi kyun gayi hai-2
7) 'Mubarak' jab kaha zehra ne rokar
nazar aata hai tukdo me dilawar
qayamat tak na ab aansu rukege
Lehad choti banayi kyun gayi hai-2

items.title: Baba mujhe zindaan mein rulwata hai zalim
items.body:
Haye sakina (s.a)-1
Souz.....
Qaid khane me sakina ko jo laae taqdeer ro ro kehne lagi hai hai mere baba shabbir kyun nahin dete khabar aaj huwi hoon mai asi aab meri tumhari hai mulaqaath aakhir nifs shab tak bhi yahan jena hai dushwar mera dekho ab aur ke bas aakhri deedaar mera.....
Baba mujhe Zindaan me rulwata hai Zalim..-2
Sar tasht me rakkha huwa dikhla ta hai Zalim -1
Baba mujhe Zindaan me rulwata hai Zalim..-2
(1).Wo mujhko dara ta hai tamacho'n sitam se
Mai Jab Bhi Sada Deti HooN Ammu (a.s) Ko Bula De.
Naam Ammu (a.s) Ka Sun Kar Mere Tham Jaata Hai Zaalim.
Baba mujhe Zindaan me rulwata hai Zalim..-2
(2).Gauhar Bhi Mere Cheene HaiN Kurta Bhi Jalaya.
Hai Qaid Bana Kar Mujhe Zindaan Mein Rakkha.
Aur BediyaaN Sajjad (a.s) Ko Phena Ta Hai Zaalim.
Baba mujhe Zindaan me rulwata hai Zalim..-2
(3).Kyun Teri Sakina (s.a) Pe Sitam Hota Hai Aisa.
Ro Ro Ke TumheiN Jab Bhi Sada Deti HooN Baba (a.s).
Phir Durre Laga Ne Ko Chala Aata Hai Zaalim.
Baba mujhe Zindaan me rulwata hai Zalim..-2
(4).Roti HooN To Rone NahiN Deta Mujhe Baba (a.s).
Na Ro'oN To Rone Ke Liye Kehta Hai Baba (a.s).
Zindaan Mein Kuch Aise Sitam Dhaata Hai Zaalim.
Baba mujhe Zindaan me rulwata hai Zalim..-2
(5).Kya Beti Teri Ashk Bahane Ke Liye Hai.
Kya Beti Teri Sirf Satane Ke Liye Hai.
Kyun Mujh Ko Rula Kar Hi SukooN Paata Hai Zaalim.
Baba mujhe Zindaan me rulwata hai Zalim..-2
(6).Baba (a.s) Yeh Mujhe Yaad NahiN Kab Se HooN Pyaasi.
Aansu To Mere Sookh Chuke Khoon Hai jaari.
Paani Ki Har Ik Boond Ko Tarsa Ta Hai Zaalim.
Baba mujhe Zindaan me rulwata hai Zalim..-2
(7).Dadi (s.a) Ki Tarah MaiN Bhi HooN Ummat Ki Satayi.
Dadi (s.a) Ki Tarah Mujh Pe Bhi Chhayi Hai Zayeefi.
Haalat Pa Taras Meri NahiN Khaata Hai Zaalim.
Baba mujhe Zindaan me rulwata hai Zalim..-2
(8).Bas "Arsalaan" Mar Gayi Zindaan Mein Bachchi.
Kya Us Pe Guzar Ti Rahi Keh Bhi NahiN Paayi.
"Shahkaar" Bas Itna Kaha Tadh Paata Hai Zaalim.
Baba mujhe Zindaan me rulwata hai Zalim..-2

items.title: Har zulm ka nisha banaya batool ko
items.body:
HAR ZULM KA NISHANA BANAYA BATOOL KO X2
BABA KI TAAZIYAT MEI HAEY BABA KI TAAZIYAT MEI SATAYA BATOOL KO
ISS ZULM SE HILAYA GAYA MARQAD E RASOOL
IZHAR E TAAZIYAT MEI JALAYA DARRE BATOOL
GHURBAT KA TAAZIYANA LAGAYA BATOOL KO
HAIDER PE ZULM DHAYA GAYA DEKH TI RAHI
BAANDA GAYA ALI KA GALA DEKH TI RAHI
JO HO SAKA WO ZULM DIKHAYA BATOOL KO
HAQ MAANG NE GAYI THI YE KYA LEKE AAYI HAI
HONTO PE APNE AAH O BUKKA LEKE AAYI HAI
APNEH HI HAQ SE GHER BATAYA BATOOL KO
DARBAAR SE PALAT KE JO GHAR AAYI FATIMA
ZAINAB YEH BOLI BIBI HEY KYA NAAM APKA
SOUN KAR SAWAAL GUM SE GHASH AAYA BATOOL KO
CHUP CHUP KE JAAYA KARTI THI QABAR E RASOOL PAR
LEKIN JAB ASHKIYA KI PARI AAP PAR NAZAR
QABR E RASOOL SE BHI HATAYA BATOOL KO
BABA TERI JUDAYI KA SADHMA BHI KAM NE THA
PHIR BHI HUWA NA MUJPE WO KOI SITAM NE THA
WAJIB AMAL SAMAJ KE RULAYA BATOOL KO
QABR E NABI PE JAA KE YE KEHTI THI FATIMA
BABA TUMHARE GUM MEI NA RONEY MUJE DIYA
KHAMOSH JHIRKIYO SE KARAYA BATOOL KO
ZAHRA NE GUM JO DEKHY RAKAM HO ASAD SE KIA
PARTHE JO DEEN PE SHAB MEI BADAL JAATA FATEMAH
GUM NE QAZA KI NEENDH SULAYA BATOOL KO

items.title: Jiye Sada Hussain
items.body:

Nabi ki aal par ajeeb waqt aaj aa pada
Hussain chhod kar Madina ja rahe hain Karbala
Lahad se aayi ek shikasta pehlu Bibi ki sada
Ghareeb ho rahi hoon aaj main
Tere hawale ae Khuda Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Badi museebaton se paala hai gule jamal ko
Chalai chakkiyan to god mein sula ke laal ko
Kiya hai faqon mein bhi poora uske har sawaal ko
Zamana dushmani pe hai tula
Mere Khuda hai bekhata Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Alam-e-Jari ke haath mein, amariyon mein bibiyan

ho Tujh pe dukhiya maan fida Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Safar su'ubaton ka hai, bala ka saamna bhi hai
Hai tez dhoop ki tapish to garmiye hawa bhi hai
Hai saath Akbar-e-Haseen, Hasan ka mah-laqa bhi hai
Rabab ki hai god mein Sagheer
jo Ghutnon na chal saka Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Chiragh kaun ab mere mazar par jalayega
Mujhe qarar kis tarah tere baghair aayega
Tera firaq qabr mein sada mujhe rulayega
Na betiyan hon be-rida meri
Na be-kafan rahe mera Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Zamana kamsini mein dekhe to shuoor-e-mehjabi
Behan ki god chhodta nahin tha Asghar-e-Hazeen
Hussain bole muntazir hai Karbala ki sarzameen
Yeh keh ke god mein woh aa gaya
Hussain Hussain, Labbaik Ya Hussain

Main sun chuki hoon Baba se ke tujh ko maara jayega
Atash mein teen din ke tere sar ko kaata jayega
Teri yateem bachi par taras na koi khayega

<<DIVIDER>>

items.title: Koi Mere Bhai Ko Aakar Bachale
items.body:
Koi Mere Bhai Ko Aa Kar Bacha Le
<<DIVIDER>>
Tadap Kar Ye Kehti Thi Sarwar Ki Khwahar,
Koi Mere Bhai Ko Aa Kar Bacha Le.
Koi Rok Le Is Sitamgar Ka Khanjar,
Koi Mere Bhai Ko Aa Kar Bacha Le.
<<DIVIDER>>
Badi Mehnaton Se Meri Maa Ne Pala,
Main Bhooli Nahin Unke Haathon Ka Chhala.
Chala Kar Ke Chakki Khilaya Niwala,
Ise Maa Bulati Thin Ghar Ka Ujala.
Ujad Jaayega Fatima Ka Bhara Ghar.
Koi Mere Bhai Ko Aa Kar Bacha Le.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ibn-e-Saad Tujhko Ye Kya Ho Gaya Hai,
Tu Kaise Sitam Ye Khada Dekhta Hai.
Nabi Ne Jise Apna Beta Kaha Hai,
Laeen Uska Sookha Gala Kaat Ta Hai.
Hai Khanjar Tale Bosa-Gaah-e-Paighambar.
Koi Mere Bhai Ko Aa Kar Bacha Le.
<<DIVIDER>>
Musafir Ko Narge Se Koi Nikale,
Ghareeb-ul-Watan Hi Samajh Kar Bacha Le.
Kisi Dhaal Se Khasta Tan Ko Chhupa Le,
Bahut Sangdil Hain Sitam Karne Wale.
Baraste Hain Pyaase Ke Zakhmon Pe Patthar.
Koi Mere Bhai Ko Aa Kar Bacha Le.
<<DIVIDER>>
Bata De Koi Ja Ke Zaalim Ko Itna,
Khudara Kare Na Sitam Ye Dobara.
Hilaye Na Pahlu Mein Paiwast Neza,
Khadi Hai Wahan Ek Pahlu Shikasta.
Tadapti Hai Is Zulm Se Meri Madar.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kabhi Pyar Se Paas Apne Bitha Ke,
Jo Zulfen Sawarin Thin Maa Fatima Ne.
Laeen Kheenchta Hai Woh Zulfen Pakad Ke,
Lagata Hai Bekas Ke Munh Par Tamaache.
Koi Rok Le Shimr Ka Haath Badh Kar.
<<DIVIDER>>
Zaeefi Mein Bete Ka Gham Sah Chuka Hai,
Ye Mazloom Pehle Se Toota Hua Hai.
Akhi Ka Woh Seena Ghamon Se Bhara,
Jahan Shimr Ne Apna Zanu Rakha Hai.
Bahut Ghut Raha Hoga Mera Baradar.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sada Meri Sunte Nahin Zulm-Zade,
Kaise Ran Mein Aawaaz Ye Ghamzada De.
Kahan Hain Mere Sher Dil Shahzade,
Koi Phir Se Aun-o-Muhammad Ko La De.
Woh Rakh Dein Gala Mamu Jaan Ke Gale Par.
<<DIVIDER>>
Chalata Raha Kund Khanjar Sitamgar,
Tadapti Rahi Shah-e-Wala Ki Dukhtar.
Kabhi Dekhti Thi Sakina Ki Janib,
Kabhi Dekhti Thi Woh Dariya Ki Janib.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sada De Rahi Thi Tadap Kar Woh Muztar,
Bata De Koi Mere Ghazi Se Ja Kar.
Sakina Ki Haalat Ajab Ho Rahi Hai,
Pidar Ke Gale Par Chhuri Dekh Li Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ise Khoon Rulane Pe Zaalim Tula Hai,
Ye Choti Hai, Daagh-e-Yateemi Bada Hai.
Sitamgar Ke Khanjar Ka Dar Maar Dega,
Sakina Ko Daagh-e-Pidar Maar Dega.
<<DIVIDER>>
Nadeem Eliya, Ran Mein Ek Shoor Utha,
Ae Logo Hua Qatl Zahra Ka Jaaya.
Karo Badh Ke Pamaal Sarwar Ka Laasha,
Suw-e-Dasht Daudi Ye Sunte Hi Dukhiya.
Ye Keh Ke Giri Munh Ke Bal Bint-e-Haidar,
Koi Mere Bhai Ko Aa Kar Bacha Le.

items.title: Aa Gaya Ahle Aza Mahe Mauharram
items.body:
Aagaya ahle aza mahe muharram chalo watan ko chalen
Har azadar ka dil kahta h paiham chalo watan ko chalen
(1) Hilalo shaam e muharram ye kya khabar laaye
Ke ranjo dard k badal har ek taraf chhaye
Sabhi ye kahte hain
Na jaane kyon aakhir
Ye chand dekh k aankhon me ashk bhar aaye
Har azadar ka dil kahta h paiham chalo watan ko chalen
(2)Na jaane mahe muharram ki kaesi h taseer
Watan se door jinhen le ke jati h taqdeer
Wo is mahine me
Tamanna karte hain
Watan me ja ke karen hm bhi matam e shabbir
Har azadar ka dil kahta h paiham chalo watan ko chalen
(3) Watan se door jo rahte hain is mahine me
Watan ki yaad machalti h unke sine me
Mere pisar k muhib
Watan pahunch jayen
Duaen karti h ek maa'n yahi madine me
Har azadar ka dil kahta h paiham chalo watan ko chalen
(4)watan me ja kr ghame be watan manayenge
Nabi k laal pe ashke aza bichhayenge
Ghareeb khano me
Bichha k farshe gham
Janabe fatima zahra ko ham bolayenge
Har azadar ka dil kahta h paiham chalo watan ko chalen
(5) isi mahine me ujda h khandane batool
Isi mahine me mara gaya h jaane rasool
Isi mahine me
Nabi k gulshan ka
Bala k dasht me bikhra hua h har ek phool
Har azadar ka dil kahta h paiham chalo watan chalen
(6)ba yade tashnagiye ibne fatima zahra
Sada pilayenge pyason ko pani ahle aza
Zamane walon ko
Batate jayenge
Ke karbala me tha nahre furat pe pahra
Har azadar ka dil kahta h paiham chalo watan ko chalen
(7) alam bhi hazrat e abbas ka uthayenge
Or uspe phool aqidat k ham chadhayenge
Mareez duniya k
Alam ki chhaon me
Ali k laal se aakr shifayen payenge
Har azadar ka dil kahta hai paiham chalo watan ko chalen
(8)watan se door jo rahte hain aye shabih o raza
Ye unse kah do sakina ko yaad kar len zara
sada jo roti thi
Watan ki yaadon me
Magar watan usey jana naseeb ho na saka
Har azadar ka dil kahta hai paiham chalo watan ko chalen

items.title: Amma tere hussain ne sab kuch luta diya
items.body:
Amma tere hussain ne sab kuch luta diya
Nana se jo kiya ta wo, wada niba diya
Kitni uthayi mayate, tere hussain ne
Kitne sitam uthayi, tere hussain ne
Kitne diye jala diye, maqtal saja diya
Pyassa hun teen roz ka, gham se nidal hun
Zakmo se choor choor hun, ashur dahal hun
Lekin tumhare laal ne, jungle basa diya
Karyal jawan ki laash pe, roya tera hussain
Abbas ki juda ime, luta hai dil ka chain
Kud apne dil ko karbala, maine bana diya
Ujra hai gul sitan mere, murja gaye hai phool
Qurbanniya hussain ki, kar lijiye kubool
Kya tha ye dashte karabala, or kya bana diya
Maqtal dalo ek nazar, be sar sab badan
Pala tha jinko qod mein, ye wo hai pur mahan
Meine ajal ki god mein, sab ko sula diya
Har sakte imtehaan se, guzra tera hussain
Lekin na rahe sab se, uthra tera hussain
Bayat ke har sawaal ko, meine mita diya
Qwaabe khaleel ke liye, tabeer ban gaya
Amma mein ranjo gham ki wo, tashweer ban gaya
Umat ne nana jaan ko, ayse sila diya
Tum dekhna ke ek din, aysa bhi ayega
Hoga har ek zubaan par, noha hussain ka
Meine kuda ke deen par, ghar jo luta diya
Abbas phir hussain par, shamsheer chal gayi
Ab kya bayaan gham karu, ay mazhar abide
Gash kayega jise bhi ye, noha suna diya

items.title: Baba musafiron pe
items.body:

ranj o alam ki taygh jigar mein utar gayi

qaatil hi dikh rahe thay jahan tak nazar gayi
baba musafiron pe...

zindan e shaam pahunche to ye bhi ghazab hua
amma rabab karne lagi girya o fughan

zindan ke dar se deti thi ammu ko jo sada
aakhir yehi hua ke sakina bhi mar gayi
baba musafiron pe...

ye keh ke ghamzada ne kiya aakhri salaam
royenge jaa ke shehre madina mein subho shaam
sughra ko denge kaise tasalli e tashna kaam
ghar jaa ke yaad aayenge jalte huwe qayaam
basti zafar ghareebon ki ashkon se bhar gayi
baba musafiron pe...

items.title: Jab bhi chadar ki taraf utti nazar sajjad ki
items.body:
JAB BHI CHAADAR KI TARAF UTTI NAZAR SAJJAD KI X2
TAAZIYAANE CHOONAY AAYI KAMAR SAJJAD KI
NOK E NEZA PE RIDAAEN DEKH KE KHATA HEY GHASH
YEH BHI MANZAR DEKH KAR ABBID KO AAJATA HAY GHASH
SAAMNE GHURBAT PHUPHI HAI NANGY SAR SAJAD KI
HAQ E GIRY A YUN ADAA KARTY TH LE KE SHEH KA NAAM
KARBALA SE SHAAM THAK ITNA LAHOO ROEY IMAM
KHOON MEI TAR HO GAYI RAAH E SAFAR SAJAD KI
SABR KA HAR IMTEHAAN BEHR E KHUDA DENEH KE BAAD
KHA GAYA GHASH WA HIJABA KI SADA DENEH KE BAAD
JAB PARI SAR PAR PHUPHI KE IK NAZAR SAJAD KI
ZULM JAB BARNE LAGEH APNI HADON SE BHI MAZEED
JAB IMAM E WAQT KO KARNEH LAGA ZAALIM SHAHEED
BAN GAYI DARBAAR MEI ZAINAB SIPAR SAJAD KI
HA BAQAIYA MEI BHALA SAJAD KAB AARAAM MEI
JISAM AABID KA MADINY MEI HEY DIL HAY SHAAM MEI
DAFN HEY ZIDAAN MAI IK NOHA GAR SAJAD KI
SAJDA E MABOOD MEI JUKTEY TH JAB IBN E HUSSAIN
KHINCTI HAI ZANJIR AATEY TH SAKINA KE YE BAIN
THI NAMAZ E KHOON KE ASHKO SE TAR SAJAD KI
KARBALA SE SHAAM TAKH BABA KO BAS ROTEH RAHEY
AUR BAAD E SHAAM CHADAR KE LIYE AANSU BAHEY
UMR SAARI HO GAYI YOUHI BASAR SAJAD KI
JAB BHI DORAN E SAFAR BEHTHY ASAD THAK KAR IMAM
YOUH SITAMGAARO NE BEJAA KA LIA HEY INTEQAAM
BEHRIYA KHENCHI GAYI BAAE E DIGAR SAJAD KI

items.title: Karbala chelum manane
items.body:

items.title: Leke maula ka naam zainab ka
items.body:
Leke maula ka naam zainab ka
likh raha hu kalam zainab ka
Sub pe wajib hai saath zahra ke

Farsh e majlis hussain maula ki

items.title: Main Bewaye Muslim Hon Mera Naam
items.body:
MEIN BEWAYE MUSLIM HOON MERA NAAM RUQAYYA HAI
ghazi ki behan hu mai haider as mera baba hai
1.  HOKE BERBAAD MEIN KIS TERHA SE WATAN JAWOUNGI
DAAGH MUSLIM KA MEIN IS DIL PE NA SEH PAWOUNGI
HUM PE DHAYE HAI MAZALIM JO MUSALMANO NE
JAKE NANA KI LEHAD PER MEIN WO BATLAWOUNGI
MEIN BEWAYE MUSLIM HOON MERA NAME RUQAYYA HAI,
GHAZI KI BEHAN HOON MEIN HYDER MERA BABA HAI
MEIN BEWAYE MUSLIM HOON MERA NAAM RUQAYYA HAI
2.  MARA GAYA HAI LOGO GHURBAT MERA WAALI
MERI MANG BHI HAI UJDI AGHOSH BHI HAI KHAALI
KARBOBALA SE PEHLE GHER MERA LUT GAYA HAI
3. MAA NE HAI BACHPANE SE HUMKO WAFA SIKHAYI
GHAZI KI ZINDAGI MEIN SHEHH PE NA ANCH AAYI
ZAINAB KA SATH MENE HER GAAM NIBHAYA HAI
4. DO PHOOL JAISE BACCHE ANKHO KE MERI TAARE
BABA KE SATH DONO GHURBAT MEIN GAYE MAARE
AUN AUR MOHAMMED PE UNKO KIYA SADQA HAI
5. MUSLIM PE KUFIYO NE KYA KYA SITAM NA DHAYE
DHOKE SE KIYA HUMLA SHOLEY BHI HAI BERSAYE
GARDAN MEIN RASAN BANDHI GALIYO MEIN PHIRAYA HAI
6. MARO NA TAZIYANE ZAINAB KO AYE LAYEENO
LILLAH HA NA SATAWO AHMED KI NAWASI KO
PEHCHANO MUSALMANO YE SANIYE ZEHRA HAI
7. MEIN KAISE BHOOL JAWO WO DARDNAAK MANZAR
KUFE KE DAR PE DEKHI MUSLIM KI LASH BE SAR
MAZLOOM KI GHURBAT PE DIL MERA PHAT GAYA HAI
8. ISLAAM PE RAHEGA AHSAAN GHUMZADA KA
QURBANIYA HAI JISKI AGHAAZ KARBALA KA
ANKHO MEIN JISKA AANSO AWAAZ DERAHA HAI
9. KYO KER RAQAM HO MANZAR KAISE PADHE SHUJAYAT
BIBI KE DIL PE GUZRI KUFE MEIN JO QAYAMAT
TADPI HAI LAASHE MUSLIM BIBI NE JAB KAHA HAI
MEIN BEWAYE MUSLIM HOON MERA NAME RUQAYYA HAI
GHAZI KI BEHAN HOO MEIN HYDER MERA BABA HAI

items.title: Abbas ke baghair bhala kaise chalungi
items.body:
Abbas k bagahir bhala kesay chalon gi
Baba nay kaha paidal tu chalna seekh lay
Aik din ai ga tu paidal chalay gi
Meelon ka safar tanha bay chadar karay gi
Zainab nay kaha Baba aik baat toh batana (×2)
18 baradar hain (×2) ma paidal kiun chalon gi
Abbas k bagahir bhala kesay chalon gi
Hae Karbobala ma phir wo din aa gea
Hussain peh Zalim ka khanjar chal gea
Khaimon ma shaki naizay lay k aa gea
Pabanday rasan ho k bazaron ma jana (×2)
Naizon peh sar hain (×2) ma kaisay chalon gi
Abbas k bagahir bhala kesay chalon gi
Sajjad say yun kehnay lagien Zainab e Kubra
Chalna ma nay seekha tha ghar ma he tanha
Lakin ab hai yeh shaam ka bazaar
Shermo haya ki malka ma Zainab hoon (×2)
Chadar k baghair (×2) ma kesay chalon gi
Abbas k bagahir bhala kesay chalon
Shaam k darbaar ma Zainab ka ana tha
Islam e Muhammad ko is nay he bachana tha
Darbarion ko huq bhi toh sunana tha
Lehja e Haider ma yun booli Zainab (×2)
Nasir e Hussain (×2) ma yun ban ker chalon gi
Abbas k bagahir bhala kesay chalon

items.title: Aye Akbar
items.body:
Umme Laila Ne Kaha Ey Mere Noor e Nazar
Ey Mere Lakhte Jigar Ey Akbar
Mai Na Bhulungi Kabhi Zulm Ki vo Barchi or tera zakhme jigar ey akbar
Hasrto aas ke tufan liye baithi thi
Mai Tere byah ka armaan liye baithi thi
ye khabar mujhko na thi ek din dekhungi
Mai tujhe khoon Mai tar ey akbar
Mujhko Taqdeer agar din vo dikhati beta
Tera sehra Mai duaon say sajati beta
Mere hum shakle nabi Karti dum naad e Ali
Mai Tere sehre par ey akbar
Mere yusuf teri Barat na jaane payi
Rang hai teri dulhan Ghar Mai na aane payi
Kohey Ghum Yo'n tuta sath tera chuta
Lut gaya Mera Ghar ey akbar
Ey mere Noor e Nazar lakhte Jigar meri jaa'n
Dekhlu teri dulhan Dil Mai yahi tha arma'n
Khwab jo they mere ho na paste purey
Phat gaya Mera jigar ey akbar
Maine rakkha hai Tere byah ka silkar
Kaise rakhhungi bhala ab Mai jigar par Patthar
Zindagi guzregi ab toe is madar ki
Raat din Rorokar ey akbar
Ey mere Lal tujhe bhool na paungi Mai
Ashk aakhon say dino raat bahaungi Mai
Zindagi hai Jub Tak mere pyare tab Tak
Roungi Mai tujh par ey akbar
Sath pardes Mai amma ka na chhodo pyare
Maa say mooh esy gharibi may na modo pyare
Mere naazo ke paley uth ke lag jao galey
Hai pareshaN madar ey akbar
Bain Karti rahi Akbar vo ghamo ki pyari
Rokey waiz ye sada Deti rahi dukhyari
Mar Gaye tum beta rehgai Mai zinda
Ab jiyu'n ghutghut kar ey akbar

items.title: Haram e shah kuja
items.body:
Harame shah kuja...kucha-o-bazar kuja
Tauq-o-zanjeer kuja... Aabide bimaar kuja
Rukh madine ko kiya aur kaha Aabid ne
Majmae aam kuja itrate athar kuja
Binte zahra ka wazifha tha chale aao jari
Fauje aagyaar kuja zainabi kirdaar kujaa
Nauha quraan ke paro ne padha ro rokar
Ahle quraan kuja Ahle sitamgaar kuja
Aye ujalo tumhe rehna hai gawah mehshar me
Raahe bazar kuja  hae hayadaar kuja
Jinke sajdo pe ibadaat ne kiya ho sajda
Baniye zulm kuja khuld ke mukhtar kuja
Ek sadma bhare darbar ye dekha yawar
Dukhtare shah kuja shami talabgaar kuja

items.title: Hussain ki madad
items.body:

usi ke haath kat chuke

hussain ki madad karo...

har ek taraf wo zalzala
meinan e shark o gharb tha

us mein karb tha
ruka na asghare hazeen
yehi to waqt e harb tha
ye kehke jhoole se gira
hussain ki madad karo...

nahi hai sher e bawafa
akela reh gaya hussain
na akbar e hazeen raha
akela reh gaya hussain
sagheer bhi chala gaya
akela reh gaya hussain
behen ne karb se kaha
hussain ki madad karo...

tadap raha hai khaak o khoon mein
fatema ke dil ka chain
zameen se arsh tak baland
zainab e hazeen ke bain
har ek ki laash legaye
pada hai laasha e hussain
layeen hai har kuchal raha
hussain ki madad karo...

ye keh rahi hai fatema
ho khatm din malaal ke
tum ashk jo bahaoge
rakhungi mai sambhal ke

bharenge zakhm laal ke
azaa ka farsh hai bicha

urooj e ghairat e nabi

usay hai aaj bhi malaal

rakhe hijaab ka khayal

jo apna gham chupa raha hai

items.title: Koi na raha sannata hai
items.body:
Koi na raha sannata hai
Maqtal se yahi aati thi sada, koi na raha sannata hai
Pardes mein aakar kaun luta, koi na raha sannata hai
Allah ye kaisa manzar hai, jo laash bhi hai wo besar hai..(2)
behta hai yaha'n khoo'n ka darya, koi na raha sannata hai
Hai aaj fezaae'n bhi ghamgee'n, laasho'n ke sarhane koi nahi..(2)
chhayi hai falak par gham ki ghata, koi na raha sannata hai
Kuch khaime nazar aate hai jale, aur sukhe huwe toote kooze..(2)
kya qafela tha ye pyaaso ka, koi na raha sannata hai
Ye laash hai kis shehzade ki, kis tarha hua seena zakhmi..(2)
qismat ne sitam kis maa pe kiya, koi na raha sannata hai
Hai qadd mein barabar do laashe, doobe hai lahu ke darya mein..(2)
dono ko ajal ne loot liya, koi na raha sannata hai
Ye maara gaya hai kaun hasee'n, sehra hai kahin kangna hai kahin..(2)
kaisa ye sitam duniya ne kiya, koi na raha sannata hai
Ek sher pada hai sahil par, haibat ka abhi tak ye hai asar..(2)
sehmi sehmi chalti hai hawa, koi na raha sannata hai
Har simt udaasi chhayi hai, teero'n pe kise neend aayi hai..(2)
Be goro kafan laasha hai pada, koi na raha sannata hai
Maqtal se yahi aati thi sada, koi na raha sannata hai

items.title: Main Dekh Rahi Hu
items.body:
Dekha jo apne bhai ka kat ta hua gala
Sattar kadam se zainab e muztar ne di sada
Bhai ka gala hai aur sitamgar ka khanjar mai dekh rahi hoon
amma ne rakha hai haath gale par ro ro kar mai dekh rahi hoon
tum kehte rahe jisko moula khanjar k tale wo bhai hai
aye bhai kaha ho aa jao shabbir pe ghurbat aayi hai
abbas tumhara naam hai bhai lab par mai dekh rahi hoon
ahmed ke nawase par haaye kya waqt e qayamat aaya hai
chuma tha mohammed ne jisko uss halq pe khanjar chalta hai
ye karbobla mein aj qayamat ka manzar mai dekh rahi hoon
zakhmi hai badan haaye mere bhai sa koi mazloom nahi
sehrooz k pyase hai sarwar kya shimr ko ye maloom nahi
karta hai sitamgar waar gale par gin gin kar mai dekh rahi hoon
Manoos hai apne baba se bichdegi toh jee na paayegi
shamsheer gale par baba ke wo dekhte hi marr jaayegi
maidan mei na aajaye sakina mud mud kar mai dekh rahi hoon
pardes mein haaye ye kaisi saadat pe ghurbat aayi hai
hadd kardi sitam ki zaalim ne lagta hai qayamat aayi hai
hai shimr ka zaanu ibne ali k seene par mai dekh rahi hoon
bikhre hue baalon mein haaye buss khaak hi khaak nazar aaye
aakhon se baraste hai aansoon aur hooton par haaye haaye
iss haal pe pehli baar nazar aayi'n madar mai dekh rahi hoon
zeeshan aur arshad roota tha zainab ke haal pe sara run
bhai ke gale par tegh chali aur kehti rahi ro ro ke behen
hota hua run mein apne baradar ko be sar mai dekh rahi hoon

items.title: Boli Maa Aun Aur Muhammad Se
items.body:
Boli ma Aun aur Muhammad se, Jaan Shabbir par Lutana hai
Karna Sharminda na ay shahzado, Amma Zehra ko muh Dikhana hai
Saare Ashaab mere bhai ke, be khata dasht me hain maare gae
Koi bhi abb nahi hai khaimo me, apni jaan bhai per fida karde,
Ayse mushkil ghadi me ay beto, sheh ki tanhai ko mitana hai.
Ummati hoke bhi paraye hain, aale Ahmed se ladne aae hain,
Badr o siffin ka hai gham taaza, badla haider se lene aae hain,
Jao jab unke tum muqabil per, naara-e haidery lagana hai.
Tumse nazre nahi milaugi, shikwe nani ko hai sunaogi,
Zinda wapas joh aae khaimo me, seene tumko nahi lagaugi,
Chahte hoke tumse raazi rahu, sheh ki khatir ghale katana hai.
Barchi seene pe khaega Akbar, hoga tukdo me Qasim dilbar,
Jinko parwaan khud chadaya hai, unke laashe uthaege sarwar,
Bhai maqtal me tumko jab dekhe, apne har zakhm ko chhupana hai.
Jaanti ho ke tum bhi ho pyase, ladlo ha magar yeh yaad rahe,
Pyase bache hai abb bhi khaimo me, boond paani na halq se utray,
Paani ko dekh kar khayal rahe, pehle besheer ko pilana hai.
Lashe baccho ki lae jab sarwar, har koi peetta tha sina o sar,
Inna lilla h padhke boli maa, tumpai hargiz na roegi muztar,
Mujhko apne ghareeb bhai par, khoone dil aanko se bahana hai.
Qaid se chhoot kar joh binte Ali, karbala hoke apne ghar pahochi,
Nanne nanne musalle jab dekhe, karke rukh Karbala ka kehne lagi,
De mujhe izn mere majae, aaj beto ka gham manana hai.
Joh bhi nauha jawad likhta hai, yeh tere ladlo ka sadka hai,
unke taboot jab bhi uthtay hain, ashk behte hain dil tadapta hai,
Joh na roo paayi apne pyaro ko, uske baccho ka gham manana hai.

items.title: Koi na tha jo karata
items.body:

imam-e-waqt se jab zuljana ne ye suna

koi na tha jo karata…

items.title: Ali Ali haye Ali
items.body:
Haye Ali Haye Ali Ya Ali Haye Ali
Gul dasta e azan say mua'zzin ne di sada
Qayam hui namaz uthey shahe lafata
Baad e ruku sajda e khalik Mai sir rakha
Sajde say sir uthate he haye Ghazab hua
Aayi nida e ghaib ke Haider hue shaheed
Gharme khuda ke saqiy e Kausar hue shaheed
Ali Ali Haye Ali Aye Mere Moula
Sajde Mai Sir Zakhmi Hua Shere khuda ka
1)
Teghe bine muljim say hai zakhmi sar e Anwar
Or khoN say namaz e ke musalla bhi hua tar
Aate hai nazar khoon mai dubey hue Haider
Masjid Mai lahu behta raha shere khuda ka
2...Teghe bine muljim jo chali farq e Ali par
Is zulm say aalam mai bapa hogaya Mehshar
Marqad Mai larazne lagi khud ruhey payambar
Jibril ne bhi noha padha shere khuda ka
3...Kufey Mai khabar phaili ke Haider hui zakhmi
Mehrab Mai damad e payamber hue zakhmi
Guriya hai falak saqiye Kausar hue zakhmi
Matam hai zamane Mai bapa shere khuda ka
4...Ab aal e Mohammad ko nahi zabt ka yara
Bikhara hua masjid Mai hai quran ka para
Quraan ke maathe say rawaN khuN ka hai dhara
Shamshir say sir zakhmi hua shere khuda ka
5...Aalam Mai Numaya hai jo aasar e Qayamat
Sadat Mai kohram hai maar e gaye Hazrat
Mabud ke ghar Mai hui Bande ki shahadat
Sir sajda e khalik Mai kata shere khuda ka
6...Kufey ke yateemo ke Labo par hai ye fariyad
Ab kon ghareebo ki karega bhala imdad
Koi bhi sahara nhi hum hogaye barbad
Ghar sog mai duba hua shere khuda ka
7...Hai zainabo kulsum ke chehro pa udasi
Abbas ke Rukhsar pa hai gard e yateemi
Hasnain ki aakhon say na kyon ashk hojari
Aalam mai hai taboot utha shere khuda ka
8...Moula ka mere kya ho bayaN haal e shahadat
Is haal Mai bhi karte hai qatil ki ziyafat
Allah re ye jazba e isaaro murawwat
Hamsar koi kya hoga bhala shere khuda ka
9....Sir pit ke jo rotey hai Zehra ke dulharey
Aakash pa larza hai chamak te hue taare
Yun Haider e karra suye khuld sidhare
Mooh takti rahi aale eba shere khuda ka
10....Mazhar ye raqam noha e gham karta rahega
Akbar bhi usey shamo sahar padhta rahega
Her dour Mai apna ye Alam ucha rahega
Saya hai saro par jo sada shere khuda ka

items.title: Dastane Shujaath Ka Darain Me
items.body:
Dastane Shujaath ka darain me ek bemisl kirdar abbas hai
Hai Ali ke Athara Hi bete Ali x2 Par sabhi me Alamdar Abbas Hai
Inke lehje me hashim ki hashmat bhi hai
Inke tewar me hamza ki haibat bhi
Har ada inki imran ka aqs hai
Inki baho me jaffar ki quwwat bhi hai
Pyar hai mustufa ka hussain o hasan
Aur hassnain ka pyar abbas hai
Qabr kya hai andhera sa ghar hai jahan
Marefat ke siva koi sapna nahi
Vo bohat hi andheri jagah hai waha
Koi yawar nahi koi apna nahi
Tumse milne lahad me ali aayenge
Bolo tanhai me aur kya chahiye
Naqle azmat ka shireen samar hai yehi
Ismato ke sadaf ke gohar hai yehi
Noor ki sidratulmuntaha hai yehi
Hashmi aasman ke qamar hai yehi
Jinke saaye me akber bhi palte rahe
Husn ka aisa minaar abbas hai
Hal ata innama ki jo misdaaq hai
Vo bhi ghazi ke aane ki mushtaq hai
Arsh se farsh tak inki jageer hai
Sari maqloq inki gadageer hai
Jo ali ki shujath ka waria bhi hai
Aisa aala zameendar abbas hai
Sahebe taqt akhline gairat hai ye
Aur charaghe hareebe sharafat hai
Zore shehwar Behre saqawat hai ye
Haq to ye hai ke haq ki haqeeqat hai
Vo duwwayen jo bibi ne sajdo me ki
Kul duaoo ka meyar abbas hai

items.author: Zafar Abbas

items.title: Like You O'Hussain (a.s) There is No Other
items.body:
Son of Allah’s fearless warrior, Oh Hussain (as)
Master of the youth of paradise, Oh Hussain (as)
Oh the Master of Martyrs, Oh Hussain (as)
Whoever takes your name, Allah blesses them with more than they can wish for,
Oh Hussain
Angels are granted with wings in your name, Oh Hussain (as)
People are blessed with sons in your name, Oh Hussain (as)
The world sheds tears in your name, Oh Hussain (as)
Life in your name
Death in your name
Unbearable is the sorrow,
Nerve-racking is the agony you put up with
For humanity and for truth to prevail
Oh Hussain (as) Oh Hussain (as) Oh Hussain (as)
Like You oh Husayn there is no other
Such a brave strong and loyal man
In history you'll never see
The world will never seee
Let us tell you the story of Karbala
Islam is still alive, just because of Karbala ...
and will remain alive, just because of Karbala
You are the grandson of the Prophet and the son of the Imam
You sacrificed all that you had so you could save Islam
Oh Husayn oh Husayn like You there is no other !!
Like you oh Hussain ...
Ur son Ali Akbar, was so dear to you
Bid farewell to your mother you told him to do
You sent him to the battle even though u knew
He would be sacrificed in Allah's name too
A spear was pierced into his wounded chest
He called out oh my master … this death is surely of the best
Oh Husayn … Oh Husayn
You crawled towards the enemy to search for your son
He was the lookalike oof the Prophet, what has been done...
Your nephew Qaasim was adamant to fight
Just like your brother Hassan, was His face's sight
For the truth with all his will and might
He said I have no fear if our path is right
Sweeter than honey to me is death
Oh master by your side, I wish to take my last breath
Oh Husayn … Oh Husayn
You carried the pieces of Qaasims trampled body to the tent
Oh The final sign of my beloved brother was your lamentYour sister Zaynab brought her two young sons to you
What she had come for oh Husayn you knew
My brother please accept my sacrifices too
Aun and Muhammad I have told you what to do
Fight like no other make your Dear Uncle proud
Only then into the tents … will your bodies be allowed
Oh Husayn … Oh Husayn
Your nephews fought like true warriors but then were killed
On the scorching sand they lay but with happiness ... their eyes were filled
There was Abbas your beloved brother
He was assigned as the army's protector
He made a promise to Husayn's young daughter
That from the river, I'll get you some water
Abbas how can I let you go too
Without you oh my brother, Husayn cried what will I do
Oh Husayn … Oh Husayn
You watched the enemy attack Abbas from all around,
When Abbas fell from his horse You also…., fell to the ground
When there was no one left by your side
Is there anyone to help me you sighed
Then from the tents a holy Lady cried
You ran to see what had happened inside
Out of his cradle fell your 6 month old baby
His mother cried he's thirsty, they'll give him water maybe
Oh Husayn ...
With Asghar towards the enemy you went to check
But the cursed enemyy shot an arrow through, his fragile neck
This is the only wish of MAHUM, SAANIA and ADEEYA

items.title: Hilale mahe moharam
items.body:
hilale mahe moharam pe pad gayi jo nazar
to yaad aa gaya zehra ke laal ka wo safar
raqam ho kis tarha phat'ta hai gham se qalb o jigar
watan se ruqsat e aakhir ka phir gaya manzar
lipat lipat ke wo sughra ka baba se israar
mujhe bhi saath mein le kar chalo shahe abraar
<<DIVIDER>>
suna raha hoo suno dastane dard o alam
ye kiske gham mein hai masroofe girya-o-matam
ye kaun tha jise rote hai is tarha se hum
bafaize shahe shaheeda karoon jawab raqam
aza ka maah isi maah ko jo kehte hai
hilal dekh ke chote bade wo rote hai
<<DIVIDER>>
yazeede faasiq-o-faajir ki jab na bayyat ki
to aur bad gaya jo bugz dil mein tha zaleel
samajh raha tha pase parda kya hai haq ka wali
safar ka faisla karne mein kuch na dayr lagi
watan chutay to chutay hurmate madina rahe
mai hoo na hoo magar islam ka kareena rahe
<<DIVIDER>>
mai sab batata chaloon kaun tha ye haq ka wali
hai uska naame gira aur hussain ibne ali
rajab ke maah mein do din thay baaqi aur abhi
chala madine se makke ki simt sipte nabi
wahan bhi dekh ke aba mein chipe hue khanjar
libaase haajiyon mein tha wo sham ka lashkar
<<DIVIDER>>
hazaron dushmane jaan dar libase dost milay
baqa e kaaab thi peshe nazar na kate galay
ye sochte thay ke sailaab e kufr kaise talay
badalke umre mein hajj ko ba dard-o-yaas chalay
abhi thay raah mein koofe ki jo ye aayi khabar
ke qatl hogaye muslim wahan ni qasta jigar
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sunke tha shahe abraar ko bahot sadma
bulaake hazrate abbas ko ye hukm diya
bajaye kufa koi aur raah lo bhaiya
bala se dasht ho sehra ho jo khuda ki raza
ye kufe waale farebi hai aur jhoote hai
hamare saath mein kuch bibiyan hai bache hai
<<DIVIDER>>
gharaz ke teen moharam ko nainawa pahunche
tamaam khaafile ke saath mustufa pahunche
malaik aur ajina o aur ambiya pahunche
hassan ke saath zehra-o-murtaza pahunche
hussain ne rakhe karbobala mein apne khadam
nidae ghaib ye aayi ke tere saath hai hum

jo aayi mahe moharam ki subhe aashura
sagheer bachon ka tha ghair haal had se siwa
buland hoti thi qaimon se al-atash ki sada
layeen dikhate thay pani ko aur bahaate thay
nabi ki aal ko lekin nahi pilaate thay

anees aale mohamed ka hai to royega
na chain din ko milega na shab ko soyega
ye zaade raahe haqeeqi hai kaise khoyega
ye haq hai baad mein ehsaas tujhko hoyega
rafeeq wo nahi jo gham mein saath ko choday
khushi mein saath ho lekin alam mein moo moday

items.title: Jo Kare Salam
items.body:
Jo Kare Salam
Jo kare salam basad adab Sheh tashnalab ki janab me,
Toh Ba roze hashr ajab nahi ke rawan ho Sheh ki rakaab me.
Jo kare salam..
Jo shameem boo-e-Hussain (as) hai, Wo araq me Sheh ki hai boo-e-khush,
Na wo boo hai ambar-o-mishq me, Na wo boo hai itr-o-gulab me.
Jo kare salam..
Shab-e-qatl chaunk ke neend se ye pukari Zainab-e-dil hazeen,
Mujhe haaye Hussain (as) barehna ser nazar aayi Fatima (sa) khwaab me.
Jo kare salam..
Kabhi ser ke baalon se maa meri ye zameen jhaad ke kehti thi,
Na Rahe Khalash khaso khaar ki mere gul ke bistaro khwab me.
Jo kare salam..
Kabhi Paani laake chidakti thi ye sukhan tha lab pe ke soyega,
Gul-e-Bu-Turab ka dil ruba isi ban keg arm turab me.
Jo kare salam..
Jo nihal taza ho baagh me usay kaat’te nahi baaghban,
Ye ghazab hai Akbar-e-Naujawan hua qatl ain shabab me.
Jo kare salam..
Jo kiya sawal Imam ne ye namaz-e-zohr ka waqt hai,
Mujhe sajda karne do farz hai toh layeen ne bola jawab me.
Jo kare salam..
Na milegi fursate dam zadan na padhen Hussain (as) namaz ko,
Ke nahi qubool ye bandage teri aaj haq ki janab me.
Jo kare salam..
Kaha tab habeeb ne ae layeen ye Hussain (as) sibte Rasool (saw) hai,
Sharaf-o-Kamal Hussain (as) ka hai bayan Hadees-o-kitab me.
Jo kare salam..
Ajab ehle sham the be haya jinhe paas sharm zara na tha,
Sare paake Sibte Rasool (saw) ko gaye le ke bazme sharab me.
Jo kare salam..
Jo suno kalam-e-Fasih ko toh durood bhejo Rasool (saw) par,
Ye sila jo do ge salam ka toh shareek hoge sawab me.
Jo kare salam..
Jo kare salam basad adab Sheh tashnalab ki janab me,
Toh Ba roze hashr ajab nahi ke rawan ho Sheh ki rakaab me.

items.title: Bazar e sham me hai
items.body:
Shaam me ehle haram laaye gaye jab be rida.
Taziyaane pusht par barsa rahe the ashkiya.
Dhoop me bacche tadap kar keh rahe the al-atash.
Paara paara binte haidar ka jigar hota raha.
Baazaare shaam me hai, baalo se muh chhupaae.
Zainab pe zaalimo ne,  kya kya sitam hai dhaae.
Durre laga laga ke, haste the jab sitamgar.
Tab faatema beti roti thi sar jhhukaae.
Sheh ke yateem bacche, pyase tadap rahe hai
Sab maangte hai paani, zaynab kaha'n se laae.
Jalti huvi zamee'n pe  hai nange paau qaydi
Kaante sitamgato ne raaho me hai bichhae.
Shaane kata ke ghaazi darya pe so raha hai.
Kisko sada de zainab hai kon jo bachae.
Urya'n pada hai laasha bhaai ka karbalaa me.
Pardesh me bahan ko kis tarh chaan aae.
Aakar najaf se baba beti ki dekho haalat.
Jaati hai kayd ho kar dee'n pe rida lutaae.
Sajjad ko laeeno maaro na taziyaane.
Mushkil se chal raha hai zulmo sitam uthaae.
Navshad ki dua hai jaae waqaar karbal.
Shabbeer ke haram me farshe aza bichhae.

items.title: Abbas Ki Aamad Hai
items.body:
Abbas ki aamad hai pur kaif nazare hain
Hai eid wafaon ki khush chand sitare hain
Haider ki duaon ko khaliq ne asar bakhsha
Sbbas ki soorat me be misl dia tohfa
Ek aur ali aya ye saaf ishare hain
Kulsoom ne zainab ne hasnain ne khush ho kar
Ghazi ki balaye lee jeene ki dua dekar
Gesooye jari bibi fizza ne saware hain
Jis simt se bhi dekho haider ka sarapa hai
Abbas ke chehre me eeman ka jalwa hai
Hain hifz use jitne quraan ke paare hain
Firdaus se dunia me ye khas khabar aai
Kulsoom ki zainab aur hasnain ki soorat hi
Abbase ali bibi zahra ke bhi pyare hain
Jibreel jhulate hain abbas ka gahwara
Midhat ke qaseedo se hooro ne sama bandha
Kahte hain jina wale abbas humare hain
Shabbir ne ye kahke parcham hai use saupa
Siffeen ke maidan me dunia ne hai khud dekha
Haider ke kamalo fan abbas me saare hain
Manzar wo ziarat ka mahdi o raza mazhar
Bhule hain na bhullenge kahte hain qasam khakar
Abbas ke rauze par wo din jo guzare hain

items.title: Bazar Hai Pathar Hai Zainab Ka Khula Sar Hai
items.body:
Bazar hai pathar hain zainab ka khula sar hai
Har zakhm pey shukrana zainab kay laboon per hai
Ek girya e khooni ki jaati hi nahi laali
Sajjad ki ankhun ko daikha hi nahi khali
Ya khoon hai ankhun main ya sham ka manzar hai
Latka dar e koofa pey daikha hai koi lasha
Kyun ch'oub sy mehmil ki zainab nay hai sar maara
Ay bakht lahuu sy kyun zainab ki jabeen tarr hai
Yeh shour e buka kiya hai matam ki sada kia hai
Tauheed bachae jo woh karb o bala kiya hai
ya hai sar e sarwar ya zainab teri chadar hai
Yeh sham e gareeban sy pur haul bayaban tak
Bazaar sy kofa tak darbar sy zindaan tak
Beyreham tamachay hain aur shah ki dukhtar hai
Takrati hai sar apna jae tu kahan jae
Masoom sakina ko ghash ae kay maut ae
Jiskay liye zindaan main bus khaak ka bistar hai
Woh qal'b thay kaisay jo jan lay gae sarwar kii
Pathar to woh hai jisnay pathar ki haya rakhi
Ae Sang e Halab tujhko kaisay kahuun pathar hai
kyun hai hussaina ka ik shour sa uthta hai
sar Ghazi ka naizay sy kyun khaak pey girta hai
Ghazi ki behan shayad balway main khulay sar hai
Maqtal nay khuda janay kia ch'een lia iska
Ek haath kaleejay per rehta hai dhara jiska
Lagta hai mujhy shayd yeh madar e akbar hai
Ek karb o bala awal ek kar o bala akhir
Kehtay hai naveed usko shabbir jo hai zahir
Aur jo pas e parda hai woh zainab e muztar hai.
