items.title: Hashr se pehle
items.body:
Hashr se pehle.....
Hashr se pehle Zamane me qayamat hogayi...
Mustufa ki laadli Nazre musibat hogayi...
(1)
The nabi ke ummati lekin sitam aisa Kiya,
Fatema ko baap ka matam nahi karne Diya,
Dhaye Kuch aise sitam paamal gairat hogayi.....
(2)
Ahlebait e Mustafa se dushmani ki leke aadh,
Zaalimo'n ne is kadar Toda masayeb ke pahaad,
Fatema Binte Mohammed ki Shahadat hogayi...
(3)
Jalta darwaza gira jab Fatema ke jism par,
Fatema ne di sada Fizza ko tab ye cheekh kar,
Aao Fizza aao Mohsin ki shahadat hogayi.....
(4)
Lene aate the falak wale Jahan par rotiya'n,
Haye us dar pe sitamgar leke aaye lakdiyan,
Aag us ghar me lagane ki hasrat hogayi.....
(5)
Gusl jab hasbe wasiyat Murtuza dene lage,
Sabr kar paye na tooti pasliyon ko dekh ke,
Yak ba Yak sher e Khuda ki Gair haalat hogayi.....
(6)
Fatahe khaibar dahade maar kar rone lage,
Laash nehlate hue aakho'n se mooh dhone lage,
Keh Uthe Salman ye Haye kaisi musibat hogayi....
(7)
Pasliyan tooti thi phir bhi mujhse batlaya nahi
Sabera kitni thi'n haaye Binte Khatmul mursaleen,
Jab ye Maula ne kaha to aur Riqqat hogayi....
(8)
Hay'n Abhi kamsin bohot dono dulare Fatema,
Inko chodhe jaati ho kiske sahare Fatema,
Dekho beto'n ki yateemi jaisi Surat hogayi.....
(9)
Laash ko jab de chuke Mushkil kusha guslo kafan,
Aakhri deedar karne Maa ka jab aaye Hasan,
Zainab o kulsoom jab tadpi qayamat hogayi....
(10)
Us ghadi Shabbir ye karne lage ro ro ke bayn,
Bin bulaye aapke Amma na aayega Husain,
Haath jab nikle kafan se Aur Aafat hogayi.....
(11)
Jis ka baba ho Jahan me Taaj daare Ambiya,
Uski beti ka janaza raat me haye utha,
Fatema ki baad e mursal aisi halaat hogayi.....
(12)
Tha Rawa'n Hasnain ke Aakho'n se aasu Zulfiqar,
Lab pe thi Afroz unke Haye Amma ki pukaar,
Dono Shehzadon ke aage Dafn Mayyat hogayi....

items.title: Ho Kaha Bhai Abbas A.S
items.body:
Thi ye Zainab ki sada ho kaha'n bhai Abbas.
Chhin gai meri rida - ho kaha'n bhai Abbas.
*1*
Jis ko tu kahta tha Aaqa wo kaha'n hai bhai.
Kat gaya us ka gala - ho kaha'n bhai Abbas.
*2*
Tha jo ham shakl e Payambar nawjawa'n Akbar ko.
Neza seene pe laga - ho kaha'n bhai Abbas.
*3*
Tak te hai'n rasta tera ab bhi ye pyaase bachche.
Paani ab leke to aa - ho kaha'n bhai Abbas.
*4*
Durre khaata hai ye beemar bhateeja mera.
Aake ab us ko bacha - ho kaha'n bhai Abbas.
*5*
Mere parde ka muhaafiz kyo'n nahi sunta tu.
Chhin li zaalim ne rida - ho kaha'n bhai Abbas.
*6*
Shaam ki galiyo'n me beparda fira kar ham ko.
Hanste hai'n ahal e jafa - ho kaha'n bhai Abbas.
*7*
Nargh e aada me hu'n aur nahi sar pe chaadar.
Baal hai meri rida - ho kaha'n bhai Abbas.
*8*
Bhai aththara the lekin koi baaqi na raha.
Kis ko ab du'n main sada - ho kaha'n bhai Abbas.
*9*
Laasha Abbas ka tadpa hai taraai pe "Anees".
Jab bhi Zainab ne kaha - ho kaha'n bhai Abbas.

items.title: Aa jao tarayi se
items.body:
Aajao taraai se, ab behre khuda ghaazi.
Ro ro ke sakeena yeh deti thi sada ghaazi.
Darya pe na so jaana, ghanghor andhera hai.
Paani ki nahi mujko, ab koi tamanna hai.
Mashqeeza liye khaali lout aao chacha ghaazi.
Dhaate hai sitam aada baba bhi nahi aaye.
Batlaavo hame aakar jaae to kaha'n jaae.
Jalta hai harek khayma lut'ti hai rida ghaazi.
Rukhsaar tamaacho se, mere hai lahu me tar.
Or shimre sitamgar ne chheene hai mere gauhar.
Kaano se mere dekho hai khoon rava ghaazi.
Sajjad ke bistar ko khayme me jalaate hai'n.
Be-rehm sitamgar ye bachho'n ko sataate hai'n.
Ab kis se madad maange ham tere siva ghaazi.
Jalta hai mera kurta ab kon bachaaega.
Or aag yeh daaman ki kon aake bujhaaega.
Ab had se siva ham par hoti hai jafa ghaazi.
Gar aap na aaye to mai nehr pe aaungi.
Haalat mai tumhe apni ro ro ke sunaungi.
Batlavo huve muj se kyu'n aap khafa ghaazi.
Tanhaai ka aalam hai aansu mai bahaaungi
Kis tarh mai jangal me ab raat guzaarungi.
Jee paaungi na hokar mai tum se juda ghaazi.
Navshado waqaar unki turbat pe kare girya.
Roze me sakeena ke din raat pade nawha.
Hardam yeh tadapkar ham karte hai'n dua ghaazi.

items.title: Ana Abbas E Ali(as)
items.body:
Aasmano Ki Bulandi Pe Hai Rutba Mera
Mujko Khud Fatema Zahra(S.A)Ne Kaha Hai Beta
Me Hu Sakka E Sakina Me Shahenshaahe Wafa
Manzelat Meri Samaj Sakti Nahi Ye Duniya
Sani E Haidere Karrar Hu Jarrar Hu Me
Lashkare Sibte Paymbar Ka Alamdaar Hu Me
Ana Abbase Ali
Ana Abbase Jari
Mere Aaqa Ki Gulami Hai Shahenshahi Meri
Ana Abbase Ali
Ana Abbase Jari
Haidero Shabbbaro Shabbir Ka Hu Me Pyara
Teen Imamo Me Julaya Hai Mera Gehwara
Mera Rutba Hai Bada
Me Zamane Se Juda
Dono Aalam Ke Liye
Me Hu Har Gam Ki Dawa
Ye Jaha Mera Gadagar Hai Tawangar Me Hu
Jo Mukaddar Ko Badal De Wo Sikndar Me Hu
Mujse Ik Baar Zara Maang Ke Dekhe Koi
Sher Kehte Hain Muje Galibe Kul Galib Ka
Meri Rag Rag Me Rawa Khu Hai Abutalib Ka
Me Hu Sultaane Wafa
Me Hu Haider Ki Dua
Ran Me Har Hamle Se
Mera Hamla Hai Juda
Shamiyo Dasht Ko Lasho Se Abhi Bhar Dunga
Hukm Milte Hi Tumhe Zero Zabar Kar Dunga
Dushmane Sibte Paymbar Se Ladaai Hai Meri
Mashk Laya Hu Me Talwaar Kaha Laya Hu
Jang Karne Nahi Paani Ke Liye Aaya Hu
Me Hu Sakka E Haram
Me Hu Pyaaso Ka Bharam
Jaan Pyaari Hai Agar
Kheech Lo Piche Qadam
Apne Abru Se Bayabaan Ulat Sakta Hu
Toote Naize Se Bhi Maidaan Ulat Sakta Hu
Rokne Ki Muje Jurrat Nahi Karna Koi
Mera Jazba Meri Himmat Meri Taaqat Dekho
Ak Pyaase Ki Sitamgaar Pe Haibat Dekho
Me Shuja,At Ka Dhani
Me Ita,At Ka Wali
Tum Ho Buzdil Ke Pisar
Me Hu Abbase Ali
Sani E Haidere Karrar Nahi Ho Sakta
Mujsa Duniya Me Wafadaar Nahi Ho Sakta
Chullu Me Aab Hai Or Hoth Pe Hai Tashna Labi
Jab Ama Nama Huwa Pesh Jari Ke Aage
Bola Abbas Ama Naame Ke Tukde Kar Ke
Ham Daga Karte Nahi
Mout Se Darte Nahi
Ran Me Hote Hain Shaheed
Ham Kabhi Marte Nahi
Kya Shahadat Ka Maza Hai Ye Kaha Tumko Khabar
Qatl Ke Baad Me Fir Zinda Kiya Jaau Agar
Waar Dunga Me Shahe Wala Pe Fir Jaan Meri
Gaiz Kehta Hai Ke Kohraam Machaya Jaaye
Hukm Kehta Hai Nahi Sabr Dikhaya Jaaye
Ha Wafadaar Hu Me
Aala Kirdaar Hu Me
Jisko Kehte Hain Wafa
Uska Sardaar Hu Me
Apne Baba Ki Tarah Sher Jigar Rakhta Hu
Teero Talwaar Me Maqtal Ka Safar Karta Hu
Chodna Seekha Nahi Sher Ne Maidaan Kabhi
Shor Khaimo Me Kamar Thaame Shahe Wala Hain
Me Batata Hu Tumhe Mere Masayeb Kya Hain
Jab Chala Teere Sitam
Ho Gye Baazu Qalam
Pani Pohcha N Saka
Reh Gya Dil Me Alam
Ghodo Ki Taapo Se Tukdo Me Meri Laash Bati
Is Liye Kabr Meri Hai Ali Asgar Jaisi
Puche Turbat Se Koi Kya Hai Meri Mazloomi
Khoon Aalood Wo Parcham Nahi Bhulenge Ham
Teri Majlis Tera Maatam Nahi Bhulenge Ham

Ay Mere Gam Ki Dawa

Ay Sakina(S.A) Ke Chacha

items.title: Ay bekaso muztar
items.body:
ay bekas o muztar ke wafadar alamdar
ay jaan o dil e hyder e karrar alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmon se badan choor hua jaata hai jaago
ay mere sipar mere wafadar alamdar
ay bekas o muztar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ta umr mujhe tum ne bas aaqa hi kaha hai
bhai bhi to kehdo zara ek baar alamdar
ay bekas o muztar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sone nahi deta tha jinhe khauf tumhara
ab chain se soyenge wo ashraar alamdar
ay bekas o muztar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon se lahoo poch ke shabbir pukare
bhai ka karo aakhri deedar alamdar
ay bekas o muztar...
<<DIVIDER>>
parde ke tahaffuz ka kiya jinse tha waada
kya unse kahe zainab e lachaar alamdar
ay bekas o muztar...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas baradar ki ye ghurbat bhi to dekho
tanhaai hai aur sayyed e abraar alamdar
ay bekas o muztar...
<<DIVIDER>>
us fauj ke marne ka yaqeen aaye to kaise
jis fauj ka tum jaisa ho jarraar alamdar
ay bekas o muztar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab raaton ko pehre pe bhala kaun rahega
abid hai faqad wo bhi hai bemaar alamdar
ay bekas o muztar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai yaad bilal aaj bhi baba ki wasiyat
shabbir se ab tak hai khabardar alamdar
ay bekas o muztar...
items.author: Bilal Kazmi

items.title: Aye masjid e kufa
items.body:
Sajde mein namazi pe hua zulm ye kaisa
aye masjid e kufa, aye masjid e kufa
Damaad e payambar ka lahu kisne bahaya
aye masjid e kufa, aye masjid e kufa
sajde mein..
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Zainab ke kaleje pe chala zulm ka khanjar
roti hai tadapkar
jibreel khabar unki sunane juhi aaya
aye masjid e kufa, aye masjid e kufa
sajde mein..
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Is zulm se aghaaz hua karbobala ka
har lab pe hai nauha
masroof hai matam mein mohammad ka gharana
aye masjid e kufa, aye masjid e kufa
sajde mein..
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Hasnain chale ghar se khabar ghum ki ye pakar
kehte the ye rokar
ab sabr ka yaara nahi phat-ta hai kaleja
aye masjid e kufa, aye masjid e kufa
sajde mein..
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Baithi thi sirhane koi payro ko sambhale
karti rahi naale
unniswi tareekh ko is tarha guzara
aye masjid e kufa, aye masjid e kufa
sajde mein..
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Phir ghusl o kafan shabbar o shabbir ne dekar
zainab ko bulakar
gharwalo ko bhi aakhri deedar karaya
aye masjid e kufa, aye masjid e kufa
sajde mein..
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Al qissa wasiyat se jo farigh hue haider
barpa hua mehshar
ek aakhri hichki ne zamane ko hilaya
aye masjid e kufa, aye masjid e kufa
sajde mein..
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Ekkiswi ramzaan ka din tha ke qayamat
aayi thi musibat
zainab ne kaha waqt e yateemi hai hamara
aye masjid e kufa, aye masjid e kufa
sajde mein..
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Ghar se jo chala haider e safdar ka janaza
tha shor buka ka
har fard ye kehta tha ke faryaad khudaya
aye masjid e kufa, aye masjid e kufa
sajde mein..
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Gehware ko ek simt se hasnain uthakar
chalne lage rokar
ek simt se mayyat ko farishto ne uthaya
aye masjid e kufa, aye masjid e kufa
sajde mein..
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Mazhar ye qalam rota hai dil kaanp raha hai
matam ki sada se
kis tarha likhu haider e qarrar ka nauha
aye masjid e kufa, aye masjid e kufa
sajde mein..

items.title: Baba tera ek shab
items.body:
beti se kaha sheh ne meri jaan sakina
baba tera ek shab ka hai mehman sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor ki ghurbat mein aseeri ke safar mein
be-rehm zamane mein rahe baad padar ke
har gaam khuda tera nigehban sakina
baba tera ek shab...
beti se kaha sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
pathar bhi tamacha kabhi durra bhi lagela
badlega kayi rang tera phool sa chehra
haan daure yateemi nahi aasan sakina
baba tera ek shab...
beti se kaha sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai aap ki aagosh mein chup jaungi baba
aur akbar o abbas ko bulwaungi baba
tanha to na hogi sar e maidan sakina
baba tera ek shab...
beti se kaha sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein na kooza liye khaali chali aana
abbas ko ro ro ke na darya se bulaana
hojayenge sharminda chacha jaan sakina
baba tera ek shab...
beti se kaha sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba tera qatil kya musalman nahi hai
kya yaad nabi ka usay farmaan nahi hai
shabbir ki baaton pe hai hairaan sakina
baba tera ek shab...
beti se kaha sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
jal jayega ghar baar to ghabraogi bibi
kal shab kahin baba ko na tum paogi bibi
na rehm karenge ye musalman sakina
baba tera ek shab...
beti se kaha sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
jin bacchon ke jal jaate hai ghar sote hai kaise
mar jaaye jo gar baap to phir rote hai kaise
batlao na baba ke hai nadaan sakina
baba tera ek shab...
beti se kaha sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaano ke tere zakhm tujhe sone na denge
zaalim mere laashe pe tujhe rone na denge
tarsegi tu rone ko meri jaan sakina
baba tera ek shab...
beti se kaha sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
sone ki tere seene pe zid chod ke baba
so jayegi zindan ki zameen od ke baba
ho jayegi islam pe qurban sakina
baba tera ek shab...
beti se kaha sheh ne...
items.author: Naqvi

items.title: Bazare shaam may
items.body:
bazare shaam may darbare aam may
qaidi rahi nana roti rahi nana
do tohfe laayi hoon mai aap ke liye
ek bhai ka kurta aur bazu'on ke neel
karbal se shaam tak be-maqna o chadar
pur-khar raho par chalti rahi nana
bazare sham may...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya bekasi bhari aayi wo shame gham
asbaab lut gaya qaime bhi jal gaye
jis dam mere sar se cheeni gayi rida
abbas ko sada deti rahi nana
bazare sham may...
<<DIVIDER>>
balon ka tha parda baazu may reesma
bali sakina ka jakda huwa gala
karte rahe aada jo sang baariyan
har ranj o musibat sehti rahi nana
bazare sham...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad natawan pe zulm ka toofan
haton may hathkadi pairon may bediyan
durre lagate thay har gaam pe aada
us bekasi pe mai roti rahi nana
bazare sham...
<<DIVIDER>>
bano ka laadla asghar bhi chal basa
akbar bhi chal basa qasim bhi chal basa
mahe bani hashim ghazi bhi chal basa
ashoor ko din bhar lut'ti rahi nana
bazare sham...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbal ki dasht may ye kya sitam hua
mai be-rida rahi wo bekafan raha
tapte zameen pe laasha pada raha
mai kuch na kar saki ghut'ti rahi nana
bazare sham...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan e shaam ka aalam ajab sa tha
din may thi tez dhoop raton may oas thi
maa'en tadapti thi bache bilakte thay
har pal wahan pe mai marti rahi nana
bazare sham...
<<DIVIDER>>
ahmed badi ghamgeen zainab ki dastan
kaamp uth'ti lehad ahmed ki ay hassan
mushkil ka marhala tay karke aayi hoo
bhai ki maut par roti rahi nana
bazare sham...
items.author: Zulfiqar Ahmed

items.title: Dekh kar hairaan
items.body:
dekh kar hairaan khuda hai asghar e baysheer ko
kar diya do lakht jis ne hurmala ke teer ko
<<DIVIDER>>
chad ke naize pe bachaya tu ne asghar la ilaah
deen e ahmed pe hua yun teer kha kar tu fida
marhaba kehna pada khud kaatib e taqdeer ko
kar diya do lakht jis ne hurmala ke teer ko
dekh kar hairaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid ki tanhaiyan aur is pe zaalim ke sitam
bhool jayegi layeen ko aur kaano ke zakhm
qabr bhoolegi na teri haye kabhi humsheer ko
kar diya do lakht jis ne hurmala ke teer ko
dekh kar hairaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
saath jab baba ke asghar ko na payegi rubab
leke khaali godh kaise shaam jayegi rubab
bas khayal aata hai maqtal mein yehi shabbir ko
kar diya do lakht jis ne hurmala ke teer ko
dekh kar hairaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
jhoolta naize pe jhoola na ye bhoolega jahan
ta abad royenge us ko ye zameen o aasman
kar gaya nakaam zaalim ki jo har tadbeer ko
kar diya do lakht jis ne hurmala ke teer ko
dekh kar hairaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar asghar ka hasna ro rahe thay ashqiyan
dekh asghar ki shuja'at jhoomte thay ambiya
saare mil kar dekhte thay deen ki tanveer ko
kar diya do lakht jis ne hurmala ke teer ko
dekh kar hairaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa rahi khursheed hai ab bhi sada e karbala
na chupega us ka khoon hai jo bina e la ilaah
laakh dunya ye chupaye khoone be-taqseer ko
kar diya do lakht jis ne hurmala ke teer ko
dekh kar hairaan...
items.author: Haider Khursheed

items.title: Fakhre maryam
items.body:
zainab kuja bazaar kuja
<<DIVIDER>>
fakhre maryam be rida hai shaam ka bazaar hai
saj raha darbar hai shaam ka bazaar hai
bheedh hai bazariyon ki
saj raha darbar hai shaam ka bazaar hai
fakhre maryam be rida hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise guzregi ali ki betiyan bazaar se
sang baari ho rahi hai raasta dushwaar hai
bheed hai bazariyon ki saj raha darbar hai
fakhre maryam be rida hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas na chalta tha magar abid se wo kehti rahi
maarta hai kyun tamache mujhko ye badkaar hai
bheed hai bazariyon ki saj raha darbar hai
fakhre maryam be rida hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa siwa sajjad ke mere bacha koi nahi
yun na maaro zaalimon bemar hai lachaar hai
bheed hai bazariyon ki saj raha darbar hai
fakhre maryam be rida hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mas'ala ye hai ke tum ne usko pehchana nahi
jisko baaghi keh rahe ho khuld ka sardar hai
bheed hai bazariyon ki saj raha darbar hai
fakhre maryam be rida hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
roo baroo baba ke apne jo na boli thi ameer
teen din deti rahi bazaar may niruvaar hai
bheed hai bazariyon ki saj raha darbar hai
fakhre maryam be rida hai...
items.author: Ameer Hussain Mashadi

items.title: Ghurbate batool
items.body:
kahan batool ki ghurbat ko hum samajh paaye
hamari saans ruki aur na hum ghash khaaye
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi bhi khaak e baqayya sadayein deti hai
khuda kare ke ye pehlu se khoon ruk jaaye
kahan batool ki ghurbat...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo dar ke jis pe jhukate thay sar nabi apna
usi pe aaj musalman diye chale aaye
kahan batool ki ghurbat...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaeef hogayi darbar jab gayi bibi
siyah sar mein safedi utar gayi haye
kahan batool ki ghurbat...
<<DIVIDER>>
utha ke haath sitamgar ne kehkahan maara
hassan ke saamne zehra pe ye sitam dhaaye
kahan batool ki ghurbat...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir ek waqt wo aaya ke kund khanjar se
rag e hussain pe bibi ne haath katwaye
kahan batool ki ghurbat...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye gham batool ka sajjad se koi pooche
rida e zainabe muztar pe ashk barsaye
kahan batool ki ghurbat...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghame imame zamana ko koi kya jaane
ke jiski maa ki lehad roz dhoop jhul saaye
kahan batool ki ghurbat...
<<DIVIDER>>
bara e fatema zehra dua karo yasir
khuda kare ke zahoor e imam hojaye
kahan batool ki ghurbat...
items.author: Yasir Abbas

items.title: Ho kahan ay laal
items.body:
haye asghar ki sada aati hai ab bhi raat ko
goonjta hai naala e qalbe rababe karbala
jab jhapak jaati thi palke chaunk uth'ti thi rabab
jaise koi kaan mein kehta ho asghar aaye hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ho kahan ay laal asghar kis tarha dhoonde ye maa
ab na qasim hai akbar kis tarha dhoonde ye maa
<<DIVIDER>>
tu mere dil ka sukoon hai tu mere dil ka qaraar
yaad mein teri sakina kar rahi hai intezaar
ye batado ho kahan par kis tarha dhoonde ye maa
ho kahaan ay laal…
<<DIVIDER>>
hai andhera soona jangal darr na jaana mere laal
ye teri lambi judaai kar gayi mujhko nidhaal
mar na jaye teri madar kis tarha dhoonde ye maa
ho kahaan ay laal…
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm ki aandhi ne tujhko kar diya mujhse juda
kis sitam ke abr mein hai chup gaya chehra tera
thokare khaati hoon dar dar kis tarha dhoonde ye maa
ho kahaan ay laal…
<<DIVIDER>>
sughra ne ye khat mein likha kaisa hai asghar mera
ghutniyon chalta wo hoga jaan meri us par fida
kya kahegi us se maadar kis tarha dhoonde ye maa
ho kahaan ay laal…
<<DIVIDER>>
chin gayi chadar bhi meri jal gaya jhoola tera
poochti hoo har kisi se hai kahan asghar mera
mujhko ghere hai sitamgar kis tarha dhoonde ye maa
ho kahaan ay laal…
<<DIVIDER>>
gham mein tere ro rahe hai ye zameen-o-aasman
mohsin-o-ahmed bhi roye ro rahe hai do jahan
keh rahi thi gham se madar kis tarha dhoonde ye maa
ho kahaan ay laal…
items.author: Zulfiqar Ahmed

items.title: Hussain saari ye
items.body:
hussain saari ye kainaat tere dam se hai
ye dil abaad hashr tak bhi tere gham se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha tha kis ne ye maula teri sharafat pe
ke hum hussain se hai aur hussain hum se hai
hussain saari ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kata ke tu ne jo sar deen ko kiya zinda
har ek aankh ashk baar tere gham se hai
hussain saari ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ufaq pe aaj jo surkhi hai khoone na-haq ki
zameen udaas abhi tak bhi tere gham se hai
hussain saari ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
namaz e ishq ada ki jo tu ne teeron mein
namaz aaj bhi qaayam tere alam se hai
hussain saari ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere namoos jo darbar mein thay beparda
hairaan aalam e islam is sharam se hai
hussain saari ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
karenge seena zani jab talak hai ye dunya
hamara deen emaan aap ke hi gham se hai
hussain saari ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
diya tha parcham e islam par jo khoon tera
mashaf fizaon mein ab tak tere karam se hai
hussain saari ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaga bhi denge ye soye huwe naseebon ko
dar e batool pe sardar aankh nam se hai
hussain saari ye...
items.author: Sardar

items.title: Jo shaamile bazme
items.body:
jo shaamil e bazme ghame shabbir nahi hai
haasil usay emaan ki jageer nahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
qurbani e shabbir hata do to ye islam
wo khwab hai jis khwab ki tabeer nahi hai
jo shaamil e bazme…
<<DIVIDER>>
be hubbe ali sajde hai yun meri nazar mein
goya to hai quran ki tafseer nahi hai
jo shaamil e bazme…
<<DIVIDER>>
bemaar ke paon ki taraf dekhne walon
islam ka langar hai ye zanjeer nahi hai
jo shaamil e bazme…
<<DIVIDER>>
ay kufiyon be-parda hai ye hurmate islam
be-parda yahan zainab e dilgeer nahi hai
jo shaamil e bazme…
<<DIVIDER>>
bano ne ye ashoor ki shab khwab mein dekha
jhoole mein mera asghare baysheer nahi hai
jo shaamil e bazme…
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ki shahadat ne kiya zulm ko ruswa
ab tarkashe aada mein koi teer nahi hai
jo shaamil e bazme…
<<DIVIDER>>
jisme na rawani ho na ho shaukate alfaaz
mehshar wo tere khaak ki tehreer nahi hai
jo shaamil e bazme…
items.author: Mehshar Lakhnavi

items.title: Karbala Ka Marqa
items.body:
KARBALA KA MARKA YUU SAR KIYA SHABBIR as NE
DEEN KA KASA SARON SE BHAR DIYA SHABBIR NE
______________
SHAHED SE SHEERIn HAI ISKA ZAIQA MERE LIYE
KEH KE YUn JAAM E SHAHADAT PI LIYA SHABBIR NE
_____________
HASHR TAK USKI HIFAZAT KO HAWA MAMOOR HAI
KHOON SE DEEn KA JALAYA JO DIYA SHABBIR NE
_________________
PEHRE PAANI PAR LAGE THE YUn BUJHAI TASHNAGI.
BADH GAYI JAB PYAS ASHKOn KO PIYA SHABBIR NE
_______________
THI YAHI RAB KI RAZA MAOLA as NE UF TAK NA KIYA
SEH GAYA HAR ZULM HONTHO KO SIYA SHABBIR NE
_______________
ZARRE ZARRE KO PILA KAR APNI SHEH RAG KA LAHOO
KAR DIYA SERAAB DASHT E MARIYA SHABBIR NE
_________________
KAT GAI SAJDE ME GARDAN BAIYAT E FASIQ NA KI
ZINDAGI KO YUn USOOLOn PAR JIYA SHABBIR NE
_______________
JABR KA KAATA GALA *JAWAD* TEGH E SABR SE
JANG KO BAKHSHA NAYA YUN ZAAWIYA SHABBIR NE
______________

items.title: Kha Gaya Sani e Zahra Ko Alamdar
items.body:

items.title: Ali Asghare Besheer (as)
items.body:
Haye meray asghar (as) ×4
Bano ne kaha roke Ali Asghar e besheer
Sunti hun ke gardan pe laga qad se bada teer
1) Khun bah gaya maqtal men wo gham tum ne uthaya
che maah ke es sin mai bhi pani nahi'n paya
roye gi teri piyas ko ye madar e dilgeer
2) Sine se lagaya hai tujhe maut ne aa kar
ji bhar ke suna bhi na saki loriyan madar
din kaisa musibat mai dikha kar gai taqdeer
3) Aaja teri gardan ka zara zakhm to dekhun
Marham to mayasar nahi'n ansu hi laga lu
maloom hai lut jaye gi kuch deer mai jageer
4) Pani ke ewaz tum ko kiya jaye ga zakhmi
wapas nahi'n aao ge khabar maa ko nahi'n thi
ab khoon rulaye gi mujhe gham ki ye Tasveer
5) Ay khun kiye dil ai meri ankhon ki basiraat
maa bhool na paye gi teri phool se surat
wabsta thi tum se hi meri akhon ki Tasveer
6) Is dil pe jo guzri hai wo rudaad sunaye
maa fir se tumehe apne kaleje se lagaye
aye noore nazar tum hi banado koi tadbeer
7) Zakhmi tera nan naha sa gala deekka hai jab se
sar peet ti hai akhon se ansu nahi'n rukte
ro ro ke na mar jaye kahi'n karb se ham sheer
8) Hoti thi'n jise deekh ke yade'n teri taza
afsoos laino ne jala dala wo jhula
hasta raha ghurbat pe meri lashkar e be peer
9) Hai mir hilal aap ki dahleez ka naukar
lillah karam babe hawaej karo es par
ye sara jahan es ko kahe zakir e Shabbeer

items.title: Ghusl kaise mai doo
items.body:

neele rukhsar kyun hai ay bibi

hai rasan ke nishan gardan par

items.title: Hussain sab teri
items.body:

hussain sab teri…

ghame hussain mein aansu phir uske baad iram
khareed lo ke ye sauda bahot hi sasta hai
hussain sab teri…
<<DIVIDER>>
mubahile ki ye soorat bata rahi hai hamein
ke panjetan ke muqabil jo aaye jhoota hai
hussain sab teri…
<<DIVIDER>>
hussainiyat ko lahoo chahiye baqa ke liye
yazeediyat ne phir ek baar sar ubhara hai
hussain sab teri…

usay hussain se nisbat na do khuda ke liye
jo maslehat se ghame sheh mein kaam leta hai
hussain sab teri…
<<DIVIDER>>
hai kya jawaaz e sitam ay zameene karbobala
ke teen roz se mehmaan tera pyasa hai

elaahi khair kisi ki nazar na lag jaye
zaeef baap ka kadiyal jawan beta hai
hussain sab teri…

zameen e garm pe wo aediya ragad'ta hai
hussain sab teri…

khudara isko tamache na maar ay zaalim
ye bachi gham ki satayi hui sakina hai
hussain sab teri…

na loot chadare zainab na cheen sar se rida
ye binte zehra hai zaalim ye binte zehra hai
hussain sab teri…

items.title: Jo tha batool ka
items.body:
jo tha batool ka wo azadaar wo uth gaya

maa ki dua hai aale payambar ki khair ho

jo tha batool ka wo...

hyder ke khoon se hogaya tar khaana e khuda

mushkil kusha e ahmed e mukhtar uth gaya

rote hai gham may hyder e safdar ke khaas o aam

items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Maine Nana Tere Islam Ko Zinda Rakha
items.body:
Main Mohammed ka nawasa hu hussain ibne ali,
meri maa fatima zehra mera baba hai ali...
mere nana ne madine me ye mimber se kaha,
hussain mujhse hai main hu hussain se ye kaha...
wahi nana ki wasiyat nibhane aaya hu,
main karbala main shariyat bachane aaya hu...
khuda ke deen ke sardar hai mere nana,
kul ambiao'n ke sardar hain mere nana,
maine sarkar me payaam ko zinda rakha,
maine quraan ke maqaam ko zinda rakha,
sajda e shukr ada karke sare maqtal mein,
maine nana tere islam ko zinda rakha...
Wada tifli mein kiya tha jo nibhaya maine,
aabru deene payamabar ki bachaya maine,
zakhm par zakhm kaleje pe hai khaaya maine,
lab pe nana koi shikwa nahi laaya maine,
deene islam ke maqsad ko bachane ke liye,
karbala mein tere paigham ko zinda rakha...
apne ansaar ki laasho ko uthaya maine,
gulshane fatima zehra bhi lutaya maine,
bhanje bete bhatijo ko gawaya maine,
hadd hai chhe maah ka asghar bhi lutaya maine,
maine awaaze ilahi ko bachane ke liye,
karbala mein tere paigham ko zinda rakha...
zohar e qain, ibne mazahir se sahare chhute,
qasim o aun o mohammed se dulhare chhute,
mere akbar mere abbas se pyaare chhute,
dekhte dekhte sab hum se humare chhute,
Zulm ke chehre se parde ko uthhane ke liye
karbala mein tere paigham ko zinda rakha...
tanha ashaab ke lasho ko uthaya maine,
tukde qasim hue ye ranj bhi paaya maine,
aankh se ashq nhi khoon bahaya maine,
dil ki har baat ko bas dil mein chhupaya maine,
parchame deene payamabar ko uthhane ke liye
karbala mein tere paigham ko zinda rakha...
Jod kar haath wo mehmaan hamara palta,
lashkar e kufr se hurr jaisa wo pyaara palta.
Chhod zulmat ka andhera wo ujala palta,
Jang ladne ke liye haqq ka jiyala palta,
Zulm ko zulm ki auqat batane ke liye
karbala mein tere paigham ko zinda rakha...
karbala walo ka gham jab bhi manayega ayaz,
Tujh pe allah bhi rehmat ko lutayega ayaz,
tu salamat rahe noha jo sunayega ayaz,
mere nouhe pe na kyu'n ashq bahayega ayaz,
Doobti kashtiye islam bachane ke liye
karbala mein tere paigham ko zinda rakha…

items.title: Aa palat aa ay
items.body:
ghaib se aayi sada aa palat aa ay hussain
tujhse raazi hai khuda aa palat aa ay hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
asre ashoor ka hangaam qayamat ka samaan
dhoop mein jalti hui rayt se uth'ta hai dhuaan
bhook aur pyasa ka maara hai har ek peer o jawan
shiddate pyaas se hai tadkhi hui teri zuban
khushk hai tera gala aa palat aa ay hussain
ghaib se aayi sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
tera har ek amal nayk hai tabinda hai
maareka haq ke liye tera ye paainda hai
sabre ayyub tere sabr se sharminda hai
qatl jo haq ke liye hogaya wo zinda hai
tere haq mein hai baqa aa palat aa ay hussain
ghaib se aayi sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu ne islam ko akbar ki jawani dedi
thi jo nana ki nishani wo nishani dedi
nafs emaan ko ashkon ko rawani dedi
khatm jo ho na sakegi wo kahani dedi
naam ooncha hai tera aa palat aa ay hussain
ghaib se aayi sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
subh se tu ne kayi laashe uthaye hai hussain
zakhm par zakhm har ek gaam pa khaye hai hussain
dushmane deen bohat tujhko sataye hai hussain
khanjar o taygh o sina tujh pa chalaye hai hussain
tu ne har zulm saha aa palat aa ay hussain
ghaib se aayi sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe qasim ke rakhe tukde abaa mein tu ne
wakf ki apni zuban hamd o sana mein tu ne
dar kiya apna fida raahe khuda mein tu ne
zulm kya kya na sahe karbobala mein tu ne
kar diya waada wafa aa palat aa ay hussain
ghaib se aayi sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
hogaya qatl har ek nasir o yawar tera
tera qasim hai na ab hai ali akbar tera
aun hai aur na mohamed hai na asghar tera
sogaya nehr pa abbas e dilawar tera
tu akela hai khada aa palat aa ay hussain
ghaib se aayi sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa mere paas mohamed ke nawase aaja
ay mere teen shab o roz ke pyase aaja
jaanibe arshe bari karbobala se aaja
ab to milne ke liye apne khuda se aaja
mera sab kuch hai tera aa palat aa ay hussain
ghaib se aayi sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
tera nauha tere akhtar ne likha hai shabbir
tere irfan ne nauha ye padha hai shabbir
majlis e gham mein ajab hashr bapa hai shabbir
ye bhi ek tera karam teri ata hai shabbir
de ke ummat ko dua aa palat aa ay hussain
ghaib se aayi sada...

na asghar may dam hai na raazi hai maula
ye kya dekhte hai nigahein jhukaye
ajal se bachane ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
ajal poochti hai shah e deen se ran may
kise laa rahe hai aba may chupaye
ajal se bachane ko...

items.title: Ali bahot roye
items.body:
bada azeem tha sadma ali bohat roye
bana ke turbat e zehra ali bohat roye
<<DIVIDER>>
na roye haath ke chaalo ko dekh kar maula
na roye ghar may raha teen roz tak faaqa
shikasta pehlu jo dekha ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
galay may baandhi gayi rassiyan to sabr kiya
dar e batool se ut'tha dhuwan to sabr kiya
bana ke turbat e zehra ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
shikasta pehlu jo dekha to sabr hona saka
kuch aisa zaqkhm tha gehra to sabr hona saka
utha ke zakhmi janaza ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi to qabr e rasool e zaman bhi thi taaza
ali ke zaqmon ka kis tarha hoga andaaza
jo ghar may reh gaye tanha ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
pukara maa ko tadap kar hussain ne jis dam
rakha tha maa ne bhi us waqt maamta ka bharam
kafan ka bandh jo toota ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
shareeke gham ki lehad par bahaye thay aansu
ba waqte gusl bhi aankhon may aaye thay aansu
pakad ke apna kaleja ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek musibat o ranj o alam may saath diya
nabi ke baad har ek ranj o gham may saath diya
na jaane soch ke kya kya ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
diya tha hausla kulsoom aur zainab ko
tasalli de ke wahan chup kara diya sab ko
hassan hussain ko dekha ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
sulaa ke zer e zameen binte musatafa ko ali
kiye wo bain ke saari zameen larazne lagi
hisaar e sabr jo toota ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
zafar wo subbat alayya masayibun kehna
ye shadman ke lab par batool ka nauha
jo yaad aaya ye nauha ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...

items.title: Ay bhai hussaina
items.body:
shabbir se milne ke liye aayi hai zainab
ay bhai hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
abid ko ziyarat ke liye laayi hai zainab
ay bhai hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
saumpi thi amanat jo mujhe aap ne bhaiya
wo pyari sakina
afsos usay shaam may chod aayi hai zainab
ay bhai hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhaiya mere akbar ki qasam sabr kiya hai
shikwa nahi lab par
raahon may har ek gaam pe dukh paayi hai zainab
ay bhai hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se mai tumhe chod ke maqtal se gayi hoo
kya guzri hai tum par
kuch to kaho sadqe gayi maajayi ay zainab
ay bhai hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar nange thi aur haath bhi gardan se bandhe thay
jis basti se guzri
paigham tera sab ko suna aayi hai zainab
ay bhai hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
marqad pa teri dekh ye behosh pade hai
kis kis ko bataun
jis jis ko aseeri se chuda laayi hai zainab
ay bhai hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
sughra jo ye poochegi kahan hai mera asghar
mai us se kahun kya
kehdungi tere paas sula aayi hai zainab
ay bhai hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
tauqeer laraz jaata hai shabbir ka rauza
ye aaj bhi sun kar
shabbir se milne ke liye aayi hai zainab
ay bhai hussaina...

items.title: Baba tere baghair
items.body:
baba tere baghair bhala kaise jiyungi
tanha rahungi qaid may zindan may marungi
<<DIVIDER>>
roti hui behna ko chacha chod na jaana
ye aakhri rishta bhi kahin tod na jaana
pani ke liye aap se ab mai na kahungi
baba tere baghair...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ko dekti thi to aate thay nazar teer
ek pal may sakina se juda hogaye shabbir
seene se laga lo mujhe ab kis se kahungi
baba tere baghair...
<<DIVIDER>>
guzregi kis tarha se meri shaam e ghariban
asghar ko sada dungi mai laashon ke darmiyan
haathon may hoga magar mai na piyungi
baba tere baghair...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai aal e mohamed ka hoo anmol nagina
rakha hai aap hi ne mera naam sakina
ab qaidi sagheeron ki mai salaar banungi
baba tere baghair...
<<DIVIDER>>
tasveer payambar ki dikha kyun nahi dete
baba mujhe asghar se mila kyun nahi dete
ye sadma judaai ka bhala kaise sahungi
baba tere baghair...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ka rasta rok ke raahon may khadi hai
masoom sakina pe qayamat ki ghadi hai
ro ro ke ye kehti hai ke jaane nahi dungi
baba tere baghair...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai bheed qayamat ki patharon ki hai barsaat
mai haath uthaun to mitt jaye kayenaat
ye bad'dua jahan ke liye mai na karungi
baba tere baghair...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime bhi jala daale jala daale hai quran
phir bhi ye apne aap ko kehte hai musalman
hai baat bade dukh ki ye nana se kahungi
baba tere baghair...

items.title: Bazaro may darbaro
items.body:
in jhakde huwe haathon ki qasam
ghazi ki behan ka waada hai
matam hoga matam hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
ye zainab ne elaan kiya
bazaron may darbaron may
ghazi ka mere matam hoga
bazaron may darbaron may
<<DIVIDER>>
na taqt raha na taaj raha
na zulm raha na raaj raha
ek shor hai matamdari ka
bazaron may darbaron may
ye zainab ne elaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
na qaatil na baatil hai
ay dunya aa ke dekh zara
shabbir ke matam ki hai sada
bazaron may darbaron may
ye zainab ne elaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum thok ke seena kehte hai
hum rukne nahi denge matam
har haal may ye matam hoga
bazaron may darbaron may
ye zainab ne elaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye seene nahi deewarein hai
ye haath nahi talwarein hai
lo aa gaya lashkar zainab ka
bazaron may darbaron may
ye zainab ne elaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
o shaamiyon himmat hai roko
mazloom behan ko bhai ka
hum dene aaye hai pursa
bazaron may darbaron may
ye zainab ne elaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
de hukm agar tu shehzadi
ye behte huwe ashkon ki qasam
hum khoon ka bichade farshe aza
bazaron may darbaron may
ye zainab ne elaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
is shaam ke is bazaar se hi
ye keh kar guzri thi zainab
ghazi ka alam lehrayega
bazaron may darbaron may
ye zainab ne elaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
paband e rasan majboor hoo mai
ay shiyon khule ho haath to phir
shabbir ka tum matam kar lo
bazaron may darbaron may
ye zainab ne elaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ki tamanna hai gohar
ho aisa qayamat ka matam
khud dekhne aaye karbobala
bazaron may darbaron may
ye zainab ne elaan...

items.title: Bulao apne ammu
items.body:
maar kar rukh par tamache bola shimr e behaya
ay sakina ab bulao apne ammu jaan ko
<<DIVIDER>>
chaahte hai wo tumhe kitna mai dekhun to zara
ay sakina ab bulao apne ammu jaan ko
<<DIVIDER>>
baal bacchi ke pakad kar khaynch kar dono gohar
bad nasab kehne laga rukh par tamache maar kar
kyun nahi kuch bolti sar kyun tumhara hai jhuka
ay sakina ab bulao...
<<DIVIDER>>
dono haathon se tamache maarta tha be-rehm
kar raha tha be jhijhak bekas yateem par sitam
har tamache par ye kehta tha chacha ko do sada
ay sakina ab bulao...
<<DIVIDER>>
naaz tha tumko bahot jis par usay awaaz do
jao darya ki taraf jaa kar usay awaaz do
apne dil ka dard batlao usay jaa kar zara
ay sakina ab bulao...
<<DIVIDER>>
maarta hoon mai tumhe koi bachata kyun nahi
jaan jo tum par lutaata tha wo aata kyun nahi
ho gaya kya ab tumhara chaahne waala khafa
ay sakina ab bulao...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai tumhe maarunga durre aur tamache tab talak
tum tadap kar padh nahi dogi ye nauha jab talak
mai bahot mushkil mein hoon imdaad ko aao chacha
ay sakina ab bulao...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha qayamat khaiz dard angez wo manzar ajeeb
laaya bacchi ko layeen abbas ke sar ke khareeb
kaske phir rassi galay ki be-rehm kehne laga
ay sakina ab bulao...
<<DIVIDER>>
us ghadi sar peet kar roye bahot ahle haram
jab kaha zaalim ne dikhla kar ke ghazi ka alam
ye alam to hai kahan hai ab alamdar e wafa
ay sakina ab bulao...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro rahi thi dukhtare shabbir waiz zaar zaar
ay ali thay dard se ahle haram sab beqarar
karbala se shaam tak shimr e layeen kehta gaya
ay sakina ab bulao...

items.title: Dekh shireen
items.body:
ran mein laashe hai pade naizon pe sar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa tere ghar aaye hai
<<DIVIDER>>
baal chehre pe hai jiske teri shehzadi hai
jiske shaano pe nishan rassi ka faryadi hai
kitne nashtar dile zainab mein utar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
jin ka pehra kabhi abbas diya karte thay
naukri jinki malayek aake kiya karte thay
tere ghar aaj wohi khaak basar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaunsa hashr ka manzar na nighaon mein phira
sar bhi naize se sar e raah kayi baar gira
dekh kis haal mein hashim ke qamar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
haath seene pe dhare baithi hai umme laila
dard jo dil mein hai tab hogaya wo aur zyada
jab bhi qaatil ali akbar ke naar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu ne daalaan mein daala hai ye kiska jhoola
teer se chidh gaya maqtal mein gala asghar ka
cheh mahine ke hai naize pe magar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo sakina hai jo sehmi hui baithi hai wahan
jaa ke nazdeek zara dekh tamachon ke nashan
sar pe chadar hai na kaano ke gohar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
umme farwa ko bhi pursa do zara qasim ka
gham na bhoolegi kabhi karbobala qasim ka
laash bhi tukdon mein taqseem jo kar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh zanjeeron mein jakda hai tera shehzada
phupiyan beparda hai uth'ta nahi sar abid ka
le ke kunbe ke ujadne ki khabar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ne aamir tujhe ye deeda e nam baksha hai
dar pe ghazi ne bula kar ye qalam baksha hai
tab tere misron mein nayyar ye asar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Farmate thay
items.body:
farmate thay ye sayyede abraar
abbas alamdar
ay lashkare islam ke salaar
abbas alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
hai kaun tere baad nigehban haram ka
batlao to waris hai bhala kaun alam ka
uthega kahan daag o bala ranjo alam ka
hai kaun yahan mera madadgaar
abbas alamdar...
farmate thay ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ruqsat jo hue hazrate shabbir haram se
gehre hai haram lipte hue shaahe umam se
ek bachi bhi lipti hui thi sheh ke khadam se
thay ghash mein udhar abid e bemaar
abbas alamdar...
farmate thay ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmo se badan choor hai aur haal hai muztar
kis tarha tanha mujhse uthe laasha e akbar
aao meri imdad ko ay mere biradar
tum ho pisare hyder e karraar
abbas alamdar...
farmate thay ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
le jayega kumbe ko mere shaam ka lashkar
sar nange haram jayenge darbar mein kyon kar
ek ek se faryad karegi meri khaahar
bemaar mera khaafila salaar
abbas alamdar...
farmate thay ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehj ayegi beyar o madadgaar sakina
kis tarha sahegi bhala aazaar sakina
ab hogi na pani ki talabgaar sakina
darya se ab aa jao wafadar
abbas alamdar...
farmate thay ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ahle aza karte hai shabbir ka matam
is gham se nahi badke hume aur koi gham
bas saaya figan sar pa rahe aap ka parcham
kehlaate hai hum aap ke ghamkhaar
abbas alamdar...
farmate thay ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
pur dil se mere door nahi aap ka rauza
rehta hai mere seene mein ek dard ka darya
daala hai isi mauj mein nowhe ka areeza
mehshar bhi hai ek adna azadaar
abbas alamdar...
farmate thay ye...
items.author: Mehshar Lakhnavi

items.title: Giri hai khaak pe
items.body:
giri hai khaak pe zainab sambhaal ay fizza
ali ki beti ka sadqa nikaal ay fizza
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha ye fizza se shabbir ne dam e ruqsat
meri sakina ka rakhna khayaal ay fizza
giri hai khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
rida na denge layeen maang mat rida inse
bas ab to khaak hi baalon pe daal ay fizza
giri hai khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi to shaam ke raste hai sabr kar ke guzar
abhi to hone hai mushkil sawaal ay fizza
giri hai khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek sawaal ke badle ye sang maarenge
na kar tu reham ka inse sawaal ay fizza
giri hai khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
bacha layeeno ki nazron se binte zehra ko
banale khud ko tu zainab ki dhaal ay fizza
giri hai khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
karega kis tarha ye guftugu sharabi se
batool zaadi ki mushkil ye taal ay fizza
giri hai khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
bula habash ke ghulamon ko tu madad ke liye
hai qaid aaj payambar ki aal ay fizza
giri hai khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
khabar hai abid e muztar ko ya hai tujhko khabar
jo hai butool ki beti ka haal ay fizza
giri hai khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
na kyun jhukaye tere dar pe sar ko noor ali
ke tujhko maa kahe zehra ke laal ay fizza
giri hai khaak pe...

items.title: Aaye ho qabr pe mere to zara baitho to
items.body:
Aye ho kabr pe meri to zara baitho to (2)
Mere baba k azadaro mera hal suno,
kon hu kiski yatima hu mai ye jante ho
Tum to apno mai ho rutba, mera pehchan te ho…
Aye ho kabr pe meri to zara baitho to, Mere baba k azadaro mera hal suno (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Aaj roza hai jahan kal tha wahi ek zindan,
asia zindan k lazar jati thi ruhe insaan,
Tum jo ate ho to palbhar ko ye ghar lagta hai,
warna zindan se mujhe aaj bhi dar lagta hai…
Aye ho kabr pe meri to zara baitho to, Mere baba k azadaro mera hal suno (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Pao zakhmi hai mere aaj bhi zakhmi sar hai,
chur zakhmo se hu kurta bhi lahoo mai tar hai,
Daro diwaar pe manzar wahi lehraega,
gor se dekho mera khoon nazar aaega…
Aye ho kabr pe meri to zara baitho to, Mere baba k azadaro mera hal suno (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Mai tadap ti hi rahi mujhko mera ghar na mila,
margayi or mujhe sina e sarwar na mila,
tum samajhte ho bohot chain se soti hu mai,
apne baba k liye aaj bhi roti hu mai…
Aye ho kabr pe meri to zara baitho to, Mere baba k azadaro mera hal suno (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Are baad mudaat k mila hukme rehaii lekin,
sab watan aa-hi gaye mai nahi aai lekin,
dil pe ek daag judaai ka uthana hi pada,
chhod kar haye meri maa ko bhi jana hi pada…
Aye ho kabr pe meri to zara baitho to, Mere baba k azadaro mera hal suno (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Khoon ho jata hai sadme se kaleja mera,
yaad ata hai mujhe aaj bhi kunba mera,
tumhi insaaf karo kya ye sitaam kehte hai,
kya meri umr k bacche bhi alag rehta hai…
Aye ho kabr pe meri to zara baitho to, Mere baba k azadaro mera hal suno (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Khaab dekha tha bohot roi thi ghabrai thi,
yaad to hoga mujhe kaisa kaza ayi thi,
hil nahi sakta tha jo kaisa chala aya tha,
kis tarah mujh ko mere bhai ne dafnaya tha…
Aye ho kabr pe meri to zara baitho to, Mere baba k azadaro mera hal suno (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Dukh uthti hai mere dil mai jab ata hai khayal,
aaj rote ho mere gam mai basad ranjo malal,
kal jo tum hote to ye haal na hone dete,
lashe baba ki bhi pamal na hone dete…
Aye ho kabr pe meri to zara baitho to,
Mere baba k azadaro mera hal suno (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Aye ho meri ziyarat ko sada saad raho,
Ae fasil ayi sada kabr se abad raho,
dastan maine masayab ki suna di meri,
aab chale jao k ane ko hai dadi meri…
Ab bhi zindan se sakina ye sada deti hai,
Meri turbat meri gurbat ka pata deti hai.

items.title: Majlis o matam sikhaya shukriya zainab ka hai
items.body:
Zikr e gham ki ibtedaa hi, tazkera Zainab ka hai
Majlis o Maatam sikhaya, shukriya Zainab ka hai
Saat sau kursi nashi’n hai, takht par Ibn e Sitam
Is bhare darbar mein bhi, dabdaba Zainab ka hai
Baarhaa sar Gaazi ka aata hai jaanib farsh ki
Kaise sar naize pe rehta, sar khula Zainab ka hai
Quwwat e baazu e Shabbir, hai Sakina ka chacha
Ye Ali ka mojiza hai, hausla Zainab ka hai
Karbala, bazaar e Kufa, Shaam ka darbar, qaid
Sakhtiyaa’n itni, kaleja phool sa Zainab ka hai
Ek zaeefa mein numaaya hai bahattar ka wajood
Baad e Asr e Gham Haram ko, aasra Zainab ka hai
Har Imam e Waqt ne taa’zim ki jis Bibi ki
Ye Khuda hi jaanta kya martaba Zainab ka hai
Nauha kya ek sher bhi tu likh nahi’n sakta ‘Salim’
Kya teri auqaat ye to, mojiza Zainab ka hai

items.title: Ajeeb hai dastane
items.body:
ajeeb hai daastane gham ajeeb hai
nabi ki itrat pe ye sitam ajeeb hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bhoolne waali baat nahi thi
ghar ghar iska charcha tha
ye to kal ki baat thi khud apni
aankhon se dekha tha
maulai ka kaad nabi ne
qum mein isko ata kiya
ajeeb hai daastane…
<<DIVIDER>>
ek hi noor ke do tukde hai
ek mohamed ek ali
dono hai mehboobe elaahi
dono ko meraj hui
ek ko haq ne kar diya zaahir
ek parde mein chupa diya
ajeeb hai daastane…
<<DIVIDER>>
zindabad ay jazba e matam
mehnat ab rang laayi hai
chauda sau saala nafrat
ab khul kar saamne aayi hai
aaj yazeediyat ne parda
rukh se apne hata diya
ajeeb hai daastane…
<<DIVIDER>>
tehr nahi sakte thay baghair
izn farishte jis dar par
naqshe nishane paaye mohamed
saqt thay jis ki chaukat par
waaye musalmano ho tum par
tumne wo dar jala diya
ajeeb hai daastane…
<<DIVIDER>>
haaton mein hai shimr ke khanjar
zaanu ke neeche hai hussain
qaime ke dar par karti hai
zainab sar kholay hue bain
baba ab tum kab aaoge
bhai ka kat'ta hai gala
ajeeb hai daastane…
<<DIVIDER>>
sar ko tan se juda kiya
sar chada diya phir naize par
laashon par ghode daudaye
bujhi na dil ki aag magar
kalma-goyo ne khud apne
nabi ke ghar ko jala diya
ajeeb hai daastane…
<<DIVIDER>>
aise mein ek bachi nikli
qaimon se ghabrayi hui
khoon tapakta tha kano se
rukh pe yateemi chaayi hui
kaamp rahi thi khauf se wo
aur shimr tamache maarta tha
ajeeb hai daastane…
<<DIVIDER>>
daaman mein thi aag lagi aur
suye najaf tha rukh uska
roti thi chillati thi
geh deti thi baba ko sada
rooth gaye kyon aap sakina se
baba kya ki thi khata
ajeeb hai daastane…
<<DIVIDER>>
bain sakina ke sun sun kar
thar'rati thi laashe hussain
saahil par ek laasha
uth uth padta tha hokar bechain
aati thi reh reh ke sada jab
aajao aajao chacha
ajeeb hai daastane…
items.author: Sachey Bhai

items.title: Ali hai sajde mein
items.body:
ali hai sajde mein tar khoon mein peshani hai
zameen se taa ba falak chaayi pareshani hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ka qatl bhi saazish ka shaakhsana tha
chale hai silsile phir se wohi kahani hai
ali hai sajde mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhala koi apne bhi mohsin ko qatl karta hai
ye musalmano ki dar asl mein nadani hai
ali hai sajde mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
abu turab ko samjhe to mustafa samjhe
ali ki zaat ko ya zaate khuda jaani hai
ali hai sajde mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
kiya jo maula ne qaatil ko apne jaam ataa
ali kareem hai kis baat pe hairani hai
ali hai sajde mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali wali ke hashr tak rahenge charche ameer
baqa unhi ko hai bas ye jahan faani hai
ali hai sajde mein...

items.title: Aye mere masoom asghar
items.body:
Ey Mere Masoom Asghar
Ghar Chalo Asghar
Ey Mere Masoom Asghar Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Chand Nikla Aasma Par Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
1) Loot Gai Maa Karbala May Haye Beta Kya Karen
Jub Mera Asghar Nahi Phir Khali Jhula Kya Karen
Ab Na Lag Jae Nazar
Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Ey Mere Masoom Asghar Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Chand Nikla Aasma Par Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
2) Teer Khakar Muskurane Wale Maa Tere Nisar
Gulshan e Karbal Ne Leli Meri Godi Ki bahar
Kya Karen Ab teri Madar
Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Ey Mere Masoom Asghar Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Chand Nikla Aasma Par Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
3)  Kabr May Nanhe Mujahid Nind Kaise Aayegi
Jubbhi Yaad Aayegi Asghar Maa Teri Mar Jaegi
Zulm Hoga Humsafar
Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Ey Mere Masoom Asghar Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Chand Nikla Aasma Par Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
4) Karbala Ja Ab Toe Tera Dil Toe Thanda Hogaya
Teri Mitti May Ali Ka Lal Aakar Sogaya
Ey Mere Lakhte Jigar
Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Ey Mere Masoom Asghar Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Chand Nikla Aasma Par Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
5) Pani Piye Ko Gaye They Khoon Mae Tar Hogaye
Maa Idhar Roti Rahi Or tum Lehed May Sogaye
Kya Mila Dil Todkar
Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Ey Mere Masoom Asghar Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Chand Nikla Aasma Par Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
6) Kya Qayamat Aagai Ehle Haram Tadpa Kiye
Dudh Pine Wale Bacche Khoon May Khela Kiye
Phat Raha Hai Ab jigar
Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Ey Mere Masoom Asghar Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Chand Nikla Aasma Par Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
7) Dekh Ey Shamshir jinki Godiya barbad hai
Unke Sadqe May Toe Ye Her Goud May Aulad Hai
Hai Bada Ehsan Humpar
Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Ey Mere Masoom Asghar Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Chand Nikla Aasma Par Raat Aai Ghar Chalo

items.title: Baba teri ummat ne
items.body:
Haye baba.. haye baba.. haye baba
Haye baba..haye baba.. haye baba
Baba teri ummat ne zehra ko sataya hai..(2)
Har gaam rulaya hai dil mera dukhaya hai
Baba teri ummat ne zehra ko sataya hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Jis dar pe mere baba tum aate the us dar ko..(2)
ummat ke ameero'n ne toda hai, jalaya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ye kaise musalma'n hai kalma tera padhte hai..(2)
lekin teri beti ka haq chheen ke khaya hai
<<DIVIDER>>

zalim ne mujhe baba darbaar bulaya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Puchoge nahi mera kyu pehlu shikasta hai..(2)
ummat ne teri mujhpe darwaza giraya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Yasir kaha bibi ne ummat ne teri baba..(2)
tauheen meri ki hai dil mera dukhaya hai
Baba teri ummat ne zehra ko sataya hai..(2)

items.title: Dekha na sakina ne
items.body:
chehra na tera saamne gar paungi baba
tareeki e zindan may ghabraungi baba
darti hoo andhere may nazar kuch nahi aata
dewaaron se takrati hoo mar jaungi baba
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha na sakina ne zindan may savera hai
mai kya bataun baba yahan kitna andhera hai
<<DIVIDER>>
har roz maarte hai mujhko tamache zaalim
teri laadli ka baba zakhmi hua chehra hai
dekha na sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
pabandi hai rone pe mai bain karoo kaise
akbar ke qaatilon ne zindan ko ghera hai
dekha na sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
hota nahi guzar bhi zindan se hawa ka
gardan may tang rasan hai dam ghut raha mera hai
dekha na sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad ke seene pe mai kis tarha so jaaun
bhai ka paak seena zanjeeron ne ghera hai
dekha na sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ka khoon bhara wo kurta nahi mai bhooli
aur yaad mujhko baba qasim ka wo sehra hai
dekha na sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere galay ko zakhmi khanjar ne kiya baba
rassiyon se gala zakhmi ab hogaya mera hai
dekha na sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyasa zibha kiya hai in zaalimon ne tujhko
mai bhi rahungi pyasi ab waada ye mera hai
dekha na sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
salman poochti thi baba se ye sakina
mujhse bhi zyada zakhmi kyun aap ka chehra hai
dekha na sakina ne...
items.author: Salman Awais Khan

items.title: Godhiyon may sone
items.body:
godhiyon mein sone waali
so gayi zindan mein
<<DIVIDER>>
bole abid kya bataun
dard ke toofan mein
<<DIVIDER>>
kis khadar armaan tha
ho kar reha jaaungi ghar
kis khadar khush hogi sughra
mujhko zinda dekh kar
kya khabar thi jayengi ghar
baaliyan saaman mein
godhiyon mein sone waali...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ka sar tab mila
jab tan se kuch rishta na tha
godh mein sar le ke boli
haye baba mai fida
kaise rakhun sar tumhare
is jale damaan mein
godhiyon mein sone waali...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala se bad ke baba
zulm e qaid e shaam hai
raat din mujhko rulaana
zaalimon ka kaam hai
kab ta'aluq toot jaaye
jism mein aur jaan mein
godhiyon mein sone waali...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid e tanhaai hai baba
goke kunba saath hai
mai jahan qaidi hoo baba
din chadhe bhi raat hai
reh rahi hoo baad e ammu
waadi e sunsaan mein
godhiyon mein sone waali...
<<DIVIDER>>
chand lamhon ki hoo mehman
saath le jaana mujhe
phir na jaane aap ko
kis waqt kab fursat milay
dard hai baba kayi din
se hamare kaan mein
godhiyon mein sone waali...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek bhai saath hai
wo bhi bada majboor hai
neend jaise door mujhse
wo bhhi mujhse door hai
ab watan jaana nahi
shayad mere imkaan mein
godhiyon mein sone waali...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis kaleje se padhun
nauha bhala mai shadman
aa gayi hai ek ek
misre pe meri lab pe jaan
soz kis ne bhar diya hai
qaama e rehaan mein
godhiyon mein sone waali...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Hassan hussain pukare
items.body:
qabr e rasool par yehi hasnain ke thay bain
nana tumhare baad na amma ne paaya chain
<<DIVIDER>>
hassan hussain pukare ab aao ay nana
hamari amma hai zakhmi bachao ay nana
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare jaane se maa ko bohat aziyat hai
pahaad waqt hai har lamha ek musibat hai
lehad se uth ke galay se lagao ay nana
hassan hussain pukare...
<<DIVIDER>>
shikasta hogaya pehlu hamari amma ka
hamara bhai wo mohsin shaheed e zulm hua
hamay na maarde humko bachao ay nana
hassan hussain pukare...
<<DIVIDER>>
uthaya jalta hua dar jo bibi fizza ne
to dekha maykhein gadi hai badan pe amma ke
ye kis khata ki saza hai batao ay nana
hassan hussain pukare...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo janasheen tumhara hamara wo baba
gala khuda ke wali ka rasan se baandha gaya
gala chuda ke galay se lagao ay nana
hassan hussain pukare...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi nabi ke bhi bachon pe kya ye zulm hua
jala ho dar kahin durra kahin tamacha laga
hum ahlebait e nabi hai batao ay nana
hassan hussain pukare...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda hi jaane ke kab tak sitam uthana hai
hamay to sar ko katana hai ghar lutana hai
jahan ho tum wahin hum ko bulalo ay nana
hassan hussain pukare...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay nana qabr se dekha to hoga wo manzar
gira tha jalta hua dar jo amma ke upar
har ek zakhm pe marham lagao ay nana
hassan hussain pukare...
<<DIVIDER>>
hassan hussain ay majid jo roye zaar o qataar
laraz rahi thi wahan qabre ahmed e mukhtar
bilak ke kehte thay bache bachao ay nana
hassan hussain pukare...
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Hoagaya qatl shahe
items.body:
hogaya qatl shahe karbobala wavaila
rote hai peet ke sar ahle aza wavaila
<<DIVIDER>>
teer se hogaya zakhmi ali akbar ka jigar
umme laila ne kaha laash pe ay noore nazar
maa se kuch baat karo utke zara wavaila
hogaya qatl shahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye jalte huwe sehra may tadap bachon ki
hogaye nehr pe abbas ke baazu zakhmi
koi bachon ka muhafiz na raha wavaila
hogaya qatl shahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
laash dulhe ki kuch is tarha se pamaal hui
umme farwa ne jo dekha to na pehchan saki
haye qasim pe hui kaisi jafa wavaila
hogaya qatl shahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kat gaye pyaas may phir aun-o-mohamed ke gale
fidya e raahe khuda hogaye godi ke pale
hogaya qaimon may kohram bapa wavaila
hogaya qatl shahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema ne bade naazon se jise paala tha
jo payambar ke gharane hi ka ujiyala tha
asre ashoor kata uska gala wavaila
hogaya qatl shahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm dhaate rahe sajjad pe har waqt layeen
berida dekh ke zainab ko tadapti thi zameen
aasman girya kuna gham se huwa wavaila
hogaya qatl shahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
jalgaye qaime to saydaniya aayi ban may
laashe jitne bhi thay be-gor o kafan thay ran may
chingayi bibiyon ke sar se rida wavaila
hogaya qatl shahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay bober rok qalam tukde jigar hota hai
sunke nauha tera har jinn o bashar rota hai
chagayi charon taraf gham ki fiza wavaila
hogaya qatl shahe...
items.author: Mir Bober Ali

items.title: Hussain shahe karbala
items.body:
hussain shaahe karbala
hussain deene mustufa
wo deene haq ka khaafila
chala jo suye karbala
yehi hai jaadae wafa
qadam qadam ye thi sada
hussain shaahe…
<<DIVIDER>>
pahunch ke dashte karbala
luta ke gulshane wafa
khiraj is tarha liya
shikaste zulm ne kaha
hussain shaahe…
<<DIVIDER>>
hai kaun kaaba e yaqeen
ay jaane khatme mursaleen
wohi hai bas panaah e deen
ye keh rahe hai ambiya
hussain shaahe…
<<DIVIDER>>
ye zikr hi namaz hai
khuda ko jispe naaz hai
wo sar hi sarfaraz hai
jabeen pa jiski hai likha
hussain shaahe…
<<DIVIDER>>
tamam shab tha imtehan
yaqeen-o-shaq ke darmiyan
hui jo suboh ki azaan
to hurr ke dil ne ye kaha
hussain shaahe…
<<DIVIDER>>
utha ke laasha e jawan
chale jo shaahe inso-jaan
na tha koi bhi paasban
magar ye haq ki thi sada
hussain shaahe…
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain deen panaah hai
bina-e la ilaah hai
kitaab e haq gawah hai
waraq waraq ye hai likha
hussain shaahe…
<<DIVIDER>>
hazaar koshihe hui
magar na ruk saka kahin
fareed zikre shaahe deen
rahega hashr tak sada
hussain shaahe…
items.author: Fareed Baig

items.title: Jab mai bhi karbala
items.body:
jab mai bhi karbala ki ziarat ko jaunga
pyason ke zayareen ko pani pilaunga
<<DIVIDER>>
poochunga dard kaisa hai pehlu ka shaah se
hargiz na apna haal mai unko sunaunga
jab mai bhi karbala ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
qabr e ghareeb e zehra pe ashoor waale din
sajjad ki taraf se kafan le ke jaunga
jab mai bhi karbala ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
bandhwa ke apne haathon ko hurr ki tarha se mai
sultan e karbala tere rauze pe aaunga
jab mai bhi karbala ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko yaqeen hai maa wahan hogi hussain ki
nazrein na qatl gaah ki jaanib uthaunga
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ko sunaunga akbar ka marsiya
abbas ko sakina ki sunaunga
jab mai bhi karbala ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis jaah giri thi naaqe se beti batool ki
wajib samajh ke khud wahan par giraunga
jab mai bhi karbala ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ragdi thi jis jagah ali akbar ne aediyan
dil keh raha hai mai to wahan mar hi jaunga
jab mai bhi karbala ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad zayareen ki khidmat karunga mai
is kaam bhi na aaya to kis kaam aaunga
jab mai bhi karbala ki...
items.author: Mir Sajjad Mir

items.title: Khaake shifa pe
items.body:
khaak e shifa pe farz jo sajda hai ay hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
dunya tere wajood ko maanegi ek din
kya teri manzilat hai ye jaanegi ek din
shayad ke teri qabr bhi kaaba hai ay hussain
khaak e shifa pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere lahoo ka ek ek khatra hai la jawab
milti nahi jahan mein teri koi bhi misaal
ye martaba ke maa teri zehra hai ay hussain
khaak e shifa pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
saahil pe sar patakta hai maujaon ka ikhtiyar
jaise ke roye asghar e baysheer ko rabab
pyasa lab e furaat pe kunba hai ay hussain
khaak e shifa pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
tune lahoo diya to bacha deen e mustafa
maqrooz tere hogaye ye saare ambiya
dunya mein har jagah tera charcha hai ay hussain
khaak e shifa pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar ko jhukaye chalta hai kaaton pe wo magar
gardan mein tauq paon mein bedi lahoo jigar
saabir teri tarha tera beta hai ay hussain
khaak e shifa pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab hai sar barehna agar tu hai be-kafan
taqdeerein uski ban gayi ye zulm ki rasan
zainab ke dil pe ek hi sadma hai ay hussain
khaak e shifa pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar nange dekh aayi hai bazaar e shaam tak
qaidi ki tarha pahunchi hai darbar e shaam tak
ye imtehan e zapt bhi kaisa hai ay hussain
khaak e shifa pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye mazhar abidi ka aqeeda bhi hai bata
jayega tere rauze pe humraah kamran
dil mein ye aarzoo tha padna hai ay hussain
khaak e shifa pe farz...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Aayi shame ghariban
items.body:
jab gardane shabbir pe phera gaya khanjar
pardes mein loota gaya zahra ka bhara ghar
qasim hai na akbar hai na abbas e dilawar
kunbe ki nigehban hai ab zainabe muztar
aayi shaam e ghariban zainab hui tanha
<<DIVIDER>>
laasha tadap raha tha kisi ka labe furaat
cheeni thi shimr ne sar e zainab se jab rida
aayi shaam e ghariban....
<<DIVIDER>>
bache ko apne dhoondti hai maa andhere mein
haathon pe hai liye huwe jhoola jala hua
aayi shaam e ghariban....
<<DIVIDER>>
dulhe ka laasha ghodon se pamaal hogaya
ye kaisa waqt hazrate kubra pe aa gaya
aayi shaam e ghariban....
<<DIVIDER>>
ammu bachaiye mujhe shimr e layeen se
ek bachi dasht mein yehi deti rahi sada
aayi shaam e ghariban....
<<DIVIDER>>
bikhraye apne baalon ko roti thi fatema
jis dum tha halq e shaah pe khanjar layeen ka
aayi shaam e ghariban....
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon ki raakh bikhri padi thi zameen par
baitha tha sar jhukaye aseeron ka khaafila
aayi shaam e ghariban....
<<DIVIDER>>
ahmed bayan karta hai karbal ke waqiyaat
mohsin jigar ko thaam ke padta hai marsiya
aayi shaam e ghariban....
items.author: Zulfiqar Ahmed

items.title: Abbas madad ko
items.body:
maqtal mein kaha sheh ne ro kar
abbas madad ko aajao
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha uthe laashe akbar
abbas madad ko aajao
<<DIVIDER>>
saahil se chale aao bhaiya
uthwao bhatije ka laasha
hai seena e akbar mein naiza
har samt andhera hai chaaya
be-noor hai aankhein tooti kamar
abbas madad ko aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene se ani jo hai khaynchi
mai kaise bataun kya guzri
hamshakle nabi reti pe gira
to rone lage khud pyare nabi
khud dekhlo maqtal mein aa kar
abbas madad ko aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
kayi baar gira is manzil mein
akbar tak pahuncha mushkil mein
jo seena e akbar mein hai laga
wo naiza hai mere dil mein
hai door hua mujhse dilbar
abbas madad ko aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab dekha akbar ka chehra
yaad aaye mujhe mere nana
kis tarha sambhalun mai dil ko
reti pe tadapta hai laasha
khoon mein hai shabihe paighambar
abbas madad ko aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
sughra se kiya tha jo waada
wo waada akbar toot gaya
ab sochta hoon kya bolunga
jab khat aayega sughra ka
tooti hai qayamat ab mujh par
abbas madad ko aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>

items.title: Anaa Zainab
items.body:
Anaa Zainab
Sarey darbaar jab Ahle Haram aaye rasan basta yazeed har ek qaidi se yahi has-has ke kehta tha
meri taakat ne dekho aaj, haqq bar-pa liya galbaa, Mohammad ka zamaaney se, nishaa(n) maine mitaa daala
Sunaa jab ye toh Ahmed ki Nawaasi ko jalaal aaya, khamosh-e-bhaksiyar lafze dile-Zehra ne lalkaara(a),
zabaa(n) ko de lagaam apni magar na hoga dubaara, rasan basta sahi magar Meri rago(n) mein khoo(n) hai Hydar ka,

Jo hai Islaam ke Baani unhe baaghi bataa-ta hai, sikhaaya jisne parda Usko be-parda phiraa-ta hai,
Mohammad ka Ali ka Fatemah ka dil dukhaa-ta hai x2, tere saarey ma-zaalim saamne duniya ke laa-oongi, Anaa Zainab, Main Zainab Hoon
Husayn ibne Ali faateh hai duniya ko bataa-oongi, yazidi kufr ke chere se Main parda hataa-oongi Ana Zainab, Main Zainab Hoon
Zameen tak hogi aur tu khaakh ke andar samaayega, mazii ek saan(s) lene ki tu mohlat naa paayega,
na lashkar aur na takh-to taaj phir tujhko bachaaega x2, agar Main bad-dua ko haath ye apne uthaa-oongi, Anaa Zainab, Main Zainab Hoon
Husayn ibne Ali faateh hai duniya ko bataa-oongi, yazidi kufr ke chere se Main parda hataa-oongi Ana Zainab, Main Zainab Hoon
Magar Humko rawaa(n) hai sabr toh Hum sabr karte hai, na hargiz ye samajh na Hum teri taakat se darte hai,
tere darbaar mein haqq ki sadaa bankar ubharte hai x2, sadaa-e-haqq mein tere zulm ke aiwaa(n) dhaa-ongi, Anaa Zainab, Main Zainab Hoon

Fanaa jaahil ko hai ba-taur aadil ko baqaa dena, zamaanay mein rahega tu na takh-to-taaj ye tera,

items.title: Aye Mere Nana Deene Khuda Ko Bacha Ke Aayi Hun
items.body:
Aye mere nana dine khuda ko bacha ke aayi hun
Bala ke ban me kamayi maa'n ki luta ke aayi hun
Nana kaho to haal sunaye tmko ye dukhiya
Dashte bala me lasha pada tha god ke paalon ka
Gham bhi manane diya gaya na maaon ko wa waila
Zulm ki had ye ho gayi nana rone pe tha pahra
Charo taraf the zulm ke bani koi na tha apna
Ghar ko luta or jangal ko basa ke aayi hun
Ibne hasan pamal hua tha zinda maqtal me
Or kaleja akbar ka tha barchhi ke phal me
Asghar ka khu'n ab bhi laga hai maa'n ke anchal me
Zulm hua hai nana ham par aisa jangal me
Suraj ne bhi ankh chhupa li apni badal me
Nana kitne sadme dil par utha ke aayi hun
In aankhon se kya kya manzar dekha zainab ne
Khun me duba bhai ka paikar dekha zainab ne
Khushk gale pr shimr ka khanjar dekha zainab ne
Bhai ko pamali ki zad par dekha zainab ne
Noke sina par bhai ka sar dekha zainab ne
Kaise manazir in aankhon me chhipa ke aayi hun
11 muharram ko aye nana aesi qayamat thi
Zulm ke bani charo taraf the or na tha koi
Bhai tha be goro kafan or ahle haram qaidi
Kaise bataun nana jo thi halat abid ki
Hanth me rasha aankh me aansu chehre par zardi
Maut ke panje se main usko chhurda ke aayi hun
Bhuli nahi mqin karbobala ke dardo alam ab bhi
Aankhon me mahfuz hai mere shaame gham ab bhi
Nana mere zakhmi hain abid ke qadam ab bhi
Tauq gira'n ke sabab se uski pusht hai kham ab bhi
Sath liye hun sare nishan e zulm o sitam abhi
Kya kahun nana kitne durre kha ke aayi hun
Qabre payambar kanp uthi zainab ki sadaon se
Aane lagi thi giriye ki awaz fizaon se
rauza nabi ka gunj utha fariyad se aanhon se
Ashk gire be sakhta har bibi ki nigahon se
Jab ye kaha zainab ne aye nana teri duaon se
Bhai ka chehlum karbobala me mana ke aayi hun
Ek bala ka hashr bapa tha rauze pr asghar
Koi sina pit raha tha koi apna sar
Rote the sab bain ali ki beti ke sun kar
Kaise bataun dagh liye hain kitne sine par
Zainab to aayi hai nana sath nahi sarwar
Sar jab sabke mile hain to dafna ke aayi hun

items.title: Dekhi Hai Zulmo Sitam Ki Aandhiyan Sajjad Ne
items.body:

Taaziyano ki Sahi hai SakhtiyaN sajjad ne..
Dasht me Dekha Kaleja, Aur Gala,Baju Juda..
Baba ki Tooti huwi bhi PasliyaN Sajjad ne..
Maut aayi aaj lekin mar to woh tab hi gaya..
Dast e Zainab me jo dekhi RassiyaN sajjad ne..
Hai Musalsal ye Sakina pe Tamacho ka asar...
Bachhi ki Bachpan me dekhi JurriaaN sajjad ne..
Rooh e Akbar keh Rahi thi Dekh kar Nauke SinaaN..
Mujhse bhi jyada hain Khaayi BarchhiyaN sajjad ne..
MezbaaN ghar me Hua jab Qaatile akbar jawaaN...
HaathoN se Usko Khilayi RotiyaN sajjad ne..
Kya Guzar jayegi Zainab par yahi to Soch kar..
Dard tha phir bhi na li hain SiskiyaN sajjad ne..
Shimr ne jab naam e zainab le liya darbaar me..
Sath aankhoN ke kari Bandh MuththiyaN sajjad ne...
Khakh par mujh ko sulado Ye kaha Waqt e kaza..
Haaye baba keh ke Ragdi EdiyaaN sajjad ne..
Der tak rote rahe "Asmee" Sakina ko WahaN
Paayi hai Asbab me jab BaaliyaN sajjad ne..

items.body:

Matla....

items.title: Abbas Mar Gaye
items.body:
Abbas mar gaye Ali akbar juda hua, Mujhse kisi ne ye bhi na pucha k kya hua,
*Dashte bala me shah ye padhte the
marsiya, Mujhse kisi ne ye bhi na
pucha k kya hua,
1. Qasim rahe na, auno mohammad guzar gaye, Asghar mri nigah k aage hi mar gaye, Ik dopaher me mera bhara ghar ujad gaya, Mujhse kisi ne ye bhi na pucha k kya hua,
2. kis bebasi se pahucha mai lashe pisar pe Haye, Dushman ko bhi khuda na kbhi aisa din dikhaye, Bete ko apne dasht me mai dhundta rha, Mujhse kisi ne ye bhi na pucha k kya hua,
3. duniya ne mujhse chheen liya mere sher ko, Pyasa hi qatl krdiya mere diler ko, Lasha bhi uska khaime me mai la nahi saka, Mujhse kisi ne ye bhi na pucha k kya hua
4. be rahem hogye hain musalman is qadar, Terah baras k bache ka sar tan se kaat kr, Lasha bhi uska ghodo se Pamal krdiya Mujhse kisi ne ye bhi na pucha k kya hua
5. Allah tujhko bakhshe kbhi na aye hurmala, wo teer teen bhaal ka besheer ka gala, hatho pe mere mar gaya lakhte jigar mera, Mujhse kisi ne ye bhi na pucha k kya hua
6. lasho pe lash lata rha hu mai bar bar, Ghurbat to meri dekh le aye rabbe kirdegar, Mai ro rha tha lasho pe hanste the ashqiya, Mujhse kisi ne ye bhi na pucha k kya hua
7. ya rab koi bhi mujhsa ghareebul watan na ho, Aise Kheza'n raseeda kisi ka chaman na ho, Dashte bala me chhut gaye sab mere aqraba Mujhse kisi ne ye bhi na pucha k kya hua,
8. bahti rahi furat nigaho k samne, Bache mre tadapte rhe Phir Bhi pyas se, Mujhpe paraye des me Kya kya sitam pada Mujhse kisi ne ye bhi na pucha k kya hua,
9. ghurbat me the jo sath wo sathi guzar gaye, Mai ji k kya kru mere Ansar mar gaye, Ik ek kr k hogye sab Yaar bhi juda, Mujhse kisi ne ye bhi na pucha k kya hua,
10. bache hain tadpe pyas se bahlau kis tarah, sharminda hu khayam me mai jau kis tarah, Kaisa ye imtehan h aye mere kibriya, Mujhse kisi ne ye bhi na pucha k kya hua,
11. suhail apne sir ko jhukaye hue Husain, Khaliq ki bargaah me krte rhe ye bain, karbal me aake lut gaya ghar baar sab mera, Mujhse kisi ne ye bhi na pucha k kya hua.

items.title: Ali haye Ali
items.body:
Aaj kufe me hai kohram ali haye ali.
Hai falak larza baranjam ,
ali hae ali, ali hae ali.
Aaj kufe me hai kohram ali hae ali.
Kon zakhmi hua sajde me zameen kanp uthi,
kiska ye khun baha, subha andhere me dhali,
kyun ajal lai hai paigam,
ali hae ali, ali hae ali.
Aaj kufe me hai kohram ali hae ali.
Fark e insaf pe ze zarb lagai kisne,
mazhar e adl ki tasweer mitai kisne,
sar pe ab zulm ki hai shaam,
ali hae ali, ali hae ali.
Aaj kufe me hai kohram ali hae ali.
Khul hua haye yateemo ka sahara na raha,
kon zainab ko batae tera baba na raha,
kaise paegi wo aaram,
ali hae ali, ali hae ali.
Aaj kufe me hai kohram ali hae ali.
Aaj fir gulshan e zehra me khiza aai hai,
ranjh o aalam ki har samt ghata chai hai,
tham gai gardish e aiyyam,
ali hae ali, ali hae ali.
Aaj kufe me hai kohram ali hae ali.
Ghash me hain zainab o kulsum khuda khair kare,
dil e abbas hai maghmoon khuda khair kare,
kamp uthe hain dar o bam ,
ali hae ali, ali hae ali.
Aaj kufe me hai kohram ali hae ali.
Kar qahe hain dar o deewar ali ka matam,
aasman jin o malak noha kuna hai paiham,
kaise dil ko mile aaram,
ali hae ali, ali hae ali.
Aaj kufe me hai kohram ali hae ali.
Aal e ahmed ke masaib ki nahi koi had,
samra ho k najaf ho ya madina mashad,
kufa o karbobala shaam,
ali hae ali, ali hae ali.
Aaj kufe me hai kohram ali hae ali.
Hai zafar waqt dua mang le ab ro ro kar,
jab likha jae ghulamaan e ali ka daftar,
usme shamil ho mera naam,
ali hae ali, ali hae ali.
Aaj kufe me hai kohram ali hae ali.

items.title: Aye shaheed e insani
items.body:
Aye Shaheed-e-Insaani
Aye Shareek-e-Qur'aani,
Aaj Tak Dilo'n Par
Hai Teri Hi Hukmeraani,
Zibh Kardiya Tujhko
Aur Nahi Diya Paani
Aye Shaheed-e-Insaani
Aye Shareek-e-Qur'aani
1) Jaan-e-Mustafa(s.a) Tum Ho
Jaan-e-Murtuza(a.s) Ho,
Jaan-e-Fatema(s.a) Tum Ho
Roohe Anbiya Tum Ho,
Tum Muammae Kul Ho
Juz-e-Shar-e-Qur'aani
Aye Shaheed-e-Insaani
Aye Shareek-e-Qur'aani
2) Marqade Nabi(s.a) Chhoota
Qabr-e-Fatema(s.a) Chhooti,
Roza-e-Hassan(a.s) Chhoota
Pyaari Dilruba Chhooti,
Iss Tarha Madeene Se Aale Mustafa(s.a) Chhooti,
Shehr Saara Sunsaa'n Thaa
Chha Gayi Thi Veerani
Aye Shaheed-e-Insaani
Aye Shareek-e-Qur'aani
3) Karbala Ki Manzil Bhi

Aye Shaheed-e-Insaani

Jaadae Haqeeqat Se

Kaise Kaise Jaano'n Ki
Pesh Kardi Qurbaani
Aye Shaheed-e-Insaani
Aye Shareek-e-Qur'aani
5) Bhai Ke Kate Shaane
Uff Nahi Kiya Toone,
Chhote Aqruba Saare
Uff Nahi Kiya Toone,
Haaye Jalgaye Qaeme
Uff Nahi Kiya Toone,
Lab Mile Toh Naeze Par
Bolte Toh Qur'aani
Aye Shaheed-e-Insaani
Aye Shareek-e-Qur'aani
6) Dhoop Wo Qayaamat Ki
Tera Aaqri Sajda,
Ishq-e-Haq Ki Manzil Thi
Tera Aaqri Sajda,
Fatema(s.a) Na Bhholegi
Tera Aaqri Sajda,
Pusht Par Sitamgar Tha
Khaak Par Thi Paeshaani
Aye Shaheed-e-Insaani
Aye Shareek-e-Qur'aani
7) Zulm-o-Joar Ki Quavvat
Toone Tod Kar Rakhdi,
Kufr Ki Kalaai Bhi
Toone Tod Kar Rakhdi,
Gardan-e-Yazeedi Bhi
Toone Tod Kar Rakhdi,
Thokro'n Mein Udta Hai
Uska Taaj-e-Shaetaani
Aye Shaheed-e-Insaani
Aye Shareek-e-Qur'aani
8) Ek Dopaher Mein Hi
Ghar Ujad Gaya Tera,
Hai Furaat Par Abtak
Bhayi Ka Tere Qabza,
Sar Ke Bal Ziyaarat Ho
Hai RAZA Ka Ye Mansha
Hind Mein Pareshaa'n Hai
Qaadim-e-Quraasani

Aye Shareek-e-Qur'aani

items.title: Hay Be Rida Zainab
items.body:
Hai be Rida zainab sa aor sham ka bazar
Ab waqte madad hai aa jao alamdar as
Koi nahi yawar na koi hai ghamkhwar
Ab waqte madad hai aa jao alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Kis Shan se tum laye the zainab sa ko watan se
Mehmil thi amari bhi thi pehre bhi Lage the
Har simt hain aghiyar Abid as bhi hai lachar
Ab waqte madad hai aa jao alamdar.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Bazar me ham jaenge kis tarha khule sar
Shole koi barsaega ham par koi patthar
Sadqe ki khajooren phekenge sitamgar
Ab waqte madad hai aa jao alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Raho me hai kante mere paon me hain chhale
Be dard tamashai hain sunte nahi naale
Aor tez chalo ab kehte hain sitamgaar
Ab waqte madad hai aa jao alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Awaz tumhe deti hai Masoom sakina sa
Is darja mazalim hain ke dushwar hai jeena
Shiddat se atash ki mar jaye na ghamkhwar
Ab waqte madad hai aa jao alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Hai takht pe baitha hua ma'loon sharabi
Aor qaid khadi farsh pe aolad nabi saww ki
Ghurbat pe hamari khush hote hain aghiyar
Ab waqte madad hai aa jao alamdar

items.title: Hogaye Qatl Haye Sher E Khuda
items.body:
Waa aliaa ki aa Rahi hai sadaa

Gham se kulsoom aah bharti hai

Kyon na royen mubashshir o Rizwan
Zabt karna nahi ye gham aasaan

nazar kaise lagegi ab badan saanso se khaali hai

nazar aa jayega tumko behen hai ab kahan beta

padhi nade ali le kar chale sheh laasha e akbar

items.title: Ali hujjatullahe ala ibadah
items.body:
Ali ali..
Ya ali...
ali haq ali haq
Maslak e ishq ye tehreer hua
ali hujjatullahe ala ibadah
Dekho tafseer sare karbobala
ali haq ali haq
ali hujjatullahe ala ibadah
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Shab he ashoor hui jab ye ayaa
har taraf ranjo alam ka tha samaa
gunji sehra me jo akbar ki azaa
ali haq ali haq
Har taraf chhane lagi meri sadaa
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ishq e haider se mila ishq e khuda
sab ali waley sare karbobala
ek ek karte hue sheh pe fida
ali haq ali haq
jo bhi ghode se gira usne kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Wo jo tauheed bachane aaye
aur shabbeer pe qurban hue
jaante the ye husaini saare
ali haq ali haqye hi naara hai baqaae kabaa
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ghum ke tufoon to chhate hi rahe
dil pe har zakhm ko khate hi rahe
laashein shabbir uthate hi rahe
ali haq ali haq
sheh ki dharas tha faqat ye jumla
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Marhala haaye wo aaya jis dum
waada sarwar ne nibhaya jis dum
deene haq yaani bachaaya jis dum
ali haq ali haq
keh ke sar rakkha mayane sajdah
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Bole shabbir suno fauje jafa
ab nahi koi mere rab ke siwa
aur risalat ke amee hai nana
ali haq ali haq
aur phir sheh ne bila fasl kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Bhai ki laash pe aai dukhiya
laashe shabbir pe zainab ne kaha
ab mai phailaungi paighaam tera
ali haq ali haq
kal sadaa hogi sare farshe azaa
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Laakh salmaan mukhalif thi hawa
humne har aan shabhi ghum ye saha
koshishe karte rahe ehle jafa
ali haq ali haq
kalmaye haq se na ho paya juda

items.title: Ay doston kami na
items.body:
ay doston kami na ho ab shor o shain mein
zainab bhi hai aza e shahe mashraqain mein
phat jaye dil wo dard hai dukhiya ke bain mein
lo fatema bhi aagayi bazme hussain mein
chehre pe khaak baal pareshan kiye huwe
godhi mein ek nanha sa laasha liye huwe
<<DIVIDER>>
goya ye keh rahi hai batool e falak maqam
ay bewatan ke taziyadaron mera salaam
matlab ye hai ke aaj majalis hui tamam
ruqsat talab hai ahle aza maadar e imam
dil par hujoom hai gham o ranj o malaal ka
pursa batool o paak ko do unke laal ka
<<DIVIDER>>
rolo ke ye tazkira e gham bhi khatm hai
fasle aza e sarwar e aalam bhi khatm hai
matam karo ke aaj ye matam bhi khatm hai
majlis bhi marsiya bhi moharram bhi khatm hai
hyder bhi sab ke saath hi aansu bahate hai
yaaro hussain taaziya khane se jaate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ay rone waalon aankhon se darya e khoon bahao
matam karo hussain ka sar par khaak udao
farshe aza lapet ke rakho alam badhao
das din ka mehman chala taaziya uthao
ashkon ki nazr de ke imame anaam ko
ruqsat karo hussain e alaihis salaam ko
<<DIVIDER>>
ro kar kaho ke ay shahe abraar alwida
ay kaarwan e dard ke salaar alwida
ay ummate rasool ke ghamkhwar alwida
kadiyal jawan pisar ke azadaar alwida
kya jaane agle saal jiye ya marenge hum
par qabr mein bhi taziyadari karenge hum
<<DIVIDER>>
ay be-dayar o be-sar o samaan alwida

hyder ki rooh fatema ki jaan alwida
ay mustafa ki godh ke quran alwida
ashre ke khatm hote hi hum se bichad gaye
maula tumhare taaziya khane ujad gaye

items.title: Hay qasim mere
items.body:
HAY QASIM MERE ×2
‘TERE TUKDON PE MAN ×2 KAISE ROYE TUJHE -
MERE NAOJAWAN HAI LASHA KHAN
YE TUKDE TER UTHATI HAI MAN...
HAY QASIM MERE ×2
TERE BABA NE MUJHSE WASIYAT YE KI
MERE BHAI PE JAB AYE MUSHKIL GHADI
‘MERI JANIB SE TUM ×2 WAR DENA ISE -
MERE NAOJAWAN HAI LASHA KHAN
YE TUKDE TER UTHATI HAI MAN...
HAY QASIM MERE ×2
DEKH KARTI HAI BALI SAKINA BUKA
AYE CHACHI MERE BHAI KO YE KYA HUWA
‘AYE MERE LAL MAI ×2 KAYA BATAUN USE –
MERE NAOJAWAN HAI LASHA KHAN
YE TUKDE TER UTHATI HAI MAN...
HAY QASIM MERE ×2
KHUN SE RANGGI HUWI TERE KARBOBALA
HAY MARA GAYA RAN ME TU BE KHATA
‘EK GATHDHI ME SHAH ×2 LE KE AYE TUJHE –
MERE NAOJAWAN HAI LASHA KHAN
YE TUKDE TER UTHATI HAI MAN...
HAY QASIM MERE ×2
KAMSINI KA TERE PAS KUCH NA RAKHA
JISM GHODO SE PAMAL TERA KIYA
‘JAA BAJAA THE TERE ×2 TUKDE BIKHRE HUWE-
MERE NAOJAWAN HAI LASHA KHAN
YE TUKDE TER UTHATI HAI MAN...
HAY QASIM MERE ×2
SHAH NE RO KAR KAHA AYE MERE GULBADAN
MUJHKO YAD AGAE MERE BHAI HASAN
‘UNKE TUKDE JIGAR ×2 TUKDE TAN KE TERE –
MERE NAOJAWAN HAI LASHA KHAN
YE TUKDE TER UTHATI HAI MAN...
HAY QASIM MERE ×2
PURSA KULSUM-O ZAINAB NE RO KAR DIYA
YOUSUF E KARBALA HAY MARA GAYA
‘SAR KO AHELE HARAM ×2 PEET KAR RO PADE –
MERE NAOJAWAN HAI LASHA KHAN
YE TUKDE TER UTHATI HAI MAN...
HAY QASIM MERE ×2
FAIZ-O MANZAR NE QASIM KA NAWHA PADHA
BIBI FARWA KO BETE KA PURSA DIYA
‘PHAT GAYA YE JIGAR ×2 ASK JARI HUWE –
MERE NAOJAWAN HAI LASHA KHAN
YE TUKDE TER UTHATI HAI MAN...

items.title: Hussain tu kamyaab hogaya
items.body:
ya hussain (x4)
hussain tu ne dee(n) bacha ke kamyaab hogaya
aye maqsad e yazid tu na kamyaab hai
mera hussain sir katake (zindabad hogaya x3)
*hussain tu kamyaab hogaya
yazid tu na kamyaab hai (x2)
(1) hussain tum ne nana ka wada nibhaliya
hussain tum ne sir katake dee(n) bachaliya
pani jo tumse chin liya sabr tho kiya
hussain tu kamyaab kamyaab hogaya
hussain tu kamyaab hogaya
yazid tu na kamyaab hai (x2)
(2) yazid jhoota khaath bhija ke dhooka de diya
noor e khuda pe tune jo khanjar chala diya
ghareeb ka jo khoo(n) baha kar qatl kar diya
yazid tu tho ab bhi na muraad hogaya
hussain tu kamyaab hogaya
yazid tu na kamyaab hai (x2)
(3) (yeh farsh e aza x3) tera liye bichti hai shabbir
tum deen e islam ki tasweer hu shabbir
tera naam se milti hai shifa  aye mere shabbir
ya hussain aati hai parcham se sada
hussain tu kamyaab hogaya
yazid tu na kamyaab hai (x2)
(4) koshish kiya yazid ne na ho saka wo kaam
hussain ne jo sab ke liye dediya wo jaan
wo ahle aza aaj bhi lete hai uska naam
tu ab bhi zindabad hai hussain
hussain tu kamyaab hogaya
yazid tu na kamyaab hai (x2)
(5) yazid ka tho qabr ka nishan bhi nahi
yazid ka quran me bayan bhi nahi
yazid ki wo nasl ka koyi pata nahi
yazid wo murdabad murdabad hi rahega
hussain tu kamyaab hogaya
yazid tu na kamyaab hai (x2)
(6) aye mazhar o rizvi o syed raza hussain
ta hashr rahegi ye azadari aye hussain
ye farsh e aza bichti rahegi mere hussain
shabbir baherehal tera naam rahega
hussain tu kamyaab hogaya
yazid tu na kamyaab hai (x2)
salam....
salam....
salam ya hussain (x3)

items.title: Aag Aur Dar
items.body:
Chal Base Haaye Dunia Se Jab Mustafa
Teen Din Baad ye kia Sitam Hogaya
Aisa Badla Madina Kay Wa Ghurbataa
Wo Sitamgar Wo Aag Aur Dar e Fatima
Bola Darwaza Ye Aag ko Dekh kar
Hoon Dar e Fatima Kia Nahi Hai Khabar
Aag Aur Dar ki Baaten Suno
Main wo dar jiski Ahmed Ne Tazeem ki
Sar jukate hain Is Dar pe Jibraeel bhi
koi Khali Yahan Se Gaya Naa Kabhi
tu Jalane mujhe q Yahan Agai
Fatima Mere Peeche Hain Jaa Laut Jaa
Aag Tujhko Muhammad Ka Hai Wastaa
Phir Dar e Fatima Se Kaha Aag Ne
Kitni majbur Hoon kia Bataun Tujhe
Fatima Kon Hain Sab Khabar Hai Mujhe
Khud Parishan Hoon Main ye Dar Dekh kay
Kitni Bebas Hoon Bechain Hoti Hoon Main
Haaye Bibi s.a ki Ghurbat pe Roti Hoon Main
Phir ye Dar ne Kaha Aag Mat pass aa
Mujhko Thame khari Hain abhi Fatima
Teri Shiddat Se Isdam Agar main jala
Dast e Zehra Mere Sath Jal Jaiga
Dar Gira to Qayamat yahan Ayegi
Meekh Pehlu Mein Pewast Hojaigi
Aag Phir Dar Se Karne Lagi ye bayan
Leke aaii Hai Ummat Yahan Lakriyan
Ikhtiyarat De de Agar LaMakan
Zalimon Ka Mita dun main Naam o Nishaan
Kar Khuda Kay Sitam ye kabhi bhi na ho
Fatima Meri Shiddat Se Zakhmi Na Ho
Phir ye Hasrat Se Dar Ne Kaha Aag Se
Sath Bibi Kay Masoom bhi Hain khare

Rorahe Hain wo Maa ki Taraf Dekh Kay
puchte Hain Kay ye shor Kaisa hai Maa
Kon Darwaze pe Aag Laaya Hai Maa
Aag Ne Phir Kaha Aag e Barhte Hue
kaise Khud ko bujhaon Batade mujhe
Ghair Munkin hai Kay Zulm ab Ruk sake
ab jalainge ye Ummati Khud Tujhe
Aye Dar e Fatima Alwida Alwida
Waqt e Rukhsat hua Alwida Alwida
Haaye Zeeshan o Imran Dar Jal Gaya

items.title: Faryaad E Sakina
items.body:
Rokey karti thi ye faryaad sakina' baba
Paani baad aapkey dushwaar hai peena baba
Mujhsey milney ke liye aaye ho ek saal ke baad
Kya na yaad aayi tumhey baali sakina' baba
My zaraa deyr bhi panjo'n pey chalii naa baba
Kheenchta aakey rasan shimr kameena' baba
Oonth se raah mey zaalim ney giraaya mujhko
Dekhiye zaqmi hai kitna mera seena' baba
Aap kehtey they jisey dil ka sukoo'n Jaan e jigar
Usko ab maarta hai shimr kameena', baba
Chotey ruqsaar merey, haath badaa zaalim ka
Socho baad aapkey kya mera hai jeena baba
Kabse rorokey yuhi qaak pey sojaatii hoon
Hai kahaa'n soney ko ab aapka seena' baba
Aap maarey gaye, my qaidi bani, shaam chalii
Raas aaya na moharram ka maheena' baba
Zaqmi sarr dekh ke pehchaan lo haalat meri
Khoon hai yaa ke hai maathey pey paseena' baba
Khoon kaano'n se merey paav talak Jaa pahuncha
Shimr bey rehmi se jab baaliyaa'n cheena baba
Aapka naam liya jab bhi, tamaachey khaayi
Tumpey roney ki ijaazat bhi milii naa baba
Laut'tey ghar ko parindo'n pey nazar jab bhi gayii
Yaad aaya hai bohat mujhko madeena' baba
Aapkey sookhey labo'n par Jo chadii dekhi thi
Tabsey beykaar huwa mera ye jeena baba
Khaid khaaney mey bapaa hogaya maatam *"Gaazi"*
Jabkey qaamosh huwi kehkey sakina' baba

items.title: Dete hai aza'n akbar
items.body:
Karbal ke bayaaba me, dete hai'n aza'n akbar.
Yasrab me jise sughra, betaab huvi sunkar.
Beemaar bahan khat me, likhti hai biraadar ko.
Din raat tadapti hu, bhaai se juda ho kar.
Karbal se madeene me, ab jald chale aao.
Le jaao muje aakar, taskeene dile khwaahar.
Sughra ne kaha ro kar, khat de ke yeh qasid ko.
Baba ko suna dena, tu haale ghame dukhtar.
Maqtal me java'n beta, galtaan lahoo me hai.
Zakhmi hai kamar sheh ki, or koi nahi yaavar.
Laashe pe khate sughra, pad kar yeh kaha sheh ne.
Hai waqte namaaz aaya, uthke do aza'n akbar.
Thi khasta kamar *sheh ki* aankho me andhera tha.
Mayyat ali akbar ki jab leke chale sarwar.
Ek hashr sa barba hai, khayme me shahedee'n ke.
Hai girya kuna'n zainab, hai mehve fugha'n maadar.
Navshad ajab haalat, sarwar ki huvi usdam.
Jab maa ne vaqaar apna, sajde me jukaaya sar.
