items.title: Jab rida sar se chini
items.body:
Haye meri zainab, haye meri zainab..(4)
Jab rida sar se chini, tu sada deti rahi, tu na aya gazi..(2)
Tere hatho'n me rasan, dekhta kaise bahen
Bhai bekas tha tera you na aya gazi
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ye tujhe bhi hai khabar dukhtare khaire bashar
Me utha sakta na tha hukme shabbir pe sar
Mere bazu the juda mashk se paani baha
Agayi mujhko haya you na aya gazi

2. Sunke mai teri sada ye tho mumkin hi na tha
Me na aata kaise dhukhtare shere khuda
Be rida dekhu tujhe  kab tha manzoor mujhe
Hausla mujhme na tha you na aya gazi
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Mera chalni tha badan teer the misle kafan
Khoo'n se rangeen tha ban bhai bekas tha bahen
Ghurz tha sar pe laga gash me tha bhai tera
Tera shikwa hai bajha you na aya gazi
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Jang mai kar na saka hukme shabir jo tha
Tha sakina ke liye dum bhi hotho'n pe ruka
Mashk zakhmi jo hui ruk gai saans meri
Phir qadam uth na saka you na aya gazi
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Jab huwa thanda alam amma zahra ki qasam
Kis tarha thujhse kaho kaise nikla mera dam
Wo teri aaho fugha jalte khaimo ka dhuwa
Sharm ne maar diya you na aya gazi
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Jab me ghode se gira aayi amma ki sada
Ae shahensha e wafa aa meri god me aa
Rab ne bejha tha jinhe dekhta kaise unhe
Khu tha ankho me jama you..............
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Ye to acha hi huwa aankh me teer laga
Yu rasan basta tujhe dekhna padta mujhe
Muh dikha sakta na tha ye alam dar e wafa
Dil mera doob gaya you.............
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Tune jo zulm sahe kis tarha bhai kahe
Noke neza pe bhi mai band ankhein tha kiye
Sham tak sath gaya tere pathar jo laga
Mai bhi naizey se gira you...........
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Bhai ki tooti kamar dekhe hashim ka qamar
Tere gazi ka alam ho gaya khoon me tar
Pyase bacho ke liye pani lana tha mujhe
Wada pura na huwa you............
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Rroya rehan qalam karke ye baat raqam
Khoon me doob gaya tere ghazi ka alam
Sar jo zakhmi tha mera aankh me khoo'n tha jama
Aagayi mujhko qaza you na aya gazi.

<<DIVIDER>>
ehsaas kaise likhe lafzon mein aah ainee
mudh mudh ke dekhte thay kaabe ko shaah ainee
aamir ye shaahe deen ka nauha suna raha hai
tera hussain tere...
items.author: Ainee Rizvi

items.title: Karbala khamosh hai
items.body:
aagayi shaam e ghariban karbala khamosh hai
hogaya maqtool quran karbala khamosh hai
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema ke laadle sab zulm se maare gaye
murtaza ki aankh ke roshan sabhi taare gaye
mushaf e ismat ke jitne thay sabhi paare gaye
hal ata par gham hai taari innama khamosh hai
aagayi shaame ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
jal gaye hai saare qaime kya kare saydaniyan
chadarein bhi chin gayi hai kya kare saydaniyan
zulmaton ke bheed mein hai mustafa ki betiyan
chup hai abbas e jari aur alqama khamosh hai
aagayi shaame ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
maadar e baysheer ko zainab sambhale kya kare
godh mein saare yateemon ko uthaale kya kare
abid e muztar ko sholon se nikaale kya kare
ek zainab hai akeli khaafila khamosh hai
aagayi shaame ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek taraf qaime jale aur ek taraf masnad jali
har taraf dil ki sada hai ya mohamed ya ali
aise mein zainab bani hai khud hussain ibne ali
azme zainab dekh ke har maujiza khamosh hai
aagayi shaame ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
mushkilein is raat mein jab mehwe ghairat hogayi
ek phupi aur ek bhatiji kohe ghairat hogayi
har musibat jhel kar faqre mashiyat hogayi
sabr o gham ka is jagah har falsafa khamosh hai
aagayi shaame ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
aakhirash mir e najaf khud bhi ye manzar dekh kar
aagaye karbobala beti ko muztar dekh kar
keh uthi hyder se ye hyder ki dilbar dekh kar
mere baba aap ka har dilruba khamosh hai
aagayi shaame ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
shadman o mir tusi gham ke in halaat mein
aansuon ki dard ki ehsaas ki barsaat mein
tum ko padhna mujhko likha mil gaya khairaat mein
tum ko sun kar dehr ka har khushnawa khamosh hai
aagayi shaame ghariban...
items.author: Mir Tusi

items.title: Khafila jaa raha
items.body:
khafila jaa raha hai watan ke liye
karbala mein qayamat ka ek shor hai
<<DIVIDER>>
khafila jaa raha hai watan ke liye
koi roti hai apne jawan laal ko
ro rahi hai koi kam-sukhan ke liye
<<DIVIDER>>
jab chale thay madine se sab saath thay
aun o jafar thay akbar thay abbas thay
jaa rahi hoon madine to koi nahi
ab musibat faqat hai behan ke liye
khafila jaa raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi chadar na thi kaisi bedaad thi
haath hote huwe bhi na azaad thi
kitni majboor kar di gayi thi behan
apne bhai ke dafn o kafan ke liye
khafila jaa raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
apni barbadiyon ko gawara kiya
khoon mein doobe gulon ka nazara kiya
de diya fatema ka bhara gulsitan
karbala tere ujde chaman ke liye
khafila jaa raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
qabre sarwar pe ke behan ne kaha
kya bataun ke bhaiya sitam kya hua
kufa o shaam mein hoon phiri berida
aap mohtaj yan thay kafan ke liye
khafila jaa raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
qabre qasim se hai yun mukhatib phupi
teri shadi kuch is tarha ban mein hui
koi sehre ka bhi phool baaqi nahi
warna le jaati qabre hassan ke liye
khafila jaa raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
bain karti thi ye banu e shaahe deen
mai kahin reh gayi mera asghar kahin
godh khaali hai meri sakina nahi
mar gayi qaid mein wo watan ke liye
khafila jaa raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
cheh mahine ki jaan asghar e bezuban
ho gayae karbala ki zameen mein nehan
soone jangal mein ab jaa ke dhoondun kahan
maa tadapti hai us gulbadan ke liye
khafila jaa raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab e dil hazeen seh ke ranj o mahan
jab madine mein pahunchegi ye khasta tan
umr bhar haath malti rahegi behen
bhai abbas se saf shikan ke liye
khafila jaa raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
kasre zaalim kabhi qaid khaana kabhi
nok e naiza kabhi taziyana kabhi
kaun si thi aziyyat jo di na gayi
har jafa thi aseer e mehan ke liye
khafila jaa raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
naala e gham sehelta hai charkhe kohan
qabr e qasim pe aati hai bewa dulhan
chadare ashk laati hai behre kafan
ran mein teeron se chalni badan ke liye
khafila jaa raha...
items.author: Sachey Bhai

items.title: Kund khanjar na
items.body:
garm reti pe sar e dasht ajab hai manzar
koi saaya hai jo deta hai sada ro ro kar
dekh zakhmi hai musafir hai mera lakhte jigar
kam se kam pani se tar kar le layeen tu khanjar
qabr ko chod ke yan aayi hoo dilgeer hoo mai
naam zehra hai mera maadar e shabbir hoo mai
<<DIVIDER>>
kund khanjar na chala shimr e sitamgar ruk ja
waasta rab ka tujhe behre payambar ruk ja
<<DIVIDER>>
is ke farzand jawan ne abhi khaayi barchi
is ke seene mein hai paywast wo naize ki ani
zakhm par zakhm na de ab to sitamgar ruk ja
kund khanjar na chala...
<<DIVIDER>>
iske chehre pe lahoo asghar e baysheer ka hai
ghao seene mein abhi is ke kisi teer ka hai
hai abhi sajda e mabood mein ye sar ruk ja
kund khanjar na chala...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek bhai tha jo bekas ki kamar tod gaya
ek bhatija tha bilakta hua jo chod gaya
mai dua doongi tujhe haath utha kar ruk ja
kund khanjar na chala...
<<DIVIDER>>
be gala jisko samajhta hai tu sarwar ka gala
ghaur se dekh ye hai tere payambar ka gala
kuch na samjhe to yehi baat samjh kar ruk ja
kund khanjar na chala...
<<DIVIDER>>
jurm kya hai mere bache ka tu itna to bata
is ke nana ka padha karta hai tu bhi kalma
muntazir is ki hai ek choti si dukhtar ruk ja
kund khanjar na chala...
<<DIVIDER>>
aisa lagta hai ke hamsheer nahi hai teri
warna rakhta nahi pyase ke galay par tu churi
qaime ke dar pe hai mazloom ki khwahar ruk ja
kund khanjar na chala...
<<DIVIDER>>
chakkiyan pees ke mehnat se isay paala hai
is ne jo keh diya khudrat ne kahan taala hai
ye dila sakta hai jannat mein tujhe ghar ruk ja
kund khanjar na chala...
<<DIVIDER>>
safdar e khasta jigar gham ye bayan kaise karun
chashme zehra jo se tapka tha wo ek khatra e khoon
tu bhi rehaan qalam rakh de ye keh kar ruk ja
kund khanjar na chala...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Luti dunya ali
items.body:
luti dunya ali e murtuza ki
shahadat ho gayi hai sayyeda ki
<<DIVIDER>>
khadija khuld mein nauha kuna hai
duhaai de rahi hai wo khuda ki
luti dunya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
mila baagh e fidak ka dil ko sadma
sitam ye aur mohsin ne qaza ki
luti dunya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai gham mein mubtila rooh e payambar
lehad tharra rahi hai mustafa ki
luti dunya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
milayzakhmon pa usko zakhm itne
zaroorat thi bahot jisko dawa ki
luti dunya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha mayyat par yehi zainab ka nauha
saza paayi hai hum ne kis khata ki
luti dunya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha hasnain ne qabr e nabi par
aray nana meri maa ne qaza ki
luti dunya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
ba waqte ghusl e mayyat roye hyder
shikasta phasliyan thi ehliya ki
luti dunya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
na le kar jaaiye maadar ko meri
padar se betiyon ne ilteja ki
luti dunya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
madina ro raha tha khoon ke aansu
uthi mayyat jo ghar se fatema ki
luti dunya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
musmalmano na maaro is pa pathar
ke mayyat hai ye binte mustafa ki
luti dunya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham e zehra mein girya ho raha hai
moharram hai safon mein ambiya ki
luti dunya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
rasool e paak ka gulshan hai zad mein
sitam ki aag hai aisi bala ki
luti dunya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghame sheh par raza kyun kar na roye
haqeeqat jaante hai karbala ki
luti dunya ali...
items.author: Raza Ali Khan Lakhnavi

items.title: Manzar pase manzar
items.body:
manzar pas e manzar
<<DIVIDER>>
wo hussain ibne ali aur wo shimr ka khanjar
manzar pas e manzar...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhko kahan maloom hai shabbir ka rutba
payambar ke bete hai bhala tujhko khabar kya
na waqif e anjaam hai tu dhyaan ye rakhna
jis deh ki hukumat ke liye aaya hai ladne
wo ab teri qismat may hai kab tera muqaddar
manzar pas e manzar...
wo hussain ibne ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
is khaak ki kya tujhko khabar kitni bhali hai
is dasht ke ausaaf may aqwaal e jali hai
firdaus ka tukda to sar e dasht yehi hai
ta hadde nazar aaj yahan hai mere aghyaar
kal honge yahan chaaron taraf zaair e sarwar
manzar pas e manzar...
wo hussain ibne ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum binte payambar ke chaheete hai khabardaar
hum hyder e safdar ke dulaare hai khabardaar
hum ahmed e mursal ke nawase hai khabardaar
mukhtar hai hum tum hame majboor na samjho
chaahe to abhi khaak kare shaam ka lashkar
manzar pas e manzar...
wo hussain ibne ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehra hai labe nehr atash lab pe hamare
tum ne to taraayi pe bitha rakhe hai pehre
ye aaj ki tasveer hai ekaad ke bete
kal pyason ke isma e girami ke tasadduq
dunya may rawan hoga sabeelon ka samandar
manzar pas e manzar...
wo hussain ibne ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu fauj ki kasrat pe na itra pisar e saad
kal khud hi tu ye bolega lo hogaye barbaad
lashkar se sada aayegi imdad ho imdad
us waqt ka manzar na kabhi bhoolegi dunya
aayega paye jang mera jab ali asghar
manzar pas e manzar...
wo hussain ibne ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah ne apne hi liye hum ko banaya
ye jaan ke bhi tum ne hame dukh diye kya kya
hum uski hi tauheed tale karte hai sajda
sar tan se juda hoga magar dekh na zaalim
aayegi kate sar se sada allahu akbar
manzar pas e manzar...
wo hussain ibne ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ishq ki meraj hai qurbani e shabbir
faqre yade bezaam hai islam ki taqdeer
maqsad se mere khoob hai waqif mera baysheer
khamoshiyan kyun odh ke nikle hai watan se
manzoor hai hum logon ko taskeen e payambar
manzar pas e manzar...
wo hussain ibne ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum logon ne jis dasht ko pur khaar kiya hai
tum logon ne jis dasht ko aazaar diya hai
tum logon ne jis dasht ko laashon se bhara hai
wo dasht azadaron ke phoolon se bharega
kal maqtal e shabbir ka tum dekhna manzar
manzar pas e manzar...
wo hussain ibne ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay dayam o yazdan yehi sheh kehte thay sunle
ye dhoop ye sehra ye baraste huwe sholay
ye gulshan e sehra sipaahe shaam ke qabze
ye aaj ki tasveer hai ye aaj ka manzar
kal chamkega is dasht ka aabaad manzar
manzar pas e manzar...
wo hussain ibne ali...
items.author: Dayam Najafi

items.title: Aagaya maahe aza
items.body:
gham ki chaayi hai ghata aansu bahalo momino
aagaya maahe aza aansu bahalo momino
<<DIVIDER>>
haye darya ki tarayi par jari abbas ka
zulm se baazu kata aansu bahalo momino
aagaya maahe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
chand dikhte hi falak par saj gaye har ghar alam
aur bicha farshe aza aansu bahalo momino
aagaya maahe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar o aun o mohamed qasim e naushah ko
yaad karke tum zara aansu bahalo momino
aagaya maahe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaah ke haaton pe teere hurmala ki nok se
halqe asghar bhi chida aansu bahalo momino
aagaya maahe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
baade ashoora sabhi saydaniyo ke haye haye
chin gayi sar se rida aansu bahalo momino
aagaya maahe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne aansu marhame zakhme shahe mazloom hai
kuch nahi iske siwa aansu bahalo momino
aagaya maahe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab bhi aajaye moharram zindagi may ay bober
kehte rehna tum sada aansu bahalo momino
aagaya maahe aza...
items.author: Mir Bober Ali

items.title: Ab ay hussain aa
items.body:
aayi ye arsh e paak se allah ki sada
ab ay hussain aa ab ay hussain aa
<<DIVIDER>>
aaja palat ke rab ki taraf aa hussain aa
ay mere mustafa ke kalaf aa hussain aa
ay laqte qalbe shaahe najaf aa hussain aa
sar kar gaya hai jaan bakaf aa hussain aa
<<DIVIDER>>
hyder ke laal fatema zehra ke noore ain
noore nazar rasool ke zehra ke dil ke chain
jannat ke baadhshah shehensahe mashraqain
tere liye hai kaun o makan ke ye zeb o zain
<<DIVIDER>>
nana se apne tu ne jo waada kiya hussain
mesaaq waale ehd ko poora kiya hussain
tu ne jo mere saamne sajda kiya hussain
haq bandagi ka tu ne ada kar diya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ab tere mere beech nahi koi faasla
ab ay hussain aa ab ay hussain aa
aayi ye arsh e paak se...
<<DIVIDER>>
teeron par teer tere badan par baras gaye
pani ki boondh boondh ko bacche taras gaye
ghazi ne tere nehr pe katwa diye hai haath
zinda rahenge haath ye mashk o alam ke saath
<<DIVIDER>>
islam sar barehna khada tha jo saamne
zainab ne apne sar ki rida baksh di usay
zehra ne chakki pees ke paala tujhe hussain
in dushmano ne maar hi daala tujhe hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
tu ne jawan pisar ali akbar bhi de diya
shish maah bezuban ali asghar bhi de diya
ghar ko mere bachane bhara ghar bhi de diya
islam ki baqa ke liye sar bhi de diya
<<DIVIDER>>
ab saari kayenaat tere naam hai hussain
islam tere dam se hi islam hai hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
haa mai hoo tera tu hai mera
ab ay hussain aa ab ay hussain aa
aayi ye arsh e paak se...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmon se choor choor hai tera badan hussain
jangal mein lut gaya tera saara chaman hussain
laashon se saj gayi hai teri anjuman hussain
ab karbala ki khaak hai tera watan hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak e shafa hai maine teri khaak ko kiya
takmeel tujhse panjetan e paak ko kiya
tu mera aaena hai mai hoo aaena tera
ab ay hussain aa ab ay hussain aa
aayi ye arsh e paak se...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain marzi e khaaliq hai tere haathon mein
payam o haq o sadaqat hai tere haathon mein
<<DIVIDER>>
ba ho chuki ye jang har ek maareka hua
raazi hussain tujhse tera kibriya hua
rakh ay hussain apni ye shamsheer niyam mein
aa baargahe jalwa e rabbe anaam mein
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmon se saara jism sajaya hua hai tu
apne lahoo mein aaj nahaya hua hai tu
tanha khada rahega bhala kab talak bata
ab ay hussain aa ab ay hussain aa

items.title: Abbas meri shimr se
items.body:
abbas meri shimr se chadar to dila do
balwe mein khule sar hoo zara parda bana do
<<DIVIDER>>
har simt lagi aag mai kis kis ko sambhalun
sajjad ko jalte huwe qaimon mein nikalo
abbas meri shimr se...
<<DIVIDER>>
paband e rasan shaam ko tayyar khadi hoo
mehmil pe zara aa ke mujhe aap bitha do
abbas meri shimr se...
<<DIVIDER>>
daaman mein lagi aag na jal jaye sakina
masooma ke daaman ki zara aag bujha do
abbas meri shimr se...
<<DIVIDER>>
sehme huwe masoomo ko neend aayegi kaise
ek baar zara aa ke inhe aap sula do
abbas meri shimr se...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa akbar o asghar ki mere saath hai kehti
sughra ko madine mein ye paigham pahuncha do
abbas meri shimr se...
<<DIVIDER>>
waaqif mai nahi shaam ki raahon se ay bhaiya
ek baar mujhe shaam ka rasta to bata do
abbas meri shimr se...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo ajre risalat diya ummat ne tere baad
abbas ye zewar mere haathon mein pehna do
abbas meri shimr se...
<<DIVIDER>>
sardar ko gham tera hai aulaad se pyara
kehta hai shab e roz mere bakth jaga do
abbas meri shimr se...

items.title: Ali jaisa namazi
items.body:
ali jaisa namazi todta hai dum musalle par
manati hai namazein murtaza ka gham musalle par
<<DIVIDER>>
bujha kar zehr may shamsheer apni ibne muljim ne
lagayi us ghadi zarbat lagayi ibne muljim ne
ali e murtaza ne jab kiya sar kham musalle par
ali jaisa namazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaqi ne waar sheh par ain sajde may kiya aisa
sar e hyder hua do neem ubla khoon ka darya
tadapta reh gaya sultane do aalam musalle par
ali jaisa namazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda jaane ye himmat kaisi dikhlayi hai shabbar ne
namaze fajr ki takmeel phir bhi ki hai shabbar ne
ali ke sar se behta tha lahoo paiham musalle par
ali jaisa namazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
sada deta hai kufa keh raha hai bait e daawar bhi
gawahi de rahe hai masjid o mehraab o mimbar bhi
hai ab bhi mehwe sajda waarise aadam musalle par
ali jaisa namazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jabeen sajde may hai aur zehn may kufa ka manzar hai
nazar may zakhmi sar hai nauha e hyder labon par
ke aansu kar rahe hai shaah ka matam musalle par
ali jaisa namazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
rulaati hai hamesha shaah e khyber geer ki yaadein
sada tadpati rehti hai hamay shabir ki yaadein
namazon ke liye aate hai jab bhi ham musalle par
ali jaisa namazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
lahoo rehan roye waaris e kaaba ki furqat may
mujeeb afkaar ne nauhe padhe roze ki haalat may
kiya unnisween ramzan ne bhi matam musalle par
ali jaisa namazi...
items.author: Mujeeb Alipuri

items.title: Ant e ummul aza
items.body:
Sayyeda sayyeda sayyeda sayyeda ante ummul aza
Raziya marzia qudsiya tahera ante khairun nesa
Fatema fatema fatema fatema binte khairul wara
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Baad e nabi zulm ka kuch is tarah toofa utha
Ghar jala darwaza gira pahlu shekasta hua
Samne haider ke sitamgaro ne ki wo jafa
Tera shekam mohsin e mazloom ka maqtal bana
Reh gaya kaap kar rauz e Mustafa
Sayyeda sayyeda sayyeda sayyeda ante ummul aza
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Zulm o sitam ki wo madine me hui ibteda
Jiska nazar aa gya anjaam sar e karbala
Qatl waha batn me ek maa ka jo mohsin hua
Baap ki aghosh me asghar yaha mara gaya
Wo bhi gham apka ye bhi gham apka
Sayyeda sayyeda sayyeda sayyeda ante ummul aza
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Dar na jalate jo madeene me tera badguma
Karbobala me ma kabhi khaimo se uthta dhuwa
Parhti na maula ke gale me jo waha reesma(rassi)
Garden e beemar me hota nahi tauq e gera
Tere qalb e shekasta(toota hua) pe jaane feda
Sayyeda sayyeda sayyeda sayyeda ante ummul aza
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Uthte the jis beti ki tazeem ko paiham nabi
Chin li jallado ne u uske labo se hasi
Roti hai mazloomi e masooma pe khud be basi
Ghar me hai sadat ke din raat ki faqa kashi
Zakhm e zehra ki ho kis tarah ab dawa
Sayyeda sayyeda sayyeda sayyeda ante ummul aza
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Umr hai athhara baras au rasa haath me
Bachhe bohot chhote hain ab kon chale saath me
Rehti hain din raat namaz aur monajaat me
Dard se gir parhti hain din me to kabhi raat me
Koi marham nahi ashk e gham ke sewa
Sayyeda sayyeda sayyeda sayyeda ante ummul aza
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Zarbe jafa(zulm ki chot) aisi thi kaari(kamyab) ke qayamat hui
Teen maheene nahi guzre ke shahadat hui
Ummat e ahmad ko na taufeeq e ayadat hui
Aalame ghurbat hi me shahzadi ki rehlat hui
Alwida alwida aye shaheede jafa
Sayyeda sayyeda sayyeda sayyeda ante ummul aza
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Ghusl jo haidar ne wasiyat ke mutabiq diya
Dekha ke bazu na to pahlu hi salmat raha
Jism bohot zakhmi hai masooma e konain ka
Peet ke sar rone lage apna imam e huda
U na roye kabhi cheekh kar murtaza
Sayyeda sayyeda sayyeda sayyeda ante ummul aza
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Laash nazar aayi jo mazlooma ki zere kafan
Seena o sar peet te the zehra ke ghuncha dahan(phul jaise mu waale bachhe)
Paayeti thi zainab o kulsum sarhaane hasan
Ruk gay eek goshe me ye keh ke hussain e zaman
Meri amma bulayengi tab aaunga
Sayyeda sayyeda sayyeda sayyeda ante ummul aza
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Sun ke ye dil soz sada paikar(badan) e zehra hila
Bande kafan toot gye aur hua mehshar bapa
hathon ko be sakhta shehzadi ne phaila diya
ladle shabbier ko phir seene se lipta liya
kehti thi u na ro aye mere mehlaqa
Sayyeda sayyeda sayyeda sayyeda ante ummul aza
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Ghurbat e zehra ka ye shamshad ne nauha likha
Mursal e azam ne di khud haath uthakar dua
Farshe aza se utha kuch is tarah shor e buka
Aa gye majlis me jena chhorh kea hl e kisa
Barh gyi ronaq e bazm e sehne aza.(azadari ka aangan)
Sayyeda sayyeda sayyeda sayyeda ante ummul aza

items.title: Ay godiyo ke paale
items.body:
ay godiyon ke paale laila ke dil ki dhaaras
islam ki tajalli emaan ke ujaale
<<DIVIDER>>
bujhti hui jawani ye bhool jaane waale
kaise samajh sakegi wo maut ke ishare
ay godiyon ke paale...
<<DIVIDER>>
parda pada hua hai kis tarha maa pukare
ay maut ki nazar se aakhein ladane waale
ay godiyon ke paale...
<<DIVIDER>>
ujde huwe chaman ki khilti kali hai akbar
har saans keh rahi hai tum zindagi ho akbar
ay godiyon ke paale...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay noor e chasm e laila taqdeer ke ujale
<<DIVIDER>>
ruqsat ka dil par gham ha akbar salaam le lo
ye aakhri alam hai akbar salaam le lo
ay godiyon ke paale...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaati hui ada hai ab khatm hai ye naale
hai qaum tum par sadqe jibraeel ke dulaare
ay godiyon ke paale...
<<DIVIDER>>
islam ke sahare emaan ke shaahzade
ye roshni ata ki athara saal waale
ay godiyon ke paale...

items.title: Babul Murad Ghazi
items.body:
Shere khuda ke Dilbar Babul murad ghazi
Abbas ibne haidar Babul murad ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
(1)
Bharti hai har bashar ki jholi thumare dar se
Mujh natawa’n pe tera abre karam jo barse
Guncha bane gule tar Babul murad ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
(2)
Chaukhat pe teri maula aata hai jo sawali
Hargiz nahi palatta babe ata se khali
Kono maka’n ke sarwar Babul murad ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
(3)
Do mustafa ka sadqa mushkil kusha ka sadqa
Maula hasan ka sadqa shahe hoda sadqa
Aye fatima ke dilbar Babul murad ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
(4)
Chalta hai ab bhi sikka ghazi teri wafa ka
Isaar or shujaat padhti hai tera kalma
Sani e shere dawar Babul murad ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
(5)
Saya tere Alam ka hai shaha ki aza par
Karte hain shae ka matam parcham tera utha kar
Sabro wafa ke mahewar Babul murad ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
(6)
Taskeen e kalbe zainab kulsoom ka sahara
Tere wajood hi se thi mutmaeen sakeena
Aye aitebar e sarwar Babul murad ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
(7)
Badli musibato’n ki har samt cha gayi hai
Be jurm ahele haq ko duniya sata rahi hai
Imdad kar do akar Babul murad ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
(8)
Zulmat mite Jaha’n se waqte zahoor aaye
Mahfooz noor e haq se kaunain jagmagaye
Paye sukoon khawar Babul murad ghazi

items.title: Bechain hai zainab
items.body:
bechain hai zainab aaja
veeran hai ghar ali akbar
mere laal tu laut ke aaja

pardes ki is ghurbat mein
hum jaaye kahan batla jaa
bechain hai zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
athara baras paala tujhko
tu ghar se gaya na baahar
din doob gaya hai beta
ghar laut ke ab to aaja
bechain hai zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai waasta tere baba ka
haathon ke mere nawaalon ka
marne ki umr thi teri
ek baar mujhe samjha jaa
bechain hai zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
lagta hai watan na jaungi
ghut ghut ke mar jaungi
jeene ki karungi tamanna
ek baar tu wapas aaja
bechain hai zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
zanjeer mein jakda hai kunba
sar naize par hai tera
aankhon se lahoo barsaun
mai kab tak ye batla jaa
bechain hai zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri yaadein hai aur zainab hai
hamshakle payambar akbar
doo dil ko tasalli kaise
ye baat zara batla jaa
bechain hai zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan fughan thi zainab ki
ye shaam ke bazaron mein
dukhiyari phuphi kehti hai
akbar mere akbar aaja
bechain hai zainab...

hashr tak deodi pe maa karti rahegi intezar

laashe asghar godh mein hai aur laashon par nazar

chal diye shabbir...

qabre asghar khud bana li fatema ke laal ne
godh mein jhoole ke aadi ko jhulane ke liye
chal diye shabbir...

mil gaye hyder ka dil zabte hassan sabre hussain
gardan e asghar se paikaan kheench laane ke liye

jin ki aamad se bana buth khana ay khana e khuda
reh gayi aulaad unki qaid khane ke liye
chal diye shabbir...

kyun rahe zulmat mein hum jab ke nisar apne hussain
noor ka minaar hai saare zamane ke liye
chal diye shabbir...

items.title: Deti hai sada sughra
items.body:
Deti hai sada sugra mai kaise jiyu baba
Weeran hai ghar mera mai kaise jiyu baba
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Akbar ne kaha tha ye aavunga tujhe lene
Wada na hua pora mai kaise jiyu baba
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Rahkar mai watan me bhi lagti rahi pardesi
Koi bhi nahi mera mai kaise jiyu baba
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Tadpati hai ab yaade yaad ate hai maa bahne
Hai baar har ek lamha mai kaise jiyu baba
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ye kaisi ghadi aayi rulwaati hai tanhaayi
Dushwaar hai ab jeena mai kaise jiyu baba
<<DIVIDER>>
5.  Har dam hai nazaaro me phirta hai nigaaho me
Asgar ka hasee chahra mai kaise jiyu baba
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Hai zoaf ka ye alam mai kaapti hu har dam
Is haal me hu tanha mai kaise jiyu baba
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Rah rah ke rulaata hai dil mera dukhata hai
Ye chand muharram ka mai kaise jiyu baba
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Bibi ki azadari barpa hai kamaal ab bhi
Shahzaadi ka hai nawha mai kaise jiyu baba

items.body:
zainab ye buka aaj bhi karti hai khule sar
faryad hai baba

faryad hai baba

ye haal hai mera
kuch itne sitam dhaaye hai taqdeer ne mujh par
faryad hai baba
zainab ye buka aaj bhi..

bewa hui kubra
mehendi bhare haathon ko dulhan reh gayi mal kar
faryad hai baba
zainab ye buka aaj bhi..

is gham se phata jaata hai seene may kaleja
mai reh gayi tanha
shabbir sa laaungi kahan se mai biraadar
faryad hai baba
zainab ye buka aaj bhi..

paywast hua seene may is tarha se naiza
khinch aaya kaleja
aur khoon may tadapta raha shakle payambar
faryad hai baba
zainab ye buka aaj bhi..

le kar mai alamdar ke do daste bureeda

faryad hai baba
zainab ye buka aaj bhi..

items.title: Haal E Yateemi
items.body:
Haye baba haye baba
Mere baba mere baba
Aye baba is hale yateemi mein
kitna mushkil mera jeena hai
Tum se bichadh ke zinda rah pana
mere liye marne se zyada hai
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Hoke yateema kitne tamache rukh par khati hun
Kano se khun aur aankho se ashk bahati hun
Uth gaya sar se baap ka saya sab se batati hun
Maqtal se tum aate nahi ho kitna bulati hun
Ahle sitam ne zulm hai dhaya
Kurte ka daaman bhi hai jalaya
Maine musibat mein aye baba tumko pukara hai
Sun lo meri fariyad mere baba
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ab mujhko apne seene par kon sulayega
Kon mohabbat se ab sar par haath phirayega
Kon hai ab jo mere dil ki pyas bujhayega
Is sahra se kon madfine lekar jayega
Baba tum seene pe sulalo
Zulmo sitam se mujhko bachalo
Aao to aur pucho to kya hale sakina hai
Sun lo meri fariyad mere baba
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Aada ne mujhko jakda hai zulm ki rassi mein
Pusht pa durre bhi padte hain haaye yateemi mein
Kal talk thi aazad sakina ab hai aseeri mein
Kitna watan bhi yaad ata hai ayesi ghareebi mein
Jaati hun mai qaidi bankar
Is sahra mein barbad hua ghar
Karbobala se kufe ke bazar mein jana hai
Sun lo meri fariyad mere baba
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Kufe ke bazar mein baba sab the tamashai
Kitna mujhko dukh pahucha tha kitni haya aai
Thoda sa paani aur na chadar koi mil paai
Bheed mein bhi mahsoos hui thi kitni tanhai
Kufe se ab sham safar hai
Chalni chalni mera jigar hai
Itna bata do kitni musibat aur uthana hai
Sun lo meri fariyad mere baba
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Jaaun kahan mai raah me pushte naqa se girkar
Allaho akbar kaisi musibat aai hai ye mujhpar
Qafile waale choot gaye hain dhundhna hai dhoobhar
Ab na hai phuphiyan saath me mere aur na hai maadar
Charo taraf ik sannata hai
Seene mein dil ghabrata hai
Bichdi hui hun mai kunbe se tumko milana hai
Sun lo meri fariyad mere baba
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Rah rah ke tadpata hai mujhko asr ka har manzar
Pyase par barsaaye sitam ne kis darja patthar
Sajda aur teeron ka musalla chalta hua khanjar
Ghash mein pada beemar baradar khaime ke andar
Kaisi musibat ki wo ghadi thi
Kitni mpareshan meri phuphi thi
Gham ki ghatayen chai hain ab bhi khun barasta hai
Sun lo meri fariyad mere baba
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Tashte tala se uth ke meri god mein sar aaya
Tumne apne paas na mujhko ab tak bulwaya
Khwab me tumne le chalne ko mujhse hai farmaya
Qaide sitam mein dhundh rahi hun chain ka sarmaya
Aa gaya fidvi shah ka kata sar
Haye raza shabbir ki dukhtar
Mar gai ro kar aaj bhi zinda uska noha hai
Sun lo meri fariyad mere baba

phir na soyi kabhi saydaniya gham ki maari

mar gayi qaid may ro ro ke sakina pur gham

ashk se marqade baysheer ko sairaab kiya
kaash abbas mera...

baaghi keh keh ke chalate hai wo hum par pathar
yun na be-aas mohamed ka na hota kunba
kaash abbas mera...
baade ashoor ye...

sar khule koocha o bazaar phir aayi zainab

khoon ke ashk har ek pal hai bahayi zainab
dil mein gham leke bahattar ko hoo zinda bhaiya
kaash abbas mera...
baade ashoor ye...

baap ki laadli hai baap ki shafqat se juda

baade ashoor ye...

chal basa mursale aazam ka gharana saara
haye zaalim ne sakina ko tamacha maara
bibiyan peet ke sar dene lagi ye naara
ghair hai charon taraf koi nahi hai apna

baade ashoor ye...

kis mein himmat thi mere baandta baazu mein rasan
noke naiza pe nahi hota sar e shaahe zaman
kitne khush haal raha karte thay hum apne watan
ye to acha hua karbal mein na aayi sughra
kaash abbas mera...
baade ashoor ye...

akbar o asghar e baysheer na maare jaate

sab mere saath watan aaj hamare jaate
haye zindan mein na rehti sakina tanha
kaash abbas mera...
baade ashoor ye...

sunke karbal mein najaf zainab e muztar ka bayan
shaah ke laashe se bhi hone lagay ashk rawan

items.title: Karbala ki kahani
items.body:
tareekh e karbala hai ye tareekh e karbala
haye ghareeb hussain haye ghareeb hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
aao sunaun tum ko mai tareekh e karbala
yani ghareeb e fatema zehra ka marsiya
zehra ka laal shaam ki faujon mein tha ghira
qurban ho chuke thay sab ansar o aqraba
ghurbat ki bekasi thi shah e mashreqain thay
nau laakh fauj e shaam mein tanha hussain thay
haye ghareeb hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
tanhaai dhoondti hai wo lashkar kidhar gaya
tooti hui kamar hai jawan bhai mar gaya
noor e nazar ke saath hi noor e nazar gaya
armaan tha jiski shadi ka wo bhi guzar gaya
rota hai dil shabih e payambar nahi raha
sughra ki yaad aati hai akbar nahi raha
haye ghareeb hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai kis tarha bayan karun us waqt kya tha haal
kha kar sitam ka teer jo asghar hua nidhaal
jab hichkiyan wo leta tha masoom naunehaal
bano na dekh le kahin sheh ko tha ye khayal
jitna lahoo ugal diya maah e muneer ne
utna to doodh bhi na piya tha sagheer ne
haye ghareeb hussain...

bache ki apne qabr banane lage hussain
khud bebasi ki laash uthaane lage hussain
pyase labon pe ashk girane lage hussain
matti mein apna chand chupane lage hussain
thi itni garm rayt ke ghabra gaye hussain
chehre pe khaak daal ke tharra gaye hussain
haye ghareeb hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
rote huwe imam jo qaime ke dar pe aaye

items.title: Ab bhi asghar so raha hai
items.body:
Haye asghar, haye asghar
Hai lehed mein haath sheh ka lasha e besheer par
ab bhi asghar so raha hai seena e shabbir par
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Qabr mein baba se ye lipta hua hai aaj bhi
hurmala ke teer se zakhmi gala hai aaj bhi
sar burida baap ka yeh dekhta hai aaj bhi
puri ginti ho na paayi gin raha hai aaj bhi
zakhm naizo'n ke hai kitne seena e shabbir par
ab bhi asghar so raha hai seena e shabbir par
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Baap godi mein utha laaya ise kis aas mein
rote hai aulad wale aalam e ehsaas mein
hoti hai mehsoos larzish lasha e abbas mein
nanhe hoto'n par zaba'n pheri hai kisne pyaas mein
roye dushman dekh kar is ko shishe tazeer par
ab bhi asghar so raha hai seena e shabbir par
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Faisla bus hoga haq hai kaun batil kaun hai
hurmala ki soch ka duniya mein hamil kaun hai
munsife tareekh likhe ismein shamil kaun hai
bekhata chhe maah ke bachhe ka qatil kaun hai
mohr asghar ne lagadi nusrate shabbir par
ab bhi asghar so raha hai seena e shabbir par
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Jab burida seh gaye to in mein ek sar kam hua
qabr taaza koi wo zalim chala tha dhundhta
wo zamee'n par har jagah par gaadhta naiza chala
lasha e asghar sina ke saath bahar aagaya
dekh kar ye ghash hai taari madar e besheer par
ab bhi asghar so raha hai seena e shabbir par
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ek sadaa girye ki hai zindaan ke zulmaat mein
aur izafa ho raha hai din badin sadmaat mein
baap ke seene pe soti hai sakina raat mein
kitni hasrat aur hai kitna gila is baat mein
aaj rona aagaya zindaan ki taqdeer par
ab bhi asghar so raha hai seena e shabbir par
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Kitni sadiya waris e shabbir ne sadma saha
khoon ke aansu bahakar raat din rota raha
nahiya mein ek bachhe ko salaam usne kaha
chhe mahine ke bhala bachhe ka kya hai khoo'n baha
khoon ka badla hai wajib waris e shabbir par
ab bhi asghar so raha hai seena e shabbir par
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Hichkiyo'n aur siskiyo'n ka ab bhi jaari hai safar
har azakhane mein hai mashk o alam aate nazar
ek hai taboot sheh ka phool aur ashko se tarr
hai ali asghar ka jhula is liye khali qamar
likh diya jaaye azakhane ki ye tameer par
ab bhi asghar so raha hai seena e shabbir par

items.title: Abbas mujhe karbala
items.body:

ro ro ke kaha maine lipat kar ye alam se

abbas mujhe karbala...

mai bhi to azadar hoon kya dil nahi mera
zawwaron ki khidmat mein karun paaon daba kar
wahan paidal mai chalun saare maukab dekhun
wa hussaina keh kar khaak chehre pe malun
ek baar mashi mujhko kara do
abbas mujhe karbala...

teer aankh mein tha chehra bhi zakhmon se bhara tha

jahan dono baazu khaak par kat ke gire

abbas mujhe karbala...

abbas mujhe karbala...

shaah pahunche thay jahan khaak par gir gir kar

dil kitna pareshan hai abbas se bolo

items.title: Haal Kya Ho Gaya Sakina Ka
items.body:
Sakina….
Main Sakina Hoon Dekhiye Baba,
Haal Kya Ho Gaya Sakina Ka,
Jab Se Utha Hai Aap Ka Saaya,
Haal Kya Ho Gaya Sakina Ka..
1) Mere Rukhsaron Ki Tarha Itne,
Zakhmi Rukhsar Jo Tumhare Hai’n,
Meri Tarha Tumhein Bhi Zalimo Ne,
Haaye Kitne Tamache Mare Hai’n,
Haal Kya Ho Gaya Tera Baba,
Haal Kya Ho Gaya Sakina Ka..
2) Jab Huye Zibha Aap Maqtal Mein,
Mar Gayi Thi Mai Jeete Jee Usdin,
Aap Ke Baad Sham Tak Chal Kar,
Zinda Aa Jana Kab Yeh Tha Mumkin,
Chal Ke Aaya Hai Yeh Mera Lasha,
Haal Kya Ho Gaya Sakina Ka..
3) Kya Batau’n Tumhari Beti Ko,
Shaam Mein Shimr Kaise Laya Hai,
Kabhi Ghodo’n Ke Saath Daudaya,
Aur Kabhi Naaqe Se Giraya Hai,
Choor Zakhmo Se Hai Badan Saara,
Haal Kya Ho Gaya Sakina Ka..
4) Jaise Baloon Se Sar Tera Pakda,
Waise Baalo’n Se Mujh Ko Pakda Gaya,
Haath Rangeen Jo Tere Khoon Se The,
Unhi Haatho’n Se Mujh Ko Jakda Gaya,
Shimr Aise Mujhe Satata Raha,
Haal Kya Ho Gaya Sakina Ka..
5) Tang Rasi Mein Tha Gala Mera,
Bolti Hoon Tu Bola Jata Nahi,
Pyaas Se Khushk Thi’n Rage’n Pehle,
Ab Ghuttan Hai Keh Saans Aata Nahi,
Hai Abhi Tak Mera Gala Dukhta,
Haal Kya Ho Gaya Sakina Ka..
6) Pusht Par Neel Taziyano Ke,
Kaise Baba Tujhe Dikhau’n Mai’n,
Aur Shano Pe Zakhm Naizo’n Ke,
Kitne Hai’n Baba Kya Bataau’n Mai’n,
Zalimo Ne Mujhe Bohat Maara,
Haal Kya Ho Gaya Sakina Ka..
7) Zakhmi Rukhsaro’n Par Mere Jis Dam,
Phuphi Amma Ke Ashk Girte Hai’n,
God Se Unn Ki Uth Ke Dekhti Hoo’n,
Ro Ke Sajjad Sar Ko Peet Te Hai’n,
Kehti Hai’n Jab Yeh Zainab-E-Kubra,
Haal Kya Ho Gaya Sakina Ka..
8) Chup Hui Beti Haye Joun-O-Asad,
Baap Ke Sar Ko Dukh Sunate Huwe,
Uth Ke Bolo Yeh Ro Ke Kehti Thi,
Zakhmi Beti Ko Maa Hilate Huwe,
Bhai Lasha Utha Ke Kehta Tha,
Haal Kya Ho Gaya Sakina Ka..

items.title: Lutkar watan me aana Zainab ke dil se pucho
items.body:
Lutkar watan me aana zainab Ke dil se poocho,
Nana se kuch Bataan (2) zainab Ke dil se poocho.
1) jab rauza e nabi par saidaaniya gayi thi,zainab tadap tadap Kar ye bain Kar rahi thi (2)
Nana madeeney aana (2) zainab Ke dil se poocho.
2) Nana layee hamaarey durrey lagaa rahey they, Bey waarison ki tarha dar dar phiraa rahey they (2)
Dar dar ki thokar khaana(2) zainab Ke dil se poocho.
3) naizey pey Sar aqee ka aansuu bahaa rahaa tha, Nana sakina ko jab zaalim sataa rahaa tha (2)
Uska bhilakke Rona (2) zainab Ke dil se poocho.
4) koofa wohi tha Nana jisme rahi thi shaahi,log humpey has rahey they yuu aagayi tabaahi (2)
Aabid ka Sar jhukaana (2) zainab Ke dil se poocho.
5) bhai they aur na betey saaya tha barchiyon ka, hum Sar khuley khadey they majmaa tha haajiyon ka (2)
Qutbaa wahaa sunaana (2) zainab Ke dil se poocho.
6) paani dikhaa dikhaa Kar zaalim bahaa rahey they, Har ek qadam pey aada humko sataa rahey they (2)
Abbas ka na Hona (2) zainab Ke dil se poocho.
7) ek doosrey ko zaalim Nana bataa rahey they, ye hai ali ki beti sab ko dikhaa rahey they (2)
Baalon se moo chupaana (2) zainab Ke dil se poocho.
8) taqvi lehad se aayi aawaaz meri jaayi,Sab sun raha hai Nana zainab Teri duhaayi (2)
Qabr e nabi ka hilnaa (2) zainab Ke dil se poocho

items.title: Abbas Mujhko Chhor Ke
items.body:
Thame hue kamar ko ye shabbir ne kaha.
Abbas mujh ko chhor ke tu bhi chala gaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sb qatal ho gaye mera koi nhi bacha
Abbas mujh ko chhor ke tu bhi chla gaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
1)
Pahuche jari ki laash pe maqtal me jab hussain.
Zanu pe sar ko rakh ke ye karte the roke Bain.
Kis ke sahare ab me jiyunga bhala bata.
<<DIVIDER>>
2)
Ankho me teer teri laga hai mere diler.
Aa khoon saaf krdun me ankho se teri sher
Ghash kha rhe the kehte hue yeh shahe karabala.
<<DIVIDER>>
3)
Tha zalimo ke dil me aye Abbas tera dar.
Mujh par na koi uthti thi Abbas bad nazar
Uth kr ye dekh haste hain ab mujh pe Ashkiya’n.
<<DIVIDER>>
4)
Abbas tere jaane se zainab ka hai ye haal
Chadar ko apni dekh ke hoti hai wo nidhal
Kehti hai kis tarha se jiyungi me ba wafa.
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Bali sakina krti hai khaime me intezar.
kya dun use jawab bata de ye ek baar.
mar jayegi sunegi ye jis waqt ghum zada.
<<DIVIDER>>
6)
Tukde jari ki laash ke sheh ne samet kar.
Rakhe the Ek chatai me thame hue jigar.
Bazu ko leke goud me kehte the barha’n.
<<DIVIDER>>
7)
Shane utha ke apne dilawar ke khaq se.
Dil se kabhi lagaye kabhi choomne lge.
Or bazuo se kehne lage ye shahe huda.
<<DIVIDER>>
8)
Johar bayan kese ho mola ka halezar.
‘Haider’ ‘Ali’ yeh kehte the Sheh Hoke Beqarar
Mere liye yeh dagh hai Bhai Boht bada

items.title: Ao ghazi hamari nusrat ko
items.body:
Ao Ghazi hamari nusrat ko
Roke kehti thi zainabe muztar
Deraha hai sada ye Sara ghar
Ao Ghazi hamari nusrat ko
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Tere Marne se ay mere Ghazi
Hogae dar badar ye shahzadi
Chini aada ne hai meri chadar
Roke kehti thi zainabe muztar
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Run me akbar gaya tha JAB ladne
Dekhte jao mujh ko mud mud ke
Kehrahe thae jawab se ye sarwar
Roke kehti thi zainabe muztar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ali Akbar ne khaye Hi barchi
Sona Akbar ka hogaya chalni
Tha xayefi me dagh ye dil per
Roke kehti thi zainabe muztar
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Jab gala kat raha tha bhai ka
Maine dekha tha ghaur se Bhaiya
Ek tera Hi nam tha lab per
Roke kehti thi zainabe muztar
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Hum ko darbar me bhi jana hai
Wada bhai se tha nibhana hai
Sar khule kaise jayegi khwahar
Roke kehti thi zainabe muztar
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Hai bachi tadap ke roti hai
Jagti Hi wo aur na soti hai
Shimr ke taaziyane khaane per
Roke kehti thi zainabe muztar
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Hum to dar dar phiraye jaate hain
Roye to taaziyane khaate hain
Zulm uthaye har ek manzil per
Roke kehti thi zainabe muztar
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Hashmi JAB gala kata sheh ka
Qaak udati thi dast me zahra
Qun rulata hai qun bhara manzar
Roke kehti thi zainabe muztar

items.title: Bachche unto se gir gir ke
items.body:
BACHCHE OONTO SE GIR GIR KE MARTE RAHE SABR KARTI RAHI.
ZULM ZAINAB PE HAR GAAM HOTE RAHE SABR KARTI RAHI.
HATHKADI BEDIYO ME THA JAKDA HUWA SHAAH KA LAADLA.
AABIDE KHASTA TAN JAAN KHOTE RAHE SABR KARTI RAHI.
GHAIR HAALAT THI CHAL CHAL KE BEEMAAR KI.
RAAH PURKHAAR THI TAAZIYANE BHATIJE k LAGTE RAHE SABR KARTI RAHI.
4 SAALA SAKINA THI LAAGHAR BAHOT AUR MUZTAR BAHOT.
HAR GHADI USKO ZAALIM RULATE RAHE SABR KARTI RAHI.
QAFELA SHAAH KA AAGE BADHTA RAHA ZULM HOTA RAHA.
BIBIYO.N KO SITAMGAR SATATE RAHE SABR KARTI RAHI.
PAHONCHI DARBAR ME SAR KHULE BIBIYA.N THI QAYAMAT AYAA.N.
SAR KHULE AALE ATHAAR ROTE RAHE SABR KARTI RAHI.
YE ROQAYYA YE ZAINAB YE KULSUM HAIN SHAH KE MAGHMUM HAIN.
NAAM LEKAR SITAMGAR BATATE RAHE SABR KARTI RAHI.
QAID ZINDAA.N ME AHLE HARAM HO GAYE JANNATO.N KE PALE.
JAAM ASHKO.N KE SAADAAT PITE RAHE SABR KARTI RAHI.
YAAD ASGHAR SAKINA KO AATE RAHE KHU.N RULATE RAHE
GHAM SAKINA KO LORI SUNATE RAHE SABR KARTI RAHI.
YE AZIM O SHAJAR GHAM KI RUDAAD HAI WAQTE FARIYAD HAI.
ZULM ZAINAB PE BE PEER DHATE RAHE SABR KARTI RAHI.

items.title: Chala gaya abbas
items.body:

items.title: Haal Sunaawan Aai Haan
items.body:
Tere Baad Kivein Pai Nibhdi Hai,
Tainu Haal Sunaawan Aayi Haan
Teri Qabr Ko Aakhri Waari Ajj
Gul Baba Laawan Aayi Haan
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu Pyo Hain Je Kar Maa Hondi,
Tainu Apne Zakhm Dikhaawan Haa
Tainu Zakhm Dikha Ta Na Sakdi,
Par Zakhm Dasaawan Aayi Haan
<<DIVIDER>>
Chalo Mendi Khair Hai Ae Baba,
Tendi Tehreer Te Hansde Han
Teri Qabr Ch Teri Sanad Wale
Tukde Dafnaawan Aayi Haan
<<DIVIDER>>
Jihde Dar Te Baba Rukda Hain,
Othon Bha Da Sek Nahi Vinda
Oh Sek Hai Mendi Chadar Tain,
Tathir Dikhaawan Aayi Haan
<<DIVIDER>>
Jadon Dar Aaya Main Ujri Te,
Mede Hathaan Te Mera Mohsin Hae
Ohnade Main Ton Pehle Saah Muk Gaye,
Ohnda Sog Manaawan Aayi Haan
<<DIVIDER>>
Hasnain De Paase Dekh Kar,
Eh Mainu Talwar Dikhaunde Han
Dithi Maqtal Gah Darbaar De Wich,
Tainu Tu Parachaawan Aayi Haan
<<DIVIDER>>
Hik Sanad Bia Bha Dar Wali,
Bia Zakhmi Paasa Te Rassiyan
Baba Teri Qabr Te Ummatiyan De
Ehsaan Ginnaawan Aayi Haan
<<DIVIDER>>
Aakhe Kazim Zahra Jaandi Haan,
Mainu Qabr Di Ja Ethe Nahi Milni
Par Qabr Di Ja Tere Rozay Wich,
Baba Rakhwaawan Aayi Haan
<<DIVIDER>>
(Kazim Hussain Kazim)
items.author: Kazim Hussain Kazim

items.title: Haye Abbas Ko Larne Ki Ijazat Na Mili
items.body:
Haye abbas ko ladhne ki ijazat naa mili.
Jung ki arzoo sine me tadhapti hi rahi.
1.Bhagne ka na layi no pe bhi rasta bachta.
Ek bhi dushmane shabbir na zinda bachta.
Gazi bawafa sabr e karbala sabka hausla ibne Murtaza.
Hukme shabbir se majbur rahi tegh e jari.
2.Samne sani e zahra ke main sharminda hu.
Mar gaye aun o mohd main abhi zinda hu.
Gazi bawafa sabr e karbala sabka hausla ibne Murtaza.
Sar jhukaye hue abbas ne yeh baat kahi.
3.Mashq jab chhid gayi har shaks yehi kehta tha. Mashq ke saath se ghazi ka lahu behta tha.
Sakina ka jo bada maan tha sakina se woh sharam saar tha.
Kaise bin hath ke maqtal me gira sher e ali.
4.Aakhri waqt hai kehte hai yeh shahe abrar.
Bhai abbas hume bhai to kehdo ek bar.
Gazi bawafa sabr e karbala sabka hausla ibne Murtaza.
Ungliya phir gayi aaya jo zuba per bhai.
5.Haye woh waqt sakina ke chhine jab
gauhar.
Haye woh waqt ke lagte the tamache muh
per.
Sakina ka jo bada maan tha sakina se woh sharam saar tha.
Yaad aati thi sakina ko bht ghazi ki.
6.Aye qamar shame ghariba me the abbas nahi.
Kaha us waqt sakina ne mujhe pyas nahi.
Sakina ka jo bada maan tha sakina se woh sharam saar tha.
Chahiye pani ke daman me hai ab aag lagi...

items.body:

items.title: Kya kare zainab
items.body:
shaam e ghariban shaam e ghariban

items.title: Apna akbar de diya allahu akbar ke liye
items.body:
Apna akbar dediya allah ho akbar ke liye
Imteha tha sakht ye mazloom e sarwar ke kiye
1) Umme laila se koi kahede kaleja thamle
horahi hai barchiya tayyar akbar ke liye
2) Baap ko kaise dikhaye sine mei barchi ka phal
marhala tha sakht ye maqtal mei akbar ke liye
3) Koi ab zainab se puche kya hai hum shakle nabi
kitne bchcho ko kiya qurban akbar ke liye
4) Teen phal ka teer jo khaya to bachcha has diya
ek khilona chahiye tha pyase asgar ke liye
5) Khana kaba jo pukara shukriya tera hussain
apna akbar dediya allah ho akbar ke liye
6) Sahibealam padho noha reza ne jo likha
Hai ye abbas marham khatoon e mehshar ke liye
Apna akbar dediya allahu akbar ke liye

items.title: Horaha Hai Hussain (as) Ka Chehlum
items.body:
Horaha hai Hussain(as) ka chehlum,
Qalb-e-Zehra(sa) ke chain ka chehlum.
1) Zulm har ek uthaayi hai Zainab(sa),
Wada karke nibhaayi hai Zainab(sa),
Qaid khaane se aayi hai Zainab(sa).
Horaha hai Hussain(as) ka chehlum
Qalb-e-Zehra(sa) ke chain ka chehlum.
2) Shaahe waala ke jaan nisaaroun ka,
Chashm-e-Zainab(sa) tere sitaaroun ka,
Pursa dena hai gham ke maaroun ka.
Horaha hai Hussain(as) ka chehlum,
Qalb-e-Zehra(sa) ke chain ka chehlum.
3) Sab azadaar-e-Shaahe Karbobala,
Bibi Kubra(sa) ko dete hain pursa,
Bhaiyon ka pidar ka waali ka.
Horaha hai Hussain(as) ka Chehlum,
Qalb e-Zehra(sa) ke chain ka chehlum.
4) Hashr ek Karbala me hai barpa,
Haaye kaisa sitam ye dhaaya gaya,
Ghum zada Fatima(s.a) ka hai kunba.
Horaha hai Hussain(as) ka chehlum,
Qalb-e-Zehra(sa) ke chain ka chehlum.
5) Asghar-e-bezubaan ka maatam hai,
Akbar- e-noujawan ka maatam hai,
Aur Shahe dojahaan ka maatam hai.
Horaha hai Hussain(as) ka chehlum
Qalb - e- Zehra(sa) ke chain ka chehlum.
6) Aal-e-Ahmed(saws) hai aaj maatam me,
Doobi hai kayenaat is ghum me,
Goonjti hai sada ye aalam me.
Horaha hai Hussain(as) ka chehlum,
Qalb-e-Zehra(sa) ke chain ka chehlum.
(7) Kya qayamat ka dekho manzar hai,
Qabr -e- Sarwar(a.s) pa ek mehshar hai,
Nouhagar Fatima(sa) ki dukhtar hai.
Horaha hai Hussain (as) ka chehlum.
Qalb-e-Zehra(sa) ke chain ka chehlum.
8) Bain karti hain Zainab-e-muztar,
Ek qayamat guzar gayi hum par,
Margayi qaid me teri dukhtar.
Horaha hai Hussain(as) ka chehlum,
Qalb-e-Zehra(sa) ke chain ka chehlum.
9) Umme Kulsoom(sa) hai bohot muztar,
Qabr-e-Abbas(as) par hai nouhagar,
Kehti hai Ghazi se ye ro ro kar.
Horaha hai Hussain(as) ka chehlum,
Qalb-e-Zehra(sa) ke chain ka chehlum.
10) Saath kunbe ke darbadar phir kar,
Leke soughaat aayi hai khwahar,
Ab nishaan-e-rasan hain baazu par.
Horaha hai Hussain(as) ka chehlum,
Qalb-e-Zehra(sa) ke chain ka chehlum.
11) Hai dua ye laboun pe 'Sahil' ke,
Aye Khuda hum ko din wo dikhlaaye,
Nouha 'Hasnain' Karbala me padhe
Horaha hai Hussain(as) ka chehlum,
Qalbe-Zehra(sa) ke chain ka chehlum.

thay yahin par ek rassi mein bandhe baara gale
ye ali ki betiyan hai thi munadi ki nida
ahle aza tum jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
nayyar o aamir ki hai tum se guzarish zaairon
ho sake to ek yateema ke liye lekar chalo
nanhi si do baliyan aur ek choti si rida
ahle aza tum jab...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Kaash tumko neend
items.body:
baba ki pyari sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam e ghariban hai ye sakina
kaash tum ko neend aa jaaye
<<DIVIDER>>
be-sar padar ka ban mein tha nauha
kaash tum ko neend aa jaaye
<<DIVIDER>>
pathar badan se hataun to kaise
lori tumhe mai sunaun to kaise
pehlu mein soja ay shaahzadi
seene pe tum ko sulaun to kaise
teeron bhara hai bistar tumhara
kaash tum ko neend aa jaaye
shaam e ghariban hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
baysheer wapas jo aaya nahi hai
maine tumhe ye bataya nahi hai
lori sunayi hai teeron ne usko
asghar ko maine sulaya nahi hai
tum ko to lori dete hai baba
kaash tum ko neend aa jaaye
shaam e ghariban hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
us waqt mujhpe bhi mushkil badi thi
pehlu mein maadar ke sota tha mai bhi
mai jaanta hoon ye mushkil hai kitna
bichdi thi jab mujhse dadi tumhari
mere liye bhi kehti thi zehra
kaash tum ko neend aa jaaye
shaam e ghariban hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
har taur khud ko sambhalegi zainab
go tum jo royi to royegi zainab
tum bhi samajhti ho phir bhi kahunga
gar tum na soyi to jaagegi zainab
zainab ki khaatir so jao beta
kaash tum ko neend aa jaaye
shaam e ghariban hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo dekho kuch door soye hai akbar
aun o mohamed hai soye wahan par
aadat hai pehre mein sone ki tumko
bibi muhafiz hai poore bahattar
charon taraf hai laashon ka pehra
kaash tum ko neend aa jaaye
shaam e ghariban hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek dher hai patharon ka zameen par
baithi ek bibi jis ke barabar
aulaad ke gham mein doobe padar ki
aati hai jis se sadayein ye akbar
jaagogi kab tak meri sakina
kaash tum ko neend aa jaaye
shaam e ghariban hai...
items.author: Hasnain Akbar

items.title: Khamosh hai alqama
items.body:
khamosh hai alqama ki mauje
faza may bhi maut ka samaa hai
rida-e-zainab tera mohafiz
ukhadti saanso ke darmiyan hai
khamosh hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
hawa'on ke rukh badal rahe hai
qayaam darya se hat rahe hai
kisi ke teywar bata rahe hai
ke toot padne ko aasman hai
khamosh hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
sitam ki paykaan to kheynch lenge
hussain chashm-e-jari se lekin
khalish ka ek teer aur bhi hai
jo qalb-e-abbas may nihaan hai
khamosh hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
sakina bibi ki tashnagi ka
jigar pe ab tak hai daagh baaqi
wahin wahin mashk bhi milegi
alam jari ka jahan jahan hai
khamosh hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
ba chashm-e-purnam ba-waqte rehlat
ali ne jin baazu'on ko chooma
kahin wo baazu qalam huye hai
kahin pe in may reesma hai
khamosh hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
lahoo lahoo paykar e tamanna
qareeb mashkeeza e sakina
gira hai rehwaar se wo aise
kahin pe baazu kahin nishan hai
khamosh hai…
items.author: Shahid Jafer

items.title: Kya mai yateem
items.body:
kyun mujhpe sitam dhaane laga shimr e sitamgar
kya mai yateem hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein sakina ye buka karti thi ro kar
kya mai yateem hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
khaata hi nahi rehm ghareebon pe zara bhi
durre wo lagata hai kabhi deta ghudki
reh reh ke mujhe hota hai ehsaas yahan par
kya mai yateem hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
dam ghut'ta hai is zulm ke mahol se mera
yaad aati hai baba ki to phat'ta hai kaleja
sone ke liye mujhko mila khaak ka bistar
kya mai yateem hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad bhi seene se lagate hai ye keh kar
ab laut ke aayenge nahi baba kabhi ghar
is baat pe chalte hai mere qalb pe khanjar
kya mai yateem hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas itna bata dijiye mujhko phuphi amma
kab tak mujhe is dasht mein rehna hai hirasan
baba ko sada deti hoo aate nahi kyun kar
kya mai yateem hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
bikhre huwe laashe hai bayaban mein har soo
is dasht mein kyun chod gaye hai mujhe ammu
kyun nahi leta koi khabar bhi meri aa kar
kya mai yateem hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
amma mujhe aaghosh mein tum apni chupa lo
kuch dayr to pehlu mein zara mujhko sula lo
mai jaagti rehti hoon to rehta hai yehi darr
kya mai yateem hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay baba kahan ho mai tumhe dhoond rahi hoon
har laash ko baba ki samajh kar mai giri hoon
patthar se kabhi laashon se khaati hoon thokar
kya mai yateem hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
bin baap ki bacchi ki fughan safdar o mazhar
ek marsiya lagne lagi qirtaas pe aa kar
jab khaak udaate huwe kehti thi wo muztar
kya mai yateem hoon...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Aagayi shaam ki nagri
items.body:
aagayi shaam ki nagri may khule sar zainab
maangti reh gayi ek ek se chadar zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
is liye zaalimon ne aur bhi pathar maare
jaante thay ke hai abbas ki khaahar zainab
aagayi shaam ki nagri may...
<<DIVIDER>>
karwatein lene lagi laashe hussain ibne ali
bhai ki laash pe aayi jo khule sar zainab
aagayi shaam ki nagri may...
<<DIVIDER>>
band ho jaati thi khud naize pe chashme abbas
jab nazar aati thi naaqe pe khule sar zainab
aagayi shaam ki nagri may...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad aa jaati thi us waqt usay nana ki
naize pe dekhti thi jab sar e akbar zainab
aagayi shaam ki nagri may...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhko chadar na di kam zarf musalmano ne
gard ne daal di sar par tere chadar zainab
aagayi shaam ki nagri may...
<<DIVIDER>>
thi sar e shaam e ghariban wo misaale zehra
ban gayi shaam ke darbar may hyder zainab
aagayi shaam ki nagri may...
<<DIVIDER>>
haal ye tha ke na pehchana usay shauhar ne
shaam ki qaid se aayi jo palat kar zainab
aagayi shaam ki nagri may...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro diya kufe ke darbar may majid mukhtar
sar e darbar sitamgar thi khule sar zainab
aagayi shaam ki nagri may...

items.title: Ab koi ghar koi
items.body:
ab koi ghar koi takiya na bichona hoga
aaj ke baad tujhe khaak pe sona hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ke seene pe sone ki tujhe aadat thi
ab muqaddar may tere hogi zameen maqtal ki
shiddate pyaas may ashkon ko hi peena hoga
aaj ke baad tujhe...
ab koi ghar koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab sitamgaar ke taano pe guzar hoga tera
shimr e be-deen ke tamachon pe guzar hoga tera
odh ke qaid ke andhiyaron ko sona hoga
aaj ke baad tujhe...
ab koi ghar koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
taziyano ki aziyat hi ghiza howegi
ek din saare aseeron se juda howegi
ek alag qaid ki tanhaai may rona hoga
aaj ke baad tujhe...
ab koi ghar koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi aahat bhi sunegi to lagega aise
ek yateema ko bulaya ho padar ne jaise
chain aaram sukoon sab kuch hi khona hoga
aaj ke baad tujhe...
ab koi ghar koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
loriyan maut sunayegi kabhi khauf tujhe
ek ek saans saza hogi meri furqat se
tujko ab chehra bhi ashkon se hi dhona hoga
aaj ke baad tujhe...
ab koi ghar koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham ki badli may muqaddar ka sitara hoga
baba baba ki sada'on ka sahara hoga
sabr phupiyon ki tarha tujhko bhi karna hoga
aaj ke baad tujhe...
ab koi ghar koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
shadman thi ye wasiyat hi shahe waala ki
jisko likhte huwe mazhar ki bandhi hai hichki
bas yehi keh ke chale rona hi rona hoga
aaj ke baad tujhe...
ab koi ghar koi...

items.body:
abbas na laute sheh aagaye mashk aagayi
maqtal ki zameen bha gayi abbas na laute
abbas na laute...

is shaan se maqtal ko sidhara tha alamdaar
aada ki nazar khaa gayi abbas na laute
abbas na laute...

jab teer chala beh gaya sab mashk se pani
abbas ko sharm aagayi abbas na laute
abbas na laute...

rone ke liye laasha e shabbir pe ran may
firdaus se maa aagayi abbas na laute
abbas na laute...

qaimon may lagi aag to ammu ko bulane
masoom sakina gayi abbas na laute
abbas na laute...

had hogayi bhai ko manane labe saahil
khud saani e zehra gayi abbas na laute
abbas na laute...

kya jaaniye kyun rooth gaye kehti thi zainab

abbas na laute...

behta hua kano se lahoo sookhe hue lab

abbas na laute...

deti rahi awaaz pe awaaz sakina
aakhir ko khaza aagayi abbas na laute
abbas na laute...

pani ke liye mashk o alam le ke gaye thay
din dhal gaya raat aagayi abbas na laute

items.title: Ayyuhan naas
items.body:
ayyuhan naas shumara ba haq e khoon e hussain
lehja ee gosh numaya idari shewan o shain
<<DIVIDER>>
ayuhannas tumhe khoon e hussaini ki qasam
kam na ho ranj o alam aur ye shor e matam
<<DIVIDER>>
ye wo matam hai jo zahra o ali karte rahe
asre ashoor ye matam to nabi karte rahe
jab luta fatema zehra ka bhara ghar ran mein
alqama roti thi aur karbobala karti thi bain
ayyuhan naas shumara...
<<DIVIDER>>
shud sakina chu giraftar e ajal dar zindan
na rafeeq e na anees e dam e gham khwaran
mar gayi shaam ke zindan mein sakina ghut kar
dafn ke waqt bhi aaye nahi bhaiya akbar
dil ki hasrat rahi dil mein hi rehaai na mili
khoon bhara kurta kafan ban gaya marqad zindan
ayyuhan naas shumara...
<<DIVIDER>>
murd farzand e jawan khurd seena bar seena
padari sokhta jaan girya kunad wawela
mar gaya saamne athara baras ka beta
haye is umr mein sajta hai saron par sehra
noor aankhon ka gaya thokarein khaate hai hussain
dar e qaima pe khadri roti hai binte zahra
ayyuhan naas shumara...
<<DIVIDER>>
turbat e asghar e masoom ba maidan beeni
bar lehad ashk fishanand hussain ibne ali
ek nanhi si lehad khod ke maidan mein hussain
kehte hai saunpa khuda ko tujhe ay noor e ain
khwab sab aankhon ka paiwand huwe umme rubab
khaali jhoola hua aur kokh tumhari ujdi
ayyuhan naas shumara...
<<DIVIDER>>
rafta shud chadar e zainab sar e bazaar e jafa
seena kobi ba kunan ahle aza wawela
sar e bazar e jafa binte ali be-chadar
bhai athara thay koi na raha sar pe magar
rassiyan qaid e sitam ranj o alam kunbe ka gham
tan ba taqdeer hai is haal mein binte zehra
ayyuhan naas shumara...
<<DIVIDER>>
man na khwaham deegar e zindagi aakhir lashkar
baad e abbas alamdar o ali e akbar
jee ke ab kya kare shabbir ke lashkar na raha
wo alamdar wo abbas e dilawar na raha
asr ka waqt liye jaam e shahadat aaya
rakh diya sajda e mabood mein shabbir ne sar
ayyuhan naas shumara...
<<DIVIDER>>
chashme ma ashk fishan dar ghame shabbir hanooz
man na khwaham ma siwa matame shabbir hanooz
ashk aankhon se nahi thamte hai rehaan kabhi
yaad aa jaata hai jab shaam ka zindan kabhi
jab bhi qirtaas pe mai nauha e shabbir likhun
meri tehreer mein aata hai mere qalb ka soz
ayyuhan naas shumara...

items.title: Bada andhera hai
items.body:
sakina qaid ho kar shaam ke zindan mein jab aayi
wo bacchi us andhere ghar ki tareeki se ghabrayi
muqaddar ne ajab aafat ki pehli raat dikhlayi
zameen to farsh tha saaya fighan tha charkhe meenayi
phupi ke saath rehti thi na maa ke paas soti thi
barehna sar khadi zindan ke darwaze pa roti thi
<<DIVIDER>>
pukari ro ke sakina bada andhera hai
ye kaisi qaid hai baba bada andhera hai
<<DIVIDER>>
main ek kone mein baithi hui hoon sehmi hui
dikhayi kuch nahi deta bada andhera hai
pukari ro ke sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
jigar figaar hai kamsin hai aur akeli hai
na jee sakegi sakina bada andhera hai
pukari ro ke sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhari laadli tanha hai koi paas nahi
madad ko aaiye baba bada andhera hai
pukari ro ke sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
agar ho aana to asghar ko saath mat laana
jahan mai qaid hoon baba bada andhera hai
pukari ro ke sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
tamache lagte hai mere jo dar ke roti hoon
magar mai kya karun baba bada andhera hai
pukari ro ke sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
behan se milne ko aao agar ali akbar
to ek charaagh bhi laana bada andhera hai
pukari ro ke sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
bahot tadapte thay sajjad ye sada sun kar
behan bulaati hai bhaiya bada andhera hai
pukari ro ke sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi charaagh jalane na aa saka haye
pukarti rahi dukhiya bada andhera hai
pukari ro ke sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan ke hai ye musafir shikasta haal o ghareeb
kahan kiya hai basera bada andhera hai
pukari ro ke sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab uska maqbara minaar e noor hai gohar
jo roz karti thi nauha bada andhera hai
pukari ro ke sakina...

naize pe chada hai baap ka sar

zindan mein behen ko maut aayi

kab isko milegi azaadi
zanjeer hai iski faryadi
kab choot ke ghar jaana hoga

kab tauq khulega gardan se
kab khoon rukega gardan se
hai surkh lahoo se uski aba

<<DIVIDER>>
ye likhna suroor aasaan nahi
lagta hai badan mein jaan nahi
tahreer karun kaise mai bhala
beemar bahot takleef...

items.title: Fatema hoo mai
items.body:
ya sayyeda ya tahera ya umme abiha
<<DIVIDER>>
salaam jis ko alaihis salam karte hai
wo fatema hoo mai
jhuk ke hasnain bhi jis se kalaam karte hai
wo fatema hoo mai
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhe hi raaziya marziya sadeeqa kehte hai
mujhe taahira umme abiha kehte hai
wo jiska ahmed bhi ehteraam karte hai
wo fatema hoo mai
salaam jis ko…
<<DIVIDER>>
daleel e haq tera sajda teri jabeen to nahi
tera wajood gumaan hai tera yaqeen to nahi
mai fatema hoo sadaqat ki wo daleel hoo mai
agar mai kehdun khuda hai to hai nahi to nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
bana ke sura e kausar mujhe utaara gaya
mujhe hijaab e muzammil se hai pukara gaya
tazeeem jiski baara imam karte hai
wo fatema hoo mai
salaam jis ko…
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ne aise jahan may mujhe badaayi di
quran ne aayaton se meri hi gawahi di
wo jiske ghar se arshi ta'aam karte hai
wo fatema hoo mai
salaam jis ko…
<<DIVIDER>>

items.title: Kaat Kar bajoo Ko Mara
items.body:
Kaat kar baaju ko maraa Bawafa abbas ko..
Ro Rahi hai Lash par maa fatema abbas ko.
Dono baju kat chuke the aankh me bhi teer tha..
Kis tarah zeeN se giraya bawafa Abbas ko..
Khaime me laaye Alam ko Aur mashkiza chhida..
Nehr se laaye nahi shaahe hoda abbas ko...
Tukde tukde lash zainab ran me hai bikhri hui..
Kar diya paamal dekho ba wafa abbas ko...
Hass ke bola shimr bachhi ko tamacha mar kar..
Dekh le aawaz de ke tu chacha abbas ko..
Jab Gale par shaah ke khanjar chalaya shimr ne..
Zakhmi honthho se di sarwar ne sada abbas ko..
Nauke naiza se ridayeN chhin kar bola laeeN..
Naaz tha tujhko ay zainab jaa bula abbas ko..
Hath me zainab ki chadar aur sakina ke ghohar..
Nehr par aaya Dikhane be haya abbas ko..
Shaam ke bazaar me ghode ki gardan ki taraf
Dekh ker rote rahe Zainul eba Abbas ko..
Asmee o jafar sakina mar gayi zindaan me
Yaad karte karte her lamha chacha Abbas ko..

items.title: Haath kiya sheh ka qalam
items.body:
Haye haye haye husaina
Haye husaina (2)
Kaise bhoole jo kiye ummat-e-aasi ne sitam
Ek anghuti ke liye haath kiya sheh ka qalam (2)
1) Le gaya koi kamar bandh Amama koi
Sar koi le gaya aur jism ka kurta koi
Koi batlaaye sitam kya yeh qayamat se hai kam...
2) Hai musalmaa ke liye doob ke marne maqaam
Be kafan dasht e baya me hai ummat ka imam
Kya bhula dene ke qabil hai yeh sab ranjo alaam...
3) Jiska gehwara jhulaate thay malayak akar
Jis gehwaare se fitroos ko mile baalo par
Jisko kaandho pe bithaate thay'n rasool e akram..
4) zindagi me hi agar maangte sarwar dete
Jholiyaa'n apni jo phailaate use bhar dete
Yeh sakhi vo hai jo rakhte hai sakhawat ka bharam...
5) Chain se zehra ko marqad me bhi sone na diya
Bhai ki laash pe ek behen ko rone na diya
Ummat-e-amad-e-mursal ne kiye kitne sitam...
6)Malkaaye sharmo haya deti thi khaime se sada
Wasta tujh ko muhammad ka laee'n zulm na dha
Phir bhi kata hai sitam gar ne sare shaahe umam..
7) Jisko seene pe sulaate thay rasool e arabi
Laash us bekaso muztar ki na dafnai gai
Gham hai is baat ka phir bhi na hui aankhe nam ...
8) Ek musalmaa ka musalmaano ne laasha luta
Kis liye dhaate ho yeh zulm kisi ne na kaha
Haaye khaamosh rahe sab hi arab ho ke ajam..
9) Jab kata haath toh "Asif yeh kaha zehra na
Kaun se zulm ka badla yeh liya hai mujhse
Keh rahen honge "Taqi" roke rasool-e-akram..

items.title: Haye abbas-e-jari
items.body:
HAAI ABBAS-E-JARI SHERE ALI BHI NA BACHA
ASR-E-AASHOOR KO KHANJARE TALE SHAI KI THI SADA…….
WO SAKHI SHER JARI GHAZI TAMANNA-E-ALI
BANI HAASHIM KA QAMAR BABE HAWAIJ HAI WAHI
WO DUA FATHIMA KI AUR HAI HYDER KI SHABI
SHAI KE LASHKARKA ALAMDAAR WALI IBNE WALI
YAHI ALFAAZ KEHKE HIL RAHE THE ARZO SAMA…
LABE DARIYA PE BHI PYASA HI WAFADAR RAHA
HAAI NAULAAKH  KE NARGE ME ALAMDAAR RAHA
HAATH ME TEER NA SHAMSHEER NA TALWAAR RAHA
MASHQ THI AUR ALAM TANHA ALAMDAAR RAHA
YAAD KARTI HAI WO MANZAR KO ALQAMA KI FIZA….
GAR WO HOTA TO SAKEENA NA TAMACHE KHAATI
GAR WO HOTA TO NA CHINTI THI RIDA ZAINAB KI
GAR WO HOTA TO BIBIYAN NAHI BANTI QAIDI
AUR AULADE ALI PAR NA MUSIBAT PADTI
QAIME JALNE LAGE TO ROKE YE ZAINAB NE KAHA…..
CHIDGAYI MASHKE SAKEENA DONO BAZU BHI KATE
AAB KE SAATH HI ABBAS KE ARMAAN LUTE
HAAI BEDAST HUE ZEEN PE KAISE SAMBHLE
KHOO SE TAR SAARA BADAN KAUN MADAD KO AAYE
THARTHARATI HI RAHI TAB SE ZEENE KARBOBALA…..
JIS GHADI BINTE SHEH KE CHEENE GAYE THE GAUHAR
KAUN DE HAUSLA AB KAUN BACHAYE AAKAR
NEEL RUQSAR HUE GHAM SE TADAPTI MUZTAR
ZULM KARTA THA SHIMR HAAI WO YATEEMA PAR
SAR KO DEEWARO SE TAKRAKE SAKEENA NE KAHA……
HOTE ABBAS TO QAIME NA JALAATA ZAALIM
PYAASE SHABBIR PE QANJAR NA CHALAATA ZAALIM
SHEH KE KUNBE KO RULAATA NA SATAATA ZAALIM
AUR BEEMAR KO DURRE NA LAGATA ZALIM
ROKE DARBAR ME ZAINAB NE BIBIYON SE KAHA…….
HAAI CHALNE LAGI PYASE KE GALE PAR QANJAR
FATHIMA NAUHAKUNA GIRYAKUNA HAI HYDER
QAAK UDAATE THE HASAN RORAHE THE PAIGAMBER
QATM NAUHA HUA ALTHAF –O-AAGHA YE KEHKAR
HOTE ABBAS TO PYAASE KA GALA NA KAT TA……

items.title: Beemare karbala hai
items.body:

6
Lagte hai taazyaane aabid ko har qadam par.

Beemaare karbala hai Beemaare karbala hai.
7
Kar paae na baya'n woh guzri jo unke dil par.

Zainab ka sar khula hai baazaar shaam ka hai.
Beemaare karbala hai Beemaare karbala hai.
8
Zindaane shaam hai or ghanghor hai andhera.
Baaba ko yaad kar ke rukhsat huvi sakena.
Dekar dilaasa sab ko saabir bhi ro raha hai.
Beemaare karbala hai Beemaare karbala hai.
9

SHAHE MARDA SHER E YAZDAAN MAULA

items.title: Ab Nahi Hai Meri Saanso Ka Bharosa Baba
items.body:
```Nauha```
Ab Nahi Hai Meri Saanso, Ka Bharosa Baba,
Jane Kya Hai, Meri Taqdeer Me Likha Baba,
Ab Nahi Hai Meri Saanso, Ka Bharosa Baba,
(1)
Aap Jab Qatal Hue Tab Ye Qayamat Aai,
Chaar Janib Se Ye Yateema Pe Musibat Aai,
Jalte Khaimo Se Jala Hai Mera Kurta Baba,
Ab Nahi Hai Meri Saanso, Ka Bharosa Baba,
(2)
Apne Ammu Ko Bulao Ye Laee Kehta Tha,
Mai Sisakti Thi Mere Kaano Se Khoon Behta Tha,
Shimar Ne Bunddo Ko Iss Tarah Se Khaicha Baba,
Ab Nahi Hai Meri Saanso, Ka Bharosa Baba,
(3)
Jiska Koi Na Rahe Usko Rulata Hai Koi,
Ek Yateema Ko Bhala Durre Lagata Hai Koi,
Pushat Per Ab Bhi Har Ek Zakham Hai Taza Baba,
Ab Nahi Hai Meri Saanso, Ka Bharosa Baba,
(4)
Pushat Per Durre Na Lagte Na Tamache Padte,
Aap Hote To Mere Zakham Pe Merham Rakhte,
Bs Isi Aas Me Ab Tak Hu Main Zinda Baba,
Ab Nahi Hai Meri Saanso, Ka Bharosa Baba,
(5)
Be Kajawa Tha Shutur Jispe Mujhe Bandha Gaya,
Baba Mai Rooti Rahi Jism Mera Chilta Raha,
Hai Mera Sara Badan Khoon Me Duba Baba,
Ab Nahi Hai Meri Saanso, Ka Bharosa Baba,
(6)
Meri Gardan Thi Phuphi Amma Ki Gardan Se Bandhi,
Iss Liye Baba Main Panjo Per Safar Karti Rahi,
Mera Qad Saare Aasiro Me Tha Chota Baba,
Ab Nahi Hai Meri Saanso, Ka Bharosa Baba,
(7)
Sham Pahuchte To Aaseero Ne Ye Manzar Dekha,
Tanz Ke Teer Har Ek Hath Me Patthar Dekha,
Sabne Dekha Meri Gurbat Ka Tamasha Baba,
Ab Nahi Hai Meri Saanso, Ka Bharosa Baba,
(8)
Baith Kar Takhat Per Hasta Tha Khushi Se Zalim,
Aapke Hotho Ko Chuta Tha Dhadhi Se Zalim,
Maine Ye Zulam Bhi Darbar Me Dekha Baba,
Ab Nahi Hai Meri Saanso, Ka Bharosa Baba,
(9)
Tauq Pehne Hue Ek Bekaso Muztar Roya,
Dekhar Suy-e- Falaq Mera Baradar Roya,
Mujhko Zalim Ne Kaneezi Me Jo Manga Baba,
Ab Nahi Hai Meri Saanso, Ka Bharosa Baba,
(10)
Ghudkiya Dete Hai Zindaan Me Aakar Mujhko,
Baba Rone Nahi Dete Hai Sitamgar Mujhko,
Kaise Aankho Me Thame Ashqo Ka Dariya Baba,
Ab Nahi Hai Meri Saanso, Ka Bharosa Baba,
(11)
Kar Ke Humwar Har Ek Reh Guzar Jaugi,
Aise Ek Roz Riha Ho Ke Mai Ghar Jaugi,
Jaise Jata Hai Koi Ghar Ko Parinda Baba,
Ab Nahi Hai Meri Saanso, Ka Bharosa Baba,
(12)
Dekh Leti Main Use Baat Meri Ho Jati,
Kash Sugra Se Mulaqaat Meri Ho Jati,
Yaad Aata Hai Bahut Mujhko Madina Baba,
Ab Nahi Hai Meri Saanso, Ka Bharosa Baba,
(13)
Qabar Ke Jaisa Andhera Hai Ye Zindaan Nahi,
Iss Andhere Se Nikalna Koi Aasan Nahi,
Hai Savere Ke Tasawvur Me Bhi Pehra Baba,
Ab Nahi Hai Meri Saanso, Ka Bharosa Baba,
(14)
Ab To Ammu Bhi Nahi Aas Bhala Kiski Hai,
Peyaas Aisi Hai Ki Taalu Se Zaban Chipki Hai,
Tashnagi Maut Na Ban Jaye Karu Kya Baba,
Ab Nahi Hai Meri Saanso, Ka Bharosa Baba,
(15)
Waqt Darkar Hai Rudaad Sunane Ke Liye,
Rooh Betaab Hai Zindan Basane Ke Liye,
Maine Dekha Hai Abhi Maut Ka Saya Baba,
Ab Nahi Hai Meri Saanso, Ka Bharosa Baba,
(16)
Jisko Pani Na Mila Haye Rahi Tashna Dahen,
Uske Khadim Hai Her Ek Gaam Nawaz Aur Hasan,
Jo Ye Kehti Rahi Zindaan Me Baba Baba,
Ab Nahi Hai Meri Saanso, Ka Bharosa Baba, -2

Rubaru Shere Khuda Ke Koi Ruk Sakta Hai Kab

items.title: Apne shabbir ko seene se lagalo amma
items.body:
Kheti ujad rahi thi shahe mashraqain ki
maida'n se aa rahi thi sada ye hussain ki
apne shabbir ko seene se laga lo amma
arey aao ghode se mai girta hu sambhalo amma
apne shabbir ko seene se laga lo amma..(2)
aao ghode se mai girta hu sambhalo amma
apne shabbir ko seene se laga lo amma..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Amma tumne to bade naazo se paala hai hamein
lad khadate hue chalne mein sambhala hai hamein
aakhri baar kaleje se lagalo amma
apne shabbir ko seene se laga lo amma..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Guthniyo chalta to tum saath mere chalti thi
apni aankho se mere talwo ko tum malti thi
choor zakhmo se hu mai mujhko sambhalo amma
apne shabbir ko seene se laga lo amma..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Mai bohot tanha hu ab koi mujhe aas nahi
dekho akbar nahi qasim nahi abbas nahi
tum najaf se zara baba ko bulalo amma
apne shabbir ko seene se laga lo amma..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Charkh ne aaj sitam kaisa ye dikhlaya
teen din hogaye pani bhi nahi paya hai
jaa balab pyaas se hu jaan bachalo amma
apne shabbir ko seene se laga lo amma..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Aise hai zakhm e badan jaan chali jaati hai
khoon behta hai bohot neend si aajati hai
aake aaghosh mein ab mujhko sulalo amma
apne shabbir ko seene se laga lo amma..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Sehme baccho ko musibat se nikale zainab
mujhpe girya kare ya khudko sambhale zainab
apni beti ka zara haath batalo amma
apne shabbir ko seene se laga lo amma..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Hone wali hai yateema jo sakina amma
asr ke baad se ujdega madina amma
aao ab karbobala aake basalo amma
apne shabbir ko seene se laga lo amma..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Kaise majid mai likhu dard o alam ka manzar
aye jari dasht mein gunji ye sada e sarwar
aao ghode se mai girta hu sambhalo amma
apne shabbir ko seene se laga lo amma..(2)

items.title: Badan se noke naiza tak
items.body:
sar jo cheh maah ke baysheer ka naize pe chada
nok e naiza se ye asghar ki sada aane lagi
<<DIVIDER>>
badan se nok e naiza tak mera sar aa gaya amma
tera asghar bhi ek akbar ke barabar aa gaya amma
<<DIVIDER>>
galay par teer khaaye chain se soya hua tha mai
achanak qabr may naiza utar kar aa gaya amma
badan se nok e naiza tak...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai kuch teer o sina par aur kuch baba ke chehre par
badan may khoon jitna tha wo baahar aa gaya amma
badan se nok e naiza tak...
<<DIVIDER>>
bataye aap ne ye raakh jo pehlu may baandhi hai
mera jhoola bhi kya sholon ki zad par aa gaya amma
badan se nok e naiza tak...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar e bazaar us lamhe bhi tumko sabr karna hai
mere sar ki taraf koi jo pathar aa gaya amma
badan se nok e naiza tak...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhala tum meri masooma behen ko kya batati ho
sakina poochti hogi ke asghar aa gaya amma
badan se nok e naiza tak...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera khoon may bhara kurta liye yasrab chali jaana
samajh lena tumhare saath mai ghar aa gaya amma
badan se nok e naiza tak...
<<DIVIDER>>
ba roze hashr ahsan bas yehi sun'ne ki hasrat
ali asghar kahe mera sukhanwar aa gaya amma
badan se nok e naiza tak...

items.title: Beh raha hai saamne
items.body:
beh rahi hai saamne nehre furaat
mustufa ki aal tishnakaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala mein shaad fauje shaam hai
khatm shahe deen ka sar anjaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
pyas se bache hai shah ke jaan balab
umr ka lab rez unka jaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
khatema bil khair lashkar ka hua
halq pyason ka tahe shamshaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
panjetan ka khatema hota hai aaj
garkh khoon mein kaukab-e-islam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam ke badal mein hai mehve mubeen
hai andhera hashr ka hangam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
haale asghar dekh kar bole adoo
rehm ke khaabil ye tishnakaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hum pilayenge isay pani zaroor
jaan balab afsos ye gulfaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hurmula se phir ye bola naabkaar
sach bata tu taalibe inaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shaah ke haaton pe jo hai bezuban
tashnalab do din se ye gulfaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
chahta hoo mai ye marjaye abhi
tere ek teere sitam ka kaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
waada e tifli bapa hone ko hai
shaah khush hai qalb ko aaram hai

items.title: Chale ho kis pe
items.body:
abbas mere bhai
chale ho kis pe shahe deen ko chod kar abbas

qadam qadam pe rahe saath umr bhar abbas
chale ho kis pe shahe deen ko chod kar abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
ye jaante ho sakina ka haal kya hoga
palat ke aaye na darya se tum agar abbas
chale ho kis pe...

koi hai nauha kuna aur koi tadapta hai
bana hai dard ki tasweer ghar ka ghar abbas
chale ho kis pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
na jaane kya hua saakit hai bolti hi nahi
palat ke dekhlo zainab ko ek nazar abbas
chale ho kis pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
khabar na hogi tumhe tum to so rahe honge
jab hogi zainab e dilgeer dar badar abbas
chale ho kis pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
gaye jo tum suye maqtal zuban se kuch na kaha
khade na reh sake sibte nabi magar abbas
chale ho kis pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
raha na ek bhi suraj hussain ke ghar mein
na hogi shaam e ghariban ki ab sahar abbas
chale ho kis pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare baad jo hona tha wo hua aakhir
hussain mar gaye zainab hai nange sar abbas
chale ho kis pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
wafa shiyaron mein hashim ka naam aajaye
bas ek nazre karam mujhpe ho agar abbas
chale ho kis pe...

items.title: Dhoondti phirti hai
items.body:
dhoondti phirti hai zainab laashon mein abbas ko
karti hai mehsoos ro ke aahon mein abbas ko
<<DIVIDER>>
fikr hai maqtal mein zainab ko faqat laahaq yehi
rassiyan aaye nazar na baahon mein abbas ko
dhoondti phirti hai zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
maangne wapas zamanat chadaron ki aagayi
dekha hai jab barchiyon ki chaaon mein abbas ko
dhoondti phirti hai zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha bin baazuon ka laasha bhoolegi behan
ke jawan hote hai dekha haathon mein abbas ko
dhoondti phirti hai zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
zikr apno se bichadne ka kahin bhi gar hua
le hi aati thi wo dukhiya baaton mein abbas ko
dhoondti phirti hai zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
gir hi jaata hai sina ki nok se har baar sar
be-rida sar jab dikha hai raahon mein abbas ko
dhoondti phirti hai zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo wafayein jaanti hai hai dilon mein ba-khuda
bandagi ka rutba haasil maaon mein abbas ko
dhoondti phirti hai zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
qalb e zainab hi salamat jaanta hai kis tarha
laut aayi hai wo lekar yaadon mein abbas ko
dhoondti phirti hai zainab...

items.title: Fatema kehti thi
items.body:
roti rahi hai sayyeda karti rahi aah o buka
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema kehti hai mai roti thi chillaati thi
haye mai khanjar e qatil se lipat jaati thi
<<DIVIDER>>
mere husain ka zakhmon se bhar chuka tha badan
khareeb hi dare qaime pe ro rahi thi behan
meri fughan se larazne laga tha saara ban
juda hussain ki gardan jo hui jaati thi
haye mai khanjar e qatil...
<<DIVIDER>>
gira tha ghode se jis dam wo mera laqte jigar
utha ke godh mein rakha tha maine uska sar
giraati jaati thi aansu mai uske honton par
wo pyaas taygh talay aur badi jaati thi
haye mai khanjar e qatil...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai ro ke kehti thi zaalim se zulm ke baani
agar hai dil mein zara sa bhi dard e insani
ba waqte zibhe to de de husain ko pani
nabi ka waasta de de ke mai samjhati thi
haye mai khanjar e qatil...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai boli laashe uthaata raha hai ye din bhar
jawan bhai ke gham mein jhuki hui hai kamar
kadi hai dhoop udha de usay koi chadar
mai baal khole huwe dasht mein chillaati thi
haye mai khanjar e qatil...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi jo karbobala jao mesum o rehaan
tumhare kaano mein aayegi ek sada har aan
ghareeb maa teri ghurbat pe sabr par qurban
mai kuch na kar saki bas itna hi kar paati thi
haye mai khanjar e qatil...

items.title: Haaton may rasiyan
items.body:
haaton may rasiyan hai sar par rida nahi hai
zainab tera muhafiz abbas kya nahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
dharne ki til jagah hai bazaar may bhala kab
apni musibaton ko tu jaane ya tera rab
abbas ka sina par sar thayrta nahi hai
haaton may rasiyan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah se ahad ko tune bhi hai nibhana
in shamiyon ke haaton se uska deen bachana
tera hai aur kisi ka ye hausla nahi hai
haaton may rasiyan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mumkin agar hai bibi kuch aur sar jhuka le
chadar to ye na denge balon se moo chupa le
koi sadayein sunle ye wo jagah nahi hai
haaton may rasiyan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
parwardigar tujhpar nazrein jamaye hoga
qadmon may tere apna taaba bichaye hoga
tujhsa siwaye tere koi doosra nahi hai
haaton may rasiyan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
nana ke deen ki bibi tauqeer tu badha de
himmat se hausle se mushkil ghadi bata de
uska tere siwaye mushkil kusha nahi hai
haaton may rasiyan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab khadija saani zainab hi zehra saani
wo jaan bhaiyon ki wo noore aasmani
paband hai ahad ki be-aasra nahi hai
haaton may rasiyan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek taraf se hogi barsaat patharon ki
lekin hai jeet sar ki aur maut patharon ki
hai ya hussain lab par lab par dua nahi hai
haaton may rasiyan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ki maa ka daaman khulne se tu bachana
aabad raakh se hai uska wo ashiyana
muddat se uska beta us'se mila nahi hai
haaton may rasiyan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
abid ye paak bibi hi hai khuda ka parda
mumkin nahi hai isko chashme na jisne dekha
ye kya hai rab hi jaane mujhko pata nahi hai
haaton may rasiyan hai...

khat bhi hamsheer ka bhai ko sunane na diya
itna mauqa ali akbar ko...

baap sharminda hai is aalame ghurbat ne mujhe
chand khatre tujhe pani bhi pilane na diya
itna mauqa ali akbar ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
lag gayi maut ki bhar poor jawani mein nazar
haye taqdeer ne sehra bhi sajane na diya
itna mauqa ali akbar ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
maut se sirf rahega ye gila akbar ko
jo tha sughra se wo waada bhi nibhane na diya
itna mauqa ali akbar ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise uthega zaeefi mein janaza uska
baap ko jisne kabhi ranj uthane na diya
itna mauqa ali akbar ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
lag gaya chand ko laila ke gehen maqtal mein
maa ke armaano ko parwaan chadhane na diya
itna mauqa ali akbar ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
keh ke roti thi yehi aamir o akhtar ek maa
kaun sa zakhm mujhe karbobala ne na diya
itna mauqa ali akbar ko...

items.title: Jab zehr ka imame
items.body:
jab zehr ka imame hassan par asar hua
khoone jigar se daaware didar batar hua

jodha tujhe imam pa dhaate huwe sitam
khaufe khuda hua na zamane ka darr hua
jab zehr ka imame...

aankhon se ashk behne lage kaayenat ki
aalam ghame imam mein zer o zabr hua
jab zehr ka imame...
<<DIVIDER>>
farshe zameen pa baith ke rone lage hussain
bhai ke saath ek safar muqtasar hua
jab zehr ka imame...
<<DIVIDER>>
larza thi qabr haye nabi o batool ki
dunya se jab imame hassan ka safar hua
jab zehr ka imame...
<<DIVIDER>>
barse hai teer haye janaze pe aap ke
ye ek aur taaza sitam aap par hua
jab zehr ka imame...
<<DIVIDER>>
tukde gire hilal bahattar jo tasht mein
aaghaz e karbala se jahan ba-khabar hua
jab zehr ka imame...

items.body:
tha shaam ke zindan mein sakina ka ye nauha
kab aaoge baba
ab aur kahan tak mujhe rulwaoge baba
kab aaoge baba

ab bhi na khabar li to mai zinda na rahungi
mai bach na sakungi
dil kaampta hai dekh ke zindan ka andhera
kab aaoge baba
tha shaam ke zindan...

ek raat bhi mai chain se sone nahi paayi
ammu hai na bhai
phat jaye kahin shiddat e gham se na kaleja
kab aaoge baba
tha shaam ke zindan...

bhaiya ali akbar hai na qasim hai na ammu
roothe hai ye sab kyun
chillaati hoo ro ro ke koi bhi nahi aata
kab aaoge baba
tha shaam ke zindan...

ab mera muqaddar hai yehi khaak pe sona
takiya na bichona
sone ke liye aap ka seena na milega
kab aaoge baba
tha shaam ke zindan...

mai kaise yaqeen karloo ke faryad ye meri
tum tak nahi pahunchi
sunte rahe aur haal bhi mera nahi poocha
kab aaoge baba
tha shaam ke zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-parda phiraye gaye bazaaron mein jis dam
kyun mar na gaye hum
har gaam pe maine tumhe ro ro ke pukara
kab aaoge baba
tha shaam ke zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ko bulaade koi ghut'ta hai mera dam
hai waqt bahot kam
bekas ki to faryad bhi koi nahi sunta
kab aaoge baba
tha shaam ke zindan...

items.title: Kya yateemi hai
items.body:
haye jab shaam e ghariban ka andhera chaaya
dhoondne baap ko maqtal may gayi ek dukhiya
darmiyan laashon ke ek laasha e besar dekha
aayi us laash se awaaz sakina aaja
jab suni baap ki awaaz to royi bacchi
laash e besar se lipat kar ye fughan karne lagi
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ke baad ye ehsaas hua hai baba
kya yateemi hai ye ab mujhpe khula hai baba
<<DIVIDER>>
aag daaman may lagata hai sitamgar koi
koi kaano se gohar cheen raha hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
haath kaano pe dhare di ye sakina ne sada
khoon is khaak may mera bhi mila hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap pehchaan na paoge yaqeen hai mujhko
haal jo aap ki beti ka hua hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
zibha se pehle tujhe pani diya zaalim ne
ya gala khusk tera kaata gaya hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
looto sadaat ko abbas nahi hai baaqi
shor hai samt yehi goonj raha hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera pehlu bhi hai dadi ki tarha se zakhmi
pursa ummat ne ye mujhko bhi diya hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
uthke ammu se mere kehdo ke ab aajaye
dashte pur haul may dam ghutne laga hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj sar rakh ke sakina kahan soye bolo
saara seena tera teeron se chida hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
tashna sehne hai sitam mujhko sitamgaaron ke
shaam tak ab ye muqaddar may likha hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
