items.title: Maa dekho na
items.body:
gire jo ghode se maqtal mein shaahe karbobala
hazaron zakhm thay saara badan lahoo se bhara
suni jo qadmon ki awaaz to uthe maula
kaha tadap ke ye jab maa ko saamne dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ali akbar ko naiza maara
haye maa ho gaya seena paara paara
haye maa beh gaya uska khoon bhi saara
maa dekho na
<<DIVIDER>>
uthaya hai jab se uska laasha mai thak gaya hoon maa
fajr se lekar asr talak mai ujad gaya hoon maa
haye maa dekho na
<<DIVIDER>>
maa meri sakina kaise jiyegi
haye maa baap ka seena wo dhoondegi
haye maa mere bina wo mar jayegi
maa dekho na
sula ke mai khaak par sakina ko aa gaya hoon maa
fajr se lekar asr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa mar gaya meri godh mein ghazi
haye maa kat gaye baazu beh gaya pani
haye maa ho gaya uska chehra zakhmi
maa dekho na
nahi mile koi bhai se jaise mai mila hoon maa
fajr se lekar asr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa jiska badan tha phool ke jaisa
haye maa usko uthane jab mai pahuncha
haye maa bikhra tha qasim ka laasha
maa dekho na
sameta usko kahan kahan se mai jaanta hoon maa
fajr se lekar asr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa aun o mohamed mar gaye pyase
haye maa zinda na aaye wo darya se
haye maa mil nahi paaye wo sughra se
maa dekho na
magar sakina ko unke laashe dikha chuka hoon maa
fajr se lekar asr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ghutniyo bhi jo chal na paaya
haye maa teer gale par usne khaaya
haye maa asghar ko maine dafnaya
maa dekho na
wo kitna pyasa tha soch kar mai tadap raha hoon maa
fajr se lekar asr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa aapka beta reh gaya tanha
haye maa lakhon ne mil kar mujhko maara
haye maa teer lage aur khaaya naiza
maa dekho na
hai zakhmi sar dekho gurz kha kar abhi gira hoon maa
fajr se lekar asr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha ran mein zeeshan aur farhan kaisa manzar
jab aake seene pe shimr baitha to bole sarwar
<<DIVIDER>>
maa chalne waala hai ab khanjar
haye maa haath na rakhna tum gardan par
haye maa godh mein le lo mujhko aakar
maa dekho na
sukoon se maut aaye bas mai ye chaahta hoon maa
fajr se lekar asr talak...

items.title: Aahain Hain Dhoop Hai Aur Jhoola hai ek
items.body:
Aahain Hain Dhoop Hai Aur, Jhoola hai ek Khali
Asghar ki ujri Maa ne, dunya alag basa li
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek phool ko dehekthi raiti mai dafun kar ke
Bas haat mal raha tha, ujrey chaman ka mali
<<DIVIDER>>
Sehra me sogeya hai jhooley me sonay wala
Zindan me sogayi hai Jhoolay jhulaney wali
<<DIVIDER>>
Aab janay kya kahengey madar se uski Jaakay
Khaimo ko ja rahey hain Shabbir haat khali
<<DIVIDER>>
Dehka Rubab ko jab Sajda e shukar kar kay
Behlool e hajira nay kyun kar nazar jukali

items.title: Ab raat ho chuki
items.body:
jab khaak mein chupa chuke beti rasool ki
moo rakh ke apna qabr pe rote rahe ali
quran pad rahe thay jo ro ro ke murtaza
itne mein aayi fatema zahra ki ye sada
<<DIVIDER>>
marqad pe meri aise na aansu bahaiye
ab raat ho chuki hai bahot laut jaaiye
<<DIVIDER>>
maloom hai ye aap ko naazon ke hai palay
bache kabhi bhi raat mein tanha nahi rahe
ghar jaake pyaar kiye khana khilaiye
ab raat ho chuki hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
bichde hai pehli baar jo maadar se naunehal
bachon ka mere ya ali rakhna bahot khayal
lipta ke apne seene se dhaaras bandhaiye
ab raat ho chuki hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
milta nahi hai chain mere dil ke chain ko
raaton mein pyaas lagti hai mere hussain ko
ashkon ko uske pochiye pani pilaiye
ab raat ho chuki hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab bahot hai choti ye gham seh na payegi
kehna bhi jo chahegi to kuch keh na payegi
bin maa ke kaise rehte hai usko sikhaiye
ab raat ho chuki hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
ek aarzu hai aap se marqad pe ya ali
le aaiyega bachon ko mere kabhi kabhi
mera nishan e qabr kayi jaa banaiye
ab raat ho chuki hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
faryad ka na qabr pe rone ka waqt hai
bachon ka mere ya ali sone ka waqt hai
lori thapak ke dijiye unko sulaiye
ab raat ho chuki hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko yaqeen hai aaj wo hargiz na soyenge
chup chup ke mere hujre mein jaa kar wo royenge
meri nishaniyon ko wahan se hataaiye
ab raat ho chuki hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
ainee bhala wo kis tarha bechaargi likhe
aamir na jaane kaise ali qabr se uthay
awaaz bas ye aati rahi gham na khaaiye
ab raat ho chuki hai…
items.author: Ainee Rizvi

items.title: Abbas piye kaise
items.body:
abbas piye kaise pani abbas ka aaqa pyasa hai
qaime may sakina pyasi hai aur bacha bacha pyasa hai
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ne jab peene ko kaha rehwaar ne bhi moo phayr liya
matlab tha yehi mai kaise piyu baysheer hamara pyasa hai
abbas piye kaise...
<<DIVIDER>>
barsat ka mausam bhi to nahi pani ka barasna na mumkin
darya bhi udoo ki qaid may hai shabbir ka kunba pyasa hai
abbas piye kaise...
<<DIVIDER>>
paaya jo sakina ne pani ye kehke badi maqtal ki taraf
asghar ko pilaungi pehle nanha mera bhaiya pyasa hai
abbas piye kaise...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab shere khuda ne pyaso ko kausar pa diya jaame kausar
moo phayr liya sab ne keh kar ahmed ka nawasa pyasa hai abbas piye kaise...
<<DIVIDER>>
laghar hai bahot bemaar bhi hai zanjeer badan se bhari hai
durre na laga abid ke shaqi wallah ye bhooka pyasa hai
abbas piye kaise...
<<DIVIDER>>
azaad hui itrat lekin zindan may sakina hai ab tak
chidkao lehad par kaun kare har zarra zarra pyasa hai
abbas piye kaise...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashkon ke ye jharne ankhon se chauda sau baras se jaari hai
sairaab abhi tak ho na saka rumaale zehra pyasa hai
abbas piye kaise...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ka jis may zikr na ho baysheer ki jis may pyas na ho
kitne bhi masayab ho anwar lekin wo noha pyasa hai
abbas piye kaise...
items.author: Anwar Zahir

items.title: Akbar jawan thay
items.body:
kya sakht majera hai kahani hussain ki
be-waqt kya miti hai nishani hussain ki
akbar ka tha shabab jawani hussain ki
akbar jawan thay jee se guzarne ke din na thay
ay dashte karbala abhi marne ke din na thay
<<DIVIDER>>
ye deen se lagao ye dunya se be-dili
barchi wegha mein aake kaleje se jab lagi
kya aan baan thi ke palak tak nahi hili
akbar jawan thay jee se guzarne ke din na thay
ay dashte karbala abhi marne ke din na thay
<<DIVIDER>>
kya teen din ki pyaas mein tewar dikha gaye
dunya ke naujawano ki himmat badha gaye
phoolon mein tul rahe thay sinanon mein aagaye
akbar jawan thay jee se guzarne ke din na thay
ay dashte karbala abhi marne ke din na thay
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhiye maut aalam e imkaan e kis tarha
ye daagh utha liya shahe zeeshan ne kis tarha
dulha bana ke bhej diya maa ne kis tarha
akbar jawan thay jee se guzarne ke din na thay
ay dashte karbala abhi marne ke din na thay
<<DIVIDER>>
ruqsat ke waqt bano e shabbir chup rahi
behnein ghareeb surat e tasveer chup rahi
sab ek samt zainab e dilgeer chup rahi
akbar jawan thay jee se guzarne ke din na thay
ay dashte karbala abhi marne ke din na thay
<<DIVIDER>>
maana ke sabr o shukr ka dil mein wafoor tha
bacche ka gham na ho ye mohabbot se door tha
maadar ko inke byaah ka armaan zaroor tha
akbar jawan thay jee se guzarne ke din na thay
ay dashte karbala abhi marne ke din na thay
items.author: Najm Afandi

items.title: Ali ke shehr kufa
items.body:
ali ke shehr kufa mein samaan zainab pe kya aaya
kuja burqa shariyat ka rida ka bhi nahi saaya
<<DIVIDER>>
janaza jis ki maadar ka utha tha parda e shab mein
zamana us ki beti ko sar e bazaar le aaya
ali ke shehr kufa mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha ro kar sakina ne chacha muslim duhaai hai
wo dekho phir mujhe zaalim tamache maarne aaya
ali ke shehr kufa mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
darazi manzilon ki rayt ke tapte huwe raste
anokha saarban hai bediyan pehne huwe aaya
ali ke shehr kufa mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
saje hai baam o dar kufa mein aamad hai aseeron ki
tamasha aale ahmed ka musalman dekhne aaya
ali ke shehr kufa mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo khutba tha ke haibat cha gayi darbar saare par
ali ki sher dil beti mein hyder sa jalaal aaya
ali ke shehr kufa mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha sajjad se zainab ne ro ke kuch to batlao
najaf se le ke chadar kyun mera baba nahi aaya
ali ke shehr kufa mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jahan baba ki shaahi thi usi darbar mein zainab
nisar aayi barehna sar ye kaisa inquilaab aaya
ali ke shehr kufa mein...
items.author: Baba Nisaar Haideri

items.title: Apni aghosh mein
items.body:
haye ya hussain haye ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
chal rahi hai meri gardan pe churi
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
<<DIVIDER>>
keh rahe the ye hussain ibne ali
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
<<DIVIDER>>
tashna lab naazon ka paala hai tumhara beta
qatl ab hone hi waala hai tumhara beta
rukne waali hai har ek saans meri
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
chal rahi hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne bachpan ka nibhata hoo ye waada dekho
maine badla to nahi apna iraada dekho
sar mera kaatne waala hai shaqi
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
chal rahi hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
thak gaya laashein utha kar bhare lashkar ki
laash qasim ki mai laaya hoon kabhi akbar ki
khud banayi hai lehad maine ali asghar ki
do tasalli mujhe seene se laga lo amma
haye ya hussain haye ya hussain
chal rahi hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitni bechain hai amma meri zainab khwahar
aake teele pe wo khud dekh rahi hai manzar
ho rahi hai usay takleef badi
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
chal rahi hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
mar gaya mera jari bhai magar sabr kiya
mere akbar ne sina khaayi magar sabr kiya
mil gayi khaak mein tasveer e nabi
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
chal rahi hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
haajira aasia maryam bhi isi dasht mein hai
nooh bhi hazrate aadam bhi isi dasht mein hai
ro rahe hai meri ghurbat pe sabhi
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
chal rahi hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
kho diye dasht mein aankhon ke ujaale maine
khaliye dil pe bahot dard ke bhaale maine
maut aati hai to aa jaaye abhi
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
chal rahi hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
kalmago khoon rulaate hai mujhe maqtal mein
dekhlo kitna sataate hai mujhe maqtal mein
hil gayi dekhlo maqtal ki zameen
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
chal rahi hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek guzarish hai meri tum se ab itni maadar
amma baba ki qasam dhaamp lo moo par chadar
dekha jayega na ab tum se ye khooni manzar
aray qatl hota hoo nigaahon ko hata lo amma
haye ya hussain haye ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
arz karte hi nawab ho gaya mehshar barpa
khaak udhane lagi maqtal mein janabe zahra
shadman jab ye sada shaah ne di
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
chal rahi hai meri...
items.author: Nawab Cholasvi

items.title: Bade sarkar
items.body:
kehte hai hussain jab bhi aao karbala
pehle maango mere chote bhai se riza
zaairon do sada baadshahe wafa
yaad aa rahi hai karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
wo hai maula sakhi maula
tum iraada karo ziyarat ka
dil nahi todte kabhi maula
izne ziyarat chote sarkar se le ke
aao chale bade sarkar se milne
<<DIVIDER>>
tizurooni aaidkum taarifooni shafee'akum
<<DIVIDER>>
saamne rauze ke gumbad jo nazar aayenge
aankh mein aansu unhe dekh ke bhar jaayenge
dil se niklegi sada ya aba abdillah
aap par mera salaam ay hussain saarallah
rote huwe unhe awaaz ye denge
maula yahan aap mazloom thay kitne
tizurooni aaidkum...
<<DIVIDER>>
karte hai fazl o karam fazl ke baba sab par
unko tum yaad karo babul hawaij keh kar
tumko lene ke liye khud wo aa jayenge
saath abbas ke hum karbala jayenge
waada karo in ziyaraat se pehle
royenge hum kafe abbas pe jaa ke
tizurooni aaidkum...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil mein jo baat hai abbas se ja kar kehna
unke rauze ki taraf dekh ke rote rehna
do kate haathon ka unko pursa dena
kehna hum bhoole nahi alqama par jo hua
gurz laga haye jab aap ke sar pe
zakhmi huwe aap rahwaar se gir ke
tizurooni aaidkum...
<<DIVIDER>>
maula abbas jise chaahe bula lete hai
wo ghareebon ko bhi zawwar bana dete hai
ay azadaron suno fikr kyun karte ho
maula bulwa lenge unse keh kar dekho
haath rakho jaa ke ek baar alam pe
zaade safar khud alamdar karenge
tizurooni aaidkum...
<<DIVIDER>>
abadwallah ya zahra maaninsa hussaina
abadwallah ya zahra maaninsa hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
maula jab sunta hoon naara mai abad wallah ka
dil mera kehta hai maaninsa hussaina zahra
haan wo halmin ki sada kabhi bhoolenge na hum
jab nazar aayega shaahe waala ka haram
bolenge hum door se haath utha ke
aa gaye hum ya hussain aap se milne
tizurooni aaidkum...
<<DIVIDER>>
izn jab hazrate abbas se hum payenge
ya hussain aap ke rauze se lipat jayenge
waasta zehra ka mujhko rone dena
haath mere dil par maula tum na rakhna
haq to ye hai dil ye phat jaaye wahan pe
qatl huwe maula jis khaak pe pyase
tizurooni aaidkum...
<<DIVIDER>>
wahin qasim ka badan ghode se pamaal hua
barchi akbar ko lagi seene ka kya haal hua
teer asghar ko laga chid gaya nanha gala
do thay zainab ke pisar dono ko maar diya
ahle haram jahan har laash pe roye
aaj bhi hai wahin sadaat ke qaime
tizurooni aaidkum...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitne din ho gaye wo rauza nahi dekha hai
jis ke darwaze pe saaqi e atash likha hai
bolo zeeshan o raza ay shehenshahe wafa
zaairon mein ab to naam likh de mera
baithun kabhi mai bhi darbar mein aa ke
rota rahun haye awaaz ye sun ke
tizurooni aaidkum...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Behan sakina muaf
items.body:
behan sakina muaaf karna
rehaai bhi mai dila na paaya
lehad pe sajjad ka tha nauha
ye bhai tujhko bacha na paaya
<<DIVIDER>>
wo durr jo baba ne thay pinhaye
wo shimr ne is tarha se cheene
tujhe tamachon se shimr ke mai
ay mere pyari bacha na paaya
behan sakina muaaf...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo bebasi se tera bilakna
jab aag daaman jala rahi thi
mai kitna majboor tha sakina
wo aag teri bujha na paaya
behan sakina muaaf...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum oont ki pusht se bandhi thi
badan tha zakhmi lahoo tha jaari
tadap rahi thi atash se jab tum
mai pyaas teri bujha na paaya
behan sakina muaaf...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo yaas o hasrat se tera kehna
ke qaid mein hai bahot andhera
charagh laa do bas ek khudara
charagh bhi mai jala na paaya
behan sakina muaaf...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai haal bhaiya kise bataun
nahi hai ammu kahan hai baba
bulaye baba ko mere bhaiya
behan mai unko bula na paaya
behan sakina muaaf...
<<DIVIDER>>
lita lo seene pe aaj bhai
ke yaad baba ki aa rahi hai
thay itne lohe ke tan pe ke itne zewar
behan mai tujhko lita na paaya
behan sakina muaaf...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu kitni hasrat se poochti thi
milegi kab qaid se rehaai
nahi rehaai tera muqaddar
behan mai tujhko bata na paaya
behan sakina muaaf...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo tauq o zanjeer o hathkadi mein
banayi kaise behan ki turbat
shameem likhe wo kaise manzar
jo mera maula bhula na paaya
behan sakina muaaf...
items.author: Shamin Farhat Zaid

items.title: Chalees baras rote
items.body:
chalees baras rote na kyun abid e muztar
ta umr sameina raha aankhon mein wo manzar
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha tha inhi aankhon se ghar apna ujadta
be goro kafan laashe shaheedo ke zameen par
chalees baras rote na…
<<DIVIDER>>
phirta hi raha aankhon mein bhai ka wo laasha
barchi thi kaleje mein ani seene ke baahar
chalees baras rote na…
<<DIVIDER>>
guzre thay kahan ranj bahot poocha kisi ne
as shaam hi as shaam kaha sar ko jhuka kar
chalees baras rote na…
<<DIVIDER>>
daawat koi deta to ye farmate thay sajjad
gar mujhko bulana hai to majlis tu bapa kar
chalees baras rote na…
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhe thay jo ashoor ko bujhte hue sholay
ta umr dhuan uth'ta raha aahon mein dhal kar
chalees baras rote na…
<<DIVIDER>>
kya guzri dile sayyede sajjad pe us dam
jab loota gaya bibiyon ka makhna o chadar
chalees baras rote na…
<<DIVIDER>>
kis mard mein hai hausla juz abid e bemaar
maa behno ko jo dekhle balwe mein khule sar
chalees baras rote na…
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek nafas girya tha ya tha ata'ay mabood
ek lamha bhi raahat na anees aayi meinassar
chalees baras rote na…
items.author: Anees

items.title: Dhoop may hai
items.body:
dhoop may hai qabre zehra gumbad e khizra ke paas
ye nabi karte hai nauha gumbad e khizra ke paas
<<DIVIDER>>
naaz se paala tha is ko thi meri noor e nazar
meri ummat ne jalaya hai meri beti ka dar
ye sitam zehra pe dhaaya gumbad e khizra ke paas
dhoop may hai qabre zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye athara baras may ye huwe is par sitam
kaise kaise aur kya kya mil gaye zehra ko gham
hogayi zehra zaeefa gumbad e khizra ke paas
dhoop may hai qabre zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah allah sabr e hyder tha ye kaise marhala
fatema zehra ko jo darbar bulwaya gaya
imtehan e murtaza tha gumbad e khizra ke paas
dhoop may hai qabre zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera kalma padhne waale kar gaye kaisi jafa
jab gul e ismat ke upar jalta darwaza gira
hogaya pehlu shikasta gumbad e khizra ke paas
dhoop may hai qabre zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbar o shabbir ko tum ne hai kaisa gham diya
haye bachon ke saron se maa ka saaya uth gaya
ro ke kehti thi ye fizza gumbad e khizra ke paas
dhoop may hai qabre zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sada e mustafa hai baqer o safdar suno
koi qabre fatema zehra pe saaya to karo
dhoop may hai qabre zehra gumbad e khizra ke paas
dhoop may hai qabre zehra...
items.author: Baqar Hussain

items.title: Fatema khamosh hai
items.body:
pehlu shikasta fatema kis se kare bayan
dar is tarha giraya ke tooti hai phasliyan
har shab ko apni haal par roti hai fatema
lekin kabhi ali se na shikwa koi kiya
<<DIVIDER>>
dard e gham pehlu ka sehkar fatema khamosh hai
zakhm ye dekhe na hyder fatema khamosh hai
<<DIVIDER>>
phasliyan tooti hui hai dard ki hai inteha
kar rahi hai baith kar apni namazo ko ada
kab koi shikwa hai lab par fatema khamosh hai
dard e gham pehlu ka sehkar...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil pe mohsin ki shahadat ka abhi taaza hai gham
muntazir hai maut ki aur ashk se aankhein hai nam
gham sabhi apne chupa kar fatema khamosh hai
dard e gham pehlu ka sehkar...
<<DIVIDER>>
khauf hai is baat ka dekhe na chehra murtaza
neel zaalim ke tamacha ka hai bibi ke pada
dard ki tasveer ban kar fatema khamosh hai
dard e gham pehlu ka sehkar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bazzato minni kaha jis ko nabi e paak ne
haif ke ummat ne har lamha sataya hai usay
qabr mein roye payambar fatema khamosh hai
dard e gham pehlu ka sehkar...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaas se maadar ko apni dekhte hai mujtaba
ro ke ye baba se kehte hai shahe karbobala
kyun meri awaaz sunkar fatema khamosh hai
dard e gham pehlu ka sehkar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa ke ummat ne jalaya fatema zahra ka ghar
dekh kar hyder ko tanha khoon rota hai jigar
qalb pe chalta hai khanjar fatema khamosh hai
dard e gham pehlu ka sehkar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi thi haq lene zahra zulm ke darbar se
kar diye tukde sanad ke be-haya badkaar ne
bikhre tukdon ko utha kar fatema khamosh hai
dard e gham pehlu ka sehkar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha rehan koi ghurbate zahra likhe
ye wo mazlooma hai jis par zulm ab tak na ruke
rota hai danish bhi likh kar fatema khamosh hai
dard e gham pehlu ka sehkar...

items.title: Haye akbar
items.body:
haye akbar haye akbar haye akbar haye akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
mar gaye laal mere kha ke sina seene par

items.title: Kya Yateemon Pe Sitam
items.body:
Haye Sakeena Haye Yateema
Kya yateemon pe sitam aisa kiya jata hai
Baap par roney pe durre koi barsata hai
1) Ek beti hai jo baba ko bahut pyari thi
Baap ke seene pe aaram se sojati thi
Ab to dil khaak pe sote huwe tharrata hai
2) Ummati kaise hain ye kaise musalmañ ya rab
Kyun samajhte nahin ye aale nabi ka mannsab
Badle purse ke hameñ qaid kiya jata hai
3) Chalte naaqe se giraya gaya baba mujhko
Aap ke baad sataya gaya baba mujhko
Sar ko dikhla ke sitamgar mujhe rulvata hai
4) Aye phuphi amma batao hai ye kaisa zindañ
Raat ko oos to din me hai tapish ka sadma
Kyun yateemon pe taras koi nahin khata hai
5) Aap ki yaad me roti hun main baba jab bhi
Haye zindañ me chala aata hai be deen shaqi
Durre phir Sayyed e Sajjad pe barsata hai
7) Leke sar good me baba ka fughaan karti thi
Is tarha soyi ke phir uth nahin payi bacchi
Shore gham se dar e Zindaan hila jata hai
8) Kaise Sajjad ne Qaisar wo uthaya lasha
Hathkadi bediyaan parhti thin Hasan ye Nauha
Haye kis haal me bhai tujhe dafnata hai

Dadi Zahra ki goud main sar hai

items.title: Behan zainab khudahafiz
items.body:
Salamay aakhri tumpar behan zainab khudahafiz
Kaha  shabbir nay rokar behan zainab khudahafiz
1.Hawalay ab tere behna ye sab ghar daar aur kunba,
Safar hai ye mera aakhir, behan zainab khudahafiz
2.Mera akber mera abbas, nahi ab koi mere paas
Sidharay sab sooye kausar, behan zainab khudahafiz
3.Layee ye shaam o koofa kay , hai mere khoon kay pyaase
Hazaron tegh mera sar, behan zainab khudahafiz
4.Abhi kuch der may behna qayamat hoyegi barpa
Lutega ghar khulega sar, behan zainab khudahafiz
5.Kaha zainab kay ab dilbar, kaha hai qasimay muztar,
Kaha akber kaha asghar, behan zainab khudahafiz
6.Zamee ko zaljala hoga falak se khoon barsega
Katay jab tansay mera sar, behan zainab khudahafiz
7.Sitamgar aaga laayengay nabi ka ghar jalayengay
Naya hai har qadam mehshar, behan zainab khudahfiz
8.Tamachay khaa kay royegi sakina laadli meri
Dilaasa dena tum khwahar, behan zainab khudahafiz
9.Aye momin aasma gham ka nabi ki aal par toota
Chalay kehtay huwe sarwar, behan zainab khudahafiz.

items.title: Jafar ke laal
items.body:
Phir se nabi ki aal pe ranjo alam hai aaj,
Jafar ke lal musiye kazim ka gham hai aaj
Baghdadi soghwar hai yasrab hai soghwar,
Har ek bashar har ek mukarrab hai soghwar,
Tuta nabi ki aal pe kaisa sitam hai aaj,
25 saal tak jo raha qaid e zulm me,
Har ek zulm jisne saha qaide zulm me,
Ha ha ousi ke gham me har ek aankh nam hai aaj.
Qaide sitam me margaa jafar ka nau nehal,
Kyun hona jae kalb musibat se paemal
Maula raza ko chain kahan koi dum hai aaj.
Mazdoro ne outhaya hai lasha imam ka ,
Pull par rakha hua hai jaaza imam ka,
Majruh kalbe sahebe judo karam hai aaj.
Jiske sabab hai deen ki kheti hari bhari,
Lawarisee me lash hai ouski padi hui,
Jetna bhi roe shahe ke azadar kam hai aaj.
Chhaya hai asmaano zamee par hawa pe sogh,
Tari hua hai phir se imame raza pe sogh,
Giriya kunan sahebe jaho hasham hai aaj.
Pardes me hussain ke pote pe hai jafa,
Phir se rasoole haqke nawase pe hai jafa,
Taza hua jahaan me wo zulm o sitam hai aaj.
Zulmo sitam na pahonche abhi ikhtetam ko,
Markad me bhi sukoon nahi hai imam ko,
Ghaibat ke izterab me khairul umam hai aaj.
Is baat par zamana kare kistarha na ghaur.
18 bete jiske ho uspar ho zulmo jaur,
Giriyaa sukhan warsan ki noke kalam hai aaj.
Ye baat or uspe bhi hojata hai karam,
Warna likhe azim ye rudade pur alam,
Kazim ke gham ka thoda sa qissa rakam hai aaj.

items.title: Kyu na ho chalni jigar
items.body:
1
Kyu'n naho chhalni jigar zehra ke maatamdaar ke.
Jab ke rote hai ali bhi haath sar pe maar ke.
2
Zainabo kulsoom hai'n girya kuna fizza ke saath.
Aur rote hai nawaase ehmade mukhtaar ke.
3
Taab la sakte nahi unke masaaeb sunke ham.
Zakhm kaise ho baya'n binte shahe abraar ke.
4
Aag aada ne lagaayi lakdiya'n karke jam'a
Kar diya zehra ko zakhmi laat dar pe maar ke.
5
Ho gayi us waqt chakna choor dono pasliya'n
Fatema thi darmya'n jisdam daro dewaar ke.
6
Fatema ke jism me keele'n saraayat kar gai.
The badan me zakhm misle teer or talwaar ke.
7
Ho gaya saaqit hamal mohsin jaha se chal base
Raakh jalke ho gae armaan ek laachaar ke.
8
Jab talak zinda rahi sub'ho masa roti rahi rahi.
Khoon ke aansu rava aakho'n se the ghamkhaar ke.
9
Aake baytul huzn me karti voh ummat ka gila.
Baba dekho aake khud zulmo sitam aghyaar ke.
10
Rote rote jaanibe mulke baka voh chal basi.
So gai turbat me dardo gham se woh thak haar ke.
11
Qabr me bhi chain na so saki Navshad woh.

items.title: Ali marey gaye hai
items.body:
Koi Zainab ko batlaa dein ye Jaa kar Ali marey gaye hain,
Lagi hai Zarb ik Sajdey mein Sar par Ali marey gaye hain..
(1) Jaha'n Masroof Masjid mein Ali they Ibadat mein Khuda ki,
Laee'n ne aa ke yu'n Shamsheer un ke Sar-e-Aqdas pe Maari,
Khuda ke ghar mein Damaad-e-Payambar Ali marey gaye hain..
(2) Sar-e-Arshe Baree Matam bapa hai Wasi-e-Mustafa ka,
Ali-e-Murtaza ke Sar se jis dam Ugalta Khoon dekha,
Sadaa Jibreel ne di Aasma'n par Ali marey gaye hain..
(3) Fiza maghmoom hai Bait-e-Khuda ki Qayamat ka Sama'n hai,
Ali ke Sog mei'n Masroof-e-Maatam Zameen-o-Aasma'n hai,
Bukaa kartey hain ye Mehrab-o-Mimbar Ali marey gaye hain..
(4) Merey baba abhi kuch deir pehley Hamarey darmiya'n they,
Kaha Kulsoom ne Baba ki Khushbu abhi bhi aa rahi hai,
Yaqee'n mujh ko bhala Aayega kyu'n Kar Ali marey gaye hain..
(5) Janazey ke Sirhaney Rooh e Zahra sada ye de rahi hai,
Koi to aa ke bachho ko sambhaley Musibat ki ghadi hai,
Yateemi chha gayi hai unke sar par Ali marey gaye hain..
(6) Janaza utha raha hai murtaza ka Sahaba Ghamzada hai,
Shikasta sar ki janib tak ke ghazi musalsal ro raha hai,
Bacha paaya na main Baba ko kyu'n kar Ali marey gaye hain..
(7) Yateeman e Ali se eyk Saail ye rokar keh raha tha,
Mujhey khana khilaney teen din se mera moula na aaya,
Ye boley us ghadi Shabbir-o-Shabbar Ali marey gaye hain..
(8) Ali ke baad kuch din tak ye Haalat rahi hai Faiz unki,
Kisine Khairiyat malum ki hai merey Moula se jab bhi,
Hasan ye Ro ke farmatey they Aksar Ali marey gaye hain..

items.body:

Boli Sajjad Se Zainab-e-Khastatan
Beta Sajjad Ye Kya Maqaam Aagaya, Kya Maqaam Aagaya. Kya Maqaam

Mera Bi Imtihaan Poora Hoga Yahi

Wo Maqaam Aagaya, Haaye Shaam Aagaya, Haaye Shaam Aagaya, Kya Maqaam
<<DIVIDER>>
Karbala Kufa Aur Shaam Mai Lutgaya
Sab Bhara Ghar Batool Aur Hasnain Ka
Chaadaray Zainab O Umme Kulsoom Se
Parda Ummat Ka Aur Deen Ka Rehgaya
Kaash Aaye Nida Jiske Thay Muntazir
Sibte Jafar Wo Zul Inteqaam Aagaya, Kya Maqaam Aagaya, Kya Maqaam

items.title: Haye Alamdar
items.body:
Haaye alamdaar haaye alamdaar
Kahte ye roke harame ahmade mukhtaar
Haaye alamdaar haaye alamdaar
Is aalame ghurbat me chhuta saath tumhara
Ye zulm jari tumne Kiya kaise gawara
Dar aaye hain khaime me jari dekho sitamgaar
Haaye alamdaar haaye alamdaar
Akbar ne sada di to ye shabbir pukaare
Ab aankho se dikhta nahi baba ko tumhare
Lashkar me nahi koi mera monis o ghamkhaar
Haaye alamdaar haaye alamdaar
Qasim bhi nahi hain ali akbar bhi nahi hai
Ghurbat hai ke chehre maah ka Asghar bhi nahi hai
Ab kon bachayega sakina tere rukhsaar
Haaye alamdaar haaye alamdaar
Abbas ke laashe pe ye sheh padhte the noha
Is dasht me batlaao bhala kon hai apna
Uth jaao mere bhai meri fauj ke salaar
Haaye alamdaar haaye alamdaar
Abbas ki bahno ko rulaate the sitamgar
Allah re khaimo ko jalate the sitamgar
Majboor hai sajjad bhala kya kare beemaar
Haaye alamdaar haaye alamdaar
Shabbir se kahti Rahi Zainab yahi rokar
Baad aapke batlaaiye aye mere baradar
Kis tarah se ham jaayenge bhayya sare bazaar
Haaye alamdaar haaye alamdaar
Haider koi dariya pe ye abbas se kah de
Marega layee jab bhi sakina ko tamaache
Dariya se bulayegi bhatiji tumhe har baar
Haaye alamdaar haaye alamdaar

items.title: Hussaina hussaina
items.body:
hussain bazm e jahan ko jaga ke soye hai
chiragh e quwwate baatil bujha ke soye hai
sitam ke qasr ko thokar se dha ke soye hai
udoo ke taygh talay muskurake soye hai
hussaina hussaina haye hussain hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
noha tha ye zainab e dilgeer ka
koi nahi sar pe raha aasra
waqt tha ye ahle haram pe kada
ghar bhara ujda chin gayi rida
hussaina hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
dulha ka ran mein hua tukde badan
dekh ke roya kiye shaahe zaman
ho gaya pamaal sheh ka gulbadan
tukde badan tha kaun utha'ta
hussaina hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
aun o mohamad jo gire khaak par
raahe haq mein ho gaye qurban pisar
pahunchi jo qaime mein ye gham ki khabar
maa ne kiya tha shukr khuda ka
hussaina hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene pe akbar ke jab barchi lagi
sakht thi boodhe pidar pe ye ghadi
kaandhe pe leke laashe jawan laal ki
thokare khaata qaime mein pahuncha
hussaina hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehm kha cheh maah ka bacha hai ye
bano ka bhi sab ka dulaara hai ye
pyaas se gehware mein tadpa hai ye
pani mila na paas tha darya
hussaina hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
nehr pe abbas ke shaane kate
baith gaye shaah kamar thaam ke
zainab o kulsum ne naale kiye
ghazi ka laasha dekh ke roya
hussaina hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
qatl huwe kund churi se hussain
maadar e shabbir ye karti thi bain
kaise mile pyasi sakina ko chain
ahle haram ka tha yehi nauha
hussaina hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
as-salaam ya hussain as-salaam
roze pe ek roz ho uska qayaam
dije najaf ko raza ay imam
ay mere maula ay mere aaqa
hussaina hussaina...
items.author: Najaf Murshidabadi

items.title: Jafar ki shahadat
items.body:
jafar ki shahadat jo madine mein hui hai
phir aale mohamed pe qayamat ki ghadi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
tukde kiya turbat mein mohamed ka kaleja
jafar ko diya zehr jo mansoor e shaqi hai
jafar ki shahadat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
bistar pa tadapte rahe shabbar ki tarha se
ek aag hai jo zehr ki shiddat se lagi hai
jafar ki shahadat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
sam seene mein jafar ke jo pahuncha hai khudara
dil tukde hai andar se koi chalti churi hai
jafar ki shahadat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo ilm ka khazzaan utha aaj jahan se
tafseer jo masoom ne quran ki ki hai
jafar ki shahadat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jafar ke janaze pa hai yun moosiye kazim
ammama nahi sar pa yateemi ki ghadi hai
jafar ki shahadat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadiq ki shahadat pa hai shiyyon ka ajab haal
sar peet'te hai koyi kahin seena zani hai
jafar ki shahadat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai sarfe aza aap ki aulaad ke gham mein
ye matami sangat jo rasoole arabi hai
jafar ki shahadat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
hurr baade nabi aale nabi kaise guzaare
ummat hai nabi ki jo kabhi chayn na di hai
jafar ki shahadat jo...
items.author: Hur Hyderabadi

items.title: Karbala se shaam
items.body:
karbala basa kar apna ghar luta kar
godh ke sabhi pale rayt mein chupa kar
karbala se shaam ja rahe hai hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
naize pe quran suna rahe hai hussain
karbala se shaam ja rahe hai hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
jang e karbala ko maine fatha kar liya
faatahe damishq hogi binte sayyeda
ye qadam qadam bata rahe hai hussain
naize pe quran suna...
karbala se shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
bibyon ke sar khule koi na dekh le
har nigaah meri samt hi jami rahe
sab ko maujiza dikha rahe hai hussain
naize pe quran suna...
karbala se shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
bain thay sakina ke mai ro nahi saki
baba kitne din huwe mai so nahi saki
lori beti ko suna rahe hai hussain
naize pe quran suna...
karbala se shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-rida haram hai chaar samt ahle shar
khoon ro raha hai saarban jhukaye sar
us ka hausla bada rahe hai hussain
naize pe quran suna...
karbala se shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
aag aur patharon ki barishein hui
zakhmi sar behan ka hai lahoo lahoo jabeen
zakhm patharon se khaa rahe hai hussain
naize pe quran suna...
karbala se shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab suna ye shireen ne to ro ke di sada
jaag utha naseeb mera ay mere khuda
aaj mere ghar pe aa rahe hai hussain
naize pe quran suna...
karbala se shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
bete bhanje bhatije ban mein so chuke
alqama pe sher jaisa bhai kho chuke
waada aakhri nibha rahe hai hussain
naize pe quran suna...
karbala se shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaafile se mutmain imam ho gaye
shaam pahunche khatm saare kaam ho gaye
nana se duayein paa rahe hai hussain
naize pe quran suna...
karbala se shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
maante hai matami bhi aur farhan bhi
daastan e gham safar ki mazhar abidi
likh raha hoo mai likha rahe hai hussain
naize pe quran suna...
karbala se shaam...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Kyu Tere Naam Se Tari Naho Riqqat Zehra
items.body:
kyu tere naamse taari naho riqqat zehra
umrbhar sheti rahi ranjo musibat zehra
1.uski hurmat na rakhi usko jalaya aakar
jalta darwaza giraya hai tere pehlu par
pursa deti hai ajab tujko ye ummat zehra
kyu tere naamse....
2.dard pe dard tha din raat me tadpi lekin
umar sub ranjo masaeb me guzari lekin
lab pe layi na kabhi hurfe shikayat zehra
kyu tere naamse....
3.baal ujle hai jhuki pusth shikasta phelu
zerd rukhsar tera tuta huwa hai baazu
ye musalmaa ne diya ajre risaalat zehra
kyu tere naamse....
4.dil pe har gaam naya dard naya ek alam
umr atthara baras ki hai magar pust hai khum
kis qadar toone uthaye hai saoobat zehra
kyu tere naamse....
5.marsiya labpe hai kuch itne uthaye sadme
kaali raato me badal jaate ujale dinke
is qadar tujh pe masaeb ki thi shiddat zehra
kyu tere naamse....
6.pasliya tooti huwi dekh ke qaboo na raha
khud ali jaisa bahadur bhi tadap kar roya
aise zakhmo ki sahi toone aziyat zehra
kyu tere naamse....
7.kab uthata hai bashar koi bhi ghum maut ke baad
qatm ho jaata hai sab ranjo alam maut ke baad
tujh ko haasil na huwi marke bhi raahat zehra
kyu tere naamse....
8.zindagi me kabhi baba pe bhi rone na diya
baad az maut tuje chain se sone na diya
munhadim kardi shaqi ne teri turbat zehra
kyu tere naamse....
9.galiya shaahid hai madine ki musalsal tadpi
baad ahmad ke hamesha wo azadar rahi
sochke rota hai asgar teri gurbat zehra
kyu tere naamse taari naho riqqat zehra
umar bhar sheti rahi ranjo musibat zehra

items.title: Maa kehti thi asghar
items.body:
maa kehti thi asghar tujhe seene mein chupalun
barsaat hai teeron ki tujhe kaise bachalun
<<DIVIDER>>
garmi ke hai ayyaam kahin saaya nahi hai
is haal mein kaise mai tujhe ghar se nikalun
maa kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya naara e hal min ki sada ne kiya bechain
tu jaata hai aanchal mai tere sar pe to daalun
maa kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaghosh ko veeran meri kar ke na jao
roothe ho tumhe loriyan de de ke manalun
maa kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani ke liye tum to meri jaan thay beta
tehro zara abbas ko darya se bulalun
maa kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ahle jafa hai inhe insan na samajhna
kis tarha se mai apne kaleje ko sambhalun
maa kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
maidan mein gaya jo bhi palat kar nahi aaya
ek baar tujhe aur mai jhoola to jhulalun
maa kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kangi karun baalon mein tera kurta badaldun
mai dulha bana kar tujhe armaan nikalun
maa kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan ne nauha ali asghar ka likha hai
is nauhe ko farhan mai majlis mein sunalun
maa kehti thi...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Aaj ghar se nahi
items.body:
kya ajab si sehar ye aayi hai
jis taraf dekhiye udaasi hai
baap jaata hai ghar se masjid ko
beti faryad karti jaati hai
aaj ghar se nahi jao baba
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ke zainab ye hyder se boli
aaj ghar se nahi jao baba
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise samjhaye tumko ye dukhiya
kaifiyat ko meri samjho baba
khauf hai mere dil mein ajab sa
koi hum se tumhe cheen lega
hoga hum pe yateemi ka saaya
aaj ghar se nahi jao baba
ro ke zainab ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
maan lo aaj ye baat meri
pyare baba pareshan hai beti
aaj ka din laga mujhko aise
jaise darbar ko maa gayi thi
waasta hai tumhe sayyeda ka
aaj ghar se nahi jao baba
ro ke zainab ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kal se kufe mein hai khauf phaila
shakhs dekha gaya ek aisa
zehar mein doobi talwaar thaame
wo bhi masjid ki jaanib gaya tha
ilteja sun lo meri khudara
aaj ghar se nahi jao baba
ro ke zainab ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaanti hoon mai ye baade zahra
ghar mein lagta nahi dil tumhara
aaj ke roz bas reh lo ghar mein
saani e fatema hoon mai baba
meri chadar ko kar lo musalla
aaj ghar se nahi jao baba
ro ke zainab ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya bataun tumhe dil ki haalat
toot jayegi hum par qayamat
jab se maa se juda hogaye hai
hai nahi gham ko sehne ki himmat
dekh sakte nahi hum janaza
aaj ghar se nahi jao baba
ro ke zainab ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum to khud jaante ho na baba
bewafa hai ye saara hi kufa
ye to pursa bhi hum ko na denge
fitraton mein hai inki madina
jaane kyun khinch raha hai kaleja
aaj ghar se nahi jao baba
ro ke zainab ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
raasta roka murghabiyon ne
haath jode hai khud betiyon ne
phir bhi masjid ki jaanib badhe wo
dekha azlaan sab kufiyon ne
bolti hi rahi binte zahra
aaj ghar se nahi jao baba
ro ke zainab ye...
items.author: Arslan Azmi

items.title: Ab shaam ho rahi hai
items.body:
KEHTI THI YE SAKINA, AB SHAM HO RAHI HAI
BOLO KAHAN HO BABA, AB SHAM HO RAHI HAI
JUNGLE ME MAI AKELI, DHOONDU KAHA BATAO
AAWAZ DEKE TUMHI, BETI KO AB BULLO
DIL MUZTARIB HAI MERA, AB SHAM HO RAHI HAI
KUCH TO BATAO MUJHKO, YEH KAISA IMTEHAN HAI
NEEND AYE KAISE MUJHKO, KAISA SEENA TERA KAHA HAI
BECHAIN HAI SAKINA, AB SHAM HO RAHI HAI
AB JALD AAO MUJHKO, AAGHOSH ME UTHALO
TUM APNI LADLI KO, SEEENE PE AB SULALO
NEEND AARAHI HAI BABA, AB SHAM HO RAHI HAI
GAUHAR BHI CHIN CHUKE HAI, KHATI HOON MAI TAMACHE
ZAQMI HAI KAAN MERE, RUQSAAR BHI HAI SOOJHE
YE HAAL DEKHO MERA, AB SHAM HO RAHI HAI
KAISE SITAM HUWE HAI, DEKHO HAMARA ALAM
KHAIME BHI JAL CHUKE HAI, BAITHE HAI QAAK PAR HUM
DIJYE HAME SAHARA, AB SHAM HO RAHI HAI
APNA CHAHCHA KO SARI RUDAD HAI SUNANI
BABA TUMHARI BETI MANGEGI AB NA PANI
AMMU KAHA HAI MERA , AB SHAM HO RAHI HAI
SARWAR KI LASH KAANPI RAN MEIN RASHEED US DUM
BEKAS YATEEM BACHI KARTI THI BAIN JIS DUM
BIBI KA THA YE NOUHA , AB SHAM HO RAHI HAI

items.title: Abbas se kehna hai
items.body:
ay ishq e hussaini mujhe aejaz dikha de
tu meri aqeedat ka mujhe aisa sila de
ek baar mujhe khwaab mein ghazi se mila de
jo baat hai is dil mein wo sarkar se kehna hai
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas se kehna hai abbas se kehna hai
abbas se kehna hai alamdar se kehna hai
abbas se kehna hai
ghazi alamdar e wafa ghazi alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas se kehna hai ke tum shaah e wafa ho
tum sheh ke alamdar sakina ke chacha ho
aur saare muhibbon ke liye dast e ata ho
abbas ghulami ki sanad aap se lena hai
abbas se kehna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo shaan e alamdar wohi shaan e alam hai
dono hi hamare hai ye maalik ka karam hai
maula ye alam aap ka ham sab ka bharam hai
hum ko to alam ke hi sada saaye mein rehna hai
abbas se kehna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum baab e hawaij ho waseela ho hamara
aata hai muraade liye chaukhat pe zamana
haa dar se tumhare koi khaali nahi jaata
allah se maanga hai magar tum ne dilana hai
abbas se kehna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham koi bhi jab dil ko hamare hai satata
jab koi kada waqt kabhi hum pe hai aata
abbas alam aap ka himmat hai badhata
dil toote to toota hua dil tum ko bulata hai
abbas se kehna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sayeen mere sarkar mere murshid o maula
is baar moharam mein ho mera bhi bulawa
likhwado mera naam bhi zawwaro mein aaqa
ro ro ke tumhe nauha sakina ka sunana hai
abbas se kehna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo jo bhi sitam baad e alamdar hua hai
sadaat ne pardes mein jo zulm saha hai
har mod pe zainab ne yehi ro ke kaha hai
is dil pe jo guzri hai kisi se nahi kehna hai
abbas se kehna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas se kehna hai ke ghar aao na maula
tum apni ziyarat hamein karwao na maula
ek tohfa tumhara hai wo le jao na maula
pani se bhari mashk sakina tumhe dena hai
abbas se kehna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas mere rab ka anmol waseela hai
mashoor zamane mein saqqa e sakina hai
har toote huwe dil ka abbas waseela hai
ye baab e hawaij hai har gham ka madawa hai
har lab ka wazeefa hai har dil mein dhadakta hai
girton ko uthaata hai doobo to bachata hai
taqdeer jagaata hai qismat ko sajaata hai
abbas se kehna hai abbas se kehna hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hasnain ka sadqa do abbas se kehna hai
jholi ko meri bhar do abbas se kehna hai
mushkil meri hal kar do abbas se kehna hai
parcham ki hawa dedo abbas se kehna hai
rauze pe bula bhejo zawwari ata kar do
maula ye karam kar do
abbas se kehna hai mujhe abbas se kehna hai
items.author: N. Sarwar & J. Jaffri

items.title: Akbar ki laash
items.body:
akbar ko maar daala ye jab ran mein shor utha
laashe pe aake rone lage shaahe karbala
dil mein sina thi aur badan tha kata hua
bete ka haal dekha to sambhla nahi gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ki laash par gire kehte huwe hussain
kya haal mere chaand se bete ka hogaya
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ne bhari jawani mein khaayi hai barchiyan
akbar ko maut aa gayi kaise sunegi maa
rakhti thi jisko ghar mein bhi laila naqaab mein
kiski nazar lagi mera ye laal mar gaya
akbar ki laash par...
<<DIVIDER>>
milte nahi thay tum mujhe ay mere naujawan
mai is liye bhi aaya hoon ghutno ke bal yahan
rakh rakh ke haath laashon pe dhoonda tera badan
beta tumhara gham meri beenayi le gaya
akbar ki laash par...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah kitne zakhm hai akbar ke jism par
talwarein sab ne maari hai ye bol bol kar
akbar ko maar do khud hi mar jayega hussain
bhoolunga kis tarha ye layeeno ka bolna
akbar ki laash par...
<<DIVIDER>>
bole hussain dekh ke tooti hui sina
zaalim ne mere sabr ka lena tha imtehan
ye keh ke barchi todi hai ibne numair ne
niklegi jab ye barchi kaleja bhi aayega
akbar ki laash par...
<<DIVIDER>>
shayad kisi ne gurz bhi maara hai khaynch kar
sehra mai kaise baandhunga zakhmi hai tera sar
attharwein baras mein hi jaata hai chod kar
dulha tujhe banaaun ye armaan reh gaya
akbar ki laash par...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaana hila hila ke ye bole shahe zaman
mayyat na apne bhai ki dekhe koi behen
sughra watan mein reh gayi acha hua magar
laasha tera sakina se kaise chupaunga
akbar ki laash par...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ki zakhmi laash se lipte huwe wahin
zainab na saath deti to mar jaate shaahe deen
haye kisi bhi baap pe aaye na ab kabhi
maula pe jaisa waqt tha zeeshan aur raza
akbar ki laash par...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Ali maulana
items.body:
ta surat e paywand e jahan bood ali bood
ta naqsh e zameen bood zamaan bood ali bood
shaahi ke wali bood o wasi bood ali bood
sultan e sakha o karam o jood ali bood
ham adam o ham shees o ham idris o ham ayub
ham yusuf o ham yunus o ham hood ali bood
ham musa o ham isa o ham khizr o ham ilyaas
ham saalih e paygambar o dawood ali bood
<<DIVIDER>>
taaron ne abhi aankh na kholi thi ali tha
na amn ka paigham na holi thi ali tha
daata tha duayein thi na jholi thi ali tha
khaaliq ki zaban kun bhi na boli thi ali tha
ali maulana ali ali maulana ali
<<DIVIDER>>
toote dilon ki sada ali maulana ali
taaj e wilayat tera ali maulana ali
haq ne kiya faisla khuld mein wo jayega
jo bhi mohib hai tera
ali maulana ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
angusht pe darwaza e khyber ko utaahle
jo doobte suraj ko ishaare se bulaale
toofano ka rukh phayr de mushkil se nikaale
jab chaahe jahan chaahe jise chaahe bachale
kulle emaan hai tu
rab ki pehchaan hai tu
deen ki jaan hai tu
ali maulana ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri jo fazeelat hai wo afsana nahi hai
munkir hai jise teri taraf aana nahi hai
juz zaat e mohamed koi pehchana nahi hai
dunya ne tujhe maana magar jaana nahi hai
ye tera jaah o hasham
saahib e tayg e do dam
hai tera sab pe karam
ali maulana ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu sab se badi khaliq e akbar ki nishani
na uska koi saani na tera koi saani
kehte hai ye quran ke tafseer o ma'ani
dunya ne abhi teri haqeeqat nahi jani
ayatullah bhi tu
wajhullah bhi tu
asadullah bhi tu
ali maulana ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum tere muqallid hai tu hi rehbar e azam
hai noor tera noor e khudawand e do aalam
ek bhai mohamed hai tera noor e mujassam
jhutlaye meri baat ko kis mein hai bhala dam
hai tu hi aala nasb
sher haq tera laqab
keh rahe hai yehi sab
ali maulana ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
doobte suraj ne kaha
chand sitaron ne kaha
laal qalandar ne kaha
tere liye hamd o sana
<<DIVIDER>>
na nooh thay na un ka safina tha ali tha
yasrab tha na makka na madina tha ali tha
abid na ibadat ka kareena tha ali tha
jis waqt pe marna tha na jeena tha na ali tha
<<DIVIDER>>
taskeen e dil o jaan to ibadat se milegi
tasdeeq ibadat ko mawadat se milegi
sajdon ko sanad teri wilayat se milegi
tauheed hamein teri mohabat se milegi
jo tujhe maane khuda
wo bhi munkir hai tera
ye aqeeda hai mera
ali maulana ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
padta hai teri shaan mein quran qaseede
alhamd se wal-naas talak hai tere charche
quran ki tilawat se khule raaz ye saare
wal-fajr bhi wal-shams bhi wal-layl bhi tu hai
aql mein aata nahi
qalb se jaata nahi
kya hai samajh aata nahi
ali maulana ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
juz tere kiya jis ne salooni ka ye daawa
jo poochna chahoge jawab uska milega
haathon ki hateli ki tarha se hai ye dunya
mai hota tere daur mein to pooch hi leta
kun faya kun ka safar
ye sitaron ka nagar
kya hai ye shams o qamar
ali maulana ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
ummat ne tere baad yateemo ko sataya
maula teri aulaad ko hai khoon rulaaya
ek pyase musafir ka lahoo ban mein bahaya
zainab ki rida loot ke qaimo ko jalaya
royi thi karbobala
aaiye sher e khuda
lut gayi aal e aba
ali maulana ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab shaam e ghariban ki rida dasht pe chaayi
ghazi ki behan ranj o masayib ki satayi
ek toota huwa naiza liye pehre pe aayi
haathon se jigar thaam ke deti thi duhaai
chin gayi meri rida
bhai bhi qatl huwa
aaiye karbabola
ali maulana ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte hai zamane se yehi mesum o mazhar
hum hyder e karraar ki dehleez ke naukar
rehti hai hama waqt sada ek labon par
is dar se bada saare zamane mein nahi dar
maalik e kauno makan
saat pardon mein niha
hai aqeedat ki azan
ali maulana ali...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Arbaeen mein
items.body:
maula bulalo karbobala arbaeen mein
<<DIVIDER>>
karte hai sogwaar dua arbaeen mein
maula bulalo karbobala arbaeen mein
<<DIVIDER>>
toote huwe dilon ki hai ye aas dekhle
ek baar hum bhi rauza e abbas dekhle
kar do sharaf ye humko ataa arbaeen mein
maula bulalo karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
aasaan kijiye sabhi dushwaar raaste
kab se tadap rahe hai ziyarat ke waaste
dikhla do khuld ek dafa arbaeen mein
maula bulalo karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaakar haram mein shukr ke sajde ada kare
maula har ek shaheed ki majlis bapa kare
hum bhi bichaye farshe aza arbaeen mein
maula bulalo karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
maula tumhe janab e sakina ka waasta
hum ko bhi dekhna hai wo jannat ka raasta
jaaye najaf se karbobala arbaeen mein
maula bulalo karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa baap se kiya hai ye waada dikhaunga
mai aap ko hussain ki dunya dikhaunga
karna hai mujhko waada wafa arbaeen mein
maula bulalo karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
har waqt bas ye fikr hai mere khayal mein
lagta hai mar na jaaun kahin is malaal mein
mai ek dafa bhi jaa na saka arbaeen mein
maula bulalo karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
is baar kar do mere safar ka kuch intezam
har saal soch soch ke reh jaata hai ghulam
jaati hai saari khalq e khuda arbaeen mein
maula bulalo karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
is ghamzada ke qalb ki khwahish hai aakhri
jis waqt bhi ho aap ke rauze pe haazri
ho jaye meri rooh fanaa arbaeen mein
maula bulalo karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai aamir o kumail ki maula se ilteja
hum bekason ka khalq mein tum hi ho aasra
kar lo qubool sab ki dua arbaeen mein
maula bulalo karbobala...
items.author: Kumail Jafri

items.title: Baghor sunle zamana
items.body:
baghor sun le zamana hussain aise thay
baqa fana ko banaya hussain aise thay
<<DIVIDER>>
churi ke neeche wo khaliq se pyar ki baatein
ajal ko ho gaya sakta hussain aise thay
<<DIVIDER>>
mukhalifat pe zamana tha us taraf lekin
wohi kiya jo kaha tha hussain aise thay
<<DIVIDER>>
sipahe shaam shujaat ka loha maan gayi
dabe na laakhon se tanha hussain aise thay
<<DIVIDER>>
kamar ko baandh ke peeri may jalti reti se
uthaya bete ka laasha hussain aise thay
<<DIVIDER>>
jawan ki laash uthayi banayi qabre sagheer
kahin bhi azm na badla hussain aise thay
<<DIVIDER>>
hazar shukr ke sajday shaheed karta hay
banaya qatre ko darya hussain aise thay
items.author: Shaheed Lakhnavi

items.title: Bekafan baap ki
items.body:
be kafan baap ki mayyat se guzara mujhko
kitna ummat ne mere baba sataya mujhko
<<DIVIDER>>
aablo se mere pairon ke lahoo jaari hai
ek qadam rakhna zameen par bhi mera bhari hai
haye kaanto pe kuch is tarha chalaya mujhko
be kafan baap ki mayyat...
<<DIVIDER>>
baad phir aap ke aada ne jalaye yun khayaam
jal ke qaime may hi mar jaata shariyat ka imam
jalte qaimon se phuphi jaan ne nikala mujhko
be kafan baap ki mayyat...
<<DIVIDER>>
saamne mere kaneezi may behen ko maanga
haye saadaat pe ummat ne hai sadqa phaynka
maar daalega mere baba ye sadma mujhko
be kafan baap ki mayyat...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab kabhi raah may qaidi ne jo paaya saaya
thak ke ek pal ke liye baithna chaaha baba
maar kar durra sitamgar ne uthaya mujhko
be kafan baap ki mayyat...
<<DIVIDER>>
bediyan payr may langar hai kamar may mere
zauf beemar ke tan may hai chale to kaise
tauq gardan may hai aada ne pinhaya mujhko
be kafan baap ki mayyat...
<<DIVIDER>>
roke kehti hai mujhe pani pilao bhaiya
mujhko zaalim ke tamachon se bachao bhaiya
hasrat o yaas se takti hai sakina mujhko
be kafan baap ki mayyat...
<<DIVIDER>>
har kisi baap ki chaahat ye hua karti hai
apne bete se bas umeed yehi hoti hai
gar marunga to pisar dega ye kaandha mujhko
be kafan baap ki mayyat...
<<DIVIDER>>
bekafan baap ke laashe se guzarta mai tha
aisa lagta tha ke dam mera nikal jayega
iss qadar aap ki ghurbat ka tha sadma mujhko
be kafan baap ki mayyat...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye danish mere maula ki ghareebi ka samaa
laasha e shaah pe kehta tha ye beta rehan
dard ab aur bhi hai baba uthana mujhko
be kafan baap ki mayyat...
items.author: Danish Mirza

items.title: Fatema zehra ke
items.body:
ho tasavvur aur ghame shabbir ho
haath ho seene pe zehn pa baysheer ho
ashk e gham mein kabhi tankeed ki parwa na karo
sada e girya ho yaade shahe dilgeer ho
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema zehra ke bachon par bahao aansu
aah bhar ke ghame sarwar par bahao aansu
fatema zehra ke bachon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo san e iksat hijri aur bala ka manzar
chaar jaanib thay darinde aur wo tanha sarwar
yaad e mazloomi e sarwar par bahao aansu
fatema zehra ke bachon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaeef kaandhe pe laash tha jawan ka logon
aur dile zainab e muztar ka tadapna logon
har nafas ghurbat e sarwar par bahao aansu
fatema zehra ke bachon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
maut ka darr na karo tum ho azadar e hussain
tumko deti hai dua azadar e hussain
bhool kar khauf e waba sheh par bahao aansu
fatema zehra ke bachon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne maa behno se karta hoo guzarish is dam
berida hoke kabhi tum na manana ye gham
khastatan saani e zehra par bahao aansu
fatema zehra ke bachon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
ho moharram ko tasavvur mein faqad ho sarwar
na siyasat ho zara dil mein faqad ho sarwar
khuloos e dil se shaheedon par bahao aansu
fatema zehra ke bachon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
nauha jo tu ne likha aazam jaza o ahsan
khatra jo aansu ke nikle hai bane wo marham
soch kar zakhmi shahe deen par bahao aansu
fatema zehra ke bachon par...
items.author: Azam Hussain

items.title: Haye ali akbar
items.body:
baap se maange ijazat ran ki jab kadiyal jawan
thaam kar dil shaah bole pehle do akbar azan
rodiye kauno makan jab kaha wo naujawan
allahu akbar allhu akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon mein doobi ali akbar ki jab aayi sada
ladkhadate suye maqtal chal diye shaahe huda
haye ali akbar haye ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
pahonch kar dekha ali akbar ka sheh ne haale zaar
seene mein barchi gadi hai dard se hai be-qaraar
haye ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
seena e akbar se barchi ko nikale jab hussain
sheh ke qaime se utha wa akbara ka shor o shain
haye ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
gul hua pal bhar mein laila ki umeedon ka charaagh
rehgaya ek maa ke dil mein hasrat o armaan ka daagh
haye ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ki nazron mein hui tareek aashiq kayenaat
sar jhuka kar ro rahe hai hoor o hilma ek saath
haye ali akbar...

items.title: Hussaini Arbaeen
items.body:
Ye Arbaeen Arbaeen Arbaeen Hai(2)
Akbar Ka Arbaeen
Asgar Ka Arbaeen
Moula Husain Aapke Lashqar Ka Arbaeen
Husaini Arbeen(2)
(1) Sarwar Ke Sogwaaro Ke Lab Par Hai Marsiya
Dil Me Game Husain Hai Aankho Me Karbala
Lazim Tamam Shey Pe He Shabbir Ki Aza
Utra Hai Aasma Se Farishto Ka Qafl
(2) Dehleeze Shaahe Di Pe He Maqqe Ka Ahtqaaf
Sab Ka Hai Ye Akida Nahi Koi Ikhtelaaf
Manzar Dikhai Deta Hai Qabe Ka Saaf Saaf
Sab Kar Rahe Hain Rouz E Shabbir Ka Tawaaf
(3) Hasil Irakiyo Ko Hai Moula Ki Noukri
Karte Hain Zayereen Ki Khidmat Khushi Khushi
Karbobala Ki Wadi Me Pyaaso Ke Naam Ki
Chaaro Taraf Hai Aaj Sabile Lagi Hu
(4 )Manzar Ye Arbeen Ke Jaisa Kahi Nahi
Kaale Libaas Me He Azadaare Shaahe Di
Farshe Aza Me Ho Gyi Tabdeel Sar Zami
Mehsoos Hota Hai Ke He Jannat Yahi Kahi
(5 )Ham Se Husain Razi Ho Sab Ka Hai Ye Hadaf
Maatam Ki Pursadaaro Ne Bandhi Hui Hai Saf
Aankhe Hain Karbala Me To Dil Hai Suye Najaf
Labbaik Ya Husain A.S Ka Hai Shor Har Taraf
(6) Kya Puchte Ho Zayere Sarwar Ki Manzelat
Deedare Karbala Se Banaate Hain Aakherat
Kis Ko Nahi Hai Shaahe Shaheeda Ki Marefat
Ye Wo Hai Bokhlaai Hai Jis Se Yazeediya
(7) Ye Shaah Ka Karishma Hai Ye Shaah Ki Bisaat
Choti Si Karbala Ko Di Itni Badi Hayaat
Lakho Nahi Yaha Pe Carodo Hai Ak Sath
Daato Tale Ab Ungli Dabaye N Kayenaat
(8) Kazim Ki Guftagu Hai To Rizwan Ka Qalam
Sun Kar Munafekeen Ka Niklega Aaj Dam
Hatho Me Leke Hazrate Abbas Ka Alam
Ye Ishq Ka Safar Yu Hi Jaari Rakhenge Ham

items.title: Jahan may fana ke
items.body:
baakhi raha hai kaun jahan mein fana ke baad
zinda magar hussain hai khatle jafa ke baad
baakhi raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaqa hai wo hamara hum uske ghulam hai
khabza hai kayenaat pe jiska khuda ke baad
baakhi raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai marqade hussain tamanna e aakhri
jannat bhi gar milay to na le karbala ke baad
baakhi raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
nusrat ko aa rahe hai malak chod kar falak
paaya sharaf hussain ne ye ambiya ke baad
baakhi raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
parde ki aayaton ki ye tafseer dekhlo
balon se moo chupaye haram hai rida ke baad
baakhi raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
karke baland haaton pe asghar ko bolay shaah
baakhi nahi hai ab koi is mehlakha ke baad
baakhi raha hai...

items.title: Karbala tayyar hai
items.body:
masjid bhi ro rahi hai kaaba bhi ro raha hai
hyder ka qatl kya hai aaghaaz e karbala hai
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala tayyar hai karbala tayyar hai
khoone hyder keh raha hai karbala tayyar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sogh mein doobi fiza hai karbala tayyar hai
khoone hyder keh raha hai karbala tayyar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aaye jab masjid se ghar mein zakhmi ho kar murtaza
baap ko tar khoon mein dekha ro ke zainab ne kaha
ab mujhe aisa laga hai karbala tayyar hai
khoone hyder keh raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aagayi sakte mein fizza kyun ye kya jaane koi
paaon mein baithi thi beti aur sarhane koi
keh ke ghazi chup khada hai karbala tayyar hai
khoone hyder keh raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
umme haani aur khadija ro ke ye kehne lagi
is qadar hai zakhm gehra khoon mein tar hai jabeen
haan ye manzar keh raha hai karbala tayyar hai
khoone hyder keh raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
fajr se yun rote rote bol uthi shaam e aza
rozadaron khaak udao hai ye ayyaam e e aza
dil sabhi ka sochta hai karbala tayyar hai
khoone hyder keh raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
phaynk kar chadar saron se betiyan hai mehwe gham
shaahe deen nauha kuna hai baith kar zer e alam
binte zehra berida hai karbala tayyar hai
khoone hyder keh raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehla gham zehra ka jaana doosra hyder ka gham
khud saf e matam bicha kar bol uthe shaah e umam
farshe gham ki ibteda hai karbala tayyar hai
khoone hyder keh raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab kahan taab e sukhan hai bas labon par jaan hai
safdar o mazhar ye nauha dard ka quran hai
ek mukammal marsiya hai karbala tayyar hai
khoone hyder keh raha hai...

items.title: Khat e sughra
items.body:
asghar ko jaga de koi
akbar ko bata de koi
bemaar behan ne khat mein
sab haal e zaar likha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ko duaein di hai
asghar ko pyar likha hai
bemaar behan ne khat mein
sab haal e zaar likha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sughra ne na poocho khat mein
kya kya tehreer kiya hai
poocha hai har ek bhai ko
zikre hamsheer kiya hai
kyun bhol gaye dukhiya ko
sab rishtedaar likha hai
bemaar behan ne khat mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhaiya ne khoob behan ki
ulfat ka karz chukaya
pardes mein jaa kar apna
waada bhi yaad na aaya
lene ko na aaye akbar
shikwa har baar likha hai
bemaar behan ne khat mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis din se aap gaye hai
udti hai khaak watan mein
kab jaane bahaar aayegi
umeed ke is gulshan mein
baba hai akele ghar mein
jeena dushwaar likha hai
bemaar behan ne khat mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
furqat mein jhula kar asghar
khaali tera gehwara
yaadon mein teri sughra ka
kat jaata hai din saara
nanhe se musafir tujh par
sadqe sau bar likha hai
bemaar behan ne khat mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
itni si dabe lafzon mein
sughra ne jasarat ki hai
ammu se gila furqat ka
baba se shikayat ki hai
kyun bhool gaye gurbat mein
sab zimmedar likha hai
bemaar behan ne khat mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab aun o mohamed mujhko
tanhaai mein yaad aate hai
do chand se chehre
meri nazron mein samaa jaate hai
kab hoga na jaane unka
mujhko dedaar likha hai
bemaar behan ne khat mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun door watan se jaa kar
saare ehbaab base hai
aankhon mein mere bhaiya ki
shadi ke khwaab saje hai
karti hoo khayalon mein mai
sehra tayyar likha hai
bemaar behan ne khat mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
padte hai shahe deen jab khat
har laash tadap jaati hai
qasim ko hijab aata hai
akbar ko haya aati hai
kya koi nahi hai baba
mera ghamkhwar likha hai
bemaar behan ne khat mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek baap ne aamir o akhtar
mushkil se jigar ko thaama
akbar ki laash pe rakha
ye keh ke behan ka naama
khud uth ke maseeha padh le
haal e bemaar likha hai
bemaar behan ne khat mein...
items.author: Akhtar Sirsvi

items.title: La denge tumhe
items.body:
mere ammu abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
jab pyaas badi pani na mila
to ro ke sakina ne di sada
ay mere chacha mai tum pe fida
asghar hai mera kab se pyasa
tum pyason ki saqqayi karo
darya se hame pani la do
sar choom ke phir shehzadi ka
abbas e jari ne farmaya
<<DIVIDER>>
la denge tumhe pani ye bacchon ko batado
hum nehr pe jaate hai ay shehzadi dua do
<<DIVIDER>>
hum baithe hai do zaanu tum aage badho bibi
khud haathon se mashkeeza kaandhe pe rakho bibi
ay pyasi sakina hume saqqa to bana do
hum nehr pe jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jaaun jo maidan mein teele pe chali aana
khud dekhna aankhon se saahil pe mera jaana
tum roz hi kehti thi ke siffeen suna do
hum nehr pe jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah kare jaldi ye khatm udaasi ho
abbas ke hote bhi seh roz se pyasi ho
mere bandhe haaton ko azaad kara do
hum nehr pe jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
izhaar na ho paya is quwwate baazu ka
majboor e ita'at hai dil phat'ta hai ammu ka
lillaah ab na kehna meri pyaas bujha do
hum nehr pe jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
khidmat mein bhatiji ki kaam aaye mere baazu
bil-farz jo darya par kat jaaye mere baazu
tadpogi nahi bibi yaqeen mujhko dila do
hum nehr pe jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ruqsat e aakhir hai baba ko tujhe saumpa
ab teeron ki baarish mein jaata hai tera saqqa
ek shor hai faujon mei kamar sheh ki jhuka do
hum nehr pe jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
pur khoon mein takallum jab wo mashk o alam dekhe
abbas ke bete ne ro kar kaha bibi se
baba ki tarha se hame mashkeeza to laa do
hum nehr pe jaate hai...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Maa kehti thi asghar
items.body:
Maa kehti thi asghar
[Haaye asghar, haay haay asghar] ×3
[Maa kehti thi asghar mere ghar lawt ke aana] ×3
Royi hu bhare ghar ko, muje tum na rulaana
[Maa kehti thi asghar mere ghar lawt ke aana] ×2
[Tu bol nahi sakta hai, kya mangega paani] ×2
Ay nehr mere laal ko, tu paani pilaana
[Maa kehti thi asghar mere ghar lawt ke aana] ×2
[Talwaar utha sakte nahi, tum mere beta] ×2
Tum teer-e-tabassum hi ko hathyaar banaana
[Maa kehti thi asghar mere ghar lawt ke aana] ×2
(Maydan me barsaat hai teero(n) ki meri jaan) x2
Ay laal mere teero(n) se, tum khud ko bachana
[Maa kehti thi asghar mere ghar lawt ke aana] ×2
(Aah nad-e-ali dam karoo(n) gardan pe teri mei) x2
Hai radde balaa ke liye, nuskha ye puraana
[Maa kehti thi asghar mere ghar lawt ke aana] ×2
(Sunti hu(n) lagaa teer gale par tere beta) x2
Ye zakhme guloo khuld mei, daada ko dikhana
[Maa kehti thi asghar mere ghar lawt ke aana] ×2
[Maloom tha mujhko ke tumhe pyaas hai kaysi] ×2
Marne ke liye paani ka, karte the bahaana
[Maa kehti thi asghar mere ghar lawt ke aana] ×2
("Rehan" dua karta hu(n) nohay ke sile me) x2
"Shabbir" ka shaair hi, kahe mujhko zamana
[Maa kehti thi asghar mere ghar lawt ke aana] ×2
[Haaye asghar, haay haay asghar] ×3

items.title: Aaj hai chaliswan
items.body:
shaam se jab ahlebait barsare uryan chale
yani suye karbobala chaak gareban chale
leke shaheedon ke sar besar o saaman chale
karte huwe ye bayan ba dile naalan chale
aaj chai chaliswan hazrate shabbir ka
syed e mazloom ka zehra ke masoom ka
aaj hai chaliswan
<<DIVIDER>>
raah mein unse koi poochta gar aan kar
kiske ho namoos tum kisko ho laqte jigar
kisne loota hai tumhe kisne kiya bepadar
kehte thay ahle haram ro ro ke ba chashme tar
tujhse bayan kya kare hum apne ehwaal ko
dafn karne hai chale fatema ke laal ko
syed e mazloom ka zehra ke masoom ka
aaj hai chaliswan
<<DIVIDER>>
wo haram e mohtaram shaah ke ba sad buka
manzilein tay karte haye pahunche thay jo karbala
door se jab qatlgaah inko dikhayi diya
ro ro ke kehne lage hazrate zainul liba
oonton se utro tum ab karte huwe shor o shain
ro ke chalo pyada paa yan se ba laashe hussain
syed e mazloom ka zehra ke masoom ka
aaj hai chaliswan

hazrate sajjad se sun ke haram ye kalaam

items.title: Haaye Zainab (s.a)
items.body:
1.
Haai Zainab veer di maut diyan
Ghadiyaan ghanaindi reh gayi
Nap ke der khaimay da haaye
Takraan marendi reh gayi
2.
Veer de walaan chay hath Shimr da
Saamnay bhaynee de haaye kusda
Hun te Ghazi aaway haaye
Wal wal saddayndi reh gayi
3.
Na Hussain koun maarein wasta ae
Kalli bhaynee da ay asra ae
Veer de qatil koun haaye
Mintaan karayndee reh gayi
4.
Lab Baisheer de hil gaaye
Behan paani ro payee
Gurbat taoun baun nimani
Tin dinaan taoun pyaasi haaye
Paani mangayndee reh gayi
5.
Bibi Zainab rondhi reh gayi
Ae kon hai eda naa kya hai
Ae sawaal Yazid karendha je
Bibi Zainab rondhi reh gayi
6.

Ho cha ungli-ishare denda je
Bibi Zainab rondhi reh gayi
Ae kon hai eda naa kya hai
Ae sawaal Yazid karendha je
7.
Rab jaarne kitne deen guzre
Bibi Zainab paarni peeta nai
Hik beh koo(n) darbari
Bhar jaam sharaab paleyndha je
8.
Thalle sirr Shabbir musafir da
Uthe takhat te zalim beytha haan
Zulfaa(n) vich hatth paake
Gustakkhi naal halendha je
9.
Ay shahi nay terey babey di
Hurn Qaidan banke aayi hai
Kitthe veer abbas hai vi
Enj beghayrat jhirdakendha je
10.
Bibi Zainab rondhi reh gayi
Ae kon hai eda naa kya hai
Ae sawaal Yazid karendha je
Bibi Zainab rondhi reh gayi

items.title: Jahan Sara Husain Se Hai
items.body:
Husain Se Hai Jahan Sara Jahan Sara Husain Se Hai,
Ye Hi To Hai Ham Sabhi Ka Naara Jahan Sara Husain Se Hai.
Isi Ne Quran Ko Bachaya Isi Ne Eemaan Ko Bachaya,
Isi Liye To Ye Dil Pukara Jahan Sara Husain Se Hai,
Agar Ye Qurba'n Na Hota Dee'n Par Na Hota Islam Bhi Kahi'n Par,
Kaho Ye Tum Bhi Sabhi Khudara Jahan Sara Husain Se Hai,
Zaban Apni Jo Kat Bhi Jaye Ye Jism Tukdo'n Me Bat Bhi Jaye,
Kahega Phir Bhi Lahoo Hamara Jahan Sara Husain Se Hai,
Ye Masjide'n Ye Namaz Or Deen Baqi Hai Bas Isi Ke Dam Se,
Ye Hi Hai Insaniyat Ka Naara Jahan Sara Husain Se Hai,
Palat Ke Aa Nafs-e-mutmainna Tu Mujhse Razi Main Tujhse Razi,
Khuda Ne Kahkar Kiya Ishaara Jahan Sara Husain Se Hai,
Qalam Ko Na Rokna Kabhi Tum 'Raees' Zikr-e-husainiyat Se,
Likhe Sada Ye Qalam Tumhara Jahan Sara Husain Se Hai.

items.title: La ilah hussain
items.body:
Banaye la-ilah hussain
Nabi ka ladla
Ali ka dilruba
Hasan ka rahnuma
Hamara badshah
1) hussain jiski dars gah bani hai god-e- Fatima,
Chirag-e-bazm e panjetan hasan ka hai ye dilruba,
Sukoon e qalbe murtaza sawar e doshe mustafa,
Hai naaze qibriya hussain
2) nabi ne jiske wastey hussaino minni tha khaha,
Hai ummate rasool ne usi pe dhai hai jafa,
Kiya mutaleba usi se bayyate yazid ka,
Ye kaise manta hussain
3) kada jo waqt agaya nabi ke paak deen ka,
Watan ko kehke alwida chaoa batool ka pisar,
Madine se shuru hua,
Yun sue karbala safar,
Yun Bewatan hua hussain
4) furat par jo khaimazan hua hussain kafela,
Yun ummate rasool ne chukaya ajre mustafa,
Nabi ki paak aal ka hai band aab kardiya,
Yun pyaasa rehgaya hussain
5) zameen pe aya zeen se kata ke baazu bawafa,
Sina ki nazr hogaya jawa'n pisar hussain ka,
Hai hurmala ke teer se chida sagheer ka gala,
Ghareebe nainawa hussain
6) fizae karbala me jab azaan gunji asr ki,
Mila bajaye aab ke wazu ko khoone asghari,
Imam ne ada kiya yun ran me sajda akhiri,
Khuda ki hai eaza hussain
7) tha haalate namaz me khuda se mehwe guftagu,
Churi se shimr ki kata sakhi hussain ka gulu,
Bachali shaahe deen ne yun ambiya ki aarzoo,
Qatile bekhata hussain
9) jawad tujhpe hai sada us hi hussain ki ata,
Aza ka jiski farsh hai jagah jagah bicha hua,
Har aankh ashk baar hai har ek dil hai ghamzada,
Har ek zaban pe hai ya hussain.

items.title: Chalo Karbala Chalein
items.body:
Har dil ki ye sadaa hai,chalo Karbala chalein;
Ye haq ka raasta hai, chalo Karbala chalein.
1) Mazloom e Karbala ki ziyarat jise mili,
Samjho ke do jahan ki nemat usey mili,
Qudrat ki ye ataa hai chalo Karbala chalein.
2) Zainab ki aarzu ke ye dekhe hain maujize,
Aate hain Karbala me subh o shaam qaafile,
Ye marzi e Khuda hai chalo Karbala chalein.
3) Jab zair e Hussain(as) chale sooye Karbala,
Lene ko uske aate hain Abbas-e-bawafa,
Kya martaba mila hai chalo Karbala chalein.
4) Boodhe, jawan, bacche sabhi iss dagar me hain,
Maazoor o natawa'an bhi shaamil safar me hain,
Ye zinda maujiza hai chalo Karbala chalein.
5) Toofaan o aandhiyon ka yahan zikr hi nahi,
Zaair ko mausamo'n ki koi fikr hi nahi,
Saaya Imam(as) ka hai, chalo Karbala chalein.
6) Mazhab ki koi qaid na maslak ki bartari,
Jis dil me bhi basi hai mohabbat Hussain(as) ki,
Us dil ka faisla hai, chalo Karbala chalein.
7) Dehshat se zulm o jabr se rukta nahi ye gham,
Har haal me Hussain(as) ka maatam karenge hum,
Zehra(sa) ki ye dua hai, chalo Karbala chalein.
8) Ye nazm e kayenaat hai jiski panaah me,
Shaahoun ke sar bhi jhukte hain jis bargaah me,
Wo dar Hussain(as) ka hai, chalo Karbala chalein.
9) Khaak-e-shifa se badh ke nahi quld ki ataa,
Utre hain aasmaa'n se ye kehkar malaayeka,
Jannat me kya rakha hai, chalo Karbala chalein.
10) Ye ittehaad o pyaar o mohabbat ko dekhkar,
Rauze pe zaairon ki aqeedat ko dekhkar,
Kaaba bhi kehraha hai, chalo Karbala chalein.
11) Hasnain aur Nawaaz ko Moula bulaaiye,
Aankhoun se Karbala ki ye jannat dikhaaiye,
Har pal yehi dua hai, chalo Karbala chalein.

items.title: Dil Kahe Mola Hussain
items.body:
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
Hussaino minni ki ye sada hai hussain jaisa koi nahi hai
yahi shareeat ka aaina hai yahi mohabbat ki inteha hai
Sare azadaro pe ye ahsan usi ka hai
daman me jo ishq shahe kaunain ko bakhsha hai
jo dil hai parwan chadha mola ki mohabbat se
ban ke lahu name sarwar us dil me dhadakta hai
ye dil kahe mera mola hussain
saanso pa hai tera pahra hussain
har soo hussaina ki sada dono jahan par hai chahi hui
ashke aza ke saath me meraj par hai meri bandagi
kausar ki aabru zamzam ki aabru
kabe ki hai sada hussain kubaku
insaniat ki baqa ke liye baiat na ki sar dia ya hussain
tu adl ka maiaar hai tu hi mohammad ka kirdar hai
tu hai shareeat ki zaban inkare deen tera inkar hai
deen ki pahchan hai roohe quraan hai
tujh se wabastagi aine imaan hai
usko yaqeenan khuda mil gaya jis shkhs ko tu mila ya hussain
hussain sa rahnuma jahan me koi nahi hoga
ye faisla ho gaya khuda ka kahin nahi hoga
hidayato ka charagh hai ye nabi ka aaina
jahan me raushan inhi ke dam se wafa ki hai dunia
jab se pade tere qadam karbobala aasman ban gai
is pe lahu tera baha ye khak rashke jinaa ban gai
tabibe be kasaan hakime nafse jaan
hai sooraj ki qadmo ka har nishan
sab arsh waale yahin hain makin jannat teri karbala ya hussain
teri shahadat ke sabab dunia ko raahe baqa mil gai
marna khuda ki raah me mitna nahi hai yahi zindagi
dunia me dekh lo ab kiska naam hai
raze haqqaniat kiska paigham hai
ahle sitam ka nishan tak nahin zinda hai teri wafa ya hussain
shujaaton ki misal ban kar jahan pe cha baithe
sitamgaron ki sitam zarifi ko aazma baithe
gala kataya bala ke ran me ali ke bete ne
tamam soye huye dilo ko magar jaga baithe
zalim ne ki baiat talab shabbir ne usko thukra dia
wo kaun the kya azm tha deke lahu sabko batla dia
sab zulm mit gaye zinda hai karbala
fathe shabbir hai azaano ki sada
phir koi baiat na mangi gai inkar tha tera aysa hussain
wo aashiqe shahe zaman baiat sitamgar ki karte nahi
haq ke liye dete hain jaan marte to hain phir bhi marte nahi
tera ye hai karam aye sultane umam
jhukne nahi dia deene haq ka alam
karbobala ki yahi hai sada har su ho haq ki zia ya hussain
deen ki jaan hussain mera imaan hussain
rabbe kaba ki qasam hai quraan hussain
shahe mardaan hussain shere yazdaan hussain
jahan jahan khuda waha wahan hussain
aye shahe karbala aye jaane mustafa
aye zahra ke pisar quwwate murtaza
tune sar de dia aur na uff kia
deene haq ke liye ghar bhi luta dia
karbal me wada wafa kar dia nana se jo tha kia ya hussain
tera karam be inteha teri ataa ki koi had nahi
jo bhi tere dar pe gaya hur kar dia aapne bilyaqeen
aye ibne murtaza sultane karbala
tu ba kamal hai jamale mustafa
sadiyon se dono jahan ke liye jari hai teri ataa ya hussain
ye karwane shahe deen haqqaniat ka bharam ban gaya
fathe hussaini ka nishan dekho jari ka alam ban gaya
jab ye lahraega sab ko bataega
fathe islam ki yaad dilayega
ahle sitam ka sitam thak gaya ayesa tera sabr tha ya hussain
mera aaqa hussain mera qibla hussain
sari dunia kahe meri dunia hussain
shane wafa hussain jane azaa hussain
deene islam ki tu hai baqaa hussian
waqre mustafa aye fakhre ambiya
aye zinate pidar sukune sayyada
shaheede karbala mazlume nainawa
tune raushan kia charaghe lailah
tu rab se razi hai tujh se khuda aye shae sabro raza ya hussain
deene khuda ki aas tu tujh par jami hai nigahe haram
tu hai waqare ambiya tu hi nuqushe wafa ka bharam
tu hi islam hai tu hi hai bandagi
tune ata kia deen ko zindagi
har ik sadi ki zarurat hai tu har marz ki hai dawa ya hussain
aye aashqane shahe deen duniaya se kah do wasimo raza
ye maatme shabbir hai har pairwane sitam ki qaza
ye ishqe gham nahi aik tufan hai
kuzaye chashm me shah ka rman hai
ye ashk karta hai har su bayan rudade karbobala ya Hussain

items.title: Armaan Tha Sehray Ka
items.body:
Jis chaand se chehray pe armaan tha sehray ka
Hain saamnay laila ke ab uska jawaa(n) laasha
<<DIVIDER>>
Noshaah bana dekha maa ne jissay khwaabo mein
Woh laal jo ghar bhar ki aankho ka ujaala tha
*Hain saamnay laila ke ab uska jawaa(n) laasha*
<<DIVIDER>>
Uljha huwa barchi mei dil bhi hain kaleja bhi
Jis seeney mei dil maa ka behno(n) ka dharakta tha
*Hain saamnay laila ke ab uska jawaa(n) laasha*
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaandha bhi koyi dene aaya na janaazey ko
Bas baap tha betey ki mayyat ke uthanay ko
Ghurbat mei jisse tanha sarwar ne uthaaya tha
*Hain saamnay laila ke ab uska jawaa(n) laasha*
<<DIVIDER>>
Seeney ka lahoo roka zainab ne jo haatho(n) se
Kehti thi koyi jaake abbas ko batlaade
Maara gaya barchi se atthara baras waala
*Hain saamnay laila ke ab uska jawaa(n) laasha*
<<DIVIDER>>
Din byaah ke aaye toh Akbar ko qazaa aayi
Ab laut ke Sughra na aayega tera bhaayi
Ghar laut ke aane ka jis ne tha kiya waada
*Hain saamnay laila ke ab uska jawaa(n) laasha*

items.title: Ay maut teher ja
items.body:

dekha hai na suna hai kabhi aisa waqiya

dekhegi ye kin aankhon se manzar ko uski maa
ay maut teher ja...

beta to ek zameen par chal paaya na mera

jhoole mein abhi dhoondti hai usko uski maa
ay maut teher ja...

jaungi kaise chod ke maqtal ko mai bhala
sotay hai yahan bete aur sartaj bhi mera
kehti hai ek bete se ye usko uski maa
ay maut teher ja...

bemaar ko bhi chain kahan baade karbala
zakhmo pe zakhm usko bhi ek saat hai mila
lo jaa rahi hai chod ke ab usko uski maa
ay maut teher ja...

pahunchu dare haider pe hai armaan naeem ka
nauha padhun mai rauze pe hamshakle nabi ka
deti hai dua aaj ye bas usko uski maa
ay maut teher ja...

items.title: Bahot gham milay
items.body:
bahot gham milay baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan mein baba ka sar jo mila
bali sakina ne nauha kiya
pardes mein hogayi be-amaan
bahot gham milay baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kya na dhaaye sitam ashkiyan ne
khaati rahi bibiyan taaziyane
thi ek rasan aur baara galay
mai khad mein choti sab thay bade
ghuton pe meelon chali bibiyan
bahot gham milay...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam e ghariban ka ghamnaak manzar
qaime hamare thay sholon ki zad par
bistar jala bhai sajjad ka
gehwara e bezaban bhi jala
manzar tha wo al hafeez o amaan
bahot gham milay...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab ban mein aayi gyara moharram
baba tha mujh par aseeri ka aalam
phir mere dil par sitam ye hua
naize pe sar aap ka aa gaya
aankhon se khoone jigar tha rawan
bahot gham milay...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko tamache sitamgar ne maare
sajjad khaata raha taaziyane
tishna labi aur safar ki thakan
karte bhi kya dono bhai behan
dete rahe sabr ka imtehan
bahot gham milay...

phir kaan zakhmi kurta jala tha
chaale zuban par sookha gala tha
soti to sone na dete zara
royi to rone pe pehra laga
mujh par hui hai badi sakhtiyan
bahot gham milay...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha ye taqaza unki wafa ka
gham mujhse poocho mere chacha ka
dekhe jo phupiyon ke sar berida
naize se ammu ka sar gir gaya
hai yaad wo shor e aah o fughan
bahot gham milay...
<<DIVIDER>>
haa mere baba hai yaad ab bhi
jab pushte naaqa se mai gir gayi thi
tumse bichad kar mai soti na thi
aaghosh e zehra mein neend aagayi
baad uske phir neend aayi kahan
bahot gham milay...
<<DIVIDER>>
balon pe mere jo hai safedi
gham ki fazayein dekhi hai aisi
nauhon ka kamsin saheefa hoo mai
ek chaar saala zaeefa hoo mai
kham hai kamar meri misle kamaan
bahot gham milay...
<<DIVIDER>>
nauha jo likha hameed abidi ne
likhwaya shabbir ki laadli ne
nauhon se safdar ki pehchaan hai
bali sakina ka ehsaan hai
jo aaj nauha hai wirde zaban
bahot gham milay...

items.title: Fatima Darbar Mein
items.body:

items.title: Haaye Zainab(Sa)
items.body:
Shaam e gareeba'n khoon ka darya haaye zainab haaye zainab
Kaisey dekhey bhai ka laasha' haaye Zainab haaye zaianb
1) Aun o Mohammad akbar o asgar
Qasim o gaazi aur sarwar
Sorahaa hai saara kunba'
Haaye zainab haaye zainab
2) Jalgaye khaimey chingayi chaadar
Gash mey padaa hai aabed e muztar
Koi nahi hai sarr pey saaya
Haaye zainab haaye zainab
3) Dukhtar e shah jab khaayi tamaacha
Koi na aaya deney dilaasa
Kya Karey us damm bintey Zehra
Haaye zainab haaye zainab
4) Naizo'n pey hai sab laadlo'n ke sarr
Jism hai jalti reyt ke oopar
Kaisey ye manzar tumney dekha
Haaye zainab haaye zainab
5) Maadar e qasim ki thi tamanna
Doolha baney Shabbar ka pyaara
Surq hai khoo'n se uska sehra
Haaye zainab haaye zainab
6) Choti Zehra par ye mazaalim
Kaan ke gauhar cheenli zaalim
Kaisey bachaaye usko dukhiya
Haaye zainab haaye zainab
7) Aankh se aansu rota hai *Jaafar*
Aur *Qasim* peet'ta hai sarr
Jab bhi padhey ye bibi ka nauha'
Haaye zainab haaye zainab

items.title: Haye ali qatl hogaye
items.body:
haye ali qatl hogaye

shehzadiyo ne jyon hi suni gham ki ye sada
betaab hoke royi aur hasnain se kaha

ye kaun keh raha hai hue qatl murtaza

zarbe layeen se hogaya jis dam do para sar
us dam alam se hilte thay masjid ke baam o dar
mehraab aur musalla hua saara khoon mein tar
kaampa falak to zalzala aaya zameen par
haye ali qatl...

daude ye sunte hi suye masjid hassan hussain
dekha namazi karte hai naale ba shor o shain
apne lahoo mein laut'te hai shaahe mashraqain
paaya pidar ko aise kiye dono ne ye bain
haye ali qatl...

dekha namaziyo ne jo beton ko hat gaye
hasnain bad ke apne pidar se lipat gaye
naale kiye wo sunke jigar gham se phat gaye
riqqat se doston ke kaleje ulat gaye
haye ali qatl...

yan ho rahi thi seena zani naala-o-buka
aayi kahin khareeb se fizza ki ye sada
zehra ki betiyon ko nahi yaara zabt ka
bechain hai wo dekhne ko haale murtaza
haye ali qatl...

kya haal hai pidar ka na aakar bataoge

items.body:

ISS BARAS ARBAEEN ME GAZI NAAM HO ZAYERIN ME MERA
____________
1- QAFLE AAP KI ZIYARAT KO

NAAM HO ZAERIN ME MERA
________________
5- KISMATE HUR SAWARME WALE, DEE PE SIR APNA WARNE WALE

SUNLO FARIYAAD APNE SHAYDA KI, WASTA APKO SAKINA KA

______________
6- AP MUSHKIL KUSHA KE BETE HAY, AP HAJAT RAWA KE BETE HAY

BHEEK DE DIJE APNE DAR KI HAME, AYE SHAHE YASRABO SHAHE BATHA

7- AKE HUM OW MAKAM DEKHENGE, KHAYI AKBAR NE JIS JAGAH BARCHI

items.title: had a thousand sons I’d name them all Ali
items.body:
With no family… he calls out proudly
By the son of Ali… we’ll never leave Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
By our guide Mohammed who never told a lie
By the household that never once uttered “I lie”
By the awaited saviour to whom we ally
By these moons never late and suns never early
Not a lie, on our eyes lies “allied to Ali”
<<DIVIDER>>
The eye never lies… written on our eyes
We’ll never leave Ali even if every eye dies
To prove we’re with Ali… we swear it by Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
Against seventy thousand he cried out “Haider”
A pride that slept in his blood and none could hide her
Against the world he held the pride of his leader
Against the seven skies like a flash of thunder
He replied when they cried “we shall avenge Badr”
“Ali is my leader and none could be prouder”
<<DIVIDER>>
He killed thirty-five… for vengeance they’d strive
And yet one thousand years later, Ali’s still alive
Always living, Ali… none can defeat Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
His allegiance is not choice, it flows in the blood
All created from mud, but us from Ali’s mud
The father of dust became to dust a beloved
And turned every grain of dust into a rose bud
The eye’s gaze stays fixed on whatever the eye’s loved
And against the shore of Ali his lovers flood
<<DIVIDER>>
Just like skin and hair… or breathing and air
His name is fused with our blood and comforts all despair
In the bloodstream, Ali… unseperable, Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
To Hussain his father was not just a parent
Their connection a secret and not apparent
If Ali’s the memory, Hussain’s the moment
Just as we’ve held onto Ali despite torment
<<DIVIDER>>
He saw Ali’s worth… and cried with our birth
When all hated Ali… we stood beside Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
Seeing the strike on the head of Ali Akbar
Hussain remembers the strike upon his father
Like the strike on his father yet like no other
The strike does not reach his skull but reaches further
To the name ‘Ali’ no other was worthier
They wanted to kill Ali and found another
<<DIVIDER>>
And all Hussain sees… are the two Alis
Two memories clash together like the clash of seas
The son he’d named Ali… had become like Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
“Ali” on his tongue and “Ali” upon each lip
Against the sea of enemies like a warship
He cries out “remembering Ali is worship”
Seeking Ali’s love, arrows into his chest rip
Till the ship of salvation boarded Ali’s ship
<<DIVIDER>>
And still this Hussain… on Karbala’s plain
Cries out “Ali’s in my heart, my soul and every vein”
Headless, he meets Ali… in the love of Ali

items.title: Khayaal-e-Fatima Deen Ki Hai Abroo Zainab
items.body:
Ali Imam Ki Sajdon Main Aarzoo Zainab.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hay Zay Say Zeenat-e-Ajdaad Ye Say Yakta Hay
To Noon Say Yeh Naboowat Ki Mohsina Ttheri
Jo Bay Kay Raaz Ko Kholoon To Bay Ali Mola
Thi Baab-e-Ilm Ki Beti Muallima Ttheri
Misaal-e-fatemah Zehra Hay Hoobahoo Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Mujhay Hussain Ki Bemisl Sajdahgah Ki Qasam
Kaheen Na Hoteen Namaz-o-Quraan Ki Baatain
Manaat-o-Laat Ki Pooja Bahaal Ho Jaati
Na Koi Karta Dehr Main Eemaan Ki Baatain
Sunaanay Khutbay Jo Jaati Na Koobakoo Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Janab-e-Akbar-e-Zejaah Ki Parwarish Karkay
Muqaam-e-Aamina Khaaliq Say Paa Gai Bibi
Janaab-e-Aabid-e-Beemaar Ki Baqa Kay Liyay
Dayaar-e-Shaam Main Sir Nangay Aagai Bibi
Ali Ki Tarah Thi Baatil Kay Roobaroo Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Ajeeb Aalam-e-Ghurbat Tha Shaam Main Logo
Rasan Main Qaidi Thee Baalon Say Moon Chupayay Huay
Chahaar Simt Say Honay Lagi Thi Sangbaari
Hui Jo Daakhil-e-Bazaar Sir Jhukayay Huay
Bachaati Deen Ko Hogai Lahoo Lahoo Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Kabhi Sakeena Ko Deti Rahi Dilaasay Wo
Kabhi Rubab Ka Ghurbat Main Gham Banati Thi
Kabhi Sajjad Kay Ashkon Ko Saaf Karti Thee
Kabhi Wo Farwa Ko Apnay Galay Lagaati Thi
Bari Katthin Thi Jo Karti Thi Justujoo Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Janaab-e-Syed-e-Sajjad Aik Din Logo
Chalay To Gir Paray Qadam Uttha Na Sakay
Yun Shimr Koray Ko Lehraata Aagaya Yakdum
Haram Zaeef Ko Maloon Say Bacha Na Sakay
Ajeeb Yaas Say Takti Thi Chaar Soo Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Hujoom-aam Say Guzri To Aik Aurat Nay
Ali Ki Beti Ko Pathar Uttha Kay Maara Tha
Baha Jo Khoon To Chehray Pay Ik Naqaab Bana
Yeh Pardadaar Ki Fatha Ka Ik Ishaara Tha
Chalee Thi Jaanib-e-darbaar Surkhuroo Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Dayaar-e-Ghair Main Tauqeer Pardaydaari Ko
Ali Ki Beti Nay Kuch Iss Tarah Sajaya Tha
Banaya Baalonn Say Parda To Sir Pay Khaak-e-shifa
Zubaan Pay Lehja-e-Shair-e-khudda Sajjkaya Tha
Ali Kay Lehjay Main Karti Thi Guftagoo Zainab

ruksat ki ghadi h mera dil hota h bezaar
bus ek yehi baat to kahti hoo'n main so baar
tum rahna hamesha mere baccho'n se khabardaar
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye meri wasiyat na kabhi talna fizza
baccho'n ko mere maa'n ki tarha palna fizza
<<DIVIDER>>
rishta ye muhabbat ka kahi'n tod na jana
mushkil ki ghadi aaaye to munh mod naa jana
baccho'n ko musibat me mere chod na jana
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye meri wasiyat na kabhi talna fizza
baccho'n ko mere maa'n ki tarha palna fizza
ae ahsano fakhri ye baya'n karti thi zehra
dum hontho'n pe tha aur fuga'n karti thi zehra
ek dil ki tadap thi jo aya'n karti thi zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye meri wasiyat na kabhi talna fizza
baccho'n ko mere maa'n ki tarha palna fizza
