items.title: Aaj meri maa
items.body:
jab aaye qabr mein dafna ke fatema ko ali
kaha hussain se aayengi ab na amma kabhi
tumhe pilaunga beta mai aaj se pani
ye pehli raat yaad aayegi bahot maa ki
tumhari fikr mein hogi lehad mein maa bechain
subha se jaage ho so jao thodi dayr hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
badh kar ali ne galay jab lagaya
ye keh ke shabbir ne sar uthaya
aaj meri maa chali gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
baba mujhe ye batayein
kyun chod jaati hai maayein
seene se apne laga kar
ab kaun dega duayein
nazron se jaata nahi maa ka chehra
kaise mujhe neend aayegi baba
aaj meri maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
rota hoon jab se suna hai
maa ko tamacha laga hai
aulaad ke saamne kya
maa ko koi maarta hai
ye waqt baba kisi par na aaye
maa apne bacchon se chehra chupaye
aaj meri maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
darwaza maa par gira kar
kehne laga ek sitamgar
aaj itna zehra ko maaro
uth na sake zindagi bhar
hasta raha maar kar taziyane
aaya nahi maa ko koi bachane
aaj meri maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
baazu hi jab toot jaaye
kaise koi haath uthaye
bete ko is haal mein maa
seene se kaise lagaye
phir bhi mere naaz uthaati thi amma
takleef mein muskurati thi amma
aaj meri maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa mar gayi hai pata tha
par dil nahi maanta tha
aur aap ne mere baba
jab ghusl unko diya tha
yun cheekh kar aap roye thay baba
us waqt mujhko yaqeen aagaya tha
aaj meri maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye mai darbar se ghar
aaya tha jab maa ko le kar
raste mein amma ke paon
khat khaynchte thay zameen par
aise khadam wo uthaati thi baba
chalti thi phir baith jaati thi baba
aaj meri maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
maara tha zaalim ne baba
jis haath par taaziyana
bhoolunga kaise mai maa ka
wo haath mujhse chupana
wo neel meri nazar mein tab aaya
maa ne kafan khol kar jab bulaya
aaj meri maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab door apne watan se
mehroom ho kar kafan se
laasha pada hoga mera
lut jayega sab badan se
jaaunga ek roz karbobala mai
lekin ghareeb aaj se hogaya mai
aaj meri maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene se apne laga kar
us dam bahot roye hyder
haye raza aur zeeshan
jab bole shabbir ro kar
maa mar gayi ab jiyunga mai kaise
ay kaash mar jaata mai unse pehle
aaj meri maa...

items.title: Ab Toh Ghazi Ko Do Sada Zainab
items.body:
Ab Toh Ghazi Ko Do Sada Zainab, Shimar Khaimay May Aah Na Jayay Kahin.
<<DIVIDER>>
Keh Rahee Thee Fizza Yeh Ro Ro Kar,
Ab To Khaimay Bee Jhal Chukay Bibi,
Zulm Zaalim Na Aur Daayay Kahin.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab Sakina Na Jaana Maqtal May, Dhoor Say Shimaar Dekhta Hoga
Ab Sakina Na Jaana Maqtal May, Phir Tamachay Nah Yeh Lagaye Kahin.

items.title: Abbas tum kahan ho
items.body:
ya aqi ho kahan
aina abbas aina abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab pukari rokar abbas tum kahan ho
hote hai zulm hum par abbas tum kahan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
bas ek hi rasan mein baara gale bandhe hai
har ek qadam pe bhai dam sab ke ghut rahe hai
ay bawafa dilawar abbas tum kahan ho
zainab pukari rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aada ne kar diya hai dushwar iska jeena
har saans le rahi hai mushkil se ab sakina
ab jaan balab hai dukhtar abbas tum kahan ho
zainab pukari rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum sab ke sar khule hai abid ka sar jhuka hai
sadme se sar jhuka kar bemaar ro raha hai
mar jaaye na ye laaghar abbas tum kahan ho
zainab pukari rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri behen pe durre barsa rahe hai aada
kis ko bulaye zainab itna bata do bhaiya
koi nahi hai yawar abbas tum kahan ho
zainab pukari rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
apna nahi hai koi aa kar jo inko roke
baaghi ki ye behen hai shaami ye kehke mujhpe
barsa rahe hai patthar abbas tum kahan ho
zainab pukari rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ahle haram pe zaalim angaare phaynkte hai
arz o samaa hamari ghurbat pe ro rahe hai
ghayyur sher e hyder abbas tum kahan ho
zainab pukari rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne alam ko laa kar meri rida bana do
darbar ja rahi hoon kuch hausla badha do
sar par nahi hai chadar abbas tum kahan ho
zainab pukari rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
waiz ali mohammad wo dard ki ghadi thi
darbar mein ye zainab jab roke keh rahi thi
hai hashr ka ye manzar abbas tum kahan ho
zainab pukari rokar...

items.title: Akbar ko na maaro
items.body:
ay baba alaika minni as salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
jab ye awaaz suni jawan bete ki
shaah gir gir ke uthe suye maidan chale
haath akbar ka kaleje pe jo dekha to kaha
ay barchiyon waalon akbar ko na maaro
mere akbar ko na maaro
<<DIVIDER>>
allah allah kahin teer kahin bhaala hai
kya isay barchiyan khaane ke liye paala hai
ye mera noore nazar shabihe paighambar
ye agar maara gaya mai bhi na jee paaunga
ay barchiyon waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye abbas ke marne se kamar may kham hai
aur akbar ki judaai may nazar bhi kam hai
dekho mai tanha hoo ghareeb kitna hoo
mera ab koi nahi hai ali akbar ke siwa
ay barchiyon waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghayr kar dasht may tum maar rahe ho jis ko
mil ke do maaon ne parwaan chadaya is ko
naiza bardaron ruko kuch to ehsaas karo
seh na payengi ye gham zainab o umme laila
ay barchiyon waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi akbar to kabhi suye madina dekha
dasht may jaate huwe yaad jab aayi sughra
bole maula ro kar wo yahan hoti agar
dekhti kaisi jawan bhai ka zakhmi seena
ay barchiyon waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya tumhari koi aulaad nahi hai bolo
beta kis tarha jawan hota hai mujhse poocho
gurz se zakhmi hai sar hai lahoo chehre par
mera armaan tha akbar ke ho sar par sehra
ay barchiyon waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
maula jab bete ke paas aaye suno kya dekha
aediyan khaak pe akbar ko ragadta dekha
sabr phir toot gaya shaah ne ro ke kaha
shiddat e dard se mar jaaye na akbar mera
ay barchiyon waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kabhi socha hai zeeshan aur irfan e aza
kaise us baap ne bete ka uthaaya laasha
haye jo qaimon se ghutniyo chalte huwe
naujawan laash tak aaya ye sada deta hua
ay barchiyon waalon...

items.title: Ali rone lage
items.body:
rone waalon rone waalon
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar beti ke aansu khud bhi ro jaata hai baap
kitna bebas betiyon ke gham mein ho jaata hai baap
<<DIVIDER>>
sar shikasta hogaya lekin ali khamosh thay
betiyon ka jab khayal aaya ali rone lage
<<DIVIDER>>
dard ki shiddat mein bhi na aankh se aansu bahe
betiyon ka jab khayal aaya ali rone lage
<<DIVIDER>>
jab hassan ne baap ka sar apne zaano par rakha
zakhm gehra dekh ke shabbir ne girya kiya
apne beton ko musalsal hausla dete rahe
betiyon ka jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
betiyon ke haal ka tha baap ki aankhon mein gham
haye zainab haye chadar keh rahe thay har qadam
masjid e kufa se ghar tak raaston ko dekh ke
betiyon ka jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh ke is haal mein mar jaaye na zainab meri
saamne uske mai ghar se chal ke aaya tha abhi
apne beton ke sahare haye ghar jaate huwe
betiyon ka jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala yaad aayi to chooma gala shabbir ka
aur phir abbas ke shaano ka bhi bosa liya
haan magar sajjad ke nanhe se paon choom ke
betiyon ka jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitne manzar aa rahe thay murtaza ke roo baroo
zakhmi sar se beh ke aa pahuncha jo chehre tak lahoo
shaam mein sar pe baraste patharon ka soch ke
betiyon ka jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab gayi darbar zahra thay sahabi saamne
shaam ke darbar mein honge sharabi saamne
aakhri sanson mein naame fatema lete huwe
betiyon ka jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun ali ki aankh se hote rahe aansu rawan
bas wo samjhega khuda ne di hai jis ko betiyan
dil tadap kar reh gaya jab ye suna zeeshan se
betiyon ka jab...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: As sham as sham
items.body:
abid se jab watan mein kisi ne kiya kalaam
guzre kalak zyada kahan tumpe ya imam
abid ne teen baar kaha shaam shaam shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
as-sham as-sham as-sham kaha
bazaar mein jaana yaad raha
<<DIVIDER>>
pabande rasan beparda haram
bazaar mein aayi maa bandi
un galiyon mein bazaaron mein
abid pe qayamat kya guzri
pathar dil un bedardo ka
bazaar sajana yaad raha
as-sham as-sham...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab yaad wo manzar aata tha
sajjad ka dil khoon rota tha
aankhon se lahoo barsaata tha
ek dard jigar mein hota tha
bemaar tadapta tha keh kar
ghurbat ka zamana yaad raha
as-sham as-sham...
<<DIVIDER>>
naizo pe shaheedo ke sar thay
aur ahle haram be chadar thay
lachaar haram bazaaron mein
bas ahle sitam ki zad par thay
pardes mein khoon rokar mujhko
ye zakhm uthana yaad raha
as-sham as-sham...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ahle shaam tamashayi
hum par pathar barsate thay
bazaaron se darbaron tak
hum sar ko jhuka kar jaate thay
ghairat ki sabab un raahon mein
sar apna jhukana yaad raha
as-sham as-sham...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaati thi tamache zaalim ke
masoom sakina raahon mein
dil ab bhi laraz jaata hai mera
wo dard tha uski aankhon mein
meri mazloom sakina ka
ghazi ko bulana yaad raha
as-sham as-sham...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ki khwahar ko zaalim
baaghi ki behan jab kehte thay
dil khoon ke aansu rota tha
jis waqt ye taane sehte thay
wo meri phupi ka is gham se
ashkon ka bahana yaad raha
as-sham as-sham...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ki khwahar be-chadar
ye baat to khoon rulaati thi
zainab ke khule sar par jab bhi
ghazi ki nazar pad jaati thi
naize ki ani se ghazi ka
sar khaak pe aana yaad raha
as-sham as-sham...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad ka ye nauha likh kar
dil rone laga mera safdar
namoose nabi bazaaron se
kis tarha gayi hogi rokar
jis gham ke sabab abid ko sada
sar apna jhukana yaad raha
as-sham as-sham...

items.title: Ay mere baba jaan
items.body:
us waqt jab ke zainab darbar may gayi thi
khaari namaziyon se mehfil saji hui thi
zaalim ye poochta tha ghazi tera kahan hai
balon se moo chupaye zainab ye keh rahi thi
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere baba jaan ho rahi hai azan sar chupa'un kahan
majmaye aam may bewatan be-ama aa gaya karwan
ay mere baba jaan…
<<DIVIDER>>
mai bhi hoo marzia binte khairun-nisa
mere lehje may hai baba teri aada
naam zainab mera tune jo rakh diya dedi apni zuban
ay mere baba jaan…
<<DIVIDER>>
baba jaan mai rida maangti reh gayi
baam o dar sajgaye jeete ji mar gayi
halqae shaam may naam sunkar mera margaya natawan
ay mere baba jaan…
<<DIVIDER>>
haath kaano pe hai neel gaalo pe hai
aur nishan jo sakina ke shaano pe hai
har nishan se yahi aa rahi hai sada baba jaan baba jaan
ay mere baba jaan…
<<DIVIDER>>
sham e ashoor se shaam o kufa talak
maine maanga nahi hai khiraaje fadak
meri chadar se hai meri maa ka sukoon sunle zalim jahan
ay mere baba jaan…
<<DIVIDER>>
baba jaan ye tera aakhri tha bayaan
teri chadar bachayega ghazi jawan
margaya bawafa chingayi hai rida kehti hai bibiyan
abbas abbas abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
ruk na paaya mere bawafa ka wo sar
noke naiza se aane laga khaak par
behan ko darbadar dekh kar nange sar seh na paya jawan
ay mere baba jaan…
<<DIVIDER>>
kal thi maa aaj mai bhi hoon darbar may
misle zahra khadi hoon mai aghiyar may
us taraf hai shaqi is taraf rehgaye bepadar betiyan
ay mere baba jaan…
<<DIVIDER>>
aisa khutba diya maine darbar may
likh raha hai jo yawar tere pyar may
lehjaye hyderi har azan ke liye hai sada e azan
ay mere baba jaan…

items.title: Azan do ay mere dilbar
items.body:
azan do ay mere dilbar savera hone wala hai
tumhare baad aalam mein andhera hone wala hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha sarwar ne akbar se ujala hone wala hai
bala ke ban mein ek khooni savera hone wala hai
hamare khoon se rangeen sehra hone wala hai
kaleje se tumhare paar naiza hone wala hai
azan do ay mere dilbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
rasool allah ki itrat par aafat aane wali hai
ali ke naunehalon par musibat aane wali hai
nabi ki aal par subhe qayamat aane wali hai
aseerane haram ki shaam e ghurbat aane wali hai
azan do ay mere dilbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaheede zulm hojayenge bhai bhi bhatije bhi
tahe tayghe sitam hojayenge bache bhi boodhe bhi
chidegi gardane asghar jawano ke kaleje bhi
chalenge teer bhi talwar bhi khanjar bhi naize bhi
azan do ay mere dilbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
juda shaane kisi ke aur kisi ke sar qalam honge
na abbas e jari honge na tum honge na hum honge
hamare qaanwade par bahot zulm o sitam honge
jafaon par jafa hogi bala honge alam honge
azan do ay mere dilbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
labe darya mere haaton pa naazon ka pala hoga
zaban sookhe labon par hogi aur manka dhala hoga
sitam insaniyat par is se bad kar aur kya hoga
mere baysheer ki gardan mein teer e hurmala hoga
azan do ay mere dilbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sitamgaron ka nargha hoga aur aale abaa hogi
rasan basta hamare baad binte murtaza hogi
bhare darbar mein zehra ki beti berida hogi
meri nanhi sakina par tamachon ki jafa hogi
azan do ay mere dilbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shab e ashoor sheh ke qaimo mein mirza tha ek mehshar
basad hasrat pisar se apne farmate thay jab sarwar
mere kadiyal jawan ay hoo baroo hamshakale payghambar
tumhare baad ay noore nazar hai khaak aalam par
azan do ay mere dilbar...

items.title: Bahot roya hai
items.body:
daair e raahib mein jo sarwar ka kata sar aaya
noor chehre ka jo dekha to bahot ghabraya
utha tazeem ko naize ke barabar aaya
godh mein leke wo sar hujre ke andar aaya
saaf karta tha lahoo mehwe buka tha raahib
moo pe moo rakh ke yehi soch raha tha raahib
<<DIVIDER>>
laashein ghar bhar ki utha kar ye abhi soya hai
dekh kar chehre ko lagta hai bahot roya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
warm aankhon ka batata hai bahot saabir hai
haye baalon ki safedi se yehi zaahir hai
ho na ho isne barabar ka pisar khoya hai
dekh kar chehre ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaane ye kaun hai dil mera phata jaata hai
ya nabi zaada koi hai ya wali zaada hai
baad marne ke bhi naize pe jo ye goya hai
dekh kar chehre ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ragein khushk batati hai bada pyasa tha
jis ghadi taygh se zaalim ne gala kaata tha
kaunsi maa hai ke jisne ye pisar khoya hai
dekh kar chehre ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
baal sab khoon mein matti mein atay hai is ke
hont bhi pyaas ki shiddat se phate hai is ke
apne ashkon se hi in honton ko bhigoya hai
dekh kar chehre ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
log kehte hai badi eeza uthayi is ne
qabr masoom se bacche ki banayi is ne
khoon e masoom se hi zakhme jigar dhoya hai
dekh kar chehre ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
dhyaan jab aaya behan ka tahe khanjar roya
sar khule dekha to phir naize ke upar roya
ye muqaddar isay kis mod pe le aaya hai
dekh kar chehre ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
hont masoom si bacchi ke bhi pyase dekhe
haye lagte huwe gaalon pe tamache dekhe
rassiyon se bandha nanha sa gala dekha hai
dekh kar chehre ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ghadi qasim e muztar gaye maare roya
bhai ki laash pe darya ke kanare roya
dono haathon se kamar pakde huwe pahuncha hai
dekh kar chehre ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
shadman godh mein rakhe tha qamar ko raahib
bain kehta tha yehi choom ke sar ko raahib
godh mein chand ka tukda ye meri soya hai
dekh kar chehre ko...

items.title: Beparda shaam ki
items.body:
haye zainab haye baazar
<<DIVIDER>>
be parda shaam ki galiyon mein
tatheer ki chaadar waali hai
khoton se baraste hai patthar
athara baradar waali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hasnain ki jo maajayi hai
wo qaidi ban ke aayi hai
ek jashn bapa bazar mein hai
namoos e payambar waali hai
be parda shaam ki...

sar zakhmi hai zakhmi hai badan

jurrat bhi shuja'at bhi lekin
abbas e dilawar waali hai

be gor o kafan islam tha jab
de kar chadar boli zainab
ye saari sakhawat khoon mein mere
taaseer ye hyder waali hai
be parda shaam ki...

durron ki aziyat sehti hui
taa shaam gayi ye kehti hui
ye khutbon ki talwaar nahi
tehreer ye shabbar waali hai
be parda shaam ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis waqt azan raahon mein suni
sar dhaamp ke haathon se boli
ay nana din ye dard ke hai
ye baat muqaddar waali hai
be parda shaam ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ka sar naize se gira
sar zainab ka dekha jo khula
ye taaza musibat ghazi par
shamsheer sikandar waali hai
be parda shaam ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar e sitam mein shahzadi
pahunchi to qayamat barpa thi
har ek sitamgar kehta tha
ye saa'at mehshar waali hai
be parda shaam ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi sakina ro ro kar
kab jayenge zindan se ghar
zainab ne kaha ye baat na kar
ye chot hai khanjar waali hai
be parda shaam ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay nasir ay rehan e aza
zainab ko ye keh kar do pursa
ye ashk nahi ruk sakte kabhi
ye mauj samandar waali hai
be parda shaam ki...

items.title: Abbas tum kahan ho
items.body:
Gaazi mere baradar Abbas tum kahaa’n ho
Aayi hai raat sar par Abbas tum kahaa’n ho
Aao sahara de do, laasha jawaan ka hai
Kaise uthhaye Sarwar, Abbas tum kahaa’n ho
Zehra bhi aa gayi hai, taakhir na karo tum
Kat’ta hai halq e Sarwar, Abbas tum kahaa’n ho
Jisko nazar milaakar, dekha kabhi na tumne
Uska hai naize pe sar, Abbas tum kahaa’n ho
Gairat ko aap ki ye, tasleem kaise hoga
Khaimo’n mein aaye lashkar, Abbas tum kahaa’n ho
Sholay bhadak rahe hain, maqtal dhuaa’n dhuaa’n hai
Hai khaufnaak manzar, Abbas tum kahaa’n ho
Dar dar phiregi waaris, tat’heer ki ab aise
Sar par na hogi chaadar, Abbas tum kahaa’n ho
Pal bhar ko aa bhi jaao, bachchi ko chayn aaye
Jaao tasalli dekar, Abbas tum kahaa’n ho
Kabze mein tegh hoti, to jaante ye zaalim
Kya hai jalaal e Haidar, Abbas tum kahaa’n ho
Manzil ‘Salim’ aaye, pool e Siraat ki to
Dena sadaa tadapkar, Abbas tum kahaa’n ho

items.title: Hum Najaf Aagaye
items.body:
Ali Ali Ali Ali Ali Ali Ali...
Ali Ali Ali Ali Ali Ali Ali...
Hajat Rawa,n Hai Mushkil Kusha Shre Khuda Hai Mere Moula...
Daste Jali Hai Haqqe Wali Hai Nafse Nabi Hai Mere Moula...
Moula...Moula...Moula...Moula...
Moula...Moula...Moula...Moula...
Ham Najaf Aagaye Aur Kia Chahiye...
Aey Khuda e Ali (As) Bs Qaza Chahiye...
1) La Maka,n Ke Maka,n Ka Makee,n Aagaya...
Aey Buto,n Ghar Naya Dhundna Chahiye...
2)Turr Par To Nahi Ham Ko Musa Miley...
Ab Najaf Unhe Dhundna Chahiye...
3) Aey Khuda Sirf Chalees Ghar Ko Nahi...
Sari Duniya Ko Hi Murtaza Chahiye...
4) Jab Se Ka'aba Bana Tab Se Zid Uski Thi...
Murtaza Chahiye Murtaza Chahiye...
Kiya Batau Ali (As) Ki Shan Hai Kia...
Rab Ke Jesi Meri Saban Hai Kia
Ham Dare Murtaza Pey Bethey Hai
Is Se Behtar Koyi Amaan Hai Kia
Ham Najaf Tak Ka Kar Chukey Hai Safar
Is Se Aagey Bhi Aasmaan Hai Kia
Ham Najaf Aagaya Aur Kia Chahiye...
5) Ayse Kaise Samjh Aayegey Murtaza...
Aey Muqassir Bada Housla Chahiye...
6) Ham Se Kiyu Chanda Masjid Ka Letey Ho Tum...
Bas Khuda Se Agar Mangna Chahiye...
7) Bole Asghar Ye Hanstey Hue Baap Se...
Ab Khiloney Nahi Hurmala Chahiye...
8) Padh Ke SAJJAD Tasbeehe Zehra (Sa) Kaho...
Ya Ali (As) Aapse Mashwara Chahiye...

items.title: Ali Shaheed Hue.
items.body:
Hai Jibraeel Ka Nauha Ali Shaheed Hue.
Tadap Rahi Hai Duniya Ali Shaheed Hue.-2
(1)
Lebas E Gham Me Hai Kaba Tadap Rahi Hai Zami,
Hai Ashk-Bar Madina Ali Shaheed Hue,
Hai Jibraeel Ka Nauha Ali Shaheed Hue.
(2)
Bujhi Me Zaher Me Talwaar Ibne Muljim Ki,
Tha Aisa Zaher Ka Hamla Ali Shaheed Hue,
Hai Jibraeel Ka Nauha Ali Shaheed Hue.
(3)
Hasan Husain Ki Aankho Se Ashk Jaari Hai,
Nahi Hai Koi Sahara Ali Shaheed Hue,
Hai Jibraeel Ka Nauha Ali Shaheed Hue.
(4)
Tamaam Kunbe Ki Ab Passban Hai Zainab,
Hua Hai Julam Ye Kaisa Ali Shaheed Hue,
Hai Jibraeel Ka Nauha Ali Shaheed Hue.
(5)
Khuda Ke Ghar Me Lagi Zarb Ek Namazi Ko,
Lahu Bhara Hai Musalla Ali Shaheed Hue,
Hai Jibraeel Ka Nauha Ali Shaheed Hue.
(6)
Butool Rooti Hai Marqad Me Ya Ali Keh Kar,
Mila Hai Dil Ko Ye Sadma Ali Shaheed Hue,
Hai Jibraeel Ka Nauha Ali Shaheed Hue.
(7)
Khuda Ke Ghar Me Namazi Ko Qatal Kar Dala,
Ye Marsiha Hai Ali Ka Ali Shaheed Hue,
Hai Jibraeel Ka Nauha Ali Shaheed Hue.
(8)
Khayal Kun Karega Bhala Ghareebo Ka,
Yateem Ho Gaya Koofa Ali Shaheed Hue,
Hai Jibraeel Ka Nauha Ali Shaheed Hue.
(9)
Lipat Kar Baap Se Kulsoom Or Jari Rooye,
Pahadh Gham Hai Toota Ali Shaheed Hue,
Hai Jibraeel Ka Nauha Ali Shaheed Hue.
(10)
Ye Bain Karti Hai Abbas-E-Naamdaar Ki Maa,
Jafa Ne Ghar Ko Mere Loota Ali Shaheed Hue,
Hai Jibraeel Ka Nauha Ali Shaheed Hue.
(11)
Qareeb Eid Ke Aye Momino Hua Ye Ghazab,
Chaman Butool Ka Ujdha Ali Shaheed Hue,
Hai Jibraeel Ka Nauha Ali Shaheed Hue.
(12)
Lipat Ke Roote Hai Turbat Se Chahane Wale,
Har Ek Dil Hai Shikastta Ali Shaheed Hue,
Hai Jibraeel Ka Nauha Ali Shaheed Hue.
(13)
Ye Zakham Aur Hare Hoge Karbala Jakar,
Hasan Husain Hai Tanha Ali Shaheed Hue,
Hai Jibraeel Ka Nauha Ali Shaheed Hue.-2

items.title: Berida hai bibiyaa'n
items.body:
Haay Zainab Haay Zainab Haay Zainab Haay Shaam..(2)
Berida hai bibiyaan or shaam ka bazaar hai (2),
Shaam ke bazaar me ye majmaae agyaar hai..
Khoo’n bhara kurta hua hai abid e bimaar ka,
Hogaya zakhmo se mazru kul badan gumghaar ka,
Pau me hai able aur ablo’n me khaar hai..
Berida hai bibiyaan or shaam ka bazaar hai..
Hai gala rassi se bandha dukhtar e shabbir ka,
Pyaas se chale hai lab par aag se daaman jala,
Aur tamacho ke nishano se bhara rukhsaar hai..
Berida hai bibiyaan or shaam ka bazaar hai..
Karbala me lut gaya ghar phir bhi na kuch hai kaha,
Shaam ke bazar me bhi lab pe hai shukr e khuda,
Sabr e abid sabr e zainab sabr ka meyaar hai..
Berida hai bibiyaan or shaam ka bazaar hai..
Sogae abbas o akbar karbala ki khaak par,
Na rahe sarwar bhi haay lut gaya karbal me ghar,
Sayyade sajjad kunbe ka bana salaar hai..
Berida hai bibiyaan or shaam ka bazaar hai..
Bangai faryaadi zainab apni chadar ki jaha’n,
Kya kare shikwa kisi se hogaya dushman jaha’n,
Sar jhukaae ro raha khoo’n abid e bimaar hai..
Berida hai bibiyaan or shaam ka bazaar hai..
Koi kehta hai ye baaki koi patthar maarta,
Haatho me hai rassiyaa’n aur khoon sar se behraha,
Shaam me aale nabi par zulm o ki bouchaar hai..
Berida hai bibiyaan or shaam ka bazaar hai..
Hamid o Reza nabi ki aal par kaisa sa sitam,
Jo masayab in pe guzre likh nahi sakta kalam,
Qaid hai aal e payamber sajraha darbaar hai..

items.title: Kaha Ho Aye Shabihe Mustafa (s.a.w.s)
items.body:
Haaye......
Zakhmoñ Se Choor Jab Hua Sarwar (as) Laadla
Baba Madad Ko Aaiye Bete Ne Di Sada

Aisa Laga Ki Aañkhoñ Se Rukhsat Hui Ziya
Bete Se Milne Ghutniyoñ Chalte Rahe Hussain (as)
Har Ek Qadam Pe Bas Yahi Kahte Rahe Hussain (as)
Dikhayi Kuch Nahi Deta
Ali Akbar (a.s) Mere Beta
Mujhe Aawaz do Beta
Kahañ Ho Aye Shabeeh e Mustafa (saws) Itna Bata Do

1. Jigar Ko Thaam Kar Aawaaz Do Lillaah Aye Beta
Tumheiñ Dhuñduñ Bhala Kaise Sujhayi Kuchh Nahiñ Deta
Taras Khao Zaeefi Par Zara Itna Bata Do
Kahañ Ho Aye Shabeeh e Mustafa (saws) Itna Bata Do ×2
<<DIVIDER>>

Batauñ Haal e Dil Kaise Zara Itna Bata Do
Kahañ Ho Aye Shabeeh e Mustafa (saws) Itna Bata Do ×2
<<DIVIDER>>

Kahañ Par Laal Hai Naiza Laga Itna Bata Do
Kahañ Ho Aye Shabeeh e Mustafa (saws) Itna Bata Do ×2

Jiyegi Kis Tarah Tum Bin Bhala Itna Bata Do
Kahañ Ho Aye Shabeeh e Mustafa (saws) Itna Bata Do ×2
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Tumhari Yaad Me Jo Roz o Shab Yasrab Me Roti Hai
Tumhare Byaah Ke Armaan Me Khaati Na Soti Hai
Use Jaoge Lene Kab Bhala Itna Bata Do
Kahañ Ho Aye Shabeeh e Mustafa (saws) Itna Bata Do ×2
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Meri Aañkhoñ Ka Taara Kho Gaya Hai Dasht e Ghurbat Me
Sar e Maqtal Maiñ Thokar Kha Raha Hooñ Jis Ki Furqat Me
Use Dhuñduñ Kahañ Ja Kar Bhala Itna Bata Do
Kahañ Ho Aye Shabeeh e Mustafa (saws) Itna Bata Do ×2
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Mujhe Naane Ki Furqat Ka Alam Jab Bhi Satata Tha
Maiñ Tum Ko Dekh Leta Tha To Mujh Ko Chain Aata Tha
Kise Dekhega Ab Ye Ghamzada Itna Bata Do
Kahañ Ho Aye Shabeeh e Mustafa (saws) Itna Bata Do ×2
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Sarhaane Aa gaya Hooñ Maiñ Mere Noor e Nazar Uttho
Sukoon e Qalb e Madar Aye Mere Lakht e Jigar Uttho
Kahañ Par Laal Hai Naiza Laga Itna Bata Do
Kahañ Ho Aye Shabeeh e Mustafa (saws) Itna Bata Do ×2
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Pisar Ki Laash Par Ro Ro Ke Kahte The Shaih e Waala (as)
Tumhare Dil Me Hai Naize Ka Phal Uljha Hua Beta
Maiñ Khaichuñ Kis Tarah Naiza Zara Itna Bata Do
Kahañ Ho Aye Shabeeh e Mustafa (saws) Itna Bata Do ×2
<<DIVIDER>>

Likhe Gul Kazmi Kaise Bhala Itna Bata Do

items.title: Laash e akbar par
items.body:
[Haye Hussein(as) Haye Haye Akber(as) ]x2
Zaif baap ka kaisa hai imtehan
[Haye Hussein(as) Haye Haye Akber(as) ]x2
(Larkharate huwe shahe wala aise pohche hai laashe Akber(as) par)x2
Jis tarha sheer khaar chalte hai GhutniyoN ka Sahara le le kar
(Larkharate huwe shahe wala aise pohche hai laashe Akber(as) par)x2
Hain bohat durr hum toh khaimo se,tum jawaaN hoo zaef hai baba
Yeh bhi tum jaante hoo baad e Jari,
jhuk gayi hai qamar meri beta
Mar gaye tum agar toh laash teri Kaise khaime mei jaaunga lekar
(Larkharate huwe shahe wala aise pohche hai laashe Akber(as) par)x2
Dekha barchi ka phal hai sine mei,khoon e Akbar(as) se tar hai karbobala
Quwwat e jism ko samete huwe,sheh ne Nad e Ali ka wird kiya
Kechi barchi jawaaN ke sine se bole Shabbir(as) ya Ali Haider(as)
(Larkharate huwe shahe wala aise pohche hai laashe Akber(as) par)x2
Tan se barchi nikal gayi lekin saath lekar kaleja Akber(as) ka
Sheh(as) ne laashe jawaaN ke sine ko apne sine se phir lagaya tha
Ran mei gunji sada yeh Sarwar(as) ki Ali Akber(as) mere Ali Akber(as)
(Larkharate huwe shahe wala aise pohche hai laashe Akber(as) par)x2
Ek maaN hai Teri musalle par,zindagi ki jo maangti hai dua
Jisne atthara saal paala hai,dekhti hai woh maaN Tera rasta
Kya kahu dono maaoN ko main Teri yeh bata do Mujhe ay lakht e Jigar
(Larkharate huwe shahe wala aise pohche hai laashe Akber(as) par)x2
Sheh the laashe jawaaN ke sarhane aaya jab ran mei qaside Sughra(sa)
Khat mei beti ne apne baba se apne bhai ka haal pucha tha
Ro pade ran mei Shahe Kaun o MakaaN khat ko Sughra(sa) ka laash par rakh kar
(Larkharate huwe shahe wala aise pohche hai laashe Akber(as) par)x2
Baap budha tha aur laash jawaaN,sheh pe royi zameen e karbobala
Laash khaime mei kis tarha pohchi,koi bhi shaks likh nahi sakta
Ek khat ediyo ka jaata tha haye maqtal se khaime ke andar
(Larkharate huwe shahe wala aise pohche hai laashe Akber(as) par)x2
Khaima e shah mei Raza barpa,ek Qayamat ka shor o girya tha
Koi chehre ko dekhe rota tha,koi rota tha dekh kar sina
Daag lekar jawaaN ki furqat ka,Ek kone mei the Khade Sarwar(as)
(Larkharate huwe shahe wala aise pohche hai laashe Akber(as) par)x2

Akbar..
1) Aye chand mere noor e nazar raaj dulaare,
Tum chod ke madar ko gaye kiske sahare,
Furqat hai teri maut (2)
hamare liye dilbar...
2) kya usko bataungi gai jab ke madina
Bechain madine me bohot rehti hai sughra,
Baithi hai waha palke (2)
Bichaaye teri khuwahar..

Yun mujhko laga qalb pe mere vo lagi hai,
Hai vo jo sina tooti (2)
Tere sine ke andar..
5) Ek lamha jafao me kami hoti nahi hai

Banadeti vo chadar..

yeh mere qalb pe khanjar..

Jise naize pe akbar...
Akbar mere Akbar...

items.author: Yasir Raza

items.title: Azan-e-Ali Akbar(a.s)
items.body:
Aaya hai sare khaima laasha ali akbar ka,
Dum hoto'n pe aaya hai yu zainabe muztar ka..
Tuti hai qamar sheh ki binaai hui ruksat,
Kuch aise tassasul se gham deti rahi kismat,
Sadma tha abhi gehra abbase dilawar ka..
Beta wo shahedeen ka ahmed ki nishani tha,
Madar ka dulara tha wo yusufe saani tha,
Haay zakhmi hua sina us husn ke paikar ka..
Seh roz se pyaasa tha na socha sitamgar ne,
Hai gher ke maara tha nau laakh ke lashkar ne,
Dil doobta jaata hai ye soch ke madar ka..
Hasrat thi bohat dil me har waqt ye sughra ke,
Laaenge dulhan akbar sehra jo sajaaenge,
Par khaak hua saara armaan wo khahar ka..
Jab sinaae akbar me naize ki ani tuti,
Shabbir ki haalat pe khud maut bhi roti thi,
Dushwar hua jina ab dehar me sarwar ka..
Kufe se mutassil hai ye karbobala haay,
Maqtal ki fizaao me ye bain hai zahra ke,
Phir shaak se tuta hai gul gulshane haider ka..
Ek hook si uthti hai shabbir ke sine me,
Laila bhi hai khaime me zainab bhi hai khaime me,
Kis tarah is hashr ke manzar ka..
Qurane masaib ka tafsir ka nauha hai,
Kirtas ke sine pe tehreer ka nauha hai,
Salman lahu hoga dil kyu na sukhanwar ka..

items.body:

<<DIVIDER>>
Bharay Darbaar Main Musalmaan Nay Dono Jhutla Diye Hain Laal Us Kay
Jaanay Kaisa Salook Kaar Dala Pal May Ho Gayai Safaid Baal Us Kay
Girr Kay Bayhosh Ho Gaye Zahra, Haal Zainab Ko Jab Sunaya Hay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Boli Fizza Issay Rulao Na Jhirkiyan Do Na Kuch Toh Sharam Karo
Dekh Jis Ko Nabhi Kharay Rehtay Us Ko Darbaar Main Khara Na Karo
Royi Jab Ladli Muhammad Ki, Sara Darbaar Muskaraya Hay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Teri Himmat Ka Naam Hai Zainab Aur Shabbir Hai Sabar Tera
Teray Aansu Sajaad Kay Aansu, Aur Sakina Main Hai Asaar Tera
Teray Bachon Nay Bibi Teri Tarha, Zulam Seh Kay Yeh Deen Bachaya Hay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo Ajar Syedan Nay Hay Paaya Kaisay Koyi Lagaiay Andaaza
Jab Musalmano Nay Kiya Humla Yun Laaga Fatima Ko Darvaza
Zakhmi Pehloon Say Paak Bibi Nay, Markay Bi Haath Na Uthaya Hay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Na Hassan Daar Hai Koyi Mehshar Ka Aur Nah Khauf Hai Jahanum Ka
Hum Azadaron Ko To Bus Bibi Aasara Hay Bohat Teray Ghum Ka
Kasam Ghazi Ki Khush Naseeb Hay Woh, Jis Kay Dil Main Yeh Ghum Samaya Hay.

items.title: Maa Raaito Illa Jamila
items.body:
Pucha Jab Yazeed (l.a) Ne Darbar E Shaam Mein,
Manzar Yeh Karbala Ka Tumhe Kis Tarha Laga,
Samjha Tha Woh Ke Zainab E Dilgeer (s.a) Royengi,
Lekin Ali (a.s) Beti Ne Jurrat Se Yeh Kaha,
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila,
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila... (2)
Bint E Haider Ki Yahi Darbar Me Goonji Sada,
Kya Samjhta Hai Yazeed E Asr Tu Karbobala...
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila,
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila... (2)
Warisaan E Haq Hain Hum Hi Waris E Quran Hain,
Waris E Deen E Khuda Hain Kul Ka Kul Imaan Hain,
Hashr Tak Pehchaan Hai Islam Ki Karbobala,
Kya Samjhta Hai Yazeed E Asr Tu Karbobala...
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila,
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila... (2)
Thi Khabar Humko Madiney Se Chala Jab Qafela,
Jante Thy Imtehaan E Sabr Hai Rab Ki Reza,
Chal Raha Tha Yeh Nabi (s.a.w.w) Ke Daur Se Hi Silsila,
Kya Samjhta Hai Yazeed E Asr Tu Karbobala...
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila,
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila... (2)
Mai Aqeela E Bani Hashim Hu Bint E Murtaza,
Meri Maadar Syeda (s.a) Hai Aur Nana Mustafa (s.a.w.w),
Tu Nijasat Ka Gharana Dekh Yeh Shajra Mera,
Kya Samjhta Hai Yazeed E Asr Tu Karbobala...
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila,
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila... (2)
Tu Samjhta Hai Shaheedon Ka Lahoo Chup Jayega,
Shoor E Matam Har Jagha Duniya Ko Yeh Batlayega,
Maarqa Yeh Haq O Baatil Ka Hai Yeh Haq Ki Sada,
Kya Samjhta Hai Yazeed E Asr Tu Karbobala...
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila,
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila... (2)
Teen Deen Bhuka O Pyaasa Aale Ahmad Ko Rakha,
Zulm Jo Bhi Ho Saka Tujhse Rawa Tune Kiya,
Ladke Jaan De Di Nahi Sar Tere Aage Jhuk Saka,
Kya Samjhta Hai Yazeed E Asr Tu Karbobala...
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila,
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila... (2)
Sine Mein Barchhi Ka Phaal Akbar Ko Maara Bekhata,
Qasim O Asghar O Ghazi Pe Sitam Ki Imtehaa,
Dekh Kar Guzri Hu Laashon Ka Yeh Manzar Be Rida,
Kya Samjhta Hai Yazeed E Asr Tu Karbobala...
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila,
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila... (2)
Hum Khuda Ke Deen Ki Hurmat Bachane Aaye Thy,
Jante Thy Karbala Mein Ghar Lutane Aaye Thy,
Shukr Hai Khaaliq Ka Jissne Surkhuru Humko Kiya,
Kya Samjhta Hai Yazeed E Asr Tu Karbobala...
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila,
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila... (2)
Nauke Naize Pe Bahhatar(72) Sar Hai Sabse Motaabar,
Apne Fathaa Ka Yeh Elaan Kar Rahein Har Ek Nagar,
Karwaan Izzat Ka Hai Zillat Muqqadar Hai Tera,
Kya Samjhta Hai Yazeed E Asr Tu Karbobala...
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila,
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila... (2)
Sani E Zahra (s.a) Ke Dam Se Yeh Azadari Bapa,
Yeh Karam ALI DEEP Par Hai Bibi Zainab (s.a) Ki Dua,
Daur E Baatil Mein Jo Iss Ne Yeh Payam E Haq Likha,
Kya Samjhta Hai Yazeed E Asr Tu Karbobala...
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila,
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila... (2)
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila,

items.title: Abbas (as) jo Dariya Se Palat Kar Nahi Aayya
items.body:
ABBAS (as) JO DARIYA SE PALAT KAR NAHI AAYA
SAADAAT KO PHIR CHAIN MAYASSER NAHI AAYA
<<DIVIDER>>
The sadaat never atained serenity again
<<DIVIDER>>
TUKRE HUWE LAASHO PE BUKAA KARTI THI ZEHRA (sa)
ABBAS (as) KE BAAZU HAY YEH SHABIR (as) KA SEENA
YAK JA KOI LAASHA BHI ZAMEEN PAR NAHI AAYA
<<DIVIDER>>
Zahra (sa) laments over the severed bodies
Abbas’ (as) arms and Shabir’s (as) chest
Not one body hit the ground unsevered
<<DIVIDER>>
HAR BIBI KO EK AAS THI ABBAS (as) KE DUM SE
LIPTI HUWI ZAINAB (sa) YEHI KEHTI THI ALAM SE
MAQTAL SE MERA ZAAMINE CHAADAR NAHI AAYA
<<DIVIDER>>
Every Bibi had hope with Abbas’ (as) breath
This is what Zainab (sa) said while clasping the Alam
<<DIVIDER>>
JAB MAARE GAYE HAYE SAKINA (sa) KO TAMACHE
ROTI RAHI WO HAATHO SE CHEREH KO CHUPAKE
BEHLANEH KOI MOONISO YAWAR NAHI AAYA
<<DIVIDER>>
She cried whilst hiding her face with her hands
No sympathiser nor protector came to console her
<<DIVIDER>>
JAB SHAAMEH ALAM AA GAYI KOHRAAM BAPA THA
JALTE HUWE KHAIMO KA DHUWAA DUNDH RAHA THA
SAQQA E HARAM SANI E HAIDER NAHI AAYA
<<DIVIDER>>
ABBAS (as) KA SAR NEZE PE RUKH TA HI NAHI THA
JAB SHAAM KI RAAHO MEI SADAA DETI SAKINA (sa)
JAB KEHTI THI ZAINAB (sa) KE BIRAADAR NAHI AAYA
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas’ (as) head would not remain upon the spear
When Sakina (sa) cried out on the journey to Shaam
And when Zainab (sa) said O my brother never returned
<<DIVIDER>>
GHASH KHAA KE GIREH QABRE SAKINA (sa) PE JO SAJJAD (as)
KARTI THI LARAZ TI HUWI ZANJEER YE FARYAAD
GHUM KONSA MAULA TERE DIL PAR NAHI AAYA
<<DIVIDER>>
Sajjad (as) fainted as he fell on to Sakina’s (sa) grave
The trembling shackles of Sajjad (as) cried aloud
<<DIVIDER>>
AB TAK HAY SAMAR KARBOBALA KA YAHI NAUHA
SAAHIL PE TARAPTA RAHA ABBAS (as) KA LAASHA
PHIR HASHMI METAAB UFAQ PAR NAHI AAYA
<<DIVIDER>>
Till today SAMAR this is the lamentation of Karbala
Abbas’ (as) torso remained trembling by the river
No Hashemite moon ever rose to the night skies again
<<DIVIDER>>
ABBAS (as) JO DARIYA SE PALAT KAR NAHI AAYA

items.title: Abbas(as) Aajao
items.body:
Zainab hai khadi bey aas aye Abbas aajao
Hai koi nahi merey paas aye Abbas aajao
1) Zaailim ke tamaachey khaakey sakina' roti hai dekho
Seeney par soney waali reyt pey soti hai dekho
Bujhgayi hai uski pyaas aye Abbas aajao
2) Chaadar cheenengey khaimo'n mey aa aakey sitamgar jab
Sarr uryaa'n hokar baazaaro'n mey jaayegi zainab
Maareygi ye ehsaas aye Abbas aajao
3) Jaatey hii terey khatl huwey akbar bhi asgar bhi
Aur chalgaya gardan e shaah e hudaa par zulm ka Khanjar bhi
Hai ahley haram mey yaas aye Abbas aajao
4) Laakar tu udaadey koii chaadar aye merey bhayya
Jaana hai galii koocha o darr darr aye merey bhayya
Beyparda hai mera raas aye Abbas aajao
5) Hai pusht taley mere haath bandhey khologey nahi bhayya
Mehmil na amaarii hai sarr par kyu kartey nahi saaya
Aye hyder ke almaas aye Abbas aajao
6) Nazro'n se bachaaney mujhko logo'n ki bhayya sarwar
Quran ka soora e kahf sunaatey hai Naiza' chadhkar
Tum aakey padho wannaas aye Abbas aajao
7) Shaano' ke katney par bhi mujhko ghum naa tha koi
Par jaa'n chorhi mashkeeza' chidtey hi my ney bibi
Mujhko na kaho ilyaas aye Abbas aajao
8) Jitney bhi museebat raah e Shaam mey zainab ney jhelaa
Pur dard masaayab *"Gaazi"* raqam karsakta nahi maula
Rotey hai qalam qirtaas aye Abbas aajao

items.title: Akbar Nahin Aye
items.body:
Haaye Akbar nahi aaye, maa dekhti reh gayi
Maa dekhti reh gayi, dil thaamein, Akbar nahi aaye
Khaime ke dar pe Bint-e-Ali
Jaati hai, kabhi laut aati hai
Maa ban ke jis ne paala, kyun na bikhraaye
Aaghosh ke paale betay ka
Gham jeenay nahi dayga usko
Maa gham ki maari, dukhyari kahin mar na jaaye
18 baras ka sher jari
Kuch der ko ghar mein aa jaaye
Maa behnai duaein karti rahi, daaman phelaaye
Khaimon ki tanabon se lipti
Weeran udaasi roti hai
Maidan lahu mein doob gaya
Gehrayei Huwaie Sayei
Khud dhula banai betay ko
Armaan to buhat hai dil mein magar
Maa kaise pisar ki shaadi ka armaan barhaaye

ye aseeri ki hawa kaise chali hai abbas
aaj zainab sar e darbar khadi hai abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
jin ke waali bhi nahi godh mein bacche bhi nahi
ye behan saath unhe le ke chali hai abbas
ye aseeri ki hawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab bhala aur ghareebul watani kya hogi
sar pa chadar nahi aur dhoop kadi hai abbas
ye aseeri ki hawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
bujh gaye shaam e ghariban ke wo sholay lekin
dil e zainab mein abhi aag lagi hai abbas
ye aseeri ki hawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek bemaar bhatija hai faqath saath mere
us ke pairon mein bhi zanjeer padi hai abbas
ye aseeri ki hawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
log sadqe ke khajoorein meri jaanib phaynke
kya yehi martaba e aal e nabi hai abbas
ye aseeri ki hawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
lab e sarwar pa chadi maar raha hai zaalim
aur hasrat se behan dekh rahi hai abbas
ye aseeri ki hawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
baith kar padti hoo raaton ko namazein bhaiya
ab to meri bhi kamar toot gayi hai abbas
ye aseeri ki hawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye aseeri hai faqath maqsad e sheh ki khaatir
warna zainab tere saanche mein dhali hai abbas
ye aseeri ki hawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaksiyat zainab e muztar ki bayan kya ho bilal
kabhi zehra kabhi sarwar to kabhi hai abbas
ye aseeri ki hawa...

items.title: Ay mere dilo jaan
items.body:
ay mere dil o jaan ali asghar ali asghar
maa tujhpe ho qurban ali asghar ali asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
deti mai kafan tujhko rida sar pe jo hoti
mil jaata ta jo pani to tere zakhm ko dhoti
hoon be-sar o saaman ali asghar ali asghar
ay mere dil o jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho to sare shaam e ghariban meri ghurbat
jhulsa hua jhoola hai to ujdi hui turbat
ujda hai gulistan ali asghar ali asghar
ay mere dil o jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
nauhon ki sadaon mein badal bhi chuki lori
jhoola hi salaamat hai na ab jhoole ki dori
godhi bhi hai veeran ali asghar ali asghar
ay mere dil o jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo need se aur dhoop se jalti hui aankein
yaad aati hai wo ashk ugalti hui aankhein
mamta hai pareshan ali asghar ali asghar
ay mere dil o jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis teer ne chedi thi teri phool si gardan
maa kaise batayein bhala us teer ki uljhan
seene mein hai paikaan ali asghar ali asghar
ay mere dil o jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
hasrat thi ke baandhun mai tere maathe pe mai sehra
aur sehre mein dekhun tera hasta hua chehra
ujde mere armaan ali asghar ali asghar
ay mere dil o jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa baandhun tere nanhe se sar par mai amaama
aur choomun tera phool sa moo chand sa maatha
haste huwe quran ali asghar ali asghar
ay mere dil o jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas rayt hai maqtal ki na takiya na bichona
ab hashr talak tujh ko isi ban mein hai sona
maa jaati hai zindan ali asghar ali asghar
ay mere dil o jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha shaam e ghariban ka dhuaan aamir o nayyar
khaak ujde huwe jhoole ki bikhri thi jahan par
kehti thi wahin maa ali asghar ali asghar
ay mere dil o jaan...

items.title: Azane akbar bula
items.body:
allahu akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
aao namaze fajr hai
azaane akbar bula rahi hai
khuda ki wehdaniyat ka humko
paighame haq ye suna rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
isi azaan ke liye sayyed
jawan akbar fida kiye hai
raahe khuda mein shaahe shaheedan
masoom asghar bhi de diya hai
hussain lekar chale jo maqsad
kyun aaj dunya bhula rahi hai
aao namaze fajr hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
chale azaane fajar jo de kar
to bole sheh ye batao akbar
judi hai saansein wo jiski tum se
wo bin tumhare jiyegi kyun kar
mazaare nana pe roz jaa kar
diye jo sughra jala rahi hai
aao namaze fajr hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
quran kaafi hai jo thay kehte
yehi hai quran ke wo kaari
hai wo jo naatiq quran logon
usay karenge ye qatl kaari
karenge pamaal iska laasha
ghadi asr ki wo aa rahi hai
aao namaze fajr hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
quran ke tukde huwe hai ban mein
ghilaaf e kaaba utaar daala
hussain ko karbala mein ummat
hai pyasa khursheed maar daala
usi ki mazloomiyat pe dunya
ye aaj aansu baha rahi hai
aao namaze fajr hai...

items.title: Berida shaam ke
items.body:
berida shaam ke bazaar mein jaati hai behan
aankhein abbas khuli mat rakhna

bhai is chand se chehre ko na lag jaye grahan
aankhein abbas khuli mat rakhna
<<DIVIDER>>
teri ghairat ye gawara na karegi bhaiya
sab tamashayi hai aur bhai behan be-parda
badti jaati hai ay abbas kaleje mein chuban
aankhein abbas khuli mat rakhna
berida shaam ke bazaar...

tumko abbas bahot tha mere parde ka khayaal
aa gaya shaam ka bazaar aur zainab hai nidhaal
tere marne se badi zainab e kubra ki thakan
aankhein abbas khuli mat rakhna
berida shaam ke bazaar...

ashk ke badle teri aankh se khoon behta hai
hoga ye ranj bhatije ke hai haathon mein rasan
aankhein abbas khuli mat rakhna
berida shaam ke bazaar...

thodi hi dayr ko rukta tera sar naize par
be-rida sab mera sar dekh ke phir tera sar
khauf hai soch ke rukh jaye na dil ki dhadkan
aankhein abbas khuli mat rakhna
berida shaam ke bazaar...

ek ghatri mein hamein laash mili qasim ki
dasht mein baad tere aisi qayamat tooti
ran mein pamaal hua is tarha naushaah ka tan
aankhein abbas khuli mat rakhna
berida shaam ke bazaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
boli zainab ke sakina ki rida aayi hai
na yateema hai na zinda mera bhai hai
thi wo rehan o mubarak to ajab si uljhan
aankhein abbas khuli mat rakhna
berida shaam ke bazaar...

items.title: Gar Fatema na hoti
items.body:
Teri kayenat mola, na libaas e kun pehenti, gar fatema na hoti
Kabhi bazme do jahaa(n) mein, nah ya ki baat chalti, gar fatema na hoti
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Teri lam yalid ki baatein, koi maanta bhi kaise
Tere laa ilaah ki hurmat, koi jaanta bhi kaise
Jo banaayi tu ne duniya, tujhe kibriya na kehti, gar fatema na hoti
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ye kalaam-e paak saara, hai manqabat usi ki
Karta hai zikr uska, khud sura e nisa bhi
Tafseer hal ata ki, lafzo(n) mein kaise dhalti, gar fatema na hoti
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Tune hi to kaha tha ek roz mustafa se
Takhleeq e do jahaa(n) hai, mansoob sayyada se
Main kuch nahi banata, haa(n) nasl mein tumhari, gar fatema na hoti
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Saqlain mein ali ka, koi bhi kuffo nahi tha
Saara jahaan tera, ya rab nusairi hota
Sach to yahi hai ya rab, mola ali ki biwi, gar fatema na hoti
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Is darja paak bibi, dekhi nahi koi bhi
Duniya ke saamne hai, quraan ki gawahi
Tatheer ki aayat, kiske liye utarti, gar fatema na hoti
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ye chaand aur sitaare, ye asmaa(n) ye dharti
Ye salsabeel kausar, jaageer hai usi ki
Kono makaa(n) pe tere, laa waarasi barasti, gar fatema na hoti
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Dehleez e panjatan se, nisbat huwi hai jabse
Mashhoor Ho rahe hai, mere kalaam saare
Yoo(n) mazhar abidi ko, shohrat kabhi na milti, gar fatema na hoti

items.title: Hai momino pe farz
items.body:
hai momino pe farz ita'at hussain ki
<<DIVIDER>>
karboabala mein zulm o jafa ka riwaj tha
sar pe yazeediyat ke khilafat ka taaj tha
shabbir ka lahoo jo maseeha mizaaj tha
warna munafiqat ka maraz la-ilaaj tha
yun karbala mein fikr o nazar ki dawa hui
karbobala ki khaak bhi khaake shifa hui
hai momino pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaye hai deen e haq ke liye karbala hussain
sibte rasool o laqte dil e murtuza hussain
hadi imam haq ke wali rehnuma hussain
tum ko pukarte hai azadaar ya hussain
aankhon mein apni ashke aza leke aaye hai
dil mein shaoor e karbobala leke aaye hai
hai momino pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
yun karbala mein sheh ne bhara ghar luta diya
khud sogaye to deen ka muqaddar jaga diya
chehre se ahle kufr ke parda hata diya
asghar ne has ke saare jahan ko rula diya
baysheer mein asar tha ali ke shaoor ka
asghar ke has ke tod diya buth ghuroor ka
hai momino pe farz...

bedi pehen ke abid e bemaar aayega
is raaste mein shaam ka bazaar aayega
ye zikr baad sayyede abraar aayega
jab tasht mein ye sar sar e darbar aayega
zindan mein shor hoga zameen thar tharayegi
baba ka naam leke sakina bulayegi
hai momino pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
hogi abhi to shaam e ghariban ki daastan
cheenga shimr baali sakina ki baaliyan
bazaar e shaam pahunchega lut kar ye karwan
qaidi banegi ahmed e mursal ki betiyan
baaqi musibatein hai abhi qaid khane ki
in qaidiyon pe hongi nigahein zamane ki
hai momino pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ka laal sibte rasool e anaam hai
khanjar talay bhi bakshishe ummat se kaam hai
shabbir ka payaam khuda ka payaam hai
matloob e do jahan shahe aali maqam hai
paata raha urooj yuhin gham hussain ka
lehra raha hai aaj bhi parcham hussain ka
hai momino pe farz...
items.author: Urooj Bijnori

items.title: Haye beemar e karbobala
items.body:
Haye bimar e Karbobala
ghash pe ghash kha ke girta raha..
Zulm karta Hai tauqe jafa,
Tar ba tar khoon me Hai gala..
(1)
Shiddate tashnagi se hai sukhi zuba'n,
Khoon peeta Hai gardan ka tauqe gara'n,
Gosht Tak kha gayi paaw ki bediya'n,
Ab Nazar aarahi Hai fakat haddiyan,(2)
Haddiyon me Bhi Hai khoo'n bhara..
Ghash pe ghash kha ke girta raha.....
2)
Mushtaqil badhta jaata Hai Haye waram,
Durre lagte Hain rukte Hain jab Bhi kadam,
Ho raha Hai ye Abid​ pe kaisa sitam,
Ya ilahi karam Ya ilahi karam,(2)
Marna jaye kahin Ghamzada,
Ghash pe ghash kha ke girta raha.....
(3)
Keh rahi Hain ye ro ro ke saydaniya'n
Kaisi hoti Hain bimar par saqhtiya'n,
Durre padhte hi gir jaata Hai Natawa'n,
Ho rahi Hai use khoon ki ultiya'n,(2)
Aur dawa Hai Na koi gizaa,
Ghash pe ghash kha ke girta raha.....
(4)
Ro ke kehti Hai Abid se bekas bahen,
Dono Bhai bahen ke Hain Zakhmi badan,
Tauq Tere Hain mere gale me rasan,
Kaise aagosh me le tujhe khasta tan,(2)
Kya Kare gham ka maara hua,
Ghash pe ghash kha ke girta raha.....
(5)
Jism ke zakhm dhone Bhi dete nahi,
Damane gham bhigone Bhi dete nahi,
Baap ke gham me rone Bhi dete nahi,
Hadd to ye Hai ke soone Bhi dete nahi,(2)
Kaise soye asire jafa,,
Ghash pe ghash kha ke girta raha.....
(6)
Tauq lipta Hai aisa chute Bhi nahi,
Hadd to ye Hai ke gardan hile Bhi nahi,
Shiddate dard se sar uthe Bhi nahi,
Aur utha le'n to phir sar jhuke bhi nahi,(2)
Kaisi aafat me Hai mubtila,
Ghash pe ghash kha ke girta raha.....
(7)
Sar shaheedo'n ka maqtal me kaata gaya,
Aur laasho'n pe ghodo'n ko dauda Diya,
Haye Jo the yateeman e Karbobala,
Unko durro'n se pursa Diya baap ka,(2)
Aur Zainab Hui berida,,
Ghash pe ghash kha ke girta raha...
(8)
Khoon se tar zamee'n ka mussalla Mila,
Hathkadi bediyo'n ne bhi Sajda Kiya,
Kaun karta Hai aise me shukre Khuda,
Ye tera Kaam Tha Abid e Ghamzada,(2)
Sajde Bhi keh uthe shukriya,,
Ghash pe ghash kha ke girta raha.....
(9)
Haye "Irfan" Bimar e Karbobala,
Deen e Haq ke liye har sitam seh Gaya,
Bekafan baap ke gham me rota raha,
Ho gayee'n ran me saydaniya'n be Rida,(2)
Maqsad e Haq ko zinda rakha,,
Ghash pe ghash kha ke girta raha.....

items.title: Hum wahi log hai
items.body:
Hum wahi log hai - 4
Karbala se chale jab ke ahle haram
Guzre ganje shaheeda se ba chashme nam
Girte padte chale Abide khasta dam
Pohche kufa to bole imame umam
Dekhlo kufiyo hum wahi log hai
Hum wahi log hai x 2
Dekhlo kufiyo hum wahi log hai
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Khatm jis ghar pa aaker shariyat hui
Aur muqammal nabuwat risalat hui
Farz ummat pa jinki ita'at hui
Unki ummat ke haatho ye haalat hui
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Jinka jibrael jhula jhulate rahe
Huro gilmaan lori sunaate rahe
Banke saael malaaek bhi aate rahe
Ambiya jinke ghar aate jaate rahe
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Maghbate wahya hai jinka ghar wo hai hum
Jinki sidra bani rehguzar wo hai hum
Jo hai marzi ye rab sar ba sar wo hai hum
Sajdagahe rasool jinka ghar wo hai hum
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Hum ke Allah ki tarjamani kare
Ambiya jinke ghar ki gulami kare
Jibrael aaye aur jab hasayi kare
Jinno inso malak madhakhwani kare
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Tum jama jo yahan itnai afraad ho
Dekh kar ham ko mushkil main kyun shaad ho
ya Nabi zadiyaan hai agar yaad ho
Tum hamarai ghulaamo ki aulad ho.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Jin ka tum dekh tai ho tamasha yahan
Bint-e-Paighambare do jahan in ki maa
Thi yahi pehlai kufai ki shahzaadiyaan
Thi kaneezain tumhari bahu betiyan.
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Hum ko taajo hukumat sai raghbaat kahan
Hum tumhaarai bulaanai par aye yahan
Mujhko pehnayai tauk-o-rassan bediyaan
Hun main ibn-e-Imamo Imam-e-zaman.
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Kaisai kaisia haseen aur piyarai gayai
Mushafe-noor Quran kai paarai gayai
Saamnai apni aankhon kai taarai gayai
Kaisai kaisai jawa apnai maarai gayai.
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Ghar ka ghar nazrai Karbobala ho gaya
Aaj balwe mei hai itrat-e-Mustafa
Qaid aur band mei hum howe mubtala
Hum ko dar dar phiratai ho tum bai khata.
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Phir rahai hai jo bazaar main dar ba dar
Lutt gaya do pahar mein bhara ghar ka ghaar
Hai shaheedon kai laashai pade khaak par
Nok-e-naiza pa hai sab shaheedon kai sar.
<<DIVIDER>>
11. Mai bazahir nahi faur bezaar hu
Bhuka  pyasa aseer aur beemar hu
Mujko majboor mat jaano mukhtar hu
Par razae elahi se lachaar hu
<<DIVIDER>>
12. Kya meri shayri aur nauha mera
Mir sahab ka arse se israar tha
Aap aye sibte jafar jo pursa diya
Dar haqiqat ye hai sayyada ki ata

items.title: Jalta Hai Darwaza E Khatun E Jannat Ya Rasool(s.a.w.w.)
items.body:
Jalta Hai Darwaza E Khatoone Jannat Ya Rasool,
Ho Gyi Hai Aaj Yasrab Me Kayamat Ya Rasool..
(1) Naazo Se Pala Tha Jisko Aaj Wo Mushkil Me Hai,
Fathe Khaibar Ali Bhi Sabr Ki Manzil Me Hai,
Fatema Kis Se Kare Jakar Shikayat Ya Rasool..
(2) Dar Jala Kar Qalb Dehlaya Gya Hasnain Ka,
Pasliya Todi Gyi Baage Fidak Bhi Le Liya,
Ye Mila Hai Aal Ko Ajre Risalat Ya Rasool..
(3) Raat Din Jis Dar Pe Juk Kar Aap Karte The Salam,
Naaz Karte The Farishte Ban Ke Jis Dar Ke Ghulam,
Bhool Bethe Qalma Go Us Dar Ki Azmat Ya Rasool..
(4) Qatl Jab Mohsin Huwe Veeran Duniya Ho Gyi,
Haaye Aththara Baras Me Hi Zaeefa Ho Gyi,
Zalimo Ne Is Qadar Di Hai Aziyat Ya Rasool..
(5) Bani E Zulmo Jafa Ne Zulm Ki Had Tod Di,
Jis Ghadi Haq Maangne Darbaar Me Zahra Gyi,
Aapki Beti Ki Juthla Di Sadakat Ya Rasool..
(6) Bar Sare Farshe Aza Zahra Ka Nouha Laaye Hain,
Kazimo Rizwan Pursa Paish Karne Aaye Hain,
Kijiye Maqbool Ye Ajre Risalat Ya Rasool..

items.title: Kaha rabab ne rokar
items.body:
kaha rabab ne ro kar watan chalo beti
ye maa ho tum pa nichawar watan chalo beti
<<DIVIDER>>
tadap tadap ke mai roti hoo har ghadi ab to
rehaai qaid se sun kar watan chalo beti
kaha rabab ne ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
khila pila ke sulaya karungi pehlu may
ye waada karti hai maadar watan chalo beti
kaha rabab ne ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
na ab tamache na shimr e layeen ka darr hoga
na koi cheenega gauhar watan chalo beti
kaha rabab ne ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek lamha jise yaad kar ke roti thi
hai muntazir wo tera ghar watan chalo beti
kaha rabab ne ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bahana shimr ka pani wo tum ko tadpa kar
na bhool paayi wo manzar watan chalo beti
kaha rabab ne ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
andheri raat hai aur ek hoo ka aalam hai
sukoon paaogi kyun kar watan chalo beti
kaha rabab ne ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi khushi ki tamanna wo maa kare kaise
ke jis pa toota ho mehshar watan chalo beti
kaha rabab ne ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
rabab qabr e sakina se jab raza uthi
har ek lamha tha lab par watan chalo beti
kaha rabab ne ro kar...
items.author: Raza Ali Khan Lakhnavi

items.title: Khoon barsa
items.body:
khoon barsa khoon barsa
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon barsa na barasna tha na badal barse
ek ek khatre ko pani ke shah e deen tarse
khoon barsa khoon barsa
<<DIVIDER>>
pyaas jab hadh se badi ro ke sakina ne kaha
door kitni hai chacha nehr batao ghar se
khoon barsa khoon barsa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab kahan khaak pe baithi ho sakina utho
kaun aaya hai palat kar jo gaya ran ghar se
khoon barsa khoon barsa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghurkiyan shimr ki kahin jo kiya baap ko yaad
kaan ke dard se royi to tamache barse
khoon barsa khoon barsa...
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi shabbir hai zinda wahin tehro zainab
tum ko akbar ki qasam tum na nikalna ghar se
khoon barsa khoon barsa...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere nana ke madine tujhe zainab ka salaam
thokare khaa ke palat aayi hoo main dar dar se
khoon barsa khoon barsa...
<<DIVIDER>>
haq o baatil ka ho takrao to dil ladte hai
jang ye jeeti nahi jaati kabhi lashkar se
khoon barsa khoon barsa...

items.title: Laashae abbas tanha
items.body:
laasha e abbas tanha reh gaya
dekh kar darya tadapta reh gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
jab gira ghoday se saqqa e haram
qalbe zehra ran may rota reh gaya
laasha e abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
chid gayi mashke sakina zulm se
pyase bache khaali kooza reh gaya
laasha e abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
kham hui is gham se sarwar ki kamar
chashme tar se khoon tapakta reh gaya
laasha e abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
us taraf pyasi sakina reh gayi
is taraf laasha tadapta reh gaya
laasha e abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
roke kehti thi chacha aajaiye
lab pe uske bas ye nauha reh gaya
laasha e abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunte hi bhai ke marne ki khabar
phat ke zainab ka kaleja reh gaya
laasha e abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo nigehbane haram jabse gaya
tab se aafat hi may kunba reh gaya
laasha e abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
cheenli ghazi ne yun nehre faraath
hashr tak darya pe khabza reh gaya
laasha e abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
lut gaye dunya may kitne taqt-o-taaj
bas azakhana hi sheh ka reh gaya
laasha e abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
parchame islam aur abbas ka
har taraf dunya may charcha reh gaya
laasha e abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro rahi hai aaj bhi mauje faraath
ibne zehra haaye pyasa reh gaya
laasha e abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
nauha e gham kis tarha likhe bober
jab qalam hi uska rota reh gaya
laasha e abbas...
items.author: Mir Bober Ali

items.title: Aaja Ali Asghar Tujhe Seenay Seh Laga Loon
items.body:
Kyun Rooth Gaye Loriyaan De De Keh Mana Loon
<<DIVIDER>>
Pyasa Raha Dariya Keh, Kinaray Mera Asghar,
Jee Chahta Iss Paani Ko, Mein Aag Laga Doon
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu Bol Nahi Sakta, Yeh Kehti Hai Sakina,
Asghar Tujhe Mein Maang Na, Paani Toh Sikha Doon
<<DIVIDER>>
Ay Chand Meray Marne Ko, Jaatay Ho Khuda Hafiz,
Thehro Zara Bhikri Huwi, Zulfoun Ko Saja Doon
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabbir Ne Socha Tha, Pamali Seh Bach Jayengay,
Choti Si Qabar Khod Ke, Asghar Ko Chupa Loon,
<<DIVIDER>>
Betaab Hai Jhoolay Mein, Hai Shokh E Shahadat,
Ruk Jao Mein Kubra Ko, Madinay Seh Bula Loon

items.title: Abbas aa ke dekho
items.body:
zainab ki ye sada thi zaalim sata rahe hai
abbas aa ke dekho zaalim sata rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
meri rida sina par mujhko dikha rahe hai
abbas aa ke dekho
<<DIVIDER>>
sadaat ke saron se chinti thi jab ridayein
aale nabi ne di thi us dam tujhe sadayein
ab khaake karbala se sar ko chupa rahe hai
abbas aa ke dekho
zainab ki ye sada thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
naazon se jo pali thi bhaiya teri bhatiji
ab hai sitam ke zad par haye sakina meri
usko sata rahe hai durre laga rahe hai
abbas aa ke dekho
zainab ki ye sada thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon mein aag jis dam zaalim laga rahe thay
tujhko madad ki khaatir hum sab bula rahe thay
sajjad ka bhi bistar aada jala rahe hai
abbas aa ke dekho
zainab ki ye sada thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
na-mehramon mein zainab sar nange ab yahan hai
zaamin meri rida ke na jaane tu kahan hai
be-pardagi pe meri aada rula rahe hai
abbas aa ke dekho
zainab ki ye sada thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
salman ek qayamat karbobala mein guzri
sun kar sada e zainab ghazi ki laash larzi
meri rida sina par mujhko dikha rahe hai
abbas aa ke dekho
zainab ki ye sada thi...
items.author: Salman Rizvi

items.title: Abbas(As) Ka Chehlum Hai
items.body:
Farsh e aza bichaao Abbas ka chehlum hai
Pyaasey ka ghum manaao Abbas ka chehlum hai
1) Haashim ka chaand hai ye hyder ka dilruba hai
Mazloom e karbala ka saalaar e kaafela hai
Aao Alam uthaao Abbas ka chehlum hai
2) Zehra kareygi Shirkat farsh e aza bichaao
Pyaaso'n ki yaad mey tum paani pilaao sabko
Rasm e aza nibhaao Abbas ka chehlum hai
3) Zainab na karsaki thi maatam jo baawafa ka
Hum karkey aaj maatam zainab ko dengey pursa
Maatam ki saff mey aao abbas ka chehlum hai
4) Zainab ki hai tamanna Majlis ye aah o zaari
Maatam ho sab ke ghar mey Gaazi e baawafa ki
Aankho'n se Khoo'n bahaao Abbas ka chehlum hai
5) Jee bhar ke rosakey na ahley haram jarii ko
Marham ke waastey kuch ashko'n ke qaafley ho
Aye roney waalo aao abbas ka chehlum hai
6) Hasrat thi baawafa ki koii rahey na pyaasa
Uskey hi yaad mey tum haatho'n mey lekey kooza
Paani yahaa'n pilaao Abbas ka chehlum hai
7) Ghodo'n ney jiska laasha' paamaal Kardiya hai
Karbobala mey wo jo tukdo'n mey batgaya hai
Wo waaqia sunaao abba ska chehlum hai
8) Paakar rihaayi zainab jab Karbala mey aayi
Boli ke bey kafan hai Gaazi mera abhi bhi
Uspar ridaa udhaao Abbas ka chehlum hai

items.title: Akbar naujawan
items.body:
akbar e naujawan tujhko dhoondun kahan
nauha laila ka tha akbar e naujawan
<<DIVIDER>>
tere barchi lagi maa ka dil chidh gaya
ab jeeye kis tarha teri dukhiyari maa
akbar e naujawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
roye ansar o ahle haram kehke ye
aakhri hai ye aks e nabi ki azan
akbar e naujawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri tarha lage har jawan ki sada
dekhti hoo jahan tu dikhe hai wahan
akbar e naujawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
khat mila aa ke le jao bemaar ko
kyun ho naraaz sughra se ay bhai jaan
akbar e naujawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab pisar ne bulaaya madad ke liye
shaah karte thay girte sambhalte fughan
akbar e naujawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ne khaynchi sina kehke jab ya ali
phasliyon se tha baahar dil e bekaraar
akbar e naujawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
gaysuon waale tujh par phupi ho fida
thi yun zainab bhi laashe pe nauha kuna
akbar e naujawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghash mein pyasi sakina ye kehti rahi
mujhko dilwado bhaiya meri baaliyan
akbar e naujawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab ay mirza ye nasir ne nauha padha
ashk aankhon mein thay lab pe tha ye bayan
akbar e naujawan...
items.author: Javaid Mirza

items.title: Ali yaad aaye
items.body:
Ya ali, ali ali ali ali, ya ali
Musibat ke badal, juhi sar pe chaaye, ali yaad
aaye ali yaad aaye
Bhula baithe jab saare apne paraaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Har ek kehkashaa(n) mein hai unka hi
jalwa
Maho mehr mein bhi ali ko hi dekha
Sitaare sare arsh jab jhil milaaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Udoo ko bhi mushkil se jis ne churaya
Halakat se kitno ko jisne bachaya
Koi jaan kar usko jitna bulaaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Payambar ne hare k ko jab aazmaya
Koi bhi na khaybar ka dar tod paaya
Sabhi hoke na kaam jab lawt aaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ali ki wilayat ka munkir huwa tha
Tujhe zikr e haider buraa lag raha tha
Qayamat mein sajde na jab kaam aaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Sare khum bhari dopehr mein ali ko
Rasool e khuda ne yu(n) mola banaya
Ke jab bhi koi haaji saaye mein jaaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Jo sidra ki manzil pe pohnche payambar
Koi haath parde se nikla jo baahar
Anghuti ko dekha nabi muskuraaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Sitamghaar ka halq chilne laga tha
Ke haybat se darbaar hilne laga tha
Ali ki jo beti ne khutbe sunaaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Rasool e khuda se dua mil gayi hai
Hassan ko najaf ki fazaa mil gayi hai
Jo ash-aar Imran tu ne sunaaye…

items.title: Asghar aajao
items.body:
maa dhoond rahi hai kabse asghar aajao aajao
chaaya hai har simt andhera dilbar aajao
maa dhoond rahi…
<<DIVIDER>>
tumse bichad kar dilbar mere
tadpoongi mai shaam savere
kaise jiyegi maa bin tere
aajao aajao asghar aajao
maa dhoond rahi…
<<DIVIDER>>
bhuka aalam gor andhera
soone jangal mein hai basera
ghut'ta hai dam khauf se mera
phaile hai har simt sitamgar aajao
maa dhoond rahi…
<<DIVIDER>>
khushk gala hoga mere jaani
aao pila laa'un tumhe pani
kuch to pata do kuch to nishani
khaati hoo mai thokare dar dar aajao
maa dhoond rahi…
<<DIVIDER>>
aaja mere raaj dulare
aa meri aankhon ke taare
dukhiya maa ro ro ke pukare
kaise jiyungi tumse bichad kar aajao
maa dhoond rahi…
<<DIVIDER>>
jabse suna hai fikr siwa hai
nanhe galay mein teer e jafa hai
dil ko ek dhadka sa laga hai
chalta hai dil par mere khanjar aajao
maa dhoond rahi…
<<DIVIDER>>
dhoondh rahi hoo kabse ro ro
chain se maqtal mein sotay ho
tarsogay maa ke soorat ko
jaati hoo mai shaam khule sar aajao
maa dhoond rahi…

items.title: Ay mere hussain
items.body:
ay mere hussain as-salam
ay mere imam as-salam
bekas o ghareeb as-salam
shaahe tishnakaam as-salam
<<DIVIDER>>
alqama pe jab alam gira
goonji ye taraai mein sada
al-madad ay shaahe karbala
kehta hai ghulam as-salam
ay mere hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
ek sitam ye aur ho gaya
qalbe akbar-e-hazeen chida
akse mustufa ne di sada
ya shahe inaam as-salam
ay mere hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi ye shaah ki behan
haye be-dayaro be-watan
berida hoo kaise doo kafan
jaa rahi hoo shaam as-salam
ay mere hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
ay habeeb ay hure jari
aun-o-akbar-o-mere aqi
yun hi saare dard mein ghiri
mere nayk naam as-salam
ay mere hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
tum kahan ho paaraye jigar
dhoondti hai tum ko ye nazar
chin chuki rida jala hai ghar
mere la-laqaam as-salam
ay mere hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
maine ye kalaam jo likha
is ko nazre shaah kar diya
hai yahin pa mohsin ab mera
harfe istetaam as-salam
ay mere hussain…
items.author: Mohsin Shakeeb

items.title: Bain ye zainab ka
items.body:
bain ye zainab ka tha shaam e ghariban bata
kya hua kunba mera shaam e ghariban bata
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim e naushaah ki laash ke tukde huwe
kaisa ye sehra bandha shaam e ghariban bata
bain ye zainab ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun ye har ek aankh se khoon ke aansu giray
kaise hai gham ki ghata shaam e ghariban bata
bain ye zainab ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
abid e beemar par shah ke ghamkhwar par
kyun hai ye jor o jafa shaam e ghariban bata
bain ye zainab ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyaas may asghar mera rayt par tadpa kiya
pani kya usko mila shaam e ghariban bata
bain ye zainab ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisi ye aayi hai shaam khauf har ek soo hai aam
aur iraada hai kya shaam e ghariban bata
bain ye zainab ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
aun o mohamed mere ganj e shaheedan may thay
dono ka hai haal kya shaam e ghariban bata
bain ye zainab ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon se jalte huwe maut ke sholay uthe
kya koi zinda bacha shaam e ghariban bata
bain ye zainab ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye yateemon ke saath aur aseeron ke saath
hai yehi insaaf kya shaam e ghariban bata
bain ye zainab ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo mera akbar jawan mar gaya kha kar sina
laasha kya uska utha shaam e ghariban bata
bain ye zainab ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
sarwar e zeeshan ke zakhm bahatar lage
hai yehi karbobala shaam e ghariban bata
bain ye zainab ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai bhi palta nahi pani bhi aaya nahi
kya hua ghazi mera shaam e ghariban bata
bain ye zainab ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye garoh e hussain padti hai zainab ke bain
kyun na ho ghamgeen raza shaam e ghariban bata
bain ye zainab ka tha...
items.author: Raza Ali Khan Lakhnavi

items.title: Berida shaam ki
items.body:
be rida shaam ki galiyon se guzar zainab ka
phir se abid pe hai tehreer safar zainab ka
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon e shabbir ki har boond ka maqrooz bashar
khoon e shabbir hai maqrooz ye magar zainab ka
be rida shaam ki galiyon...
<<DIVIDER>>
gir pada khaak pe abbas ka sar maqtal may
nok e naiza se na dekha gaya sar zainab ka
be rida shaam ki galiyon...
<<DIVIDER>>
lashkar e shaam ki tayghon may ghira hai akbar
chup gaya kitni ghata'on may qamar zainab ka
be rida shaam ki galiyon...
<<DIVIDER>>
laash e akbar se lipat kar ye hawa kehti thi
kitna chalni kiya barchi ne jigar zainab ka
be rida shaam ki galiyon...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye alag baat ke mehfooz raha deen e rasool
ye alag baat ke loota gaya ghar zainab ka
be rida shaam ki galiyon...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis jagah shaam e ghariban ki ho majlis barpa
zikr hota hai wahan taa'ba sehar zainab ka
be rida shaam ki galiyon...
<<DIVIDER>>
aur goonjega abhi arz o samaa may mohsin
matam e ibne ali may hai asar zainab ka
be rida shaam ki galiyon...
items.author: Mohsin

items.title: Charaghe hussain
items.body:
charagh e hussain
phaili hui hai khushbuein baaghe hussain ki
har simt roshni hai charagh e hussain ki
<<DIVIDER>>
ye woh charag jise sheh ne aagahi di hai
isi charagh ne dunya ko roshni di hai
isi charagh ne gul hoke shaam e ashoora
hussaniyat ke iradon ko zindagi di hai
charagh e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
isi ke noor se dunya ye jagmagayi hai
hayaat shams o qamar ne isi se paayi hai
dayaar e zulm se hurr is taraf jo aaya hai
isi charag ke lou hurr ko khaynch laayi hai
charagh e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussaniyat ka jigar mein charagh jalta hai
shaour o fikr o nazar mein charahg jalta hai
kabhi namaz ki surat kabhi azan ban ke
khuda e paak ke ghar mein charagh jalta hai
charagh e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye baat haq hai ke noor e tahoor is mein hai
tajalliyaat raheem o ghafoor is mein hai
har ek shaks isy dekh hi nahi sakta
jo koh e toor pe chamka woh noor is mein hai
charagh e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
shumaar iska hai mabood ke nageeno mein
isi ki aag hai maulaiyon ke seeno mein
isi charagh se hai raunaq e azadari
yehi charahg to roshan hai sheh nasheeno mein
charagh e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek sadi ki sada hussain zindabad
bayaz e dil pe likha hussain zindabad
payambaro ne kaha hussain zindabad
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi to surat e baysheer mein hai muskaya
bana ye seena e akbar sina ka phal khaaya
hussain ban ke yehi noor baad e ashoora
quran padhte huwe bar sar e sina aaya
charagh e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
khusha naseeb jo hum ko mili hai karbobala
hussaniyo ke liye zindagi hai karbobala
jise ye saara zamana salaam karta hai
usi charagh se roshan hui hai karbobala
charagh e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
sune ye saara zamana wafa hussain se hai
hamari khuld ka har raasta hussain se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
dar e hussain pe jo shaqs jaa nahi sakta
hisaar e noor mein is ke woh aa nahi sakta
hussain ibne ali ne isay jalaya hai
isay koi bhi yazeedi bujha nahi sakta
charagh e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
noor uska chupa nahi har ek ko dikha nahi
dushman ko mila nahi zaalim se bujha nahi
charagh e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
yazeediyat ke andheron ko maarne waala
yehi hai dasht mein hal min pukaarne waala
shahadaton ko ziya baar kar diya is ne
yehi hai joun ki surat nikhaarne waala
charagh e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
dua hai phoolta phalta rahe charagh e hussain
hawa e zulm kuchalta rahe charagh e hussain
faqat yehi hai dua e kumail o aamir ki
aza ki shakl mein jalta rahe charagh e hussain
charagh e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera imam hussain mera kalaam hussain
hai subho shaam hussain tumhara naam hussain
items.author: Kumail Jafri

items.title: Din dhal gaya
items.body:
din dhal gaya shaam aa gayi abbas abbas na laute
shaam aur ghazab dha gayi abbas abbas na laute
<<DIVIDER>>
baakhi nahi ansar na hai monis o yawar
maqtool-e-jafa ran may hue sarware aalam
karte hai haram shiddate aalaam se matam
sab khurdo kalzam aaho buka karte hai payham
ye kiski nazar kha gayi abbas abbas na laute
din dhalgaya shaam aagayi…
<<DIVIDER>>
wo kaunse hai zulm jo bedeeno ne choday
atfaal e hussaini pe sitam haye ye today
ghash may pade bemaar ko maare gaye koday
taraaj kiya qaimon ko dauda diye ghoday
sadaat pe aanch aa gayi abbas abbas na laute
din dhalgaya shaam aagayi…
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar loot liya cheeni rida qaime jalaye
zar loot ke saydaniyo ko durre lagaye
hai kaun jo aada ki jafa'on se bachaye
zainab kisay imdaad ko ab apni bulaye
ghurbat ki faza chagayi abbas abbas na laute
din dhalgaya shaam aagayi…
<<DIVIDER>>
dar aaye qayame pisar-e-sheh may sitamgar
zakhmi kiya durro se tan e abide mustar
khayncha sitam afgaaro ne bemaar ka bistar
dekha gaya aflaak o zameen se na ye manzar
karbobal tharra gayi abbas abbas na laute
din dhalgaya shaam aagayi…
<<DIVIDER>>
jab zainab-e-kubra ne khabar gham ki ye paayi
maqtal may kahin kho gayi shabbir ki jaayi
us waqt suqan lab pe ye binte ali laayi
ay dashte jafa kaisi jafa aur ye dhaayi
maa ghamzada ghabragayi abbas abbas na laute
din dhalgaya shaam aagayi…
<<DIVIDER>>
aaghosh tumhari hai na hai baap ka seena
zid karti hai jaan khoti hai ro ro ke hazeena
aisa to kabhi dekha na tha bhai khareena
kyon aayi na darya pe tumhe yaad sakina
kya cheez wahan bha gayi abbas abbas na laute
din dhalgaya shaam aagayi…
<<DIVIDER>>

items.title: Akbar ne di aza'n
items.body:
1
Subhe dahum ke waqt jo akbar ne di aza'n.
Qalbo jigar ko thaam ke roti thi ayk maa'n.
2
Hur chal diya yazeed ke lashkar ko chhor kar
Takraai uske kaano se akbar ki jab aza'n.
3
Kehte the sheh utha ke ye laasha habeeb ka
Bachpan ki dosti ko na hone di raegaa'n.
4
Qurbaan kar ke bhaai pe bete na roungi.
Khayme me bibiyo'n se tha zainab ka yeh baya'n.
5
Takseem ran me hogya qaasim sa gulbadan.
G
athri mai laasha dekhke dam tor degi ma'n.
6
Jalti zamee'n pe gir gae thaame huve kamar.
Baazu mila husain ko abbas ka janha'n.
7
Naala hai yeh husain ka bhaai ki laash par.
Tanha mai aaj ho gaya dushman ke darmya'n.
8
Ayyoob sabr dekho lo aakar husain ka
Sheh ke zaeef kaandho pe hai laasa e jawa'n.
9
Seene mai tere dil nahi  path'thar hai hurmala
Hai teen fal ka teer to asghar hai bezaba'n.
10
Tanha husain hogae ab kisko de sada
Sajjad pe yaqeen tha wo bhi hai naatva'n.
11
Tab shimr kund karta tha khanjar ki dhaar ko.
Ran me sunaai deti thi jab asr ki aza'n.
12
Sajde mai sheh ki kaat ke gardan ko phir laee'n
Sar ko pakad ke baalo'n se hansta tha bad gumaa'n.
13
Kar paaenge baya'n na woh Navshad o Mustafa.
Bade husain hoga jo zaina ka imteha'n.

items.title: Beta Abbas (Wasiyat E Mola Ali As)
items.body:
Zaqmi jab masjid e kufa se ali aaye Ghar
Roke farmane Lage hai Mera abbas kidhar
Di sada ai mere Sani mere mazloom pisar
Aake ab baap ki tum sunlo wasiyat dilbar
Hai wasiyat ye meri tum se ai beta abbas
Dhyan ab zainab o kulsoom ka rakhna abbas
1) Sar se bacho ke utha jab se hai maa ka saya
Mai ne bacho ko bade nazon se pala beta
Tum mere baad ho is Ghar ka sahara abbas
Hai wasiyat ye meri tum ....
2) Yad Amma ki unhen aane na paye dilbar
Samne zainab o kulsoom ke mumkin ho agar
Baat maa se bhi kabhi Hans ke na karna abbas
Hai wasiyat ye meri tum...
3) Gulshan e fatema zehra ki Kali hai zainab
Saaye me ismat o iffat ke Pali hai zainab
Aanch parde pa kabhi aane na Dena abbas
Hai wasiyat ye meri tum...
4) Mere qatil ko pakard kar koi le aaye agar
Sabr karlena magar, tegh uthana na pisar
Karbala ke lye Mai ne tumhe maanga abbas
Hai wasiyat ye meri tum...
5) Pani raton ko pilati thi usey maa zehra
Pyasa shabbir ko tum rehne na dena beta
Kaam saqqai ka in hathon se lena abbas
Hai wasiyat ye meri tum...
6) Saans ruk ruk ke meri chalne lagi hai beta
Aisa lagta hai ye ruqsat ki ghadi hai beta
Rakhna is Ghar ka qayal Aaj se beta abbas
Hai wasiyat ye meri tum...
7) Betiyon ko mere Jane se bahut hoga malal
Jab uthe mera janaza to rahe itna qayal
Sar se zainab ke Rida sarke na beta abbas
Hai wasiyat ye meri tum...
8) De ke abbas ke hathon pa wo dast e sarwar
Chal base Ghazi se haidar yahi Arham keh kar
Sheh ko hargiz na kabhi chordna tanha abbas
Hai wasiyat ye meri tum se ai beta abbas

items.title: Haye Bin Maa Ke Ho Gaye Ham Log
items.body:
Zehra ko dafn karke jo aaye bashor-o-sheen

Haaye bin maa ke ho gaye hum log….

Meri Amma nikal ke aayengi

Par khayaalon ki hai yeh raahguzar
Haaye bin maa ke ho gaye hum log….

Gard baalon mein hai, chuda jaao
Tumko Amma qasam hai Nana ki
Apne bachchon ke paas aa jaao
Neend aati nahi humein shab bhar
Haaye bin maa ke ho gaye hum log….

Haaye bikhri hai ja-ba-ja ghar mein
Kaisi-kaisi nishaaniyaan maa ki
Baithi roti hai us jagah Kulsoom
Jahaan tooti thi pasliyaan maa ki
Jalta darwaaza bhi gira un par
Haaye bin maa ke ho gaye hum log….
<<DIVIDER>>
Kis tarah bhool jaaun ae Zainab
Maa ka deewaar-o-dar mein pis jaana
Aankh mein baar-baar phirta hai
Woh tamaache, waseeliyaan khaana
Gham se phat jaaye na hamaara jigar
Haaye bin maa ke ho gaye hum log….

Dekho deewaar-o-dar pe ae Zainab

Haaye maa ke ho gaye hum log….

Hashr barpa tha ek bachchon mein
Ro ke Aamir sabhi yeh kehte the
Dil ko aata nahi yaqeen pal bhar
Haaye maa ke ho gaye hum log….

items.title: Jalta huwa darwaza
items.body:
Jalta hua darwaza pahlu pe giraya hai.
Ummat ne teri baba kistarha sataya hai.
Pursa tera dene ko aayana koi baba
Har ek ne yatimi ka ehsas dilaya hai.
Jis dar pe salami ko aap aate they aye baba.
Afsos usi dar ko ummat ne giraya hai.
Guzri jo jafa mujh par kis tarha bataoon main.
Har aan laeeno ne haider ko rulaya hai.
Bardasht na kar paya pahluwe shikasta ko.
Jisne dare khaibar ko ungli pe uthaya hai.
Jo baaghey fedak tumne tha mujhko diya baba.
Uske liye zalim ne darbar bulaya hai.
Yoon ajr risalat ka hota hai ada baba.
Ummat ne teri hamko jibhar ke sataya hai.
Rad sari dalilon ko maloon ne kardala.
Jisne meri chaokhat se islam ko paya hai.
Kistarha nawaz apne ashkon kontasalli de.
Zahra ki lahed pe jab aalam ka saya hai.

akbar ne kaha zakhm...

saniye shere khuda madadgaar
baab e hussain - alamdaar..(4)

dete hai humko ye daleel
wallah

tu hai ghume sheh ka wakeel
jab jaha'n dekhe alam kahe hum
duniya ho jaye fana rahe ghum
matam e sheh ki sadaa na ho kam
baab e hussain - alamdaar..(4)

ho ye zanjeer zani hamadam
aur rahe khooni qaba yehi hum
yani abaad rahe tera ghum
baab e hussain - alamdaar..(4)

6. Rasme saqqayi adaa aath moharram ko kare
haziri hum karte rahe
wallah
banke faqeer, ameer, wazeer, aseer

tu duao'n ko asar ataa kar
khali godi ko pisar ataa kar
rizq, aulad, hunar ataa kar
baab e hussain - alamdaar..(4)

7. Kehke jo baab e hussain maange dua hogi qubool
kehta hai ye ibn e rasool
wallah
tera akhi, wali, wasi, sakhi
ye hai dilo jaane batool
ye wazeefa ho tere labo par
teri sunlenge dua payambar
wird ye sham o sahar kiya kar
baab e hussain - alamdaar..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Zindagi bhar yehi mazhar o irfan dua
zinda rahe ehle azaa
wallah..
nauha azaa, fugha, quraa'n, bayaa'n
jaari rahe ye silsila

soz khwa'n ehle qalam nauha khwa'n
tu azadaro ka hai qadardaa'n
baab e hussain - alamdaar..(4)

items.title: Baab E Saat Aur Zainab
items.body:
kaise ghazi ke sar ko aye qaraar
baab sa'at hai aur zainab  hai
khune dil ro raha hai ek bimaar
baab-e-sa'at hai aur zainab  hai
1) ja'an se rote huwe guzar jaye
ghairaton se kahin na mar jaye
charo janib hai majmaye aghiyaar
2) hai har ek simt aina bandi
sar jhukaye khadi hai binte ali
kis qadar hai ye marhala dushwar
3) kitni bebas hai binte shahe hejaz
bahre imdaad kis ko de awaaz
qatl maqtal me ho gaye ansaar
4) be redai ka gham hai aur ye sitam
dekhti hai'n nigahe na mahram
kya kare binte haidar e karrar
5) qatle sarwar pe dekhti hai khushi
gham zada hai batool ki beti
hai aya'n rukh se maut ke asaar
6) hai pase pusht dono hath bandhe
kaise chehra bachaye zakhmon se
pattharon ki hai har taraf bauchaar
7) dil pa chalta hai zulm ka khanjar
yaad aati hai ghurbate madar
jane wali hai ab sare darbaar
8) dil pa sadma hay be ridayi ka
aur gham hay ghareeb bhai ka
khwahar e shah hay bekaso lachaar
9) kaise likkhun mai dastan e malal
dil phata ja raha hay mir hilal
gham zada dil hay aur qalam ghamkhar

items.title: Kaha shabbir ne ran mein
items.body:
kaha shabbeer ne ran me mere akbar kaha'n ho tum.
Zara aavaaz do mujko mere dilbar kaha'n ho tum.
Jawa beta asa hota hai baba ka zaerfi mai
Mere pyaare sahaara do muje aakar kaha'n ho tum.
Janaaze par janaaze sub'h se maine uthae hai.
utha lunga tera laasha mai kaandhe par kaha'n ho tum.
chhupa kar zakhm seene ka na ragdo ediya'n bete.
mai kheechunga kaleje se tere nashtar kaha'n ho tum.
huvi behosh ro ro kar tumhaari yaad me laila
hai lab par marsiya uske dile maadar kaha'n ho tum
tumhe paala hai ath'thara baras naazo'n se zainab ne.
na ji paaegi woh tumse juda hokar kaha'n ho tum.
Suna hai jab se tere biyaah ke baare mai zainab se
Sakeena maangti hai neg mai gohar kaha'n ho tum
watan se qaaside sughra hai aaya aaj khat lekar.
Bahut bechain hai beta teri khwaahar kaha'n ho tum.
muje tanha samaj kar ab sitamgar yeh daraate hai.
chalaaenge meri gardan pe ab khanjar kaha'n ho tum.
kaleja muh ko aaya baap ne dekha jo bete ko.
tadap kar fir pukaare ay mere dilbar yaha'n ho tum.
shehedee'n jab vaha ghutno ke bal  pohche to yeh bole
meri jaa'n hai jigar tera lahu me tar yaha'n ho tum.
Sada di Mustafa sheh ne kabhi Navshad ghaazi ko.
Chale aavo zaaeefi par taras khaakar kaha'n ho tum.

items.title: Abbas abbas
items.body:
hai bekason ka ghareebon ka aasra abbas
wafa hai mulk to us mulk ka khuda abbas
janabe fatema zehra ka mudda'a abbas
janabe hyder e safdar ka aeena abbas
har ek simt do aalam me zikr hota hai
janabe fatema binte asad ka pota hai
abbas abbas abbas abbas
abbas abbas abbas abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek sawaal se pehle jawab dete hai
jo zarra maango to ye aaftab dete hai
koi jo khatra kahe behre aab dete hai
sakhi hai kaanto ke badle gulaab dete hai
yehi ruke huwe toofan ka ishara hai
furaat par abhi abbas ka ijaara hai
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
usi furaat pe maare gaye ba- dard o malaal
pahunch ke laash pe sarwar ne tab kiya ye malaal
abhi mai poora karunga agar ho koi sawaal
jari ye ro ke pukara ke ay batool ke laal
laga hai aankh mein jo teer usay hata dije
huzoor apna ye chehra mujhe dikha dije
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha ye aur suye firdaus chal diya ghazi
labe furaat har ek mauj khoon bahati rahi
ye choonke hazrate abbas ki wasiyat thi
jo laash saahil e darya pe shaah ne chodi
ye kehte jaate thay kis tarha ab jiye shabbir
alam ko leke suye qaima chal diye shabbir
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
tamam bacchon ne haathon se kooze phaynk diye
alam se haye chacha keh ke daud kar lipte
sakina boli chacha ko kahan pe chod aaye
na pani chahiye ab aur hai na pyaas mujhe
chacha ko ya to yahin par bula do ay baba
ya mujhko paas unhi ke par sula do ay baba
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaban e haal se zainab pukari ay bhai
ho tum pe khwahar e dilgeer waari ay bhai
suno to aake hamari bezaari ay bhai
kahin lute na ridayein hamari ay bhai
magar hua wohi zainab ko jiska dhadka tha
jo shaam aayi to na chadar thi aur na parda tha
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi ke sar pe na baaqi rida thi ay majid
ajeeb tarha ki jor o jafa thi ay majid
ke ashk afshan wo chashme khuda thi ay majid
ke taaba shaam haram ki sada thi ay majid
kahan ho ab paye imadad aao ay abbas
hamay sitam se layeen ke bachao ay abbas
abbas abbas...

items.title: Geera hai Kha ke Sina Ran Me Naujawan Akbar
items.body:
Sina jo seena e Akbar me aake toot gayi..
Jawaan laal ko sheh dhoondhne nikalte hain..
Dikhai kuch nahi deta Husain ko run me..
Kabhi wo girte hain gir kar kabhi wo uthtey hain..
Geera hai kha ke sinaN Ran me naujawaN Akbar...
Hussain dhundh rahe hai Yahan Wahan Akbar...
Tumhare baap ko has has ke dekhte hain shaqi
Jigar me maar ke do (2)
tere barchiya Akbar..
Hussain dekh ke bete ka pehlu kehte the..
Hain yaad aa gayi amma ki Pasliya Akbar..
Najaf se maine bulaya hai dada Haider ko
Abhi na hona tu be-jaan meri jaa Akbar..
Shaqi ne seene me ye keh ke barchi todi hai
Hussain kaise nikalenge ye sina Akbar..
Zaeef baba hai Sabir ye sabr kar lega..
Dikhawo sine me tooti huwi seena Akbar..
Hamare zaanu pe tum todte ho dum beta..
Duaein jeene ki karti hai Teri maa Akbar..
Jawan lal ko dulha banane wali thi..
Qaza ne chhin liya uska ye jawan Akbar..
Zameen e garm pe Laila giri hain ghash khake
Chada jo katt ke Tera sar ser e sina Akbar
Hai jaese zahra ne pala mujhe tumhe waise
Chala ke pala hai Zainab ne chakkiya Akbar..
Hussain kar na sake kuch Turab aur Asmee
Radag ke mar Gaya maqtal me Ediya Akbar..

rehan o mubarak zainab ka

items.title: Bali Sakina Roti Hai
items.body:
Aye Baba Payare Baba
Bali sakeena Roti hai Baba Baba kaheti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Bali sakeena Roti hai zulm ye kitni saheti hai
Aye Baba Payare Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
(1)
Ammu nahi Akbar Bhi nahi
Haye koi yawar Bhi nahi
Kiske sahare Ab mai jiu’n
Had hai mera asghar bhi nahi
Teer gale par uske mara
Jal gaya sholo’n me gahewara
<<DIVIDER>>
(2)
Rooh meri dukh payi hai
Aankh meri bhar aayi hai
Qaid mera ek bhai hai
Qismat me tanhayi hai
Chut gaye mere sare sahare
So gaye Ammu naher kanare
<<DIVIDER>>
(3)
Sahe Liya sadma asghar ka
Dard hai dil me akbar ka
Hye hye dagh bahattar ka
Kaise ho matam ghar bhar ka
Mooh pe tamache kab tak kahu’n
Kab tak chup kar ashq bahau’n
<<DIVIDER>>
(4)
Sahe ke tamacho’n ke yalgaar
Neel hue mere rukshar
Ek qadam pe so so Baar
Pusht pe durro’n ki bauchar
Dil ke sab Armaan hai zakhmi
Chin gaye gohar kaan hai zakhmi
<<DIVIDER>>
(5)
Rukh pe tamachon ke hai nishaan
Khoon ke aansu Rote hain kaan
Itna souch ke hoon hairan
Tanha mai or ye zindan
Qaid se chut kar jab jayenge
Chode ke mujhko sab jayenge
<<DIVIDER>>
(6)
Tum se Bichad kar neend kahan
Ab hai bichauna renge tapa’n
Koi nahi hum dard yahan
Chatkhe hain lab sukhi zaban
Dard bhari rudad sunega
Kon meri fariyad sunega
<<DIVIDER>>
(7)
Gurbat ke ahesas ka sadma
Tooti hui har aas ka sadma
Bhuk ka sadma payas ka sadma
Haye chacha abbas ka sadma
Ab nahi kahete koi sakeena
Sab kahete hain mujhko yateema
<<DIVIDER>>
(8)
Aale nabi ka gham fakhri
Kaise likhenge hum fakhri
Nam aankhen hain aye Mahfooz
Karte raho matam fakhri
Tha wo qayamat jaisa manzar
Royi sakeena jab ye kahe kar

items.title: Ghadeer e khum ka suraj
items.body:
Ghadeer e khum ka suraj kaam kya purkaar karta hai
kisi ko noor karta hai kisi ko naar karta hai
Wilayat se ali ki aaj jo inkaar karta hai
wo apne badnasab hone ka khud iqraar karta hai
Nishaa'n deewaar ka ye aaj bhi iqraar karta hai
kaaba toot kar maula ali se pyaar karta hai
Hasee meesam ke hotho'n par dame aakhir hai kyu maula
mujhe lagta hai jaise aapka deedar karta hai
Yehi pehchaan hai logo zamane mein muqassir ki
zabaa'n iqraar karti hai, amal inkaar karta hai
Nuseri se bada mushrik nahi dekha koi maine
jo apne hi khuda ki baat ka inkaar karta hai
Nishaa'n deewaar ka ye aaj bhi iqraar karta hai
ke kaaba toot kar maula ali se pyaar karta hai

items.title: Kaha'n se layegi duniya hussain ke jaisa
items.body:
Kahan se laayegi Duniya HUSSAIN (a.s.) ke jaisa,
Faqat Hussain(a.s.)Melegaa
HUSSAIN (a.s.) ke Jaisa,
Ibadaton ka toh jarri hai Silsila abh tak,
Namaz ko wo Namazi nahi Mila abh tak,
Karey jo khaq pe sajdaa Hussain ke jaisa,
Kahan se laayegi Duniya HUSSAIN (a.s.) ke jaisa,
Delaair manrahi hai shujaateinn tumko,
Salaam karti hai Asghar(a.s.) Shahadatein Tumko,

Kahan se laayegi Duniya HUSSAIN(a.s.) ke jaisa,
Khuda hi jane ke Abbas(a.s.) kya hai shaan Teri,
Ye manzilat Ye saaadat kisey nasib huwi,
Tujhe samajhti hai Zehra(s.a.) HUSSAIN(a.s.) ke Jaisa,
Kahan se laayegi Duniya HUSSAIN (a.s.) ke jaisa,
Nusairioon se kaho chod dey baa zidd hona,
Qubool kaise karega wo Lam Yalid Hona,
