items.title: Bali sakina tanha
items.body:
jab qaid se aseer reha hogaye tamam
qabre sakina par gaye rote huwe imam
matam kuna saath mein ahle haram tamam
aahista aa rahi thi rabab e khadista kaam
choti si qabr saamne nazron ke phir gayi
ek aah sard khaynch ke marqad pa gir gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan se rehaai sadaat ko mili hai
bali sakina tanha zindan mein reh gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bano ke bain sun kar har bibi ro rahi hai
bali sakina tanha zindan mein reh gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi shamiyon se bano ghareeb ro ke
is ka khayal rakhna naazon ki ye pali hai
har shab diye jalana marqad pe teeragi hai
bali sakina tanha...
zindan se rehaai...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba chacha ko tarsi aah o buka ko tarsi
zindan mein ye yateema taaza hawa ko tarsi
baba ko rote rote bas thak ke so gayi hai
bali sakina tanha...
zindan se rehaai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi roz ro kar ab to phupi chalo ghar
zindan mein mar na jaye shabbir ki ye dukhtar
ye yaad kar ke zainab sar apna peet'ti hai
bali sakina tanha...
zindan se rehaai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kamsin ho bekhata ho aur qaid e jafa ho
daaghe yateemi logon jaise koi saza ho
bano ke dil se poocho kaisi ye bekasi hai
bali sakina tanha...
zindan se rehaai...
<<DIVIDER>>
faryad par thay pehre zakhme jigar thay gehre
ta marg mit na paye taqdeer ke andhere
kis jurm ki saza hai bachi ko jo mili hai
bali sakina tanha...
zindan se rehaai...

is qaid se nikalo aaghosh mein chupalo
kehti thi zaalimo se baba mujhe bachalo
ye bain karte karte khamosh ho gayi hai
bali sakina tanha...
zindan se rehaai...

ab ghar chalenge bhai payenge kab rehaai
abid se poochti thi sadmon ki wo satayi
wo mar chuki hai lekin faryad goonjti hai
bali sakina tanha...
zindan se rehaai...

safdar ki chasme nam bhi rote hai ahle gham bhi
mazhar bhi likh ke roya khirtaas aur qalam bhi
kya gham ka marsiya tareekh ro padi hai
bali sakina tanha...

items.title: Betiyan aayi hai
items.body:
baap ki mayyat ki raunaq betiyon ke dam se hai
aa rahi hai zainab o kulsoom haye sar khule
<<DIVIDER>>
betiyan aayi hai mayyat ke sirhane ya ali
<<DIVIDER>>
di sada kufe mein rooh e fatema ne ya ali
betiyan aayi hai mayyat ke sirhane ya ali
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm kufe mein kiya hai kaisa ahle shaam ne
umr bhar zainab na aayi thi padar ke saamne
aaj kaise aayi hai mayyat pe jaane ya ali
betiyan aayi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham ke aalam mein ruqayya ki wafa to dekhiye
kis tarha wo zainab o kulsoom se aage badhe
laash par aayi nahi aansu bahane ya ali
betiyan aayi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar zainab ki haalat yaad aata hai mujhe
us ghadi ummul masayib mere baba kehte thay
jis ghadi di thi hamay zainab khuda ne ya ali
betiyan aayi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya bataun kya guzarti hai tere abbas par
hausla kaise kare zainab ko rota dekh kar
ghar se baahar hai wo pehre ke bahane ya ali
betiyan aayi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
teen din se shor hai har ek azaan par bain ka
kis tarha se gham batta'un boliye hasnain ka
mere bacche aur yateemi ke zamane ya ali
betiyan aayi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ki mayyat pe kaise aayi hai ye dekhiye
jaate jaate beti ka lehja to sunt jaaiye
shaam jaana hai isay khutbe sunane ya ali
betiyan aayi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kahun baba ka kaisa haal tha aflaak par
gir gayi thi mai baqayya mein tadap kar khaak par
aap ne choome thay jab ghazi ke shaane ya ali
betiyan aayi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ka saaya ho na baaqi baap hi zinda rahe
jaate jaate betiyon ko itna batla dijiye
kaise palthe hai bhala aise gharane ya ali
betiyan aayi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm ki akbar hui hai har taraf yun inteha
karbala kufa najaf yasrab se aati hai sada
aaye ab ibe hassan inko basaane ya ali
betiyan aayi hai...

items.title: Chehlum manane bhai
items.body:
chehlum manane bhai zainab tumhari aayi

rassi se jab sitamgar baandhe meri kalayi
chehlum manane bhai...

ab aun na mohamed kaisi ye bebasi hai
koi nahi hai mera ab kya ye zindagi hai
sab yaad aa rahe hai veerani si hai chaayi
chehlum manane bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab qatl ho gaye jab abid pe zulm dhaaye
sar se ridayein cheeni qaime sabhi jalaye
jab zulm ke shehr may shaam e ghariban aayi
chehlum manane bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai mai shaam ke bhi bazaar may phiri hoo
bhai mai sar barehna darbar may gayi hoo
ahmed ki mai nawasi mai dar badar phirayi
chehlum manane bhai...

dooba hua hussain ka…

dooba hua hussain ka…

items.title: Ghadeer phir ghadeer hai
items.body:
Hai Boriya nashee'n to kya ameer phir ameer hai
Adu hai hukmaraa'n to kya faqeer phir faqeer hi
bohot se din hai eid ke Ghadeer phir ghadeer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Awaam ho ya hukmara'n madad inhi se lete hai
ghulam apne khoon ki sanad inhi se lete hai
ghulam ho ya ho pisar haqeer phir haqeer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Khushi ke din hai fitr azha aur mubahila sabhi
jo masiyat se paak ho wo roz bhi hai eid hi
khushi ke din bohot se hai Ghadeer phir Ghadeer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ali nabi ka janashee'n hai baab e shehr e ilm bhi
shareek e noor e mustafa hai pesh aur wasi wali
wo sab hai par nabi nahi wazeer phir wazeer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Halaak hone se bachaya usne tumko baarha
agar che tumne har qadam pa murtaza ko dukh diya
madad ko phir bhi aayega Ameer phir Ameer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Tere mu'aamile mein kar rahe hai jo agar magar
nabi ki shahzadi haq nahi mila to ghum na kar
Khalifa hogaya to kya, Faqeer phir Faqeer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Agarche hur ne sheh ki raah rok kar bura kiya
wo saari raat lashkare yazeed mein raha to kya
wo haq pa hoga subho dum Zameer phir Zameer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Wo shaah e inso jaa'n malaeka ka bhi imaam hai
usi ka sibt e jafar e haqeer bhi ghulaam hai
ghulaam sab bade sahi Haqeer phir haqeer hai

items.title: Hurmala ne teer se cheda gala besheer ka
items.body:
Hurmula ne teer se cheda gala besheer ka..
Khoon se sukha Gala tar Ho Gaya besheer ka..
Zalimo se bole sarwar pyasa hai asghar mera..
Halq me kateN pade hai Kab se hai sukha gala...
Tashngi se haal dekho kya hua beshir ka...
Bund paani na mila to Bete se bole imam
Khushq Hontho ko dikha ke Kar do ab Hujjat tamam..
Lashkar e aada ne dekha Hosla besheer ka..
Garm reti par sulaya shah ne jab ye gulab
Dard ka manzar na dekhe Khaime se Umme rabab
Pusht par chhale pade aur tan jala besheer ka..
Aab ke badle gale per hurmula ka teer hai
Teer e sheh shoba se Zakhmi bazu e shabbeer hai
Khoon jitna tha badan me bah gaya besheer ka..
Hath me khune Ali tha or Husaain ibn e ali..
AasmaaN raazi nahi tha Na zameeN razi huwi..
Apne chehre pe lahu sheh ne mala besheer ka
Aage badhte thy kabhi peeche hataa'te the kadam..
Soch ker ye janib e khaima chale shaahe umam..
Haal kya maa'N ko bataunga bhala besheer ka
Kabr se bahar nikala Shimr ne nanha sa phool..
Dil kate aale nabi ke kampi hai Rooh e batool
Samne jab Maa'N ke haaye Sar kata besheer ka..
Ghurbat e shabeer bhi shabber pe rone lagi..
Tar ali asghar ki turbat sheh ne jab ashqo se ki..
Pyaas ne asmee padha jab marsiya besheer ka..

items.title: Janabe umme laila
items.body:
aayi jawan laal ke marne ki jab khabar
maa royi dono haathon se dil apna thaam kar
moo peet'ti thi apna kabhi peet'ti thi sar
kehti thi lut gaya mera karbobala mein ghar
barchi ne tod daala jigar meri jaan ka
sehra na dekh paayi mai apne jawan ka
<<DIVIDER>>
janabe umme laila yehi padti thi nauha
na dekha maine apne jawan bete ka sehra
<<DIVIDER>>
meri nazron ke aage luti hai meri dunya
na dekha maine apne jawan bete ka sehra
<<DIVIDER>>
duayein kar ke athara baras jis laal ko paala
lahoo mein doob kar aaya hai wo kadiyal jawan mera
kahan se laaun himmat mai kaise dekhun laasha
na dekha maine apne jawan bete ka sehra
janabe umme laila...
<<DIVIDER>>
nahi tha saahibe aulaad kya wo be-rehm qatil
nikaala jiski barchi ne mere kadiyal jawan ka dil
mere bacche ko pyasa layeen ne maar daala
na dekha maine apne jawan bete ka sehra
janabe umme laila...
<<DIVIDER>>
sila tha maine khud apne pisar ke byaah ka joda
bahot nazdeek tha din mere shehzade ki shadi ka
kahan mujhko khabar thi lutegi meri dunya
na dekha maine apne jawan bete ka sehra
janabe umme laila...
<<DIVIDER>>
bada armaan tha akbar ki hogi jab teri shadi
bulaungi teri dulhan ko mai yasrab ki shehzadi
magar qismat mein meri wo din aane na paaya
na dekha maine apne jawan bete ka sehra
janabe umme laila...
<<DIVIDER>>
nahi tha door wo din jab tamanna meri bar aati
bahot hi dhoom se baraat mere laal ki jaati
magar karbobala ne mere yusuf ko cheena
na dekha maine apne jawan bete ka sehra
janabe umme laila...
<<DIVIDER>>
saron ko peet ke ahle haram karne lage matam
ali akbar ke laashe par kaha laila ne ye jis dam
lagaun kisko mehendi banaun kisko dulha
na dekha maine apne jawan bete ka sehra
janabe umme laila...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye hasrat thi mai apne laal ki shadi racha leti
ali akbar ki dulhan ko kaleje se laga leti
kaleja maamta ka na hone paaya thandha
na dekha maine apne jawan bete ka sehra
janabe umme laila...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye keh kar umme laila peet'ti thi sar kabhi seena
nahi hai maut se kam ab ali akbar ke bin jeena
luti uski jawani jo meri zindagi tha
na dekha maine apne jawan bete ka sehra
janabe umme laila...
<<DIVIDER>>
na ujde maadare akbar ki tarha koi maa waiz
na maara jaaye ghurbat mein kisi ka naujawan waiz
na tadpe ab jahan mein ye keh kar koi dukhiya
na dekha maine apne jawan bete ka sehra
janabe umme laila...

items.body:

ladte hue darya pe gaye aun-o-mohamed
bhari thay hazaron ke liye aun-o-mohamed

items.title: Akbar Teri Saanso Se Meri
items.body:
Haye akbar haye akbar
Akbar Teri Sanso'n Se Meri Saansein Judi He.
Me Kaise Riza Dedu Tu Ham Shaqle Nabi He.
1) Nana Ki Zeyarat Ko Me Jis Waqt Tadapta.
Bulva Ke Tuje beta me bas dekhta rehta
Shabbir Ki khatir ye Badi Sakht Ghadi He.
Akbar Teri Sanso'n Se Meri Saansein Judi He.
2) Kuch Der Hui Hur Se Abhi Mene Kaha Tha.
Budhe Se Jawa'n Bete Ka Lasha Na Uthega.
Khud Maut Tere saamne Ab Aake Khadi He.
Akbar Teri Sanso'n Se Meri Saansein Judi He.
3) Hasrat He Ke Sehre Ko Tere Sar Pe Sajaye.
Zainab Ko Ye Manzar Na Khuda Kash Dikhaye.
Seene Me Tere Zulm Ke Naize Ki Ani Hai.
Akbar Teri Sanso'n Se Meri Saansein Judi He.
4) Ay Kash Tera Beta Koi Hota Ay Akbar.
Ehsaas Mere haal ka hota tuje Dilbaar.
Dil Pe Mere Ek Dar'd Ki Bijli Si Giri He.
Akbar Teri Sanso'n Se Meri Saansein Judi He.
5) Zainab Se Reza Mangne Akbar Juhi'n Aaye.
Hasrat Bhari Nazro'n Se Wo Leti Thi Balaye.
Wo Deke Reza Dil Me Ye Khud Soch Rahi He.
6) Shabbir Ke Qadmo'n Me He Akbar Ka Janaza.
Hatho'n Me Ani Neze Ki Tar Khu se He Kurta.
Khamosh hain Lab Aankhe Magar Boal Rahi He.
Akbar Teri Sanso'n Se Meri Saansein Judi He.
7) Abbas O Haqir Apna Yahi Nauha Sunaye.
Karbobla Shabbir Hame Jab Bhi Bulaye.
Dil ka mere bas aakhri Armaan Yahi He.
Akbar Teri Sanso'n Se Meri Saans Judi He.

items.title: Abhi mat ro behan zainab
items.body:
Abhi mat ro behan zainab
Abhi sar pe tere saya hai baqi tere bhai ka
Abhi nazdeek khaimo ke sitamgar to nahi aaye
Musalla tere abid ka jalane ke liye haye
Abhi mehve ibadat hai mera beemar aye behna
Mere seene pe sar rakh kar abhi aasu bahati ho
Hamare bad aye bibi najaf se aaye baba to
Gale baba se milkar ay meri hamsheer ro lena
Abhi akbar ke seene ne sina khaie nahi bibi
Kaleja ko sina bahar abhi laie nahi bibi
Abhi jee bhar ke zainab dekh le akbar ka tu sina
Rida ka soch kar bibi mera dil bhi to phatta hai
Kaza ke bad bhi mujhko ye sadma haye sehna hai
Sina ki nok pe khoon mujh ko ye gam hi rulaye ga
Behan dekho salamt hai abhi abbas ke bazo
Padho nade ali inpar bahao to nahi aasu
Agar drya pe ja kar aaye na abbas to rona
Sakina ke mai hato ko tere hato me deta hi
Yahi ek ilteja tujh se meri majai karta hu
Tujhe rota hua dekhegi to roegi masooma
Baya shabir ka sun kar ye boli sayada zainab
Bhala kistatha se bhai behan ko chin aye ab
Mujhe rote hue tum kehrahe ho aye meri behna

items.title: Baade sheh zainabe
items.body:

tauq o zanjeer mein bemaar ko jakda dekha

baade sheh zainabe...

khud ko is koofe mein be-makna o chaadar dekha
baade sheh zainabe...

qaid mein margayi ghut ghut ke sakina aakhir
markhad ek chota sa zindan mein banta dekha
baade sheh zainabe...

items.title: Betiyan to sab ko
items.body:
zindan e shaam mein wo qayamat ka waqt tha
saumpa gaya sakina ko jab sar hussain ka
baba ke zakhmi chehre se khoon saaf jab kiya
baalon se khaak jhaad ke beti ne ye kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
tum to kehte thay sakina
tum bin mera dil nahi lagta
phir kyun itni dayr ki aane mein tumne baba
<<DIVIDER>>
betiyan to sab ko pyari hoti hai na baba
dekho mujhko shaam ke logon ne kitna maara
<<DIVIDER>>
aap thay jab tak saath ay baba ye beti shehzadi thi
naaz uthaate thay sab mere sab ki pyari beti thi
haath chacha rakhte thay zameen par ghar mein jab mai chalti thi
mujhko sahara dene sab uth jaate thay jab girti thi
lekin ye masoom sakina jab giri naaqe se baba
mujhe sahara kyun dene koi bhi na aaya baba
betiyan to sab ko pyari...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyare ammu chod gaye thay pani ko mai tarsi thi
bas ye mai hi jaanti hoon bazaar mein kaise chalti thi
shimr tamache maarta tha jab bhi thak kar mai rukti thi
mujhko ye bhi yaad nahi tha ke mai kab se pyasi thi
apni betiyon ko ye shaami la la kar dete thay pani
jab mai pani maangti thi khaati thi kyun durra
betiyan to sab ko pyari...
<<DIVIDER>>
choom ke baba ka zakhmi sar beti boli ay baba
kuch din pehle qaid mein mujhse milne aayi thi ramla
mere gohar pehni thi mujhko us baat ka gham na tha
mai ye soch ke rone lagi jab dekha ramla ka chehra
zaalim ne darbar mein baba mujhe kaneezi mein jab maanga
us ke ghar mein bhi to ek beti hai kyun na socha
betiyan to sab ko pyari...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba aap ka qaatil mere saamne jab bhi aata tha
aap ka jis pe khoon laga tha wo khanjar lehrata tha
baandh ke mujhko rassi se rahwaar wo jab daudata tha
nok e sina se mere chacha abbas ka sar gir jaata tha
naize par us waqt ay baba aap ko maine rote dekha
zaalim ne jab raah mein baalon se mujhe khayncha
betiyan to sab ko pyari...
<<DIVIDER>>
aag lagi thi daaman mein aur haath tha zakhmi kaano par
shaam e ghariban mein jab tumko dhoonde nikli mai baahar
baba maine dekha tha apni aankhon se wo manzar
dada ko awaaz phupi zainab ne jab di ro ro kar
beti ki awaaz pe haye dada ali to milne aaye
lekin mera haal kyun tumne na aa kar poocha
betiyan to sab ko pyari...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar e hussain pukara beti yaad karo na wo manzar
baba baba kehte huwe jab girti thi tum laashon par
maine hi to paas bulaya tha shehzadi ye keh kar
soja meri bacchi zakhmi seene pe tu sar rakh ke
be-sar tha beti ye baba paas tumhare kaise aata
tum ne jab awaaz de kar bola tha ay baba
betiyan to sab ko pyari...
<<DIVIDER>>
beti baba se boli ab chod ke mujhko mat jaana
kab tak hai meri qismat mein zaalim ke durre khaana
tum bhaiya sajjad se keh do mujhko yahin par dafnana
baap se baatein karte karte aakhri hichki ka aana
ay zeeshan o raza ro ro kar baba ke moo pe moo rakh kar
baali sakina ne bas ye kehte huwe dam toda
betiyan to sab ko pyari...

items.body:
haye zahra haye darbar

haq lene gayi thi jo apna athara baras ki bibi thi

gham dil pe uthaye...

darbar mein us pe kya guzri kya ahle sitam ne zulm kiye
baba ki lehad pe shehzadi sab haal sunaane aayi hai
gham dil pe uthaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehlu pe giraya darwaza mohsin ka diya gham bibi ko
ummat se nabi ki shehzadi ye ajre risalat paati hai
gham dil pe uthaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai chaak gareban saare nabi aur sher e khuda hai khaak basar
ye kis ka janaza utha hai ye kaisi qayamat aayi hai
gham dil pe uthaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaunain ke waali ke ghar se rone ki sadayein aati hai
khaak udti hai har ek taraf har simt udaasi chaayi hai
gham dil pe uthaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah gawahi deta hai jis bibi ki sachayi ki
afsos ghulamon ne ashtar uski hi sanad jhutlayi hai
gham dil pe uthaye...

items.title: Haye Haye Ali Asghar (As)
items.body:
Haye Haye Ali Asgar.
Kehte The Ye Shabbir Lahu Chehre Pe Mal Kar.
Haye Haye Ali Asgar.
1: Chota Hai Bahot Tera Gala Teer Bada Hai.
Aada Ne Tuje Zabh'a Nahi Naher Kiya Hai.
Ay Mere Guletar.
Haye Haye Ali Asgar.
2: Muskaan Labo'n Par Thi Tere Teer Ke Aage.
Naize Pa Jo Dekhega Rida Maa'n Ke Dulhaare.
Roega Tera Sar.
Haye Haye Ali Asgar.
3) Nanha Sa Tera Sar Bhi Chadhaenge Sina Par.
Fekenge Sabhi Kholta Pani Kabhi Patthar.
Ye Dushmane Haider.
Haye Haye Ali Asgar.
4)Is Jalti Hui Khaak Me Gar Tujko Chupaya.
Garmi Se Badan Tera Na Gaal Jaye Ay Beta.
Lagta Hai Muje Dar.
Haye Haye Ali Asgar.
5): Sukhi Hui Gardan Se Abhi Khoon Rawa,n Hain.
Or Pusht Pe Chaalo'n Ke Nisha,n Khushk Zaba,n Hai.
Kaisa Hai Ye Manzar.
Haye Haye Ali Asgar.
6) Tuti Hui Gardan Se Teri Khun Ka Bhena.
Dekhegi Jo Is Haal Me Maa'n Tujko Ay Beta.
Mar Jayegi Madar.
Haye Haye Ali Asgar.
7): Dekhu'n Mai Jawa'n Hote Tumhe Tha Mera Arma'n.
Lekin Mere In Khwab Ki Duniya Hui Weera'n.
Ab ky karo jee kar .
Haye Haye Ali Asgar.
8) Ye Zul'm Yahi'n Par To Nahi'n Rokenge Aada.
Naizo'n Se Niqalenge Tera Qab'r Se Laasha.
Katenge Tera Sar.
Haye Haye Ali Asghar
9) Puchegi Sakina Kya Pila Laye Ho Pani.
Kya Jaa Ke Bataunga Use Ran Ki Kahani.
Kuchto Kaho Dilbaar
Haye Haye Ali Asgar.
10): Abbas O Haqeer Aaqa Sare Khaima Jab Aaye.
Lashe Ko Rakha Khaak Pa Kuch Keh Nahi Paye.
Bas Ye Tha Labo'n Par.
Haye Haye Ali Asgar.

items.title: Karbobala mein kaisi qayamat guzar gayi
items.body:
Karbobala me kaisi qayamat guzar gayi bhai ka dam nikal gaya bhai ke saamne
Nauhakuna thi dasht e musibat me zindagi bhai ka dam nikal gaya bhai ke saamne
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Lashkar ki shaan kaafla salaar na raha..
Sarwar tadhap ke roye alamdaar na raha..
Maktal me kis kadar hai musibat ki yeh ghadhi, bhai ka dam nikal gaya bhai ke saamne
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Manzar na yeh kisi ko dikhaye mera khuda..
Pehlu me ek bhai ke bhai guzar gaya..
Paiwast teer aankh me be dast tha jari, bhai ka dam nikal gaya bhai ke saamne
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Haaye jawaan bhai tha battees saal ka..
Woh jo hua hussain se pardes me juda..
Bole hussain chhodh ke jao na aye akhee ,bhai ka dam nikal gaya bhai ke saamne
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Dil pe badan pe rooh pe sheh ki hua asar..
Kham ho gayi hai hazrat e shabbir ki kamar..
Jeene ki dil me aarzoo baaki nahi rahi ,bhai ka dam nikal gaya bhai ke saamne
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Kehte the shah aye mere abbas e bawafa..
Ek baar bhai kehke pukaro hame zara..
Bhai ka lafz honto pe aaya hi tha abhi, bhai ka dam nikal gaya bhai ke saamne.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Girye ne sheh ke arsh e moalla hila diya..
Nauha fiza e dasht e bala me suna gaya..
Sarwar pe roti reh gayi maktal me bekasi, bhai ka dam nikal gaya bhai ke saamne
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Manzar woh qatl gaah ka"SALMAN AZMI"..
Lafzo'n me kar sakega na tehreer koi bhi..
Kaafi hai rone walo ko jumla bus ek yahi, bhai ka dam nikal gaya bhai ke saamne

items.title: Abhi na maidan mein
items.body:
suye maidan na abhi chod ke jao mujhko

ay mere tashna dahan noor meri aankhon se
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi na maidan mein jao akbar
ke laal zahra ka mar na jaye
idhar tumhari baraat nikle
udhar ye jaan se guzar na jaye
abhi na maidan...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaeef baba jawan bete
ke baad jee kar bhi kya karega
raha na aankhon ka noor baakhi
to deeda e tar bhi kya karega
tumhare dam se jo saans baba
ka chal raha hai teher na jaye
abhi na maidan...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhari furqat garan hai dil pe
andhera aankhon pe cha raha hai
tumhari ruqsat ke waqt dil ko
khayaal payham ye kha raha hai
tumhare marne se bibiyon ke
saron se chadar utar na jaye
abhi na maidan...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhari sughra ko khat mein baba
tasalli kaise bhala wo dega
batao itna to jaate jaate
jawab qasid ko kya wo dega
tumhare waade pe jo hai zinda
wo sughra bemaar mar na jaye
abhi na maidan...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhari shaadi ka jashn karne
kahan kahan se hai aaye zaalim
tumhe lagane lahoo ki mehendi
hai barchiyon ko sajaye zaalim
tumhare nazuk badan mein koi
sitam ki barchi utar na jaye
abhi na maidan...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabih e ahmed ho tum ay akbar
tumhare dam se hi raahatein hai
tumhare sehre ki paak ladiyan
tamaam quran ki aayatein hai
ye gham hai humko zameen pe beta
tumhara sehra bikhar na jaye
abhi na maidan...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain ghash khaake gir pade hai
baraat akbar ki jaa rahi hai
samajh ke dulha shabih e ahmed
pe phool ummat gira rahi hai
ab aur natiq na likhna aage
ke phat hamara jigar na jaye
abhi na maidan...

items.title: haye haye mere hussain
items.body:
KHAIME MEI KAISE JAAYE TERI LAASH LEKE MAA HAI HAI MERE HUSSAIN
TAKHTI HEY RAASTA TERA MASLOOM BIBIYA HAI HAI MERE HUSSAIN
FARYAD FATEMAH KI KISSI NE NAHI SUNNI
GOWDI MEI TERE SAR KO LIYE DEKH THI RAHI
PYASEH GALE PE HOGAYA KHANJAR TERE RAWA HAI HAI MERE HUSSAIN
MAA JAANTI HEY ISSKA SABBAB KISKI ZAAT HEY
MARNE KE BAAD BHI TERA SEENE PE HAATH HEY
AKBAR KE GUM KI DIL MEI HEY TOOTI HUWI SEENA HAI HAI MERE HUSSAIN
KARDI HEY ZAALIMO NE ADAAWAT KI INTEHAA
TUJPAR EH LAAL HOGAYI GURBAT KI INTEHAA
DOW BHOOND TUJKO PAANI NAHI DE SAKA JAHAA HAI HAI MERE HUSSAINI
ITNA LAHOO BAHAA HEY KE CHERA BHI ZARD HEY
MAALOOM HEY MUJE TERE PEHLU MEI DARD HEY
TOOTI HUWI HEY MERI TARHA TERI PASLIYAA HAI HAI MERE HUSSAIN
TERA AMAAMA TERI ABAA LOOT LI GAYI
ANGOOST TERI KE WAASTE ANGOOST KAAT DI
KYA HAAL KAR DIYA TERA UMMAT NE MERI JAA HAI HAI MERE HUSSAIN
GIRTE HUWE ZAMEEN PE AWAAZ TUNE DI
MEI HOKE BEKERAAR LEHAD MEI NE REH SAKI
PHIR THOR KAR MEI BAND E KAFAN AAYI HU YEHAA HAI HAI MERE HUSSAIN
PEHLE AZIYAT O SE TERA SAR JUDDA KIYA
PHIR TERI ZAKHMI LAASH KO PAMAAL KAR DIYA
QURAN JAISE JISM PE TAAPO KE HEY NISHAA HAI HAI MERE HUSSAIN
POHCHA JO KATAL GA TAKKALUM THO YU LEGA
GOHDI MEI ABHI MAA KI LAASHA HEY GARIB KA
BINTE NABI YEH KEHTI HEY LE LE KE HICHKIYA HAI HAI MERE HUSSAIN

items.title: Janaza Hai Ali Ka
items.body:
Hasnain ke kandho'n pa janaza hai Ali ka..
Sar peetlo taar Khoon me chehra hai Ali ka...
1) chaei huwi hai Charo taraf ghum ki ghataye
Ghumge'n hai Zamee'n aur hain alamnak fizaye'n
Hain noha kuna saqi-e-kausar me hawaye'n
Har simt Ali haye Ali ki hain sadaye'n
Honto'n pa falak walo ke..2 noha hai Ali ka...
Janaza hai Ali ka ....
2) qura'n pa lagi zarb bikharne lage soorhe
Mandlane lage chand sitaro'n pa andhere
Veeran huwe hai parindo'n ke baseere
Ghumlagaye hanste huwe phoolo'n ke ke bhi chehre
Ghum Kitna asar dar..2 khudaya hai Ali ka ...
Janza hai Ali ka..
3) doobe hain ghum-fatha-e-khaibar me do aalam
Nabio'n ke musalo'n pa bichi hai saafe matam
Roone ka falak walo'n me ek shoor hai paihem
Sar khole huwe aagaye hain mursal-e-azam
Har Koi Malak marsiya..2 pardhta hai Ali ka ..
Janaza hai Ali...
4) zehra ke yateemo pa qayamat huwi barpa
Phir chagaya ankho'n me yateemi ka andhera
Agoosh hai madar ki na baba ka hai Saya
De kon yateemo ko tasali o dilasa
Taboot bhare ghar se..2 nikalta hai Ali ka...
Janaza hai Ali ka..
5) Ummat ke liye mangata tha jis me duaye'n
Jam jati jaha'n atsh nashino ki nigahaye'n
Jis noor ki hoti thi falak par bhi shuwaye'n
Janat ki jise choomti thi aake hawaye'n
Matam Karo veeran wo..2 hujra hai Ali ka..

items.title: Karna hai chehlum ayiye
items.body:
1) FATEMA KE LAAL KA
KARNA HAI CHEHLUM AAYIYE
AAYIYE AHL-E-AZA
KARNA HAI CHEHLUM AAYIYE
2) QAID SE HOKAR REHA
JATA HAI KUNBA KARBALA
LAB PE YE ZAINAB KE THA
KARNA HAI CHEHLUM AAYIYE
3) BHAAYI KA CHAHLUM KARUNGI
KAHTI THI ZAINAB YEHI
DIL MEI ARMAAN RAH GAYA
KARNA HAI CHEHLUM AAYIYE
4) NAAZON SE PAALA THA MAA NE
PEES KAR CHAKKI JISE
TASHNA LAB WO REH GAYA
KARNA HAI CHEHLUM AAYIYE
5) AALAM-E-TANHAYI MEI
SEHRA KI JALTI RAIT PAR
BE KAFAN LASHA RAHA
KARNA HAI CHEHLUM AAYIYE
6) ASGHAR-E-MASOOM KA
AUR AKBAR-E-ZEESHAN KA
QASIM-O-ABBAS KA
KARNA HAI CHEHLUM AAYIYE
7) ZAINAB-E-DILGEER KA
KOI NAHI AB AASRA
DETI HAI ROKAR SADA
KARNA HAI CHEHLUM AAYIYE
8) ARBAYEEN-E-SHAH KI
HOTI HAI MAQSOOSI WAHAN
JAATE HAIN HUM KARBALA
KARNA HAI CHEHLUM AAYIYE
9) EK DIN MEI HOGAYA
ZEHRA KE GHAR KA KHAATEMA
FATEMA KE AAL KA
KARNA HAI CHEHLUM AAYIYE
10) BIBI ZAINAB KI DUA KA
HAI ASAR ABBAS YE
HOTI HAI MAJLIS BAPA
KARNA HAI CHEHLUM AAYIYE

godh mein baba ki humkat ho
shauq e shahadat mein jaagat ho
kaa bolat ho dheere dheere
asghar moray aghar moray
saanj bhayi ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kurta lahoo ma doob gawa hai
gardan ma suraakh bawa hai
moo se zaban hai baahar tohre
asghar moray aghar moray
saanj bhayi ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ee nauha rehaan o raza jab
aawe jaisan maahe aza tab
bhariyo royi nain katore
asghar moray aghar moray
saanj bhayi ghar...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Ay Musalman Kash Socha Hota
items.body:
Halat-e-Sajda Main Hai Baykaso Majboor Bhi Hai, Aur Kayee Roz Ka Pyaasa Hai Yeh.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aqal Hairaan Thi Issay Banda Kay Rehman Kaihay
Nokay Naiza Pe Issay Bolta Quran Kaihay
Ya To Rab Hai Jokay Banday Sa Nazar Aata Hai
Ghaar Hai Insaan To Khuda Sa Hai Yeh.
<<DIVIDER>>
Boli Zainab Zulam Shabbir Peh Dhanay Waalo
Patharon Kay Talay Mayyat Ko Chupanay Waalo
Haye Kaanday Peh Uthathey Tay Jinhay Khatmay Rasool
Meray Us Bhai Ka Laasha Hai Yeh.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis Ka Ghazi Na Raha Aur Ali Akbar Na Bacha
Bhai Ki Laash Pay Khulkay Jisay Ronay Na Diya
Aaj Matam Sar-e-bazaar Jo Hum Kartay Hay
Issi Zainab Ka Dilasa Hai Yeh.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sayyedon Ka Bhara Ghaar Baar Jalaya Kyu Hai
Bibiyon Ko Sar-e-bazaar Phiraya Kyu Hai
Tunay Toh Yeh Bhi Na Socha Kay Jo Qaidi Hay Banay
Paak Zahra Ka Asasa Hai Yeh.
<<DIVIDER>>
Main Hun Zainab Mujhe Haider Ko Samajta Kyu Hain
Sun Kay Khutba Mera Mal’oon Bigarta Kyu Hai
Boli Zainab Kay Yeh Khutba Hi Na Hi Sun Ay Yazid
Paak Quran Ka Khulasa Hai Yeh.
<<DIVIDER>>
Saaniy-e-Zahra Ki Akhtar Yeh Ataa Hai Tujhko
Noha Likhnay Ke Liye Dard Mila Hay Tujh Ko
Teray Alfaz Mai Hai Fatima Zahra Ki Dua
Tera Andaaz Judasa Hai Yeh.

items.title: Baap ka saaya
items.body:
kehti thi sakina na uthe baap ka saaya
bachon ke sada sar pe rahe baap ka saaya
<<DIVIDER>>
dunya may yehi unko badi neymate rab hai
jeete hai saron par ko liye baap ka saaya
kehti thi sakina na uthe...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaati na tamache na kabhi chinte ye gowhar
uth'ta na agar sar se mere baap ka saaya
kehti thi sakina na uthe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch kam nahi hai unke liye lutfe zindagi
wo khush naseeb jinko milay baap ka saaya
kehti thi sakina na uthe...
<<DIVIDER>>
mayoosi zindagi may lagi rehti hai sada
aulaad ke sar se jo hatay baap ka saaya
kehti thi sakina na uthe...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab tak mere baba thay koi gham na mujhe tha
jeeti rahi be-khauf liye baap ka saaya
kehti thi sakina na uthe...
<<DIVIDER>>
sehti na sitam is tarha ashoor se ab tak
hota jo agar sar pe mere baap ka saaya
kehti thi sakina na uthe...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhko kahan kami thi kisi cheez ki bober
jab tak ke raha sar pe tere baap ka saaya
kehti thi sakina na uthe...
items.author: Mir Bober Ali

items.title: Bano (sa) Ki Fughan
items.body:
Bano(sa)ki fughaan thi mere Dilbar Ali Asghar(as),
Marne se tere ghar me hai mehshar Ali Asghar(as).
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ghurbat ko teri dekh ke maidan e wigha me,
Rone laga baatil ka bhi lashkar Ali Asghar(as).
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Jab halq chhida teer e jafa kaar se tera,
Rone lage sar peet ke Sarwar(as)Ali Asghar(as).
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Qaimey ki taraf badhte hain ruk jate hain Sarwar(as),
Nanhi si teri laash utha kar Ali Asghar(as).
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Tha teer e sitam se hi gala pehle Jo zaqmi,
Phir us pa chala zulm ka khanjar Ali Asghar(as).
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Khoon rota raha dil ye mera sonch ke har dum,
Kyu qatl hua tera mukarrar Ali Asghar(as).
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Sooni hui godi meri ankho mai dhuwaan hai,
Jab se tu gaya janib e Kausar Ali Asghar(as).
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Har saahib e ehsaas ko raaho me rulaya,
Tha nok e sina par jo tera sar Ali Asghar(as).
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Peshani-e-Islam pe tehreer hai ab tak,
Qurbaan hue Deen e Khuda par Ali Asghar(as).
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Saahil ki tamanna hai ye Hasnain ki khwahish,
Nouha ye rahe sabke laboun par Ali Asghar (as)

items.title: Beton ki maa
items.body:
khaafila zindan se chut kar jab madine aa gaya
daf'atan baab e madina par jo naqqara baja
ek manadi ne sada di odh kar shaale aza
chain se baithe ho kyun ay aashiqan e mustafa
jab suna ummul baneen ne fatema ka ghar luta
qatl sarwar hogaye zainab hui thi berida
maadar e abbas ne bechain ho kar di sada
kya nibhaya na mere abbas ne haq e wafa
<<DIVIDER>>
badi sharmindagi hai tum se bibi
mujhe beton ki maa bole na koi
<<DIVIDER>>
mera abbas kyun na kaam aaya
bacha na fatema zehra ka beta
banaya tha jise zaamin rida ka
bacha paaya na wo zainab ka parda
ali ka saamna kaisi karungi
badi sharmandi hai...
mujhe beton ki maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
na jeene dega ab mujhko ye sadma
laqab jiska khuda wande wafa tha
kaha tha jisko zehra ne bhi beta
sabaq jisko ghulami ka padhaya
nibhaya kyun nahi haq e ghulami
badi sharmandi hai...
mujhe beton ki maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
chida akbar ka seena halq e asghar
raha wo dekhne ko ye bhi manzar
raha na sar mere qasim ke tan par
lahoo mein tar huwe zainab ke dilbar
na uski nyaam se talwaar nikli
badi sharmandi hai...
mujhe beton ki maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
tadap kar saani e zehra pukari
mai apne bhai pe sau baar waari
wohi to ek tha dhaaras hamari
thi uske dam se baaqi pardadari
khudara ab na ye kehna kabhi bhi
badi sharmandi hai...
mujhe beton ki maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
baha hai sab se pehle khoon uska
baghair taygh wo kis tarha ladta
usay izn e wigha kab hi mila tha
nibhaya marte dam tak hukm e aaqa
ye tum se kehti hai zehra ki beti
badi sharmandi tum se hai bibi
mera maara gaya abbas e ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
mai zainab berida hargiz na hoti
kamar hoti na kham ibne ali ki
na lagti seena e akbar mein barchi
agar maara na jaaata mera ghazi
mere ghazi ki kismat bewafa thi
badi sharmandi tum se...
mera maara gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sun kar maadar e abbas tadapti
kaha rab se hai ye faryad meri
har ek maa ko milay aulaad aisi
jawani jis ne aaqa pe fida ki
bina tasdeeq mai kya kya na boli
badi sharmandi tum se...
mera maara gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
liya pursa raza zainab se aise
bayan rehaan ho lafzon mein kaise
diye zainab ne ro ro kar dilaase
sunaye saare manzar karbala ke
tumhari lut gayi amma kameini
badi sharmandi tum se...
mera maara gaya...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Chin gayi rida ghar
items.body:
dhalne lagi jo raat mein bewarison ki shaam
aata hua sawaar jo dekha suye qayaam
binte ali ne thaam ke dil thaamli lajaam
goonji sada e dukhtare zehra e nek naam
<<DIVIDER>>
chingayi rida ghar ujad gaya
aap thay kahan haye baba jaan
ran mein kat gaya bhai ka gala
aap thay kahan haye baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
thaam ke wo dil khaak par gira
hoo bahoo jo tha shakle mustufa
uske seene par naiza jab laga
aap thay kahan haye baba jaan
chingayi rida ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
nanha sa gala teer se chida
khoon jab baha larzi karbala
chehre par wo khoon bhai ne mala
aap thay kahan haye baba jaan
chingayi rida ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mashk ki taraf teer jab chala
mere sher ka baazu jab kata
mashk jab chidi gurz jab laga
aap thay kahan haye baba jaan
chingayi rida ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhoolungi na mai wo dard ki ghadi
chal rahi thi jab bhai par churi
de rahi thi mai us ghadi sada
aap thay kahan haye baba jaan
chingayi rida ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
lootne ko jab aaye ashkiyan
ghar ka ghar tha jab sholon mein ghira
chin rahi thi jab sar se ye rida
aap thay kahan haye baba jaan
chingayi rida ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
lag rahi thi jab moo pe sayliyan
haye kano se tha lahoo rawan
jab gohar chinay kurta jab jala
aap thay kahan haye baba jaan
chingayi rida ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye baba tha honton par naved
ro rahi thi baag thaam kar naved
goonjti thi ye dasht mein sada
aap thay kahan haye baba jaan
chingayi rida ghar...
items.author: Ahmed Naved

items.title: Dua Fatima Ki
items.body:
Dua fatima ki hum ehle aza hai
hume aazmane ki koshish na karna
muqallid hai meesam ke daaro rasan se
kabhi bhi darane ki koshish na karna
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Wilayat ke munkir se ye keh rahi hai
lahu ki taharat sada de rahi hai
najaf ki zami hai saqifa nahi hai
yaha aap aane ki koshish na karna
dua fatima ki..
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Waha bhi ali ne ki mushkil kushai
lehed ke sirhane se aawaaz aai
azadar e sarwar hai sone do isko
farishto jagane ki koshish na karna
dua fatima ki..
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Kajawo ka mimbar banaya nabi ne
ye hukme khuda hai bataya nabi ne
ali ke siwa janasheen e mohammad
kisi ko banane ki koshish na karna
dua fatima ki..
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Musalsal ha pehra waha ambiya ka
jaha par saja hai alam bawafa ka
khabardar kehde koi mushkilo se
waha aane jane ki koshish na karna
dua fatima ki..
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Khuda hukm deta hai mere Mohammad
kiye jaye sajdo pe sajde Mohammad
husain aapki pusht par aagaye hai
abhi sar uthane ki koshish na karna
dua fatima ki..
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Khuda ki qasam shak nahi isme koi
nigehbaan khud hai Mohammad ki beti
charagh e azadari jalta rahega
hawao bujhane ki koshish na karna
dua fatima ki..
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Hai naukar ali ka azal se mizajan
bigad jaega misle tufan fauran
takallum ke aage uduwe ali ka
qasida sunane ki koshish na karna
dua fatima ki hum ehle aza hai
hume aazmane ki koshish na karna...

items.title: Gham ki maari
items.body:
gham ki maari ye boli sakina
koi ab to nahi haye apna

ab na qasim rahe hai na bhaiya
ab na ammu rahe hai na baba
kis ko awaaz doon mai khudaya
gham ki maari...

pani lene ko darya kinaare
mere ammu yahan se sidhaare
dum bhi ghutne laga gham ke maare

gham ki maari...

jhoola asghar ka khaali pada hai
meri amma ko gash aa gaya hai
haath jhoole pe unka dhara hai
koi aa kar khudara uthaana
gham ki maari...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhaiya abid bhi ghash may pada hai
wohi is waqt sab se bada hai
unke charon taraf sab khadhe hai
unke maathe pe bhi hai pasina
gham ki maari...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba jaane ko aaye hai dekho
kuch batane ko aaye hai dekho
kya sunane ko aaye hai dekho
ab to mushkil hua mera jeena
gham ki maari...
<<DIVIDER>>
dukh pa dukh zaalimon ne diye hai
shimr ne mere bunde liye hai
kaan mere wo zakhmi kiye hai
haye rukta nahi khoon behna
gham ki maari...
<<DIVIDER>>
rassiyan kab ye aakhir khulengi
sakhtiyan zulm ki kab rukengi
sayliyan yun hi padti rahengi
meri amma se jaa kar ye kehna
gham ki maari...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid may kya sada hum rahenge
zulm kab tak ye aakhir sahenge
aisa lagta hai ab hum marenge
hua hargiz na sughra se milna
gham ki maari...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab bhi tauqeer zaidi ye sun lo
ek bachi ye kehti hai ro ro
qaid khane se mujh ko chuda do
mere ammu ko jaa kar ye kehna
gham ki maari...

items.title: Haider ne kaha roke ye abbas se betan
items.body:
Unneesviñ Ramzan ka mahaul ajab tha
Abbas (as) ka Nauha tha ke haye merey Baba
Us waqt Ali (asws) ne ye kaha apne Pisar se
Aa Karbobala ka maiñ sunauñ tujhe qissa
Haider (asws) ne kaha Ro ke ye Abbas (asws) se Beta !
Maiñ dekh raha huñ tera bikhra hua laasha
1:Talwaar ka ek waar hua hai mere sar par
Tujh par to baras jayeñge talwaroñ ke lashkar
Aur tukdoñ me hoga mere bachche tera laasha
Maiñ dekh raha huñ tera bikhra hua laasha
2) bin haathon kay aayega tu ghodey sey zameeñ per
Sar hoga tera paara merey betey zameeñ per
Sar tera maiñ aaghosh mein us waqt rakhunga
Maiñ dekh raha huñ tera bikhra hua laasha
3) laashey ko terey dekhega to royega Shabbir (as)
Aur dega sadaa aaiye ay Madare Dilgeer
Phir tukdey sametegi teri laash ke Zahra s.a
Maiñ dekh raha huñ tera bikhra hua laasha
4) Khanjar jo tere bhai ki gardan pa chalega
Sookhi hui Shaihrag se sadaa aayegi beta
"Dekho meri gardan pa chhuri chalti hai bhaiya"
Maiñ dekh raha huñ tera bikhra hua laasha
5) Laa kar terey laashe pa Sakina s.a ko sitamgar
Marengey tamachey wo tere tukdey dikha kar
Aur shimr tujhe dekh kay os waqt hañsega
Maiñ dekh raha huñ tera bikhra hua laasha
6) haaris (al) sar e Zainab s.a sey bahayega lahu jab
Faryad karegi wo tera dekh ke Sar tab
Matam to bahot naize pa os waqt karega
Maiñ dekh raha huñ tera bikhra hua laasha
7) Aaunga teri qabr pa Abbas asws main har roz
Royega wahañ Nasire dilsoz o jigars bhi tere Rauze pa nauha ye padhega
Maiñ dekh raha huñ tera bikhra hua laasha

items.title: Haye hussain
items.body:
shor tha ashoor ko
haye hussain haye hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ki fughan haye hussain
abbas ke baazu haye hussain
asghar ka gala haye hussain
zainab ki rida haye hussain

ashoor ko waqte asr sada
deta tha manadi khaaliq ka
chinti hai sare zainab se rida
ro ro ke ye kehti hai dukhiya
haye hussain...

humshakle nabi farzande jawan
wo pyaas may tar lehja wo zaban
takbeer may wo andaz e bayan
ashoor ke din akbar ki azan

items.author: Anwar Zahir

items.title: Husain As-salaam
items.body:
HUSAIN AS-SALAAM
HUSAIN BE-KAFAN, HUSAIN BE-WATAN, HUSAIN BE-KHATA, QATEEL E NAINAWA
Salaam tujpe ali O batool ke pyaare
salaam tujpe khuda o rasool ke pyaare
SULAGTI RET pe teero pe jo kiya sajda
bacha gaya hai shariat ko wo tera sajda
zamana laakh chupaaye teri haqeeqat ko
magar ye sach hai jila tune di shariat ko
tere hi dum se khuda ka kalaam baaqi hai
tere hi dum se mohammad ka naam baaqi hai
yazeed deen ko mitane jo pur fitan nikla
tu sar se baandhe kafan chod kar watan nikla
tujhe na chain se rehne diya madine me
ya zakhm ab bhi buka kar rahe hai seene me
kabhi jo chashme tasavvur gayi hai karb o bala
to maine dasht ka manzar lahu lahu dekha
kisi zaeefa ke maqtal me bain goonj uthe
main tere khushk gale par fida mere bacche
ye wo zaeefa thi jisko batool kehte hai
jigar ka tukda jise khud rasool kehte hai
zamine garm ko baalon se saaf karti thi
tadap ke roti thi aur marsiya ye padhti thi
jafa ke dasht me teeron ki jaa namaaz bichi
aur uspe sibte payambar ne wo namaaz padhi
wuzu lahu se kiya jo ke bandh tha paani
ye wo namaaz hai jiska nahi koi saani
ali ne khuld me rokar roohe hasan dekha
jo tujko dhoond ke jangal me khaimagan dekha
faras ki pusht pe teero pe jab badan dekha
abu turab ke lab par yahi sukhan aaya
jab talak thi wafa zindagi likhi safdar
karega zikr tera teri shayari safdar
har ek bashar per tera aaj hai ye karz husain
ke teri majlis o maatam hai hum pe farz husain

items.title: Janaza hydere karrar
items.body:
ghul pad gaya ke sayyed e abraar mar gaye
matam karo ke hyder e karrar mar gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar se uth'ta hai janaza hyder e karrar ka
rote hai sab sun ke nauha zainabe ghamkhar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
baap bhi ab jaa raha hai maa ka saaya bhi nahi
haye tanhaai ka aalam shaah ke ghar baar ka
ghar se uth'ta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab o kulsoom kaise dekhengi baba ka haal
sar do paara ho chuka haid zakhm hai talwaar ka
ghar se uth'ta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte hai abbas ro kar ay mere bhaiya hussain
ye safar hai aakhri khaaliq ke rozedaar ka
ghar se uth'ta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro diye ghar ki taraf aate huwe zakhmi ali
jis ghadi dekha tha manzar kufe ke bazaar ka
ghar se uth'ta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye hassan bole sambhalo bibiyon ko ay hussain
dekha jayega na manzar aakhri deedar ka
ghar se uth'ta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hazrate abbas ki choti behan behaal hai
ab yateema hai laqab is kamsin o nachaar ka
ghar se uth'ta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab e dilgeer ki chadar ko hyder choom kar
dayr tak dheka kiye chehra alam bardaar ka
ghar se uth'ta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro diye be-saakhta beti ko lipta kar ali
yaad us dam aagaya manzar bhare darbar ka
ghar se uth'ta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dafn majid kar rahe thay murtaza ko jab hassan
haath ubhra qabr se tab ahmed e mukhtar ka
ghar se uth'ta hai...
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Kahan ho abbas
items.body:
aagaya shaam ka bazaar kahan ho abbas
mere monis mere ghamkhwar kahan ho abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
kis musibat mein hai bhaiya ye behen dekh to lo
mere ghazi mere haathon mein rasan dekh to lo
koi yawar na madadgaar kahan ho abbas
aagaya shaam ka bazaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo nakahat hai chala bhi nahi jaata mujhse
baith'ti hoon to utha bhi nahi jaata mujhse
al-madad sheh ke alamdaar kahan ho abbas
aagaya shaam ka bazaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kahun kis se kahun haal bhala abid ka
kaz gaya tauq ke kaanto se gala abid ka
saans lena bhi hai dushwaar kahan ho abbas
aagaya shaam ka bazaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
parde majrooh ek dard jaga deti hai
bediyan bhi tumhe ro ro ke sada deti hai
qaid hai abid e bemaar kahan ho abbas
aagaya shaam ka bazaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhse pooche koi ehsaas e ghareebul watani
har nafas dil mein mere chubti hai barchi ki ani
mar gaya akbar e jarrar kahan ho abbas
aagaya shaam ka bazaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise hota teri ghairat ko gawara bhaiya
naam lekar mujhe zaalim ne pukara bhaiya
hum pe haste hai sab aghiyaar kahan ho abbas
aagaya shaam ka bazaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
habashi aagaye fizza ki himayat ke liye
kyun nahi aate bhala tum meri nusrat ke liye
taziyano ki hai bauchaar kahan ho abbas
aagaya shaam ka bazaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
khul ke roti nahi mazloom yateema bhaiya
siskiyan leti hai reh reh ke sakina bhaiya
kitna karti thi tumhe pyaar kahan ho abbas
aagaya shaam ka bazaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum nahi ho to sakina pe sitam hote hai
khushk aankhein magar kaan lahoo rote hai
marsiya padhte hai rukhsaar kahan ho abbas
aagaya shaam ka bazaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
lut gaya ghar mera aur gham ki ijazat bhi nahi
kitni majboor hoon matam ki ijazat bhi nahi
hoon rasan basta azadaar kahan ho abbas
aagaya shaam ka bazaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai bapa shaam ke bazaar mein aamir mehshar
noke naize se gira jaata hai ek sar nayyar
bain karte hai giraftaar kahan ho abbas
aagaya shaam ka bazaar...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Khuda khair kare
items.body:
Khuda khair kare..(2)
Haaye sajjad chale shaam
Khuda khair kare
Gale mein tauq hai aur bediya'n hai payro mein
diya hai shaam ke logo ne ye inaam
Khuda khair kare
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Wo jiske sar se rida bhi kabhi sarak jaye
to maare sharm ke suraj wahi palat jaaye
sharabiyo se hui hai wo hum kalaam
Khuda khair kare
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Tamaam shehro ke deewar o darr sajaye hai
khadi hai aurte haatho mein sang uthaye hai
kiya hai jashn e fatha ka ehtemaam
Khuda khair kare
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Banake qaidi aulad e ali ko laaye hai
ye shor barpa hai aaye hai, baaghi aaye hai
macha hai shaam ke logo mein kohraam
Khuda khair kare
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Bazaar e shaam mein zainab jo hai berida hai khadi
bimaar sayyad e abid pe kya kathin hai ghadi
khada bazaar mein har su hai majma e aam
Khuda khair kare

har ek tamacha par, abbas alamdaram

items.title: Akbar yu na jao chodkar
items.body:
AKBAR YU NA JAAO CHODKAR
KEHTE THE SHABBIR RO ROKAR
BAAD TERE AB HAALE DIL MY KISKO SUNAAUNGA
TERE BIN EK PAL BHI MAI RAAHAT NA PAAUNGA
CHAL RAHI HAI QALB PAR QANJAR…..
SAARE SAHAARE LUTGAYE TANHA HU  NOORE AIN
IBNE AMEER HOKE GHAREEB AAJ HAI HUSSAIN
REHAM KARDO MERI ASEERI PAR….
TUM MERE AANKHON KI THANDAK ZINDAGAANI HO
KAISE JAANE DU MERE NANA KI NISHAANI HO
AB NA NAZAR AAYENGE PAIGAMBER….
SEHNAHI PAAUNGA AKBAR MAI YE JUDAAI
SAATH TUMHAARE JAAYEGI BABA KI BEENAAYI
THOKARE KHAAUNGA NOORE NAZAR…
YE TO BATAAKE JAAO MAI LAILA SE KYA KAHU
DAAG DIL PER DEKE NA JAAO MAA SE KYA KAHU
MARJAAYEGI LAILA GHUTGHUTKAR…
JISNE TUMHE BETON KE BARAABAR PAALA THA AKBAR
KAISE JAAOGE USE AB TANHA CHODKAR
AARZUE ZAINABE MUZTAR…..
RAAH TUMHARA DEKH RAHI HAI SUGHRA WATAN ME
BYAAH KA ARMAAN BASAA BAITHI HAI WO MAN ME
YU NA JAAO ARMAAN TODKAR….
JUNG KE LIYE TAYAR KARKE KADIYAL JAWAA KO
CHOOMKAR PESHAANI BHEJ RAHE HAI MAIDAA KO
KEHTE THE SEENE SE LAGAAKAR….
MAI BHI TUMHAARE PEECHE PEECHE AAUNGA BETA
PHIR NA KABHI TASWEER TUMHAARI PAAUNGA BETA
DEKHTE REHNA BAAP KO MUD MUDKAR…..
CHALPADE AKBAR TO PEECHE THE SARWAR ALTHAF
MAI NA BAYAA KARPAAUNGA AB WO MANZAR ALTHAF
GOONJI SADA HAR EK THOKAR PAR…..

items.title: Janaza uth raha
items.body:

waqte ruqsat hai ye fatema ka
ho chuki hai namaz e janaza
bache mayyat se lipte huwe hai
aakhri hai ye deedar maa ka
<<DIVIDER>>
nahi hai koi ab apna ali ko chod kar tanha
ali ke ghar ki raunaq jaa rahi hai
janaza uth raha hai fatema ka
<<DIVIDER>>
bahot zakhmi thi khud lekin ali ke zakhm bharti thi
utha kar haath pehlu se wo aansu saaf karti thi
ab aansu kaun pochega bahot yaad aayegi zehra
ali ke ghar ki raunaq...
janaza uth raha hai...

bulaya tha jise maa ne kafan se haath phaila ke
usay lipta hua dekha to fizza ne kaha aa ke

ali ke ghar ki raunaq...
janaza uth raha hai...

kafan jab bhi hataata hai tamacha yaad aata hai
wo zakhmi maa ka chehra choom ke aansu bahata hai
hassan ko gham hai chehre par tamache ka nishan le kar
ali ke ghar ki raunaq...
janaza uth raha hai...

sirhane baith kar zainab ne maa ka haath jab chooma
ali kehne lage dekha nishan jab taziyane ka
chupa do saani e zehra ye zakhmi haath zehra ka
ali ke ghar ki raunaq...
janaza uth raha hai...

na ab lori sunayegi na wo jhoola jhulayegi
hussain ab fatema kaise tumhe pani pilayegi
wasiyat kar gayi zehra tumhe paalegi ab fizza
ali ke ghar ki raunaq...
janaza uth raha hai...

madine waalon ab apne gharon may chain se sona
satayega na ab tum ko nabi ki beti ka rona
gira tha jispe jalta dar wo tooti phasliyan lekar
ali ke ghar ki raunaq...
janaza uth raha hai...

chuda kar maa se bachon ko ali ne jab kafan baandha
tadap ke haye zeeshan o raza kehne lage maula
hai taaza zakhm pehlu ka zara aahista do kaandha
ali ke ghar ki raunaq...
janaza uth raha hai...

items.title: Abbas Ali ka matam hai
items.body:
1) SARWAR KE AKHEE KA MATAM HAI
ABBAS-E-ALI KA MATAM HAI
GHODE SE GIRE SHAANE BHI NAHI
BE DAST JARI KA MATAM HAI
2) MOULA NE KHUDA SE MAANGA JISE
ZEHRA NE KAHA HAI BETA JISE
KAHTE HAI JISE FARZAND-E-ALI
ABBAS-E-ALI KA MATAM HAI
3) BACHON SE SAKEENA KEHTI THI
AAYENGE CHACHA LEKAR PAANI
KAB SE HAI MERE YE AAS LIYE
ABBAS-E-ALI KA MATAM HAI
4) KYA ZABTE WIGHA THA GHAZI KA
ARMAAN NA NIKLA GHAZI KA
NA IZN MILA NA TAIGH CHALI
ABBAS-E-ALI KA MATAM HAI
5) KAB GURZ LAGA KYA HAAL HUWA
JAB AANKH ME AAKAR TEER LAGA
PHIR TAIGH-E-SITAM SHAANO'N PE LAGI
ABBAS-E-ALI KA MATAM HAI
6) SARWAR KI ITA'AT ME PAIHAM
REHTA THA MERA GHAZI HAR DAM
KEHTE HAIN JISE SARWAR KA AKHI
ABBAS-E-ALI KA MATAM HAI
7) JAFAR KI TARHA TAI'YAR HAI TOO
HYDER KI TARHA JARRAR HAI TOO
PARCHAM BHI TERA OONCHA HAI JARI
ABBAS-E-ALI KA MATAM HAI
8) HAI SHEIR-E-DILAWAR KA MATAM
KARNA HAI HAMEIN MILKAR PAIHAM
PHIR DENGEE DUA'EN BINTE NABI
ABBAS-E-ALI KA MATAM HAI
9) KUNBE KA SAHARA THA JO JARI
BACHON KA SAHARA THA JO JARI
ABBAS HAI AATI YAAD HAI USKI
ABBAS-E-ALI KA MATAM HAI

items.title: Abid e beemar
items.body:
1) BOLI ZAINAB MAI ABID KO BACHAOON KAISE
AAG KHAIMO ME LAGI HAI MAI BUJHAOON KAISE
GASH ME AABID HAI PADEN UNKO JAGAOON KAISE.......
2) TU HAI ZANJIROON ME MUJRIM KI TARAH JAKDA HUWA
TAUQ HAI AABID E BEMAAR KI GARDAN ME PADA
APNE SAJJAD KO IS GHAM SE CHUDAOON KAISE..........
3) GARM RETI HAI TO KHAIMON SE NIKALTA HAI DHUAAN
KAFILA WALOON KO BAITHAOON TO BAITHAOON KAHAN
JAA KE ABBAS SE DARIYA PE BATAOON KAISE............
4) AB NA AYEENGE PALAT KAR KABHI AMMU TERE
CHADREN CHINNE KA LO HO GAYA SAMAN MERE
YE KHABAR BALI SAKINA KO SUNAOON KAISE...........
5) HAR TARAF LASHAI BE SAR HAI PADE MAKHTAL ME
BABA KO DHONDHNE BACHCHI HAI GAI JANGAL ME
LASHA PAMAAL SAKINA KO DIKHAOON KAISE............
6) JALTI RETI HAI JALA JATA HAI BHAI MERA
ROKE BEMAAR SE YE ZAINAB E MUZTAR NE KAHA
HAIN BANDHE HAANTH ME BHAIYYA KO UTHAOON KAISE.......
7) KHAAK PE MAYYATEN URYA HAI PADI BHAI KI
CHADAREN SAR PE NAHI ZULM KI HAD ITNI BADHI
CHOOD KAR BAI KO IS DAST ME JAOON KAISE...........
8) BE KAFAN BHAI BATIJE HAI KAFAN DOON KAISE
SAB TO ZALIM HAIN YAHAAN MANGOON KAFAN MAI KISSE
KHAK ME BHAI KI MAYYAT KO CHUPAOON KAISE............
9) MERE BEMAAR KO KANTOON PE CHALATEN HAI LAEN
BAITHNE DETE NAHI CHAIN SE RAHOON ME KAHIN
HAANT MERE HAI BANDHE ISKO BACHAOON KAISE...........
10) HATHKADI HANTHOON ME PAIROON ME PADI HAI BEDI
AISA DUNIYAN ME KISI NE NAHI DEKHA QAIDI
MAI BHI QAIDI HOON ISE JA KE CHUDAOON KAISE..........
11) AE QAMAR ROK KALAM PHATTA HAI ZAHRA KA JIGAR
IN SHAHEEDOON ME THA EK CHOTA SA BACHCHA ASGHAR
MIL GAYA PANI MAGAR USKO PILAAOON KAISE.................
BIN JANIB ANJUMANE SADQA E ZAHRA KARARI...........................

items.title: Husain's sacrifice
items.body:
Hussain your sacrifice has become our way of life......
Hussain hussain ...
All thanks to imam hussain(pbuh) that the heart of humanity is still beating
Hussain hussain...
Hussain your sacrifice has become our way of life ..(4)
(1)We have learned so many lessons from your tragedy
And from all those who are part of your great story
If for a moment someone was to stop and see..(2)
There's no doubt they would say likes yours there is no day..(2)
Hussain your sacrifice has become our way of life..(2)
(2) In history a man like you we cannot find
You left for karbala leaving everything behind
Protecting the right path is all you had in your mind..(2)
So by truth we will stand with your flag in our hands..(2)
Hussain your sacrifice has become our way of life..(2)
(3) They were all so young children present with you
When the time came young qasim knew what to do
He says any outcome is sweet if your cause is true..(2)
We'll raise our children this way they'll fight for you one day..(2)
Hussain your sacrifice has become our way of life..(2)
(4) Not once did the decision your companions doubt
Even though their result they surely knew about
You gave them the chance  to save   their lives and bail out..(2)
We will not fear death if we are on the right path..(2)
Hussain your sacrifice has become our way of life..(2)
(5) When we think about abbas your dear brother
Not once did he call you anything but master
So loyal to Zainab to you hussain and your daughter..(2)
Abbas's life we'll observe and our master we will serve..(2)
Hussain your sacrifice has become our way of life..(2)
(6)When thinking of sajjad with sadness our hearts are filled
He was strong and brave on the battlefield was skilled
He had to watch all his family members be killed..(2)
Sajjad's patience teaches us in allah we must trust..(2)
Hussain your sacrifice has become our way of life..(2)
(7) Your daughter sakina her thirst was not quenched
When her uncle returned in blood he was drenched
How will i now help my brother she questioned..(2)
We will  think about others and  put their needs first  ..(2)
Hussain your sacrifice has become our way of life..(2)
(8) After losing everything Zainab  still stood strong
She showed all of us the path of right and wrong
Close to her and her loved ones is where we belong..(2)
Hashimi sisters will this wish of hers fulfill..(2)
Hussain your sacrifice has become our way of life..(2)

items.title: Abbas Ammu janam
items.body:
Abbas(as) Ammujanam, Abbas Ammujana,
Boli Sakina(sa) rokar, Abbas Ammujanam..
1) Maare gaye Akbar(as) bhi, maare gaye Asghar(as) bhi,
Dasht-e-balaa me jaakar, Abbas(as) Ammujanam..
2) Tanha pada hai laasha ab mere Babaja'an ka,
Tapti hui zamee'n par, Abbas(as) Ammujanam..
3) Pyaase hain saare bacche, behlaaun unko kaise,
Paani pilaado aakar, Abbas(as) Ammujanam..
4) Shaam-e-Ghariba'an aayi, deti hu mai duhaayi,
Chhinti hai sar se chadar, Abbas(as) Ammujanam..
5) Shimr-e-laeen ne haaye, khenche hain kis tarah se,
Kaanou se mere gouhar, Abbas(as) Ammujanam..
6) Zalim sataa rahe hain, durre lagaa rahe hain,
Hota hai zulm mujh par, Abbas(as) Ammujanam..
7) Ab Dar se aake dekho, qaidi banaake humko,
Lejaate hain sitamgar, Abbas(as) Ammujanam..
8) Jis raah se bhi guzri, pyaasi teri Bhatiji,
Khaati rahi vo pathhar, Abbas(as) Ammujanam..
9) Kis tarha mai bataaun, kis tarha mai bhulaaun,
Darbar ka wo manzar, Abbas(as) Ammujanam..
10) Toote pahaad gham ke, ab qaid se sitam ke,
Chudwaao jald aakar, Abbas(as) Ammujanam..
11) Hasnain aur Sahil ab kya bayaan karenge(sa),
Rote rahe ye sun kar, Abbas (as) Ammujanam..

items.title: Bhagi hai aisefauj
items.body:
Bhaagi hai aise fauj ke muddkar nahin dekha
Thhehro abhi to Gaazi ka jauhar nahin dekha
Haebat ne jiski zer kiya fauj e sitam ko
Abbas sa duniya mein Ghazanfar nahin dekha
Mashkizaa chhid gayaa to hua sharmsaar wo
Gaiyyoor ne haram ko palatkar nahin dekha
Do mukhtalif husuul hai par hai mushabehat
Fat’he Furaat dekho jo Khaibar nahin dekha
Yaksaaniyat gulaam ki aaqa se kaise ho
Dono’n ko noke naize pe humsar nahin dekha
Akbar bhi ho, Shabbir bhi, ho Aun-o-Muhammad
Zainab ne phir kabhi wo bhara ghar nahin dekha
Beta tha ek, wo bhi tha Shabbir ka bismil
Taarikh ne Yazeed sa abtar nahin dekha
Munkir Naqeer poochhte ho kyon sawaal tum
Kya marsiya ‘Salim’ ke labpar nahin dekha

items.title: Aake To Zara Dekho Sakina Pe Hai Jafa
items.body:
Zindan-e-shaam Se Ye Hi Aati Thi Ik Sada,
Baba Mere Baba Baba Mere Baba,

Baba Mere Baba Baba Mere Baba.
Kaisa Ye Qaid Khana Hai Dam Mera Hai Ghut Ta,
Ay Shah-e-karbala Ay Shah-e-karbala,
Kab Subah Hai Hui Na Khabar Kab Hai Din Dhala,

Mare Hain Tamanchey Bhi Sitamgar Ne Mujhi Ko,

Rukhsaron Pe Hain Ab Bhi Tamanchon Ke Wo Nishaan,
Baba Mere Baba Baba Mere Baba.
Kano Se Gaushwarey Bhi Wo Chheen Le Gaye,
Ay Baba Dekhiye Ay Baba Dekhiye,
Zakhmon Se Bahne Lagta Hai Ab Bhi Lahoo Mera,
Baba Mere Baba Baba Mere Baba.
Mujhko Khabar Na Thi K Mera Jal Gaya Kurta,
Ay Shah-e-karbala Ay Shah-e-karbala,
Aankhon Ke Samne Tha Meri Bas Dhuan Dhuan,
Baba Mere Baba Baba Mere Baba.
Pani Dikha Dikha Ke Bahate The Ahl-e-shar,
Ay Shah-e-behr-o-bar Ay Shah-e-behr-o-bar,
Main Khak Pe Tadapti Thi Jaise K Machhliyan,
Baba Mere Baba Baba Mere Baba.
Bandha Tha Zalimon Ne Pas-e-pusht Naqa Par,
Mujhko Mere Padar Mujhko Mere Padar,
Wo Chalta Tha Uski Mere Chubhti Thi Haddiyan,
Baba Mere Baba Baba Mere Baba.
Kaisa 'Raees' Zulm Sakina Pe Ho Gaya,

mar gaya bhai mera…
<<DIVIDER>>
pyaas se sab hai nidhaal pani ka hoga sawaal
kehna wo sab beh gaya haye kamar jhuk gayi
mar gaya bhai mera…
<<DIVIDER>>
aisa anees ab kahan paaega sibte nabi
jaisa ke abbas tha haye kamar jhuk gayi
mar gaya bhai mera…
items.author: Anees Pehersari

items.title: Khule sar bhai
items.body:
dekh lo abbas mere dekh lo abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
khule sar bhai zainab jaa rahi hai
sada zainab ki dekho aa rahi hai
khule sar bhai…
dekh lo abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi panjo ke bal chalti hai bacchi
kabhi uth'ti hai aur girti hai bacchi
rasan gardan mein kasti jaa rahi hai
khule sar bhai…
dekh lo abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye dekho kaise kaise marhale hai
ke ek rassi hai aur baara gale hai
rasan shaano mein khud bandhwa rahi hai
khule sar bhai…
dekh lo abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi ne durron se nashtar se maara
kisi ne mujhko phir patthar se maara
ye dekho zakhm kaise khaa rahi hai
khule sar bhai…
dekh lo abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
ke jis ka chehra suraj ne na dekha
khule sar dekhti hai aaj dunya
ye kismat kya hamay dikhla rahi hai
khule sar bhai…
dekh lo abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek bibi chipi zainab ke peeche
bhala zainab kahan chip jaaye jaa ke
ye manzar dekh ke ghabra rahi hai
khule sar bhai…
dekh lo abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
wiqare aaya e tatheer hai ye
lo dekho zainabe dilgeer hai ye
ye fauje ashkiyan batla rahi hai
khule sar bhai…
dekh lo abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek galiyon mein koochon mein phirao
ke jaise ho sake waise satao
munadi ki sada ye aa rahi hai
khule sar bhai…
dekh lo abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
bayan aamir jo zainab kar rahi thi
na poocho shams wo kaisi ghadi thi
ke maqtal se madina jaa rahi hai
khule sar bhai…
dekh lo abbas...
items.author: Shams Rizvi

aflaak pukare ya abbas azadaar pukare ya abbas

labbaika ya abbas labbaika ya abbas
ya abbas e alamadar ya abbas e alamadar
<<DIVIDER>>
jaise hi mere lab par abbas ka naam aya
abbas ke parcham ka mere sar pe hua saaya
ek noor e wafa phaila mere dil ne sukoon paaya
noori nazara hai abbas hyderi jalwa hai abbas
dilbar e zahra hai abbas saath hamesha hai abbas
labbaika ya abbas labbaika ya abbas

aflaak pukare ya abbas azadaar pukare ya abbas
hum sab hai tumhare ya abbas
labbaika ya abbas labbaika ya abbas

do sher hai dunya mein jiska na koi sani
ek sher e khuda hyder ek sher e ali ghazi
mashoor e zamana hai dono ki alamdari
ghazi ali ka hai sarmaya ghazi hussain ka hai saaya
ghazi hai sher e karbobala maula hamara hai abbas

mai apni duaon mein abbas ko le aaya
ye waasta ghazi ka mere kaam bada aaya
gham ka madawa hai ghazi mera bharosa hai ghazi
mera aqeeda hai ghazi rab ka waseela hai abbas
labbaika ya abbas labbaika ya abbas

aflaak pukare ya abbas azadaar pukare ya abbas

labbaik suno

abbas ka charcha ghar ghar hai

shabbir se tum ne paaya hai
us din se lekar aaj talak
labbaik labbaik labbaik

labbaika ya abbas labbaika ya abbas

saamne paak haram hoga shaah e wafa ka gham hoga

items.title: Madine mai na jaungi
items.body:
jab qaid se azad hui aal e payambar
aur karbobala aa gaye sab waaris o yawar
tab bibiyan rone lagi qabron se lipat kar
abid se ye farmani lagi zainab e muztar
ay laal watan chalne pe majboor na karna
maajaye ki turbat se mujhe door na karna
madine mai na jaungi
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain ibne ali ki qabr pe aansu bahaungi
madine mai na jaungi
<<DIVIDER>>
akela chod doo kaise mai zehra ki kameini ko
abhi royi nahi dil khol ke mai apne bhai ko
yahan farshe aza shabbir ka mai to bichaungi
madine mai na jaungi...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi poochega qasim ko koi poochega akbar ko
koi abbas ko poochega koi aake sarwar ko
hua barbaad saara ghar mai kis kis ko bataungi
madine mai na jaungi...
<<DIVIDER>>
yahan aayi to athara baradar saath laayi thi
chali thi jab madine se bhara ghar saath laayi thi
wahan jaa kar nazar sughra se mai kaise milaungi
madine mai na jaungi...
<<DIVIDER>>
madine shauq se jaati ali akbar agar hote
pisar hote na hote bhai mere humsafar hote
jo milne bibiyan aayengi mai to mar hi jaungi
madine mai na jaungi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kiya hai qatl aada ne mohamed ke nawase ko
sukoon miljayega is amr se do din ke pyase ko
hussain ibne ali ke naam par pani pilaungi
madine mai na jaungi...
<<DIVIDER>>
yahan par aan kar ab ambiya aansu bahayenge
hassan zehra mohamed hyder e karrar aayenge
hussain ibne ali ka marsiya sab ko sunaungi
madine mai na jaungi...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere bhai ki turbat soona jangal aur veerana
andhera ban ye tanhaai ye charon samt sannata
yahan reh kar ghame shabbir ki basti basaungi
madine mai na jaungi...
<<DIVIDER>>
bithaya kaise anwar naaqe pa sarwar ki khwahar ko
sunati thi sukhan yehi magar sajjad e muztar ko
charaghe qabr ashkon se mai ro ro kar jalaungi
madine mai na jaungi...
items.author: Anwar Zahir

items.title: Abbas ankhein khol
items.body:
jab sar e abbas zainab ko mila
sar se ye karne lagi ro kar gila
aa gayi bali sakina ko qaza
ab to ay abbas aankhein khol do
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid khane mein ye zainab ne kaha
ab to ay abbas aankhein khol do
<<DIVIDER>>
dafn hum ne kar diya ghamkhar ko
tum na aaye aakhri deedar ko
ho gayi hum se sakina bhi juda
ab to ay abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
dard aur gham ka dafeena dekh lo
ek nazar qabr e sakina dekh lo
ho nahi paayi wo mar kar bhi reha
ab to ay abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
ho gayi hai dafn wo zer e zameen
aaj bhi us ke liye pani nahi
qaid khana ban gaya hai karbala
ab to ay abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
rote rote khatm saansein ho gayi
khud bhi uski band aankhein ho gayi
jo tumhe deti thi ro ro kar sada
ab to ay abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
mustaqil sehti rahi ranj o mahan
saal bhar pehne rahi ek pairahan
ho gayi ghurbat ki us par inteha
ab to ay abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab sakina pani maangegi nahi
mashk bhi apni tumhe degi nahi
na karegi tum se wo koi gila
ab to ay abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
dukhtar e shaahe madina ke liye
fateha padh do sakina ke liye
kar do apna farz tum ye bhi ada
ab to ay abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaan se pyari sakina thi tumhe
de rahi hoo mai qasam uski tumhe
khol do ek baar tum aankhein zara
ab to ay abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
aamir o yaqoob gham barpa hua
zainab e dilgeer ne jab ye kaha
mil gayi mujhko sakina ki rida
ab to ay abbas...
items.author: Yaqoob Jarchvi

items.title: Akela hai hussain
items.body:
jab girne laga jab hazrat e abbas ka parcham
ro ro ke sada dene lage ye shahe aalam
laut aao mere bhai khudara palat aao
kuch ho gaya agar tumko to mar jayenge phir hum
<<DIVIDER>>
waasta deta hoon sakina ka tumhe
laut kar qaimon mein aa jao akela hai hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
haath ko jod ke ab tumko bulaata hai hussain
laut aao hamay maloom hai tum ho zakhmi
ab sakina bhi nahi maangegi tum se pani
waasta deta hoon sakina ka tumhe
tum bulao to tumhe lene ko aata hai hussain
haye abbas haye abbas haye abbas haye abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
ghayr kar qatl na kar de ye tumhe fauje yazid
jab talak zinda ho baaqi hai hamari ummeed
waasta deta hoon sakina ka tumhe
ay mere bhai tumhe khone se darta hai hussain
haye abbas haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj jee bhar ke tumhe dekha nahi hai maine
aaj baazu bhi tera chooma nahi hai maine
waasta deta hoon abbas sakina ka tumhe
aao seene se tumhe apne lagata hai hussain
haye abbas haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai kyun dil ko mere tod diya hai tum ne
mujhko marne ke liye chod diya hai tum ne
waasta deta hoon abbas sakina ka tumhe
ab judaai ko teri seh nahi sakta hai hussain
haye abbas haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai hum dono ka bachpan se ajab hai rishta
door mai bhi nahi tu bhi nahi reh sakta tha
waasta deta hoon abbas sakina ka tumhe
jaanta hoon ke tere dil mein dhadakta hai hussain
haye abbas haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum gaye jab se tabiyat meri ghabrati hai
theek se bhai mujhe saans nahi aati hai
waasta deta hoon abbas sakina ka tumhe
bin tumhare badi mushkil se hi zinda hai hussain
haye abbas haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
aise azlaan ko zawwar bana lo maula
jeete jee mujhe rauze pe bula lo maula
waasta deta hoon abbas sakina ka tumhe
tumse maango to dua ko meri sunta hai hussain
haye abbas haye abbas...
items.author: Arsalan Azmi

items.title: Ay paalne waale
items.body:
sheh ran may ye farmate thay
ay paalne waale ay paalne waale
ek baap kaleje se sina kaise nikaale
<<DIVIDER>>
hum naad e ali padte hai aajayega aaram
yun aediyan ragdo na mere gaysuon waale
ay paalne waale...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kehke giri qaime may maa dasht may shabbir
akbar gaye ruqsat huwe aankhon ke ujaale
ay paalne waale...
<<DIVIDER>>
yan garm lahoo behta tha akbar ke jigar se
padte thay kaleje pe wahan laila ke chaale
ay paalne waale...
<<DIVIDER>>
shayad de jawab apni behen ka ali akbar
qasid ko koi laasha e akbar pe bulaale
ay paalne waale...
<<DIVIDER>>
laila se kaha sheh ne rida daal ke apni
is zakhm ko zainab ki nigahon se chipaale
ay paalne waale...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab laashon pe zainab ne har ek maa ko sambhala
ab laasha e akbar hai usay kaun sambhale
ay paalne waale...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad ye kehte huwe sheh ne rakha laasha
koi mere abbas ko darya se bulaale
ay paalne waale...

items.title: Baap ki tarha
items.body:
ekeeswi ki subha qayamat ka tha samaa
thar'ra raha tha chand larazta tha aasman
baitus sharaf may baithe thay sab log neem jaan
hyder ne baari baari har ek par nigah ki
zainab ko junhi dekha to ek sard aah ki
beti ko dekh dekh ke rone lage ali
sarwar ka haath thaam ke kehne lage ali
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ki tarha kaleje se lagana beta
phir meri laash se zainab ko chudana beta
<<DIVIDER>>
betiyan baap se manoos bahot hoti hai
choti choti si musibat pe bahot roti hai
zakhm sar ka meri zainab se chupana beta
baap ki tarha kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
bain ehsaan yateemi se kare ghabrakar
laash par meri jo gir jaye pachade kha kar
kar ke dam nade ali usko uthana beta
baap ki tarha kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye ye darr hai mujhe jaan ko khote khote
meri bachi kahin mar jaye na rote rote
chup ke zainab se kafan mujhko udhana beta
baap ki tarha kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
karwan amn ka sab zulm o sitam lootenge
meri bachi pe bahot ranj o alam tootenge
har musibat se mere baad bachana beta
baap ki tarha kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
laash par meri to jee bhar ke abhi rolegi
par teri laash pe ye laakhon sitam jhelegi
naaz saare meri zainab ke uthana beta
baap ki tarha kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir ye kehne lage aankon se baha kar aansu
choom lena meri jaanib se behan ke baazu
jis ghadi marne ko maidan may jaana beta
baap ki tarha kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
chain se raaton ko zainab na kabhi soyegi
mere veeran musalle pe bahot royegi
kar ke talqeen usay aas bandhana beta
baap ki tarha kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
sabr wo meri judaai pe na kar payegi
mujhko jo qabr may dekhegi to mar jayegi
saath may usko janaze may na laana beta
baap ki tarha kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ainee khamoosh huwe maula shahadat paayi
utha taboot jo aamir to sada ye aayi
mujhpe jo guzri musibat na batana beta
baap ki tarha kaleje se...
items.author: Ainee Rizvi

items.title: Bano ye boli rokar
items.body:
bano ye boli rokar jhoole ke sone wale
sadqe gayi ye maadar jhoole ke sone wale
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon mein rehne wale seene pe sone wale
baysheer mere asghar jhoole ke sone wale
sadqe gayi ye maadar...
bano ye boli rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
gardan dhali hui hai manka dhala hua hai
sotay ho teer kha kar jhoole ke sone wale
sadqe gayi ye maadar...
bano ye boli rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani pila'un aaja seene laga'un aaja
kab se khadi hai maadar jhoole ke sone wale
sadqe gayi ye maadar...
bano ye boli rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
godhi hui hai sooni jhoola hua hai khaali
sunsan kar gaye ghar jhoole ke sone wale
sadqe gayi ye maadar...
bano ye boli rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
gehwara jal raha hai qaime bhi jal rahe hai
laa'un kahan se bistar jhoole ke sone wale
sadqe gayi ye maadar...
bano ye boli rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jangal ye soona soona ye har taraf andhera
ghabraiyo na asghar jhoole ke sone wale
sadqe gayi ye maadar...
bano ye boli rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek aag si lagi hai dil gham se phat raha hai
aaye kharaar kyun kar jhoole ke sone wale
sadqe gayi ye maadar...
bano ye boli rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jalti zameen pe mirza pas murdaye kali hai
ghuncha-dehan khulay tar jhoole ke sone wale
sadqe gayi ye maadar...
bano ye boli rokar...
items.author: Mirza Murtaza Ali

items.title: Bhai ka pehla
items.body:
zindan mein zainab roti hai
bhai ka pehla chehlum hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sar apna jhukaye baithi hai
bhai ka pehla chehlum hia
<<DIVIDER>>
wo nazr dilaye kis tarha
pani bhi nahi hai ek khatra
ghazi ki bahot yaad aati hai
bhai ka pehla...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil khol ke rone na paayi
apne bhai ko maajayi
rone pa bhi pabandi hai
bhai ka pehla...
<<DIVIDER>>
is tarha koi majboor na ho
aur itne ghamon se choor na ho
zahra ki dulaari qaidi hai
bhai ka pehla...
<<DIVIDER>>
kulsoom ke dil pe kya guzri
ye jaan nahi paaya koi
chehre pe bahot mayoosi hai
bhai ka pehla...
<<DIVIDER>>
athara baradar ki khwahar
kis tarha rajhe dil pe pathar
zindan hai aur lachari hai
bhai ka pehla...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan ke andar ay waiz
hai hashr ka manzar ay waiz
ghurbat hai ali ki beti hai
bhai ka pehla...

items.title: Dunya may aaj
items.body:
dunya may aaj hashr ka din aashkaar hai
sibte nabi ke seene pa qatil sawaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mar jaunga mai aap hi ab thodi dayr may
qaalib may rooh ka koi dam ko qaraar hai
dunya may aaj hashr ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
unees sau hai taygh o sinaan o tabar ka zakhm
sang e sitam ke khoon se badan laal zaar hai
dunya may aaj hashr ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai zalzala zameen ko gehn may hai aaftab
baarish hai khoon ki chashme falak ashk baar hai
dunya may aaj hashr ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
chilla rahi hai qaime se zainab utar layeen
bhai ka mere zakhm se seena figaar hai
dunya may aaj hashr ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte thay shaah shimr se mujhko na zibha kar
dunya hai chand roz ka kya aetbaar hai
dunya may aaj hashr ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
quran hai saaf seena ye baith'ta hai jis pe tu
bosagah e rasool pe khanjar ki dhaar hai
dunya may aaj hashr ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai an-khareeb phoonke sarafeel soor ko
bas hukme kibriya ka faqat intezaar hai
dunya may aaj hashr ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab aage kar bayan na anees e jigar figaar
ye din wo hai ke saara jahan ashk baar hai
dunya may aaj hashr ka...
items.author: Mir Anees

items.title: Ghame baqir
items.body:
momino utha janaza
baqir e mazloom ka
qatle na-haq kalmago ne
phir kiya masoom ka
ahle arsh o farsh mein
mehshar bapa hai al amaan
gham se phat'ta hai kaleja
sadiq e maghmoom ka
<<DIVIDER>>
gham e baqir mein roti hai khudayi
jafa ye kalmago ne kaisi dhaayi
<<DIVIDER>>
yun phir hai gulshan e saadaat ujda
madina sog e baqir mein hai dooba
sar apna peet ke kehti hai farwa
yateemi jafar e sadiq pa chaayi
gham e baqir mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jis se rahmatein hoti thi naazil
ye ummat hogayi uski hi qaatil
bata aakhir hua kya tujh ko haasil
mawaddat kaisi ummat ne nibhayi
gham e baqir mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
lehad mein fatema ko phir rulaya
sutoon e rauza e hyder hilaya
hishaam e bad nasab ne zulm dhaaya
duhaai ya muhamed hai duhaai
gham e baqir mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
sada e haye wawaila lagaate
imam e ilm par aansu bahaate
chale hai marsiya qudsi sunaate
hai ta aflaak nauhon ki rasaayi
gham e baqir mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
shahe yasrab zara khidmaat dekhein
di ummat ne nayi saughaat dekhein
gham o aazaar hai din raat dekhein
luti phir fatema ki hai kamaayi
gham e baqir mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
sitam aisa hua aflaak roye
lehad mein sayyed e laulaak roye
hue jafar gareeban chaak roye
gira dil par hai ehsaas e judaai
gham e baqir mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
wila e hyder e safdar ki khaatir
shahe mazloom ke maqtal ka zaakir
hua ruqsat wo karbal ka musafir
aziyat jis ne bachpan se uthaayi
gham e baqir mein...
items.author: Wila Hallauri

items.title: Halchal hai fauje
items.body:
teero pe teer naizo par naize chalaate hai
halchal hai fauje shaam mein abbas aate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kya waqt pad gaya hai mohamed ki aal par
chadar nahi hai baalon se moo ko chupate hai
halchal hai fauje…
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ko maa chupati hai jhuk jhuk ke godh mein
qaimon ko tod tod kar jab teer aate hai
halchal hai fauje…
<<DIVIDER>>
dil pani pani hota hai bachon ka pyas se
sookhi zaban hoton par asghar phirate hai
halchal hai fauje…
<<DIVIDER>>
ghode daudaye sham se lashkar jo aate hai
kam umr bache qaimon mein ghabraye jaate hai
halchal hai fauje…
<<DIVIDER>>
dunya ko de diya hai sabak ye hussain ne

halchal hai fauje…
<<DIVIDER>>
allah re sabr sayyede waala ka dekhle
ran mein jawan bete ka laasha uthate hai
halchal hai fauje…

items.title: Haye jis kurte
items.body:
haye jis kurte may zindan talak laayi gayi
ay sakina tu usi kurte may dafnayi gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
tere kano se na ruk paaya lahoo ka behna
kab ruka shaam talak haye tamache lagna
har qadam haye aziyat tumhe pahunchayi gayi
haye jis kurte may...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhko zindan may sar baap ka dikhlaya gaya
imtehan baap ki chahat ka tumhe dena pada
jitna tu royi koi bachi na rulwayi gayi
haye jis kurte may...
<<DIVIDER>>
jitna mayyat pe teri barsi ye ghurbat bibi
aise dafnayi nahi jaati hai koi bachi
do bandhe haaton se tu qabr talak laayi gayi
haye jis kurte may...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi gardan pe rasan aati kabhi jism bandha
haye thi kaisi tasalli ki chini teri rida
har nafas ek qayamat tere sar dhaayi gayi
haye jis kurte may...
<<DIVIDER>>
naam sunte hi tera bhai chala aata hai
shimr lagta hai aziyat tumhe phir deta hai
jab kabhi teri musibat kahin dohrayi gayi
haye jis kurte may...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere dada ne to qaatil ko pilaya pani
aur mere baba ne haiwano ko baksha pani
par ek sakina hi meri pani ko tarsayi gayi
haye jis kurte may...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri khwahar ko kaneezi may koi maangta tha
aur koi raah may sadqa isay dikhlata tha
poti zahra ki aur bazaaron may bulwayi gayi
haye jis kurte may...
<<DIVIDER>>
thi dua baba ki mujhse na bichadne paaye
itna mai chahoo mere bin na usay neend aaye
sheh se rehan aur mubarak wohi chudwayi gayi
haye jis kurte may...

items.title: Hussain aap ki ghurbat
items.body:
hussain aap ka gham kitna nafsiyati hai
zara si baat bahot dayr tak rulaati hai
hussain aap ki ghurbat bahot rulaati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda gawah mere dil ko roze ashoora
hussain aap ki ghurbat bahot rulaati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kadakti dhoop wo garmi wo pyaas ka ghalba
hussain aap ki ghurbat bahot rulaati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
musafirat mein ye ghurbat bhi aap ne dekhi
hussain aap ke dil par na jaane kya guzri
bana jab aap ka mehman hurr mere maula
nahi tha aap ke qaime mein boond bhar pani
kareem aap ka mehman reh gaya pyasa
khuda gawah mere dil ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
bala ke dasht mein ibne hassan ke tukde thay
zameen e garm pe qasim ke tan ke tukde thay
wo jisko aap ne khud baap ban ke paala tha
nazar ke saamne us gulbadan ke tukde thay
uthaya khaak se rote huwe har ek tukda
khuda gawah mere dil ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi furaat kabhi arz e nainawa royi
hussain aap ki haalat pe karbala royi
na royi apne dularon ki laash par zainab
magar wo aap ki ghurbat pa jaa ba jaa royi
behen ne aap ki bas aap par kiya girya
khuda gawah mere dil ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
jigar tha aap ka ay ibne faatahe khyber
akele aap thay kadiyal jawan ke laashe par
jhinjhodti hai bahot aap ki wo tanhaai
uthaya aap ne peeri mein laasha e akbar
nahi tha aap ka pardes mein koi apna
khuda gawah mere dil ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
dilayr zaigham o jarrar mar gaya ran mein
hussain aap ka ghamkhwar mar gaya ran mein
jo haath aap ki quwwat thay ay mere maula
kate wo haath alamdar mar gaya ran mein
jari ne aap ke zaanu pe apna dam toda
khuda gawah mere dil ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
salaam aap ki himmat ko sayyed e mazloom
chida hai teer se asghar ka jis ghadi hulqoom
dahaade maar ke roya hai sabr khud us dam
hua jab aap ke haathon pa munqalib masoom
wo be-zaban pisar aur wo teer e seh shoba
khuda gawah mere dil ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
jisay sukoon bataate thay aap khud apna
wo jisko aap ke seene pe chain milta tha
sakina aap se jis dam juda hui hogi
kaleja aap ka us waqt phat gaya hoga
wo char saal ki bacchi ko chod kar jaana
khuda gawah mere dil ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
qadam qadam pe rulaya hai shaam waalon ne
musafirat mein sataya hai shaam waalon ne
kahan ye zulm kisi bewatan pe hota hai
jo zulm aap pe dhaaya hai shaam waalon ne
rula rula ke layeeno ne aap ko maara
khuda gawah mere dil ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo bekasi wo musibat wo aalam e ghurbat
paraya des zaeefi wo pyaas ki shiddat
wo dard aap ka kaise raqam kare waiz
bayan ali se na hogi wo aap ki haalat
lahoo ke ashk rulaata hai bas yehi jumla
khuda gawah mere dil ko...

items.title: Jangal may bhare
items.body:
jangal mein bhare ghar ko luta aayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
abid ko kisi tarha bacha laayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
<<DIVIDER>>
bandwake rasan haaton mein aur khutbe sunake
ghar baar lutaake
dewaar bade kufr ke dha aayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
jangal mein bhare…
<<DIVIDER>>
jis shehr mein shehzadiyon ki tarha rahi thi
naazon se pali thi
sar nange usi shehr mein ho aayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
jangal mein bhare…
<<DIVIDER>>
jo hijre padar mein rahe har waqt pareshan
soyi nahi ek aan
us bachi ko zindan mein sulaa aayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
jangal mein bhare…
<<DIVIDER>>
dhaaras thi bahot bhai ko jis bhai ke dam se
dil phat'ta hai gham se
saahil pe akela usay chod aayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
jangal mein bhare…
<<DIVIDER>>
cheh maah ke asghar ko bhi jhoole ke bajaye
dukh dard chipaaye
aaghosh mein turbat ke sula aayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
jangal mein bhare…
<<DIVIDER>>
thay aun o mohamad jo meri ankhon ke taare
mamu ke dulaare
qurban unhe bhai par kar aayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
jangal mein bhare…
<<DIVIDER>>
tha akbare nashaad jo is ghar ka ujaala
wo gaysuon wala
marqad mein akela usay chod aayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
jangal mein bhare…
<<DIVIDER>>
naadim hai bahot laa saki qasim ko na humraah
wa hasrato darda
kubra ko magar saath liye aayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
jangal mein bhare…
<<DIVIDER>>
pani jo piye ehle watan pyaas na bhule
moo ashkon se dhole
kehne ko ye bhai ka payaam aayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
jangal mein bhare…
<<DIVIDER>>
manzar wo bhula sakti nahi ta dame aakhir
hai kehne se qaasir
jo shaam ke darbar mein dekh aayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
jangal mein bhare…
<<DIVIDER>>
kis waqt khuda jaane qadam nikle thay ghar se
chaadar chini sar se
ab tak na masayab se nikal payi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
jangal mein bhare…
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir pe ab royega ta hashr zamana
hai gham ka fasana
majlis ki bina shaam mein daal aayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
jangal mein bhare…
<<DIVIDER>>
reh jayega akhtar ufaqe gham pe tera naam
kya khoob hai inaam
nowha tera sun'ne ke liye aayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
jangal mein bhare…

ay mere laal hussain

allah rehm farma ek bezuban ki mayyat

bachon ko apne maayein sarwar pe waarti hai

hai jin ke ghar se parda unko nabi ke dushman

ek ghamzada tasavvur may apne laadle ko
lori suna rahi hai jhoola jhula jhula kar
karti hai bain zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay dayam aur yazdan sarwar ke qatilon ne
dukhiyon ko maar daala paidal chala chala kar
karti hai bain zehra...

items.body:
bataati jaati hai mafhoom e karbala sab ko
hussain is liye laaye thay saath zainab ko
<<DIVIDER>>
guzaari bhai ke laashe pe raat wo zainab
na paayi ranj se jis ne nijaat wo zainab
irada jiska hai koh e sabaat wo zainab
bajaye khud hai jo ek kainaat wo zainab
bataati jaati hai mafhoom e karbala sab ko
hussain is liye laaye thay saath zainab ko
bataati jaati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghamon ka baar uthaati hui chali zainab
khuda ki raah dikhaati hui chali zainab
lahoo se shamma jalaati hui chali zainab
yazeediyat ko mitaati hui chali zainab
dayaar e shaam ka gham zabt kar gayi zainab
yazeediyat ko kuchal kar guzar gayi zainab
bataati jaati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mila jo hukm ke jao yazeed ke darbar
ali ki beti ne jaane se kar diya inkaar
phupi se kehne lagay ro ke abid e bemaar
ke hum aseer hai is waqt bekas o nachaar
ye zulm shaam ki manzil hai is ko sar kar lo
kisi tarha shab e gham ko phupi sehar kar lo
bataati jaati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye socha zainab e muztar ne nange sar hoo mai
ajeeb waqt hai mujh par ke darbadar hoo mai
hazaar bekas o majboor bhi agar hoo mai
yazeediyat ke liye ab bhi dard e sar hoo mai
ali ki beti hoo qasr e yazeed dhaa doongi
yazeed kaun hai mai kaun hoo bata doongi
bataati jaati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri majaal ke sar nange tu kare tash'heer
hamare sar pe azal se hai chadar e tatheer
jala ke khana e zehra hamein kiya hai aseer
aur apne aap ko kehta hai momino ka ameer
ye keh ke itrat e uqba se tu hua mehroom
teri nijaat ki zid ban gaye hai hum mazloom
bataati jaati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
yazeed paikar e zillat hai ay musalmano
yazeed dushman e ummat hai ay musalmano
yazeediyat hi aziyat hai ay musalmano
urooj ki jo zaroorat hai ay musalmano
yazeediyat ko mitao isay bala samjho
khuda ke waaste mafhoom e karbala samjho
bataati jaati hai...

items.title: Aakhri Bar Kaleje Se Laga Lo Baba
items.body:
Tamheed
Le Li Zainab Se Jo Shabbir Ne Maqtal Ki Raza,
Ho Ke Rukhsat Chale Khaime Se Shah-e-Karb-o-Bala.
Pehle To Thaam Liya Baap Ka Daman Aur Phir,
Jod Kar Haathon Ko Masoom Sakina Ne Kaha,
<<DIVIDER>>
Haaye Baba Mere Baba, Haaye Baba Mere Baba.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aakhiri Baar Kaleje Se Laga Lo Baba,
God Mein Apni Sakina Ko Utha Lo Baba.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aap Ke Saath Meri Neend Chali Jaayegi,
Phir Kabhi Laut Ke Aankhon Mein Nahin Aayegi.
Apne Seene Pe Phir Ek Baar Sula Lo Baba.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kitne Din Beet Gaye Chhode Hue Apna Watan,
Dil Tadapta Hai Mera Yaad Jo Aati Hai Behan.
Ab To Sughra Ko Madine Se Bula Lo Baba.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ja Rahe Ho To Mujhe Itna Batate Jana,
Neend Aayegi Sakina Ko Kahan Par Tanha.
Jaate Jaate Mujhe Seene Pe Sula Lo Baba.
<<DIVIDER>>
Maine Akbar Ke Kaleje Ko Nikalte Dekha,
Khoon-e-Besheer Ko Bhi Maine Ubalte Dekha.
Dam Nikal Jaayega Mera, Mujhe Sambhalo Baba.
<<DIVIDER>>
Main Judai Ka Ye Sadma Na Utha Paungi,
Yaad Mein Aap Ki Ghut Ghut Ke Main Mar Jaungi.
Aur Kuch Der Mere Naaz Utha Lo Baba.
<<DIVIDER>>
Baap Se Ro Ke Sharafat Ye Sakina Ne Kaha,
Chhod Kar Mujhko Yahan Ran Ko Na Jao Tanha.
Laaj Rakh Lijiye, Meri Baat Na Taalo Baba.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aakhiri Baar Kaleje Se Laga Lo Baba.

items.title: Allaho Akbar Ya Hussain
items.body:
ALLAHU AKBAR YA HUSSAIN(4)
Zere khanjar Ya Hussain(2)
Noke sina par Ya Hussain....
ALLAHU AKBAR YA HUSSAIN(4)
1) Marhala hai faisle ka muntazir Tauhid hai,
Karde sajda ek raazi, par khuda ki deed hai
Sabse badtar Ya Hussain(2)
Kul ke barabar Ya Hussain
ALLAHU AKBAR YA HUSSAIN(4)
2)De chuka tu sar kata kar taa abad deen ko amaa,
Ruk gayi jumbish zamee ki kaap utha aasman,
Rab pukara kab hai koi(2)
Tera humsar Ya Hussain
ALLAHU AKBAR YA HUSSAIN(4)
3) Noke naiza ke musafir tu azeemo sarbuland,
Bibiyon ke sar khule hai kyu teri ankhein hai band,
Aankh hai Sajjad ki(2)
Khun Ka samandar Ya Hussain
ALLAHU AKBAR YA HUSSAIN(4)
4) Akhri sajda woh tera aur musalla Karbala,
Roze Ashura hua kaabe ka qibla Karbala,
Karbala hai woh jahan(2)
Bikhra tera ghar Ya Hussain
ALLAHU AKBAR YA HUSSAIN(4)
5) Sin fakad cheh maah ka dekho magar uska Shaoor,
Janta hai teer khaakar muskurana hai zaroor,
Fatahe Karbobala hai(2)
Tera Asghar ya Hussain
ALLAHU AKBAR YA HUSSAIN(4)
6) Isne kis tarha sameta Qasime naushah ko,
Isne kis tarha se roka lab pe aati aah ko,
Ek- ek tukda pukara(2)
Aahein karkar Ya Hussain
ALLAHU AKBAR YA HUSSAIN(4)
7) Ye agar mehshar nahi hai phir bhala mehshar hai kya,
Hai khule sar binte Zehra ye hai mehshar se siva,
Gair ki har ek nazar hai(2)
Misle khanjar Ya Hussain
ALLAHU AKBAR YA HUSSAIN(4)
8) Lehed me "Abid" se tere kya sawaal aur kya jawab,
Saath rakhwalunga sirhane mai nauhe ki kitaab,
Kuch nahi likha hai likha(2)
Zindagi bhar Ya Hussain
ALLAHU AKBAR YA HUSSAIN(4)
